   2: 
   3: ## Validation des entrÃ©es
   4: 
   5: - Toujours valider les paramÃ¨tres de requÃªte avec Zod
   6: - VÃ©rifier les types et formats avant traitement
   7: 
   8: ## Adaptation des entrÃ©es non structurÃ©es
   9: 
  10: - Ne jamais connecter directement une entree libre (email, texte, OCR) a une route metier
  11: - Imposer le flux: Input brut -> Adaptation (IA/parsing) -> Draft structure -> Validation humaine -> Appel API
  12: - Les routes API ne doivent accepter que des payloads structures et valides
  13: - Si les donnees extraites sont incompletes, retourner un statut de validation requise (pas de creation metier)
  14: - Conserver la source brute (ex: rawEmail) pour audit, sans exposer de donnees sensibles dans les logs
  15: 
  16: ## Gestion des erreurs
  17: 
  18: - Retourner des codes HTTP appropriÃ©s (400, 401, 403, 404, 500)
  19: - Ne jamais exposer les stack traces en production
  20: - Logger les erreurs avec le contexte nÃ©cessaire
  21: 
  22: ## Authentification
  23: 
  24: - VÃ©rifier la session NextAuth sur toutes les routes protÃ©gÃ©es
  25: - Valider les permissions utilisateur (rÃ´le, abonnement)
  26: 
  27: ## Rate limiting
  28: 
  29: - VÃ©rifier la prÃ©sence du rate limiting sur les endpoints sensibles
  30: - Utiliser Upstash Redis pour le tracking
  31: 
  32: ## Webhooks
  33: 
  34: - Valider les signatures (Stripe, WhatsApp, etc.)
  35: - ImplÃ©menter la dÃ©duplication avec checksum
  36: - GÃ©rer l'idempotence avec messageId unique

  26: function toSeverity(value: string | null | undefined): 'critique' | 'haute' | 'normale' {
  27:   const normalized = (value || '').toLowerCase();
  28:   if (normalized === 'critical' || normalized === 'critique') return 'critique';
  29:   if (normalized === 'high' || normalized === 'haute') return 'haute';
  30:   return 'normale';

  32: 
  33: function toSla(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  34:   if (!value) return 'Sans echeance';
  35:   const due = new Date(value);
  36:   if (isNaN(due.getTime())) return 'Sans echeance';
  37: 
  38:   const diffMs = due.getTime() - Date.now();
  39:   if (diffMs <= 0) return 'Echu';
  40:   const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
  41:   if (diffHours < 24) return `Echeance dans ${diffHours}h`;
  42:   return `Echeance dans ${Math.round(diffHours / 24)}j`;
  43: }

  18:   if (normalized === 'bloque' || normalized === 'retard') return 'critique';
  19:   if (normalized === 'nouveau' || normalized === 'en_cours') return 'haute';
  20:   return 'normale';

  48: function normalizeStatus(value: string | null | undefined): Exclude<DossierStatus, 'all'> {
  49:   const normalized = (value || '').toLowerCase().replace('-', '_');
  50: 
  51:   if (normalized === 'en_cours' || normalized === 'en cours') return 'en_cours';
  52:   if (normalized === 'nouveau') return 'nouveau';
  53:   if (normalized === 'bloque') return 'bloque';
  54:   if (normalized === 'archive') return 'archive';
  55:   if (normalized === 'clos' || normalized === 'cloture' || normalized === 'ferme') return 'clos';
  56: 
  57:   return 'en_cours';
  58: }
  59: 
  60: function normalizePriority(value: string | null | undefined): DossierPriority {
  61:   return (value || '').toLowerCase() === 'haute' ? 'haute' : 'normale';
  62: }
  63: 
  64: function toUiDossier(item: DossierListItem): Dossier {
  65:   const clientName = [item.client?.firstName, item.client?.lastName].filter(Boolean).join(' ').trim();
  66:   const updatedAtIso = item.updatedAt || item.dateCreation || null;
  67: 
  68:   return {
  69:     id: item.id,
  70:     numero: item.numero,
  71:     client: clientName.length > 0 ? clientName : 'Client inconnu',
  72:     objet: item.description?.trim() || item.typeDossier || 'Sans objet',
  73:     status: normalizeStatus(item.statut),
  74:     priority: normalizePriority(item.priorite),
  75:     updatedAt: updatedAtIso ? new Date(updatedAtIso).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR') : 'Date inconnue',
  76:   };
  77: }

  79: export default function DossiersPage({ params }: DossiersPageProps) {

  91: 
  92:   useEffect(() => {

  96:       try {

 104:           sortOrder,

 107:         setDossiers(response.data.map(toUiDossier));
 108:         setTotalPages(Math.max(1, response.pagination.pages));

 110:       } catch (fetchError) {

_archive\frontend\app\[locale]\tasks\page.tsx

   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
   4: import { CheckCircle2, Filter, Search } from 'lucide-react';
   5: import { listTasks, updateTask, type TaskApiItem, type TaskAssignee } from '@/lib/services/tasks-api';
   6: 
   7: type TaskStatus = 'todo' | 'in-progress' | 'blocked' | 'done';
   8: type TaskPriority = 'critique' | 'haute' | 'normale';
   9: 
  10: type TaskItem = {
  11:   id: string;
  12:   title: string;
  13:   dossier: string;
  14:   owner: string;
  15:   dueIn: string;
  16:   status: TaskStatus;
  17:   priority: TaskPriority;
  18:   assignedToId?: string | null;
  19: };
  20: 
  21: const statusToApi: Record<TaskStatus, 'TODO' | 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'BLOCKED' | 'DONE'> = {
  22:   todo: 'TODO',
  23:   'in-progress': 'IN_PROGRESS',
  24:   blocked: 'BLOCKED',
  25:   done: 'DONE',
  26: };
  27: 
  28: const priorityToApi: Record<TaskPriority, 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL'> = {
  29:   normale: 'MEDIUM',
  30:   haute: 'HIGH',
  31:   critique: 'CRITICAL',
  32: };
  33: 
  34: function normalizeStatus(value: string | null | undefined): TaskStatus {
  35:   const normalized = (value || '').toLowerCase();
  36:   if (normalized === 'in_progress' || normalized === 'in-progress' || normalized === 'doing') return 'in-progress';
  37:   if (normalized === 'blocked') return 'blocked';
  38:   if (normalized === 'done' || normalized === 'completed') return 'done';
  39:   return 'todo';
  40: }
  41: 
  42: function normalizePriority(value: string | null | undefined): TaskPriority {
  43:   const normalized = (value || '').toLowerCase();
  44:   if (normalized === 'critical' || normalized === 'critique') return 'critique';
  45:   if (normalized === 'high' || normalized === 'haute') return 'haute';
  46:   return 'normale';
  47: }
  48: 
  49: function toDueIn(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  50:   if (!value) return 'Sans echeance';
  51:   const due = new Date(value);
  52:   if (isNaN(due.getTime())) return 'Sans echeance';
  53: 
  54:   const diffMs = due.getTime() - Date.now();
  55:   if (diffMs <= 0) return 'Echu';
  56: 
  57:   const diffHours = Math.round(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
  58:   if (diffHours < 24) return `${diffHours}h`;
  59: 
  60:   const diffDays = Math.round(diffHours / 24);
  61:   return `${diffDays}j`;
  62: }
  63: 
  64: function toUiTask(task: TaskApiItem): TaskItem {
  65:   return {
  66:     id: task.id,
  67:     title: task.title || 'Tache sans titre',
  68:     dossier: task.case?.numero || task.case?.title || 'Sans dossier',
  69:     owner: task.assignedTo?.name || task.assignedTo?.email || 'Equipe',
  70:     dueIn: toDueIn(task.dueDate),
  71:     status: normalizeStatus(task.status),
  72:     priority: normalizePriority(task.priority),
  73:     assignedToId: task.assignedToId,
  74:   };
  75: }
  76: 
  77: const statusLabel: Record<TaskStatus, string> = {
  78:   todo: 'A faire',
  79:   'in-progress': 'En cours',
  80:   blocked: 'Bloquee',
  81:   done: 'Terminee',
  82: };
  83: 
  84: const statusClass: Record<TaskStatus, string> = {
  85:   todo: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700',
  86:   'in-progress': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700',
  87:   blocked: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700',
  88:   done: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700',
  89: };
  90: 
  91: const priorityClass: Record<TaskPriority, string> = {
  92:   critique: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700',
  93:   haute: 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-700',
  94:   normale: 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700',
  95: };
  96: 
  97: export default function TasksPage() {
  98:   const [assignees, setAssignees] = useState<TaskAssignee[]>([]);
  99:   const [tasks, setTasks] = useState<TaskItem[]>([]);
 100:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
 101:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
 102:   const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
 103:   const [savingTaskId, setSavingTaskId] = useState<string | null>(null);
 104:   const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
 105:   const [status, setStatus] = useState<'all' | TaskStatus>('all');
 106:   const [priority, setPriority] = useState<'all' | TaskPriority>('all');
 107:   const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<'dueDate' | 'createdAt' | 'priority' | 'status'>('dueDate');
 108:   const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('asc');
 109: 
 110:   useEffect(() => {
 111:     let active = true;
 112: 
 113:     const run = async () => {
 114:       try {
 115:         setLoading(true);
 116:         setError(null);
 117:         const response = await listTasks({
 118:           sortBy,
 119:           sortOrder,
 120:           includeAssignees: true,
 121:         });
 122:         if (!active) return;
 123:         setTasks(response.data.map(toUiTask));
 124:         setAssignees(response.assignees || []);
 125:       } catch (fetchError) {
 126:         if (!active) return;
 127:         const message = fetchError instanceof Error ? fetchError.message : 'Erreur de chargement des taches';
 128:         setError(message);
 129:       } finally {
 130:         if (active) setLoading(false);
 131:       }
 132:     };
 133: 
 134:     run();
 135: 
 136:     return () => {
 137:       active = false;
 138:     };
 139:   }, [sortBy, sortOrder]);
 140: 
 141:   useEffect(() => {
 142:     if (!toast) return;
 143:     const timer = setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2500);
 144:     return () => clearTimeout(timer);
 145:   }, [toast]);
 146: 
 147:   const filteredTasks = useMemo(() => {
 148:     const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();
 149: 
 150:     return tasks.filter((task) => {
 151:       const matchesStatus = status === 'all' || task.status === status;
 152:       const matchesPriority = priority === 'all' || task.priority === priority;
 153:       const matchesQuery =
 154:         normalizedQuery.length === 0 ||
 155:         task.title.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
 156:         task.dossier.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
 157:         task.owner.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery);
 158: 
 159:       return matchesStatus && matchesPriority && matchesQuery;
 160:     });
 161:   }, [tasks, priority, query, status]);
 162: 
 163:   const handleStatusChange = async (taskId: string, newStatus: TaskStatus) => {
 164:     const previous = tasks;
 165:     setSavingTaskId(taskId);
 166:     setError(null);
 167: 
 168:     setTasks((current) => current.map((task) => (task.id === taskId ? { ...task, status: newStatus } : task)));
 169: 
 170:     try {
 171:       await updateTask(taskId, { status: statusToApi[newStatus] });
 172:       setToast('Statut mis a jour');
 173:     } catch (mutationError) {
 174:       const message = mutationError instanceof Error ? mutationError.message : 'Erreur de mise a jour du statut';
 175:       setError(message);
 176:       setTasks(previous);
 177:     } finally {
 178:       setSavingTaskId(null);
 179:     }
 180:   };
 181: 
 182:   const handlePriorityChange = async (taskId: string, newPriority: TaskPriority) => {
 183:     const previous = tasks;
 184:     setSavingTaskId(taskId);
 185:     setError(null);
 186: 
 187:     setTasks((current) => current.map((task) => (task.id === taskId ? { ...task, priority: newPriority } : task)));
 188: 
 189:     try {
 190:       await updateTask(taskId, { priority: priorityToApi[newPriority] });
 191:       setToast('Priorite mise a jour');
 192:     } catch (mutationError) {
 193:       const message = mutationError instanceof Error ? mutationError.message : 'Erreur de mise a jour de la priorite';
 194:       setError(message);
 195:       setTasks(previous);
 196:     } finally {
 197:       setSavingTaskId(null);
 198:     }
 199:   };
 200: 
 201:   const handleAssigneeChange = async (taskId: string, assigneeId: string) => {
 202:     const previous = tasks;
 203:     setSavingTaskId(taskId);
 204:     setError(null);
 205: 
 206:     const assignee = assignees.find((item) => item.id === assigneeId);
 207: 
 208:     setTasks((current) =>
 209:       current.map((task) =>
 210:         task.id === taskId
 211:           ? {
 212:               ...task,
 213:               assignedToId: assigneeId,
 214:               owner: assignee?.name || assignee?.email || 'Equipe',
 215:             }

   1: /**
   2:  * AI Session Detail API (Phase 8)

   4:  * GET /api/ai/sessions/[id]
   5:  * - RÃ©cupÃ¨re historique complet d'une session
   6:  *
   7:  * DELETE /api/ai/sessions/[id]
   8:  * - Termine une session
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  12: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  13: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
  14: import { AIAssistantService } from '@/lib/services/ai-assistant.service';
  15: 
  16: const aiAssistant = new AIAssistantService();
  17: 
  18: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  19:   try {
  20:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  21: 
  22:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const sessionData = await aiAssistant.getSession(params.id);
  27: 
  28:     if (!sessionData) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Session non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     // VÃ©rifier ownership
  33:     if (sessionData.session.userId !== session.user.id) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     return NextResponse.json({
  38:       success: true,
  39:       session: {
  40:         id: sessionData.session.id,
  41:         title: sessionData.session.title,
  42:         dossierId: sessionData.session.dossierId,
  43:         dossier: sessionData.session.dossier,
  44:         createdAt: sessionData.session.createdAt,
  45:         updatedAt: sessionData.session.updatedAt,
  46:         endedAt: sessionData.session.endedAt,
  47:       },
  48:       messages: sessionData.messages.map(m => ({
  49:         id: m.id,
  50:         role: m.role,
  51:         content: m.content,
  52:         metadata: m.metadata,
  53:         createdAt: m.createdAt,
  54:       })),
  55:     });
  56:   } catch (error: any) {
  57:     console.error('Get session error:', error);
  58:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  59:   }
  60: }
  61: 
  62: export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  63:   try {
  64:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  65: 
  66:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  67:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  68:     }
  69: 
  70:     await aiAssistant.endSession({
  71:       sessionId: params.id,
  72:       userId: session.user.id,
  73:       tenantId: session.user.tenantId || 'default',
  74:     });
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  77:   } catch (error: any) {
  78:     console.error('End session error:', error);

   1: /**
   2:  * POST /api/analysis/execute
   3:  *
   4:  * Executes the complete analysis pipeline
   5:  * - Retrieves units from Prisma
   6:  * - Calls Python backend
   7:  * - Persists EventLog
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: 
  12: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const { tenantId, unitStatus = 'RECEIVED', limit = 100 } = await req.json();
  15: 
  16:     if (!tenantId) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId required' }, { status: 400 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     // Call Python backend to execute pipeline
  21:     const pythonResponse = await fetch('http://localhost:5000/analysis/execute', {
  22:       method: 'POST',
  23:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  24:       body: JSON.stringify({
  25:         tenant_id: tenantId,
  26:         unit_status: unitStatus,
  27:         limit,
  28:         persist: true,
  29:       }),
  30:     });
  31: 
  32:     if (!pythonResponse.ok) {
  33:       const errorText = await pythonResponse.text();
  34:       console.error('Python backend error:', errorText);
  35:       throw new Error(`Python backend error: ${pythonResponse.statusText}`);
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     const result = await pythonResponse.json();
  39: 
  40:     return NextResponse.json({
  41:       success: true,
  42:       events_generated: result.events_generated,
  43:       duplicates_detected: result.duplicates_detected,
  44:       processing_time_seconds: result.processing_time_seconds,
  45:       rules_applied: result.rules_applied || [],
  46:       errors: result.errors || [],
  47:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  48:     });
  49:   } catch (error) {
  50:     console.error('[ANALYSIS/EXECUTE]', error);
  51:     return NextResponse.json(
  52:       { error: 'Pipeline execution failed', details: String(error) },
  53:       { status: 500 }
  54:     );
  55:   }
  56: }

   1: import { getServerSession } from "next-auth";
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
   3: import Stripe from "stripe";
   4: import { authOptions } from "@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route";
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: 
   7: const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
   8:   apiVersion: "2026-01-28.clover",
   9: });
  10: 
  11: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: "Non authentifiÃ©" }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     // Get subscription
  20:     const subscription = await prisma.billingSubscription.findUnique({
  21:       where: { userId: session.user.id },
  22:     });
  23: 
  24:     if (!subscription || !subscription.stripeSubscriptionId) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: "Abonnement non trouvÃ©" }, { status: 404 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     // Cancel at period end
  29:     await stripe.subscriptions.update(subscription.stripeSubscriptionId, {
  30:       cancel_at_period_end: true,
  31:     });
  32: 
  33:     // Update in database
  34:     await prisma.billingSubscription.update({
  35:       where: { id: subscription.id },
  36:       data: {
  37:         cancelAtPeriodEnd: true,
  38:       },
  39:     });
  40: 
  41:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  42:   } catch (error: any) {
  43:     console.error("Error canceling subscription:", error);
  44:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  45:   }
  46: }

_archive\frontend\app\api\billing\checkout\route.ts

   1: import { getServerSession } from "next-auth";
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
   3: import Stripe from "stripe";
   4: import { authOptions } from "@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route";
   5: 
   6: const stripe = new Stripe(process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!, {
   7:   apiVersion: "2026-01-28.clover",
   8: });
   9: 
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json(
  16:         { error: "Non authentifiÃ©" },
  17:         { status: 401 }
  18:       );
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const { priceId, billingCycle } = await req.json();
  22: 
  23:     if (!priceId) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json(
  25:         { error: "Price ID requis" },
  26:         { status: 400 }
  27:       );
  28:     }
  29: 
  30: 
  31:     // Create or retrieve Stripe customer
  32:     const customerEmail = session.user.email;
  33:     let customer: Stripe.Customer;
  34: 
  35:     // Check if customer already exists
  36:     const existingCustomers = await stripe.customers.list({
  37:       email: customerEmail,
  38:       limit: 1,
  39:     });
  40: 
  41:     if (existingCustomers.data.length > 0) {
  42:       customer = existingCustomers.data[0];
  43:     } else {
  44:       customer = await stripe.customers.create({
  45:         email: customerEmail,
  46:         metadata: {
  47:           userId: session.user.id || "",
  48:         },
  49:       });
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // Create Checkout Session
  53:     const checkoutSession = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
  54:       customer: customer.id,
  55:       payment_method_types: ["card"],
  56:       line_items: [
  57:         {
  58:           price: priceId,
  59:           quantity: 1,
  60:         },
  61:       ],
  62:       mode: "subscription",
  63:       success_url: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/dashboard/billing?success=true&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
  64:       cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/pricing?canceled=true`,
  65:       metadata: {
  66:         userId: session.user.id || "",
  67:         billingCycle,
  68:       },
  69:       subscription_data: {
  70:         trial_period_days: 14, // 14-day free trial
  71:         metadata: {
  72:           userId: session.user.id || "",
  73:         },
  74:       },
  75:       allow_promotion_codes: true,
  76:     });
  77: 
  78:     return NextResponse.json({ url: checkoutSession.url });
  79:   } catch (error: any) {
  80:     console.error("Stripe checkout error:", error);
  81:     return NextResponse.json(
  82:       { error: error.message || "Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation de la session" },
  83:       { status: 500 }
  84:     );
  85:   }
  86: }

_archive\frontend\app\api\cron\purge-legal-proofs\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Route CRON - Purge Automatique Preuves LÃ©gales
   3:  *
   4:  * ExÃ©cutÃ© mensuellement via Vercel Cron Jobs
   5:  * Supprime preuves > 10 ans (sauf contentieux)
   6:  *
   7:  * SÃ©curitÃ©: Requiert token CRON_SECRET
   8:  *
   9:  * @route GET /api/cron/purge-legal-proofs
  10:  */
  11: 
  12: import { getLegalProofRetentionStats, purgeLegalProofs } from '@/lib/cron/legal-proof-purge';
  13: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  14: 
  15: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
  16: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
  17: export const maxDuration = 300; // 5 minutes max (Vercel Pro)
  18: 
  19: /**
  20:  * Purge CRON - ExÃ©cution mensuelle
  21:  *
  22:  * @example
  23:  * ```bash
  24:  * # Test local
  25:  * curl -H "Authorization: Bearer your_secret" \
  26:  *   http://localhost:3000/api/cron/purge-legal-proofs
  27:  *
  28:  * # Production (Vercel Cron automatic)
  29:  * # Schedule: "0 2 1 * *" (1er du mois Ã  2h)
  30:  * ```
  31:  */
  32: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  33:   const startTime = Date.now();
  34: 
  35:   try {
  36:     // 1. SÃ©curitÃ©: VÃ©rifier token Vercel Cron
  37:     const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  38:     const expectedToken = `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`;
  39: 
  40:     if (!process.env.CRON_SECRET) {
  41:       console.error('[CRON] CRON_SECRET non configurÃ©');
  42:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Server misconfiguration' }, { status: 500 });
  43:     }
  44: 
  45:     if (authHeader !== expectedToken) {
  46:       console.warn('[CRON] Tentative accÃ¨s non autorisÃ©e');
  47:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     console.log('[CRON] Purge Legal Proofs - DÃ©marrage');
  51: 
  52:     // 2. Statistiques prÃ©-purge
  53:     const statsBefore = await getLegalProofRetentionStats();
  54:     console.log('[CRON] Stats avant purge:', statsBefore);
  55: 
  56:     // 3. ExÃ©cuter purge (production)
  57:     const purgeResult = await purgeLegalProofs({
  58:       dryRun: false,
  59:       archiveBeforeDelete: true,
  60:       ignoreActiveContentieux: true,
  61:       retentionYears: 10,
  62:     });
  63: 
  64:     // 4. Statistiques post-purge
  65:     const statsAfter = await getLegalProofRetentionStats();
  66:     console.log('[CRON] Stats aprÃ¨s purge:', statsAfter);
  67: 
  68:     // 5. RÃ©sultat
  69:     const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
  70:     const response = {
  71:       success: true,
  72:       purgeResult,
  73:       statsBefore,
  74:       statsAfter,
  75:       executionTime,
  76:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  77:     };
  78: 
  79:     console.log(
  80:       `[CRON] Purge terminÃ©e: ${purgeResult.deleted} preuves supprimÃ©es en ${executionTime}ms`
  81:     );
  82: 
  83:     return NextResponse.json(response, { status: 200 });
  84:   } catch (error) {
  85:     const executionTime = Date.now() - startTime;
  86:     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
  87: 
  88:     console.error('[CRON] Erreur purge:', message);
  89:     console.error('[CRON] Stack:', error instanceof Error ? error.stack : 'N/A');
  90: 
  91:     // Sentry reporting (si configurÃ©)
  92:     if (typeof window === 'undefined' && global.Sentry) {
  93:       global.Sentry.captureException(error, {
  94:         tags: {
  95:           cron: 'purge-legal-proofs',
  96:         },
  97:         extra: {
  98:           executionTime,
  99:         },
 100:       });
 101:     }
 102: 
 103:     return NextResponse.json(
 104:       {
 105:         success: false,
 106:         error: message,
 107:         executionTime,
 108:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 109:       },
 110:       { status: 500 }
 111:     );
 112:   }
 113: }
 114: 
 115: /**

 118:  *
 119:  * @example

 121:  * curl -H "Authorization: Bearer your_secret" \
 122:  *   -X POST \
 123:  *   http://localhost:3000/api/cron/purge-legal-proofs

 126: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {

 134:     }

 137: 
 138:     // Statistiques actuelles

 150:       success: true,

 157:   } catch (error) {
 158:     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);

_archive\frontend\app\api\github\callback\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getGitHubApp } from '@/lib/github-app';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * Endpoint OAuth callback GitHub
   7:  * GET /api/github/callback
   8:  *
   9:  * GÃ¨re le retour OAuth pour l'authentification utilisateur
  10:  * Inclut la vÃ©rification CSRF via le paramÃ¨tre state.
  11:  */
  12: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const searchParams = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  15:     const code = searchParams.get('code');
  16:     const state = searchParams.get('state');
  17:     const error = searchParams.get('error');
  18: 
  19:     // VÃ©rifier les erreurs OAuth
  20:     if (error) {
  21:       console.error('[GitHub OAuth] Error:', error);
  22:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=github_oauth_failed', req.url));
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     // VÃ©rifier le code
  26:     if (!code) {
  27:       console.error('[GitHub OAuth] Missing code parameter');
  28:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=missing_code', req.url));
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     // VÃ©rifier le state CSRF token
  32:     if (!state) {
  33:       console.error('[GitHub OAuth] Missing state parameter â€” possible CSRF attack');
  34:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=missing_state', req.url));
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     const cookieStore = await cookies();
  38:     const storedState = cookieStore.get('github_oauth_state')?.value;
  39: 
  40:     if (!storedState || storedState !== state) {
  41:       console.error('[GitHub OAuth] State mismatch â€” possible CSRF attack', {
  42:         receivedState: state,
  43:         hasStoredState: !!storedState,
  44:       });
  45:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=csrf_validation_failed', req.url));
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     // Ã‰changer le code contre un access token
  49:     const app = getGitHubApp();
  50:     const tokenResponse = await app.oauth.createToken({
  51:       code,
  52:     });
  53:     const token =
  54:       (tokenResponse as any).token || (tokenResponse as any).authentication?.token || null;
  55: 
  56:     if (!token) {
  57:       console.error('[GitHub OAuth] Failed to obtain token');
  58:       return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=token_exchange_failed', req.url));
  59:     }
  60: 
  61:     console.log('[GitHub OAuth] Token obtained successfully');
  62: 
  63:     // TODO: Stocker le token en session (via NextAuth JWT callback)
  64:     // TODO: RÃ©cupÃ©rer les infos utilisateur avec le token
  65:     // TODO: Lier Ã  l'utilisateur MemoLib existant
  66: 
  67:     // Supprimer le cookie state aprÃ¨s validation
  68:     const response = NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/dashboard', req.url));
  69:     response.cookies.delete('github_oauth_state');
  70:     return response;
  71:   } catch (error) {
  72:     console.error('[GitHub OAuth] Error in callback:', error);
  73:     return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/?error=oauth_error', req.url));
  74:   }
  75: }

_archive\frontend\app\api\github\connect\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
   3: 
   4: /**
   5:  * GET /api/github/connect
   6:  * 
   7:  * Initie le flow OAuth GitHub App en gÃ©nÃ©rant un state CSRF token,
   8:  * le stockant dans un cookie HttpOnly, puis redirigeant l'utilisateur
   9:  * vers GitHub pour autorisation.
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET() {
  12:   const clientId = process.env.GITHUB_CLIENT_ID;
  13:   const callbackUrl = process.env.GITHUB_CALLBACK_URL || `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/api/github/callback`;
  14: 
  15:   if (!clientId) {
  16:     return NextResponse.json(
  17:       { error: 'GitHub OAuth not configured' },
  18:       { status: 500 }
  19:     );
  20:   }
  21: 
  22:   // GÃ©nÃ©rer un state CSRF cryptographiquement alÃ©atoire
  23:   const state = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  24: 
  25:   // Construire l'URL d'autorisation GitHub
  26:   const params = new URLSearchParams({
  27:     client_id: clientId,
  28:     redirect_uri: callbackUrl,
  29:     scope: 'read:user user:email repo',
  30:     state,
  31:     allow_signup: 'false',
  32:   });
  33: 
  34:   const githubAuthUrl = `https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?${params.toString()}`;
  35: 
  36:   // Stocker le state dans un cookie HttpOnly sÃ©curisÃ©
  37:   const response = NextResponse.redirect(githubAuthUrl);
  38:   response.cookies.set('github_oauth_state', state, {
  39:     httpOnly: true,
  40:     secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  41:     sameSite: 'lax',
  42:     path: '/',
  43:     maxAge: 600, // 10 minutes max pour complÃ©ter le flow OAuth
  44:   });
  45: 
  46:   return response;
  47: }

   1: import { GitHubEventType, GitHubWebhookPayload, verifyWebhookSignature } from '@/lib/github-app';
   2: import { createHash } from 'crypto';
   3: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   4: 
   5: // DÃ©sactiver le body parser de Next.js pour accÃ©der au body brut
   6: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
   7: 
   8: /**
   9:  * Endpoint webhook GitHub
  10:  * POST /api/github/webhook
  11:  *
  12:  * ReÃ§oit les Ã©vÃ©nements GitHub et les enregistre dans l'EventLog immuable
  13:  */
  14: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  15:   try {
  16:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer le body brut pour la vÃ©rification de signature
  17:     const body = await req.text();
  18:     const signature = req.headers.get('x-hub-signature-256');
  19:     const event = req.headers.get('x-github-event') as GitHubEventType;
  20:     const deliveryId = req.headers.get('x-github-delivery');
  21: 
  22:     // VÃ©rification de la signature
  23:     if (!verifyWebhookSignature(body, signature, process.env.GITHUB_APP_WEBHOOK_SECRET!)) {
  24:       console.error('[GitHub Webhook] Invalid signature');
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 401 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     // Parser le payload
  29:     const payload: GitHubWebhookPayload = JSON.parse(body);
  30: 
  31:     // GÃ©nÃ©rer le hash SHA-256 de l'Ã©vÃ©nement pour l'EventLog
  32:     const eventHash = createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex');
  33: 
  34:     // CrÃ©er l'entrÃ©e EventLog immuable
  35:     const eventLog = {
  36:       id: deliveryId,
  37:       type: 'github_event',
  38:       event_type: event,
  39:       action: payload.action,
  40:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  41:       hash: eventHash,
  42:       payload: {
  43:         repository: payload.repository?.full_name,
  44:         sender: payload.sender?.login,
  45:         sender_email: payload.sender?.email,
  46:         installation_id: payload.installation?.id,
  47:       },
  48:       raw_payload: payload,
  49:     };
  50: 
  51:     console.log('[GitHub Webhook] Event received:', {
  52:       event,
  53:       action: payload.action,
  54:       repository: payload.repository?.full_name,
  55:       sender: payload.sender?.login,
  56:       deliveryId,
  57:     });
  58: 
  59:     // TODO: Enregistrer dans la base de donnÃ©es (EventLog)
  60:     // await prisma.eventLog.create({ data: eventLog });
  61: 
  62:     // TODO: Traiter l'Ã©vÃ©nement selon son type
  63:     switch (event) {
  64:       case 'push':
  65:         await handlePushEvent(payload);
  66:         break;
  67:       case 'pull_request':
  68:         await handlePullRequestEvent(payload);
  69:         break;
  70:       case 'issues':
  71:         await handleIssuesEvent(payload);
  72:         break;
  73:       case 'issue_comment':
  74:         await handleIssueCommentEvent(payload);
  75:         break;
  76:       case 'workflow_run':
  77:         await handleWorkflowRunEvent(payload);
  78:         break;
  79:       case 'check_run':
  80:         await handleCheckRunEvent(payload);
  81:         break;
  82:       case 'repository':
  83:         await handleRepositoryEvent(payload);
  84:         break;
  85:       case 'member':
  86:         await handleMemberEvent(payload);
  87:         break;
  88:       default:
  89:         console.log(`[GitHub Webhook] Unhandled event type: ${event}`);
  90:     }
  91: 
  92:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event, deliveryId });
  93:   } catch (error) {
  94:     console.error('[GitHub Webhook] Error processing webhook:', error);
  95:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  96:   }
  97: }

_archive\frontend\app\api\health\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   2: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: 
   4: /**
   5:  * Health Check API - Production Monitoring
   6:  *
   7:  * Endpoint: GET /api/health
   8:  *
   9:  * VÃ©rifie l'Ã©tat de santÃ© de l'application et de ses dÃ©pendances:
  10:  * - Base de donnÃ©es (PostgreSQL via Prisma)
  11:  * - Services externes (Azure AD, Twilio, etc.)
  12:  *
  13:  * UtilisÃ© par:
  14:  * - Azure Application Insights
  15:  * - Uptime monitors (UptimeRobot, Pingdom)
  16:  * - Load balancers
  17:  * - Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes
  18:  *
  19:  * Codes de retour:
  20:  * - 200: Healthy (tous les services OK)
  21:  * - 503: Unhealthy (au moins un service critique en erreur)
  22:  */
  23: 
  24: interface HealthCheck {
  25:   status: 'ok' | 'degraded' | 'error';
  26:   latency?: number;
  27:   error?: string;
  28:   details?: Record<string, any>;
  29: }
  30: 
  31: interface HealthStatus {
  32:   status: 'healthy' | 'degraded' | 'unhealthy';
  33:   timestamp: string;
  34:   uptime: number;
  35:   version: string;
  36:   environment: string;
  37:   checks: {
  38:     database: HealthCheck;
  39:     memory: HealthCheck;
  40:     env: HealthCheck;
  41:   };
  42: }
  43: 
  44: /**
  45:  * Check database connectivity
  46:  */
  47: async function checkDatabase(): Promise<HealthCheck> {
  48:   const startTime = performance.now();
  49: 
  50:   try {
  51:     // Simple query to verify connection
  52:     await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
  53: 
  54:     const latency = performance.now() - startTime;
  55: 
  56:     // Warn if latency > 1000ms
  57:     if (latency > 1000) {
  58:       return {
  59:         status: 'degraded',
  60:         latency: Math.round(latency),
  61:         details: { warning: 'High database latency' },
  62:       };
  63:     }
  64: 
  65:     return {
  66:       status: 'ok',
  67:       latency: Math.round(latency),
  68:     };
  69:   } catch (error: any) {
  70:     return {
  71:       status: 'error',
  72:       error: error.message || 'Database connection failed',
  73:       latency: Math.round(performance.now() - startTime),
  74:     };
  75:   }
  76: }
  77: 
  78: /**
  79:  * Check memory usage
  80:  */
  81: function checkMemory(): HealthCheck {
  82:   try {
  83:     const usage = process.memoryUsage();
  84:     const heapUsedMB = Math.round(usage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024);
  85:     const heapTotalMB = Math.round(usage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024);
  86:     const heapUsagePercent = Math.round((usage.heapUsed / usage.heapTotal) * 100);
  87: 
  88:     // Warn if heap usage > 80%
  89:     if (heapUsagePercent > 80) {
  90:       return {
  91:         status: 'degraded',
  92:         details: {
  93:           heapUsed: `${heapUsedMB}MB`,
  94:           heapTotal: `${heapTotalMB}MB`,
  95:           heapUsagePercent: `${heapUsagePercent}%`,
  96:           warning: 'High memory usage',
  97:         },
  98:       };
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     return {
 102:       status: 'ok',
 103:       details: {
 104:         heapUsed: `${heapUsedMB}MB`,
 105:         heapTotal: `${heapTotalMB}MB`,
 106:         heapUsagePercent: `${heapUsagePercent}%`,
 107:       },
 108:     };
 109:   } catch (error: any) {
 110:     return {
 111:       status: 'error',
 112:       error: error.message || 'Memory check failed',
 113:     };
 114:   }
 115: }
 116: 
 117: /**
 118:  * Check critical environment variables
 119:  */
 120: function checkEnvironment(): HealthCheck {
 121:   const criticalVars = [
 122:     'DATABASE_URL',
 123:     'NEXTAUTH_SECRET',
 124:     'NEXTAUTH_URL',
 125:   ];
 126: 
 127:   const missing = criticalVars.filter((varName) => !process.env[varName]);
 128: 
 129:   if (missing.length > 0) {
 130:     return {
 131:       status: 'error',
 132:       error: `Missing critical environment variables: ${missing.join(', ')}`,
 133:       details: { missing },
 134:     };
 135:   }
 136: 
 137:   return {
 138:     status: 'ok',
 139:     details: {
 140:       nodeVersion: process.version,
 141:       platform: process.platform,
 142:       nodeEnv: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
 143:     },
 144:   };
 145: }
 146: 
 147: /**
 148:  * GET /api/health
 149:  */
 150: export async function GET() {
 151:   const startTime = performance.now();
 152: 
 153:   try {
 154:     // Run all health checks in parallel
 155:     const [database, memory, env] = await Promise.all([
 156:       checkDatabase(),
 157:       checkMemory(),
 158:       Promise.resolve(checkEnvironment()),
 159:     ]);
 160: 
 161:     const checks = { database, memory, env };
 162: 
 163:     // Determine overall status
 164:     const hasError = Object.values(checks).some((check) => check.status === 'error');
 165:     const hasDegraded = Object.values(checks).some((check) => check.status === 'degraded');
 166: 
 167:     const overallStatus = hasError ? 'unhealthy' : hasDegraded ? 'degraded' : 'healthy';
 168: 
 169:     const healthStatus: HealthStatus = {
 170:       status: overallStatus,
 171:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 172:       uptime: process.uptime(),
 173:       version: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION || '0.0.0',
 174:       environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
 175:       checks,
 176:     };
 177: 
 178:     // Return 503 if unhealthy, 200 otherwise
 179:     const statusCode = overallStatus === 'unhealthy' ? 503 : 200;
 180: 
 181:     // Add custom headers for monitoring
 182:     const response = NextResponse.json(healthStatus, { status: statusCode });
 183:     response.headers.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate');
 184:     response.headers.set('X-Health-Check-Duration', `${Math.round(performance.now() - startTime)}ms`);
 185: 
 186:     return response;
 187:   } catch (error: any) {
 188:     // Catastrophic failure
 189:     return NextResponse.json(
 190:       {
 191:         status: 'unhealthy',
 192:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 193:         error: error.message || 'Health check failed',
 194:       },
 195:       { status: 503 }
 196:     );
 197:   }
 198: }

   1: /**
   2:  * RGPD Delete API (Phase 9)
   3:  *
   4:  * POST /api/rgpd/delete
   5:  * - Suppression complÃ¨te compte utilisateur
   6:  * - CASCADE sur toutes relations
   7:  * - IrrÃ©versible - confirmation requise
   8:  *
   9:  * POST /api/rgpd/anonymize
  10:  * - Anonymisation donnÃ©es (alternative suppression)
  11:  */
  12: 
  13: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  14: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  15: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
  16: import { RGPDComplianceService } from '@/lib/services/rgpd-compliance.service';
  17: 
  18: const rgpdService = new RGPDComplianceService();
  19: 
  20: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  21:   try {
  22:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  23: 
  24:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     const body = await req.json();
  29:     const { action, confirmed } = body;
  30: 
  31:     if (!confirmed) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json(
  33:         {
  34:           error: 'Confirmation requise',
  35:           message: 'Vous devez confirmer la suppression en passant confirmed: true',
  36:         },
  37:         { status: 400 }
  38:       );
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     if (action === 'anonymize') {
  42:       // Anonymisation (droit Ã  l'oubli sans suppression)
  43:       const result = await rgpdService.anonymizeUser({
  44:         userId: session.user.id,
  45:         tenantId: session.user.tenantId || 'default',
  46:         requestedBy: session.user.id,
  47:       });
  48: 
  49:       return NextResponse.json({
  50:         success: true,
  51:         action: 'anonymized',
  52:         result: {
  53:           anonymizedFields: result.anonymizedFields,
  54:           tablesAffected: result.tablesAffected,
  55:           timestamp: result.timestamp,
  56:         },
  57:         message: 'Vos donnÃ©es ont Ã©tÃ© anonymisÃ©es avec succÃ¨s',
  58:       });
  59:     } else {
  60:       // Suppression complÃ¨te (irrÃ©versible)
  61:       const result = await rgpdService.deleteUserData({
  62:         userId: session.user.id,
  63:         tenantId: session.user.tenantId || 'default',
  64:         requestedBy: session.user.id,
  65:       });
  66: 
  67:       return NextResponse.json({
  68:         success: true,
  69:         action: 'deleted',
  70:         result: {
  71:           deletedRecords: result.deletedRecords,
  72:           totalDeleted: result.totalDeleted,
  73:           timestamp: result.timestamp,
  74:         },
  75:         message: 'Votre compte et toutes vos donnÃ©es ont Ã©tÃ© supprimÃ©s',
  76:       });
  77:     }
  78:   } catch (error: any) {
  79:     console.error('RGPD delete error:', error);
  80:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  81:   }

  47: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  48:   try {
  49:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  50: 
  51:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  52:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  53:     }
  54: 
  55:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  56:     const requestId = searchParams.get('requestId');
  57: 
  58:     if (!requestId) {
  59:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'requestId requis' }, { status: 400 });
  60:     }
  61: 
  62:     const exportRequest = await rgpdService.getExportRequest(requestId);
  63: 
  64:     if (!exportRequest) {
  65:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Export non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     // VÃ©rifier ownership
  69:     if (exportRequest.userId !== session.user.id) {
  70:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  71:     }
  72: 
  73:     // VÃ©rifier expiration
  74:     if (exportRequest.expiresAt && new Date() > new Date(exportRequest.expiresAt)) {
  75:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Export expirÃ©' }, { status: 410 });
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     if (exportRequest.status !== 'completed') {
  79:       return NextResponse.json({
  80:         success: false,
  81:         status: exportRequest.status,
  82:         message: 'Export en cours de traitement',
  83:       });
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     return NextResponse.json({
  87:       success: true,
  88:       exportRequest: {
  89:         id: exportRequest.id,
  90:         status: exportRequest.status,
  91:         exportUrl: exportRequest.exportUrl,
  92:         exportSize: exportRequest.exportSize,
  93:         completedAt: exportRequest.completedAt,
  94:         expiresAt: exportRequest.expiresAt,
  95:       },
  96:     });
  97:   } catch (error: any) {
  98:     console.error('Get export error:', error);
  99:     return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });

_archive\frontend\app\api\v1\clients\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { requireApiPermission, RBAC_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/auth/rbac';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth/next';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/v1/clients
   9:  * List all clients for tenant
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_READ);
  20:     if (!guard.ok) {
  21:       return guard.response;
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  25:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  26:     });
  27: 
  28:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  33:     const search = searchParams.get('search');
  34:     const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
  35:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');
  36:     const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  37: 
  38:     const where: any = { tenantId: user.tenantId };
  39:     if (search) {
  40:       where.OR = [
  41:         { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
  42:         { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
  43:         { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
  44:       ];
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     const [clients, total] = await Promise.all([
  48:       prisma.client.findMany({
  49:         where,
  50:         include: { dossiers: { select: { id: true, numero: true, statut: true } } },
  51:         skip,
  52:         take: limit,
  53:         orderBy: { lastName: 'asc' },
  54:       }),
  55:       prisma.client.count({ where }),
  56:     ]);
  57: 
  58:     return NextResponse.json({
  59:       data: clients,
  60:       pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) },
  61:     });
  62:   } catch (error) {
  63:     console.error('[GET /api/v1/clients]', error);
  64:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  65:   }
  66: }
  67: 
  68: /**
  69:  * POST /api/v1/clients
  70:  * Create a new client
  71:  */
  72: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  73:   try {
  74:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  75: 
  76:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  77:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  78:     }
  79: 
  80:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_MANAGE);
  81:     if (!guard.ok) {
  82:       return guard.response;
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  86:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  87:     });
  88: 
  89:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  90:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  91:     }
  92: 
  93:     const body = await req.json();
  94:     const { firstName, lastName, email, phone, address, codePostal, ville } = body;
  95: 
  96:     if (!firstName || !lastName || !email) {
  97:       return NextResponse.json(
  98:         { error: 'Missing required fields: firstName, lastName, email' },
  99:         { status: 400 }
 100:       );
 101:     }
 102: 
 103:     // Check if client already exists
 104:     const existing = await prisma.client.findFirst({
 105:       where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, email },
 106:     });
 107: 
 108:     if (existing) {
 109:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client with this email already exists' }, { status: 409 });
 110:     }
 111: 
 112:     const client = await prisma.client.create({
 113:       data: {
 114:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 115:         firstName,
 116:         lastName,
 117:         email,
 118:         phone: phone || null,
 119:         address: address || null,
 120:         codePostal: codePostal || null,
 121:         ville: ville || null,
 122:         status: 'actif',
 123:       },
 124:     });
 125: 
 126:     // Log to audit
 127:     await prisma.auditLog.create({
 128:       data: {
 129:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 130:         userId: user.id,
 131:         userEmail: user.email,
 132:         userRole: user.role,
 133:         action: 'CREATE',
 134:         entityType: 'client',
 135:         entityId: client.id,
 136:         newValue: JSON.stringify(client),
 137:         ipAddress: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '',
 138:       },
 139:     });
 140: 
 141:     return NextResponse.json(client, { status: 201 });
 142:   } catch (error) {
 143:     console.error('[POST /api/v1/clients]', error);
 144:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
 145:   }
 146: }

  16:

  40:       where: { dossierId: params.dossierId },
  41:       include: { client: true },

  43:       take: 100,
  44:     });
  45: 
  46:     return NextResponse.json({ data: messages });
  47:   } catch (error) {

  83:         { status: 400 }

  95:         direction: 'OUTBOUND',
  96:         status: 'PROCESSED',
  97:         senderData: { email: user.email, name: user.name },
  98:         checksum: Buffer.from(`${user.id}-${Date.now()}-${messageBody}`).toString('base64'),
  99:       },
 100:     });

 102:     // Notify

 105:         data: {
 106:           userId: clientId,
 107:           type: 'message_received',
 108:           title: 'Nouveau message',
 109:           message: `Vous avez reÃ§u un message concernant le dossier ${params.dossierId}`,
 110:           data: JSON.stringify({ dossierId: params.dossierId, messageId: message.id }),
 111:         },
 112:       });
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     return NextResponse.json(message, { status: 201 });
 116:   } catch (error) {
 117:     console.error('[POST /api/v1/dossiers/:dossierId/messages]', error);
 118:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });

  65:   try {

  67: 
  68:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  69:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  70:     }
  71: 
  72:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_MANAGE);
  73:     if (!guard.ok) {
  74:       return guard.response;
  75:     }
  76: 
  77:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  78:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  82:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     // Check if dossier exists & belongs to tenant
  86:     const existing = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  87:       where: { id: params.id, tenantId: user.tenantId },

  89:

  91:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier not found' }, { status: 404 });

  95:     const { statut, priorite, description, dateEcheance } = body;
  96: 
  97:     const updated = await prisma.dossier.update({
  98:       where: { id: params.id },
  99:       data: {
 100:         statut: statut || existing.statut,
 101:         priorite: priorite || existing.priorite,
 102:         description: description || existing.description,
 103:         dateEcheance: dateEcheance ? new Date(dateEcheance) : existing.dateEcheance,
 104:         updatedAt: new Date(),
 105:       },

 115:         userRole: user.role,
 116:         action: 'UPDATE',
 117:         entityType: 'dossier',
 118:         entityId: params.id,
 119:         oldValue: JSON.stringify(existing),
 120:         newValue: JSON.stringify(updated),
 121:         ipAddress: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '',
 122:       },
 123:     });
 124: 
 125:     return NextResponse.json(updated);
 126:   } catch (error) {
 127:     console.error('[PUT /api/v1/dossiers/:id]', error);

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { requireApiPermission, RBAC_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/auth/rbac';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth/next';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/v1/dossiers
   9:  * List all dossiers for current user
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_READ);
  20:     if (!guard.ok) {
  21:       return guard.response;
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     // Get user & tenant
  25:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  26:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  27:       include: { tenant: true },
  28:     });
  29: 
  30:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  31:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  32:     }
  33: 
  34:     // Get query params for filtering
  35:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  36:     const statut = searchParams.get('statut');
  37:     const clientId = searchParams.get('clientId');
  38:     const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
  39:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');
  40:     const sortBy = searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'dateCreation';
  41:     const sortOrder = (searchParams.get('sortOrder') || 'desc').toLowerCase();
  42: 
  43:     const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
  44: 
  45:     // Build filter
  46:     const where: any = { tenantId: user.tenantId };
  47:     if (statut) where.statut = statut;
  48:     if (clientId) where.clientId = clientId;
  49: 
  50:     const allowedSortBy = ['dateCreation', 'updatedAt', 'priorite', 'statut'] as const;
  51:     const normalizedSortBy = allowedSortBy.includes(sortBy as (typeof allowedSortBy)[number])
  52:       ? (sortBy as (typeof allowedSortBy)[number])
  53:       : 'dateCreation';
  54:     const normalizedSortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc' = sortOrder === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';
  55: 
  56:     // Fetch dossiers
  57:     const [dossiers, total] = await Promise.all([
  58:       prisma.dossier.findMany({
  59:         where,
  60:         include: { client: true, legalDeadlines: { take: 1, orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' } } },
  61:         skip,
  62:         take: limit,
  63:         orderBy: { [normalizedSortBy]: normalizedSortOrder },
  64:       }),
  65:       prisma.dossier.count({ where }),
  66:     ]);
  67: 
  68:     return NextResponse.json({
  69:       data: dossiers,
  70:       pagination: { page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) },
  71:     });
  72:   } catch (error) {
  73:     console.error('[GET /api/v1/dossiers]', error);
  74:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  75:   }
  76: }
  77: 
  78: /**
  79:  * POST /api/v1/dossiers
  80:  * Create a new dossier
  81:  */
  82: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  83:   try {
  84:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  85: 
  86:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  87:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_MANAGE);
  91:     if (!guard.ok) {
  92:       return guard.response;
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     // Get user
  96:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  97:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  98:       include: { tenant: true },
  99:     });
 100: 
 101:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
 102:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
 103:     }
 104: 
 105:     const body = await req.json();
 106:     const { numero, clientId, typeDossier, dateEcheance, description, priorite } = body;
 107: 
 108:     // Validate required fields
 109:     if (!numero || !clientId || !typeDossier) {
 110:       return NextResponse.json(
 111:         { error: 'Missing required fields: numero, clientId, typeDossier' },
 112:         { status: 400 }
 113:       );
 114:     }
 115: 
 116:     // Check if client exists & belongs to tenant
 117:     const client = await prisma.client.findFirst({
 118:       where: { id: clientId, tenantId: user.tenantId },
 119:     });
 120: 
 121:     if (!client) {
 122:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client not found' }, { status: 404 });
 123:     }
 124: 
 125:     // Create dossier
 126:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.create({
 127:       data: {
 128:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 129:         numero,
 130:         clientId,
 131:         typeDossier,
 132:         dateEcheance: dateEcheance ? new Date(dateEcheance) : undefined,
 133:         description,
 134:         priorite: priorite || 'normale',
 135:         statut: 'en_cours',
 136:         dateCreation: new Date(),
 137:         dateOuverture: new Date(),
 138:       },
 139:       include: { client: true },
 140:     });
 141: 
 142:     // Log to audit
 143:     await prisma.auditLog.create({
 144:       data: {
 145:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 146:         userId: user.id,
 147:         userEmail: user.email,
 148:         userRole: user.role,
 149:         action: 'CREATE',
 150:         entityType: 'dossier',
 151:         entityId: dossier.id,
 152:         newValue: JSON.stringify(dossier),
 153:         ipAddress: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '',
 154:       },
 155:     });
 156: 
 157:     return NextResponse.json(dossier, { status: 201 });
 158:   } catch (error) {
 159:     console.error('[POST /api/v1/dossiers]', error);
 160:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
 161:   }

  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.EVENTS_READ);
  20:     if (!guard.ok) {
  21:       return guard.response;
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  25:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  26:     });
  27: 
  28:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  33:     const from = searchParams.get('from');
  34:     const to = searchParams.get('to');
  35: 
  36:     const where: any = { userId: user.id };
  37:     if (from && to) {
  38:       where.AND = [
  39:         { startDate: { gte: new Date(from) } },
  40:         { endDate: { lte: new Date(to) } },
  41:       ];
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     const events = await prisma.event.findMany({
  45:       where,
  46:       include: { case: true },
  47:       orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
  48:     });
  49: 
  50:     return NextResponse.json({ data: events });
  51:   } catch (error) {
  52:     console.error('[GET /api/v1/events]', error);
  53:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  54:   }
  55: }

  64: /**
  65:  * POST /api/v1/factures
  66:  * Create a new invoice
  67:  */
  68: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  69:   try {
  70:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  71: 
  72:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  73:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  74:     }
  75: 
  76:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_MANAGE);
  77:     if (!guard.ok) {
  78:       return guard.response;
  79:     }
  80: 
  81:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  82:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  83:     });
  84: 
  85:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  86:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  87:     }
  88: 
  89:     const body = await req.json();
  90:     const { clientId, dossierId, numero, montantHT, tauxTVA, dateEcheance, lignes } = body;
  91: 
  92:     if (!clientId || !numero || !montantHT || !dateEcheance) {
  93:       return NextResponse.json(
  94:         { error: 'Missing required fields' },
  95:         { status: 400 }
  96:       );
  97:     }
  98: 
  99:     // Create facture
 100:     const montantTVA = montantHT * (tauxTVA / 100);
 101:     const montantTTC = montantHT + montantTVA;
 102: 
 103:     const facture = await prisma.facture.create({
 104:       data: {
 105:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 106:         clientId,
 107:         dossierId: dossierId || null,
 108:         numero,
 109:         montantHT,
 110:         tauxTVA: tauxTVA || 20,
 111:         montantTVA,
 112:         montantTTC,
 113:         dateEcheance: new Date(dateEcheance),
 114:         dateEmission: new Date(),
 115:         statut: 'brouillon',
 116:         lignes: {
 117:           create: lignes?.map((l: any) => ({
 118:             description: l.description,
 119:             quantite: l.quantite || 1,
 120:             prixUnitaire: l.prixUnitaire,
 121:             montantHT: l.montantHT,
 122:           })) || [],
 123:         },
 124:       },
 125:       include: { client: true, lignes: true },
 126:     });
 127: 
 128:     // Log to audit
 129:     await prisma.auditLog.create({
 130:       data: {
 131:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 132:         userId: user.id,
 133:         userEmail: user.email,
 134:         userRole: user.role,
 135:         action: 'CREATE',
 136:         entityType: 'facture',
 137:         entityId: facture.id,
 138:         newValue: JSON.stringify(facture),
 139:         ipAddress: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || '',
 140:       },
 141:     });
 142: 
 143:     return NextResponse.json(facture, { status: 201 });
 144:   } catch (error) {
 145:     console.error('[POST /api/v1/factures]', error);
 146:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
 147:   }

  14:  */
  15: export async function GET(
  16:   req: NextRequest,
  17:   { params }: { params: { factureId: string } }
  18: ) {
  19:   try {
  20:     if (!hasStripeSecret) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Stripe not configured' }, { status: 503 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  25: 
  26:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT);
  31:     if (!guard.ok) {
  32:       return guard.response;
  33:     }
  34: 
  35:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  36:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  37:       select: { id: true, tenantId: true },
  38:     });
  39: 
  40:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  41:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  42:     }
  43:

  45:       where: { id: params.factureId },
  46:       include: { client: true },
  47:     });
  48: 
  49:     if (!facture) {
  50:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invoice not found' }, { status: 404 });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     if (facture.tenantId !== user.tenantId) {
  54:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
  55:     }
  56: 
  57:     // Create Stripe payment intent
  58:     const intent = await stripe.paymentIntents.create({
  59:       amount: Math.round(facture.montantTTC * 100), // in cents
  60:       currency: 'eur',
  61:       metadata: {
  62:         factureId: facture.id,
  63:         clientEmail: facture.client.email,
  64:       },
  65:     });
  66: 
  67:     // Save to DB
  68:     const paiement = await prisma.paiement.create({
  69:       data: {
  70:         invoiceId: facture.id,
  71:         clientId: facture.clientId,
  72:         amount: facture.montantTTC,
  73:         method: 'CARD',
  74:         status: 'PENDING',
  75:         stripePaymentIntentId: intent.id,
  76:       },
  77:     });
  78: 
  79:     return NextResponse.json({
  80:       clientSecret: intent.client_secret,
  81:       paiementId: paiement.id,
  82:       amount: facture.montantTTC,
  83:     });
  84:   } catch (error) {
  85:     console.error('[GET /api/v1/factures/:factureId/payment-intent]', error);
  86:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { requireApiPermission, RBAC_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/auth/rbac';

   6: 
   7: const ALLOWED_STATUS = ['TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED', 'DONE'] as const;
   8: const ALLOWED_PRIORITY = ['LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] as const;
   9: 
  10: function normalizeStatus(value: unknown): (typeof ALLOWED_STATUS)[number] | null {
  11:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;
  12: 
  13:   const normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase();
  14:   if (normalized === 'IN-PROGRESS' || normalized === 'IN PROGRESS') return 'IN_PROGRESS';
  15: 
  16:   return ALLOWED_STATUS.includes(normalized as (typeof ALLOWED_STATUS)[number])
  17:     ? (normalized as (typeof ALLOWED_STATUS)[number])
  18:     : null;
  19: }
  20: 
  21: function normalizePriority(value: unknown): (typeof ALLOWED_PRIORITY)[number] | null {
  22:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;
  23: 
  24:   const normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase();
  25: 
  26:   return ALLOWED_PRIORITY.includes(normalized as (typeof ALLOWED_PRIORITY)[number])
  27:     ? (normalized as (typeof ALLOWED_PRIORITY)[number])
  28:     : null;
  29: }
  30: 
  31: /**
  32:  * PATCH /api/v1/tasks/[id]
  33:  * Update task status and/or priority
  34:  */
  35: export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  36:   try {
  37:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  38: 
  39:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  40:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_MANAGE);
  44:     if (!guard.ok) {
  45:       return guard.response;
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  49:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  50:     });
  51: 
  52:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  53:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     const existing = await prisma.task.findFirst({
  57:       where: {
  58:         id: params.id,
  59:         createdBy: {
  60:           tenantId: user.tenantId,
  61:         },
  62:       },
  63:     });
  64: 
  65:     if (!existing) {
  66:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Task not found' }, { status: 404 });
  67:     }
  68: 
  69:     let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  70:     try {
  71:       body = (await req.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
  72:     } catch {
  73:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }, { status: 400 });
  74:     }
  75: 
  76:     const status = body.status !== undefined ? normalizeStatus(body.status) : undefined;
  77:     const priority = body.priority !== undefined ? normalizePriority(body.priority) : undefined;
  78:     const assignedToId = body.assignedToId !== undefined ? String(body.assignedToId) : undefined;
  79: 
  80:     if (body.status !== undefined && status === null) {
  81:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid status value' }, { status: 400 });
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     if (body.priority !== undefined && priority === null) {
  85:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid priority value' }, { status: 400 });
  86:     }
  87: 
  88:     if (assignedToId !== undefined) {
  89:       const assignee = await prisma.user.findFirst({
  90:         where: {
  91:           id: assignedToId,
  92:           tenantId: user.tenantId,
  93:         },
  94:       });
  95: 
  96:       if (!assignee) {
  97:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid assignee' }, { status: 400 });
  98:       }
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     if (status === undefined && priority === undefined && assignedToId === undefined) {
 102:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No updatable fields provided' }, { status: 400 });
 103:     }
 104: 
 105:     const updated = await prisma.task.update({
 106:       where: { id: params.id },
 107:       data: {
 108:         ...(status !== undefined ? { status } : {}),
 109:         ...(priority !== undefined ? { priority } : {}),
 110:         ...(assignedToId !== undefined ? { assignedToId } : {}),
 111:       },
 112:       include: { case: true, assignedTo: true, createdBy: true },
 113:     });
 114: 
 115:     return NextResponse.json(updated);
 116:   } catch (error) {
 117:     console.error('[PATCH /api/v1/tasks/:id]', error);
 118:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
 119:   }
 120: }

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';

   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/v1/tasks
   9:  * List tasks for current user
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_READ);
  20:     if (!guard.ok) {
  21:       return guard.response;
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  25:       where: { email: session.user.email },
  26:     });
  27: 
  28:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'No tenant found' }, { status: 400 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  33:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  34:     const priority = searchParams.get('priority');
  35:     const includeAssignees = searchParams.get('includeAssignees') === '1';
  36:     const sortBy = searchParams.get('sortBy') || 'dueDate';
  37:     const sortOrder = (searchParams.get('sortOrder') || 'asc').toLowerCase();
  38: 
  39:     const where: any = {};
  40:     if (status) where.status = status;
  41:     if (priority) where.priority = priority;
  42: 
  43:     const allowedSortBy = ['dueDate', 'createdAt', 'priority', 'status'] as const;
  44:     const normalizedSortBy = allowedSortBy.includes(sortBy as (typeof allowedSortBy)[number])
  45:       ? (sortBy as (typeof allowedSortBy)[number])
  46:       : 'dueDate';
  47:     const normalizedSortOrder: 'asc' | 'desc' = sortOrder === 'desc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
  48: 
  49:     const tasks = await prisma.task.findMany({
  50:       where: {
  51:         ...where,
  52:         assignedToId: user.id,
  53:       },
  54:       include: { case: true, createdBy: true, assignedTo: true },
  55:       orderBy: { [normalizedSortBy]: normalizedSortOrder },
  56:     });
  57: 
  58:     if (!includeAssignees) {
  59:       return NextResponse.json({ data: tasks });
  60:     }
  61: 
  62:     const assignees = await prisma.user.findMany({
  63:       where: {
  64:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  65:         role: { in: ['ADMIN', 'LAWYER'] },
  66:       },
  67:       select: {
  68:         id: true,
  69:         name: true,
  70:         email: true,
  71:         role: true,
  72:       },
  73:       orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
  74:     });
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json({ data: tasks, assignees });
  77:   } catch (error) {
  78:     console.error('[GET /api/v1/tasks]', error);
  79:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  80:   }
  81: }

 154:       externalId: message.externalId,
 155:       checksum: message.checksum,
 156:       channel: message.channel,
 157:       status: message.status,
 158:       duration: Math.round(duration * 100) / 100, // Round to 2 decimals
 159:       timestamp: message.receivedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
 160:     };
 161: 
 162:     console.log('[DEBUG] Response object:', JSON.stringify(response));
 163: 
 164:     return NextResponse.json(response);
 165:   } catch (e: any) {
 166:     const duration = performance.now() - startTime;
 167: 
 168:     // Check if it's a duplicate error
 169:     if (e.message?.includes('DUPLICATE')) {
 170:       Sentry.captureMessage('Webhook duplicate detected', {
 171:         level: 'warning',
 172:         tags: {
 173:           error: 'DUPLICATE',
 174:         },
 175:         extra: {
 176:           duration: `${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`,
 177:         },
 178:       });
 179: 
 180:       return NextResponse.json(
 181:         {
 182:           success: false,
 183:           error: 'DUPLICATE_MESSAGE',
 184:           message: e.message,
 185:         },
 186:         { status: 409 }
 187:       );
 188:     }
 189: 
 190:     // Log error to Sentry
 191:     Sentry.captureException(e, {
 192:       tags: {
 193:         error: 'WEBHOOK_ERROR',
 194:       },
 195:       extra: {
 196:         duration: `${duration.toFixed(2)}ms`,
 197:       },
 198:     });
 199: 
 200:     console.error('[Webhook Error]', e.message);
 201:     return NextResponse.json({ error: e.message || 'Internal server error' }, { status: 400 });
 202:   }
 203: }

   1: "use client";

   8: type Subscription = {
   9:   id: string;
  10:   plan: string;
  11:   status: string;
  12:   currentPeriodEnd: string;
  13:   cancelAtPeriodEnd: boolean;
  14:   maxClients: number;
  15:   maxDossiers: number;
  16:   maxStorage: number;
  17: };
  18: 
  19: type Payment = {
  20:   id: string;
  21:   amount: number;
  22:   currency: string;
  23:   status: string;
  24:   paidAt: string;
  25:   last4?: string;
  26:   brand?: string;

  28: 
  29: async function safeReadJson<T = any>(response: Response): Promise<T | null> {
  30:   const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  31:   const rawBody = await response.text();
  32: 
  33:   if (!rawBody.trim()) {
  34:     return null;
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
  38:     return null;
  39:   }
  40: 
  41:   try {
  42:     return JSON.parse(rawBody) as T;
  43:   } catch {
  44:     return null;
  45:   }
  46: }
  47: 
  48: export default function BillingDashboard() {
  49:   const router = useRouter();
  50:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  51:   const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState<Subscription | null>(null);
  52:   const [payments, setPayments] = useState<Payment[]>([]);
  53:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  54:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  55: 
  56:   useEffect(() => {
  57:     if (searchParams?.get("success") === "true") {
  58:       setSuccess(true);
  59:       setTimeout(() => setSuccess(false), 5000);
  60:     }
  61:     fetchBillingData();
  62:   }, [searchParams]);
  63: 
  64:   const fetchBillingData = async () => {
  65:     try {

  67:       const data = await safeReadJson<{ subscription?: Subscription; payments?: Payment[] }>(res);
  68: 
  69:       if (!res.ok || !data) {
  70:         console.error("Invalid billing API response", { status: res.status });
  71:         return;
  72:       }
  73:

  75:         setSubscription(data.subscription);
  76:         setPayments(data.payments || []);

  78:     } catch (error) {
  79:       console.error("Error fetching billing data:", error);
