  92: export default function PricingPage() {
  93:   const [billingCycle, setBillingCycle] = useState<"monthly" | "yearly">("monthly");
  94: 
  95:   const safeReadJson = async <T,>(response: Response): Promise<T | null> => {
  96:     const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  97:     const rawBody = await response.text();
  98: 
  99:     if (!rawBody.trim()) return null;
 100:     if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) return null;
 101: 
 102:     try {
 103:       return JSON.parse(rawBody) as T;
 104:     } catch {
 105:       return null;
 106:     }
 107:   };
 108: 
 109:   const getPrice = (plan: PricingPlan) => {
 110:     const price = billingCycle === "yearly" ? plan.price * 10 : plan.price;
 111:     return price;
 112:   };
 113: 
 114:   const handleCheckout = async (plan: PricingPlan) => {
 115:     if (plan.id === "FREE") {
 116:       // Redirect to signup
 117:       window.location.href = "/signup?plan=FREE";
 118:       return;
 119:     }
 120: 
 121:     try {
 122:       // Call Stripe checkout API
 123:       const response = await fetch("/api/billing/checkout", {
 124:         method: "POST",
 125:         headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
 126:         body: JSON.stringify({
 127:           priceId: plan.priceId,
 128:           billingCycle,
 129:         }),
 130:       });
 131: 
 132:       const data = await safeReadJson<{ url?: string; error?: string }>(response);
 133: 
 134:       if (!response.ok || !data) {
 135:         alert("Erreur de connexion API. Réponse invalide du serveur.");
 136:         return;
 137:       }
 138: 
 139:       if (data.url) {
 140:         window.location.href = data.url;
 141:       } else {
 142:         alert(data.error || "Erreur lors de la création de la session de paiement");
 143:       }
 144:     } catch (error) {
 145:       console.error("Checkout error:", error);
 146:       alert("Une erreur est survenue. Veuillez réessayer.");
 147:     }
 148:   };
 149: 
 150:   return (
 151:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 to-white">
 152:       {/* Header */}
 153:       <header className="border-b bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm sticky top-0 z-50">
 154:         <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8  py-4 flex justify-between items-center">
 155:           <Link href="/" className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600">
 156:             MemoLib
 157:           </Link>

   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: 
   3: export const RBAC_PERMISSIONS = {
   4:   TENANTS_READ: 'tenants:read',
   5:   TENANTS_CREATE: 'tenants:create',
   6:   USERS_READ: 'users:read',
   7:   USERS_MANAGE: 'users:manage',
   8:   CLIENTS_READ: 'clients:read',
   9:   CLIENTS_MANAGE: 'clients:manage',
  10:   TASKS_READ: 'tasks:read',
  11:   TASKS_MANAGE: 'tasks:manage',
  12:   EVENTS_READ: 'events:read',
  13:   EVENTS_MANAGE: 'events:manage',
  14:   DOSSIERS_READ: 'dossiers:read',
  15:   DOSSIERS_MANAGE: 'dossiers:manage',
  16:   DOCUMENTS_READ: 'documents:read',
  17:   DOCUMENTS_MANAGE: 'documents:manage',
  18:   FACTURES_READ: 'factures:read',
  19:   FACTURES_MANAGE: 'factures:manage',
  20:   PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT: 'payments:create_intent',
  21:   ANALYTICS_READ: 'analytics:read',
  22: } as const;
  23: 
  24: export type RbacPermission = (typeof RBAC_PERMISSIONS)[keyof typeof RBAC_PERMISSIONS] | '*';
  25: 
  26: export type RbacGroup =
  27:   | 'platform-admin'
  28:   | 'cabinet-admin'
  29:   | 'billing-manager'
  30:   | 'lawyer'
  31:   | 'client';
  32: 
  33: type SessionLike = {
  34:   user?: {
  35:     role?: string;
  36:     groups?: string[];
  37:   };
  38: };
  39: 
  40: const GROUP_PERMISSIONS: Record<RbacGroup, RbacPermission[]> = {
  41:   'platform-admin': ['*'],
  42:   'cabinet-admin': [
  43:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.USERS_READ,
  44:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.USERS_MANAGE,
  45:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_READ,
  46:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_MANAGE,
  47:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_READ,
  48:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_MANAGE,
  49:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.EVENTS_READ,
  50:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.EVENTS_MANAGE,
  51:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_READ,
  52:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_MANAGE,
  53:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOCUMENTS_READ,
  54:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOCUMENTS_MANAGE,
  55:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_READ,
  56:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_MANAGE,
  57:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT,
  58:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.ANALYTICS_READ,
  59:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TENANTS_READ,
  60:   ],
  61:   'billing-manager': [
  62:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_READ,
  63:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_MANAGE,
  64:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT,
  65:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.ANALYTICS_READ,
  66:   ],
  67:   lawyer: [
  68:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_READ,
  69:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.CLIENTS_MANAGE,
  70:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_READ,
  71:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TASKS_MANAGE,
  72:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.EVENTS_READ,
  73:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.EVENTS_MANAGE,
  74:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_READ,
  75:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_MANAGE,
  76:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOCUMENTS_READ,
  77:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOCUMENTS_MANAGE,
  78:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_READ,
  79:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT,
  80:   ],
  81:   client: [
  82:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_READ,
  83:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOCUMENTS_READ,
  84:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.FACTURES_READ,
  85:     RBAC_PERMISSIONS.PAYMENTS_CREATE_INTENT,
  86:   ],
  87: };
  88: 
  89: const ROLE_GROUPS: Record<string, RbacGroup[]> = {
  90:   SUPER_ADMIN: ['platform-admin'],
  91:   ADMIN: ['cabinet-admin', 'billing-manager'],
  92:   LAWYER: ['lawyer'],
  93:   CLIENT: ['client'],
  94: };
  95: 
  96: function unique<T>(items: T[]): T[] {
  97:   return Array.from(new Set(items));
  98: }
  99: 
 100: function normalizeRole(role?: string): string {
 101:   return (role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
 102: }
 103: 
 104: function resolveGroupsFromRole(role?: string): RbacGroup[] {
 105:   const normalized = normalizeRole(role);
 106:   return ROLE_GROUPS[normalized] || ['client'];
 107: }
 108: 
 109: function resolvePermissionsFromGroups(groups: readonly string[]): RbacPermission[] {
 110:   const allPermissions: RbacPermission[] = [];
 111:   for (const group of groups) {
 112:     const groupKey = group as RbacGroup;
 113:     const groupPermissions = GROUP_PERMISSIONS[groupKey] || [];
 114:     allPermissions.push(...groupPermissions);
 115:   }
 116:   return unique(allPermissions);
 117: }
 118: 
 119: export function requireApiPermission(
 120:   session: SessionLike | null,
 121:   required: RbacPermission
 122: ): { ok: true } | { ok: false; response: NextResponse } {
 123:   if (!session?.user) {
 124:     return {
 125:       ok: false,
 126:       response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 }),
 127:     };
 128:   }
 129: 
 130:   const roleGroups = resolveGroupsFromRole(session.user.role);
 131:   const explicitGroups = (session.user.groups || []).filter((group): group is string => Boolean(group));
 132:   const groups = unique([...roleGroups, ...explicitGroups]);
 133:   const permissions = resolvePermissionsFromGroups(groups);
 134: 
 135:   const allowed = permissions.includes('*') || permissions.includes(required);
 136:   if (!allowed) {
 137:     return {
 138:       ok: false,
 139:       response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 }),
 140:     };
 141:   }
 142: 
 143:   return { ok: true };
 144: }

  12:   entityType: 'email' | 'dossier' | 'client' | 'document';
  13:   entityId: string;
  14:   authorId: string;
  15:   tenantId: string;

  17: 
  18: interface MentionInfo {
  19:   userId: string;
  20:   username: string;
  21: }
  22: 
  23: export class CollaborationService {
  24:   private prisma: PrismaClient;
  25:   private eventLogService: EventLogService;
  26: 
  27:   constructor(prisma?: PrismaClient, eventLogService?: EventLogService) {
  28:     this.prisma = prisma || new PrismaClient();
  29:     this.eventLogService = eventLogService || new EventLogService(this.prisma);
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   /**
  33:    * Détecte les mentions @username dans le contenu
  34:    * Format: @john.doe ou @marie
  35:    */
  36:   private async parseMentions(
  37:     content: string,
  38:     tenantId: string
  39:   ): Promise<MentionInfo[]> {
  40:     const mentionRegex = /@([\w.]+)/g;
  41:     const matches = [...content.matchAll(mentionRegex)];
  42: 
  43:     if (matches.length === 0) {
  44:       return [];
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     const usernames = [...new Set(matches.map((m) => m[1]))];
  48: 
  49:     // Récupérer les users du tenant par email/username
  50:     const users = await this.prisma.user.findMany({
  51:       where: {
  52:         tenantId,
  53:         OR: usernames.map((username) => ({
  54:           email: { contains: username, mode: 'insensitive' as const },
  55:         })),
  56:       },
  57:       select: {
  58:         id: true,
  59:         email: true,
  60:         name: true,
  61:       },
  62:     });
  63: 
  64:     return users.map((u) => ({
  65:       userId: u.id,
  66:       username: u.email.split('@')[0],
  67:     }));
  68:   }
  69: 
  70:   /**
  71:    * Créer un commentaire avec mentions automatiques
  72:    */
  73:   async createComment(params: CreateCommentParams) {
  74:     const { content, entityType, entityId, authorId, tenantId } = params;
  75: 
  76:     // Détecter mentions
  77:     const mentions = await this.parseMentions(content, tenantId);
  78: 
  79:     // Créer commentaire + mentions en transaction

  81:       fn: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>

  83: 
  84:     const comment = await runTransaction(async (tx) => {
  85:       // 1. Créer le commentaire
  86:       const newComment = await tx.comment.create({
  87:         data: {
  88:           content,
  89:           entityType,
  90:           entityId,
  91:           authorId,

  95:           author: {

  99:               email: true,
 100:               avatar: true,
 101:             },
 102:           },
 103:         },
 104:       });
 105: 
 106:       // 2. Créer les mentions
 107:       if (mentions.length > 0) {
 108:         await tx.mention.createMany({
 109:           data: mentions.map((m) => ({
 110:             commentId: newComment.id,
 111:             userId: m.userId,
 112:           })),
 113:         });
 114:       }
 115: 
 116:       // 3. EventLog USER_COMMENTED
 117:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 118:         tenantId,
 119:         eventType: 'USER_ADDED_COMMENT',
 120:         actorType: 'USER',
 121:         actorId: authorId,
 122:         entityType,
 123:         entityId,
 124:         metadata: {
 125:           commentId: newComment.id,
 126:           content: content.substring(0, 100),
 127:           mentionsCount: mentions.length,
 128:         },
 129:       });
 130:

 132:       for (const mention of mentions) {
 133:         await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({

 141:             commentId: newComment.id,
 142:             mentionedUserId: mention.userId,
 143:             mentionedUsername: mention.username,
 144:             entityType,
 145:             entityId,
 146:           },
 147:         });
 148:       }

 151:     });

 162:             avatar: true,

_archive\frontend\lib\services\deadline-monitor.service.ts

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * DeadlineMonitorService - Phase 6
   4:  * Monitoring et notifications délais critiques
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { PrismaClient, DeadlineStatus } from '@prisma/client';
   8: import { EventLogService } from '../../../lib/services/event-log.service';
   9: 
  10: interface DeadlineCheckResult {
  11:   deadlineId: string;
  12:   label: string;
  13:   dueDate: Date;
  14:   previousStatus: DeadlineStatus;
  15:   newStatus: DeadlineStatus;
  16:   daysRemaining: number;
  17:   eventCreated: boolean;
  18: }
  19: 
  20: export class DeadlineMonitorService {
  21:   private prisma: PrismaClient;
  22:   private eventLogService: EventLogService;
  23: 
  24:   constructor(prisma?: PrismaClient, eventLogService?: EventLogService) {
  25:     this.prisma = prisma || new PrismaClient();
  26:     this.eventLogService = eventLogService || new EventLogService(this.prisma);
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   /**
  30:    * Calculer jours restants jusqu'à deadline
  31:    */
  32:   private calculateDaysRemaining(dueDate: Date): number {
  33:     const now = new Date();
  34:     now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  35:     const due = new Date(dueDate);
  36:     due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  37:     const diffTime = due.getTime() - now.getTime();
  38:     return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  39:   }
  40: 
  41:   /**
  42:    * Déterminer status selon jours restants
  43:    */
  44:   private determineStatus(daysRemaining: number, currentStatus: DeadlineStatus): DeadlineStatus {
  45:     // Ne pas changer si déjà COMPLETED ou CANCELLED
  46:     if (currentStatus === 'COMPLETED' || currentStatus === 'CANCELLED') {
  47:       return currentStatus;
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     if (daysRemaining < 0) {
  51:       return 'OVERDUE';
  52:     } else if (daysRemaining === 0 || daysRemaining === 1) {
  53:       return 'CRITICAL'; // J-1 ou J-0
  54:     } else if (daysRemaining <= 3) {
  55:       return 'URGENT'; // J-3 à J-2
  56:     } else if (daysRemaining <= 7) {
  57:       return 'APPROACHING'; // J-7 à J-4
  58:     }
  59:     return 'PENDING';
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   /**
  63:    * Vérifier et mettre à jour une deadline
  64:    */
  65:   private async checkSingleDeadline(deadline: any): Promise<DeadlineCheckResult | null> {
  66:     const daysRemaining = this.calculateDaysRemaining(deadline.dueDate);
  67:     const newStatus = this.determineStatus(daysRemaining, deadline.status);
  68: 
  69:     // Pas de changement nécessaire
  70:     if (newStatus === deadline.status) {
  71:       return null;
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     // Mettre à jour status + flags alert
  75:     const updates: any = { status: newStatus };
  76: 
  77:     if (daysRemaining <= 7 && !deadline.alertJ7Sent) {
  78:       updates.alertJ7Sent = true;
  79:     }
  80:     if (daysRemaining <= 3 && !deadline.alertJ3Sent) {
  81:       updates.alertJ3Sent = true;
  82:     }
  83:     if (daysRemaining <= 1 && !deadline.alertJ1Sent) {
  84:       updates.alertJ1Sent = true;
  85:     }
  86: 
  87:     await this.prisma.legalDeadline.update({
  88:       where: { id: deadline.id },
  89:       data: updates,
  90:     });
  91: 
  92:     // Créer EventLog selon nouveau status
  93:     let eventType: any = null;
  94:     if (newStatus === 'APPROACHING') eventType = 'DEADLINE_APPROACHING';
  95:     else if (newStatus === 'URGENT') eventType = 'DEADLINE_URGENT';
  96:     else if (newStatus === 'CRITICAL') eventType = 'DEADLINE_CRITICAL';
  97:     else if (newStatus === 'OVERDUE') eventType = 'DEADLINE_MISSED';
  98: 
  99:     let eventCreated = false;
 100:     if (eventType) {
 101:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 102:         tenantId: deadline.tenantId,
 103:         eventType,
 104:         actorType: 'SYSTEM',
 105:         entityType: 'deadline',
 106:         entityId: deadline.id,
 107:         metadata: {
 108:           deadlineId: deadline.id,
 109:           label: deadline.label,
 110:           type: deadline.type,
 111:           dueDate: deadline.dueDate.toISOString(),
 112:           daysRemaining,
 113:           previousStatus: deadline.status,
 114:           newStatus,
 115:           dossierId: deadline.dossierId,
 116:           clientId: deadline.clientId,
 117:         },
 118:       });
 119:       eventCreated = true;
 120:     }
 121: 
 122:     return {
 123:       deadlineId: deadline.id,
 124:       label: deadline.label,
 125:       dueDate: deadline.dueDate,
 126:       previousStatus: deadline.status,
 127:       newStatus,
 128:       daysRemaining,
 129:       eventCreated,
 130:     };
 131:   }
 132: 
 133:   /**
 134:    * Vérifier toutes les deadlines actives
 135:    */
 136:   async checkAllDeadlines(tenantId?: string) {
 137:     const where: any = {
 138:       status: {
 139:         notIn: ['COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'],
 140:       },
 141:     };
 142: 
 143:     if (tenantId) {
 144:       where.tenantId = tenantId;
 145:     }
 146: 
 147:     const deadlines = await this.prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({
 148:       where,
 149:       include: {
 150:         dossier: {
 151:           select: { numero: true, objet: true, statut: true },
 152:         },
 153:         client: {
 154:           select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
 155:         },
 156:       },
 157:       orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' },
 158:     });
 159: 
 160:     const results: DeadlineCheckResult[] = [];
 161: 
 162:     for (const deadline of deadlines) {
 163:       const result = await this.checkSingleDeadline(deadline);
 164:       if (result) {
 165:         results.push(result);
 166:       }
 167:     }
 168: 
 169:     return {
 170:       checked: deadlines.length,
 171:       updated: results.length,
 172:       results,
 173:     };
 174:   }
 175: 
 176:   /**
 177:    * Récupérer deadlines urgentes (upcoming)
 178:    */
 179:   async getUpcomingDeadlines(
 180:     tenantId: string,
 181:     options: {
 182:       status?: DeadlineStatus[];
 183:       dossierId?: string;
 184:       limit?: number;
 185:       daysAhead?: number;
 186:     } = {}
 187:   ) {
 188:     const { status = ['APPROACHING', 'URGENT', 'CRITICAL', 'OVERDUE'], dossierId, limit = 50, daysAhead = 30 } =
 189:       options;
 190: 
 191:     const futureDate = new Date();
 192:     futureDate.setDate(futureDate.getDate() + daysAhead);
 193: 
 194:     const where: any = {
 195:       tenantId,
 196:       status: { in: status },
 197:       dueDate: { lte: futureDate },
 198:     };
 199:

  64: async function parseResponse<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  65:   const text = await response.text();
  66:   let body: unknown = null;
  67: 
  68:   if (text) {
  69:     try {
  70:       body = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  71:     } catch {
  72:       body = null;
  73:     }
  74:   }
  75: 
  76:   if (!response.ok) {
  77:     const message =
  78:       typeof body === 'object' && body !== null && 'error' in body
  79:         ? String((body as { error: unknown }).error)
  80:         : 'Erreur API';
  81: 
  82:     throw new ApiError(message, response.status);
  83:   }
  84: 
  85:   return body as T;
  86: }

_archive\frontend\lib\services\filter-rule.service.ts

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * FilterRuleService - Service de filtrage email automatique (Phase 3)
   4:  *
   5:  * Ã‰value des règles de filtrage pour router automatiquement les emails
   6:  * vers dossiers, clients, catégories selon conditions (from, subject, etc.)
   7:  *
   8:  * @example
   9:  * ```ts
  10:  * const service = new FilterRuleService();
  11:  * const matches = await service.evaluateAllRules(email, tenantId);
  12:  * for (const match of matches) {
  13:  *   await service.applyActions(email.id, match.rule);
  14:  * }
  15:  * ```
  16:  */
  17: 
  18: import { PrismaClient, FilterRule, Email } from '@prisma/client';
  19: import { eventLogService } from '../../../lib/services/event-log.service';
  20: 
  21: export type FilterCondition = {
  22:   field: 'from' | 'to' | 'subject' | 'body' | 'category' | 'urgency' | 'sentiment';
  23:   operator: 'EQUALS' | 'CONTAINS' | 'STARTS_WITH' | 'ENDS_WITH' | 'REGEX' | 'IN' | 'NOT_IN';
  24:   value: string | string[];
  25: };
  26: 
  27: export type FilterAction = {
  28:   type:
  29:     | 'ASSIGN_DOSSIER'
  30:     | 'ASSIGN_CLIENT'
  31:     | 'SET_CATEGORY'
  32:     | 'SET_URGENCY'
  33:     | 'SET_TAGS'
  34:     | 'MARK_STARRED'
  35:     | 'ARCHIVE'
  36:     | 'NOTIFY_USER'
  37:     | 'TRIGGER_WORKFLOW';
  38:   dossierId?: string;
  39:   clientId?: string;
  40:   value?: string;
  41:   userId?: string;
  42:   workflowId?: string;
  43: };
  44: 
  45: export type RuleMatch = {
  46:   rule: FilterRule;
  47:   matchedConditions: string[]; // Liste des champs qui ont matché
  48:   confidence: number; // 0-1 (% conditions matchées)
  49: };
  50: 
  51: export class FilterRuleService {
  52:   constructor(private prisma: PrismaClient = new PrismaClient()) {}
  53: 
  54:   /**
  55:    * Ã‰value toutes les règles actives pour un email donné
  56:    * Retourne les règles qui matchent, triées par priorité
  57:    */
  58:   async evaluateAllRules(email: Email, tenantId: string): Promise<RuleMatch[]> {
  59:     const rules = await this.prisma.filterRule.findMany({
  60:       where: {
  61:         tenantId,
  62:         enabled: true,
  63:       },
  64:       orderBy: {
  65:         priority: 'asc', // Plus bas = plus prioritaire
  66:       },
  67:     });
  68: 
  69:     const matches: RuleMatch[] = [];
  70: 
  71:     for (const rule of rules) {
  72:       const match = this.evaluateRule(email, rule);
  73:       if (match) {
  74:         matches.push(match);
  75:       }
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     return matches;
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   /**
  82:    * Ã‰value une règle contre un email
  83:    * Retourne RuleMatch si toutes les conditions sont remplies, null sinon
  84:    */
  85:   private evaluateRule(email: Email, rule: FilterRule): RuleMatch | null {
  86:     const conditions = rule.conditions as FilterCondition[];
  87:     const matchedConditions: string[] = [];
  88: 
  89:     for (const condition of conditions) {
  90:       if (this.evaluateCondition(email, condition)) {
  91:         matchedConditions.push(condition.field);
  92:       }
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     // Si toutes conditions matchent, c'est un succès
  96:     if (matchedConditions.length === conditions.length) {
  97:       return {
  98:         rule,
  99:         matchedConditions,
 100:         confidence: 1.0,
 101:       };
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     return null;
 105:   }
 106: 
 107:   /**
 108:    * Ã‰value une condition individuelle
 109:    */
 110:   private evaluateCondition(email: Email, condition: FilterCondition): boolean {
 111:     const fieldValue = this.getFieldValue(email, condition.field);
 112:     if (!fieldValue) return false;
 113: 
 114:     switch (condition.operator) {
 115:       case 'EQUALS':
 116:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase() === (condition.value as string).toLowerCase();
 117: 
 118:       case 'CONTAINS':
 119:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().includes((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 120: 
 121:       case 'STARTS_WITH':
 122:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().startsWith((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 123: 
 124:       case 'ENDS_WITH':
 125:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().endsWith((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 126: 
 127:       case 'REGEX':
 128:         try {
 129:           const regex = new RegExp(condition.value as string, 'i');
 130:           return regex.test(fieldValue);
 131:         } catch {
 132:           return false;
 133:         }
 134: 
 135:       case 'IN':
 136:         return (condition.value as string[]).some(
 137:           v => v.toLowerCase() === fieldValue.toLowerCase()
 138:         );
 139: 
 140:       case 'NOT_IN':
 141:         return !(condition.value as string[]).some(
 142:           v => v.toLowerCase() === fieldValue.toLowerCase()
 143:         );
 144: 
 145:       default:
 146:         return false;
 147:     }
 148:   }
 149: 
 150:   /**
 151:    * Récupère la valeur d'un champ email
 152:    */
 153:   private getFieldValue(email: Email, field: FilterCondition['field']): string | null {
 154:     switch (field) {
 155:       case 'from':
 156:         return email.from;
 157:       case 'to':
 158:         return email.to;
 159:       case 'subject':
 160:         return email.subject;
 161:       case 'body':
 162:         return email.body;
 163:       case 'category':
 164:         return email.category;
 165:       case 'urgency':
 166:         return email.urgency;
 167:       case 'sentiment':
 168:         return email.sentiment;
 169:       default:
 170:         return null;
 171:     }
 172:   }
 173: 
 174:   /**
 175:    * Applique les actions d'une règle à un email
 176:    * Met à jour l'email en DB et trace avec EventLog
 177:    */
 178:   async applyActions(emailId: string, rule: FilterRule, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
 179:     const actions = rule.actions as FilterAction[];
 180: 
 181:     const updateData: any = {};
 182: 
 183:     for (const action of actions) {
 184:       switch (action.type) {
 185:         case 'ASSIGN_DOSSIER':
 186:           if (action.dossierId) {
 187:             updateData.dossierId = action.dossierId;
 188:           }
 189:           break;
 190: 
 191:         case 'ASSIGN_CLIENT':
 192:           if (action.clientId) {
 193:             updateData.clientId = action.clientId;
 194:           }

  30: async function parseResponse<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  31:   const text = await response.text();
  32:   let body: unknown = null;
  33: 
  34:   if (text) {
  35:     try {
  36:       body = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  37:     } catch {
  38:       body = null;
  39:     }
  40:   }

  44:       typeof body === 'object' && body !== null && 'error' in body

  46:         : 'Erreur API';
  47: 
  48:     throw new ApiError(message, response.status);
  49:   }
  50: 
  51:   return body as T;
  52: }

_archive\frontend\lib\services\smart-inbox.service.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * SmartInboxService - Service de scoring intelligent des emails (Phase 4)
   4:  *
   5:  * Calcule un score de priorité 0-100 pour chaque email basé sur:
   6:  * - Urgence (30%)
   7:  * - Client VIP (25%)
   8:  * - Deadline proche (20%)
   9:  * - Sentiment (15%)
  10:  * - Attachments (10%)
  11:  *
  12:  * @example
  13:  * ```ts
  14:  * const service = new SmartInboxService();
  15:  * const score = await service.calculateScore(email, tenant);
  16:  * console.log(score.score); // 85
  17:  * console.log(score.factors); // { urgency: 30, vipClient: 25, ... }
  18:  * ```
  19:  */
  20: 
  21: import { PrismaClient, Email, Client } from '@prisma/client';
  22: import { eventLogService } from '../../../lib/services/event-log.service';
  23: 
  24: export type ScoringFactors = {
  25:   urgency: number; // 0-30
  26:   vipClient: number; // 0-25
  27:   hasDeadline: number; // 0-20
  28:   sentiment: number; // 0-15
  29:   hasAttachments: number; // 0-10
  30:   total: number; // 0-100
  31: };
  32: 
  33: export type InboxScoreResult = {
  34:   score: number;
  35:   factors: ScoringFactors;
  36:   model: string;
  37:   confidence: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  38: };
  39: 
  40: export class SmartInboxService {
  41:   constructor(private prisma: PrismaClient = new PrismaClient()) {}
  42: 
  43:   /**
  44:    * Calcule le score de priorité pour un email
  45:    */
  46:   async calculateScore(email: Email, tenantId: string): Promise<InboxScoreResult> {
  47:     const factors: ScoringFactors = {
  48:       urgency: 0,
  49:       vipClient: 0,
  50:       hasDeadline: 0,
  51:       sentiment: 0,
  52:       hasAttachments: 0,
  53:       total: 0,
  54:     };
  55: 
  56:     // 1. Urgence (30 points max)
  57:     factors.urgency = this.scoreUrgency(email.urgency);
  58: 
  59:     // 2. Client VIP (25 points max)
  60:     if (email.clientId) {
  61:       const client = await this.prisma.client.findUnique({
  62:         where: { id: email.clientId },
  63:       });
  64:       factors.vipClient = await this.scoreVIPClient(client);
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     // 3. Deadline proche (20 points max)
  68:     factors.hasDeadline = await this.scoreDeadline(email);
  69: 
  70:     // 4. Sentiment (15 points max)
  71:     factors.sentiment = this.scoreSentiment(email.sentiment);
  72: 
  73:     // 5. Attachments (10 points max)
  74:     const attachments = await this.prisma.emailAttachment.count({
  75:       where: { emailId: email.id },
  76:     });
  77:     factors.hasAttachments = this.scoreAttachments(attachments);
  78: 
  79:     // Total
  80:     factors.total = Math.min(
  81:       100,
  82:       factors.urgency +
  83:         factors.vipClient +
  84:         factors.hasDeadline +
  85:         factors.sentiment +
  86:         factors.hasAttachments
  87:     );
  88: 
  89:     // Confidence basée sur nombre de facteurs non-nuls
  90:     const nonZeroFactors = Object.values(factors).filter(v => v > 0).length - 1; // -1 pour exclure total
  91:     const confidence: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' =
  92:       nonZeroFactors >= 4 ? 'high' : nonZeroFactors >= 2 ? 'medium' : 'low';
  93: 
  94:     return {
  95:       score: factors.total,
  96:       factors,
  97:       model: 'smart-inbox-v1',
  98:       confidence,
  99:     };
 100:   }
 101: 
 102:   /**
 103:    * Score urgence: critical=30, high=20, medium=10, low=5
 104:    */
 105:   private scoreUrgency(urgency: string): number {
 106:     switch (urgency.toLowerCase()) {
 107:       case 'critical':
 108:         return 30;
 109:       case 'high':
 110:         return 20;
 111:       case 'medium':
 112:         return 10;
 113:       case 'low':
 114:         return 5;
 115:       default:
 116:         return 0;
 117:     }
 118:   }
 119: 
 120:   /**
 121:    * Score client VIP: 25 points si VIP, 0 sinon
 122:    * Critères VIP: >5 dossiers actifs OU factures >10kâ‚¬
 123:    */
 124:   private async scoreVIPClient(client: Client | null): Promise<number> {
 125:     if (!client) return 0;
 126: 
 127:     const dossiers = await this.prisma.dossier.count({
 128:       where: {
 129:         clientId: client.id,
 130:         statut: 'en_cours',
 131:       },
 132:     });
 133: 
 134:     if (dossiers >= 5) return 25;
 135: 
 136:     // TODO: Vérifier montant factures si >10kâ‚¬
 137:     // const factures = await prisma.facture.aggregate({ ... })
 138: 
 139:     return 0;
 140:   }
 141: 
 142:   /**
 143:    * Score deadline proche: 20 points si deadline <7j, 10 si <30j
 144:    */
 145:   private async scoreDeadline(email: Email): Promise<number> {
 146:     if (!email.dossierId) return 0;
 147: 
 148:     const now = new Date();
 149:     const in7days = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 150:     const in30days = new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 151: 
 152:     const urgentDeadline = await this.prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({
 153:       where: {
 154:         dossierId: email.dossierId,
 155:         dueDate: {
 156:           gte: now,
 157:           lte: in7days,
 158:         },
 159:         status: { in: ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING', 'URGENT'] },
 160:       },
 161:     });
 162: 
 163:     if (urgentDeadline) return 20;
 164: 
 165:     const approachingDeadline = await this.prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({
 166:       where: {
 167:         dossierId: email.dossierId,
 168:         dueDate: {
 169:           gte: now,
 170:           lte: in30days,
 171:         },
 172:         status: { in: ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING'] },
 173:       },
 174:     });
 175: 
 176:     if (approachingDeadline) return 10;
 177: 
 178:     return 0;
 179:   }
 180: 
 181:   /**
 182:    * Score sentiment: negative=15 (besoin aide), neutral=8, positive=5
 183:    */
 184:   private scoreSentiment(sentiment: string): number {
 185:     switch (sentiment.toLowerCase()) {
 186:       case 'negative':
 187:         return 15; // Client mécontent = prioritaire
 188:       case 'neutral':
 189:         return 8;
 190:       case 'positive':
 191:         return 5;
 192:       default:
 193:         return 0;
 194:     }
 195:   }
 196: 
 197:   /**
 198:    * Score attachments: 10 points si >=1 pièce jointe
 199:    */
 200:   private scoreAttachments(count: number): number {
 201:     return count > 0 ? 10 : 0;
 202:   }
 203: 
 204:   /**
 205:    * Sauvegarde le score en DB et trace avec EventLog
 206:    */
 207:   async saveScore(emailId: string, scoreResult: InboxScoreResult, tenantId: string): Promise<void> {
 208:     // Créer/mettre à jour InboxScore
 209:     await this.prisma.inboxScore.upsert({
 210:       where: { emailId },
 211:       create: {
 212:         emailId,
 213:         score: scoreResult.score,
 214:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 215:         model: scoreResult.model,
 216:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 217:       },
 218:       update: {
 219:         score: scoreResult.score,
 220:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 221:         model: scoreResult.model,
 222:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 223:         calculatedAt: new Date(),
 224:       },
 225:     });
 226: 
 227:     // Tracer avec EventLog
 228:     await eventLogService.createEventLog({
 229:       eventType: 'FLOW_SCORED',
 230:       entityType: 'email',
 231:       entityId: emailId,
 232:       actorType: 'AI',
 233:       tenantId,
 234:       metadata: {
 235:         score: scoreResult.score,
 236:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 237:         model: scoreResult.model,
 238:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 239:       },
 240:     });
 241:   }

 246:   async getPrioritizedInbox(
 247:     tenantId: string,
 248:     options: {

  49: async function parseResponse<T>(response: Response): Promise<T> {
  50:   const text = await response.text();
  51:   let body: unknown = null;
  52: 
  53:   if (text) {
  54:     try {
  55:       body = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  56:     } catch {
  57:       body = null;
  58:     }
  59:   }
  60: 
  61:   if (!response.ok) {
  62:     const message =
  63:       typeof body === 'object' && body !== null && 'error' in body
  64:         ? String((body as { error: unknown }).error)
  65:         : 'Erreur API';
  66: 
  67:     throw new ApiError(message, response.status);
  68:   }
  69: 
  70:   return body as T;
  71: }

  73: export async function listTasks(params: {
  74:   status?: string;
  75:   priority?: string;
  76:   sortBy?: 'dueDate' | 'createdAt' | 'priority' | 'status';
  77:   sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
  78:   includeAssignees?: boolean;
  79: } = {}): Promise<TasksApiResponse> {
  80:   const search = new URLSearchParams();
  81:   if (params.status) search.set('status', params.status);
  82:   if (params.priority) search.set('priority', params.priority);
  83:   if (params.sortBy) search.set('sortBy', params.sortBy);
  84:   if (params.sortOrder) search.set('sortOrder', params.sortOrder);
  85:   if (params.includeAssignees) search.set('includeAssignees', '1');
  86: 
  87:   const query = search.toString();
  88:   const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/tasks${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`, {
  89:     method: 'GET',
  90:     credentials: 'include',
  91:     cache: 'no-store',
  92:   });
  93: 
  94:   return parseResponse<TasksApiResponse>(response);
  95: }
  96: 
  97: export async function updateTask(id: string, payload: UpdateTaskPayload): Promise<TaskApiItem> {
  98:   const response = await fetch(`/api/v1/tasks/${id}`, {
  99:     method: 'PATCH',
 100:     credentials: 'include',
 101:     headers: {
 102:       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
 103:     },
 104:     body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 105:   });
 106: 
 107:   return parseResponse<TaskApiItem>(response);
 108: }

   1: # API Webhook Pattern Adapter Multi-Canal
   2: 
   3: ## Vue d'ensemble
   4: 
   5: L'endpoint `/api/webhooks/test-multichannel` normalise les messages provenant de multiples canaux (Email, WhatsApp, SMS, Formulaires) vers un format unifiÃ©.
   6: 
   7: **URL de base**: `http://localhost:3000`
   8: 
   9: ---
  10: 
  11: ## Endpoints
  12: 
  13: ### GET /api/webhooks/test-multichannel
  14: 
  15: Retourne la documentation et des exemples de payloads pour chaque canal.

  32: 
  33: ---
  34: 
  35: ### POST /api/webhooks/test-multichannel
  36:

  38:

  40:

  42: Content-Type: application/json

  60:

  62: {
  63:   "success": false,
  64:   "error": "DUPLICATE_MESSAGE",
  65:   "message": "Ce message a dÃ©jÃ  Ã©tÃ© traitÃ© (doublon dÃ©tectÃ©)",
  66:   "checksum": "abc123def456..."

  69: 
  70: **RÃ©ponse (400 Bad Request) - Erreur de traitement**:

  77: 
  78: ---
  79: 
  80: ## Format des payloads par canal
  81: 
  82: ### Email
  83: 
  84: ```json
  85: {
  86:   "channel": "EMAIL",
  87:   "messageId": "msg_1234567890",
  88:   "from": "client@example.com",
  89:   "to": "cabinet@example.com",
  90:   "subject": "Question urgente",
  91:   "text": "Bonjour, j'ai une question juridique..."
  92: }
  93: ```
  94: 
  95: **Champs extraits**:
  96: 
  97: - `sender.email`: `from`
  98: - `body`: `text`
  99: - `subject`: `subject`
 100: 
 101: ---
 102: 
 103: ### WhatsApp
 104: 
 105: ```json
 106: {
 107:   "channel": "WHATSAPP",
 108:   "entry": [
 109:     {
 110:       "changes": [
 111:         {
 112:           "value": {
 113:             "messages": [
 114:               {
 115:                 "id": "wamid_1234567890",
 116:                 "from": "+33612345678",
 117:                 "type": "text",
 118:                 "text": { "body": "Message via WhatsApp" }
 119:               }
 120:             ],
 121:             "contacts": [{ "profile": { "name": "Marie Client" } }]
 122:           }
 123:         }
 124:       ]
 125:     }
 126:   ]
 127: }
 128: ```
 129: 
 130: **Champs extraits**:
 131: 
 132: - `sender.phone`: `messages[0].from`
 133: - `sender.name`: `contacts[0].profile.name`
 134: - `body`: `messages[0].text.body`
 135: - `externalId`: `messages[0].id`
 136: 
 137: ---
 138: 
 139: ### SMS
 140: 
 141: ```json
 142: {
 143:   "channel": "SMS",
 144:   "MessageSid": "SM1234567890",
 145:   "From": "+33612345678",
 146:   "To": "+33698765432",
 147:   "Body": "Message urgent via SMS"
 148: }
 149: ```
 150: 
 151: **Champs extraits**:
 152: 
 153: - `sender.phone`: `From`
 154: - `body`: `Body`
 155: - `externalId`: `MessageSid`
 156: 
 157: ---
 158: 
 159: ### Formulaire Web
 160: 
 161: ```json
 162: {
 163:   "channel": "FORM",
 164:   "submissionId": "form_1234567890",
 165:   "email": "client@example.com",
 166:   "name": "John Doe",
 167:   "subject": "Contact formulaire",
 168:   "message": "Demande via formulaire web",
 169:   "consentGiven": true
 170: }
 171: ```
 172: 
 173: **Champs extraits**:
 174: 
 175: - `sender.email`: `email`
 176: - `sender.name`: `name`
 177: - `subject`: `subject`
 178: - `body`: `message`
 179: - `externalId`: `submissionId`
 180: 
 181: ---
 182: 
 183: ## DÃ©duplication
 184: 
 185: Chaque message reÃ§oit un **checksum SHA-256** basÃ© sur le contenu normalisÃ©.
 186: 
 187: - âœ… Premier message avec un checksum unique â†’ **Status 200**
 188: - âŒ DeuxiÃ¨me message avec le mÃªme checksum â†’ **Status 409 DUPLICATE**
 189: 
 190: **Exemple**:
 191: 
 192: ```bash
 193: # 1Ã¨re requÃªte
 194: curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/test-multichannel \
 195:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 196:   -d '{"channel":"EMAIL","from":"test@example.com","text":"Hello"}'
 197: 
 198: # RÃ©ponse
 199: { "success": true, "checksum": "abc123..." }
 200: 
 201: # 2Ã¨me requÃªte identique
 202: curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/test-multichannel \
 203:   -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

 205: 
 206: # RÃ©ponse
 207: { "success": false, "error": "DUPLICATE_MESSAGE", "checksum": "abc123..." }
 208: ```
 209: 
 210: ---
 211: 
 212: ## Cycle de vie des messages
 213: 
 214: 1. **RECEIVED** (par dÃ©faut) - Message reÃ§u et validÃ©
 215: 2. **PROCESSING** - En cours de traitement IA
 216: 3. **CATEGORIZED** - CatÃ©gorisÃ© automatiquement
 217: 4. **ASSIGNED** - AssignÃ© Ã  un avocat
 218: 5. **RESOLVED** - RÃ©pondu
 219: 
 220: ---
 221: 
 222: ## Codes de rÃ©ponse
 223: 
 224: | Code    | Signification                         |
 225: | ------- | ------------------------------------- |
 226: | **200** | Message traitÃ© avec succÃ¨s            |
 227: | **409** | Doublon dÃ©tectÃ© (mÃªme checksum)       |
 228: | **400** | Erreur de validation ou de traitement |
 229: | **500** | Erreur serveur interne                |

  70: function isFeatureEnvEnabled(envKey: string): boolean {
  71:   const val = process.env[envKey];
  72:   return val === 'true' || val === '1';
  73: }
  74: 
  75: /**
  76:  * Check if an API route is blocked by feature flags.
  77:  * Returns the module name if blocked, null if allowed.
  78:  */
  79: function getBlockedApiModule(pathname: string): string | null {
  80:   for (const { prefix, envKey, module } of DISABLED_API_PREFIXES) {
  81:     if (pathname.startsWith(prefix) && !isFeatureEnvEnabled(envKey)) {
  82:       return module;
  83:     }
  84:   }
  85:   return null;
  86: }

  88: export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  89:   const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  90: 
  91:   // â”€â”€ API routes: check feature gate, then pass through â”€â”€
  92:   if (pathname.startsWith('/api')) {
  93:     const blockedModule = getBlockedApiModule(pathname);
  94:     if (blockedModule) {
  95:       return NextResponse.json(
  96:         {
  97:           error: 'Feature not available',
  98:           message: `Le module "${blockedModule}" n'est pas activÃ©. Contactez votre administrateur.`,
  99:           code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED',
 100:           module: blockedModule,
 101:         },
 102:         { status: 404 }
 103:       );
 104:     }
 105:     return NextResponse.next();
 106:   }
 107: 
 108:   if (
 109:     pathname.startsWith('/_next') ||
 110:     pathname.startsWith('/static') ||
 111:     pathname === '/favicon.ico' ||
 112:     pathname === '/sitemap.xml' ||
 113:     pathname === '/robots.txt' ||
 114:     /\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp|ico|xml|txt)$/.test(pathname)
 115:   ) {
 116:     return NextResponse.next();
 117:   }
 118: 
 119:   // Raccourcis directs â€” redirige sans locale prefix
 120:   const shortcuts: Record<string, string> = {
 121:     '/dashboard': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/dashboard`,
 122:     '/login': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/login`,
 123:     '/emails': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/emails`,
 124:     '/dossiers': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/dossiers`,
 125:     '/clients': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/clients`,
 126:     '/documents': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/documents`,
 127:     '/jurisprudence': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/jurisprudence`,
 128:     '/calendrier': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/calendrier`,
 129:     '/factures': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/factures`,
 130:     '/admin': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/admin/dashboard`,
 131:     '/settings': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/admin/settings`,
 132:     '/billing': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/billing`,
 133:     '/analytics': `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/analytics`,
 134:   };
 135: 
 136:   if (shortcuts[pathname]) {
 137:     const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
 138:     url.pathname = shortcuts[pathname];
 139:     return NextResponse.redirect(url);
 140:   }
 141: 
 142:   // Root â†’ homepage ou dashboard selon session
 143:   if (pathname === '/') {
 144:     const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
 145:     const hasSession = request.cookies.has('next-auth.session-token') || 
 146:                        request.cookies.has('__Secure-next-auth.session-token');
 147:     url.pathname = hasSession ? `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}/dashboard` : `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}`;
 148:     return NextResponse.redirect(url);
 149:   }
 150: 
 151:   // Check if pathname already has a locale prefix
 152:   const hasLocale = LOCALES.some(
 153:     locale => pathname.startsWith(`/${locale}/`) || pathname === `/${locale}`
 154:   );
 155: 
 156:   // Redirect to default locale if no locale in path
 157:   if (!hasLocale) {
 158:     const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
 159:     url.pathname = `/${DEFAULT_LOCALE}${pathname}`;
 160:     return NextResponse.redirect(url);
 161:   }
 162: 
 163:   // Protected routes: redirect to login if no session
 164:   const hasSession = request.cookies.has('next-auth.session-token') || 
 165:                      request.cookies.has('__Secure-next-auth.session-token');
 166:   
 167:   const PROTECTED_PREFIXES = ['/dashboard', '/admin', '/super-admin', '/lawyer', '/client-dashboard', '/dossiers', '/clients', '/documents', '/factures', '/emails'];
 168:   const pathnameWithoutLocale = pathname.replace(/^\/(fr|en|es|de|pt|ja|zh|hi|ru|ko)/, '');
 169:   
 170:   if (!hasSession && PROTECTED_PREFIXES.some(p => pathnameWithoutLocale.startsWith(p))) {
 171:     const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
 172:     const locale = LOCALES.find(l => pathname.startsWith(`/${l}/`)) || DEFAULT_LOCALE;
 173:     url.pathname = `/${locale}/auth/login`;
 174:     return NextResponse.redirect(url);
 175:   }
 176: 
 177:   const response = NextResponse.next();
 178: 
 179:   // Generate CSP nonce
 180:   const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64');
 181:   response.headers.set('x-nonce', nonce);
 182: 
 183:   // ðŸ”’ ANTI-FUITE: EmpÃªche les proxies/CDN de cacher des donnÃ©es sensibles
 184:   response.headers.set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate');
 185:   response.headers.set('Pragma', 'no-cache');
 186:   response.headers.set('Expires', '0');
 187: 
 188:   // ðŸ”’ X-Frame-Options: PrÃ©vient les attaques clickjacking
 189:   response.headers.set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
 190: 
 191:   // ðŸ”’ X-Content-Type-Options: EmpÃªche le MIME-sniffing
 192:   response.headers.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
 193: 
 194:   // ðŸ”’ Referrer-Policy: ContrÃ´le les informations envoyÃ©es dans le header Referer
 195:   response.headers.set('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
 196: 
 197:   // ðŸ”’ Permissions-Policy: DÃ©sactive les APIs sensibles du navigateur
 198:   response.headers.set(
 199:     'Permissions-Policy',
 200:     'geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=()'
 201:   );
 202: 
 203:   // ðŸ”’ X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: DÃ©sactive le prefetch DNS pour les liens externes
 204:   response.headers.set('X-DNS-Prefetch-Control', 'off');
 205: 
 206:   // ðŸ”’ Content-Security-Policy (CSP) â€” nonce-based
 207:   const cspDirectives = [
 208:     "default-src 'self'",
 209:     `script-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}' 'strict-dynamic' https://vercel.live https://va.vercel-scripts.com`,
 210:     "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'",
 211:     "img-src 'self' data: https: blob:",
 212:     "font-src 'self' data:",
 213:     "connect-src 'self' https://vercel.live https://*.sentry.io https://*.neon.tech https://*.azurewebsites.net https://*.twilio.com wss://*.vercel.live",
 214:     "frame-src 'self' https://vercel.live",
 215:     "media-src 'self'",
 216:     "object-src 'none'",
 217:     "base-uri 'self'",
 218:     "form-action 'self'",
 219:     "frame-ancestors 'none'",
 220:     'upgrade-insecure-requests',
 221:   ];
 222: 
 223:   response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', cspDirectives.join('; '));
 224: 
 225:   // ðŸ”’ HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security) - PRODUCTION SEULEMENT
 226:   if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
 227:     response.headers.set(
 228:       'Strict-Transport-Security',
 229:       'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload'
 230:     );
 231:   }
 232: 
 233:   // ðŸ”’ X-XSS-Protection: Protection XSS legacy
 234:   response.headers.set('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');
 235: 
 236:   // ðŸ“Š Server header - Masquer la version
 237:   response.headers.delete('Server');
 238:   response.headers.delete('X-Powered-By');
 239: 
 240:   return response;
 241: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Gmail OAuth Setup â€” Obtenir un refresh_token
   3:  * 
   4:  * PRÃ‰REQUIS:
   5:  * 1. Aller sur https://console.cloud.google.com
   6:  * 2. CrÃ©er un projet (ou utiliser existant)
   7:  * 3. Activer l'API Gmail: APIs & Services > Enable APIs > Gmail API
   8:  * 4. CrÃ©er des credentials OAuth 2.0:
   9:  *    - APIs & Services > Credentials > Create Credentials > OAuth client ID
  10:  *    - Type: Web application
  11:  *    - Redirect URI: http://localhost:3000/api/oauth/gmail/callback
  12:  * 5. Copier Client ID et Client Secret dans .env.local
  13:  * 6. Lancer ce script: npx tsx scripts/gmail-oauth-setup.ts
  14:  */
  15: 
  16: import http from 'http';
  17: import { google } from 'googleapis';
  18: 
  19: const CLIENT_ID = process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID;
  20: const CLIENT_SECRET = process.env.GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET;
  21: const REDIRECT_URI = 'http://localhost:3000/api/oauth/gmail/callback';
  22: 
  23: if (!CLIENT_ID || !CLIENT_SECRET) {
  24:   console.error('âŒ GMAIL_CLIENT_ID et GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET doivent Ãªtre dÃ©finis dans .env.local');
  25:   console.log('\nðŸ“‹ Ã‰tapes:');
  26:   console.log('1. https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials');
  27:   console.log('2. CrÃ©er OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web application)');
  28:   console.log('3. Redirect URI: http://localhost:3000/api/oauth/gmail/callback');
  29:   console.log('4. Copier Client ID + Secret dans .env.local');
  30:   console.log('5. Relancer: npx tsx scripts/gmail-oauth-setup.ts');
  31:   process.exit(1);
  32: }
  33: 
  34: const oauth2Client = new google.auth.OAuth2(CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, REDIRECT_URI);
  35: 
  36: const SCOPES = [
  37:   'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly',
  38:   'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify',
  39:   'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.send',
  40: ];
  41: 
  42: const authUrl = oauth2Client.generateAuthUrl({
  43:   access_type: 'offline',
  44:   scope: SCOPES,
  45:   prompt: 'consent',
  46: });
  47: 
  48: console.log('ðŸ” Gmail OAuth Setup\n');
  49: console.log('Ouvre cette URL dans ton navigateur:\n');
  50: console.log(authUrl);
  51: console.log('\nâ³ En attente du callback sur http://localhost:3000/api/oauth/gmail/callback...');
  52: console.log('   (Le serveur Next.js doit tourner)\n');
  53: console.log('AprÃ¨s autorisation, copie le "code" de l\'URL de callback et colle-le ici:');
  54: 
  55: process.stdin.resume();
  56: process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');
  57: process.stdin.on('data', async (code: string) => {
  58:   try {
  59:     const { tokens } = await oauth2Client.getToken(code.trim());
  60:     console.log('\nâœ… Tokens obtenus!\n');
  61:     console.log('Ajoute dans .env.local:\n');
  62:     console.log(`GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN=${tokens.refresh_token}`);
  63:     console.log(`\n# Access token (expire, pas besoin de le stocker):`);
  64:     console.log(`# ${tokens.access_token?.slice(0, 30)}...`);
  65:     console.log('\nðŸŽ‰ Gmail est maintenant connectÃ© Ã  MemoLib!');
  66:   } catch (e: any) {
  67:     console.error('âŒ Erreur:', e.message);
  68:   }
  69:   process.exit(0);
  70: });

  23:       const parseSort = (params: URLSearchParams) => {
  24:         const sortBy = params.get('sortBy') || 'createdAt';
  25:         const sortOrder = params.get('sortOrder') === 'asc' ? 'asc' : 'desc';
  26:         return { sortBy, sortOrder };

  39:           const value = params.get(field);
  40:           if (value) filters[field] = value;

  42:         return filters;

 124:       };

 154:         return 'application/json';

 163:     it('should extract API version', () => {
 164:       const extractVersion = (path: string) => {

 166:         return match ? match[1] : 'v1';
 167:       };
 168:

 170:       expect(extractVersion('/api/users')).toBe('v1');

 174:   describe('query string handling', () => {
 175:     it('should build query string', () => {
 176:       const buildQueryString = (params: Record<string, any>) => {
 177:         const entries = Object.entries(params)
 178:           .filter(([_, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null)
 179:           .map(([k, v]) => `${encodeURIComponent(k)}=${encodeURIComponent(v)}`);
 180:         return entries.length ? `?${entries.join('&')}` : '';
 181:       };
 182: 
 183:       expect(buildQueryString({ page: 1, status: 'active' }))
 184:         .toBe('?page=1&status=active');
 185:       expect(buildQueryString({})).toBe('');
 186:     });
 187:   });

 190:     it('should validate required fields', () => {
 191:       const validateRequired = (body: any, required: string[]) => {
 192:         const missing = required.filter(field => !(field in body) || body[field] === undefined);
 193:         return {
 194:           valid: missing.length === 0,
 195:           missing,
 196:         };
 197:       };
 198: 
 199:       expect(validateRequired({ name: 'Test' }, ['name']).valid).toBe(true);
 200:       expect(validateRequired({}, ['name']).valid).toBe(false);
 201:     });
 202: 
 203:     it('should validate field types', () => {
 204:       const validateTypes = (
 205:         body: any,
 206:         schema: Record<string, string>
 207:       ) => {
 208:         const errors: string[] = [];
 209:         Object.entries(schema).forEach(([field, expectedType]) => {
 210:           if (field in body && typeof body[field] !== expectedType) {
 211:             errors.push(`${field} must be ${expectedType}`);
 212:           }
 213:         });
 214:         return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
 215:       };
 216: 
 217:       expect(validateTypes({ age: 25 }, { age: 'number' }).valid).toBe(true);
 218:       expect(validateTypes({ age: '25' }, { age: 'number' }).valid).toBe(false);
 219:     });
 220:   });

  26: function credentialsAuthorize() {
  27:   const provider = authOptions.providers.find(
  28:     (candidate) => candidate.id === 'credentials'
  29:   );
  30: 
  31:   const authorize = (provider as { options?: { authorize?: unknown } } | undefined)
  32:     ?.options?.authorize;
  33:   if (typeof authorize !== 'function') {
  34:     throw new Error('Credentials provider not configured');
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   return authorize as (
  38:     credentials: { email: string; password: string },
  39:     request?: Request
  40:   ) => Promise<unknown>;
  41: }

src\__tests__\api\webhooks\github.test.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Tests pour le webhook GitHub
   3:  * VÃ©rifie signature HMAC, gestion des Ã©vÃ©nements, sÃ©curitÃ©
   4:  * 
   5:  * RÃ©Ã©crit sans dÃ©pendance Ã  NextRequest (utilise des helpers de test)
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
   9: import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
  10: 
  11: // â”€â”€â”€ Logique mÃ©tier extraite (testable sans Next.js) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  12: 
  13: const WEBHOOK_SECRET = 'test-webhook-secret-123';
  14: 
  15: function verifyGitHubSignature(payload: string, signature: string | null, secret: string): boolean {
  16:   if (!signature || !secret) return false;
  17:   if (!signature.startsWith('sha256=')) return false;
  18:   
  19:   const expected = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
  20:   
  21:   if (signature.length !== expected.length) return false;
  22:   
  23:   try {
  24:     return timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature), Buffer.from(expected));
  25:   } catch {
  26:     return false;
  27:   }
  28: }
  29: 
  30: function processGitHubEvent(event: string, payload: any): { status: number; message: string } {
  31:   if (!event) return { status: 400, message: 'Missing event type' };
  32: 
  33:   switch (event) {
  34:     case 'ping':
  35:       return { status: 200, message: `ping received: ${payload.zen || 'pong'}` };
  36:     case 'push':
  37:       return { status: 200, message: `Push GitHub received on ${payload.ref}` };
  38:     case 'pull_request':
  39:       return { status: 200, message: `Pull Request #${payload.pull_request?.number} ${payload.action} received` };
  40:     case 'issues':
  41:       return { status: 200, message: `Issue #${payload.issue?.number} ${payload.action} received` };
  42:     default:
  43:       return { status: 200, message: `evenement non gere: ${event}` };
  44:   }
  45: }
  46: 
  47: // â”€â”€â”€ Tests â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  48: 
  49: describe('GitHub Webhook â€” Signature HMAC', () => {
  50:   it('accepte une signature valide', () => {
  51:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'opened' });
  52:     const signature = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex');
  53:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, signature, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(true);
  54:   });
  55: 
  56:   it('rejette une signature invalide', () => {
  57:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'opened' });
  58:     const signature = 'sha256=000000invalidhash00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000';
  59:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, signature, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(false);
  60:   });
  61: 
  62:   it('rejette si signature absente', () => {
  63:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'opened' });
  64:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, null, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(false);
  65:   });
  66: 
  67:   it('rejette si signature ne commence pas par sha256=', () => {
  68:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'opened' });
  69:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, 'md5=abc123', WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(false);
  70:   });
  71: 
  72:   it('rejette si secret est vide', () => {
  73:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'opened' });
  74:     const signature = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex');
  75:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, signature, '')).toBe(false);
  76:   });
  77: 
  78:   it('rÃ©siste au timing attack (mÃªme longueur)', () => {
  79:     const payload = JSON.stringify({ test: 'timing' });
  80:     const validSig = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(payload).digest('hex');
  81:     const invalidSig = 'sha256=' + 'a'.repeat(64);
  82:     
  83:     // Les deux signatures ont la mÃªme longueur
  84:     expect(validSig.length).toBe(invalidSig.length);
  85:     
  86:     // VÃ©rification timing-safe
  87:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, validSig, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(true);
  88:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(payload, invalidSig, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(false);
  89:   });
  90:

  93:     const signature = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', WEBHOOK_SECRET).update(originalPayload).digest('hex');
  94:     const modifiedPayload = JSON.stringify({ action: 'closed' });
  95:     expect(verifyGitHubSignature(modifiedPayload, signature, WEBHOOK_SECRET)).toBe(false);

  20: 
  21: const originalSecret = process.env.INBOX_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  22: 
  23: function signedRequest(payload: Record<string, unknown>, eventId = 'event-1'): NextRequest {
  24:   const body = JSON.stringify(payload);
  25:   const signature = createHmac('sha256', process.env.INBOX_WEBHOOK_SECRET!)
  26:     .update(body, 'utf8')
  27:     .digest('hex');
  28:   return new NextRequest('http://localhost/api/webhooks/inbox', {
  29:     method: 'POST',
  30:     headers: {
  31:       'content-type': 'application/json',
  32:       'x-webhook-id': eventId,
  33:       'x-webhook-signature': `sha256=${signature}`,
  34:     },
  35:     body,
  36:   });
  37: }
  38: 
  39: describe('POST /api/webhooks/inbox', () => {
  40:   beforeEach(() => {

  51:

src\__tests__\api-audit.test.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Tests unitaires - Audit API
   3:  *
   4:  * Valide:
   5:  * - Log tous les appels API
   6:  * - Enregistre user, timestamp, endpoint, status
   7:  * - Supports dÃ©tection tentatives non-autorisÃ©es
   8:  * - AccÃ¨s uniquement aux logs d'audit
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from 'vitest';
  12: 
  13: // --- Logique audit pure ---
  14: 
  15: interface AuditEntry {
  16:   id: string;
  17:   userId: string;
  18:   tenantId: string;
  19:   action: string;
  20:   endpoint: string;
  21:   statusCode: number;
  22:   timestamp: string;
  23:   ip?: string;
  24: }
  25: 
  26: function createAuditEntry(
  27:   userId: string,
  28:   tenantId: string,
  29:   action: string,
  30:   endpoint: string,
  31:   statusCode: number,
  32:   ip?: string
  33: ): AuditEntry {
  34:   return {
  35:     id: `audit-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
  36:     userId,
  37:     tenantId,
  38:     action,
  39:     endpoint,
  40:     statusCode,
  41:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  42:     ip,
  43:   };
  44: }
  45: 
  46: function isUnauthorizedAttempt(entry: AuditEntry): boolean {
  47:   return entry.statusCode === 401 || entry.statusCode === 403;
  48: }
  49: 
  50: type Role = 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'ADMIN' | 'AVOCAT' | 'CLIENT';
  51: function canReadAuditLogs(role: Role): boolean {
  52:   return role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN';
  53: }
  54: 
  55: function filterLogsForUser(logs: AuditEntry[], requestingUserId: string, role: Role): AuditEntry[] {
  56:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' || role === 'ADMIN') return logs;
  57:   return logs.filter((l) => l.userId === requestingUserId);
  58: }
  59: 
  60: describe('API Audit', () => {
  61:   let logs: AuditEntry[];
  62: 
  63:   beforeEach(() => {
  64:     logs = [];
  65:   });
  66: 
  67:   describe('API Call Logging', () => {
  68:     it('enregistre user, timestamp et endpoint dans chaque log', () => {
  69:       const entry = createAuditEntry('user-1', 'tenant-1', 'GET', '/api/dossiers', 200, '127.0.0.1');
  70:       expect(entry.userId).toBe('user-1');
  71:       expect(entry.endpoint).toBe('/api/dossiers');
  72:       expect(entry.timestamp).toBeDefined();
  73:       expect(new Date(entry.timestamp).toISOString()).toBe(entry.timestamp);
  74:     });
  75: 
  76:     it('enregistre le statut HTTP de la rÃ©ponse', () => {
  77:       const ok = createAuditEntry('u', 't', 'POST', '/api/clients', 201);
  78:       const err = createAuditEntry('u', 't', 'DELETE', '/api/dossiers/1', 403);
  79:       expect(ok.statusCode).toBe(201);
  80:       expect(err.statusCode).toBe(403);
  81:     });
  82: 
  83:     it('gÃ©nÃ¨re un identifiant unique par log', () => {
  84:       const e1 = createAuditEntry('u', 't', 'GET', '/api/health', 200);
  85:       const e2 = createAuditEntry('u', 't', 'GET', '/api/health', 200);
  86:       expect(e1.id).not.toBe(e2.id);
  87:     });
  88:   });
  89: 
  90:   describe('Unauthorized Access Detection', () => {
  91:     it('dÃ©tecte une tentative 401 Unauthorized', () => {
  92:       const entry = createAuditEntry('anonymous', 't', 'GET', '/api/admin/users', 401);
  93:       expect(isUnauthorizedAttempt(entry)).toBe(true);
  94:     });
  95: 
  96:     it('dÃ©tecte une tentative 403 Forbidden', () => {
  97:       const entry = createAuditEntry('client-user', 't', 'GET', '/api/admin/users', 403);
  98:       expect(isUnauthorizedAttempt(entry)).toBe(true);
  99:     });
 100: 
 101:     it('ne considÃ¨re pas un 200 comme une tentative non-autorisÃ©e', () => {
 102:       const entry = createAuditEntry('admin', 't', 'GET', '/api/dossiers', 200);
 103:       expect(isUnauthorizedAttempt(entry)).toBe(false);
 104:     });
 105:   });
 106: 
 107:   describe('Access Control', () => {
 108:     it('autorise ADMIN Ã  lire les logs d\'audit', () => {
 109:       expect(canReadAuditLogs('ADMIN')).toBe(true);
 110:     });
 111: 
 112:     it('autorise SUPER_ADMIN Ã  lire les logs d\'audit', () => {
 113:       expect(canReadAuditLogs('SUPER_ADMIN')).toBe(true);
 114:     });
 115: 
 116:     it('empÃªche CLIENT de lire tous les logs d\'audit', () => {
 117:       expect(canReadAuditLogs('CLIENT')).toBe(false);
 118:     });
 119: 
 120:     it('un CLIENT ne voit que ses propres logs', () => {
 121:       const allLogs: AuditEntry[] = [
 122:         createAuditEntry('user-A', 't', 'GET', '/api/dossiers', 200),
 123:         createAuditEntry('user-B', 't', 'GET', '/api/clients', 200),
 124:         createAuditEntry('user-A', 't', 'POST', '/api/factures', 201),
 125:       ];
 126:       const filtered = filterLogsForUser(allLogs, 'user-A', 'CLIENT');
 127:       expect(filtered.length).toBe(2);
 128:       filtered.forEach((l) => expect(l.userId).toBe('user-A'));
 129:     });
 130:   });
 131: });

 187:     const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;

 190:     const recordAttempt = (email: string): void => {
 191:       const current = attempts.get(email) || { count: 0, lastAttempt: new Date() };

 202:     };
 203:

 205:       attempts.delete(email);
 206:     };

  13: function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
  14:   if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
  15:   const k = 1024;
  16:   const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  17:   const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
  18:   return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];
  19: }
  20: 
  21: function getFileIcon(mimeType: string): string {
  22:   if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return 'ï¸';
  23:   if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') return '';
  24:   if (mimeType.includes('word')) return '';
  25:   if (mimeType.includes('excel') || mimeType.includes('spreadsheet')) return '';
  26:   if (mimeType.includes('text')) return '';
  27:   return '';
  28: }

  82:     const testCases = [
  83:       { route: '/api/admin/users', role: 'CLIENT', expected: false },
  84:       { route: '/api/admin/users', role: 'ADMIN', expected: true },
  85:       { route: '/api/admin/users', role: 'AVOCAT', expected: true },
  86:       { route: '/api/super-admin/tenants', role: 'ADMIN', expected: false },

  88:       { route: '/api/client/dossiers', role: 'CLIENT', expected: true },
  89:       { route: '/api/client/dossiers', role: 'ADMIN', expected: true },
  90:     ];
  91: 
  92:     testCases.forEach(({ route, role, expected }) => {
  93:       it(`${expected ? 'autorise' : 'refuse'} ${role} sur ${route}`, () => {
  94:         const isAdminRoute = ['/api/admin', '/api/lawyer', '/api/tenant'].some(r =>
  95:           route.startsWith(r)
  96:         );
  97:         const isSuperAdminRoute = route.startsWith('/api/super-admin');
  98: 
  99:         let allowed = true;
 100: 
 101:         if (isSuperAdminRoute && role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
 102:           allowed = false;
 103:         } else if (isAdminRoute && !['ADMIN', 'AVOCAT', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(role)) {
 104:           allowed = false;
 105:         }
 106: 
 107:         expect(allowed).toBe(expected);
 108:       });
 109:     });
 110:   });

 112:   describe('Rate Limiting', () => {
 113:     it('a des limites différentes par type de route', () => {
 114:       const RATE_LIMITS = {
 115:         public: 30,
 116:         auth: 100,
 117:         ai: 10,
 118:       };
 119: 
 120:       expect(RATE_LIMITS.public).toBe(30);
 121:       expect(RATE_LIMITS.auth).toBe(100);
 122:       expect(RATE_LIMITS.ai).toBe(10);
 123:     });
 124: 
 125:     it('identifie correctement les routes IA', () => {
 126:       const aiRoutes = ['/api/ai/analyze', '/api/reasoning/context', '/api/suggestions/generate'];
 127: 
 128:       const isAIRoute = (pathname: string) =>
 129:         pathname.includes('/ai/') ||
 130:         pathname.includes('/reasoning') ||
 131:         pathname.includes('/suggestions');
 132: 
 133:       aiRoutes.forEach(route => {
 134:         expect(isAIRoute(route)).toBe(true);
 135:       });
 136: 
 137:       expect(isAIRoute('/api/dossiers')).toBe(false);
 138:     });
 139: 
 140:     it('calcule le rate limit correctement', () => {
 141:       const rateLimitMap = new Map<string, { count: number; resetTime: number }>();
 142:       const WINDOW_MS = 60000;
 143:       const LIMIT = 10;
 144: 
 145:       const checkRateLimit = (key: string) => {
 146:         const now = Date.now();
 147:         const record = rateLimitMap.get(key);
 148: 
 149:         if (!record || now > record.resetTime) {
 150:           rateLimitMap.set(key, { count: 1, resetTime: now + WINDOW_MS });
 151:           return { allowed: true, remaining: LIMIT - 1 };
 152:         }
 153: 
 154:         if (record.count >= LIMIT) {
 155:           return { allowed: false, remaining: 0 };
 156:         }
 157: 
 158:         record.count++;
 159:         return { allowed: true, remaining: LIMIT - record.count };
 160:       };
 161: 
 162:       // Premier appel
 163:       const result1 = checkRateLimit('user-123');
 164:       expect(result1.allowed).toBe(true);
 165:       expect(result1.remaining).toBe(9);
 166: 
 167:       // Épuiser la limite
 168:       for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
 169:         checkRateLimit('user-123');
 170:       }
 171: 
 172:       // Devrait être bloqué
 173:       const resultBlocked = checkRateLimit('user-123');
 174:       expect(resultBlocked.allowed).toBe(false);
 175:       expect(resultBlocked.remaining).toBe(0);
 176:     });
 177:   });
 178: 
 179:   describe('Headers de Sécurité', () => {

 184:         'X-XSS-Protection': '1; mode=block',

 192:     });
 193:   });

src\__tests__\middleware\middleware.test.ts

   1: import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';
   2: 
   3: /**
   4:  * Tests pour middleware logic
   5:  * Coverage: Logique des middlewares
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: describe('Middleware Logic - Pure Unit Tests', () => {
   9:   describe('authentication middleware', () => {
  10:     it('should extract bearer token', () => {
  11:       const extractToken = (authHeader?: string) => {
  12:         if (!authHeader) return null;
  13:         const match = authHeader.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);
  14:         return match ? match[1] : null;
  15:       };
  16: 
  17:       expect(extractToken('Bearer abc123')).toBe('abc123');
  18:       expect(extractToken('bearer token')).toBe('token');
  19:       expect(extractToken('Basic abc123')).toBeNull();
  20:       expect(extractToken(undefined)).toBeNull();
  21:     });
  22: 
  23:     it('should validate session', () => {
  24:       const isValidSession = (session: any) => 
  25:         session && 
  26:         session.userId && 
  27:         session.expiresAt && 
  28:         new Date(session.expiresAt) > new Date();
  29: 
  30:       const validSession = {
  31:         userId: '123',
  32:         expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString(),
  33:       };
  34: 
  35:       const expiredSession = {
  36:         userId: '123',
  37:         expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(),
  38:       };
  39: 
  40:       expect(isValidSession(validSession)).toBe(true);
  41:       expect(isValidSession(expiredSession)).toBe(false);
  42:     });
  43:   });
  44: 
  45:   describe('rate limiting middleware', () => {
  46:     it('should track request count', () => {
  47:       const requestCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  48: 
  49:       const incrementCount = (key: string) => {
  50:         requestCounts[key] = (requestCounts[key] || 0) + 1;
  51:         return requestCounts[key];
  52:       };
  53: 
  54:       expect(incrementCount('user-1')).toBe(1);
  55:       expect(incrementCount('user-1')).toBe(2);
  56:       expect(incrementCount('user-2')).toBe(1);
  57:     });
  58: 
  59:     it('should check rate limit', () => {
  60:       const isRateLimited = (count: number, limit: number) => count > limit;
  61: 
  62:       expect(isRateLimited(5, 10)).toBe(false);
  63:       expect(isRateLimited(15, 10)).toBe(true);
  64:     });
  65: 
  66:     it('should calculate retry after', () => {
  67:       const getRetryAfter = (windowEnd: number) => 
  68:         Math.max(0, Math.ceil((windowEnd - Date.now()) / 1000));
  69: 
  70:       const future = Date.now() + 30000;
  71:       expect(getRetryAfter(future)).toBe(30);
  72:     });
  73:   });
  74: 
  75:   describe('CORS middleware', () => {
  76:     it('should check allowed origins', () => {
  77:       const isAllowedOrigin = (origin: string, allowedOrigins: string[]) => 
  78:         allowedOrigins.includes(origin) || allowedOrigins.includes('*');
  79: 
  80:       const allowed = ['https://example.com', 'https://app.example.com'];
  81: 
  82:       expect(isAllowedOrigin('https://example.com', allowed)).toBe(true);
  83:       expect(isAllowedOrigin('https://other.com', allowed)).toBe(false);
  84:       expect(isAllowedOrigin('https://any.com', ['*'])).toBe(true);
  85:     });
  86: 
  87:     it('should build CORS headers', () => {
  88:       const buildCORSHeaders = (origin: string, methods: string[]) => ({
  89:         'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': origin,
  90:         'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': methods.join(', '),
  91:         'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization',
  92:       });
  93: 
  94:       const headers = buildCORSHeaders('https://example.com', ['GET', 'POST']);
  95:       expect(headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']).toBe('https://example.com');
  96:       expect(headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods']).toBe('GET, POST');
  97:     });
  98:   });
  99: 
 100:   describe('logging middleware', () => {
 101:     it('should create request log', () => {
 102:       const createRequestLog = (
 103:         method: string,
 104:         path: string,
 105:         userId?: string
 106:       ) => ({
 107:         method,
 108:         path,
 109:         userId,
 110:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 111:       });
 112: 
 113:       const log = createRequestLog('GET', '/api/users', 'user-123');
 114:       expect(log.method).toBe('GET');
 115:       expect(log.userId).toBe('user-123');
 116:     });
 117: 
 118:     it('should calculate response time', () => {
 119:       const calculateResponseTime = (start: number, end: number) => end - start;
 120: 
 121:       expect(calculateResponseTime(1000, 1250)).toBe(250);
 122:     });
 123:   });
 124: 
 125:   describe('error handling middleware', () => {
 126:     it('should create error response', () => {
 127:       const createErrorResponse = (
 128:         status: number,
 129:         message: string,
 130:         code?: string
 131:       ) => ({
 132:         error: {
 133:           message,
 134:           code: code || 'ERROR',
 135:           status,
 136:         },
 137:       });
 138: 
 139:       const response = createErrorResponse(400, 'Bad request', 'VALIDATION_ERROR');
 140:       expect(response.error.status).toBe(400);
 141:       expect(response.error.code).toBe('VALIDATION_ERROR');
 142:     });
 143: 
 144:     it('should map error to status', () => {
 145:       const getStatusFromError = (errorType: string) => {
 146:         const statusMap: Record<string, number> = {
 147:           ValidationError: 400,
 148:           UnauthorizedError: 401,
 149:           ForbiddenError: 403,
 150:           NotFoundError: 404,
 151:           ConflictError: 409,
 152:           RateLimitError: 429,
 153:         };
 154:         return statusMap[errorType] || 500;
 155:       };
 156: 
 157:       expect(getStatusFromError('ValidationError')).toBe(400);
 158:       expect(getStatusFromError('NotFoundError')).toBe(404);
 159:       expect(getStatusFromError('UnknownError')).toBe(500);
 160:     });
 161:   });
 162: 
 163:   describe('security headers middleware', () => {
 164:     it('should generate security headers', () => {
 165:       const getSecurityHeaders = () => ({
 166:         'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
 167:         'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY',
 168:         'X-XSS-Protection': '1; mode=block',
 169:         'Strict-Transport-Security': 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains',
 170:       });
 171: 
 172:       const headers = getSecurityHeaders();
 173:       expect(headers['X-Frame-Options']).toBe('DENY');
 174:     });
 175: 
 176:     it('should generate CSP header', () => {
 177:       const generateCSP = (directives: Record<string, string[]>) => 
 178:         Object.entries(directives)
 179:           .map(([key, values]) => `${key} ${values.join(' ')}`)
 180:           .join('; ');
 181: 
 182:       const csp = generateCSP({
 183:         'default-src': ["'self'"],
 184:         'script-src': ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
 185:       });
 186: 
 187:       expect(csp).toContain("default-src 'self'");
 188:     });
 189:   });
 190: 
 191:   describe('request validation middleware', () => {
 192:     it('should validate request body', () => {
 193:       const validateBody = (body: any, schema: Record<string, string>) => {
 194:         const errors: string[] = [];
 195:         Object.entries(schema).forEach(([field, type]) => {
 196:           if (typeof body[field] !== type) {
 197:             errors.push(`${field} must be ${type}`);
 198:           }
 199:         });
 200:         return { valid: errors.length === 0, errors };
 201:       };
 202: 
 203:       const schema = { name: 'string', age: 'number' };
 204:       
 205:       const valid = validateBody({ name: 'Test', age: 25 }, schema);
 206:       expect(valid.valid).toBe(true);
 207: 
 208:       const invalid = validateBody({ name: 'Test', age: '25' }, schema);
 209:       expect(invalid.valid).toBe(false);
 210:     });
 211:   });
 212: });

  62:     const getTrend = (current: number, predicted: number): { trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable', percentage: number } => {
  63:       if (current === 0) return { trend: 'stable', percentage: 0 };
  64:       const diff = ((predicted - current) / current) * 100;
  65:       if (Math.abs(diff) < 5) return { trend: 'stable', percentage: diff };
  66:       return { trend: diff > 0 ? 'up' : 'down', percentage: diff };
  67:     };
  68: 
  69:     it('devrait dÃ©tecter une tendance haussiÃ¨re', () => {
  70:       const result = getTrend(1000, 1200);

  73:     });
  74: 
  75:     it('devrait dÃ©tecter une tendance baissiÃ¨re', () => {
  76:       const result = getTrend(1000, 800);
  77:       expect(result.trend).toBe('down');
  78:       expect(result.percentage).toBe(-20);
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     it('devrait dÃ©tecter une stabilitÃ© (<5%)', () => {

  83:       expect(result.trend).toBe('stable');
  84:     });
  85: 
  86:     it('devrait gÃ©rer la valeur zÃ©ro', () => {
  87:       const result = getTrend(0, 100);
  88:       expect(result.trend).toBe('stable');
  89:     });
  90:   });
  91: 
  92:   describe('Confidence Calculation', () => {
  93:     const calculateConfidence = (r2: number): number => {
  94:       return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, r2 * 100));
  95:     };
  96: 
  97:     it('devrait retourner 100% pour r2=1', () => {
  98:       expect(calculateConfidence(1)).toBe(100);
  99:     });
 100:

 102:       expect(calculateConfidence(0)).toBe(0);
 103:     });
 104: 
 105:     it('devrait retourner 85% pour r2=0.85', () => {
 106:       expect(calculateConfidence(0.85)).toBe(85);
 107:     });
 108: 
 109:     it('devrait plafonner Ã  100%', () => {
 110:       expect(calculateConfidence(1.5)).toBe(100);
 111:     });
 112:
