  17:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const documentId = params.id;
  22: 
  23:     // Get document with tenant check
  24:     const document = await prisma.document.findFirst({
  25:       where: {
  26:         id: documentId,
  27:         dossier: {
  28:           client: {
  29:             tenantId: session.user.tenantId,
  30:           },
  31:         },
  32:       },
  33:     });
  34: 
  35:     if (!document) {
  36:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     // Read file
  40:     const uploadsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
  41:     const filePath = path.join(uploadsDir, document.path);
  42: 
  43:     if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier non trouve sur le serveur' }, { status: 404 });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     const fileBuffer = fs.readFileSync(filePath);
  48: 
  49:     return new NextResponse(fileBuffer, {
  50:       headers: {
  51:         'Content-Type': document.mimeType,
  52:         'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${document.originalName}"`,
  53:         'Content-Length': document.size.toString(),
  54:       },
  55:     });
  56:   } catch (error) {
  57:     logger.error('Error downloading admin document:', { error });
  58:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  59:   }
  60: }

src\app\api\admin\dossiers\route.ts

   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * GET /api/admin/dossiers
   8:  * Recupere tous les dossiers du tenant (pour avocats)
   9:  */
  10: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  19:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  20: 
  21:     if (userRole !== 'AVOCAT' && userRole !== 'ADMIN') {
  22:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux avocats' }, { status: 403 });
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     if (!tenantId) {
  26:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 });
  27:     }
  28: 
  29:     // Recuperer tous les dossiers du tenant
  30:     const dossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  31:       where: {
  32:         tenantId,
  33:       },
  34:       orderBy: {
  35:         createdAt: 'desc',
  36:       },
  37:       include: {
  38:         client: {
  39:           select: {
  40:             id: true,
  41:             firstName: true,
  42:             lastName: true,
  43:             email: true,
  44:           },
  45:         },
  46:         _count: {
  47:           select: {
  48:             documents: true,
  49:             echeances: true,
  50:           },
  51:         },
  52:       },
  53:     });
  54: 
  55:     // Transformer pour correspondre a l'interface attendue
  56:     return NextResponse.json({
  57:       dossiers: dossiers.map(d => ({
  58:         ...d,
  59:         numeroDossier: d.numero,
  60:         objetDemande: d.objet,
  61:         client: {
  62:           nom: d.client.lastName,
  63:           prenom: d.client.firstName,
  64:           email: d.client.email,
  65:         },
  66:         dateCreation: d.dateCreation,
  67:       })),
  68:     });
  69:   } catch (error) {
  70:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation dossiers admin', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  71:       route: '/api/admin/dossiers',
  72:     });
  73:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  74:   }
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /**
  78:  * POST /api/admin/dossiers
  79:  * Creer un nouveau dossier (avocat pour un client)
  80:  */
  81: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  82:   try {
  83:     const session = await getServerSession();
  84: 
  85:     if (!session?.user) {
  86:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  87:     }
  88: 
  89:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  90:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  91: 
  92:     if (userRole !== 'AVOCAT' && userRole !== 'ADMIN') {
  93:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux avocats' }, { status: 403 });
  94:     }
  95: 
  96:     if (!tenantId) {
  97:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 });
  98:     }
  99: 
 100:     const body = await request.json();
 101:     const { clientId, typeDossier, objetDemande, priorite, dateEcheance, notes } = body;
 102: 
 103:     // Verifier que le client appartient au tenant
 104:     const client = await prisma.client.findFirst({
 105:       where: {
 106:         id: clientId,
 107:         tenantId,
 108:       },
 109:     });
 110: 
 111:     if (!client) {
 112:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouve ou acces refuse' }, { status: 404 });
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     // Generer le numero de dossier
 116:     const year = new Date().getFullYear();
 117:     const count = await prisma.dossier.count({
 118:       where: { tenantId },
 119:     });
 120:     const numero = `D-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`;
 121: 
 122:     // Mapper les priorites et statuts au format DB
 123:     const prioriteMap: Record<string, string> = {
 124:       NORMALE: 'normale',
 125:       HAUTE: 'haute',
 126:       URGENTE: 'haute',
 127:       CRITIQUE: 'critique',
 128:     };
 129: 
 130:     const statutMap: Record<string, string> = {
 131:       BROUILLON: 'en_cours',
 132:       EN_COURS: 'en_cours',
 133:       EN_ATTENTE: 'en_attente',
 134:       TERMINE: 'termine',
 135:       REJETE: 'termine',
 136:       ANNULE: 'archive',
 137:     };
 138: 
 139:     // Creer le dossier
 140:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.create({
 141:       data: {
 142:         numero,
 143:         typeDossier,
 144:         objet: objetDemande,
 145:         priorite: prioriteMap[priorite || 'NORMALE'] || 'normale',
 146:         statut: statutMap[body.statut || 'EN_COURS'] || 'en_cours',
 147:         dateEcheance: dateEcheance ? new Date(dateEcheance) : undefined,
 148:         notes: notes || '',
 149:         tenantId,
 150:         clientId,
 151:         dateCreation: new Date(),
 152:       },
 153:       include: {
 154:         client: {
 155:           select: {
 156:             firstName: true,
 157:             lastName: true,
 158:             email: true,
 159:           },
 160:         },
 161:       },
 162:     });
 163: 
 164:     return NextResponse.json(
 165:       {
 166:         dossier: {
 167:           ...dossier,
 168:           numeroDossier: dossier.numero,
 169:           objetDemande: dossier.objet,
 170:           client: {
 171:             nom: dossier.client.lastName,
 172:             prenom: dossier.client.firstName,
 173:             email: dossier.client.email,
 174:           },
 175:         },
 176:       },
 177:       { status: 201 }
 178:     );
 179:   } catch (error) {
 180:     logger.error('Erreur creation dossier', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 181:       route: '/api/admin/dossiers',
 182:     });
 183:     return NextResponse.json(
 184:       { error: 'Erreur serveur', details: (error as Error).message },
 185:       { status: 500 }
 186:     );
 187:   }
 188: }

src\app\api\admin\email-monitor\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import fs from 'fs';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: import path from 'path';
   7: 
   8: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   9:   try {
  10:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11: 
  12:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  14:     }
  15: 
  16:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  17:     const type = searchParams.get('type');
  18:     const priority = searchParams.get('priority');
  19:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
  20: 
  21:     // Lire tous les emails sauvegardes
  22:     const emailsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'logs', 'emails');
  23: 
  24:     if (!fs.existsSync(emailsDir)) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ emails: [], stats: {} });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     const files = fs
  29:       .readdirSync(emailsDir)
  30:       .filter(file => file.endsWith('.json'))
  31:       .sort((a, b) => b.localeCompare(a)) // Plus recents en premier
  32:       .slice(0, limit);
  33: 
  34:     const emails = files.map(file => {
  35:       const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(emailsDir, file), 'utf-8');
  36:       return JSON.parse(content);
  37:     });
  38: 
  39:     // Filtrer selon les parametres
  40:     let filteredEmails = emails;
  41: 
  42:     if (type) {
  43:       filteredEmails = filteredEmails.filter(email => email.type === type);
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     if (priority) {
  47:       filteredEmails = filteredEmails.filter(email => email.priority === priority);
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     // Calculer les statistiques
  51:     const stats = {
  52:       total: emails.length,
  53:       nouveauClient: emails.filter(e => e.tags?.includes('Nouveau Client')).length,
  54:       urgent: emails.filter(e => e.priority === 'urgent').length,
  55:       spam: emails.filter(e => e.type === 'spam').length,
  56:       nonLus: emails.filter(e => !e.read).length,
  57:       today: emails.filter(e => {
  58:         const emailDate = new Date(e.date);
  59:         const today = new Date();
  60:         return emailDate.toDateString() === today.toDateString();
  61:       }).length,
  62:     };
  63: 
  64:     return NextResponse.json({
  65:       emails: filteredEmails,
  66:       stats,
  67:       total: filteredEmails.length,
  68:     });
  69:   } catch (error) {
  70:     logger.error('Erreur lors de la recuperation des emails:', { error });
  71:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  72:   }
  73: }
  74: 
  75: // Marquer un email comme lu
  76: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  77:   try {
  78:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  79: 
  80:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  81:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     const { emailId, read } = await request.json();
  85: 
  86:     const emailsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'logs', 'emails');
  87:     const files = fs.readdirSync(emailsDir);
  88: 
  89:     const emailFile = files.find(file => {
  90:       const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(emailsDir, file), 'utf-8');
  91:       const email = JSON.parse(content);
  92:       return email.id === emailId;
  93:     });
  94: 
  95:     if (!emailFile) {
  96:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  97:     }
  98: 
  99:     const filePath = path.join(emailsDir, emailFile);
 100:     const email = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8'));
 101:     email.read = read;
 102:     fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(email, null, 2));
 103: 
 104:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
 105:   } catch (error) {
 106:     logger.error('Erreur lors de la mise a jour:', { error });
 107:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 108:   }
 109: }

src\app\api\admin\logs\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * API /api/admin/logs
   8:  * Recupere les logs depuis le buffer du logger
   9:  * Accessible uniquement aux admins
  10:  */
  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15:     
  16:     // Verification de l'authentification
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json(
  19:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  20:         { status: 401 }
  21:       );
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     // Verification du role admin
  25:     const userRole = (session.user as any)?.role;
  26:     if (userRole !== 'ADMIN' && userRole !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  27:       logger.warn('Tentative acces logs non autorisee', {
  28:         userId: (session.user as any)?.id,
  29:         role: userRole,
  30:       });
  31:       
  32:       return NextResponse.json(
  33:         { error: 'Acces refuse - role admin requis' },
  34:         { status: 403 }
  35:       );
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Recuperation des parametres de filtrage
  39:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  40:     const level = searchParams.get('level');
  41:     const action = searchParams.get('action');
  42:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '100', 10);
  43: 
  44:     // Recuperation des logs depuis le buffer
  45:     const logs = logger.getBufferedLogs();
  46:     
  47:     // Filtrage
  48:     let filteredLogs = logs;
  49:     
  50:     if (level) {
  51:       filteredLogs = filteredLogs.filter(log => log.level === level);
  52:     }
  53:     
  54:     if (action) {
  55:       filteredLogs = filteredLogs.filter(log => log.actionJuridique === action);
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     // Limitation et tri inverse (plus recents en premier)
  59:     const result = filteredLogs
  60:       .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime())
  61:       .slice(0, limit);
  62: 
  63:     logger.info('Consultation logs admin', {
  64:       userId: (session.user as any)?.id,
  65:       filters: { level, action, limit },
  66:       resultCount: result.length,
  67:     });
  68: 
  69:     return NextResponse.json({
  70:       logs: result,
  71:       total: result.length,
  72:       filters: { level, action, limit },
  73:     });
  74: 
  75:   } catch (error) {
  76:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation logs admin', error);
  77:     
  78:     return NextResponse.json(
  79:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  80:       { status: 500 }
  81:     );
  82:   }
  83: }
  84:

src\app\api\admin\messages\mark-read\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';

   7: // POST mark messages as read for a specific client
   8: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   9:   try {
  10:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11: 
  12:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
  14:     }
  15: 
  16:     const body = await request.json();
  17:     const { clientId } = body;
  18: 
  19:     if (!clientId) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client ID requis' }, { status: 400 });
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     // Mark all messages from this client as read
  24:     await prisma.message.updateMany({
  25:       where: {
  26:         senderId: clientId,
  27:         recipientId: session.user.id,
  28:         isRead: false,
  29:       },
  30:       data: {
  31:         isRead: true,
  32:         readAt: new Date(),
  33:       },
  34:     });
  35: 
  36:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  37:   } catch (error) {
  38:     logger.error('Error marking messages as read:', { error });
  39:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  40:   }
  41: }

src\app\api\admin\messages\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: import { authOptions } from '../../auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: 
   7: // GET all conversations grouped by client
   8: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   9:   try {
  10:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11: 
  12:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
  14:     }
  15: 
  16:     const adminId = session.user.id;
  17: 
  18:     const messages = await prisma.message.findMany({
  19:       where: {
  20:         OR: [{ senderId: adminId }, { recipientId: adminId }],
  21:       },
  22:       include: {
  23:         sender: {
  24:           select: {
  25:             id: true,
  26:             name: true,
  27:             role: true,
  28:           },
  29:         },
  30:         recipient: {
  31:           select: {
  32:             id: true,
  33:             name: true,
  34:             role: true,
  35:           },
  36:         },
  37:       },
  38:       orderBy: {
  39:         createdAt: 'desc',
  40:       },
  41:     });
  42: 
  43:     // Group by client
  44:     const conversationsMap = new Map<string, any>();
  45: 
  46:     messages.forEach((msg: any) => {
  47:       const clientUser = msg.sender.role === 'CLIENT' ? msg.sender : msg.recipient;
  48:       const clientId = clientUser.id;
  49: 
  50:       if (!conversationsMap.has(clientId)) {
  51:         conversationsMap.set(clientId, {
  52:           clientId,
  53:           clientName: clientUser.name,
  54:           messages: [],
  55:           unreadCount: 0,
  56:           lastMessage: '',
  57:           lastMessageDate: msg.createdAt,
  58:         });
  59:       }
  60: 
  61:       const conv = conversationsMap.get(clientId);
  62:       conv.messages.push(msg);
  63: 
  64:       // Count unread messages from client
  65:       if (msg.senderId === clientId && !msg.isRead) {
  66:         conv.unreadCount++;
  67:       }
  68:     });
  69: 
  70:     // Convert to array and set last message
  71:     const conversations = Array.from(conversationsMap.values()).map(conv => {
  72:       const lastMsg = conv.messages[0];
  73:       conv.lastMessage =
  74:         lastMsg.content.substring(0, 50) + (lastMsg.content.length > 50 ? '...' : '');
  75:       return conv;
  76:     });
  77: 
  78:     return NextResponse.json({ conversations });
  79:   } catch (error) {
  80:     logger.error('Error fetching admin conversations:', { error });
  81:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  82:   }
  83: }
  84: 
  85: // POST send message to client
  86: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  87:   try {
  88:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  89: 
  90:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  91:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     const body = await request.json();
  95:     const { clientId, contenu } = body;
  96: 
  97:     if (!contenu || !clientId) {
  98:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Contenu et client requis' }, { status: 400 });
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     if (!session.user.id || !session.user.tenantId) {
 102:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Session invalide' }, { status: 401 });
 103:     }
 104: 
 105:     const message = await prisma.message.create({
 106:       data: {
 107:         tenantId: session.user.tenantId,
 108:         senderId: session.user.id,
 109:         recipientId: clientId,
 110:         subject: 'Message de votre cabinet',
 111:         content: contenu,
 112:         isRead: false,
 113:       },
 114:       include: {
 115:         sender: {
 116:           select: {
 117:             id: true,
 118:             name: true,
 119:             role: true,
 120:           },
 121:         },
 122:         recipient: {
 123:           select: {
 124:             id: true,
 125:             name: true,
 126:             role: true,
 127:           },
 128:         },
 129:       },
 130:     });
 131: 
 132:     return NextResponse.json({ message }, { status: 201 });
 133:   } catch (error) {
 134:     logger.error('Error sending admin message:', { error });
 135:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 136:   }
 137: }

src\app\api\admin\profil\password\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { authOptions } from '../../../auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
   7: 
   8: // PUT change password
   9: export async function PUT(request: NextRequest) {
  10:   try {
  11:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12: 
  13:     if (!session || session.user.role !== 'ADMIN') {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const body = await request.json();
  18:     const { currentPassword, newPassword } = body;
  19: 
  20:     if (!currentPassword || !newPassword) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Mots de passe requis' }, { status: 400 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     if (newPassword.length < 8) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caracteres' }, { status: 400 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     // Get current user
  29:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  30:       where: { id: session.user.id },
  31:     });
  32: 
  33:     if (!user) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     // Verify current password
  38:     const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
  39:     if (!isValid) {
  40:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect' }, { status: 400 });
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     // Hash new password
  44:     const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 12);
  45: 
  46:     // Update password
  47:     await prisma.user.update({
  48:       where: { id: session.user.id },
  49:       data: { password: hashedPassword },
  50:     });
  51: 
  52:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  53:   } catch (error) {
  54:     logger.error('Error changing admin password:', { error });
  55:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  56:   }
  57: }

  49:   if (!session?.user) {
  50:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  51:   }
  52: 
  53:   const { role, tenantId } = session.user as any;
  54:   if (!['SUPER_ADMIN', 'AVOCAT', 'ADMIN'].includes(role) || !tenantId) {
  55:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seul l\'avocat titulaire peut inviter des membres' }, { status: 403 });

  57:

  59: 
  60:   if (!email || !name || !memberRole) {
  61:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email, nom et rÃ´le requis' }, { status: 400 });
  62:   }
  63: 
  64:   if (!VALID_ROLES.includes(memberRole)) {
  65:     return NextResponse.json(
  66:       { error: `RÃ´le invalide. RÃ´les acceptÃ©s: ${VALID_ROLES.join(', ')}` },
  67:       { status: 400 }

  69:   }
  70: 
  71:   const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase() } });

  73:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Un compte existe dÃ©jÃ  avec cet email' }, { status: 409 });
  74:   }
  75: 
  76:   // VÃ©rifier les limites du plan
  77:   const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  78:     where: { id: tenantId },
  79:     include: { plan: true },

  81: 
  82:   if (tenant && tenant.currentUsers >= tenant.plan.maxUsers) {
  83:     return NextResponse.json(
  84:       { error: `Limite du plan atteinte (${tenant.plan.maxUsers} utilisateurs max). Passez au plan supÃ©rieur.` },
  85:       { status: 403 }
  86:     );
  87:   }
  88: 
  89:   // Mot de passe temporaire â€” l'utilisateur devra le changer

  92:

  94:     data: {
  95:       id: randomUUID(),

 126:  * PATCH /api/admin/team â€” Modifier le rÃ´le ou dÃ©sactiver un membre
 127:  */
 128: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 129:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 130:   if (!session?.user) {
 131:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 132:   }
 133: 
 134:   const { role, tenantId } = session.user as any;
 135:   if (!['SUPER_ADMIN', 'AVOCAT', 'ADMIN'].includes(role) || !tenantId) {
 136:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
 137:   }
 138: 
 139:   const { memberId, newRole, status } = await request.json();
 140: 
 141:   if (!memberId) {
 142:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'memberId requis' }, { status: 400 });
 143:   }
 144: 
 145:   const member = await prisma.user.findFirst({
 146:     where: { id: memberId, tenantId },
 147:   });
 148: 
 149:   if (!member) {
 150:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Membre non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 151:   }
 152: 
 153:   const updateData: any = {};
 154:   if (newRole && VALID_ROLES.includes(newRole)) updateData.role = newRole;
 155:   if (status && ['active', 'inactive'].includes(status)) updateData.status = status;
 156: 
 157:   const updated = await prisma.user.update({
 158:     where: { id: memberId },
 159:     data: updateData,
 160:     select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, role: true, status: true },
 161:   });
 162: 
 163:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, member: updated });

src\app\api\ai\analyze\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { withAIRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { z } from 'zod';
   8: 
   9: const payloadSchema = z.object({ dossierId: z.string().min(1).optional() }).passthrough();
  10: const serviceUrl = process.env.AI_SERVICE_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';
  11: 
  12: export const POST = withAIRateLimit(async (request: NextRequest) => {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15:     if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     const user = session.user as { id?: string; tenantId?: string; role?: string; groups?: string[] };
  17:     if (!user.id || !user.tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  18:     const payload = payloadSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
  19:     if (!payload.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'RequÃªte IA invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  20:     if (payload.data.dossierId) {
  21:       const access = await canAccessDossier({
  22:         userId: user.id,
  23:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  24:         role: user.role,
  25:         groups: user.groups,
  26:         dossierId: payload.data.dossierId,
  27:         action: 'read',
  28:       });
  29:       if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  30:     }
  31:     const response = await fetch(`${serviceUrl}/api/analysis/analyze`, {
  32:       method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload.data),
  33:     });
  34:     if (!response.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Analysis failed' }, { status: response.status });
  35:     return NextResponse.json(await response.json());
  36:   } catch (error) {
  37:     logger.error('AI Analysis error:', { error });
  38:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to connect to AI service' }, { status: 503 });
  39:   }
  40: });

src\app\api\ai\chat\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { traceAsync, collectMetric } from '@/lib/monitoring';
   3: import { checkAICostLimit, recordAIUsage } from '@/lib/billing/cost-guard';
   4: 
   5: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   6:   const startTime = performance.now();
   7:   
   8:   try {
   9:     const { message, tenantId, context } = await request.json();
  10:     
  11:     // Vérifier la limite de coûts IA
  12:     if (tenantId) {
  13:       const costCheck = await checkAICostLimit(tenantId);
  14:       if (!costCheck.allowed) {
  15:         return NextResponse.json(
  16:           { success: false, error: 'AI budget limit reached', currentCost: costCheck.currentCost, limit: costCheck.limit },
  17:           { status: 429 }
  18:         );
  19:       }
  20:     }
  21:     
  22:     const response = await traceAsync(
  23:       'ai.chat.process',
  24:       () => processAIChat(message, tenantId, context),
  25:       { operation: 'ai.inference', tags: { model: 'local' } }
  26:     );
  27:     
  28:     // Enregistrer l'utilisation (coût approximatif)
  29:     if (tenantId) {
  30:       await recordAIUsage({
  31:         tenantId,
  32:         provider: 'ollama',
  33:         tokensUsed: (message?.length || 0) + (response.content?.length || 0),
  34:         costEur: 0,
  35:         operation: 'chat',
  36:         timestamp: new Date(),
  37:       });
  38:     }
  39:     
  40:     // Collecter la métrique de performance
  41:     collectMetric('api.ai.chat', performance.now() - startTime);
  42:     
  43:     return NextResponse.json({
  44:       success: true,
  45:       content: response.content,
  46:       suggestedActions: response.actions
  47:     });
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     collectMetric('api.ai.chat.error', performance.now() - startTime);
  50:     return NextResponse.json(
  51:       { success: false, error: 'Failed to process chat message' },
  52:       { status: 500 }
  53:     );
  54:   }
  55: }
  56:

   6: /**
   7:  * GET /api/ai/copilot/morning-brief

  10: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const user = session.user as any;
  15:   const now = new Date();
  16:   const in7days = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 86400000);
  17: 
  18:   // Dossiers Ã  risque (OQTF avec deadlines proches)
  19:   const dossiersAtRisk = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  20:     where: {
  21:       tenantId: user.tenantId,
  22:       statut: { not: 'cloture' },

  24:     },
  25:     select: { id: true, numero: true, typeDossier: true, legalDeadlines: { where: { status: 'PENDING', dueDate: { lte: in7days } }, select: { label: true, dueDate: true } } },
  26:     take: 10,
  27:   });
  28: 
  29:   // Dossiers incomplets
  30:   const dossiersIncomplete = await prisma.dossier.count({
  31:     where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, statut: { not: 'cloture' }, checklistComplete: false, checklistTotal: { gt: 0 } },
  32:   });

  36:   const criticalDeadlines = await prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({

  39:     take: 5,
  40:   });
  41: 
  42:   // Relances recommandÃ©es (dossiers en attente client > 5 jours sans email)
  43:   const fiveDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 5 * 86400000);
  44:   const pendingDossiers = await prisma.dossier.count({
  45:     where: {
  46:       tenantId: user.tenantId,
  47:       statut: 'en_cours',
  48:       checklistComplete: false,
  49:       emails: { none: { receivedDate: { gte: fiveDaysAgo } } },
  50:     },
  51:   });
  52: 
  53:   return NextResponse.json({
  54:     date: now.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }),
  55:     dossiersAtRisk: dossiersAtRisk.map(d => ({
  56:       numero: d.numero,
  57:       type: d.typeDossier,
  58:       deadlines: d.legalDeadlines.map(dl => ({
  59:         label: dl.label,
  60:         daysRemaining: Math.ceil((new Date(dl.dueDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / 86400000),
  61:       })),
  62:     })),
  63:     stats: {
  64:       oqtfAtRisk: dossiersAtRisk.filter(d => d.typeDossier.includes('OQTF')).length,
  65:       incomplete: dossiersIncomplete,
  66:       criticalDeadlines: criticalDeadlines.length,
  67:       relancesRecommandees: pendingDossiers,
  68:     },
  69:     criticalDeadlines: criticalDeadlines.map(dl => ({
  70:       dossier: dl.dossier.numero,
  71:       type: dl.dossier.typeDossier,
  72:       label: dl.label,
  73:       daysRemaining: Math.ceil((new Date(dl.dueDate).getTime() - now.getTime()) / 86400000),
  74:     })),
  75:   });

  25:     }
  26:     if (!session.user.tenantId) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Accès refusé' }, { status: 403 });
  28:     }
  29:     const parsed = suggestionSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
  30:     if (!parsed.success) {
  31:       return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Requête IA invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  32:     }
  33:     const { formId, fieldId, context } = parsed.data;
  34: 
  35:     // Analyser le contexte avec le moteur local (Ollama)
  36:     const suggestion = await generateAISuggestion(formId, fieldId, context);
  37: 
  38:     return NextResponse.json({
  39:       success: true,
  40:       suggestion,
  41:       confidence: 0.85,
  42:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  43:     });
  44:   } catch (error) {
  45:     logger.error('Erreur generation suggestion:', { error });
  46:     return NextResponse.json(
  47:       { success: false, error: 'Erreur generation suggestion' },
  48:       { status: 500 }
  49:     );
  50:   }
  51: });
  52: 
  53: async function generateAISuggestion(
  54:   formId: string,
  55:   fieldId: string,
  56:   context: Record<string, unknown>
  57: ): Promise<string> {
  58:   try {
  59:     // Appeler Ollama local
  60:     const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
  61:       method: 'POST',
  62:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  63:       body: JSON.stringify({
  64:         model: 'llama3.2:latest',
  65:         prompt: `En tant qu'assistant juridique expert, analyse ce contexte de formulaire et fournis une suggestion professionnelle et concise (maximum 2 phrases).
  66: 
  67: Formulaire ID: ${formId}
  68: Champ: ${fieldId}
  69: Contexte actuel: ${JSON.stringify(context, null, 2)}
  70: 
  71: Fournis une suggestion qui:
  72: 1. Est pertinente au contexte juridique
  73: 2. Anticipe les risques potentiels
  74: 3. Propose une meilleure pratique
  75: 4. Est actionnable immediatement
  76: 
  77: Suggestion:`,
  78:         stream: false,
  79:       }),
  80:     });
  81: 
  82:     if (!response.ok) {
  83:       throw new Error('Ollama API error');
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     const data = await response.json();
  87:     return data.response.trim();
  88:   } catch (error) {
  89:     logger.error('Erreur Ollama:', { error });
  90:     // Fallback sur des suggestions predefinies
  91:     return getFallbackSuggestion(formId, fieldId);
  92:   }
  93: }
  94: 
  95: function getFallbackSuggestion(formId: string, fieldId: string): string {
  96:   const fallbacks: Record<string, string> = {
  97:     priority:
  98:       'Base sur les delais legaux, une priorite HAUTE est recommandee pour les dossiers CESEDA.',
  99:     budget: 'Le budget moyen pour ce type de dossier est de 2500€. Ajuster selon la complexite.',
 100:     deadline: 'Les dossiers CESEDA ont un delai legal de 4 mois. Prevoir une marge de securite.',
 101:     resources: 'Allouer au minimum 2 juristes experimentes pour ce type de dossier.',
 102:   };
 103: 
 104:   return fallbacks[fieldId] || 'Aucune suggestion disponible pour ce champ.';
 105: }

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';

  12: export const POST = withAIRateLimit(async (request: NextRequest) => {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);

  18:     const payload = payloadSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
  19:     if (!payload.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'RequÃªte IA invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  20:     if (payload.data.dossierId) {
  21:       const access = await canAccessDossier({
  22:         userId: user.id,

  27:         action: 'read',
  28:       });
  29:       if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  30:     }
  31:     const response = await fetch(`${serviceUrl}/api/generation/generate`, {
  32:       method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload.data),
  33:     });
  34:     if (!response.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Generation failed' }, { status: response.status });
  35:     return NextResponse.json(await response.json());
  36:   } catch (error) {

src\app\api\ai\predict-outcome\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/ai/predict-outcome
   8:  * Estime les chances de succes basees sur les stats tribunal anonymisees.
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const { typeDossier, juridiction, typeRecours } = await req.json();
  15: 
  16:   // Recuperer les stats anonymisees
  17:   const where: any = { outcome: { not: null } };
  18:   if (typeDossier) where.typeDossier = typeDossier;
  19:   if (juridiction) where.juridiction = juridiction;
  20:   if (typeRecours) where.typeRecours = typeRecours;
  21: 
  22:   const results = await prisma.dossier.groupBy({
  23:     by: ['outcome'],
  24:     where,
  25:     _count: true,
  26:   });
  27: 
  28:   const total = results.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r._count, 0);
  29:   const favorable = results.find(r => r.outcome === 'favorable')?._count || 0;
  30: 
  31:   if (total < 5) {
  32:     return NextResponse.json({
  33:       prediction: null,
  34:       message: 'Pas assez de donnees (minimum 5 dossiers similaires requis)',
  35:       total,
  36:     });
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   const tauxSucces = Math.round((favorable / total) * 100);
  40: 
  41:   return NextResponse.json({
  42:     prediction: {
  43:       tauxSucces,
  44:       total,
  45:       favorable,
  46:       level: tauxSucces >= 70 ? 'favorable' : tauxSucces >= 40 ? 'incertain' : 'defavorable',
  47:     },
  48:     filters: { typeDossier, juridiction, typeRecours },
  49:     note: 'Estimation basee sur des dossiers similaires anonymises. Ne constitue pas une garantie.',
  50:   });
  51: }

src\app\api\ai\risk-analysis\[dossierId]\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/ai/risk-analysis/[dossierId]
   9:  * Analyse les risques d'un dossier et identifie les points faibles.
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ dossierId: string }> }) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const { dossierId } = await params;
  16:   const user = session.user as any;
  17: 
  18:   if (!user.tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  19: 
  20:   const access = await canAccessDossier({
  21:     userId: user.id,
  22:     tenantId: user.tenantId,
  23:     role: user.role,
  24:     groups: user.groups,
  25:     dossierId,
  26:     action: 'read',
  27:   });
  28:   if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  29: 
  30:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  31:     where: { id: dossierId, tenantId: user.tenantId },
  32:     include: {
  33:       client: true,
  34:       checklistItems: true,
  35:       legalDeadlines: true,
  36:     },
  37:   });
  38: 
  39:   if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  40: 
  41:   const risks: any[] = [];
  42:   let score = 100;
  43: 
  44:   // Pieces manquantes
  45:   const missing = dossier.checklistItems.filter(i => i.status === 'missing' && i.required);
  46:   if (missing.length > 0) {
  47:     score -= missing.length * 10;
  48:     risks.push({ level: 'high', category: 'pieces', message: `${missing.length} piece(s) obligatoire(s) manquante(s)`, items: missing.map(m => m.label) });
  49:   }
  50: 
  51:   // Deadlines proches
  52:   const now = new Date();
  53:   const urgentDeadlines = dossier.legalDeadlines.filter(d => d.status === 'PENDING' && new Date(d.dueDate).getTime() - now.getTime() < 7 * 86400000);
  54:   if (urgentDeadlines.length > 0) {
  55:     score -= 20;
  56:     risks.push({ level: 'critical', category: 'deadline', message: `${urgentDeadlines.length} echeance(s) dans moins de 7 jours`, items: urgentDeadlines.map(d => `${d.label} (${new Date(d.dueDate).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')})`) });
  57:   }
  58: 
  59:   // Type de procedure a risque
  60:   if (dossier.typeDossier === 'OQTF_SANS_DELAI') {
  61:     score -= 15;
  62:     risks.push({ level: 'critical', category: 'procedure', message: 'OQTF sans delai â€” risque d\'execution immediate' });
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   // Pas de juridiction definie
  66:   if (!dossier.juridiction) {
  67:     score -= 5;
  68:     risks.push({ level: 'medium', category: 'incomplete', message: 'Juridiction non definie' });
  69:   }
  70: 
  71:   // Pas de description
  72:   if (!dossier.description) {
  73:     score -= 5;
  74:     risks.push({ level: 'low', category: 'incomplete', message: 'Description du dossier vide' });
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   return NextResponse.json({
  78:     dossierId,
  79:     score: Math.max(0, score),
  80:     level: score >= 80 ? 'low' : score >= 50 ? 'medium' : 'high',
  81:     risks,
  82:     recommendation: score < 50 ? 'ACTION URGENTE REQUISE' : score < 80 ? 'Points a ameliorer' : 'Dossier en bonne voie',
  83:   });
  84: }
  85:

  74: async function summarizeWithAI(subject: string, body: string, from: string): Promise<EmailSummary> {
  75:   const prompt = `Tu es un assistant juridique. Analyse cet email et retourne UNIQUEMENT un JSON valide (pas de texte avant/aprÃ¨s).
  76: 
  77: De: ${from}
  78: Objet: ${subject}
  79: Corps: ${body.slice(0, 2000)}
  80: 
  81: Retourne ce JSON:
  82: {
  83:   "client": "nom du client ou null",
  84:   "objet": "rÃ©sumÃ© de la demande en 10 mots max",
  85:   "urgence": "basse|moyenne|haute|critique",
  86:   "actionRequise": "action concrÃ¨te Ã  faire en 1 phrase",
  87:   "deadlineDetectee": "date si mentionnÃ©e ou null",
  88:   "typeDossier": "TITRE_SEJOUR|NATURALISATION|OQTF|ASILE|REGROUPEMENT_FAMILIAL|CONTENTIEUX|GENERAL",
  89:   "resumeCourt": "rÃ©sumÃ© complet en 2 phrases max"
  90: }`;
  91: 
  92:   const user = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  93:   const tenantId = (user?.user as any)?.tenantId || 'demo';
  94: 
  95:   const aiResult = await hybridAI.generateWithCostControl(prompt, tenantId);
  96:   const jsonMatch = aiResult.response.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
  97:   if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error('No JSON in AI response');
  98: 
  99:   return JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);

 102: function summarizeWithRegex(subject: string, body: string, from: string): EmailSummary {
 103:   const text = `${subject} ${body}`.toLowerCase();
 104: 
 105:   // DÃ©tection urgence
 106:   let urgence: EmailSummary['urgence'] = 'basse';
 107:   if (text.match(/urgent|imm[eÃ©]diat|48h|24h|oqtf sans d[eÃ©]lai/)) urgence = 'critique';
 108:   else if (text.match(/d[eÃ©]lai|[eÃ©]ch[eÃ©]ance|rapidement|au plus vite/)) urgence = 'haute';
 109:   else if (text.match(/merci de|pourriez-vous|demande/)) urgence = 'moyenne';
 110: 
 111:   // DÃ©tection type dossier (ordre = prioritÃ©, OQTF d'abord car plus urgent)
 112:   let typeDossier = 'GENERAL';
 113:   if (text.match(/oqtf|obligation de quitter/)) typeDossier = 'OQTF';
 114:   else if (text.match(/asile|r[eÃ©]fugi[eÃ©]|ofpra|cnda/)) typeDossier = 'ASILE';
 115:   else if (text.match(/regroupement familial/)) typeDossier = 'REGROUPEMENT_FAMILIAL';
 116:   else if (text.match(/naturalisation|nationalit[eÃ©]/)) typeDossier = 'NATURALISATION';
 117:   else if (text.match(/titre de s[eÃ©]jour|carte de s[eÃ©]jour|r[eÃ©]c[eÃ©]piss[eÃ©]/)) typeDossier = 'TITRE_SEJOUR';
 118: 
 119:   // Extraction client depuis "from"
 120:   const client = from.match(/^([^<@]+)/)?.[1]?.trim() || null;
 121: 
 122:   // DÃ©tection deadline
 123:   const deadlineMatch = text.match(/(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{2,4})|(\d{1,2}\s+(?:janvier|f[eÃ©]vrier|mars|avril|mai|juin|juillet|ao[uÃ»]t|septembre|octobre|novembre|d[eÃ©]cembre)\s+\d{4})/);
 124:   const deadlineDetectee = deadlineMatch?.[0] || null;
 125: 
 126:   return {
 127:     client,
 128:     objet: subject || 'Sans objet',
 129:     urgence,
 130:     actionRequise: urgence === 'critique' ? 'Traiter immÃ©diatement' : 'Ã€ analyser et rÃ©pondre',
 131:     deadlineDetectee,
 132:     typeDossier,
 133:     resumeCourt: `Email de ${client || 'expÃ©diteur inconnu'} concernant ${typeDossier.toLowerCase().replace('_', ' ')}. ${urgence === 'critique' ? 'Action urgente requise.' : 'Ã€ traiter.'}`,
 134:   };
 135: }

src\app\api\ai\translate\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * POST /api/ai/translate
   7:  * Traduit un texte ou document vers le francais.
   8:  */
   9: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  12: 
  13:   const { text, sourceLang, targetLang } = await req.json();
  14: 
  15:   if (!text) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'text requis' }, { status: 400 });
  16: 
  17:   const ollamaUrl = process.env.OLLAMA_URL;
  18:   const target = targetLang || 'francais';
  19:   const source = sourceLang || 'auto-detect';
  20: 
  21:   if (ollamaUrl) {
  22:     try {
  23:       const prompt = `Traduis ce texte en ${target}. Retourne uniquement la traduction, sans commentaire.\n\nTexte: "${text}"`;
  24:       const res = await fetch(`${ollamaUrl}/api/generate`, {
  25:         method: 'POST',
  26:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  27:         body: JSON.stringify({ model: process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.2:latest', prompt, stream: false }),
  28:       });
  29:       if (res.ok) {
  30:         const data = await res.json();
  31:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, translation: data.response, source, target, provider: 'ollama' });
  32:       }
  33:     } catch { /* fallback */ }
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   return NextResponse.json({
  37:     success: true,
  38:     translation: `[TRADUCTION ${target.toUpperCase()}] ${text.substring(0, 200)}...`,
  39:     source,
  40:     target,
  41:     provider: 'fallback',
  42:     note: 'Configurez OLLAMA_URL pour la traduction reelle',
  43:   });
  44: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: 
   3: /**
   4:  * POST /api/aide-juridictionnelle/eligibilite
   5:  * Calcule l'eligibilite a l'aide juridictionnelle selon les revenus.
   6:  * Bareme 2026.
   7:  */
   8: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   9:   const { revenuMensuel, personnesACharge, patrimoine } = await req.json();
  10: 
  11:   if (!revenuMensuel && revenuMensuel !== 0) {
  12:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'revenuMensuel requis' }, { status: 400 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const charges = personnesACharge || 0;
  16:   // Bareme 2026 (approximatif)
  17:   const plafonds = {
  18:     totale: 1017 + (charges * 194),
  19:     partielle55: 1225 + (charges * 194),
  20:     partielle25: 1531 + (charges * 194),
  21:   };
  22: 
  23:   let eligibilite: string;
  24:   let tauxPriseEnCharge: number;
  25: 
  26:   if (revenuMensuel <= plafonds.totale) {
  27:     eligibilite = 'totale';
  28:     tauxPriseEnCharge = 100;
  29:   } else if (revenuMensuel <= plafonds.partielle55) {
  30:     eligibilite = 'partielle';
  31:     tauxPriseEnCharge = 55;
  32:   } else if (revenuMensuel <= plafonds.partielle25) {
  33:     eligibilite = 'partielle';
  34:     tauxPriseEnCharge = 25;
  35:   } else {
  36:     eligibilite = 'non_eligible';
  37:     tauxPriseEnCharge = 0;
  38:   }
  39: 
  40:   return NextResponse.json({
  41:     eligible: eligibilite !== 'non_eligible',
  42:     eligibilite,
  43:     tauxPriseEnCharge,
  44:     plafonds,
  45:     revenuDeclare: revenuMensuel,
  46:     personnesACharge: charges,
  47:     documentsRequis: [
  48:       'Dernier avis d\'imposition',
  49:       'Justificatifs de revenus (3 derniers mois)',
  50:       'Justificatif de domicile',
  51:       'Piece d\'identite',
  52:       'Formulaire CERFA 16146*03',
  53:     ],
  54:     note: 'Calcul indicatif base sur le bareme 2026. La decision finale appartient au BAJ.',
  55:   });
  56: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

   3: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   4: import { AIAnalytics } from '@/lib/analytics/ai';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
   7:     try {
   8:         const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   9:         if (!session?.user) {
  10:             return NextResponse.json(
  11:                 { error: 'Unauthorized' },
  12:                 { status: 401 }
  13:             );
  14:         }
  15: 
  16:         const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  17:         const type = searchParams.get('type') || 'current';
  18:         const days = parseInt(searchParams.get('days') || '30');
  19: 
  20:         let data;
  21: 
  22:         switch (type) {
  23:             case 'current':
  24:                 data = await AIAnalytics.getCurrentMetrics();
  25:                 break;
  26:             case 'tokens':
  27:                 data = await AIAnalytics.getTokenUsageTrend(days);
  28:                 break;
  29:             case 'inference':
  30:                 data = await AIAnalytics.getInferenceStats();
  31:                 break;
  32:             case 'cost':
  33:                 data = await AIAnalytics.getCostBreakdown();
  34:                 break;
  35:             default:
  36:                 return NextResponse.json(
  37:                     { error: 'Invalid type parameter' },
  38:                     { status: 400 }
  39:                 );
  40:         }
  41: 
  42:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, data });
  43:     } catch (error: any) {
  44:         console.error('AI analytics error:', error);
  45:         return NextResponse.json(
  46:             { error: error.message || 'Internal server error' },
  47:             { status: 500 }
  48:         );
  49:     }

src\app\api\analytics\metrics\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3:  * API Métriques de Performance
   4:  *
   5:  * Endpoint pour récupérer les métriques de performance du système
   6:  * Utilisé par le dashboard monitoring et les alertes
   7:  */
   8: 
   9: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  10: import { getToken } from 'next-auth/jwt';
  11: import { getPerformanceStats, collectMetric } from '@/lib/monitoring';
  12: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  13: 
  14: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  15:   try {
  16:     // Auth check - admin only
  17:     const token = await getToken({ req: request as any, secret: process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET });
  18:     if (!token || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'AVOCAT'].includes(token.role as string)) {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  23:     const operation = searchParams.get('operation');
  24: 
  25:     // Si une opération spécifique est demandée
  26:     if (operation) {
  27:       const stats = getPerformanceStats(operation);
  28:       return NextResponse.json({ operation, stats });
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     // Sinon, retourner les métriques globales
  32:     const operations = [
  33:       'api.clients.get',
  34:       'api.clients.list',
  35:       'api.dossiers.get',
  36:       'api.dossiers.list',
  37:       'api.ai.chat',
  38:       'api.ai.suggestions',
  39:       'db.query',
  40:       'cache.hit',
  41:       'cache.miss',
  42:     ];
  43: 
  44:     const metrics: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof getPerformanceStats>> = {};
  45:     for (const op of operations) {
  46:       const stats = getPerformanceStats(op);
  47:       if (stats.count > 0) {
  48:         metrics[op] = stats;
  49:       }
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // Calculer les métriques globales
  53:     const allStats = Object.values(metrics);
  54:     const totalRequests = allStats.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.count, 0);
  55:     const avgResponseTime = allStats.length > 0
  56:       ? allStats.reduce((sum, s) => sum + (s.mean * s.count), 0) / totalRequests
  57:       : 0;
  58: 
  59:     return NextResponse.json({
  60:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  61:       summary: {
  62:         totalRequests,
  63:         avgResponseTime: Math.round(avgResponseTime * 100) / 100,
  64:         operationsTracked: Object.keys(metrics).length,
  65:       },
  66:       operations: metrics,
  67:       health: {
  68:         status: avgResponseTime < 200 ? 'good' : avgResponseTime < 500 ? 'degraded' : 'critical',
  69:         threshold: { good: 200, degraded: 500 },
  70:       },
  71:     });
  72:   } catch (error) {
  73:     logger.error('[Metrics API] Error:', { error });
  74:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });
  75:   }
  76: }
  77: 
  78: // POST pour enregistrer une métrique manuellement (pour les clients JS)
  79: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  80:   try {
  81:     const { operation, duration, metadata } = await request.json();
  82: 
  83:     if (!operation || typeof duration !== 'number') {
  84:       return NextResponse.json(
  85:         { error: 'operation and duration required' },
  86:         { status: 400 }
  87:       );
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     collectMetric(operation, duration, metadata);
  91: 
  92:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  93:   } catch (error) {
  94:     logger.error('[Metrics API] POST Error:', { error });
  95:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });

src\app\api\analytics\web-vitals\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // API Route pour collecter les Web Vitals
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: // https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/route-handlers
   4: 
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: interface WebVitalMetric {
   8:   name: string;
   9:   value: number;
  10:   rating: 'good' | 'needs-improvement' | 'poor';
  11:   delta: number;
  12:   id: string;
  13:   navigationType: string;
  14:   url: string;
  15:   timestamp: number;
  16: }
  17: 
  18: // Stockage en mémoire pour les métriques (en prod, utiliser une DB)
  19: const metricsBuffer: WebVitalMetric[] = [];
  20: const MAX_BUFFER_SIZE = 1000;
  21: 
  22: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  23:   try {
  24:     const metric: WebVitalMetric = await request.json();
  25: 
  26:     // Validation basique
  27:     if (!metric.name || typeof metric.value !== 'number') {
  28:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid metric data' }, { status: 400 });
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     // Ajouter au buffer
  32:     metricsBuffer.push(metric);
  33: 
  34:     // Limiter la taille du buffer
  35:     if (metricsBuffer.length > MAX_BUFFER_SIZE) {
  36:       metricsBuffer.shift();
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     // Log pour monitoring
  40:     if (metric.rating === 'poor') {
  41:       logger.warn(`[Web Vitals] Poor ${metric.name}: ${metric.value}`, {
  42:         url: metric.url,
  43:         timestamp: new Date(metric.timestamp).toISOString(),
  44:       });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     logger.error('[Web Vitals API] Error:', { error });
  50:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to process metric' }, { status: 500 });
  51:   }
  52: }
  53: 
  54: export async function GET() {
  55:   // Retourner les statistiques agrégées
  56:   const stats = {
  57:     totalMetrics: metricsBuffer.length,
  58:     byName: {} as Record<
  59:       string,
  60:       { count: number; avgValue: number; ratings: Record<string, number> }
  61:     >,
  62:   };
  63: 
  64:   for (const metric of metricsBuffer) {
  65:     if (!stats.byName[metric.name]) {
  66:       stats.byName[metric.name] = {
  67:         count: 0,
  68:         avgValue: 0,
  69:         ratings: { good: 0, 'needs-improvement': 0, poor: 0 },
  70:       };
  71:     }
  72:     const entry = stats.byName[metric.name];
  73:     entry.avgValue = (entry.avgValue * entry.count + metric.value) / (entry.count + 1);
  74:     entry.count++;
  75:     entry.ratings[metric.rating]++;
  76:   }
  77: 
  78:   return NextResponse.json(stats);
  79: }
  80:

src\app\api\appointments\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * GET /api/appointments/available
   7:  * Retourne les creneaux disponibles pour un RDV.
   8:  * 
   9:  * POST /api/appointments/book
  10:  * Reserve un creneau.
  11:  */
  12: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  13:   const date = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('date') || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  14:   const duration = parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('duration') || '30');
  15: 
  16:   // Generer des creneaux disponibles (9h-18h, pas de pause dejeuner)
  17:   const slots: string[] = [];
  18:   const baseDate = new Date(date);
  19: 
  20:   for (let h = 9; h < 18; h++) {
  21:     for (let m = 0; m < 60; m += duration) {
  22:       if (h === 12 && m < 60) continue; // Pause dejeuner
  23:       const slot = new Date(baseDate);
  24:       slot.setHours(h, m, 0, 0);
  25:       if (slot > new Date()) slots.push(slot.toISOString());
  26:     }
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   return NextResponse.json({ date, duration: `${duration} min`, slots, total: slots.length });
  30: }
  31: 
  32: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  33:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  34:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  35: 
  36:   const { slot, clientName, clientEmail, motif, dossierId } = await req.json();
  37: 
  38:   if (!slot || !clientName) {
  39:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'slot et clientName requis' }, { status: 400 });
  40:   }
  41: 
  42:   const appointment = {
  43:     id: `rdv-${Date.now()}`,
  44:     slot,
  45:     clientName,
  46:     clientEmail,
  47:     motif: motif || 'Consultation',
  48:     dossierId,
  49:     status: 'confirmed',
  50:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  51:   };
  52: 
  53:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, appointment, message: `RDV confirme le ${new Date(slot).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')} a ${new Date(slot).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}` });
  54: }

src\app\api\audit-logs\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import crypto from 'crypto';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: 
   8: async function resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null): Promise<
   9:   | { tenantId: string; role: string; userId: string; userEmail: string }
  10:   | { error: NextResponse }
  11: > {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) {
  14:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 }) };
  15:   }
  16: 
  17:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  18:   const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  19:   const userId = String((session.user as any).id || '');
  20:   const userEmail = String((session.user as any).email || '');
  21: 
  22:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  23:     if (!requestedTenantId) {
  24:       return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 }) };
  25:     }
  26:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, role, userId, userEmail };
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   if (!sessionTenantId) {
  30:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 }) };
  31:   }
  32: 
  33:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  34:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   return { tenantId: sessionTenantId, role, userId, userEmail };
  38: }
  39: 
  40: // GET - Liste des logs d'audit
  41: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  42:   try {
  43:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  44:     const requestedTenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  45:     const userId = searchParams.get('userId');
  46:     const action = searchParams.get('action');
  47:     const entityType = searchParams.get('entityType');
  48:     const entityId = searchParams.get('entityId');
  49:     const startDate = searchParams.get('startDate');
  50:     const endDate = searchParams.get('endDate');
  51:     const limit = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '100', 10));
  52:     const offset = Math.max(0, parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10));
  53: 
  54:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  55:     if ('error' in access) {
  56:       return access.error;
  57:     }
  58: 
  59:     const allowedReadRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER']);
  60:     if (!allowedReadRoles.has(access.role)) {
  61:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     const tenantId = access.tenantId;
  65: 
  66:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId };
  67:     if (userId) where.userId = userId;
  68:     if (action) where.action = action;
  69:     if (entityType) where.entityType = entityType;
  70:     if (entityId) where.entityId = entityId;
  71:     if (startDate || endDate) {
  72:       where.timestamp = {};
  73:       if (startDate) (where.timestamp as Record<string, unknown>).gte = new Date(startDate);
  74:       if (endDate) (where.timestamp as Record<string, unknown>).lte = new Date(endDate);
  75:     }
  76: 
  77:     const [logs, total] = await Promise.all([
  78:       prisma.auditLog.findMany({
  79:         where,
  80:         orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },
  81:         take: limit,
  82:         skip: offset,
  83:       }),
  84:       prisma.auditLog.count({ where }),
  85:     ]);
  86: 
  87:     return NextResponse.json({ logs, total, hasMore: offset + logs.length < total });
  88:   } catch (error) {
  89:     logger.error('Erreur GET audit-logs:', { error });
  90:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  91:   }
  92: }
  93: 
  94: // POST - Créer un log d'audit
  95: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  96:   try {
  97:     const body = await request.json();
  98:     const {
  99:       tenantId,
 100:       userId,
 101:       userEmail,
 102:       userRole,
 103:       action,
 104:       entityType,
 105:       entityId,
 106:       oldValue,
 107:       newValue,
 108:       ipAddress,
 109:       userAgent,
 110:     } = body;
 111: 
 112:     if (!tenantId || !action || !entityType || !entityId) {
 113:       return NextResponse.json(
 114:         { error: 'Champs requis manquants' },
 115:         { status: 400 }
 116:       );
 117:     }
 118: 
 119:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(tenantId);
 120:     if ('error' in access) {
 121:       return access.error;
 122:     }
 123: 
 124:     const effectiveTenantId = access.tenantId;
 125:     const effectiveUserId = access.userId;
 126:     const effectiveUserEmail = access.userEmail;
 127:     const effectiveRole = access.role;
 128: 
 129:     // Récupérer le dernier log pour la chaîne
 130:     const lastLog = await prisma.auditLog.findFirst({
 131:       where: { tenantId: effectiveTenantId },
 132:       orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },
 133:       select: { id: true, timestampHash: true },
 134:     });
 135: 
 136:     // Calcul du hash cryptographique
 137:     const timestamp = new Date();
 138:     const hashData = `${action}|${entityType}|${entityId}|${timestamp.toISOString()}|${lastLog?.timestampHash || ''}`;
 139:     const timestampHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(hashData).digest('hex');
 140: 
 141:     const log = await prisma.auditLog.create({
 142:       data: {
 143:         tenantId: effectiveTenantId,
 144:         userId: effectiveUserId,
 145:         userEmail: effectiveUserEmail,
 146:         userRole: effectiveRole,
 147:         action,
 148:         entityType,
 149:         entityId,
 150:         oldValue: oldValue ? JSON.stringify(oldValue) : null,
 151:         newValue: newValue ? JSON.stringify(newValue) : null,
 152:         ipAddress,
 153:         userAgent,
 154:         timestamp,
 155:         timestampHash,
 156:         previousLogId: lastLog?.id || null,
 157:       },
 158:     });
 159: 
 160:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, log });
 161:   } catch (error) {
 162:     logger.error('Erreur POST audit-log:', { error });
 163:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 164:   }
 165: }
 166: 
 167: // PATCH - Interdit (logs immuables)
 168: export async function PATCH() {
 169:   return NextResponse.json(
 170:     { error: 'Les logs d\'audit sont immuables' },
 171:     { status: 403 }
 172:   );
 173: }

 176: export async function DELETE() {
 177:   return NextResponse.json(
 178:     { error: 'Les logs d\'audit sont immuables' },
 179:     { status: 403 }
 180:   );

src\app\api\auth\2fa\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import crypto from 'crypto';
   5: import { withLoginRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * POST /api/auth/2fa/setup
   9:  * Genere un secret TOTP pour activer la 2FA.
  10:  * 
  11:  * POST /api/auth/2fa/verify
  12:  * Verifie un code TOTP.
  13:  * Rate-limited pour eviter le brute-force du code a 6 chiffres.
  14:  */
  15: export const POST = withLoginRateLimit(async function twoFactorHandler(req: NextRequest) {
  16:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18: 
  19:   let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  20:   try {
  21:     body = await req.json();
  22:   } catch {
  23:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' }, { status: 400 });
  24:   }
  25: 
  26:   const { action, code } = body as { action?: string; code?: string };
  27: 
  28:   if (action === 'setup') {
  29:     const secret = crypto.randomBytes(20).toString('hex').substring(0, 32);
  30:     const user = session.user as any;
  31:     const otpauthUrl = `otpauth://totp/MemoLib:${user.email}?secret=${secret}&issuer=MemoLib`;
  32: 
  33:     return NextResponse.json({
  34:       success: true,
  35:       secret,
  36:       otpauthUrl,
  37:       qrCodeUrl: `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=200x200&data=${encodeURIComponent(otpauthUrl)}`,
  38:       instructions: 'Scannez le QR code avec Google Authenticator ou Authy, puis entrez le code pour confirmer.',
  39:     });
  40:   }
  41: 
  42:   if (action === 'verify') {
  43:     if (!code || code.length !== 6) {
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Code a 6 chiffres requis' }, { status: 400 });
  45:     }
  46:     // En production: verifier le code TOTP avec le secret stocke
  47:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, verified: true, message: '2FA activee avec succes' });
  48:   }
  49: 
  50:   return NextResponse.json({ error: 'action requis (setup ou verify)' }, { status: 400 });
  51: });

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: POST /api/auth/change-password
   3:  * 
   4:  * Permet Ã  l'utilisateur connectÃ© de changer son mot de passe.
   5:  * Requiert l'ancien mot de passe pour validation.
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: import { z } from 'zod';
  13: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
  14: 
  15: const changePasswordSchema = z.object({
  16:   currentPassword: z.string().min(1, 'Mot de passe actuel requis'),
  17:   newPassword: z.string().min(8, 'Le nouveau mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractÃ¨res'),
  18:   confirmPassword: z.string(),
  19: }).refine((data) => data.newPassword === data.confirmPassword, {
  20:   message: 'Les mots de passe ne correspondent pas',
  21:   path: ['confirmPassword'],
  22: });
  23: 
  24: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  25:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  26:   if (!session?.user) {
  27:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  28:   }
  29: 
  30:   const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  31:   if (!userId) {
  32:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ID utilisateur manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  36:   try {
  37:     body = await req.json();
  38:   } catch {
  39:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  40:   }
  41: 
  42:   const parsed = changePasswordSchema.safeParse(body);
  43:   if (!parsed.success) {
  44:     return NextResponse.json(
  45:       { error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message || 'DonnÃ©es invalides' },
  46:       { status: 400 }
  47:     );
  48:   }
  49: 
  50:   const { currentPassword, newPassword } = parsed.data;
  51: 
  52:   // RÃ©cupÃ©rer l'utilisateur avec son mot de passe
  53:   const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  54:     where: { id: userId },
  55:     select: { id: true, password: true },
  56:   });
  57: 
  58:   if (!user || !user.password) {
  59:     return NextResponse.json(
  60:       { error: 'Impossible de changer le mot de passe (compte OAuth).' },
  61:       { status: 400 }
  62:     );
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   // VÃ©rifier l'ancien mot de passe
  66:   const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
  67:   if (!isValid) {
  68:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect.' }, { status: 401 });
  69:   }
  70: 
  71:   // VÃ©rifier que le nouveau est diffÃ©rent
  72:   const isSame = await bcrypt.compare(newPassword, user.password);
  73:   if (isSame) {
  74:     return NextResponse.json(
  75:       { error: 'Le nouveau mot de passe doit Ãªtre diffÃ©rent de l\'ancien.' },
  76:       { status: 400 }
  77:     );
  78:   }
  79: 
  80:   // Hasher et sauvegarder
  81:   const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 12);
  82:   await prisma.user.update({
  83:     where: { id: userId },
  84:     data: { password: hashedPassword },
  85:   });
  86: 
  87:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Mot de passe modifiÃ© avec succÃ¨s.' });
  88: }

src\app\api\auth\forgot-password\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import crypto from 'crypto';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: import { withLoginRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * API pour demander une reinitialisation de mot de passe
   9:  * Genere un token unique et l'envoie par email
  10:  * Rate-limited pour eviter le spam/enumeration d'emails
  11:  */
  12: export const POST = withLoginRateLimit(async function forgotPasswordHandler(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  15:     try {
  16:       body = await request.json();
  17:     } catch {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' }, { status: 400 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const { email } = body as { email?: string };
  22: 
  23:     if (!email) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email requis' }, { status: 400 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     // Chercher l'utilisateur
  28:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  29:       where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
  30:     });
  31: 
  32:     // Pour des raisons de securite, toujours repondre OK
  33:     // meme si l'utilisateur n'existe pas
  34:     if (!user) {
  35:       logger.info('Demande de reset password pour email inexistant', { email });
  36:       return NextResponse.json({
  37:         success: true,
  38:         message: 'Si un compte existe avec cette adresse, un email a ete envoye.',
  39:       });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     // Generer un token de reinitialisation
  43:     const resetToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  44:     const resetTokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(resetToken).digest('hex');
  45: 
  46:     // Token valide pendant 1 heure
  47:     const resetTokenExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000);
  48: 
  49:     // Sauvegarder le token dans la base de donnees
  50:     await prisma.user.update({
  51:       where: { id: user.id },
  52:       data: {
  53:         resetToken: resetTokenHash,
  54:         resetTokenExpiry,
  55:       },
  56:     });
  57: 
  58:     // Construire l'URL de reinitialisation
  59:     const baseUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
  60:     const resetUrl = `${baseUrl}/auth/reset-password?token=${resetToken}&email=${encodeURIComponent(email)}`;
  61: 
  62:     // Envoyer l'email via Resend
  63:     try {
  64:       const { Resend } = await import('resend');
  65:       const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);
  66: 
  67:       if (process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) {
  68:         await resend.emails.send({
  69:           from: process.env.EMAIL_FROM || 'noreply@memoLib.com',
  70:           to: email,
  71:           subject: 'RÃ©initialisation de votre mot de passe - memoLib',
  72:           html: `
  73:             <h2>RÃ©initialisation de mot de passe</h2>
  74:             <p>Vous avez demandÃ© la rÃ©initialisation de votre mot de passe.</p>
  75:             <p>Cliquez sur le lien ci-dessous (valide 1 heure) :</p>
  76:             <a href="${resetUrl}" style="background:#2563eb;color:white;padding:12px 24px;text-decoration:none;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;">RÃ©initialiser mon mot de passe</a>
  77:             <p style="margin-top:20px;color:#666;">Si vous n'avez pas fait cette demande, ignorez cet email.</p>
  78:           `,
  79:         });
  80:         logger.info('Email de reinitialisation envoye', { to: email });
  81:       } else {
  82:         logger.warn('RESEND_API_KEY non configure, email non envoye');
  83:       }
  84:     } catch (emailError) {
  85:       logger.error('Erreur envoi email reset password', { error: emailError, email });
  86:     }
  87: 
  88:     // Pour le developpement, log le lien
  89:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
  90:       logger.info('\n========================================');
  91:       logger.info('ðŸ” LIEN DE REINITIALISATION (DEV ONLY):');
  92:       logger.info('Reset URL:', { resetUrl });
  93:       logger.info('========================================\n');
  94:     }
  95: 
  96:     logger.info('Demande de reinitialisation de mot de passe', {
  97:       userId: user.id,
  98:       email,
  99:     });
 100: 
 101:     return NextResponse.json({
 102:       success: true,
 103:       message: 'Si un compte existe avec cette adresse, un email a ete envoye.',
 104:     });
 105:   } catch (error) {
 106:     logger.error('Erreur forgot-password API', { error });
 107:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 108:   }
 109: });

   9: /**
  10:  * POST /api/auth/register
  11:  * Rate-limited: 5 req / 15 min par IP
  12:  * Route legacy (crÃ©e subscription + settings, status active immÃ©diatement)
  13:  */

  15:   const parsed = await parseJsonBody<RegistrationInput>(request);
  16:   if (!parsed.success) return parsed.response;

  20:       requireEmailVerification: false,
  21:       createSubscription: true,
  22:     });
