  24:     if (!result.success) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json(
  26:         { error: result.error, ...(result.details && { details: result.details }) },
  27:         { status: result.status }
  28:       );
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     return NextResponse.json({
  32:       success: true,
  33:       message: 'Inscription rÃ©ussie',
  34:       user: result.user,
  35:       tenant: result.tenant,
  36:     });
  37:   } catch (error) {
  38:     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
  39:     logger.error('[REGISTER] Erreur inscription', error);
  40: 
  41:     if (message.includes("Can't reach database server")) {
  42:       return NextResponse.json(
  43:         { error: "Service d'inscription temporairement indisponible (base de donnÃ©es)." },
  44:         { status: 503 }
  45:       );
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     return NextResponse.json(
  49:       { error: "Erreur lors de l'inscription" },
  50:       { status: 500 }
  51:     );
  52:   }
  53: });

src\app\api\auth\reset-password\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
   4: import crypto from 'crypto';
   5: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   6: import { withLoginRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
   7: 
   8: /**
   9:  * API pour reinitialiser le mot de passe avec un token valide
  10:  * Rate-limited pour eviter le brute-force du token
  11:  */
  12: export const POST = withLoginRateLimit(async function resetPasswordHandler(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  15:     try {
  16:       body = await request.json();
  17:     } catch {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' }, { status: 400 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const { token, email, password } = body as { token?: string; email?: string; password?: string };
  22: 
  23:     if (!token || !email || !password) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json(
  25:         { error: 'Token, email et mot de passe requis' },
  26:         { status: 400 }
  27:       );
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     // Validation du mot de passe
  31:     if (password.length < 8) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json(
  33:         { error: 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caracteres' },
  34:         { status: 400 }
  35:       );
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Hasher le token pour comparaison
  39:     const tokenHash = crypto
  40:       .createHash('sha256')
  41:       .update(token)
  42:       .digest('hex');
  43: 
  44:     // Chercher l'utilisateur avec ce token
  45:     const user = await prisma.user.findFirst({
  46:       where: {
  47:         email: email.toLowerCase().trim(),
  48:         resetToken: tokenHash,
  49:         resetTokenExpiry: {
  50:           gt: new Date(), // Token non expire
  51:         },
  52:       },
  53:     });
  54: 
  55:     if (!user) {
  56:       logger.warn('Tentative de reset avec token invalide', { email });
  57:       return NextResponse.json(
  58:         { error: 'Token invalide ou expire' },
  59:         { status: 400 }
  60:       );
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     // Hasher le nouveau mot de passe
  64:     const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);
  65: 
  66:     // Mettre a jour le mot de passe et supprimer le token
  67:     await prisma.user.update({
  68:       where: { id: user.id },
  69:       data: {
  70:         password: hashedPassword,
  71:         resetToken: null,
  72:         resetTokenExpiry: null,
  73:         updatedAt: new Date(),
  74:       },
  75:     });
  76: 
  77:     logger.info('Mot de passe reinitialise avec succes', {
  78:       userId: user.id,
  79:       email: user.email,
  80:     });
  81: 
  82:     return NextResponse.json({
  83:       success: true,
  84:       message: 'Mot de passe modifie avec succes',
  85:     });
  86:   } catch (error) {
  87:     logger.error('Erreur reset-password API', { error });
  88:     return NextResponse.json(
  89:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  90:       { status: 500 }
  91:     );
  92:   }
  93: });
  94:

src\app\api\azure\keyvault\secret\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
   3: 
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { getSecretClient } from '@/lib/azure/clients';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: 
   9: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:   if (!session?.user) {
  12:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  16:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  17:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   return null;
  22: }
  23: 
  24: export async function GET(request: Request) {
  25:   try {
  26:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  27:     if (authError) {
  28:       return authError;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const url = new URL(request.url);
  32:     const name = url.searchParams.get('name');
  33: 
  34:     if (!name) {
  35:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required query param: name' }, { status: 400 });
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     const client = getSecretClient();
  39:     const secret = await client.getSecret(name);
  40: 
  41:     logger.info('Key Vault: secret fetched', { rgpdCompliant: true, secretName: name });
  42: 
  43:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, name, value: secret.value ?? null, properties: {
  44:       enabled: secret.properties.enabled ?? undefined,
  45:       createdOn: secret.properties.createdOn ?? undefined,
  46:       updatedOn: secret.properties.updatedOn ?? undefined,
  47:     }});
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     logger.error('Key Vault getSecret failed', error as any, { rgpdCompliant: true });
  50:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: (error as Error).message }, { status: 500 });
  51:   }
  52: }

src\app\api\azure\storage\list\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
   3: 
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { getBlobServiceClient } from '@/lib/azure/clients';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: 
   9: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:   if (!session?.user) {
  12:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  16:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  17:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   return null;
  22: }
  23: 
  24: export async function GET(request: Request) {
  25:   try {
  26:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  27:     if (authError) {
  28:       return authError;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const url = new URL(request.url);
  32:     const prefix = url.searchParams.get('prefix') ?? undefined;
  33:     const take = Math.min(Number(url.searchParams.get('take') ?? '50'), 500);
  34: 
  35:     const containerName = process.env.AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER;
  36:     if (!containerName) {
  37:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER' }, { status: 500 });
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     const blobService = getBlobServiceClient();
  41:     const container = blobService.getContainerClient(containerName);
  42: 
  43:     const blobs: Array<{ name: string; size?: number; contentType?: string }> = [];
  44:     let i = 0;
  45:     for await (const item of container.listBlobsFlat({ prefix })) {
  46:       blobs.push({
  47:         name: item.name,
  48:         size: item.properties.contentLength,
  49:         contentType: item.properties.contentType,
  50:       });
  51:       i += 1;
  52:       if (i >= take) break;
  53:     }
  54: 
  55:     logger.info('Azure Storage: listed blobs', {
  56:       rgpdCompliant: true,
  57:       count: blobs.length,
  58:       prefix: prefix ?? null,
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, container: containerName, count: blobs.length, blobs });
  62:   } catch (error) {
  63:     logger.error('Azure Storage list failed', error as any, { rgpdCompliant: true });
  64:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: (error as Error).message }, { status: 500 });
  65:   }
  66: }

src\app\api\azure\storage\upload\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
   3: 
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { getBlobServiceClient } from '@/lib/azure/clients';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: 
   9: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:   if (!session?.user) {
  12:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  16:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  17:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   return null;
  22: }
  23: 
  24: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  25:   try {
  26:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  27:     if (authError) {
  28:       return authError;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const url = new URL(request.url);
  32:     const name = url.searchParams.get('name');
  33:     if (!name) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing query param: name' }, { status: 400 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     const containerName = process.env.AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER;
  38:     if (!containerName) {
  39:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing AZURE_STORAGE_CONTAINER' }, { status: 500 });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     const contentType = request.headers.get('content-type') || 'application/octet-stream';
  43: 
  44:     const body = await request.arrayBuffer();
  45:     const buffer = Buffer.from(body);
  46: 
  47:     const blobService = getBlobServiceClient();
  48:     const container = blobService.getContainerClient(containerName);
  49:     await container.createIfNotExists();
  50: 
  51:     const blob = container.getBlockBlobClient(name);
  52:     await blob.uploadData(buffer, {
  53:       blobHTTPHeaders: { blobContentType: contentType },
  54:     });
  55: 
  56:     logger.info('Azure Storage: uploaded blob', { rgpdCompliant: true, name, size: buffer.length });
  57: 
  58:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, name, size: buffer.length }, { status: 201 });
  59:   } catch (error) {
  60:     logger.error('Azure Storage upload failed', error as any, { rgpdCompliant: true });
  61:     return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: (error as Error).message }, { status: 500 });
  62:   }
  63: }

  26:         { error: 'Non autorisé' },

  30:

   1: /**
   2:  * API Checkout Stripe
   3:  * Cree une session de paiement pour s'abonner a un plan
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  10: import { createCheckoutSession } from '@/lib/billing/stripe-client';
  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const user = session.user as any;
  21:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  22: 
  23:     if (!tenantId) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pas de tenant' }, { status: 400 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     const { planName, billingCycle = 'monthly', trialDays = 0 } = await request.json();
  28: 
  29:     // Recuperer le plan
  30:     const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({
  31:       where: { name: planName, isActive: true }
  32:     });
  33: 
  34:     if (!plan) {
  35:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Plan introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Recuperer le tenant
  39:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  40:       where: { id: tenantId },
  41:       select: { name: true, billingEmail: true }
  42:     });
  43: 
  44:     if (!tenant) {
  45:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     // Creer la session Stripe Checkout
  49:     // NOTE: Vous devez creer les prix dans Stripe Dashboard et stocker les IDs
  50:     const priceId = billingCycle === 'yearly'
  51:       ? `price_${planName.toLowerCase()}_yearly` // a remplacer par vrai ID Stripe
  52:       : `price_${planName.toLowerCase()}_monthly`; // a remplacer par vrai ID Stripe
  53: 
  54:     const checkoutSession = await createCheckoutSession({
  55:       priceId,
  56:       customerEmail: tenant.billingEmail || user.email,
  57:       tenantId,
  58:       successUrl: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/admin/billing?success=true`,
  59:       cancelUrl: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/admin/billing?canceled=true`,
  60:       trialDays,
  61:     });
  62: 
  63:     return NextResponse.json({
  64:       success: true,
  65:       checkoutUrl: checkoutSession.url,
  66:       sessionId: checkoutSession.id,
  67:     });
  68:   } catch (error) {
  69:     logger.error('Erreur creation checkout:', { error });
  70:     return NextResponse.json(
  71:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  72:       { status: 500 }
  73:     );
  74:   }

   1: /**
   2:  * API : Features disponibles pour le tenant courant
   3:  *
   4:  * GET /api/billing/features
   5:  * â†’ Retourne la liste des features accessibles + le tier actuel
   6:  *
   7:  * UtilisÃ© par le hook useFeatureGate pour Ã©viter de dupliquer
   8:  * la logique cÃ´tÃ© client (optionnel â€” le hook fonctionne aussi en standalone).
   9:  */
  10:

  12: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  13: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  14: import { getFeatureGate, FEATURE_CATEGORIES } from '@/lib/billing/features';

  16: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  17:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  18:   if (!session?.user) {

  23:   if (!tenantId) {

  38:       tier: nextTier.tier,
  39:       newFeatures: nextTier.features,
  40:       newFeaturesCount: nextTier.features.length,
  41:     } : null,
  42:     categories: Object.entries(FEATURE_CATEGORIES).map(([key, cat]) => ({
  43:       key,
  44:       label: cat.label,
  45:       features: cat.features.map(f => ({
  46:         id: f,
  47:         available: available.includes(f),
  48:       })),
  49:     })),
  50:   });
  51: }

   1: /**
   2:  * API Portail Client Stripe
   3:  * Redirige vers le portail de gestion d'abonnement
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  10: import { createCustomerPortalSession } from '@/lib/billing/stripe-client';
  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const user = session.user as any;
  21:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  22: 
  23:     if (!tenantId) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pas de tenant' }, { status: 400 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     // Recuperer la subscription
  28:     const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findUnique({
  29:       where: { tenantId },
  30:       select: { metadata: true }
  31:     });
  32:

  34:       return NextResponse.json(

  42:       ? JSON.parse(subscription.metadata)
  43:       : subscription.metadata;
  44:

  46: 
  47:     if (!customerId) {
  48:       return NextResponse.json(
  49:         { error: 'Client Stripe introuvable' },
  50:         { status: 404 }
  51:       );
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     // Creer la session portail
  55:     const portalSession = await createCustomerPortalSession({
  56:       customerId,
  57:       returnUrl: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/admin/billing`,
  58:     });
  59: 
  60:     return NextResponse.json({
  61:       success: true,
  62:       portalUrl: portalSession.url,
  63:     });
  64:   } catch (error) {
  65:     logger.error('Erreur creation portail:', { error });

src\app\api\billing\quotas\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: 
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  10: 
  11:     if (!session?.user) {
  12:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:     }
  14: 
  15:     const user = session.user as any;
  16:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  17: 
  18:     if (!tenantId) {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     // Recuperer le tenant avec son plan
  23:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  24:       where: { id: tenantId },
  25:       include: {
  26:         plan: {
  27:           select: {
  28:             maxWorkspaces: true,
  29:             maxDossiers: true,
  30:             maxClients: true,
  31:             maxUsers: true,
  32:             maxStorageGb: true,
  33:           },
  34:         },
  35:       },
  36:     });
  37: 
  38:     if (!tenant) {
  39:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     // Calculer les quotas
  43:     const quotas = [
  44:       {
  45:         type: 'workspaces',
  46:         current: tenant.currentWorkspaces,
  47:         limit: tenant.plan.maxWorkspaces,
  48:         percentage: tenant.plan.maxWorkspaces === -1 
  49:           ? 0 
  50:           : (tenant.currentWorkspaces / tenant.plan.maxWorkspaces) * 100,
  51:       },
  52:       {
  53:         type: 'dossiers',
  54:         current: tenant.currentDossiers,
  55:         limit: tenant.plan.maxDossiers,
  56:         percentage: tenant.plan.maxDossiers === -1 
  57:           ? 0 
  58:           : (tenant.currentDossiers / tenant.plan.maxDossiers) * 100,
  59:       },
  60:       {
  61:         type: 'clients',
  62:         current: tenant.currentClients,
  63:         limit: tenant.plan.maxClients,
  64:         percentage: tenant.plan.maxClients === -1 
  65:           ? 0 
  66:           : (tenant.currentClients / tenant.plan.maxClients) * 100,
  67:       },
  68:       {
  69:         type: 'users',
  70:         current: tenant.currentUsers,
  71:         limit: tenant.plan.maxUsers,
  72:         percentage: tenant.plan.maxUsers === -1 
  73:           ? 0 
  74:           : (tenant.currentUsers / tenant.plan.maxUsers) * 100,
  75:       },
  76:       {
  77:         type: 'storage',
  78:         current: tenant.currentStorageGb,
  79:         limit: tenant.plan.maxStorageGb,
  80:         percentage: tenant.plan.maxStorageGb === -1 
  81:           ? 0 
  82:           : (tenant.currentStorageGb / tenant.plan.maxStorageGb) * 100,
  83:       },
  84:     ];
  85: 
  86:     // Filtrer les quotas illimites pour l'affichage
  87:     const visibleQuotas = quotas.filter(q => q.limit !== -1);
  88: 
  89:     return NextResponse.json({ 
  90:       success: true,
  91:       quotas: visibleQuotas,
  92:       tenant: {
  93:         name: tenant.name,
  94:         planName: tenant.plan.maxWorkspaces === 1 ? 'SOLO' : tenant.plan.maxWorkspaces === 10 ? 'CABINET' : 'ENTERPRISE',
  95:       }
  96:     });
  97:   } catch (error) {
  98:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation quotas:', { error });
  99:     return NextResponse.json(
 100:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
 101:       { status: 500 }
 102:     );
 103:   }
 104: }

src\app\api\calendar\google-sync\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/calendar/google-sync
   8:  * Synchronise les deadlines MemoLib vers Google Calendar.
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const user = session.user as any;
  15:   const { accessToken } = await req.json();
  16: 
  17:   if (!accessToken) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Google accessToken requis. Connectez votre Google Calendar.' }, { status: 400 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   // Recuperer les deadlines a venir
  22:   const deadlines = await prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({
  23:     where: { tenantId: user.tenantId, status: 'PENDING', dueDate: { gte: new Date() } },
  24:     include: { dossier: { select: { numero: true, objet: true } } },
  25:     orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' },
  26:     take: 50,
  27:   });
  28: 
  29:   let synced = 0;
  30: 
  31:   for (const dl of deadlines) {
  32:     try {
  33:       const event = {
  34:         summary: `[MemoLib] ${dl.label}`,
  35:         description: `Dossier: ${dl.dossier?.numero || 'N/A'}\n${dl.dossier?.objet || ''}`,
  36:         start: { dateTime: dl.dueDate.toISOString(), timeZone: 'Europe/Paris' },
  37:         end: { dateTime: new Date(dl.dueDate.getTime() + 3600000).toISOString(), timeZone: 'Europe/Paris' },
  38:         reminders: { useDefault: false, overrides: [{ method: 'popup', minutes: 1440 }, { method: 'popup', minutes: 60 }] },
  39:       };
  40: 
  41:       const res = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events', {
  42:         method: 'POST',
  43:         headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  44:         body: JSON.stringify(event),
  45:       });
  46: 
  47:       if (res.ok) synced++;
  48:     } catch (e) { /* skip */ }
  49:   }
  50: 
  51:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, synced, total: deadlines.length });
  52: }
  53:

src\app\api\calendar\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { NotificationService } from '@/lib/notifications';
   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: 
   8: // GET - Recuperer les evenements du calendrier
   9: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  10:   try {
  11:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:     if (!session?.user) {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14:     }
  15:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  16:     if (!tenantId) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  21:     const userId = searchParams.get('userId');
  22:     const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  23:     const clientId = searchParams.get('clientId');
  24:     const startDate = searchParams.get('startDate');
  25:     const endDate = searchParams.get('endDate');
  26:     const type = searchParams.get('type');
  27: 
  28:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId };
  29: 
  30:     if (userId) where.userId = userId;
  31:     if (dossierId) where.dossierId = dossierId;
  32:     if (clientId) where.clientId = clientId;
  33:     if (type) where.type = type;
  34: 
  35:     if (startDate || endDate) {
  36:       where.startDate = {};
  37:       if (startDate) (where.startDate as Record<string, Date>).gte = new Date(startDate);
  38:       if (endDate) (where.startDate as Record<string, Date>).lte = new Date(endDate);
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     const events = await prisma.calendarEvent.findMany({
  42:       where,
  43:       include: {
  44:         user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
  45:         dossier: { select: { numero: true, typeDossier: true } },
  46:         client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
  47:       },
  48:       orderBy: { startDate: 'asc' },
  49:     });
  50: 
  51:     return NextResponse.json({ events });
  52:   } catch (error) {
  53:     logger.error('Erreur GET calendar:', { error });
  54:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  55:   }
  56: }
  57: 
  58: // POST - Creer un evenement
  59: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  60:   try {
  61:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  62:     if (!session?.user) {
  63:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  64:     }
  65:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  66:     if (!tenantId) {
  67:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  68:     }
  69: 
  70:     const body = await request.json();
  71:     const {
  72:       userId,
  73:       dossierId,
  74:       clientId,
  75:       title,
  76:       description,
  77:       location,
  78:       startDate,
  79:       endDate,
  80:       allDay = false,
  81:       type = 'rdv',
  82:       status = 'confirmed',
  83:       reminders,
  84:       isRecurring = false,
  85:       recurrenceRule,
  86:     } = body;
  87: 
  88:     if (!userId || !title || !startDate || !endDate) {
  89:       return NextResponse.json(
  90:         { error: 'userId, title, startDate et endDate requis' },
  91:         { status: 400 }
  92:       );
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     const event = await prisma.calendarEvent.create({
  96:       data: {
  97:         tenantId,
  98:         userId,
  99:         dossierId,
 100:         clientId,
 101:         title,
 102:         description,
 103:         location,
 104:         startDate: new Date(startDate),
 105:         endDate: new Date(endDate),
 106:         allDay,
 107:         type,
 108:         status,
 109:         reminders: reminders ? JSON.stringify(reminders) : null,
 110:         isRecurring,
 111:         recurrenceRule,
 112:       },
 113:       include: {
 114:         user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
 115:         dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
 116:         client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 117:       },
 118:     });
 119: 
 120:     // Planifier les rappels si demande
 121:     if (reminders && Array.isArray(reminders)) {
 122:       await scheduleReminders(event.id, userId, title, new Date(startDate), reminders);
 123:     }
 124: 
 125:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event });
 126:   } catch (error) {
 127:     logger.error('Erreur POST calendar:', { error });
 128:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 129:   }
 130: }

 132: // PATCH - Mettre a jour un evenement
 133: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 134:   try {
 135:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 136:     if (!session?.user) {
 137:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 138:     }
 139:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
 140:     if (!tenantId) {
 141:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
 142:     }
 143: 
 144:     const body = await request.json();
 145:     const { eventId, tenantId: _ignoredTenantId, ...updateData } = body;
 146: 
 147:     if (!eventId) {
 148:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId requis' }, { status: 400 });
 149:     }
 150: 
 151:     const existing = await prisma.calendarEvent.findFirst({ where: { id: eventId, tenantId } });
 152:     if (!existing) {
 153:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Evenement non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 154:     }
 155: 
 156:     // Convertir les dates si presentes
 157:     if (updateData.startDate) updateData.startDate = new Date(updateData.startDate);
 158:     if (updateData.endDate) updateData.endDate = new Date(updateData.endDate);
 159:     if (updateData.reminders) updateData.reminders = JSON.stringify(updateData.reminders);
 160: 
 161:     const event = await prisma.calendarEvent.update({
 162:       where: { id: eventId },
 163:       data: updateData,
 164:       include: {
 165:         user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
 166:         dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
 167:         client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 168:       },
 169:     });
 170: 
 171:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event });
 172:   } catch (error) {
 173:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH calendar:', { error });
 174:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 175:   }
 176: }

 178: // DELETE - Supprimer un evenement
 179: export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
 180:   try {
 181:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 182:     if (!session?.user) {
 183:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 184:     }
 185:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
 186:     if (!tenantId) {
 187:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
 188:     }
 189: 
 190:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
 191:     const eventId = searchParams.get('eventId');
 192: 
 193:     if (!eventId) {
 194:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'eventId requis' }, { status: 400 });
 195:     }
 196: 
 197:     const existing = await prisma.calendarEvent.findFirst({ where: { id: eventId, tenantId } });
 198:     if (!existing) {
 199:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Evenement non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     await prisma.calendarEvent.delete({
 203:       where: { id: eventId },
 204:     });
 205: 
 206:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
 207:   } catch (error) {
 208:     logger.error('Erreur DELETE calendar:', { error });
 209:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 210:   }
 211: }
 212: 
 213: // Planifier des rappels pour un evenement
 214: async function scheduleReminders(
 215:   eventId: string,
 216:   userId: string,
 217:   title: string,
 218:   eventDate: Date,
 219:   reminders: Array<{ minutes: number; type: string }>
 220: ) {
 221:   for (const reminder of reminders) {
 222:     const reminderDate = new Date(eventDate.getTime() - reminder.minutes * 60 * 1000);
 223:     
 224:     // Si le rappel est dans le futur, le planifier
 225:     if (reminderDate > new Date()) {
 226:       const delay = reminderDate.getTime() - Date.now();
 227:       
 228:       // Pour les rappels a court terme, utiliser setTimeout
 229:       // Pour les rappels a long terme, utiliser une tache planifiee (cron)
 230:       if (delay < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) { // Moins de 24h
 231:         setTimeout(async () => {
 232:           try {
 233:             await NotificationService.deadlineApproaching(userId, {
 234:               title,
 235:               date: eventDate,
 236:               type: 'calendar',
 237:               id: eventId,
 238:             });
 239:           } catch (error) {
 240:             logger.error('Erreur envoi rappel:', { error });
 241:           }
 242:         }, delay);
 243:       }
 244:     }
 245:   }
 246: }

src\app\api\calendar\sync\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { calendarService, type CalendarProvider } from '@/lib/calendar/calendar-service';
   2: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
   7: 
   8: async function resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null): Promise<
   9:   | { tenantId: string }
  10:   | { error: NextResponse }
  11: > {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) {
  14:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 }) };
  15:   }
  16: 
  17:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  18:   const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  19: 
  20:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  21:     if (!requestedTenantId) {
  22:       return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 }) };
  23:     }
  24:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId };
  25:   }
  26: 
  27:   if (!sessionTenantId) {
  28:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 }) };
  29:   }
  30: 
  31:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  32:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   return { tenantId: sessionTenantId };
  36: }
  37: 
  38: export async function POST(req: Request) {
  39:   try {
  40:     const body = await req.json();
  41:     const requestedTenantId = String(body.tenantId || '').trim() || null;
  42:     const provider = String(body.provider || 'ical').trim() as CalendarProvider;
  43:     const token = body.token ? String(body.token) : undefined;
  44: 
  45:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  46:     if ('error' in access) {
  47:       return access.error;
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     const tenantId = access.tenantId;
  51:     const result = await calendarService.sync(tenantId, provider, token);
  52:     return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 200 });
  53:   } catch (e: any) {
  54:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'sync_failed', detail: e?.message }, { status: 500 });
  55:   }
  56: }
  57: 
  58: export async function GET(req: Request) {
  59:   const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  60:   const requestedTenantId = String(searchParams.get('tenantId') || '').trim() || null;
  61:   const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  62:   if ('error' in access) {
  63:     return access.error;
  64:   }
  65:   const tenantId = access.tenantId;
  66: 
  67:   const events = calendarService.listEvents(tenantId);
  68:   return NextResponse.json({ events }, { status: 200 });
  69: }

src\app\api\chat\[dossierId]\messages\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { randomUUID, createHash } from 'crypto';
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   7: 
   8: /**
   9:  * GET /api/chat/[dossierId]/messages
  10:  * Liste les messages du chat d'un dossier.
  11:  * 
  12:  * POST /api/chat/[dossierId]/messages
  13:  * Envoie un message (client ou avocat).
  14:  */
  15: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ dossierId: string }> }) {
  16:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18: 
  19:   const { dossierId } = await params;
  20:   const user = session.user as any;
  21:   const tenantId = user.tenantId as string | undefined;
  22:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  23: 
  24:   const access = await canAccessDossier({
  25:     userId: user.id,
  26:     tenantId,
  27:     role: user.role,
  28:     groups: user.groups,
  29:     dossierId,
  30:     action: 'read',
  31:   });
  32:   if (!access.allowed) {
  33:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   const rows = await prisma.channelMessage.findMany({
  37:     where: { tenantId, dossierId, channel: 'INTERNAL' },
  38:     orderBy: { receivedAt: 'asc' },
  39:     take: 200,
  40:   });
  41: 
  42:   const messages = rows.map((row) => {
  43:     const sender = (row.senderData as { id?: string; name?: string; role?: string } | null) ?? {};
  44:     return {
  45:       id: row.id,
  46:       dossierId,
  47:       senderId: sender.id ?? null,
  48:       senderName: sender.name ?? 'Utilisateur',
  49:       senderRole: sender.role ?? null,
  50:       content: row.body,
  51:       createdAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
  52:     };
  53:   });
  54: 
  55:   return NextResponse.json({ dossierId, messages });
  56: }
  57: 
  58: export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ dossierId: string }> }) {
  59:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  60:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  61: 
  62:   const { dossierId } = await params;
  63:   const user = session.user as any;
  64:   const tenantId = user.tenantId as string | undefined;
  65:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  66: 
  67:   const access = await canAccessDossier({
  68:     userId: user.id,
  69:     tenantId,
  70:     role: user.role,
  71:     groups: user.groups,
  72:     dossierId,
  73:     action: 'write',
  74:   });
  75:   if (!access.allowed) {
  76:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse au dossier' }, { status: 403 });
  77:   }
  78: 
  79:   const { content } = await req.json();
  80:   const trimmed = typeof content === 'string' ? content.trim() : '';
  81: 
  82:   if (!trimmed) {
  83:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Message vide' }, { status: 400 });
  84:   }
  85:   if (trimmed.length > 5000) {
  86:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Message trop long (5000 caracteres max)' }, { status: 400 });
  87:   }
  88: 
  89:   const id = randomUUID();
  90:   const checksum = createHash('sha256').update(`${tenantId}:${dossierId}:${id}`).digest('hex');
  91: 
  92:   const row = await prisma.channelMessage.create({
  93:     data: {
  94:       id,
  95:       tenantId,
  96:       dossierId,
  97:       checksum,
  98:       channel: 'INTERNAL',
  99:       direction: 'OUTBOUND',
 100:       status: 'PROCESSED',
 101:       body: trimmed,
 102:       senderData: { id: user.id, name: user.name, role: user.role },
 103:       processedAt: new Date(),
 104:     },
 105:   });
 106: 
 107:   return NextResponse.json({
 108:     success: true,
 109:     message: {
 110:       id: row.id,
 111:       dossierId,
 112:       senderId: user.id,
 113:       senderName: user.name,
 114:       senderRole: user.role,
 115:       content: row.body,
 116:       createdAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
 117:     },
 118:   });
 119: }

src\app\api\client\[clientId]\dashboard\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   6: 
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { clientId: string } }) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  10: 
  11:     if (!session?.user) {
  12:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:     }
  14: 
  15:     const user = session.user as any;
  16:     const { clientId } = params;
  17: 
  18:     // Verifications d'acces - Seul le client peut acceder a ses donnees
  19:     if (user.role !== 'CLIENT' || user.clientId !== clientId) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     // Recuperer les informations du client
  24:     const client = await prisma.client.findUnique({
  25:       where: { id: clientId },
  26:       include: {
  27:         dossiers: {
  28:           select: {
  29:             id: true,
  30:             numero: true,
  31:             typeDossier: true,
  32:             statut: true,
  33:             priorite: true,
  34:             dateCreation: true,
  35:             dateEcheance: true,
  36:             description: true,
  37:           },
  38:           take: 1, // Un client n'a generalement qu'un dossier principal
  39:         },
  40:       },
  41:     });
  42: 
  43:     if (!client) {
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     // Recuperer les factures du client
  48:     const factures = await prisma.facture.findMany({
  49:       where: {
  50:         tenantId: client.tenantId,
  51:         clientName: `${client.firstName} ${client.lastName}`,
  52:       },
  53:       select: {
  54:         id: true,
  55:         montant: true,
  56:         statut: true,
  57:         dateEcheance: true,
  58:       },
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     // Calculer les statistiques des factures
  62:     const facturesStats = {
  63:       total: factures.length,
  64:       payees: factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'payee').length,
  65:       enAttente: factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'en_attente').length,
  66:       enRetard: factures.filter(f => {
  67:         return f.statut === 'en_attente' && new Date(f.dateEcheance) < new Date();
  68:       }).length,
  69:       prochaine: factures
  70:         .filter(f => f.statut === 'en_attente')
  71:         .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.dateEcheance).getTime() - new Date(b.dateEcheance).getTime())[0],
  72:     };
  73: 
  74:     // Recuperer les dernieres activites (simplifiees pour le client)
  75:     const dernieresActivites = await prisma.auditLog.findMany({
  76:       where: {
  77:         tenantId: client.tenantId,
  78:         objectType: 'Dossier',
  79:         objectId: client.dossiers[0]?.id,
  80:       },
  81:       select: {
  82:         id: true,
  83:         action: true,
  84:         timestamp: true,
  85:         objectType: true,
  86:       },
  87:       orderBy: { timestamp: 'desc' },
  88:       take: 5,
  89:     });
  90: 
  91:     return NextResponse.json({
  92:       monDossier: client.dossiers[0] || null,
  93:       mesFactures: facturesStats,
  94:       dernieresActivites: dernieresActivites.map(activity => ({
  95:         id: activity.id,
  96:         type: activity.objectType.toLowerCase(),
  97:         titre: `${activity.action} - ${activity.objectType}`,
  98:         date: activity.timestamp,
  99:       })),
 100:     });
 101:   } catch (error) {
 102:     logger.error('Erreur API client dashboard', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 103:       route: '/api/client/[clientId]/dashboard',
 104:     });
 105:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 106:   }
 107: }

src\app\api\client\ai-usage\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API pour que les clients voient leur propre usage IA
   3:  */
   4: 
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  10: 
  11: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const tenantId = session.user.tenantId;
  20:     if (!tenantId) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouvé' }, { status: 400 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     // Récupérer les paramètres de période
  25:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  26:     const month = parseInt(searchParams.get('month') || String(new Date().getMonth() + 1));
  27:     const year = parseInt(searchParams.get('year') || String(new Date().getFullYear()));
  28: 
  29:     const startDate = new Date(year, month - 1, 1);
  30:     const endDate = new Date(year, month, 0, 23, 59, 59);
  31: 
  32:     // Récupérer le plan du tenant pour connaître la limite
  33:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  34:       where: { id: tenantId },
  35:       include: { plan: true },
  36:     });
  37: 
  38:     const planName = tenant?.plan?.name || 'starter';
  39:     const budgetLimit = getBudgetLimit(planName);
  40: 
  41:     // Calculer l'usage du mois
  42:     let usage = { totalCost: 0, totalRequests: 0, totalTokens: 0 };
  43:     let dailyUsage: { date: string; cost: number; requests: number }[] = [];
  44:     const byModel: Record<string, { cost: number; requests: number }> = {};
  45: 
  46:     try {
  47:       // Agrégat total
  48:       const aggregate = await prisma.aIUsageLog.aggregate({
  49:         where: {
  50:           tenantId,
  51:           createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  52:         },
  53:         _sum: {
  54:           costEur: true,
  55:           tokensUsed: true,
  56:         },
  57:         _count: true,
  58:       });
  59: 
  60:       usage = {
  61:         totalCost: aggregate._sum.costEur || 0,
  62:         totalRequests: aggregate._count || 0,
  63:         totalTokens: aggregate._sum.tokensUsed || 0,
  64:       };
  65: 
  66:       // Usage par jour
  67:       const dailyData = await prisma.aIUsageLog.groupBy({
  68:         by: ['createdAt'],
  69:         where: {
  70:           tenantId,
  71:           createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  72:         },
  73:         _sum: { costEur: true },
  74:         _count: true,
  75:       });
  76: 
  77:       // Regrouper par date
  78:       const dailyMap = new Map<string, { cost: number; requests: number }>();
  79:       for (const d of dailyData) {
  80:         const dateStr = d.createdAt.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  81:         const existing = dailyMap.get(dateStr) || { cost: 0, requests: 0 };
  82:         dailyMap.set(dateStr, {
  83:           cost: existing.cost + (d._sum.costEur || 0),
  84:           requests: existing.requests + d._count,
  85:         });
  86:       }
  87:       dailyUsage = Array.from(dailyMap.entries())
  88:         .map(([date, data]) => ({ date, ...data }))
  89:         .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  90: 
  91:       // Usage par modèle
  92:       const modelData = await prisma.aIUsageLog.groupBy({
  93:         by: ['model'],
  94:         where: {
  95:           tenantId,
  96:           createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  97:         },
  98:         _sum: { costEur: true },
  99:         _count: true,
 100:       });
 101: 
 102:       for (const m of modelData) {
 103:         byModel[m.model] = {
 104:           cost: m._sum.costEur || 0,
 105:           requests: m._count,
 106:         };
 107:       }
 108:     } catch {
 109:       // Table n'existe peut-être pas encore
 110:       logger.debug('Tables AIUsageLog non disponibles', { route: '/api/client/ai-usage' });
 111:     }
 112: 
 113:     // Calculer les statistiques
 114:     const percentage = budgetLimit > 0 ? (usage.totalCost / budgetLimit) * 100 : 0;
 115:     const remaining = Math.max(0, budgetLimit - usage.totalCost);
 116: 
 117:     // Projection fin de mois
 118:     const today = new Date();
 119:     const dayOfMonth = today.getDate();
 120:     const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
 121:     const projectedCost =
 122:       dayOfMonth > 0 ? (usage.totalCost / dayOfMonth) * daysInMonth : usage.totalCost;
 123: 
 124:     // Déterminer le statut
 125:     let status: 'normal' | 'warning' | 'critical' | 'exceeded' = 'normal';
 126:     if (percentage >= 100) status = 'exceeded';
 127:     else if (percentage >= 90) status = 'critical';
 128:     else if (percentage >= 70) status = 'warning';
 129: 
 130:     // Générer des recommandations
 131:     const recommendations: string[] = [];
 132: 
 133:     if (status === 'exceeded' || status === 'critical') {
 134:       recommendations.push('🚨 Contactez le support pour augmenter votre limite IA');
 135:     }
 136: 
 137:     if (usage.totalCost > 0 && !byModel['ollama']) {
 138:       recommendations.push('💡 Installez Ollama sur votre serveur pour réduire les coûts à 0€');
 139:     }
 140: 
 141:     if (projectedCost > budgetLimit) {
 142:       recommendations.push(
 143:         `📊 Projection fin de mois: ${projectedCost.toFixed(2)}€ (dépasse la limite)`
 144:       );
 145:     }
 146: 
 147:     return NextResponse.json({
 148:       period: {
 149:         month,
 150:         year,
 151:         label: new Date(year, month - 1).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', {
 152:           month: 'long',
 153:           year: 'numeric',
 154:         }),
 155:       },
 156:       budget: {
 157:         limit: budgetLimit,
 158:         used: usage.totalCost,
 159:         remaining,
 160:         percentage: Math.round(percentage * 10) / 10,
 161:         status,
 162:       },
 163:       usage: {
 164:         totalCost: Math.round(usage.totalCost * 100) / 100,
 165:         totalRequests: usage.totalRequests,
 166:         totalTokens: usage.totalTokens,
 167:         avgCostPerRequest:
 168:           usage.totalRequests > 0
 169:             ? Math.round((usage.totalCost / usage.totalRequests) * 10000) / 10000
 170:             : 0,
 171:       },
 172:       projection: {
 173:         endOfMonth: Math.round(projectedCost * 100) / 100,
 174:         willExceed: projectedCost > budgetLimit,
 175:       },
 176:       breakdown: {
 177:         byModel,
 178:         daily: dailyUsage,
 179:       },
 180:       plan: {
 181:         name: tenant?.plan?.displayName || planName,
 182:         aiIncluded: `${budgetLimit}€/mois`,
 183:       },
 184:       recommendations,
 185:     });
 186:   } catch (error) {
 187:     logger.error('Erreur API client ai-usage', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 188:       route: '/api/client/ai-usage',
 189:     });
 190:     return NextResponse.json(
 191:       { error: "Erreur lors de la récupération de l'usage" },
 192:       { status: 500 }
 193:     );
 194:   }
 195: }
 196: 
 197: function getBudgetLimit(planName: string): number {
 198:   const limits: Record<string, number> = {
 199:     FREE: 0.5,
 200:     SOLO: 5,
 201:     CABINET: 30,
 202:     ENTERPRISE: 100,
 203:     starter: 0.5,
 204:     pro: 10,
 205:     enterprise: 50,
 206:     BASIC: 5,
 207:     PREMIUM: 30,
 208:   };
 209:   return limits[planName] || 5;
 210: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/client/demandes
   8:  * Creer une nouvelle demande (client cree un dossier pour lui-meme)
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  19:     const clientId = (session.user as any).clientId;
  20:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  21: 
  22:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     if (!clientId || !tenantId) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client ou tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     const body = await request.json();
  31:     const { typeDossier, objetDemande, priorite, dateEcheance, complementInfo } = body;
  32: 
  33:     // Generer le numero de dossier
  34:     const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  35:     const count = await prisma.dossier.count({
  36:       where: { tenantId },
  37:     });
  38:     const numero = `D-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`;
  39: 
  40:     // Mapper les priorites
  41:     const prioriteMap: Record<string, string> = {
  42:       NORMALE: 'normale',
  43:       HAUTE: 'haute',
  44:       URGENTE: 'haute',
  45:       CRITIQUE: 'critique',
  46:     };
  47: 
  48:     // Creer le dossier avec statut en_cours (demande client)
  49:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.create({
  50:       data: {
  51:         numero,
  52:         typeDossier,
  53:         objet: objetDemande,
  54:         priorite: prioriteMap[priorite || 'NORMALE'] || 'normale',
  55:         statut: 'en_cours', // Les clients creent directement en_cours
  56:         dateEcheance: dateEcheance ? new Date(dateEcheance) : undefined,
  57:         notes: complementInfo || '',
  58:         tenantId,
  59:         clientId,
  60:         dateCreation: new Date(),
  61:       },
  62:       include: {
  63:         client: {
  64:           select: {
  65:             firstName: true,
  66:             lastName: true,
  67:             email: true,
  68:           },
  69:         },
  70:       },
  71:     });
  72: 
  73:     // Envoyer notification a l'avocat
  74:     try {
  75:       // Trouver les avocats du tenant
  76:       const avocats = await prisma.user.findMany({
  77:         where: { tenantId, role: { in: ['AVOCAT', 'ADMIN'] } },
  78:         select: { id: true, email: true },
  79:       });
  80: 
  81:       // Créer notifications pour chaque avocat
  82:       for (const avocat of avocats) {
  83:         await prisma.notification.create({
  84:           data: {
  85:             userId: avocat.id,
  86:             title: 'Nouvelle demande client',
  87:             message: `Nouvelle demande de ${dossier.client?.firstName} ${dossier.client?.lastName}`,
  88:             type: 'info',
  89:             read: false,
  90:           },
  91:         });
  92:       }
  93:     } catch (notifError) {
  94:       logger.warn('Erreur envoi notification avocat', { error: notifError });
  95:     }
  96: 
  97:     return NextResponse.json(
  98:       {
  99:         dossier: {
 100:           ...dossier,
 101:           message: 'Votre demande a ete transmise a votre avocat',
 102:         },
 103:       },
 104:       { status: 201 }
 105:     );
 106:   } catch (error) {
 107:     logger.error('Erreur création demande client', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 108:       route: '/api/client/demandes',
 109:     });
 110:     return NextResponse.json(
 111:       { error: 'Erreur serveur', details: (error as Error).message },
 112:       { status: 500 }
 113:     );
 114:   }
 115: }

  59:         'Content-Length': document.size.toString(),
  60:       },
  61:     });
  62:   } catch (error) {

  64:     return NextResponse.json(

  66:       { status: 500 }
  67:     );
  68:   }

  21: function sanitizeFileName(fileName: string): string {
  22:   return fileName
  23:     .replace(/[\\/]/g, '_')
  24:     .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._()\- ]/g, '_')
  25:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  26:     .trim()
  27:     .slice(0, 255);

  30: function matchesDeclaredType(buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string): boolean {
  31:   if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') {
  32:     return buffer.subarray(0, 4).equals(Buffer.from('%PDF'));
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   if (mimeType === 'image/jpeg') {
  36:     return buffer.subarray(0, 3).equals(Buffer.from([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff]));
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   return (
  40:     buffer.length >= 8 &&
  41:     buffer.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]))
  42:   );
  43: }

  45: function rateLimitHeaders(
  46:   response: NextResponse,
  47:   rateInfo: { limit: number; remaining: number; reset: Date }
  48: ) {
  49:   response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Limit', String(rateInfo.limit));
  50:   response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Remaining', String(rateInfo.remaining));
  51:   response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Reset', rateInfo.reset.toISOString());
  52:   return response;

  57:

 175:       prisma.document.create({

 177:           id: documentId,
 178:           tenantId,
 179:           clientId,

src\app\api\client\dossiers\[id]\checklist\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * GET /api/client/dossiers/[id]/checklist
   8:  * Vue client : progression de son dossier (pieces fournies/manquantes)
   9:  */
  10: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const { id } = await params;
  15:   const user = session.user as any;
  16: 
  17:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  18:     where: { id, clientId: user.clientId || undefined },
  19:     select: {
  20:       id: true,
  21:       numero: true,
  22:       typeDossier: true,
  23:       inboxEmail: true,
  24:       checklistComplete: true,
  25:       checklistTotal: true,
  26:       checklistReceived: true,
  27:       checklistItems: {
  28:         orderBy: { order: 'asc' },
  29:         select: {
  30:           id: true,
  31:           label: true,
  32:           category: true,
  33:           required: true,
  34:           status: true,
  35:           receivedAt: true,
  36:           order: true,
  37:         },
  38:       },
  39:     },
  40:   });
  41: 
  42:   if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  43: 
  44:   const missing = dossier.checklistItems.filter(i => i.status === 'missing' && i.required);
  45:   const received = dossier.checklistItems.filter(i => i.status === 'received' || i.status === 'validated');
  46: 
  47:   return NextResponse.json({
  48:     numero: dossier.numero,
  49:     type: dossier.typeDossier,
  50:     inboxEmail: dossier.inboxEmail,
  51:     complete: dossier.checklistComplete,
  52:     progress: {
  53:       percentage: dossier.checklistTotal > 0
  54:         ? Math.round((dossier.checklistReceived / dossier.checklistTotal) * 100)
  55:         : 0,
  56:       received: dossier.checklistReceived,
  57:       total: dossier.checklistTotal,
  58:     },
  59:     items: dossier.checklistItems,
  60:     missing: missing.map(i => i.label),
  61:     message: dossier.checklistComplete
  62:       ? 'Votre dossier est complet. Votre avocat va le traiter.'
  63:       : `Il manque ${missing.length} piece(s) obligatoire(s). Envoyez-les a ${dossier.inboxEmail}`,
  64:   });
  65: }

src\app\api\client\dossiers\[id]\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(
   7:   request: NextRequest,
   8:   { params }: { params: { id: string } }
   9: ) {
  10:   try {
  11:     const session = await getServerSession();
  12:     
  13:     if (!session?.user) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  18:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  19: 
  20:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const dossierId = params.id;
  25: 
  26:     // Recuperer le dossier avec ses relations
  27:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  28:       where: {
  29:         id: dossierId,
  30:         clientId: (session.user as any).clientId, // Securite: le client ne peut voir que ses propres dossiers
  31:       },
  32:       include: {
  33:         documents: {
  34:           orderBy: {
  35:             createdAt: 'desc',
  36:           },
  37:         },
  38:         echeances: {
  39:           orderBy: {
  40:             dateEcheance: 'asc',
  41:           },
  42:         },
  43:         client: {
  44:           select: {
  45:             firstName: true,
  46:             lastName: true,
  47:             email: true,
  48:           },
  49:         },
  50:       },
  51:     });
  52: 
  53:     if (!dossier) {
  54:       return NextResponse.json(
  55:         { error: 'Dossier non trouve ou acces refuse' },
  56:         { status: 404 }
  57:       );
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     logger.info(`Client ${userId} a consulte le dossier ${dossierId}`);
  61: 
  62:     return NextResponse.json(dossier);
  63:   } catch (error) {
  64:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation details dossier client', { error });
  65:     return NextResponse.json(
  66:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  67:       { status: 500 }
  68:     );
  69:   }
  70: }

src\app\api\client\dossiers\[id]\upload\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/client/dossiers/[id]/upload
   8:  * Permet au client d'uploader une piece directement.
   9:  * Met a jour la checklist automatiquement.
  10:  */
  11: export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const { id } = await params;
  16:   const user = session.user as any;
  17: 
  18:   if (!user.clientId) {
  19:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  20:   }
  21: 
  22:   const formData = await req.formData();
  23:   const file = formData.get('file') as File;
  24:   const checklistItemId = formData.get('checklistItemId') as string;
  25: 
  26:   if (!file) {
  27:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier requis' }, { status: 400 });
  28:   }
  29: 
  30:   // Verifier que le dossier appartient au client
  31:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  32:     where: { id, clientId: user.clientId },
  33:   });
  34: 
  35:   if (!dossier) {
  36:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   // Si un item de checklist est specifie, le marquer comme recu
  40:   if (checklistItemId) {
  41:     // Verifier que l'item de checklist appartient bien a ce dossier (anti-IDOR)
  42:     const checklistItem = await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.findFirst({
  43:       where: { id: checklistItemId, dossierId: id },
  44:     });
  45:     if (!checklistItem) {
  46:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Piece de checklist non trouvee pour ce dossier' }, { status: 404 });
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.update({
  50:       where: { id: checklistItemId },
  51:       data: {
  52:         status: 'received',
  53:         receivedAt: new Date(),
  54:         receivedVia: 'upload_client',
  55:         notes: `Fichier: ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`,
  56:       },
  57:     });
  58: 
  59:     // Recalculer progression
  60:     const allItems = await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.findMany({ where: { dossierId: id } });
  61:     const received = allItems.filter(i => i.status === 'received' || i.status === 'validated').length;
  62:     const requiredItems = allItems.filter(i => i.required);
  63:     const requiredReceived = requiredItems.filter(i => i.status === 'received' || i.status === 'validated').length;
  64:     const complete = requiredReceived === requiredItems.length;
  65: 
  66:     await prisma.dossier.update({
  67:       where: { id },
  68:       data: { checklistReceived: received, checklistComplete: complete },
  69:     });
  70: 
  71:     return NextResponse.json({
  72:       success: true,
  73:       fileName: file.name,
  74:       checklistItem: checklistItemId,
  75:       progress: `${received}/${allItems.length}`,
  76:       complete,
  77:       message: complete ? 'Dossier COMPLET ! Votre avocat va le traiter.' : `Piece recue (${received}/${allItems.length})`,
  78:     });
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   return NextResponse.json({
  82:     success: true,
  83:     fileName: file.name,
  84:     size: `${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`,
  85:     message: 'Document uploade avec succes',
  86:   });
  87: }

src\app\api\client\dossiers\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   try {
   8:     const session = await getServerSession();
   9:     
  10:     if (!session?.user) {
  11:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  12:     }
  13: 
  14:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  15:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  16: 
  17:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const body = await request.json();
  22:     const {
  23:       typeDossier,
  24:       objet,
  25:       description,
  26:       priorite,
  27:       dateEcheance,
  28:       articleCeseda,
  29:     } = body;
  30: 
  31:     if (!typeDossier || !objet) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json(
  33:         { error: 'Type de dossier et objet requis' },
  34:         { status: 400 }
  35:       );
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Recuperer le client et son tenant
  39:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  40:       where: { id: userId },
  41:       select: { tenantId: true, clientId: true },
  42:     });
  43: 
  44:     if (!user?.tenantId || !user.clientId) {
  45:       return NextResponse.json(
  46:         { error: 'Client non associe correctement' },
  47:         { status: 400 }
  48:       );
  49:     }
  50: 
  51:     // Generer un numero de dossier
  52:     const year = new Date().getFullYear();
  53:     const count = await prisma.dossier.count({
  54:       where: { tenantId: user.tenantId },
  55:     });
  56:     const numero = `D-${year}-${String(count + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  57: 
  58:     // Creer le dossier
  59:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.create({
  60:       data: {
  61:         numero,
  62:         typeDossier,
  63:         objet,
  64:         description: description || undefined,
  65:         priorite: priorite || 'normale',
  66:         statut: 'en_cours',
  67:         dateEcheance: dateEcheance ? new Date(dateEcheance) : undefined,
  68:         articleCeseda: articleCeseda || undefined,
  69:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  70:         clientId: user.clientId,
  71:       },
  72:     });
  73: 
  74:     logger.info(`Client ${userId} a cree le dossier ${dossier.numero}`);
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json({
  77:       success: true,
  78:       dossier: {
  79:         id: dossier.id,
  80:         numero: dossier.numero,
  81:       },
  82:     });
  83:   } catch (error) {
  84:     logger.error('Erreur creation dossier client', { error });
  85:     return NextResponse.json(
  86:       { error: 'Erreur serveur lors de la creation' },
  87:       { status: 500 }
  88:     );
  89:   }
  90: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: // GET: Recuperer les messages
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession();
  10:     
  11:     if (!session?.user) {
  12:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  13:     }
  14: 
  15:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  16:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  17: 
  18:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     // Recuperer les messages du client
  23:     const messages = await prisma.message.findMany({
  24:       where: {
  25:         OR: [
  26:           { senderId: userId },
  27:           { recipientId: userId },
  28:         ],
  29:       },
  30:       orderBy: {
  31:         createdAt: 'asc',
  32:       },
  33:       include: {
  34:         sender: {
  35:           select: {
  36:             name: true,
  37:             role: true,
  38:           },
  39:         },
  40:       },
  41:     });
  42: 
  43:     const formattedMessages = messages.map((msg: any) => ({
  44:       id: msg.id,
  45:       content: msg.content,
  46:       senderId: msg.senderId,
  47:       senderName: msg.sender.name,
  48:       senderRole: msg.sender.role,
  49:       createdAt: msg.createdAt,
  50:       read: msg.isRead,
  51:     }));
  52: 
  53:     return NextResponse.json({ messages: formattedMessages });
  54:   } catch (error) {
  55:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation messages client', { error });
  56:     return NextResponse.json(
  57:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  58:       { status: 500 }
  59:     );
  60:   }
  61: }
  62: 
  63: // POST: Envoyer un message
  64: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  65:   try {
  66:     const session = await getServerSession();
  67:     
  68:     if (!session?.user) {
  69:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  70:     }
  71: 
  72:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  73:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  74: 
  75:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  76:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  77:     }
  78: 
  79:     const body = await request.json();
  80:     const { content } = body;
  81: 
  82:     if (!content || content.trim() === '') {
  83:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Le message ne peut pas etre vide' }, { status: 400 });
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     // Trouver l'avocat du client (premier ADMIN du tenant)
  87:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  88:       where: { id: userId },
  89:       select: { tenantId: true },
  90:     });
  91: 
  92:     if (!user?.tenantId) {
  93:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non associe a un tenant' }, { status: 400 });
  94:     }
  95: 
  96:     const avocat = await prisma.user.findFirst({
  97:       where: {
  98:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  99:         role: 'ADMIN',
 100:       },
 101:     });
 102: 
 103:     if (!avocat) {
 104:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Aucun avocat trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 105:     }
 106: 
 107:     // Creer le message
 108:     const message = await prisma.message.create({
 109:       data: {
 110:         subject: 'Message client',
 111:         content: content.trim(),
 112:         senderId: userId,
 113:         recipientId: avocat.id,
 114:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
 115:         isRead: false,
 116:       },
 117:       include: {
 118:         sender: {
 119:           select: {
 120:             name: true,
 121:             role: true,
 122:           },
 123:         },
 124:       },
 125:     });
 126: 
 127:     logger.info(`Client ${userId} a envoye un message a ${avocat.id}`);
 128: 
 129:     return NextResponse.json({
 130:       success: true,
 131:       message: {
 132:         id: message.id,
 133:         content: message.content,
 134:         senderId: message.senderId,
 135:         senderName: message.sender.name,
 136:         senderRole: message.sender.role,
 137:         createdAt: message.createdAt,
 138:         read: message.isRead,
 139:       },
 140:     });
 141:   } catch (error) {
 142:     logger.error('Erreur envoi message client', { error });
 143:     return NextResponse.json(
 144:       { error: 'Erreur serveur lors de l\'envoi' },
 145:       { status: 500 }
 146:     );
 147:   }
 148: }

src\app\api\client\my-factures\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';

   8:     const session = await getServerSession();

  15:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  16: 
  17:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {

  44:       },

src\app\api\client\profil\password\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
   6: 
   7: export async function PUT(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession();
  10:     
  11:     if (!session?.user) {
  12:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  13:     }
  14: 
  15:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  16:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  17: 
  18:     if (userRole !== 'CLIENT') {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces reserve aux clients' }, { status: 403 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     const body = await request.json();
  23:     const { currentPassword, newPassword } = body;
  24: 
  25:     if (!currentPassword || !newPassword) {
  26:       return NextResponse.json(
  27:         { error: 'Mot de passe actuel et nouveau mot de passe requis' },
  28:         { status: 400 }
  29:       );
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     if (newPassword.length < 8) {
  33:       return NextResponse.json(
  34:         { error: 'Le nouveau mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caracteres' },
  35:         { status: 400 }
  36:       );
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     // Recuperer l'utilisateur
  40:     const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  41:       where: { id: userId },
  42:     });
  43: 
  44:     if (!user) {
  45:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     // Verifier le mot de passe actuel
  49:     const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(currentPassword, user.password);
  50: 
  51:     if (!isPasswordValid) {
  52:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
  53:     }
  54: 
  55:     // Hasher le nouveau mot de passe
  56:     const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 12);
  57: 
  58:     // Mettre a jour le mot de passe
  59:     await prisma.user.update({
  60:       where: { id: userId },
  61:       data: { password: hashedPassword },
  62:     });
  63: 
  64:     logger.info(`Client ${userId} a modifie son mot de passe`);
  65: 
  66:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Mot de passe modifie avec succes' });
  67:   } catch (error) {
  68:     logger.error('Erreur modification mot de passe client', { error });
  69:     return NextResponse.json(
  70:       { error: 'Erreur serveur lors de la modification' },
  71:       { status: 500 }
  72:     );
  73:   }
  74: }

  15: // â”€â”€â”€ POST : Partager un document â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
