  17: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  18:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  19:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  20: 
  21:   const user = session.user as any;
  22:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  23:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase();
  24: 
  25:   // Seuls AVOCAT, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN, COLLABORATEUR peuvent partager
  26:   if (!['AVOCAT', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'COLLABORATEUR', 'ASSOCIE'].includes(role)) {
  27:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seuls les avocats peuvent partager des documents' }, { status: 403 });
  28:   }
  29: 
  30:   let body: any;
  31:   try {
  32:     body = await req.json();
  33:   } catch {
  34:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   const { documentId, dossierId, clientUserId, title, message, requiresAcknowledgment, requiresSignature, expiresAt, confidentialityLevel } = body;
  38: 
  39:   if (!dossierId || !clientUserId || !title) {
  40:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'dossierId, clientUserId et title requis' }, { status: 400 });
  41:   }
  42: 
  43:   try {
  44:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({ where: { id: dossierId, tenantId } });
  45:     if (!dossier) {
  46:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve dans ce cabinet' }, { status: 404 });
  47:     }
  48:     const targetClient = await prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { id: clientUserId, tenantId } });
  49:     if (!targetClient) {
  50:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouve dans ce cabinet' }, { status: 404 });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     const share = await clientShareService.shareDocument({
  54:       tenantId,
  55:       documentId,
  56:       dossierId,
  57:       clientUserId,
  58:       sharedByUserId: user.id,
  59:       title,
  60:       message,
  61:       requiresAcknowledgment: requiresAcknowledgment ?? false,
  62:       requiresSignature: requiresSignature ?? false,
  63:       expiresAt: expiresAt ? new Date(expiresAt) : undefined,
  64:       confidentialityLevel: confidentialityLevel || 'standard',
  65:     });
  66: 
  67:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, share }, { status: 201 });
  68:   } catch (err: any) {
  69:     return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  70:   }
  71: }

  78: 
  79:   const user = session.user as any;

  82:

  88:       // Vue client : ses propres partages

  90:       return NextResponse.json({ shares });
  91:     } else {
  92:       // Vue avocat : partages d'un dossier

  94:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'dossierId requis pour la vue avocat' }, { status: 400 });
  95:       }
  96:       const shares = await clientShareService.listByDossier(tenantId, dossierId);
  97:       return NextResponse.json({ shares });
  98:     }
  99:   } catch (err: any) {
 100:     return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
 101:   }

 104: // â”€â”€â”€ PATCH : Actions sur un partage â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 105: 
 106: export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
 107:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 108:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
 109: 
 110:   const user = session.user as any;
 111:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase();
 112:   const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || 'unknown';
 113:   const userAgent = req.headers.get('user-agent') || 'unknown';
 114: 
 115:   let body: any;
 116:   try {
 117:     body = await req.json();
 118:   } catch {
 119:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
 120:   }
 121: 
 122:   const { shareId, action } = body;
 123:   if (!shareId || !action) {
 124:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'shareId et action requis' }, { status: 400 });
 125:   }
 126: 
 127:   try {
 128:     switch (action) {
 129:       case 'view': {
 130:         // Client consulte le document
 131:         await clientShareService.recordView({
 132:           shareId,
 133:           viewedAt: new Date(),
 134:           ipAddress: ip,
 135:           userAgent,
 136:           clientUserId: user.id,
 137:         });
 138:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'viewed' });
 139:       }
 140: 
 141:       case 'acknowledge': {
 142:         // Client accuse rÃ©ception
 143:         if (role !== 'CLIENT') {
 144:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seul le client peut accuser rÃ©ception' }, { status: 403 });
 145:         }
 146:         await clientShareService.acknowledge(shareId, user.id, ip);
 147:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'acknowledged' });
 148:       }
 149: 
 150:       case 'sign': {
 151:         // Client signe
 152:         if (role !== 'CLIENT') {
 153:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seul le client peut signer' }, { status: 403 });
 154:         }
 155:         const { consentText } = body;
 156:         if (!consentText) {
 157:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'consentText requis pour signer' }, { status: 400 });
 158:         }
 159:         const signatureHash = await clientShareService.sign(shareId, {
 160:           shareId,
 161:           signedAt: new Date(),
 162:           signedByUserId: user.id,
 163:           signedByName: user.name || '',
 164:           signedByEmail: user.email || '',
 165:           ipAddress: ip,
 166:           userAgent,
 167:           consentText,
 168:         });
 169:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'signed', signatureHash });
 170:       }
 171: 
 172:       case 'revoke': {
 173:         // Avocat rÃ©voque le partage
 174:         if (role === 'CLIENT') {
 175:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seul l\'avocat peut rÃ©voquer' }, { status: 403 });
 176:         }
 177:         const { reason } = body;
 178:         await clientShareService.revoke(shareId, user.id, reason || 'RÃ©voquÃ© par l\'avocat');
 179:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'revoked' });
 180:       }
 181: 
 182:       case 'export_proof': {
 183:         // Avocat exporte le bundle de preuve
 184:         if (role === 'CLIENT') {
 185:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Export rÃ©servÃ© aux avocats' }, { status: 403 });
 186:         }
 187:         const bundle = await clientShareService.exportProofBundle(shareId, user.tenantId);
 188:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, proof: bundle });
 189:       }
 190: 
 191:       default:
 192:         return NextResponse.json({ error: `Action inconnue: ${action}` }, { status: 400 });
 193:     }
 194:   } catch (err: any) {
 195:     return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 400 });
 196:   }
 197: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { cacheThrough, cacheDelete, TTL_TIERS } from '@/lib/cache';
   4: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';

   8: interface RouteParams {
   9:   params: Promise<{ id: string }>;

  11: 
  12: async function resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null): Promise<
  13:   | { tenantId: string; role: string }
  14:   | { error: NextResponse }
  15: > {
  16:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:   if (!session?.user) {
  18:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 }) };
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  22:   const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  23: 
  24:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  25:     if (!requestedTenantId) {
  26:       return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 }) };
  27:     }
  28:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, role };
  29:   }
  30: 
  31:   if (!sessionTenantId) {
  32:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 }) };
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  36:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   return { tenantId: sessionTenantId, role };
  40: }
  41: 
  42: /**
  43:  * GET /api/clients/[id]
  44:  * RÃ©cupÃ¨re un client spÃ©cifique par son ID avec ses dossiers et factures
  45:  */
  46: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {
  47:   try {
  48:     const { id: clientId } = await params;
  49:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  50:     const requestedTenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  51:     const includeDossiers = searchParams.get('includeDossiers') !== 'false';
  52:     const includeFactures = searchParams.get('includeFactures') !== 'false';
  53: 
  54:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  55:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
  56:     const { tenantId } = access;
  57: 
  58:     const cacheKey = `client:${tenantId}:${clientId}:full`;
  59: 
  60:     const client = await cacheThrough(
  61:       cacheKey,
  62:       async () => {
  63:         return prisma.client.findFirst({
  64:           where: { id: clientId, tenantId },
  65:           include: {
  66:             dossiers: includeDossiers
  67:               ? {
  68:                   orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  69:                   take: 20,
  70:                   select: {
  71:                     id: true,
  72:                     numero: true,
  73:                     titre: true,
  74:                     type: true,
  75:                     status: true,
  76:                     priorite: true,
  77:                     createdAt: true,
  78:                     updatedAt: true,
  79:                   },
  80:                 }
  81:               : false,
  82:             factures: includeFactures
  83:               ? {
  84:                   orderBy: { dateEmission: 'desc' },
  85:                   take: 20,
  86:                   select: {
  87:                     id: true,
  88:                     numero: true,
  89:                     montantHT: true,
  90:                     montantTTC: true,
  91:                     statut: true,
  92:                     dateEmission: true,
  93:                     dateEcheance: true,
  94:                   },
  95:                 }
  96:               : false,
  97:             _count: {
  98:               select: {
  99:                 dossiers: true,
 100:                 factures: true,
 101:                 documents: true,
 102:                 evenements: true,
 103:               },
 104:             },
 105:           },
 106:         });
 107:       },
 108:       'WARM'
 109:     );
 110: 
 111:     if (!client) {
 112:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     // Calculer les statistiques
 116:     const stats = {
 117:       totalDossiers: client._count.dossiers,
 118:       totalFactures: client._count.factures,
 119:       totalDocuments: client._count.documents,
 120:     };
 121: 
 122:     return NextResponse.json({ client, stats });
 123:   } catch (error) {
 124:     logger.error('Erreur GET client', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 125:       route: '/api/clients/[id]',
 126:     });
 127:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 128:   }
 129: }

 131: /**

  12: function mapPrismaErrorToHttp(error: unknown): { status: number; message: string } | null {
  13:   const code =
  14:     typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error
  15:       ? (error as { code?: unknown }).code
  16:       : null;
  17: 
  18:   if (code === 'P2002') {
  19:       return { status: 409, message: 'Conflit de donnees' };
  20:   }
  21:   if (code === 'P2025') {
  22:       return { status: 404, message: 'Ressource non trouvee' };
  23:   }
  24: 
  25:   return null;
  26: }
  27: 
  28: async function resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null): Promise<
  29:   | { tenantId: string; role: string }
  30:   | { error: NextResponse }
  31: > {
  32:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  33:   if (!session?.user) {
  34:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 }) };
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  38:   const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  39: 
  40:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  41:     if (!requestedTenantId) {
  42:       return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 }) };
  43:     }
  44:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, role };
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   if (!sessionTenantId) {
  48:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 }) };
  49:   }
  50: 
  51:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  52:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  53:   }
  54: 
  55:   return { tenantId: sessionTenantId, role };
  56: }

  58: // GET - Liste des clients d'un tenant
  59: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  60:   try {
  61:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  62:     const requestedTenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  63:     const clientId = searchParams.get('id');
  64:     const search = searchParams.get('search');
  65:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  66:     const limit = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '100', 10) || 100);
  67:     const offset = Math.max(0, parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10) || 0);
  68: 
  69:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  70:     if ('error' in access) {
  71:       return access.error;
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     const tenantId = access.tenantId;
  75: 
  76:     // Recuperer un client specifique (avec cache)
  77:     if (clientId) {
  78:       const client = await cacheThrough(
  79:         `client:${tenantId}:${clientId}`,
  80:         async () => {
  81:           return prisma.client.findFirst({
  82:             where: { id: clientId, tenantId },
  83:             include: {
  84:               dossiers: true,
  85:               emails: { take: 10, orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' } },
  86:               factures: { take: 10, orderBy: { dateEmission: 'desc' } },
  87:               _count: { select: { dossiers: true, emails: true, factures: true } },
  88:             },
  89:           });
  90:         },
  91:         'WARM'
  92:       );
  93: 
  94:       if (!client) {
  95:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  96:       }
  97:       return NextResponse.json({ client });
  98:     }
  99: 
 100:     // Liste avec cache (seulement si pas de recherche)
 101:     const cacheKey = search ? null : `clients:${tenantId}:${status || 'all'}:${limit}:${offset}`;
 102: 
 103:     const fetchClients = async () => {
 104:       const where: Record<string, unknown> = search
 105:         ? {
 106:             AND: [
 107:               { tenantId },
 108:               ...(status ? [{ status }] : []),
 109:               {
 110:                 OR: [
 111:                   { firstName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 112:                   { lastName: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 113:                   { email: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 114:                 ],
 115:               },
 116:             ],
 117:           }
 118:         : { tenantId, ...(status && { status }) };
 119: 
 120:       const [clients, total] = await Promise.all([
 121:         prisma.client.findMany({
 122:           where,
 123:           include: {
 124:             _count: { select: { dossiers: true } },
 125:           },
 126:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 127:           take: limit,
 128:           skip: offset,
 129:         }),
 130:         prisma.client.count({ where }),
 131:       ]);
 132: 
 133:       return { clients, total, hasMore: offset + clients.length < total };
 134:     };
 135: 
 136:     const result = cacheKey
 137:       ? await cacheThrough(cacheKey, fetchClients, 'HOT')
 138:       : await fetchClients();
 139: 
 140:     return NextResponse.json(result);
 141:   } catch (error) {
 142:     logger.error('Erreur GET clients', formatErrorForLogging(error), {
 143:       route: '/api/clients',
 144:     });
 145:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 146:   }
 147: }

 149: // POST - Creer un nouveau client
 150: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
 151:   try {
 152:     // Validate request body with Zod
 153:     const validation = await parseAndValidate<CreateClientInput>(request, createClientSchema);
 154:     if (!validation.valid) {
 155:       return validation.response;
 156:     }
 157: 
 158:     const {
 159:       tenantId,
 160:       firstName,
 161:       lastName,
 162:       email,
 163:       phone,
 164:       address,
 165:       codePostal,
 166:       ville,
 167:       dateOfBirth,
 168:       nationality,
 169:       civilite,
 170:     } = validation.data;
 171: 
 172:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess((tenantId as string | null) || null);
 173:     if ('error' in access) {
 174:       return access.error;
 175:     }
 176:     const effectiveTenantId = access.tenantId;
 177: 
 178:     // Verifier si le client existe deja
 179:     const existing = await prisma.client.findUnique({
 180:       where: { tenantId_email: { tenantId: effectiveTenantId, email } },
 181:     });
 182: 
 183:     if (existing) {
 184:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Un client avec cet email existe deja' }, { status: 409 });
 185:     }
 186: 
 187:     const parsedDate =
 188:       typeof dateOfBirth === 'string' && dateOfBirth.trim().length > 0
 189:         ? new Date(dateOfBirth)
 190:         : null;
 191:     if (parsedDate && isNaN(parsedDate.getTime())) {
 192:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Format dateOfBirth invalide' }, { status: 400 });
 193:     }
 194: 
 195:     const client = await prisma.$transaction(
 196:       async (tx) => {
 197:         const created = await tx.client.create({
 198:           data: {
 199:             tenantId: effectiveTenantId,
 200:             firstName,
 201:             lastName,
 202:             email,
 203:             phone,
 204:             address,
 205:             codePostal,
 206:             ville,
 207:             dateOfBirth: parsedDate,
 208:             nationality,
 209:             civilite,
 210:           },
 211:         });
 212: 
 213:         await tx.tenant.update({
 214:           where: { id: effectiveTenantId },
 215:           data: { currentClients: { increment: 1 } },
 216:         });
 217: 
 218:         return created;
 219:       },
 220:       { timeout: 30000 }
 221:     );
 222: 
 223:     // Invalider le cache des listes clients
 224:     await cacheInvalidatePattern(`clients:${effectiveTenantId}:*`);
 225: 
 226:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, client });
 227:   } catch (error) {
 228:     const mapped = mapPrismaErrorToHttp(error);
 229:     if (mapped) {
 230:       return NextResponse.json({ error: mapped.message }, { status: mapped.status });
 231:     }
 232: 
 233:     logger.error('Erreur POST client', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 234:       route: '/api/clients',
 235:     });
 236:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 237:   }
 238: }

   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/community-templates/[id]/vote
   8:  * Vote +1 ou -1 sur un template. Un seul vote par utilisateur.
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) {
  13:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  14:   }
  15: 
  16:   const { id } = await params;
  17:   const user = session.user as any;
  18:   const { vote } = await req.json();
  19: 
  20:   if (vote !== 1 && vote !== -1) {
  21:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Vote doit Ãªtre 1 ou -1' }, { status: 400 });
  22:   }
  23: 
  24:   const template = await prisma.communityTemplate.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  25:   if (!template) {
  26:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Template non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   // Upsert le vote
  30:   const existing = await prisma.templateVote.findUnique({
  31:     where: { templateId_userId: { templateId: id, userId: user.id } },
  32:   });
  33: 
  34:   if (existing) {
  35:     if (existing.vote === vote) {
  36:       // Annuler le vote
  37:       await prisma.templateVote.delete({ where: { id: existing.id } });
  38:       await prisma.communityTemplate.update({
  39:         where: { id },
  40:         data: vote === 1 ? { upvotes: { decrement: 1 } } : { downvotes: { decrement: 1 } },
  41:       });
  42:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'removed' });
  43:     }
  44:     // Changer le vote
  45:     await prisma.templateVote.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data: { vote } });
  46:     await prisma.communityTemplate.update({
  47:       where: { id },
  48:       data: vote === 1
  49:         ? { upvotes: { increment: 1 }, downvotes: { decrement: 1 } }
  50:         : { upvotes: { decrement: 1 }, downvotes: { increment: 1 } },
  51:     });
  52:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'changed' });
  53:   }
  54: 
  55:   // Nouveau vote
  56:   await prisma.templateVote.create({ data: { templateId: id, userId: user.id, vote } });
  57:   await prisma.communityTemplate.update({
  58:     where: { id },
  59:     data: vote === 1 ? { upvotes: { increment: 1 } } : { downvotes: { increment: 1 } },
  60:   });
  61: 
  62:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: 'voted' });
  63: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

   5: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   6:     try {
   7:         const session = await getServerSession();
   8:         const { consents } = await req.json();
   9: 
  10:         if (!consents || !Array.isArray(consents)) {
  11:             return NextResponse.json(
  12:                 { error: 'Invalid consent data' },
  13:                 { status: 400 }
  14:             );
  15:         }
  16: 
  17:         // Get user info
  18:         const userId = session?.user?.email || 'anonymous';
  19:         const ipAddress = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') ||
  20:             req.headers.get('x-real-ip') ||
  21:             'unknown';
  22:         const userAgent = req.headers.get('user-agent') || 'unknown';
  23: 
  24:         // Record each consent
  25:         for (const consent of consents) {
  26:             if (session?.user?.email) {
  27:                 await GDPRCompliance.recordConsent(userId, {
  28:                     type: consent.type,
  29:                     granted: consent.granted,
  30:                     ipAddress,
  31:                     userAgent,
  32:                     version: '1.0.0' // Privacy policy version
  33:                 });
  34:             }
  35:         }
  36: 
  37:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  38:     } catch (error: any) {
  39:         console.error('Error recording consent:', error);
  40:         return NextResponse.json(
  41:             { error: error.message || 'Internal server error' },
  42:             { status: 500 }
  43:         );
  44:     }
  45: }

   1: /**

  30:       CARPAService.getResumeParClient(user.tenantId),

  32:       CARPAService.getAlertesProvisionsDormantes(user.tenantId),
  33:     ]);
  34: 
  35:     return NextResponse.json({ soldeGlobal, resume, alertes });
  36:   } catch (error) {

  38:       { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erreur serveur' },

  40:     );

  47: 
  48:   const user = session.user as any;
  49: 
  50:   try {
  51:     const body = await req.json();
  52: 
  53:     if (!body.dossierId || !body.clientId || !body.type || !body.montant || !body.libelle) {
  54:       return NextResponse.json(

  56:         { status: 400 }
  57:       );
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     const mouvement = await CARPAService.enregistrerMouvement({
  61:       tenantId: user.tenantId,

src\app\api\conflicts\check\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/conflicts/check
   8:  * Verifie s'il existe un conflit d'interets avec un nouveau client/dossier.
   9:  * Compare le nom, email, parties adverses dans les dossiers existants.
  10:  */
  11: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const user = session.user as any;
  16:   const { clientName, clientEmail, partieAdverse, reference } = await req.json();
  17: 
  18:   if (!clientName && !clientEmail) {
  19:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'clientName ou clientEmail requis' }, { status: 400 });
  20:   }
  21: 
  22:   const conflicts: any[] = [];
  23: 
  24:   // Chercher si le client est deja partie adverse dans un autre dossier
  25:   if (clientName) {
  26:     const asAdverse = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  27:       where: {
  28:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  29:         description: { contains: clientName, mode: 'insensitive' },
  30:       },
  31:       select: { id: true, numero: true, objet: true, client: { select: { nom: true } } },
  32:     });
  33: 
  34:     for (const d of asAdverse) {
  35:       if (d.client?.nom?.toLowerCase() !== clientName.toLowerCase()) {
  36:         conflicts.push({
  37:           type: 'partie_adverse',
  38:           severity: 'high',
  39:           dossierId: d.id,
  40:           numero: d.numero,
  41:           message: `"${clientName}" apparait dans le dossier ${d.numero} (client: ${d.client?.nom})`,
  42:         });
  43:       }
  44:     }
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   // Chercher si la partie adverse est un client existant
  48:   if (partieAdverse) {
  49:     const existingClient = await prisma.client.findFirst({
  50:       where: {
  51:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  52:         nom: { contains: partieAdverse, mode: 'insensitive' },
  53:       },
  54:       include: { dossiers: { select: { id: true, numero: true } } },
  55:     });
  56: 
  57:     if (existingClient) {
  58:       conflicts.push({
  59:         type: 'client_existant',
  60:         severity: 'critical',
  61:         clientId: existingClient.id,
  62:         message: `La partie adverse "${partieAdverse}" est un client existant du cabinet (${existingClient.dossiers.length} dossier(s))`,
  63:       });
  64:     }
  65:   }
  66: 
  67:   return NextResponse.json({
  68:     hasConflict: conflicts.length > 0,
  69:     conflicts,
  70:     message: conflicts.length > 0
  71:       ? `ATTENTION: ${conflicts.length} conflit(s) d'interets detecte(s)`
  72:       : 'Aucun conflit detecte',
  73:   });
  74: }

   8: export async function POST(request: Request) {
   9:   try {
  10:     let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  11:     try {
  12:       body = (await request.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
  13:     } catch {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const { nom, email, telephone, cabinet, sujet, message, type } = body;
  18: 
  19:     // Validation
  20:     if (!nom || !email || !sujet || !message) {

  22:         { error: 'Veuillez remplir tous les champs obligatoires' },
  23:         { status: 400 }
  24:       );
  25:     }

  28:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     // Validation email
  32:     const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  33:     if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  35:     }
  36:

  40:     logger.info('Meta:', {
  41:       type: type || 'non-renseigne',
  42:       hasTelephone: Boolean(telephone),
  43:       hasCabinet: Boolean(cabinet),
  44:       hasSubject: Boolean(sujet),
  45:       messageLength: typeof message === 'string' ? message.length : 0,
  46:       receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  47:     });
  48:     logger.info('===================================');
  49: 
  50:     // Optionnel: CrÃ©er une entrÃ©e dans une table ContactRequest
  51:     // await prisma.contactRequest.create({ data: { ... } });
  52: 
  53:     // Optionnel: Envoyer un email de notification
  54:     // await sendNotificationEmail({ to: 'admin@memoLib.com', ... });
  55: 
  56:     return NextResponse.json({
  57:       success: true,
  58:       message: 'Votre demande a ete envoyee avec succes',
  59:     });
  60:   } catch (error) {
  61:     logger.error('Erreur API contact', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  62:       route: '/api/contact',
  63:     });
  64:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur interne du serveur' }, { status: 500 });

src\app\api\cron\cost-alerts\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Cron pour vérifier les alertes de coûts
   3:  * Appeler quotidiennement via Vercel Cron ou externe
   4:  *
   5:  * Vercel Cron config (vercel.json):
   6:  * {
   7:  *   "crons": [{
   8:  *     "path": "/api/cron/cost-alerts",
   9:  *     "schedule": "0 8 * * *"
  10:  *   }]
  11:  * }
  12:  */
  13: 
  14: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  15: import { runCostAlertCheck } from '@/lib/billing/cost-alerts';
  16: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  17: 
  18: // Clé secrète pour protéger le cron
  19: const CRON_SECRET = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  20: 
  21: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  22:   // Vérifier l'autorisation
  23:   const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
  24:   const cronHeader = request.headers.get('x-vercel-cron');
  25:   const tokenParam = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('token');
  26: 
  27:   const isAuthorized =
  28:     cronHeader === '1' ||
  29:     Boolean(CRON_SECRET && authHeader === `Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}`) ||
  30:     Boolean(CRON_SECRET && tokenParam === CRON_SECRET) ||
  31:     process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
  32: 
  33:   if (!CRON_SECRET && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development' && cronHeader !== '1') {
  34:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  35:   }
  36: 
  37:   if (!isAuthorized) {
  38:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisé' }, { status: 401 });
  39:   }
  40: 
  41:   try {
  42:     logger.info('Exécution cron cost-alerts', { job: 'cost-alerts' });
  43: 
  44:     const result = await runCostAlertCheck();
  45: 
  46:     return NextResponse.json({
  47:       success: true,
  48:       message: 'Check des alertes terminé',
  49:       ...result,
  50:       executedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  51:     });
  52:   } catch (error) {
  53:     logger.error('Erreur cron cost-alerts', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  54:       job: 'cost-alerts',
  55:     });
  56: 
  57:     return NextResponse.json(
  58:       {
  59:         error: 'Erreur lors du check des alertes',
  60:       },
  61:       { status: 500 }
  62:     );
  63:   }
  64: }
  65: 
  66: // Permettre aussi POST pour les appels manuels
  67: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  68:   return GET(request);
  69: }

------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { checkDeadlineAlerts } from '@/lib/cron/deadline-alerts';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: 
   5: async function handleCron(request: NextRequest) {
   6:   try {
   7:     const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
   8:     const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
   9: 
  10:     // Vercel Cron envoie automatiquement le header si CRON_SECRET est défini
  11:     // En dev, on accepte sans auth
  12:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
  13:       // OK, pas d'auth en dev
  14:     } else if (!cronSecret) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'CRON_SECRET non configuré' }, { status: 503 });
  16:     } else {
  17:       const token = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('token');
  18:       const vercelCronHeader = request.headers.get('x-vercel-cron');
  19:       if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}` && token !== cronSecret && !vercelCronHeader) {
  20:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisé' }, { status: 401 });
  21:       }
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const result = await checkDeadlineAlerts();
  25: 
  26:     return NextResponse.json({
  27:       success: true,
  28:       message: 'Alertes vérifiées',
  29:       stats: result,
  30:     });
  31:   } catch (error) {
  32:     logger.error('Erreur cron deadline-alerts', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  33:       job: 'deadline-alerts',
  34:     });
  35:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur', details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown' }, { status: 500 });
  36:   }
  37: }
  38: 
  39: export const GET = handleCron;
  40: export const POST = handleCron;

   9:  * 
  10:  * Envoie des emails de rappel aux avocats quand une deadline approche.
  11:  * DÃ©clenchÃ© quotidiennement par Render Cron ou manuellement.
  12:  * 
  13:  * Alertes:
  14:  * - J-7 : "Ã‰chÃ©ance dans 7 jours"
  15:  * - J-3 : "Ã‰chÃ©ance dans 3 jours â€” URGENT"
  16:  * - J-1 : "DEMAIN â€” Action immÃ©diate requise"
  17:  * - J-0 : "AUJOURD'HUI â€” Deadline atteinte"
  18:  */
  19: export async function GET(request: Request) {
  20:   // VÃ©rifier le token cron (sÃ©curitÃ©)
  21:   const url = new URL(request.url);
  22:   const token = url.searchParams.get('token');
  23:   if (token !== process.env.CRON_SECRET && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
  24:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  25:   }
  26: 
  27:   try {
  28:     const now = new Date();
  29:     const alerts = { sent: 0, errors: 0, deadlines: [] as any[] };
  30: 
  31:     // Trouver les deadlines qui approchent (J-7, J-3, J-1, J-0)
  32:     const targetDays = [0, 1, 3, 7];
  33: 
  34:     for (const days of targetDays) {
  35:       const targetDate = new Date(now);
  36:       targetDate.setDate(targetDate.getDate() + days);
  37:       const startOfDay = new Date(targetDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0));

  39: 
  40:       const deadlines = await prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({
  41:         where: {
  42:           dueDate: { gte: startOfDay, lte: endOfDay },
  43:           status: { in: ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING', 'URGENT', 'CRITICAL'] },
  44:         },
  45:         include: {
  46:           Dossier: { select: { numero: true, objet: true, responsableId: true } },
  47:           Client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
  48:         },
  49:       });
  50: 
  51:       for (const deadline of deadlines) {
  52:         // Trouver l'email de l'avocat responsable
  53:         const responsableId = deadline.Dossier?.responsableId || deadline.createdBy;
  54:         if (!responsableId) continue;
  55: 
  56:         const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  57:           where: { id: responsableId },
  58:           select: { email: true, name: true },
  59:         });
  60: 
  61:         if (!user?.email) continue;
  62: 
  63:         const clientName = deadline.Client
  64:           ? `${deadline.Client.firstName} ${deadline.Client.lastName}`
  65:           : 'Client';
  66: 
  67:         const urgencyLabel = days === 0 ? 'ðŸ”´ AUJOURD\'HUI'
  68:           : days === 1 ? 'ðŸŸ  DEMAIN'
  69:           : days === 3 ? 'ðŸŸ¡ Dans 3 jours'
  70:           : 'ðŸ“… Dans 7 jours';
  71: 
  72:         const subject = days === 0
  73:           ? `[URGENT] Deadline AUJOURD'HUI â€” ${deadline.label}`
  74:           : days === 1
  75:           ? `[URGENT] Deadline DEMAIN â€” ${deadline.label}`
  76:           : `Rappel Ã©chÃ©ance (J-${days}) â€” ${deadline.label}`;
  77: 
  78:         const body = `

  80:

  95:

   6:  * 
   7:  * Flow: EmailAccount (tokens OAuth) â†’ Gmail API / Microsoft Graph â†’ processEmail â†’ DB
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  13: 
  14: const CRON_SECRET = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  15: 
  16: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  17:   // VÃ©rifier l'authentification cron
  18:   const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  19:   if (!CRON_SECRET || authHeader !== `Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}`) {
  20:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  21:   }
  22: 
  23:   try {
  24:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer tous les comptes email actifs
  25:     const accounts = await prisma.emailAccount.findMany({
  26:       where: { isActive: true },
  27:       select: {
  28:         id: true,
  29:         tenantId: true,
  30:         provider: true,
  31:         email: true,
  32:         accessToken: true,
  33:         refreshToken: true,
  34:         tokenExpiry: true,
  35:         lastSync: true,
  36:       },
  37:     });
  38: 
  39:     if (accounts.length === 0) {
  40:       return NextResponse.json({ message: 'No active email accounts', synced: 0 });
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     let synced = 0;
  44:     let errors = 0;
  45:     const results: Array<{ email: string; status: string; count?: number; error?: string }> = [];
  46: 
  47:     for (const account of accounts) {
  48:       try {
  49:         // VÃ©rifier/rafraÃ®chir le token si expirÃ©
  50:         let accessToken = account.accessToken;
  51:         if (account.tokenExpiry && new Date(account.tokenExpiry) < new Date()) {
  52:           accessToken = await refreshOAuthToken(account);
  53:         }
  54: 
  55:         if (!accessToken) {
  56:           results.push({ email: account.email, status: 'error', error: 'No valid token' });
  57:           errors++;
  58:           continue;
  59:         }
  60: 
  61:         // Fetch emails selon le provider
  62:         let newEmails = 0;
  63:         if (account.provider === 'gmail') {
  64:           newEmails = await fetchGmailEmails(account.tenantId, account.email, accessToken, account.lastSync);
  65:         } else if (account.provider === 'outlook' || account.provider === 'microsoft') {
  66:           newEmails = await fetchOutlookEmails(account.tenantId, account.email, accessToken, account.lastSync);
  67:         }
  68: 
  69:         // Mettre Ã  jour lastSync
  70:         await prisma.emailAccount.update({
  71:           where: { id: account.id },
  72:           data: { lastSync: new Date() },
  73:         });
  74: 
  75:         synced++;
  76:         results.push({ email: account.email, status: 'ok', count: newEmails });
  77:       } catch (error) {
  78:         errors++;
  79:         const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
  80:         results.push({ email: account.email, status: 'error', error: msg });
  81:         logger.error('Email sync failed for account', undefined, { accountId: account.id, error: msg });
  82:       }
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     return NextResponse.json({
  86:       message: `Email sync complete: ${synced} accounts synced, ${errors} errors`,
  87:       synced,
  88:       errors,
  89:       total: accounts.length,
  90:       results,
  91:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  92:     });
  93:   } catch (error) {
  94:     logger.error('Email sync cron failed', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined);
  95:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal error' }, { status: 500 });
  96:   }
  97: }

  99: // ============================================
 100: // GMAIL API
 101: // ============================================
 102: 
 103: async function fetchGmailEmails(
 104:   tenantId: string,
 105:   accountEmail: string,
 106:   accessToken: string,
 107:   lastSyncAt: Date | null
 108: ): Promise<number> {
 109:   // Construire la query Gmail (emails non lus depuis le dernier sync)
 110:   const after = lastSyncAt
 111:     ? Math.floor(lastSyncAt.getTime() / 1000)
 112:     : Math.floor((Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) / 1000); // 7 jours max au premier sync
 113: 
 114:   const query = `after:${after} in:inbox`;
 115: 
 116:   // 1. Lister les messages
 117:   const listRes = await fetch(
 118:     `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&maxResults=20`,
 119:     { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000) }
 120:   );
 121: 
 122:   if (!listRes.ok) {
 123:     if (listRes.status === 401) throw new Error('Gmail token expired');
 124:     throw new Error(`Gmail API error: ${listRes.status}`);
 125:   }
 126: 
 127:   const listData = await listRes.json();
 128:   const messageIds: string[] = (listData.messages || []).map((m: { id: string }) => m.id);
 129: 
 130:   if (messageIds.length === 0) return 0;
 131: 
 132:   let imported = 0;
 133: 
 134:   // 2. RÃ©cupÃ©rer chaque message
 135:   for (const msgId of messageIds.slice(0, 20)) { // Max 20 par cycle
 136:     try {
 137:       // VÃ©rifier si dÃ©jÃ  importÃ© (dÃ©dup par providerMessageId)
 138:       const existing = await prisma.email.findFirst({
 139:         where: { tenantId, providerMessageId: msgId },
 140:       });
 141:       if (existing) continue;
 142: 
 143:       // Fetch le message complet
 144:       const msgRes = await fetch(
 145:         `https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1/users/me/messages/${msgId}?format=full`,
 146:         { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000) }
 147:       );
 148: 
 149:       if (!msgRes.ok) continue;
 150:       const msgData = await msgRes.json();
 151: 
 152:       // Extraire les headers
 153:       const headers = msgData.payload?.headers || [];
 154:       const getHeader = (name: string) => headers.find((h: { name: string; value: string }) => 
 155:         h.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())?.value || '';
 156: 
 157:       const subject = getHeader('Subject');
 158:       const from = getHeader('From');
 159:       const to = getHeader('To');
 160:       const date = getHeader('Date');
 161: 
 162:       // Extraire le body (text/plain ou text/html)
 163:       const body = extractGmailBody(msgData.payload);
 164: 
 165:       // Sauvegarder en DB
 166:       await prisma.email.create({
 167:         data: {
 168:           id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 169:           tenantId,
 170:           providerMessageId: msgId,
 171:           from,
 172:           to,
 173:           subject,
 174:           body: body.slice(0, 10000),
 175:           sourceProvider: 'gmail',
 176:           sourceChannel: 'email',
 177:           sourceDirection: 'inbound',
 178:           receivedAt: date ? new Date(date) : new Date(),
 179:           createdAt: new Date(),
 180:           updatedAt: new Date(),
 181:         },
 182:       });
 183: 
 184:       imported++;
 185:     } catch (err) {
 186:       // Skip individual email errors, continue with the rest
 187:       logger.warn('Failed to import Gmail message', { msgId, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'unknown' });
 188:     }
 189:   }
 190: 
 191:   return imported;
 192: }
 193: 
 194: function extractGmailBody(payload: any): string {
 195:   if (!payload) return '';
 196: 
 197:   // Simple text/plain
 198:   if (payload.mimeType === 'text/plain' && payload.body?.data) {
 199:     return Buffer.from(payload.body.data, 'base64url').toString('utf-8');
 200:   }
 201: 
 202:   // Multipart â€” chercher text/plain d'abord, puis text/html
 203:   if (payload.parts) {
 204:     const textPart = payload.parts.find((p: any) => p.mimeType === 'text/plain');
 205:     if (textPart?.body?.data) {
 206:       return Buffer.from(textPart.body.data, 'base64url').toString('utf-8');
 207:     }
 208:     const htmlPart = payload.parts.find((p: any) => p.mimeType === 'text/html');
 209:     if (htmlPart?.body?.data) {
 210:       const html = Buffer.from(htmlPart.body.data, 'base64url').toString('utf-8');
 211:       return html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
 212:     }
 213:     // RÃ©cursif pour multipart/alternative
 214:     for (const part of payload.parts) {
 215:       const result = extractGmailBody(part);
 216:       if (result) return result;
 217:     }
 218:   }
 219: 
 220:   return '';
 221: }

 243: 
 244:   const res = await fetch(url, {
 245:     headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
 246:     signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
 247:   });
 248:

 250:     if (res.status === 401) throw new Error('Outlook token expired');

   5: async function handleCron(request: NextRequest) {
   6:   const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
   7:   const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
   8:   const token = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('token');
   9:   const vercelCronHeader = request.headers.get('x-vercel-cron');
  10: 
  11:   if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development') {
  12:     if (!cronSecret) {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'CRON_SECRET non configurÃ©' }, { status: 503 });
  14:     }
  15:     if (authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}` && token !== cronSecret && !vercelCronHeader) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18:   }
  19: 
  20:   try {
  21:     const result = await runEscalation();
  22:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, stats: result });
  23:   } catch (error) {
  24:     logger.error('Erreur cron escalation', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { job: 'escalation' });
  25:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur', details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown' }, { status: 500 });
  26:   }
  27: }

  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: import { sendEmail } from '@/lib/email/email-service';
  13: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  14: 
  15: const CRON_SECRET = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  16: 
  17: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  18:   const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  19:   if (!CRON_SECRET || authHeader !== `Bearer ${CRON_SECRET}`) {
  20:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  21:   }
  22: 
  23:   try {
  24:     const now = new Date();
  25:     const in3days = new Date(now.getTime() + 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  26:     const in1day = new Date(now.getTime() + 1 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  27:     const yesterday = new Date(now.getTime() - 1 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  28: 
  29:     // Subscriptions en trial
  30:     const trialingSubs = await prisma.subscription.findMany({
  31:       where: { status: 'trialing', trialEnd: { not: null } },
  32:       include: {
  33:         Tenant: {
  34:           include: {
  35:             User: { where: { role: 'AVOCAT' }, take: 1, select: { email: true, name: true } },
  36:           },
  37:         },
  38:       },
  39:     });
  40: 
  41:     let sent = 0;
  42: 
  43:     for (const sub of trialingSubs) {
  44:       const trialEnd = sub.trialEnd!;
  45:       const user = (sub as any).Tenant?.User?.[0];
  46:       if (!user?.email) continue;
  47: 
  48:       const daysLeft = Math.ceil((trialEnd.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  49:       const tenantName = (sub as any).Tenant?.name || 'votre cabinet';
  50: 
  51:       let emailType: 'j3' | 'j1' | 'expired' | null = null;
  52:       if (daysLeft === 3) emailType = 'j3';
  53:       else if (daysLeft === 1) emailType = 'j1';
  54:       else if (daysLeft <= 0 && daysLeft >= -1) emailType = 'expired';
  55: 
  56:       if (!emailType) continue;
  57:

  59:       const metaKey = `trial_email_${emailType}`;
  60:       const currentMeta = sub.metadata ? JSON.parse(sub.metadata) : {};
  61:       if (currentMeta[metaKey]) continue;
  62: 
  63:       const appUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'https://memolib.space';
  64: 
  65:       const templates = {
  66:         j3: {
  67:           subject: `â° Votre essai MemoLib expire dans 3 jours`,

  69:             <h2>Bonjour ${user.name || 'MaÃ®tre'},</h2>
  70:             <p>Votre essai gratuit de MemoLib pour <strong>${tenantName}</strong> expire dans <strong>3 jours</strong>.</p>
  71:             <p>Pour continuer Ã  utiliser toutes les fonctionnalitÃ©s (IA, emails, documents), activez votre abonnement :</p>
  72:             <a href="${appUrl}/fr/billing" style="display:inline-block;background:#2563eb;color:white;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:bold;margin:16px 0;">Choisir mon plan â†’</a>
  73:             <p style="color:#666;">Ã€ partir de 29â‚¬/mois â€¢ Sans engagement</p>
  74:           </div>`,
  75:         },
  76:         j1: {
  77:           subject: `âš ï¸ Dernier jour d'essai MemoLib !`,
  78:           html: `<div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 600px;">
  79:             <h2>Bonjour ${user.name || 'MaÃ®tre'},</h2>
  80:             <p>C'est votre <strong>dernier jour</strong> d'essai gratuit de MemoLib.</p>
  81:             <p>Demain, vous perdrez l'accÃ¨s Ã  :</p>

src\app\api\cron\workflows\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { runMonitors } from '@/lib/workflows/monitors';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  *  API Cron: Execution periodique des moniteurs
   7:  *
   8:  * a appeler toutes les 15 minutes via un cron job
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  12:   try {
  13:     // Verifier le token de securite
  14:     const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
  15:     const expectedToken = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  16: 
  17:     if (!expectedToken && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development') {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     if (!expectedToken || authHeader !== `Bearer ${expectedToken}`) {
  22:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     logger.info('Exécution cron: moniteurs de workflows', { job: 'workflows' });
  26: 
  27:     // Executer les moniteurs
  28:     await runMonitors();
  29: 
  30:     return NextResponse.json({
  31:       success: true,
  32:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  33:       message: 'Moniteurs executes avec succes',
  34:     });
  35:   } catch (error) {
  36:     logger.error('Erreur exécution cron workflows', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  37:       job: 'workflows',
  38:     });
  39:     return NextResponse.json(
  40:       { error: "Erreur lors de l'execution des moniteurs" },
  41:       { status: 500 }
  42:     );
  43:   }
  44: }

src\app\api\dashboard\monthly-data\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   try {
   8:     const session = await getServerSession();
   9: 
  10:     if (!session?.user) {
  11:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  12:     }
  13: 
  14:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  15:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  16: 
  17:     if (!tenantId) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 400 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     // Calculer les donnees des 6 derniers mois
  22:     const monthlyData: Array<{ month: string; dossiers: number; factures: number; revenus: number }> = [];
  23:     const now = new Date();
  24: 
  25:     for (let i = 5; i >= 0; i--) {
  26:       const date = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i, 1);
  27:       const nextMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - i + 1, 1);
  28: 
  29:       const monthName = date.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { month: 'short' });
  30: 
  31:       // Compter les dossiers crees ce mois
  32:       const dossiersCount = await prisma.dossier.count({
  33:         where: {
  34:           tenantId,
  35:           createdAt: {
  36:             gte: date,
  37:             lt: nextMonth,
  38:           },
  39:         },
  40:       });
  41: 
  42:       // Compter les factures creees ce mois
  43:       const facturesCount = await prisma.facture.count({
  44:         where: {
  45:           tenantId,
  46:           createdAt: {
  47:             gte: date,
  48:             lt: nextMonth,
  49:           },
  50:         },
  51:       });
  52: 
  53:       // Calculer les revenus du mois
  54:       const facturesSum = await prisma.facture.aggregate({
  55:         where: {
  56:           tenantId,
  57:           createdAt: {
  58:             gte: date,
  59:             lt: nextMonth,
  60:           },
  61:           statut: 'PAYEE',
  62:         },
  63:         _sum: {
  64:           montant: true,
  65:         },
  66:       });
  67: 
  68:       monthlyData.push({
  69:         month: monthName,
  70:         dossiers: dossiersCount,
  71:         factures: facturesCount,
  72:         revenus: facturesSum._sum?.montant || 0,
  73:       });
  74:     }
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json(monthlyData);
  77:   } catch (error) {
  78:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation donnees mensuelles', { error });
  79:     return NextResponse.json(
  80:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
  81:       { status: 500 }
  82:     );
  83:   }
  84: }
  85:

src\app\api\dashboard\recent-activities\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   try {
   8:     const session = await getServerSession();
   9:     
  10:     if (!session?.user) {
  11:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  12:     }
  13: 
  14:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  15:     const userRole = (session.user as any).role;
  16:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  17: 
  18:     const activities: any[] = [];
  19: 
  20:     // Recuperer les dossiers recents
  21:     let dossiersWhere: any = {};
  22:     if (userRole === 'CLIENT') {
  23:       dossiersWhere = { clientId: userId };
  24:     } else if (userRole === 'AVOCAT' && tenantId) {
  25:       dossiersWhere = { tenantId };
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     const recentDossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  29:       where: dossiersWhere,
  30:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  31:       take: 3,
  32:       include: {
  33:         client: {
  34:           select: { firstName: true, lastName: true },
  35:         },
  36:       },
  37:     });
  38: 
  39:     for (const dossier of recentDossiers) {
  40:       activities.push({
  41:         id: `dossier-${dossier.id}`,
  42:         type: 'dossier',
  43:         title: `${dossier.numero} - ${dossier.client?.firstName} ${dossier.client?.lastName}`,
  44:         date: dossier.createdAt.toISOString(),
  45:         status: dossier.statut === 'EN_COURS' ? 'info' : 
  46:                 dossier.statut === 'TERMINE' ? 'success' : 'warning',
  47:       });
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     // Recuperer les factures recentes
  51:     let facturesWhere: any = {};
  52:     if (userRole === 'CLIENT') {
  53:       const clientDossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  54:         where: { clientId: userId },
  55:         select: { id: true },
  56:       });
  57:       facturesWhere = {
  58:         dossierId: { in: clientDossiers.map(d => d.id) },
  59:       };
  60:     } else if (userRole === 'AVOCAT' && tenantId) {
  61:       facturesWhere = { tenantId };
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     const recentFactures = await prisma.facture.findMany({
  65:       where: facturesWhere,
  66:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  67:       take: 2,
  68:     });
  69: 
  70:     for (const facture of recentFactures) {
  71:       activities.push({
  72:         id: `facture-${facture.id}`,
  73:         type: 'facture',
  74:         title: `Facture #${facture.numero} - ${facture.montant}e`,
  75:         date: facture.createdAt.toISOString(),
  76:         status: facture.statut === 'PAYEE' ? 'success' : 
  77:                 facture.statut === 'EN_ATTENTE' ? 'warning' : 'info',
  78:       });
  79:     }
  80: 
  81:     // Recuperer les clients recents (seulement pour avocats)
  82:     if (userRole === 'AVOCAT' && tenantId) {
  83:       const recentClients = await prisma.client.findMany({
  84:         where: { tenantId },
  85:         orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  86:         take: 2,
  87:       });
  88: 
  89:       for (const client of recentClients) {
  90:         activities.push({
  91:           id: `client-${client.id}`,
  92:           type: 'client',
  93:           title: `Nouveau client - ${client.firstName} ${client.lastName}`,
  94:           date: client.createdAt.toISOString(),
  95:           status: 'success',
  96:         });
  97:       }
  98:     }
  99: 
 100:     // Trier toutes les activites par date decroissante
 101:     activities.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime());
 102: 
 103:     // Limiter e 5 activites
 104:     const finalActivities = activities.slice(0, 5);
 105: 
 106:     return NextResponse.json(finalActivities);
 107:   } catch (error) {
 108:     logger.error('Erreur lors de la recuperation des activites recentes:', { error });
 109:     return NextResponse.json(
 110:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
 111:       { status: 500 }
 112:     );
 113:   }
 114: }
 115:

src\app\api\delais\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: 
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  10:     if (!session?.user) {
  11:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  12:     }
  13:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  14:     if (!tenantId) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  19:     const delaiId = searchParams.get('id');
  20:     const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  21:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  22:     const urgent = searchParams.get('urgent') === 'true';
  23: 
  24:     if (delaiId) {
  25:       const delai = await prisma.delai.findFirst({
  26:         where: { id: delaiId, tenantId },
  27:         include: { dossier: { include: { client: true } } },
  28:       });
  29:       if (!delai) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Delai non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  30:       return NextResponse.json({ delai });
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId };
  34:     if (dossierId) where.dossierId = dossierId;
  35:     if (status) where.status = status;
  36:     if (urgent) where.dateEcheance = { lte: new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) };
  37: 
  38:     const delais = await prisma.delai.findMany({
  39:       where,
  40:       include: {
  41:         dossier: {
  42:           select: {
  43:             numero: true,
  44:             titre: true,
  45:             client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
  46:           },
  47:         },
  48:       },
  49:       orderBy: { dateEcheance: 'asc' },
  50:     });
  51: 
  52:     return NextResponse.json({ delais });
  53:   } catch (error) {
  54:     logger.error('Erreur GET delais', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  55:       route: '/api/delais',
  56:     });
  57:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  58:   }
  59: }
  60: 
  61: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  62:   try {
  63:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  64:     if (!session?.user) {
  65:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  66:     }
  67:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  68:     if (!tenantId) {
  69:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  70:     }
  71: 
  72:     const body = await request.json();
  73:     const {
  74:       dossierId,
  75:       titre,
  76:       description,
  77:       type,
  78:       fondementLegal,
  79:       dateEcheance,
  80:       priorite,
  81:     } = body;
  82: 
  83:     if (!dossierId || !titre || !type || !dateEcheance) {
  84:       return NextResponse.json(
  85:         { error: 'dossierId, titre, type et dateEcheance requis' },
  86:         { status: 400 }
  87:       );
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({ where: { id: dossierId, tenantId } });
  91:     if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  92: 
  93:     const echeance = new Date(dateEcheance);
  94:     if (isNaN(echeance.getTime()))
  95:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Format dateEcheance invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  96: 
  97:     const delai = await prisma.$transaction(
  98:       async (tx) => {
  99:         const created = await tx.delai.create({
 100:           data: {
 101:             tenantId,
 102:             dossierId,
 103:             titre,
 104:             description,
 105:             type,
 106:             fondementLegal,
 107:             dateEcheance: echeance,
 108:             dateRappel1: new Date(echeance.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 109:             dateRappel2: new Date(echeance.getTime() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 110:             dateRappel3: new Date(echeance.getTime() - 1 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 111:             priorite: priorite || 'normale',
 112:           },
 113:         });
 114: 
 115:         await tx.evenement.create({
 116:           data: {
 117:             tenantId,
 118:             dossierId,
 119:             type: 'delai',
 120:             categorie: 'creation_echeance',
 121:             titre: `Délai créé: ${titre}`,
 122:             description: `Échéance: ${echeance.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`,
 123:             dateEvenement: new Date(),
 124:           },
 125:         });
 126: 
 127:         return created;
 128:       },
 129:       { timeout: 30000 }
 130:     );
 131: 
 132:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, delai });
 133:   } catch (error) {
 134:     logger.error('Erreur POST delai', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 135:       route: '/api/delais',
 136:     });
 137:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 138:   }
 139: }
 140: 
 141: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 142:   try {
 143:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 144:     if (!session?.user) {
 145:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 146:     }
 147:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
 148:     if (!tenantId) {
 149:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
 150:     }
 151: 
 152:     const body = await request.json();
 153:     const { delaiId, status, respecteLe } = body;
 154: 
 155:     if (!delaiId)
 156:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'delaiId requis' }, { status: 400 });
 157: 
 158:     const existing = await prisma.delai.findFirst({ where: { id: delaiId, tenantId } });
 159:     if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Delai non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 160: 
 161:     const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 162:     if (status !== undefined) updateData.status = status;
 163:     if (respecteLe !== undefined) updateData.respecteLe = new Date(respecteLe);
 164: 
 165:     const delai = await prisma.delai.update({ where: { id: delaiId }, data: updateData });
 166:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, delai });
 167:   } catch (error) {
 168:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH delai', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 169:       route: '/api/delais',
 170:     });
 171:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 172:   }
 173: }

  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) {
  14:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  15:   }
  16:

  18:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);

  20:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  21:   }
  22: 
  23:   return null;
  24: }

src\app\api\dev\ai-stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { logger, LogCategory } from '@/lib/dev/advanced-logger';
   5: 
   6: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
   7:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   8:   if (!session?.user) {
   9:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  10:   }
  11: 
  12:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  13:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  14:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  15:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  16:   }
  17: 
  18:   return null;
  19: }
  20: 
  21: /**
  22:  * GET /api/dev/ai-stats - Statistiques IA
  23:  */
  24: export async function GET() {
  25:   try {
  26:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  27:     if (authError) {
  28:       return authError;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const aiMetrics = logger.getPerformanceMetrics('AI');
  32:     const aiLogs = logger.getLogs({ category: LogCategory.AI, limit: 1000 });
  33: 
  34:     // Analyse des modeles utilises
  35:     const modelCounts = aiLogs.reduce((acc: any, log: any) => {
  36:       const model = log.context?.model || 'unknown';
  37:       acc[model] = (acc[model] || 0) + 1;
  38:       return acc;
  39:     }, {});
  40: 
  41:     const models = Object.entries(modelCounts).map(([name, count]) => ({
  42:       name,
  43:       count,
  44:     }));
  45: 
  46:     return NextResponse.json({
  47:       ...aiMetrics,
  48:       total: aiLogs.length,
  49:       models,
  50:       slowest: aiMetrics.slowestOperations.slice(0, 5),
  51:     });
  52:   } catch (error) {
  53:     return NextResponse.json(
  54:       { error: 'Erreur statistiques IA' },
  55:       { status: 500 }
  56:     );
  57:   }
  58: }

src\app\api\dev\health\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: const startTime = Date.now();
   7: const DEMO_MODE = process.env.DEMO_MODE === '1' || process.env.DEMO_MODE === 'true';
   8: const AI_HEALTH_STRICT = process.env.AI_HEALTH_STRICT !== 'false';
   9: 
  10: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) {
  13:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14:   }
  15: 
  16:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  17:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  18:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  19:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  20:   }
  21: 
  22:   return null;
  23: }
  24: 
  25: /**
  26:  * GET /api/dev/health - Health check systeme
  27:  */
  28: export async function GET() {
  29:   try {
  30:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  31:     if (authError) {
  32:       return authError;
  33:     }
  34: 
  35:     const uptime = Date.now() - startTime;
  36:     const uptimeFormatted = formatUptime(uptime);
  37: 
  38:     // Verifications systeme
  39:     const checks = {
  40:       database: await checkDatabase(),
  41:       ollama: await checkOllama(),
  42:       memory: checkMemory(),
  43:     };
  44: 
  45:     const allHealthy = Object.values(checks).every(check => check.healthy);
  46: 
  47:     return NextResponse.json({
  48:       status: allHealthy ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
  49:       uptime: uptimeFormatted,
  50:       uptimeMs: uptime,
  51:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  52:       checks,
  53:     });
  54:   } catch (error) {
  55:     return NextResponse.json(
  56:       {
  57:         status: 'unhealthy',
  58:         error: 'Erreur health check',
  59:       },
  60:       { status: 500 }
  61:     );
  62:   }
  63: }
  64: 
  65: async function checkDatabase(): Promise<{ healthy: boolean; message: string }> {
  66:   try {
  67:     // Vérifier connexion Prisma avec une requête simple
  68:     await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
  69:     return { healthy: true, message: 'Database OK' };
  70:   } catch (error) {
  71:     return { healthy: false, message: `Database connection failed: ${error}` };
  72:   }
  73: }
  74: 
  75: async function checkOllama(): Promise<{ healthy: boolean; message: string }> {
  76:   if (DEMO_MODE || !AI_HEALTH_STRICT) {
  77:     return { healthy: true, message: 'Ollama check skipped (demo)' };
  78:   }
  79: 
  80:   try {
  81:     const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/tags', {
  82:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000),
  83:     });
  84:     if (response.ok) {
  85:       return { healthy: true, message: 'Ollama OK' };
  86:     }
  87:     return { healthy: false, message: 'Ollama not responding' };
  88:   } catch (error) {
  89:     return { healthy: false, message: 'Ollama unavailable' };
  90:   }
  91: }
  92: 
  93: function checkMemory(): { healthy: boolean; message: string; usage?: number } {
  94:   if (DEMO_MODE) {
  95:     return { healthy: true, message: 'Memory check skipped (demo)' };
  96:   }
  97: 
  98:   try {
  99:     if (typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.memoryUsage) {
 100:       const usage = process.memoryUsage();
 101:       const heapUsedMB = Math.round(usage.heapUsed / 1024 / 1024);
 102:       const heapTotalMB = Math.round(usage.heapTotal / 1024 / 1024);
 103:       const percentage = (heapUsedMB / heapTotalMB) * 100;
 104: 
 105:       return {
 106:         healthy: percentage < 90,
 107:         message: `Memory: ${heapUsedMB}MB / ${heapTotalMB}MB (${percentage.toFixed(1)}%)`,
 108:         usage: percentage,
 109:       };
 110:     }
 111:     return { healthy: true, message: 'Memory check unavailable' };
 112:   } catch (error) {
 113:     return { healthy: true, message: 'Memory check unavailable' };
 114:   }
 115: }
 116: 
 117: function formatUptime(ms: number): string {
 118:   const seconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
 119:   const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
 120:   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
 121:   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
 122: 
 123:   if (days > 0) return `${days}j ${hours % 24}h`;
 124:   if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes % 60}m`;
 125:   if (minutes > 0) return `${minutes}m ${seconds % 60}s`;
 126:   return `${seconds}s`;
 127: }

src\app\api\dev\logs\export\route.migrated.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { verifyAuth } from '@/middleware/auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { z } from 'zod';
   5: 
   6: // ============================================
   7: // VALIDATION SCHEMAS
   8: // ============================================
   9: 
  10: const ExportFormatSchema = z.object({
  11:   format: z.enum(['json', 'csv']).default('json'),
  12: });
  13: 
  14: // ============================================
  15: // GET /api/dev/logs/export
  16: // Exporte les logs au format JSON ou CSV
  17: // ============================================
  18: 
  19: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  20:   const auth = await verifyAuth(request);
  21:   if (!auth.authenticated || !auth.user) {
  22:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  23:   }
  24:   if (auth.user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  25:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Accès refusé' }, { status: 403 });
  26:   }
  27:   const session = { user: auth.user };
  28: 
  29:   try {
  30:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  31:     
  32:     const { format } = ExportFormatSchema.parse({
  33:       format: searchParams.get('format'),
  34:     });
  35: 
  36:     logger.info(`Exporting dev logs`, { userId: session.user.id, format });
  37: 
  38:     // Recuperer tous les logs
  39:     const logs = logger.getBufferedLogs();
  40: 
  41:     if (format === 'csv') {
  42:       // Conversion en CSV
  43:       const headers = 'timestamp,level,message,context\n';
  44:       const rows = logs.map((log) => {
  45:         const timestamp = new Date(log.timestamp).toISOString();
  46:         const level = log.level;
  47:         const message = log.message.replace(/"/g, '""'); // Escape quotes
  48:         const context = JSON.stringify(log.context || {}).replace(/"/g, '""');
  49:         return `"${timestamp}","${level}","${message}","${context}"`;
  50:       }).join('\n');
  51: 
  52:       const data = headers + rows;
  53: 
  54:       logger.info(` Logs exported as CSV: ${logs.length} entries`, {
  55:         userId: session.user.id,
  56:         count: logs.length,
  57:       });
  58: 
  59:       return new Response(data, {
  60:         headers: {
  61:           'Content-Type': 'text/csv',
  62:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename=logs-${new Date().toISOString()}.csv`,
  63:         },
  64:       });
  65:     } else {
  66:       // Format JSON (default)
  67:       const data = JSON.stringify(logs, null, 2);
  68: 
  69:       logger.info(` Logs exported as JSON: ${logs.length} entries`, {
  70:         userId: session.user.id,
  71:         count: logs.length,
  72:       });
  73: 
  74:       return new Response(data, {
  75:         headers: {
  76:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  77:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename=logs-${new Date().toISOString()}.json`,
  78:         },
  79:       });
  80:     }
  81:   } catch (error) {
  82:     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
  83:       logger.warn('Invalid export format', { error: error.errors });
  84:       return NextResponse.json(
  85:         { error: 'Format invalide', details: error.errors },
  86:         { status: 400 }
  87:       );
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     logger.error('Error exporting dev logs', error);
  91:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  92:   }
  93: }
