src\app\api\dev\logs\route.migrated.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { verifyAuth } from '@/middleware/auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { z } from 'zod';
   5: 
   6: // ============================================
   7: // VALIDATION SCHEMAS
   8: // ============================================
   9: 
  10: const LogQuerySchema = z.object({
  11:   level: z.enum(['debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'critical']).optional(),
  12:   category: z.enum(['API', 'WORKFLOW', 'SECURITY', 'AI', 'DATABASE', 'EMAIL']).optional(),
  13:   limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).default(100),
  14:   since: z.string().datetime().optional().transform((val) => val ? new Date(val) : undefined),
  15: });
  16: 
  17: // ============================================
  18: // GET /api/dev/logs
  19: // Recupere les logs filtres (dev/debug uniquement)
  20: // ============================================
  21: 
  22: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  23:   const auth = await verifyAuth(request);
  24:   if (!auth.authenticated || !auth.user) {
  25:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  26:   }
  27:   if (auth.user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  28:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Accès refusé' }, { status: 403 });
  29:   }
  30:   const session = { user: auth.user };
  31: 
  32:   try {
  33:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  34:     
  35:     const { level, category, limit, since } = LogQuerySchema.parse({
  36:       level: searchParams.get('level'),
  37:       category: searchParams.get('category'),
  38:       limit: searchParams.get('limit'),
  39:       since: searchParams.get('since'),
  40:     });
  41: 
  42:     logger.info(`Fetching dev logs`, { level, category, limit, since });
  43: 
  44:     // Recuperer les logs depuis le buffer
  45:     const logs = logger.getBufferedLogs();
  46: 
  47:     // Appliquer les filtres
  48:     let filteredLogs = logs;
  49: 
  50:     if (level) {
  51:       filteredLogs = filteredLogs.filter((log) => log.level === level);
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     if (category) {
  55:       filteredLogs = filteredLogs.filter((log) => log.context?.category === category);
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     if (since) {
  59:       filteredLogs = filteredLogs.filter((log) => new Date(log.timestamp) >= since);
  60:     }
  61: 
  62:     // Trier par timestamp decroissant et limiter
  63:     const result = filteredLogs
  64:       .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime())
  65:       .slice(0, limit);
  66: 
  67:     logger.info(` Dev logs fetched: ${result.length}`, {
  68:       filters: { level, category, limit, since },
  69:       total: result.length,
  70:     });
  71: 
  72:     return NextResponse.json({
  73:       success: true,
  74:       logs: result,
  75:       total: result.length,
  76:       filters: { level, category, limit, since: since?.toISOString() },
  77:     });
  78:   } catch (error) {
  79:     if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
  80:       logger.warn('Invalid log query parameters', { error: error.errors });
  81:       return NextResponse.json(
  82:         { error: 'Parametres invalides', details: error.errors },
  83:         { status: 400 }
  84:       );
  85:     }
  86: 
  87:     logger.error('Error fetching dev logs', error);
  88:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  89:   }
  90: }
  91: 
  92: // ============================================
  93: // DELETE /api/dev/logs
  94: // Nettoie les logs (dev/debug uniquement)
  95: // ============================================
  96: 
  97: export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
  98:   const auth = await verifyAuth(request);
  99:   if (!auth.authenticated || !auth.user) {
 100:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
 101:   }
 102:   if (auth.user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
 103:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Accès refusé' }, { status: 403 });
 104:   }
 105:   const session = { user: auth.user };
 106: 
 107:   try {
 108:     logger.info(`Clearing dev logs`, { userId: session.user.id });
 109: 
 110:     // Clear logs buffer (si methode existe)
 111:     // logger.clearBuffer(); // TODO: Implementer si necessaire
 112: 
 113:     logger.info(` Dev logs cleared`, { userId: session.user.id });
 114: 
 115:     return NextResponse.json({
 116:       success: true,
 117:       message: 'Logs cleared successfully',
 118:     });
 119:   } catch (error) {
 120:     logger.error('Error clearing dev logs', error);
 121:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 122:   }
 123: }

src\app\api\dev\workflow-stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { logger, LogCategory } from '@/lib/dev/advanced-logger';
   5: 
   6: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
   7:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   8:   if (!session?.user) {
   9:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  10:   }
  11: 
  12:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  13:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  14:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  15:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  16:   }
  17: 
  18:   return null;
  19: }
  20: 
  21: /**
  22:  * GET /api/dev/workflow-stats - Statistiques workflows
  23:  */
  24: export async function GET() {
  25:   try {
  26:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  27:     if (authError) {
  28:       return authError;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const workflowLogs = logger.getLogs({ category: LogCategory.WORKFLOW, limit: 1000 });
  32: 
  33:     const active = workflowLogs.filter((log: any) =>
  34:       log.message.includes('started')
  35:     ).length;
  36: 
  37:     const completed = workflowLogs.filter((log: any) =>
  38:       log.message.includes('completed')
  39:     ).length;
  40: 
  41:     const failed = workflowLogs.filter((log: any) =>
  42:       log.message.includes('failed')
  43:     ).length;
  44: 
  45:     const pending = active - (completed + failed);
  46: 
  47:     // Stats par type de workflow
  48:     const byType = workflowLogs.reduce((acc: any, log: any) => {
  49:       const workflowId = log.context?.workflowId || 'unknown';
  50:       if (!acc[workflowId]) {
  51:         acc[workflowId] = { count: 0, success: 0, failed: 0 };
  52:       }
  53:       acc[workflowId].count++;
  54:       if (log.message.includes('completed')) acc[workflowId].success++;
  55:       if (log.message.includes('failed')) acc[workflowId].failed++;
  56:       return acc;
  57:     }, {});
  58: 
  59:     const byTypeArray = Object.entries(byType).map(([name, stats]: [string, any]) => ({
  60:       name,
  61:       count: stats.count,
  62:       successRate: (stats.success / stats.count) * 100,
  63:     }));
  64: 
  65:     const successRate = completed > 0 ? (completed / (completed + failed)) * 100 : 0;
  66: 
  67:     return NextResponse.json({
  68:       active,
  69:       completed,
  70:       failed,
  71:       pending,
  72:       successRate,
  73:       byType: byTypeArray,
  74:     });
  75:   } catch (error) {
  76:     return NextResponse.json(
  77:       { error: 'Erreur statistiques workflows' },
  78:       { status: 500 }
  79:     );
  80:   }
  81: }
  82:

src\app\api\documents\[id]\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   3: import { getBlobServiceClient } from '@/lib/azure/clients';
   4: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: 
   9: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
  10: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
  11: 
  12: export async function DELETE(
  13:   _request: NextRequest,
  14:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  15: ) {
  16:   try {
  17:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  18: 
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json(
  21:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  22:         { status: 401 }
  23:       );
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const user = session.user as {
  27:       id?: string;
  28:       tenantId?: string;
  29:       role?: string;
  30:       groups?: string[];
  31:     };
  32: 
  33:     if (!user.id || !user.tenantId) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json(
  35:         { error: 'Acces interdit' },
  36:         { status: 403 }
  37:       );
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     const { id } = await params;
  41: 
  42:     if (!id) {
  43:       return NextResponse.json(
  44:         { error: 'ID document requis' },
  45:         { status: 400 }
  46:       );
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     const document = await prisma.document.findFirst({
  50:       where: {
  51:         id,
  52:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  53:       },
  54:       select: {
  55:         id: true,
  56:         dossierId: true,
  57:         storageKey: true,
  58:       },
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     if (!document) {
  62:       return NextResponse.json(
  63:         { error: 'Document non trouve' },
  64:         { status: 404 }
  65:       );
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     if (document.dossierId) {
  69:       const access = await canAccessDossier({
  70:         userId: user.id,
  71:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  72:         role: user.role,
  73:         groups: user.groups,
  74:         dossierId: document.dossierId,
  75:         action: 'read',
  76:       });
  77: 
  78:       if (!access.allowed) {
  79:         return NextResponse.json(
  80:           { error: 'Document non trouve' },
  81:           { status: 404 }
  82:         );
  83:       }
  84:     } else if (user.role === 'CLIENT') {
  85:       return NextResponse.json(
  86:         { error: 'Acces interdit' },
  87:         { status: 403 }
  88:       );
  89:     }
  90: 
  91:     try {
  92:       if (document.storageKey.startsWith('azure://')) {
  93:         const storagePath = document.storageKey.slice('azure://'.length);
  94:         const [container, ...blobParts] = storagePath.split('/');
  95:         const blobName = blobParts.join('/');
  96: 
  97:         if (container && blobName) {
  98:           await getBlobServiceClient()
  99:             .getContainerClient(container)
 100:             .getBlockBlobClient(blobName)
 101:             .deleteIfExists();
 102:         }
 103:       } else if (document.storageKey.startsWith('/uploads/')) {
 104:         const fs = await import('fs/promises');
 105:         const path = await import('path');
 106: 
 107:         const uploadsDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
 108:         const relativePath = document.storageKey.replace(/^\/uploads\//, '');
 109: 
 110:         if (
 111:           relativePath.includes('..') ||
 112:           relativePath.includes('%2e')
 113:         ) {
 114:           return NextResponse.json(
 115:             { error: 'Chemin invalide' },
 116:             { status: 400 }
 117:           );
 118:         }
 119: 
 120:         const filePath = path.resolve(uploadsDir, relativePath);
 121: 
 122:         if (!filePath.startsWith(uploadsDir + path.sep)) {
 123:           return NextResponse.json(
 124:             { error: 'Chemin invalide' },
 125:             { status: 400 }
 126:           );
 127:         }
 128: 
 129:         await fs.unlink(filePath).catch(() => {});
 130:       }
 131:     } catch (storageError) {
 132:       logger.warn('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Erreur suppression stockage', {
 133:         documentId: id,
 134:         error: storageError,
 135:       });
 136:     }
 137: 
 138:     await prisma.document.delete({
 139:       where: {
 140:         id: document.id,
 141:       },
 142:     });
 143: 
 144:     logger.info('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Document supprime', {
 145:       documentId: document.id,
 146:       userId: user.id,
 147:     });
 148: 
 149:     return NextResponse.json({
 150:       success: true,
 151:       id: document.id,
 152:     });
 153:   } catch (error) {
 154:     logger.error('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Erreur:', { error });
 155: 
 156:     return NextResponse.json(
 157:       { error: 'Erreur lors de la suppression du document' },
 158:       { status: 500 }
 159:     );
 160:   }
 161: }

src\app\api\documents\convention-honoraires\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/documents/convention-honoraires
   8:  * Genere une convention d'honoraires pre-remplie.
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const user = session.user as any;
  15:   const { dossierId, tauxHoraire, provision, forfait } = await req.json();
  16: 
  17:   let client: any = null;
  18:   let dossier: any = null;
  19: 
  20:   if (dossierId) {
  21:     dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  22:       where: { id: dossierId, tenantId: user.tenantId },
  23:       include: { Client: true },

 165: function parseAzureStorageKey(storageKey: string): { container: string; blobName: string } | null {
 166:   if (!storageKey.startsWith('azure://')) {
 167:     return null;
 168:   }
 169: 
 170:   const [container, ...blobParts] = storageKey.slice('azure://'.length).split('/');
 171:   const blobName = blobParts.join('/');
 172:   if (!container || !blobName || blobName.includes('..')) {
 173:     return null;
 174:   }
 175: 
 176:   return { container, blobName };
 177: }
 178: 
 179: function createDownloadResponse(
 180:   fileBuffer: Buffer,
 181:   originalName: string,
 182:   mimeType: string
 183: ): NextResponse {
 184:   const safeFilename = originalName
 185:     .replace(/[^\w\s.-]/g, '_')
 186:     .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
 187:     .slice(0, 255);
 188: 
 189:   return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(fileBuffer), {
 190:     headers: {
 191:       'Content-Type': mimeType || getContentType(originalName),
 192:       'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${safeFilename}"`,
 193:       'Content-Length': String(fileBuffer.length),
 194:       'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
 195:       'Cache-Control': 'private, no-cache',
 196:     },
 197:   });
 198: }
 199: 
 200: /**
 201:  * Retourne le content-type basÃ© sur l'extension du fichier
 202:  */
 203: function getContentType(filename: string): string {
 204:   const ext = filename.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
 205:   const types: Record<string, string> = {
 206:     pdf: 'application/pdf',
 207:     doc: 'application/msword',
 208:     docx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
 209:     xls: 'application/vnd.ms-excel',
 210:     xlsx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
 211:     png: 'image/png',
 212:     jpg: 'image/jpeg',
 213:     jpeg: 'image/jpeg',
 214:     webp: 'image/webp',
 215:     txt: 'text/plain',
 216:   };
 217:   return types[ext || ''] || 'application/octet-stream';
 218: }

   9: /**
  10:  * GET /api/documents/download?id=xxx
  11:  * Returns a signed download URL for a private Vercel Blob document,
  12:  * or streams the file from local storage.
  13:  */
  14: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  15:   try {
  16:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const tenantId = session.user.tenantId;
  22:     const clientId = session.user.clientId;
  23:     if (!tenantId) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     const documentId = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('id');
  28:     if (!documentId) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document ID requis' }, { status: 400 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     const document = await prisma.document.findFirst({
  33:       where: {
  34:         id: documentId,
  35:         tenantId,
  36:         ...(session.user.role === 'CLIENT'
  37:           ? { OR: [{ clientId }, { Dossier: { clientId } }] }
  38:           : {}),
  39:       },
  40:       select: {
  41:         id: true,
  42:         storageKey: true,
  43:         filename: true,
  44:         mimeType: true,
  45:         antivirusStatus: true,
  46:       },
  47:     });
  48: 
  49:     if (!document) {
  50:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     if (document.antivirusStatus === 'INFECTED') {
  54:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document bloquÃ© par lâ€™antivirus' }, { status: 403 });
  55:     }
  56: 
  57:     if (session.user.role === 'CLIENT' && document.antivirusStatus !== 'CLEAN') {
  58:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document en cours de vÃ©rification' }, { status: 423 });
  59:     }
  60: 
  61:     // Local file fallback â€” stream the file
  62:     if (
  63:       document.storageKey.startsWith('/uploads/') ||
  64:       document.storageKey.startsWith('client-quarantine/')
  65:     ) {
  66:       const fs = await import('fs/promises');
  67:       const path = await import('path');
  68:       const filePath = document.storageKey.startsWith('client-quarantine/')
  69:         ? path.join(
  70:             /*turbopackIgnore: true*/ process.env.VAULT_STORAGE_ROOT ??
  71:               path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'client-quarantine'),
  72:             ...document.storageKey.split('/').slice(1)
  73:           )
  74:         : path.join(/*turbopackIgnore: true*/ process.cwd(), document.storageKey);
  75: 
  76:       try {
  77:         const buffer = await fs.readFile(filePath);
  78:         return new NextResponse(buffer, {
  79:           headers: {
  80:             'Content-Type': document.mimeType,
  81:             'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${document.filename}"`,
  82:             'Cache-Control': 'private, no-cache',
  83:           },
  84:         });
  85:       } catch {
  86:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier introuvable sur le disque' }, { status: 404 });
  87:       }
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Stockage non supportÃ©' }, { status: 500 });
  91:   } catch (error) {
  92:     logger.error('[DOWNLOAD] Erreur:', { error });
  93:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors du tÃ©lÃ©chargement' }, { status: 500 });
  94:   }
  95: }

 151:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 152:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
 153: 
 154:   const user = session.user as any;
 155:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
 156:   const { templateType, dossierId, variables } = await req.json();
 157: 
 158:   if (!templateType || !TEMPLATES[templateType as TemplateType]) {
 159:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Template invalide', available: Object.keys(TEMPLATES) }, { status: 400 });
 160:   }
 161: 
 162:   // Auto-remplir les variables depuis le dossier
 163:   const vars: Record<string, string> = {
 164:     date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }),
 165:     lieu: 'Paris',
 166:     avocat: user.name || 'MaÃ®tre',
 167:     ...variables,
 168:   };
 169: 
 170:   if (dossierId && tenantId) {
 171:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
 172:       where: { id: dossierId, tenantId },
 173:       include: { Client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } } },
 174:     });
 175:     if (dossier) {
 176:       vars.numeroDossier = vars.numeroDossier || dossier.numero;
 177:       const clientData = (dossier as any).Client;
 178:       vars.client = vars.client || (clientData ? `${clientData.firstName} ${clientData.lastName}` : '');
 179:       vars.objet = vars.objet || dossier.objet || '';
 180:     }
 181:   }
 182: 
 183:   const template = TEMPLATES[templateType as TemplateType];
 184:   const document = template.generate(vars);
 185: 
 186:   return NextResponse.json({
 187:     templateType,
 188:     title: template.title,
 189:     content: document,
 190:     variables: vars,
 191:   });
 192: }

   8: // POST - Upload et traitement OCR d'un document
   9: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  10:   try {
  11:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:     if (!session?.user) {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14:     }
  15:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  16:     if (!tenantId) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const formData = await request.formData();
  21:     const file = formData.get('file') as File;
  22:     const dossierId = formData.get('dossierId') as string | null;
  23:     const clientId = formData.get('clientId') as string | null;
  24:     const category = formData.get('category') as string | null;
  25:     const uploadedBy = formData.get('uploadedBy') as string;
  26: 
  27:     if (!file || !uploadedBy) {
  28:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'file et uploadedBy requis' }, { status: 400 });
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     if (dossierId) {
  32:       const access = await canAccessDossier({
  33:         userId: (session.user as any).id,
  34:         tenantId,
  35:         role: (session.user as any).role,
  36:         groups: (session.user as any).groups,
  37:         dossierId,
  38:         action: 'write',
  39:       });
  40:       if (!access.allowed) {
  41:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse au dossier' }, { status: 403 });
  42:       }
  43:     }
  44: 
  45:     // Lire le contenu du fichier
  46:     const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
  47:     const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
  48: 
  49:     // Generer une cle de stockage unique
  50:     const timestamp = Date.now();
  51:     const storageKey = `documents/${tenantId}/${timestamp}-${file.name}`;
  52: 
  53:     // Creer l'enregistrement du document
  54:     const document = await prisma.document.create({
  55:       data: {
  56:         tenantId,
  57:         dossierId,
  58:         clientId,
  59:         filename: `${timestamp}-${file.name}`,
  60:         originalName: file.name,
  61:         mimeType: file.type,
  62:         size: buffer.length,
  63:         storageKey,
  64:         category,
  65:         uploadedBy,
  66:         ocrProcessed: false,
  67:         aiAnalyzed: false,
  68:       },
  69:     });
  70: 
  71:     // Lancer le traitement OCR en arriere-plan
  72:     processOCR(document.id, buffer, file.type).catch(err =>
  73:       logger.error('Erreur OCR async', { error: err })
  74:     );
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json({
  77:       success: true,
  78:       document: {
  79:         id: document.id,
  80:         filename: document.originalName,
  81:         status: 'processing',
  82:       },
  83:     });
  84:   } catch (error) {
  85:     logger.error('Erreur upload document:', { error });
  86:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  87:   }
  88: }

  91: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  92:   try {
  93:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  94:     if (!session?.user) {
  95:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  96:     }
  97:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  98:     if (!tenantId) {

 106:

 109:         userId: (session.user as any).id,
 110:         tenantId,
 111:         role: (session.user as any).role,
 112:         groups: (session.user as any).groups,

 114:         action: 'read',
 115:       });
 116:       if (!access.allowed) {
 117:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse au dossier' }, { status: 403 });
 118:       }
 119:     }
 120: 
 121:     if (documentId) {
 122:       const document = await prisma.document.findFirst({
 123:         where: { id: documentId, tenantId },
 124:         include: {
 125:           dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
 126:           client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 127:           uploader: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
 128:         },
 129:       });
 130:       return NextResponse.json({ document });
 131:     }
 132:

 134:       where: {
 135:         tenantId,
 136:         ...(dossierId ? { dossierId } : {}),
 137:         ...(clientId ? { clientId } : {}),
 138:       },
 139:       include: {
 140:         dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
 141:         client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 142:       },
 143:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 144:     });
 145: 
 146:     return NextResponse.json({ documents });
 147:   } catch (error) {
 148:     logger.error('Erreur GET documents:', { error });
 149:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });

 153: // Fonction de traitement OCR
 154: async function processOCR(documentId: string, buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string) {
 155:   try {
 156:     logger.info(' Demarrage OCR pour document ${documentId}');
 157: 
 158:     let extractedText = '';
 159:     let confidence = 0;
 160:     let extractedData: Record<string, unknown> = {};
 161: 
 162:     // Determiner le type de document et extraire le texte
 163:     if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') {
 164:       // Pour PDF: utiliser pdf-parse ou appeler un service externe
 165:       const result = await extractTextFromPDF(buffer);
 166:       extractedText = result.text;
 167:       confidence = result.confidence;
 168:     } else if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
 169:       // Pour images: utiliser Tesseract.js ou un service OCR
 170:       const result = await extractTextFromImage(buffer);
 171:       extractedText = result.text;
 172:       confidence = result.confidence;
 173:     } else {
 174:       // Autres types: essayer d'extraire le texte brut
 175:       extractedText = buffer.toString('utf-8');
 176:       confidence = 1.0;
 177:     }
 178: 
 179:     // Analyser le contenu avec le moteur pour extraire des donnees structurees
 180:     if (extractedText.length > 0) {
 181:       extractedData = await analyzeDocumentContent(extractedText);
 182:     }
 183: 
 184:     // Mettre a jour le document avec les resultats OCR
 185:     await prisma.document.update({
 186:       where: { id: documentId },
 187:       data: {
 188:         ocrProcessed: true,
 189:         ocrText: extractedText.substring(0, 50000), // Limiter la taille
 190:         ocrConfidence: confidence,
 191:         extractedData: JSON.stringify(extractedData),
 192:       },
 193:     });
 194: 
 195:     logger.info(' OCR termine pour document ${documentId}');
 196:   } catch (error) {
 197:     logger.error(`Erreur OCR pour document ${documentId}`, { error });
 198: 
 199:     await prisma.document.update({
 200:       where: { id: documentId },
 201:       data: {
 202:         ocrProcessed: true,
 203:         ocrConfidence: 0,
 204:         extractedData: JSON.stringify({ error: 'echec du traitement OCR' }),
 205:       },
 206:     });
 207:   }
 208: }

  96: function detectMimeTypeFromBuffer(buffer: Buffer): string | null {
  97:   if (
  98:     buffer.length >= 4 &&
  99:     buffer[0] === 0x25 &&
 100:     buffer[1] === 0x50 &&
 101:     buffer[2] === 0x44 &&
 102:     buffer[3] === 0x46
 103:   ) {
 104:     return 'application/pdf';
 105:   }
 106: 
 107:   if (buffer.length >= 3 && buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xd8 && buffer[2] === 0xff) {
 108:     return 'image/jpeg';
 109:   }
 110: 
 111:   if (
 112:     buffer.length >= 8 &&
 113:     buffer[0] === 0x89 &&
 114:     buffer[1] === 0x50 &&
 115:     buffer[2] === 0x4e &&
 116:     buffer[3] === 0x47 &&
 117:     buffer[4] === 0x0d &&
 118:     buffer[5] === 0x0a &&
 119:     buffer[6] === 0x1a &&
 120:     buffer[7] === 0x0a
 121:   ) {
 122:     return 'image/png';
 123:   }
 124: 
 125:   if (
 126:     buffer.length >= 12 &&
 127:     buffer[0] === 0x52 &&
 128:     buffer[1] === 0x49 &&
 129:     buffer[2] === 0x46 &&
 130:     buffer[3] === 0x46 &&
 131:     buffer[8] === 0x57 &&
 132:     buffer[9] === 0x45 &&
 133:     buffer[10] === 0x42 &&
 134:     buffer[11] === 0x50
 135:   ) {
 136:     return 'image/webp';
 137:   }
 138: 
 139:   return null;
 140: }

 142: function looksLikePlainText(buffer: Buffer): boolean {
 143:   const sample = buffer.subarray(0, Math.min(buffer.length, 4096));
 144:   if (sample.length === 0) {
 145:     return true;
 146:   }
 147: 
 148:   let nonTextBytes = 0;
 149:   for (const b of sample) {
 150:     const isControlAllowed = b === 9 || b === 10 || b === 13;
 151:     const isPrintableAscii = b >= 32 && b <= 126;
 152:     const isUtf8HighByte = b >= 128;
 153:     if (!isControlAllowed && !isPrintableAscii && !isUtf8HighByte) {
 154:       nonTextBytes += 1;
 155:     }
 156:   }
 157: 
 158:   return nonTextBytes / sample.length < 0.02;
 159: }

  48: export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {

  57:   if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse au dossier' }, { status: 403 });
  58: 
  59:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  60:     where: { id, tenantId: user.tenantId },

 106: /**
 107:  * PATCH /api/dossiers/[id]/checklist
 108:  * Met a jour le statut d'un item (piece recue/validee)
 109:  */
 110: export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
 111:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 112:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 113: 
 114:   const { id } = await params;
 115:   const user = session.user as any;
 116:   const { itemId, status, notes } = await req.json();
 117: 
 118:   if (!itemId || !['missing', 'received', 'validated', 'rejected'].includes(status)) {
 119:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'itemId et status requis (missing/received/validated/rejected)' }, { status: 400 });
 120:   }
 121: 
 122:   const item = await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.findFirst({
 123:     where: { id: itemId, dossierId: id, tenantId: user.tenantId },
 124:   });
 125: 
 126:   if (!item) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Item non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 127: 
 128:   await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.update({
 129:     where: { id: itemId },
 130:     data: {
 131:       status,
 132:       receivedAt: status === 'received' ? new Date() : item.receivedAt,
 133:       notes: notes || item.notes,
 134:     },
 135:   });
 136: 
 137:   // Recalculate progress
 138:   const allItems = await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.findMany({ where: { dossierId: id } });
 139:   const received = allItems.filter(i => i.status === 'received' || i.status === 'validated').length;
 140:   const requiredItems = allItems.filter(i => i.required);
 141:   const requiredReceived = requiredItems.filter(i => i.status === 'received' || i.status === 'validated').length;
 142:   const complete = requiredReceived === requiredItems.length;
 143: 
 144:   await prisma.dossier.update({
 145:     where: { id },
 146:     data: { checklistReceived: received, checklistComplete: complete },
 147:   });
 148: 
 149:   return NextResponse.json({
 150:     success: true,
 151:     progress: { total: allItems.length, received, complete },
 152:     message: complete ? 'DOSSIER COMPLET â€” Action requise' : `${received}/${allItems.length} pieces recues`,
 153:   });
 154: }

   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/dossiers/[id]/honoraires
   9:  * Calcule les honoraires bases sur le temps passe et le taux horaire.
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const { id } = await params;
  16:   const user = session.user as any;
  17:   const tauxHoraire = parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('taux') || '150');
  18: 
  19:   if (!user.tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  20:   const access = await canAccessDossier({ userId: user.id, tenantId: user.tenantId, role: user.role, groups: user.groups, dossierId: id, action: 'read' });
  21:   if (!access.allowed) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  22: 
  23:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  24:     where: { id, tenantId: user.tenantId },
  25:     select: { id: true, numero: true, typeDossier: true, createdAt: true },
  26:   });
  27: 
  28:   if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  29: 
  30:   // Estimation temps par type de procedure
  31:   const tempsEstime: Record<string, { heures: number; detail: string[] }> = {
  32:     OQTF: { heures: 8, detail: ['Analyse dossier (2h)', 'Redaction recours (4h)', 'Audience TA (2h)'] },
  33:     OQTF_SANS_DELAI: { heures: 6, detail: ['Analyse urgente (1h)', 'Refere-liberte (3h)', 'Audience (2h)'] },
  34:     Asile: { heures: 12, detail: ['Entretien client (2h)', 'Preparation recit (4h)', 'Accompagnement OFPRA (3h)', 'Recours CNDA (3h)'] },
  35:     TitreSejour: { heures: 6, detail: ['Analyse (1h)', 'Constitution dossier (3h)', 'Recours (2h)'] },
  36:     Naturalisation: { heures: 5, detail: ['Analyse (1h)', 'Constitution dossier (3h)', 'Suivi (1h)'] },
  37:     RegroupementFamilial: { heures: 7, detail: ['Analyse (1h)', 'Constitution dossier (4h)', 'Recours si refus (2h)'] },
  38:   };
  39: 
  40:   const estimation = tempsEstime[dossier.typeDossier] || { heures: 5, detail: ['Estimation standard'] };
  41:   const montantHT = estimation.heures * tauxHoraire;
  42:   const tva = montantHT * 0.20;
  43:   const montantTTC = montantHT + tva;
  44: 
  45:   return NextResponse.json({
  46:     dossierId: id,
  47:     numero: dossier.numero,
  48:     typeDossier: dossier.typeDossier,
  49:     tauxHoraire: `${tauxHoraire} EUR/h`,

  51:     detail: estimation.detail,
  52:     montantHT: `${montantHT} EUR`,
  53:     tva: `${tva.toFixed(0)} EUR (20%)`,
  54:     montantTTC: `${montantTTC.toFixed(0)} EUR`,
  55:   });

src\app\api\dossiers\[id]\timeline\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/dossiers/[id]/timeline
   9:  * Retourne la timeline complete d'un dossier (evenements chronologiques)
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const { id } = await params;
  16:   const user = session.user as any;
  17:   const tenantId = user.tenantId as string | undefined;
  18:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  19: 
  20:   const access = await canAccessDossier({
  21:     userId: user.id,
  22:     tenantId,
  23:     role: user.role,
  24:     groups: user.groups,
  25:     dossierId: id,
  26:     action: 'read',
  27:   });
  28:   if (!access.allowed) {
  29:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  33:     where: { id, tenantId },
  34:     include: {
  35:       emails: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, select: { id: true, subject: true, from: true, createdAt: true } },
  36:       documents: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' }, select: { id: true, name: true, createdAt: true } },
  37:       legalDeadlines: { orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' }, select: { id: true, label: true, dueDate: true, status: true } },
  38:       checklistItems: { where: { status: { not: 'missing' } }, select: { id: true, label: true, receivedAt: true, status: true } },
  39:     },
  40:   });
  41: 
  42:   if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  43: 
  44:   // Construire la timeline
  45:   const events: any[] = [];
  46: 
  47:   // Creation
  48:   events.push({ type: 'creation', date: dossier.createdAt, label: `Dossier ${dossier.numero} cree`, icon: 'folder-plus' });
  49: 
  50:   // Emails
  51:   for (const email of dossier.emails) {
  52:     events.push({ type: 'email', date: email.createdAt, label: `Email: ${email.subject}`, detail: `De: ${email.from}`, icon: 'mail' });
  53:   }
  54: 
  55:   // Documents
  56:   for (const doc of dossier.documents) {
  57:     events.push({ type: 'document', date: doc.createdAt, label: `Document: ${doc.name}`, icon: 'file' });
  58:   }
  59: 
  60:   // Pieces recues
  61:   for (const item of dossier.checklistItems) {
  62:     if (item.receivedAt) {
  63:       events.push({ type: 'piece', date: item.receivedAt, label: `Piece recue: ${item.label}`, icon: 'check-circle' });
  64:     }
  65:   }
  66: 
  67:   // Deadlines
  68:   for (const dl of dossier.legalDeadlines) {
  69:     events.push({ type: 'deadline', date: dl.dueDate, label: dl.label, status: dl.status, icon: 'clock' });
  70:   }
  71: 
  72:   // Outcome
  73:   if (dossier.outcomeDate) {
  74:     events.push({ type: 'outcome', date: dossier.outcomeDate, label: `Decision: ${dossier.outcome}`, icon: 'gavel' });
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   // Trier par date
  78:   events.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime());
  79: 
  80:   return NextResponse.json({
  81:     dossierId: id,
  82:     numero: dossier.numero,
  83:     events,
  84:     total: events.length,
  85:   });
  86: }

  65: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {

  69:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  70:     }
  71:     const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  72:     if (!sessionTenantId) {
  73:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });

  78:       Object.fromEntries(searchParams.entries()),

  82:       return queryValidation.response;
  83:     }

   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

   6: interface TimelineEvent {
   7:   date: string;
   8:   type: 'email_recu' | 'email_envoye' | 'document' | 'deadline' | 'action' | 'creation';
   9:   title: string;
  10:   description: string;
  11:   source: string;
  12:   importance: 'haute' | 'moyenne' | 'basse';
  13: }

  15: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  16:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  18: 
  19:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  20:   const dossierId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('dossierId');
  21:   if (!dossierId || !tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'dossierId requis' }, { status: 400 });
  22: 
  23:   // VÃ©rifier accÃ¨s au dossier
  24:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  25:     where: { id: dossierId, tenantId },
  26:     include: { Client: true },
  27:   });
  28:   if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  29: 
  30:   // RÃ©cupÃ©rer tous les Ã©vÃ©nements liÃ©s
  31:   const [emails, documents, deadlines] = await Promise.all([
  32:     prisma.email.findMany({
  33:       where: { dossierId, tenantId },
  34:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  35:       select: { id: true, subject: true, from: true, createdAt: true, direction: true },
  36:     }),
  37:     prisma.document.findMany({
  38:       where: { dossierId, tenantId },
  39:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  40:       select: { id: true, title: true, type: true, createdAt: true, fileName: true },
  41:     }),
  42:     prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({
  43:       where: { dossierId, tenantId },
  44:       orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' },
  45:       select: { id: true, label: true, dueDate: true, status: true, type: true },
  46:     }),
  47:   ]);
  48: 
  49:   // Construire la timeline
  50:   const timeline: TimelineEvent[] = [];
  51: 
  52:   // CrÃ©ation du dossier
  53:   timeline.push({
  54:     date: (dossier.createdAt as Date).toISOString(),
  55:     type: 'creation',
  56:     title: `Dossier ${dossier.numero} ouvert`,
  57:     description: `Type: ${dossier.typeDossier} â€” Client: ${dossier.Client ? `${dossier.Client.firstName} ${dossier.Client.lastName}` : 'N/A'}`,
  58:     source: 'system',
  59:     importance: 'haute',
  60:   });
  61: 
  62:   // Emails
  63:   for (const email of emails) {
  64:     const isIncoming = !email.direction || email.direction === 'INCOMING';
  65:     timeline.push({
  66:       date: (email.createdAt as Date).toISOString(),
  67:       type: isIncoming ? 'email_recu' : 'email_envoye',
  68:       title: email.subject || 'Sans objet',
  69:       description: isIncoming ? `De: ${email.from || 'inconnu'}` : `EnvoyÃ© Ã : ${email.from || 'client'}`,
  70:       source: 'email',
  71:       importance: 'moyenne',
  72:     });
  73:   }
  74: 
  75:   // Documents
  76:   for (const doc of documents) {
  77:     timeline.push({
  78:       date: (doc.createdAt as Date).toISOString(),
  79:       type: 'document',
  80:       title: doc.title || doc.fileName || 'Document',
  81:       description: `Type: ${doc.type || 'autre'}`,
  82:       source: 'document',
  83:       importance: 'moyenne',
  84:     });
  85:   }
  86: 
  87:   // Deadlines
  88:   for (const dl of deadlines) {
  89:     timeline.push({
  90:       date: (dl.dueDate as Date).toISOString(),
  91:       type: 'deadline',
  92:       title: dl.label,
  93:       description: `Statut: ${dl.status} â€” Type: ${dl.type}`,
  94:       source: 'deadline',
  95:       importance: 'haute',
  96:     });

  98:

   1: /**
   2:  * PUT /api/drafts/[id]/validate â€” Valide un draft â†’ crÃ©e dossier + deadline auto
   3:  */
   4: 
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
   9: import { mapValidatedDraftToDossier } from '@/lib/mappers/draft.mapper';
  10: import { DossierService } from '@/lib/services/dossier.service';
  11: import { createAutoDeadline } from '@/lib/services/deadline-auto.service';
  12: import type { ValidateDraftPayload } from '@/types/draft.types';
  13: 
  14: export async function PUT(
  15:   request: NextRequest,
  16:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  17: ) {
  18:   try {
  19:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  20:     if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  21: 
  22:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  23:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  24:     if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  25: 
  26:     const { id } = await params;
  27:     const draft = await prisma.draft.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId, status: 'PENDING' } });
  28:     if (!draft) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Draft non trouvÃ© ou dÃ©jÃ  traitÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  29: 
  30:     const body: ValidateDraftPayload = await request.json();
  31:     if (!body.clientName || !body.clientEmail || !body.caseType) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'clientName, clientEmail et caseType requis' }, { status: 400 });
  33:     }
  34: 
  35:     const extractedData = JSON.parse(draft.extractedData);
  36: 
  37:     // 1. Trouver ou crÃ©er le client
  38:     let client = await prisma.client.findFirst({
  39:       where: { tenantId, email: body.clientEmail.toLowerCase() },
  40:     });
  41:     if (!client) {
  42:       const nameParts = body.clientName.split(' ');
  43:       client = await prisma.client.create({
  44:         data: {
  45:           tenantId,
  46:           firstName: nameParts[0] || 'Client',
  47:           lastName: nameParts.slice(1).join(' ') || body.clientName,
  48:           email: body.clientEmail.toLowerCase(),
  49:           phone: body.clientPhone || null,
  50:           status: 'actif',
  51:         },
  52:       });
  53:     }
  54: 
  55:     // 2. CrÃ©er le dossier
  56:     const dossierData = mapValidatedDraftToDossier(extractedData, body, client.id);
  57:     const dossier = await DossierService.createDossier(dossierData, tenantId);
  58: 
  59:     // 3. CrÃ©er la deadline automatique (Sprint 2)
  60:     let deadline: { id: string; dueDate: Date } | null = null;
  61:     try {
  62:       deadline = await createAutoDeadline({
  63:         dossierId: dossier.id,
  64:         tenantId,
  65:         clientId: client.id,
  66:         typeDossier: body.caseType,
  67:         caseSubType: body.caseSubType,
  68:         notificationDate: body.notificationDate ? new Date(body.notificationDate) : undefined,
  69:         createdBy: userId,
  70:       });
  71:     } catch (dlErr) {
  72:       console.error('[DRAFTS] Auto-deadline best-effort failed:', dlErr);
  73:     }
  74: 
  75:     // 4. Mettre Ã  jour le draft
  76:     await prisma.draft.update({
  77:       where: { id },
  78:       data: { status: 'VALIDATED', validatedBy: userId, validatedAt: new Date(), createdDossierId: dossier.id },
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     // 5. Lier l'email source au dossier
  82:     if (draft.sourceEmailId) {
  83:       await prisma.email.update({
  84:         where: { id: draft.sourceEmailId },

   1: /**
   2:  * GET  /api/drafts â€” Liste les drafts du tenant
   3:  * POST /api/drafts â€” CrÃ©e un draft depuis un email
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
  10: import { extractDraft } from '@/lib/adapters/email.adapter';
  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15:     if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  16: 
  17:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  18:     if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  19: 
  20:     const status = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('status') || 'PENDING';
  21: 
  22:     const drafts = await prisma.draft.findMany({
  23:       where: { tenantId, status },
  24:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  25:       include: {
  26:         sourceEmail: { select: { id: true, from: true, subject: true, receivedAt: true } },
  27:         createdDossier: { select: { id: true, numero: true } },
  28:       },
  29:     });
  30: 
  31:     const parsed = drafts.map(d => ({
  32:       ...d,
  33:       extractedData: JSON.parse(d.extractedData),
  34:       confidence: d.confidence ? JSON.parse(d.confidence) : {},
  35:     }));
  36: 
  37:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, drafts: parsed, count: parsed.length });
  38:   } catch (error) {
  39:     console.error('[DRAFTS] GET error:', error);
  40:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  41:   }
  42: }
  43: 
  44: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  45:   try {
  46:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  47:     if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  48: 
  49:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  50:     if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  51: 
  52:     const { emailId, from, subject, bodyText } = await request.json();
  53:     if (!from || !subject) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'from et subject requis' }, { status: 400 });
  54: 
  55:     if (emailId) {
  56:       const existing = await prisma.draft.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, sourceEmailId: emailId } });
  57:       if (existing) return NextResponse.json({ success: true, duplicate: true, draftId: existing.id });
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     const extracted = extractDraft({ from, subject, body: bodyText || '' });
  61: 
  62:     const draft = await prisma.draft.create({
  63:       data: {
  64:         tenantId,
  65:         status: 'PENDING',
  66:         extractedData: JSON.stringify(extracted),
  67:         confidence: JSON.stringify(extracted.confidence),
  68:         sourceEmailId: emailId || null,
  69:       },
  70:     });
  71: 
  72:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, draftId: draft.id, extractedData: extracted }, { status: 201 });
  73:   } catch (error) {
  74:     console.error('[DRAFTS] POST error:', error);
  75:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  76:   }
  77: }

src\app\api\email\connect\gmail\callback\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * GET /api/email/connect/gmail/callback
   7:  * 
   8:  * ReÃ§oit le code OAuth de Google aprÃ¨s consentement.
   9:  * Ã‰change le code contre des tokens, stocke de faÃ§on chiffrÃ©e.
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  12:   const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
  13:   const code = searchParams.get('code');
  14:   const state = searchParams.get('state');
  15:   const error = searchParams.get('error');
  16: 
  17:   const baseUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'https://memolib.space';
  18: 
  19:   // Erreur de l'utilisateur (refus de consentement)
  20:   if (error) {
  21:     logger.warn('[Gmail Connect] Consentement refusÃ©', { error });
  22:     return NextResponse.redirect(`${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?error=consent_denied`);
  23:   }
  24: 
  25:   if (!code || !state) {
  26:     return NextResponse.redirect(`${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?error=invalid_callback`);
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   // DÃ©coder le state
  30:   let tenantId: string;
  31:   let userId: string;
  32:   try {
  33:     const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(state, 'base64url').toString());
  34:     tenantId = decoded.tenantId;
  35:     userId = decoded.userId;
  36:   } catch {
  37:     return NextResponse.redirect(`${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?error=invalid_state`);
  38:   }
  39: 
  40:   const clientId = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID!;
  41:   const clientSecret = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET!;
  42:   const redirectUri = `${baseUrl}/api/email/connect/gmail/callback`;
  43: 
  44:   try {
  45:     // Ã‰changer le code contre des tokens
  46:     const tokenRes = await fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
  47:       method: 'POST',
  48:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
  49:       body: new URLSearchParams({
  50:         code,
  51:         client_id: clientId,
  52:         client_secret: clientSecret,
  53:         redirect_uri: redirectUri,
  54:         grant_type: 'authorization_code',
  55:       }).toString(),
  56:     });
  57: 
  58:     if (!tokenRes.ok) {
  59:       const err = await tokenRes.text();
  60:       logger.error('[Gmail Connect] Ã‰change token Ã©chouÃ©', { error: err });
  61:       return NextResponse.redirect(
  62:         `${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?error=token_exchange_failed`
  63:       );
  64:     }
  65: 
  66:     const tokens = await tokenRes.json();
  67: 
  68:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer l'email Google de l'utilisateur
  69:     const userInfoRes = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v2/userinfo', {
  70:       headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${tokens.access_token}` },
  71:     });
  72:     const userInfo = await userInfoRes.json();
  73:     const gmailAddress = userInfo.email as string;
  74: 
  75:     // Stocker la connexion Gmail en base
  76:     // On stocke dans EmailAccount (ou TenantSettings selon le schÃ©ma)
  77:     // Utilisation d'upsert pour Ã©viter les doublons
  78:     await prisma.emailAccount.upsert({
  79:       where: {
  80:         tenantId_email: {
  81:           tenantId,
  82:           email: gmailAddress,
  83:         },
  84:       },
  85:       update: {
  86:         provider: 'gmail',
  87:         accessToken: tokens.access_token,
  88:         refreshToken: tokens.refresh_token || undefined,
  89:         tokenExpiry: tokens.expires_in
  90:           ? new Date(Date.now() + tokens.expires_in * 1000)
  91:           : undefined,
  92:         isActive: true,
  93:         updatedAt: new Date(),
  94:       },
  95:       create: {
  96:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  97:         tenantId,
  98:         userId,
  99:         email: gmailAddress,
 100:         provider: 'gmail',
 101:         accessToken: tokens.access_token,
 102:         refreshToken: tokens.refresh_token || null,
 103:         tokenExpiry: tokens.expires_in
 104:           ? new Date(Date.now() + tokens.expires_in * 1000)
 105:           : null,
 106:         isActive: true,
 107:         updatedAt: new Date(),
 108:       },
 109:     });
 110: 
 111:     logger.info(`[Gmail Connect] BoÃ®te connectÃ©e: ${gmailAddress} pour tenant ${tenantId}`);
 112: 
 113:     // Redirection vers les paramÃ¨tres email avec succÃ¨s
 114:     return NextResponse.redirect(
 115:       `${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?success=gmail_connected&email=${encodeURIComponent(gmailAddress)}`
 116:     );
 117:   } catch (error) {
 118:     logger.error('[Gmail Connect] Erreur callback', error);
 119:     return NextResponse.redirect(
 120:       `${baseUrl}/fr/settings/emails?error=server_error`
 121:     );
 122:   }
 123: }

src\app\api\email\connect\gmail\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/email/connect/gmail
   9:  * 
  10:  * Redirige vers Google OAuth pour autoriser l'accÃ¨s Gmail (lecture emails).
  11:  * Flow sÃ©parÃ© de l'auth NextAuth â€” sert uniquement Ã  connecter la boÃ®te mail.
  12:  */
  13: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15:   const baseUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'https://memolib.space';
  16:   
  17:   if (!session?.user?.tenantId) {
  18:     return NextResponse.redirect(`${baseUrl}/fr/auth/login`);
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   const clientId = process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID;
  22:   if (!clientId) {
  23:     return NextResponse.json(
  24:       { error: 'Google OAuth non configurÃ© (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID manquant)' },
  25:       { status: 503 }
  26:     );
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   const redirectUri = `${baseUrl}/api/email/connect/gmail/callback`;
  30: 
  31:   // Scopes Gmail en lecture seule
  32:   const scopes = [
  33:     'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly',
  34:     'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email',
  35:   ].join(' ');
  36: 
  37:   // State = tenantId + userId (pour retrouver l'utilisateur au callback)
  38:   const state = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
  39:     tenantId: session.user.tenantId,
  40:     userId: session.user.id,
  41:   })).toString('base64url');
  42: 
  43:   const params = new URLSearchParams({
  44:     client_id: clientId,
  45:     redirect_uri: redirectUri,
  46:     response_type: 'code',
  47:     scope: scopes,
  48:     access_type: 'offline', // Pour obtenir un refresh_token
  49:     prompt: 'consent',      // Forcer le consentement pour le refresh_token
  50:     state,
  51:   });
  52: 
  53:   const googleAuthUrl = `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?${params.toString()}`;
  54: 
  55:   return NextResponse.redirect(googleAuthUrl);
  56: }

src\app\api\emails\[id]\integrate\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { createEventLog } from '@/lib/services/event-log.service';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * POST /api/emails/[id]/integrate
   9:  * 
  10:  * IntÃ©gration manuelle d'un email brut dans le systÃ¨me.
  11:  * L'avocat dÃ©cide explicitement d'intÃ©grer une info reÃ§ue.
  12:  * 
  13:  * Body optionnel : { dossierId?, clientId?, action: "integrate" | "archive" | "ignore" }
  14:  */
  15: export async function POST(
  16:   req: NextRequest,
  17:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  18: ) {
  19:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  20:   if (!session?.user) {
  21:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  22:   }
  23: 
  24:   const { id } = await params;
  25:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  26:   const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  27: 
  28:   const email = await prisma.email.findFirst({
  29:     where: { id, tenantId },
  30:   });
  31: 
  32:   if (!email) {
  33:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   if (email.processingStatus !== 'RECEIVED') {
  37:     return NextResponse.json({ error: `Email dÃ©jÃ  traitÃ© (Ã©tat: ${email.processingStatus})` }, { status: 409 });
  38:   }
  39: 
  40:   const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  41:   const action = body.action || 'integrate';
  42: 
  43:   if (action === 'archive' || action === 'ignore') {
  44:     await prisma.email.update({
  45:       where: { id },
  46:       data: {
  47:         processingStatus: action === 'archive' ? 'ARCHIVED' : 'IGNORED',
  48:         isArchived: action === 'archive',
  49:         processedAt: new Date(),
  50:       },
  51:     });
  52: 
  53:     await createEventLog({
  54:       eventType: 'FLOW_PROCESSED',
  55:       entityType: 'email',
  56:       entityId: id,
  57:       actorType: 'USER',
  58:       actorId: userId,
  59:       tenantId,
  60:       metadata: { action, reason: body.reason },
  61:     });
  62: 
  63:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, status: action === 'archive' ? 'ARCHIVED' : 'IGNORED' });
  64:   }
  65: 
  66:   // Action = integrate
  67:   const updateData: any = {
  68:     processingStatus: 'INTEGRATED',
  69:     isProcessed: true,
  70:     processedAt: new Date(),
  71:   };
  72: 
  73:   if (body.dossierId) {
  74:     const targetDossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({ where: { id: body.dossierId, tenantId } });
  75:     if (!targetDossier) {
  76:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouve dans ce cabinet' }, { status: 404 });
  77:     }
  78:     updateData.dossierId = body.dossierId;
  79:   }
  80:   if (body.clientId) {
  81:     const targetClient = await prisma.client.findFirst({ where: { id: body.clientId, tenantId } });
  82:     if (!targetClient) {
  83:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client non trouve dans ce cabinet' }, { status: 404 });
  84:     }
  85:     updateData.clientId = body.clientId;
  86:   }
  87:

   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * POST /api/emails/connect
   9:  * Body: { email, password }
  10:  * 
  11:  * L'avocat entre son email + mot de passe d'application.
  12:  * L'app dÃ©tecte le fournisseur, teste la connexion, et sauvegarde.
  13:  */
  14: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  15:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  17: 
  18:   const { email, password } = await req.json();
  19:   if (!email || !password) {
  20:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email et mot de passe requis' }, { status: 400 });
  21:   }
  22: 
  23:   const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();
  24:   const imap = getImapConfig(domain);
  25:   if (!imap) {
  26:     return NextResponse.json({ error: `Fournisseur "${domain}" non supportÃ©. Contactez le support.` }, { status: 400 });
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   // Test IMAP connection
  30:   const client = new ImapFlow({
  31:     host: imap.host,
  32:     port: imap.port,
  33:     secure: true,
  34:     auth: { user: email, pass: password },
  35:     logger: false,
  36:   });
  37: 
  38:   try {
  39:     await client.connect();
  40:     await client.logout();
  41:   } catch (e: any) {
  42:     const hint = domain.includes('gmail')
  43:       ? ' Pour Gmail: active la validation en 2 Ã©tapes puis crÃ©e un mot de passe d\'application sur https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords'
  44:       : '';
  45:     return NextResponse.json({
  46:       error: `Connexion Ã©chouÃ©e: identifiants invalides.${hint}`,
  47:     }, { status: 401 });
  48:   }
  49: 
  50:   // Save
  51:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  52:   await prisma.tenant.update({
  53:     where: { id: tenantId },
  54:     data: {
  55:       emailEnabled: true,
  56:       smtpHost: imap.host,
  57:       smtpPort: imap.port,
  58:       smtpUser: email,
  59:       smtpPassword: password,
  60:     },
  61:   });
  62: 
  63:   return NextResponse.json({
  64:     success: true,
  65:     message: `${email} connectÃ© via ${imap.name}. Les emails seront analysÃ©s automatiquement.`,
  66:   });
  67: }

 150: function parseDate(str: string): Date | null {
 151:   // Try DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY
 152:   const match = str.match(/(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{2,4})/);
 153:   if (match) {
 154:     const [, d, m, y] = match;
 155:     const year = y.length === 2 ? 2000 + parseInt(y) : parseInt(y);
 156:     return new Date(year, parseInt(m) - 1, parseInt(d));
 157:   }
 158:   // Try natural date
 159:   const natural = new Date(str);
 160:   return isNaN(natural.getTime()) ? null : natural;
 161: }

src\app\api\emails\fetch\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { ImapFlow } from 'imapflow';
   5: import { simpleParser } from 'mailparser';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * POST /api/emails/fetch
   9:  * RÃ©cupÃ¨re les derniers emails depuis Gmail IMAP et les injecte dans MemoLib
  10:  */
  11: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  14: 
  15:   const user = process.env.GMAIL_IMAP_USER;
  16:   const pass = process.env.GMAIL_IMAP_PASSWORD;
  17:   if (!user || !pass) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Gmail non configurÃ©' }, { status: 500 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('limit') || '10'), 50);
  22:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  23: 
  24:   const client = new ImapFlow({
  25:     host: 'imap.gmail.com',
  26:     port: 993,
  27:     secure: true,
  28:     auth: { user, pass },
  29:     logger: false,
  30:   });
  31: 
  32:   try {
  33:     await client.connect();
  34:     const lock = await client.getMailboxLock('INBOX');
  35: 
  36:     const emails: any[] = [];
  37:     // Fetch latest emails
  38:     const mailbox = client.mailbox;
  39:     const exists = mailbox ? (mailbox as any).exists || 0 : 0;
  40:     const messages = client.fetch(`${Math.max(1, exists - limit + 1)}:*`, {
  41:       envelope: true,
  42:       source: true,
  43:     });
  44: 
  45:     for await (const msg of messages) {
  46:       const source = msg.source;
  47:       if (!source) continue;
  48:       const parsed = await simpleParser(source as any);
  49:       emails.push({
  50:         from: parsed.from?.text || '',
  51:         subject: parsed.subject || '(sans objet)',
  52:         body: parsed.text || parsed.html || '',
  53:         date: parsed.date?.toISOString() || new Date().toISOString(),
  54:         messageId: parsed.messageId || `imap-${msg.seq}`,
  55:       });
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     lock.release();
  59:     await client.logout();
  60: 
  61:     // Inject into MemoLib webhook
  62:     const webhookUrl = `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000'}/api/webhooks/email-inbound`;
  63:     const secret = process.env.INCOMING_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET || process.env.EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET || 'demo';
  64:     let imported = 0;
  65: 
  66:     for (const email of emails) {
  67:       const res = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
  68:         method: 'POST',
  69:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-webhook-secret': secret },
  70:         body: JSON.stringify({ ...email, tenantId }),
  71:       });
  72:       const r = await res.json();
  73:       if (r.success || r.duplicate) imported++;
  74:     }
  75: 
  76:     return NextResponse.json({
  77:       success: true,
  78:       message: `${imported} emails importÃ©s depuis Gmail`,
  79:       total: emails.length,
  80:       imported,
  81:     });
  82:   } catch (e: any) {
  83:     return NextResponse.json({ error: `Gmail: ${e.message}` }, { status: 500 });
  84:   }
  85: }

src\app\api\emails\incoming\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Reception Email Entrant (Webhook)
   3:  * POST /api/emails/incoming - Recoit un email et declenche le workflow
   4:  * 
   5:  * Security: HMAC-SHA256 signature + timestamp verification
   6:  * Expected headers:
   7:  *   - x-webhook-signature: HMAC-SHA256 hash of body
   8:  *   - x-webhook-timestamp: Unix timestamp of request
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  12: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  13: import { eventLogService } from '@/lib/services/event-log.service';
  14: import { smartInboxService } from '@/lib/services/smart-inbox.service';
  15: import { filterRuleService } from '@/lib/services/filter-rule.service';
  16: import { analyzeEmail } from '@/lib/workflows/email-intelligence';
  17: import { PrismaClientKnownRequestError } from '@prisma/client/runtime/library';
  18: import { IncomingEmailPayloadSchema, normalizeIncomingEmailPayload } from '@/lib/email/ingestion';
  19: import { recordEmailIngestion } from '@/lib/email/ingestion-metrics';
  20: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  21: import { verifyWebhookRequest } from '@/lib/security/webhook-verification';
  22: import { createEmailActionProposal } from '@/lib/services/action-proposal.service';
  23: 
  24: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  25:   const startedAt = Date.now();
  26:   try {
  27:     const expectedWebhookSecret = process.env.INCOMING_EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  28:     if (!expectedWebhookSecret) {
  29:       logger.error('[EMAIL] Secret webhook entrant non configure');
  30:       recordEmailIngestion({
  31:         outcome: 'config_error',
  32:         durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  33:       });
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     const rawRequestBody = await request.text();
  38: 
  39:     // Verify webhook with HMAC signature and timestamp
  40:     const verification = verifyWebhookRequest(
  41:       request,
  42:       rawRequestBody,
  43:       expectedWebhookSecret,
  44:       {
  45:         signatureHeader: 'x-webhook-signature',
  46:         timestampHeader: 'x-webhook-timestamp',
  47:         maxAge: 5 * 60, // 5 minutes
  48:       }
  49:     );
  50: 
  51:     if (!verification.valid) {
  52:       logger.warn('[EMAIL_WEBHOOK] Signature verification failed');
  53:       recordEmailIngestion({
  54:         outcome: 'unauthorized',
  55:         durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  56:       });
  57:       return verification.response;
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     let requestBody: unknown;
  61:     try {
  62:       requestBody = JSON.parse(rawRequestBody);
  63:     } catch {
  64:       recordEmailIngestion({
  65:         outcome: 'invalid_json',
  66:         durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  67:       });
  68:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     const parsedPayload = IncomingEmailPayloadSchema.safeParse(requestBody);
  72:     if (!parsedPayload.success) {
  73:       recordEmailIngestion({
  74:         outcome: 'invalid_payload',
  75:         durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
  76:       });
  77:       return NextResponse.json(
  78:         { error: 'Payload email invalide', details: parsedPayload.error.flatten() },
  79:         { status: 400 }
  80:       );
  81:     }
  82: 
  83:     const normalized = normalizeIncomingEmailPayload(parsedPayload.data, rawRequestBody);
  84:     const { from, to, subject, body: emailBody, htmlBody, attachments, messageId } = normalized;
  85: 
  86:     // Trouver le tenant destinataire base sur l'email "to"
  87:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findFirst({
  88:       where: {
  89:         users: {
  90:           some: {
  91:             email: { in: normalized.tenantLookupRecipients },
  92:             role: { in: ['ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'USER'] },
  93:           },
  94:         },
  95:       },
  96:     });
  97: 
  98:     if (!tenant) {
  99:       logger.info(`[EMAIL] Aucun tenant trouve pour: ${to}`);
 100:       recordEmailIngestion({
 101:         outcome: 'tenant_not_found',
 102:         durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
 103:         to,
 104:       });
 105:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Destinataire non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
 106:     }
 107: 
 108:     const duplicateEmail = await findDuplicateEmail(tenant.id, normalized);
 109:     if (duplicateEmail) {
 110:       try {

   8:  * 
   9:  * L'avocat colle le contenu d'un email. L'app l'analyse automatiquement.

  13:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

  34:       messageId: `paste-${Date.now()}@memolib.local`,

  37:

  19:   if (status) where.processingStatus = status;
  20: 
  21:   const emails = await prisma.email.findMany({
  22:     where,
  23:     orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' },

  28:       subject: true,
  29:       body: true,
  30:       category: true,
  31:       urgency: true,
  32:       receivedAt: true,
  33:       processingStatus: true,
  34:       aiAnalysis: true,
  35:       hasAttachments: true,
  36:     },
  37:   });
  38: 
  39:   return NextResponse.json({ emails, total: emails.length });
  40: }

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: POST /api/emails/send

   4:  * Permet Ã  un avocat d'envoyer un email depuis MemoLib.
   5:  * L'email est envoyÃ© via le service email configurÃ© (Resend/SendGrid/SMTP)

  15: import crypto from 'crypto';
  16: 
  17: const sendEmailSchema = z.object({
  18:   to: z.string().email('Adresse email destinataire invalide'),
  19:   subject: z.string().min(1, 'Objet requis').max(500),
  20:   body: z.string().min(1, 'Corps du message requis').max(50000),

  22:   clientId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  23:   replyToEmailId: z.string().optional(),
  24: });
  25: 
  26: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  27:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  28:   if (!session?.user) {
  29:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   const user = session.user as any;
  33:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  34:   if (!tenantId) {
  35:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  36:   }
  37: 
  38:   let requestBody: Record<string, unknown>;
  39:   try {
  40:     requestBody = await req.json();
  41:   } catch {
  42:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  43:   }
  44: 
  45:   const parsed = sendEmailSchema.safeParse(requestBody);
  46:   if (!parsed.success) {
  47:     return NextResponse.json(
  48:       { error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message || 'DonnÃ©es invalides' },
  49:       { status: 400 }
  50:     );
  51:   }
  52: 
  53:   const { to, subject, body, dossierId, clientId, replyToEmailId } = parsed.data;
  54: 
  55:   try {
  56:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer les infos du tenant pour le from
  57:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  58:       where: { id: tenantId },
  59:       select: { name: true, billingEmail: true },
  60:     });
  61: 
  62:     const fromName = user.name || tenant?.name || 'MemoLib';
  63:     const fromEmail = tenant?.billingEmail || user.email || 'noreply@memolib.fr';
  64: 
  65:     // Envoyer l'email via le service
  66:     await sendEmail({
  67:       to,
  68:       subject,
  69:       html: `<div style="font-family: sans-serif; white-space: pre-wrap;">${body.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</div>
  70:         <br><hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #eee; margin-top: 20px;">
  71:         <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #999;">EnvoyÃ© via MemoLib par ${fromName}</p>`,
  72:       from: `${fromName} <${fromEmail}>`,
  73:       replyTo: user.email,
  74:     });
  75: 
  76:     // Sauvegarder dans l'historique (email sortant)
  77:     const savedEmail = await prisma.email.create({
  78:       data: {
  79:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  80:         tenantId,
  81:         from: `${fromName} <${fromEmail}>`,
  82:         to,
  83:         subject,
  84:         body,
  85:         sourceDirection: 'outbound',
  86:         sourceChannel: 'email',
  87:         sourceProvider: 'app',
  88:         isRead: true,
  89:         isProcessed: true,
  90:         dossierId: dossierId || undefined,
  91:         clientId: clientId || undefined,
  92:         receivedAt: new Date(),
  93:         createdAt: new Date(),
  94:         updatedAt: new Date(),
  95:       },
  96:     });
  97: 
  98:     // Si c'est une rÃ©ponse, lier au thread
  99:     if (replyToEmailId) {
 100:       const originalEmail = await prisma.email.findUnique({
 101:         where: { id: replyToEmailId },
 102:         select: { threadId: true },
 103:       });
 104:       if (originalEmail?.threadId) {
 105:         await prisma.email.update({
 106:           where: { id: savedEmail.id },
 107:           data: { threadId: originalEmail.threadId },
 108:         });
 109:       }
 110:     }
 111: 
 112:     return NextResponse.json({
 113:       success: true,
 114:       emailId: savedEmail.id,
 115:       message: `Email envoyÃ© Ã  ${to}`,
 116:     });
 117:   } catch (error) {
 118:     console.error('Email send error:', error);
 119:     return NextResponse.json(
 120:       { error: 'Impossible d\'envoyer l\'email. VÃ©rifiez la configuration email (RESEND_API_KEY).' },
 121:       { status: 500 }
 122:     );
 123:   }
 124: }
