   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { z } from 'zod';
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
   5: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   6: import { NotificationService } from '@/lib/notifications';
   7: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: 
   9: const internalRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'MANAGER']);
  10: const invoiceStatuses = ['brouillon', 'envoyee', 'payee', 'annulee'] as const;
  11: 
  12: const CreateFactureSchema = z.object({
  13:   clientId: z.string().min(1),
  14:   dossierId: z.string().min(1).nullable().optional(),
  15:   description: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  16:   lignes: z.array(z.object({
  17:     description: z.string().trim().min(1).max(1_000),
  18:     quantite: z.number().positive().max(1_000).optional(),
  19:     prixUnitaire: z.number().positive().max(1_000_000),
  20:   })).min(1),
  21:   tauxTVA: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
  22:   dateEcheance: z.coerce.date().optional(),
  23:   notes: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  24:   conditions: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  25:   notifyUserId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  26: });
  27: 
  28: const UpdateFactureSchema = z.object({
  29:   factureId: z.string().min(1),
  30:   statut: z.enum(invoiceStatuses),
  31:   datePaiement: z.coerce.date().optional(),
  32:   modePaiement: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  33:   referencePayment: z.string().max(255).optional(),
  34: });
  35: 
  36: async function resolveAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null) {
  37:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  38:   if (!session?.user) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 }) };
  39: 
  40:   const user = session.user as { id?: string; tenantId?: string; role?: string };
  41:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  42:   if (!user.id) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Session invalide' }, { status: 401 }) };
  43:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && requestedTenantId) {
  44:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, userId: user.id, role };
  45:   }
  46:   if (!user.tenantId) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 }) };
  47:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== user.tenantId) {
  48:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  49:   }
  50:   return { tenantId: user.tenantId, userId: user.id, role };
  51: }
  52: 
  53: function canManageInvoices(role: string) {
  54:   return internalRoles.has(role);
  55: }
  56: 
  57: // GET - Liste des factures du tenant de la session
  58: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  59:   try {
  60:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  61:     const access = await resolveAccess(searchParams.get('tenantId'));
  62:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
  63:     if (!canManageInvoices(access.role)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  64: 
  65:     const clientId = searchParams.get('clientId');
  66:     const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  67:     const statut = searchParams.get('statut');
  68:     const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') ?? '50', 10) || 50));
  69:     const offset = Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') ?? '0', 10) || 0);
  70:     const where = {
  71:       tenantId: access.tenantId,
  72:       ...(clientId ? { clientId } : {}),
  73:       ...(dossierId ? { dossierId } : {}),
  74:       ...(statut && invoiceStatuses.includes(statut as (typeof invoiceStatuses)[number]) ? { statut } : {}),
  75:     };
  76: 
  77:     const [factures, stats] = await Promise.all([
  78:       prisma.facture.findMany({
  79:         where,
  80:         include: {
  81:           client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true, email: true } },
  82:           dossier: { select: { numero: true, typeDossier: true } },
  83:           lignes: true,
  84:           paiements: true,
  85:         },
  86:         orderBy: { dateEmission: 'desc' },
  87:         take: limit,
  88:         skip: offset,
  89:       }),
  90:       prisma.facture.groupBy({
  91:         by: ['statut'],
  92:         where: { tenantId: access.tenantId },
  93:         _count: true,
  94:         _sum: { montantTTC: true },
  95:       }),
  96:     ]);
  97: 
  98:     return NextResponse.json({ factures, stats });
  99:   } catch (error) {
 100:     logger.error('Erreur GET factures', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/factures' });
 101:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 102:   }
 103: }

 105: // POST - Cree une facture avec ses lignes dans une transaction
 106: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
 107:   try {
 108:     const access = await resolveAccess(null);
 109:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
 110:     if (!canManageInvoices(access.role)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
 111: 
 112:     const parsed = CreateFactureSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
 113:     if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide', details: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });
 114:     const data = parsed.data;
 115: 
 116:     const client = await prisma.client.findFirst({
 117:       where: { id: data.clientId, tenantId: access.tenantId },
 118:       select: { id: true },
 119:     });
 120:     if (!client) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Client introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
 121: 
 122:     if (data.dossierId) {
 123:       const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
 124:         where: { id: data.dossierId, clientId: data.clientId, tenantId: access.tenantId },
 125:         select: { id: true },
 126:       });
 127:       if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
 128:     }
 129: 
 130:     if (data.notifyUserId) {
 131:       const recipient = await prisma.user.findFirst({
 132:         where: { id: data.notifyUserId, tenantId: access.tenantId, status: 'active' },
 133:         select: { id: true },
 134:       });
 135:       if (!recipient) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Destinataire introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
 136:     }
 137: 
 138:     const montantHT = data.lignes.reduce((total, ligne) => total + (ligne.quantite ?? 1) * ligne.prixUnitaire, 0);
 139:     const tauxTVA = data.tauxTVA ?? 20;
 140:     const montantTVA = montantHT * (tauxTVA / 100);
 141:     const montantTTC = montantHT + montantTVA;
 142:     const now = new Date();
 143: 
 144:     const facture = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 145:       const year = now.getFullYear();
 146:       const lastFacture = await tx.facture.findFirst({
 147:         where: { tenantId: access.tenantId, numero: { startsWith: `FAC-${year}-` } },
 148:         orderBy: { numero: 'desc' },
 149:         select: { numero: true },
 150:       });
 151:       const lastNumber = lastFacture?.numero.match(/FAC-\d{4}-(\d+)/)?.[1];
 152:       const numero = `FAC-${year}-${String((lastNumber ? Number.parseInt(lastNumber, 10) : 0) + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`;
 153: 
 154:       return tx.facture.create({
 155:         data: {
 156:           id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 157:           tenantId: access.tenantId,
 158:           clientId: data.clientId,
 159:           dossierId: data.dossierId,
 160:           numero,
 161:           description: data.description,
 162:           montantHT,
 163:           tauxTVA,
 164:           montantTVA,
 165:           montantTTC,
 166:           dateEcheance: data.dateEcheance ?? new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 86_400_000),
 167:           notes: data.notes,
 168:           conditions: data.conditions,
 169:           statut: 'brouillon',
 170:           updatedAt: now,
 171:           lignes: {
 172:             create: data.lignes.map((ligne, ordre) => {
 173:               const quantite = ligne.quantite ?? 1;
 174:               return {
 175:                 id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 176:                 description: ligne.description,
 177:                 quantite,
 178:                 prixUnitaire: ligne.prixUnitaire,
 179:                 montantHT: quantite * ligne.prixUnitaire,
 180:                 ordre,
 181:               };
 182:             }),
 183:           },
 184:         },
 185:         include: { Client: true, LigneFacture: true },
 186:       });
 187:     });
 188: 
 189:     if (data.notifyUserId) {
 190:       await NotificationService.factureCreated(data.notifyUserId, {
 191:         numero: facture.numero,
 192:         montant: facture.montantTTC,
 193:         factureId: facture.id,
 194:       });
 195:     }
 196: 
 197:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, facture }, { status: 201 });
 198:   } catch (error) {
 199:     logger.error('Erreur POST facture', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/factures' });
 200:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 201:   }
 202: }
 203: 
 204: // PATCH - Met a jour une facture appartenant au tenant de la session
 205: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 206:   try {
 207:     const access = await resolveAccess(null);
 208:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
 209:     if (!canManageInvoices(access.role)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
 210: 
 211:     const parsed = UpdateFactureSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
 212:     if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide', details: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });
 213:     const existing = await prisma.facture.findFirst({
 214:       where: { id: parsed.data.factureId, tenantId: access.tenantId },
 215:       select: { id: true },
 216:     });
 217:     if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Facture introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
 218: 
 219:     const facture = await prisma.facture.update({
 220:       where: { id: existing.id },
 221:       data: {
 222:         statut: parsed.data.statut,
 223:         ...(parsed.data.statut === 'payee'
 224:           ? {
 225:               datePaiement: parsed.data.datePaiement ?? new Date(),
 226:               modePaiement: parsed.data.modePaiement,
 227:               referencePayment: parsed.data.referencePayment,
 228:             }
 229:           : {}),
 230:       },
 231:       include: {
 232:         client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 233:         dossier: { select: { typeDossier: true } },
 234:       },
 235:     });
 236: 
 237:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, facture });
 238:   } catch (error) {
 239:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH facture', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/factures' });
 240:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 241:   }
 242: }

  31:             impactScore: true,
  32:           },
  33:         },
  34:       },
  35:     });
  36:

  38:   } catch (error) {

src\app\api\forms\resource-request\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  *  API: Soumission de demande de ressources
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const data = await request.json();
  18:     const {
  19:       resourceType,
  20:       justification,
  21:       urgency,
  22:       estimatedCost,
  23:       duration,
  24:       alternatives,
  25:       metadata,
  26:     } = data;
  27: 
  28:     // Creer la demande dans la base de donnees
  29:     const submission = await prisma.$executeRaw`
  30:       INSERT INTO FormSubmission (
  31:         id, formType, submitterId, status, data, impactScore,
  32:         requiresApproval, createdAt, updatedAt
  33:       ) VALUES (
  34:         ${generateId()},
  35:         'resource-request',
  36:         ${session.user.email},
  37:         'pending',
  38:         ${JSON.stringify(data)},
  39:         ${metadata.impactScore},
  40:         ${metadata.requiresApproval},
  41:         ${new Date().toISOString()},
  42:         ${new Date().toISOString()}
  43:       )
  44:     `;
  45: 
  46:     // Si approbation requise, creer les taches d'approbation
  47:     if (metadata.requiresApproval && metadata.approvers) {
  48:       for (const approver of metadata.approvers) {
  49:         await createApprovalTask(submission, approver, metadata);
  50:       }
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     // Envoyer notification par email
  54:     await sendNotificationEmail(metadata.approvers, {
  55:       formType: 'Demande de ressources',
  56:       submitter: session.user.email,
  57:       urgency,
  58:       impactScore: metadata.impactScore,
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     return NextResponse.json({
  62:       success: true,
  63:       submissionId: submission,
  64:       message: 'Demande soumise avec succes',
  65:     });
  66:   } catch (error) {
  67:     logger.error('Erreur soumission:', { error });
  68:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors de la soumission' }, { status: 500 });
  69:   }
  70: }
  71: 
  72: async function createApprovalTask(submissionId: any, approver: string, metadata: any) {
  73:   // Creer une tache d'approbation
  74:   await prisma.$executeRaw`
  75:     INSERT INTO ApprovalTask (
  76:       id, submissionId, approverRole, status, dueDate, createdAt
  77:     ) VALUES (
  78:       ${generateId()},
  79:       ${submissionId},
  80:       ${approver},
  81:       'pending',
  82:       ${new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()},
  83:       ${new Date().toISOString()}
  84:     )
  85:   `;
  86: }
  87: 
  88: async function sendNotificationEmail(approvers: string[], context: any) {
  89:   // Integration avec le systeme d'email
  90:   // Pour l'instant, log uniquement
  91:   logger.info('Email notification:', { approvers, context });
  92: }

src\app\api\forms\risk-assessment\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * ️ API: Soumission d'evaluation des risques
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const data = await request.json();
  18:     const {
  19:       riskCategory,
  20:       riskDescription,
  21:       probability,
  22:       severity,
  23:       mitigationPlan,
  24:       responsiblePerson,
  25:       metadata,
  26:     } = data;
  27: 
  28:     // Calculer le score de risque (matrice probabilite x severite)
  29:     const riskScore = calculateRiskScore(probability, severity);
  30:     const priorityLevel = getRiskPriority(riskScore);
  31: 
  32:     // Creer l'evaluation de risque
  33:     const assessment = await prisma.$executeRaw`
  34:       INSERT INTO RiskAssessment (
  35:         id, category, description, probability, severity,
  36:         riskScore, priorityLevel, mitigationPlan, responsiblePerson,
  37:         status, submitterId, createdAt, updatedAt
  38:       ) VALUES (
  39:         ${generateId()},
  40:         ${riskCategory},
  41:         ${riskDescription},
  42:         ${probability},
  43:         ${severity},
  44:         ${riskScore},
  45:         ${priorityLevel},
  46:         ${mitigationPlan},
  47:         ${responsiblePerson},
  48:         'active',
  49:         ${session.user.email},
  50:         ${new Date().toISOString()},
  51:         ${new Date().toISOString()}
  52:       )
  53:     `;
  54: 
  55:     // Si risque critique, creer une alerte immediate
  56:     if (priorityLevel === 'critical') {
  57:       await createCriticalRiskAlert(assessment, {
  58:         category: riskCategory,
  59:         description: riskDescription,
  60:         riskScore,
  61:       });
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     // Generer plan d'action IA
  65:     const aiActionPlan = await generateAIActionPlan({
  66:       category: riskCategory,
  67:       probability,
  68:       severity,
  69:       currentMitigation: mitigationPlan,
  70:     });
  71: 
  72:     return NextResponse.json({
  73:       success: true,
  74:       assessmentId: assessment,
  75:       riskScore,
  76:       priorityLevel,
  77:       aiActionPlan,
  78:       message: 'evaluation de risque enregistree',
  79:     });
  80:   } catch (error) {
  81:     logger.error('Erreur evaluation risque:', { error });
  82:     return NextResponse.json({ error: "Erreur lors de l'evaluation" }, { status: 500 });
  83:   }
  84: }
  85: 
  86: function calculateRiskScore(probability: string, severity: string): number {
  87:   const probValues: Record<string, number> = {
  88:     'very-low': 1,
  89:     low: 2,
  90:     medium: 3,
  91:     high: 4,
  92:     'very-high': 5,
  93:   };
  94: 
  95:   const sevValues: Record<string, number> = {
  96:     negligible: 1,
  97:     minor: 2,
  98:     moderate: 3,
  99:     major: 4,
 100:     critical: 5,
 101:   };
 102: 
 103:   return probValues[probability] * sevValues[severity];
 104: }
 105: 
 106: function getRiskPriority(score: number): string {
 107:   if (score >= 20) return 'critical';
 108:   if (score >= 12) return 'high';
 109:   if (score >= 6) return 'medium';
 110:   return 'low';
 111: }
 112: 
 113: async function createCriticalRiskAlert(assessmentId: any, context: any) {
 114:   // Creer une alerte dans le systeme
 115:   await prisma.$executeRaw`
 116:     INSERT INTO Alert (
 117:       id, type, severity, title, description, status, createdAt
 118:     ) VALUES (
 119:       ${generateId()},
 120:       'risk-critical',
 121:       'critical',
 122:       ${'Risque critique identifie: ' + context.category},
 123:       ${context.description},
 124:       'active',
 125:       ${new Date().toISOString()}
 126:     )
 127:   `;
 128: 
 129:   // Notifier les responsables
 130:   logger.warn('ALERTE CRITIQUE', { context });
 131: }
 132: 
 133: async function generateAIActionPlan(data: any): Promise<any> {
 134:   try {
 135:     const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
 136:       method: 'POST',
 137:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 138:       body: JSON.stringify({
 139:         model: 'llama3.2:latest',
 140:         prompt: `En tant qu'expert en gestion des risques, analyse ce risque et propose un plan d'action detaille.
 141: 
 142: Categorie: ${data.category}
 143: Probabilite: ${data.probability}
 144: Severite: ${data.severity}
 145: Mitigation actuelle: ${data.currentMitigation}
 146: 
 147: Fournis:
 148: 1. Actions immediates (0-7 jours)
 149: 2. Actions a moyen terme (1-3 mois)
 150: 3. Actions preventives long terme
 151: 4. Indicateurs de suivi (KPIs)
 152: 
 153: Sois concis et actionnable.`,
 154:         stream: false,
 155:       }),
 156:     });
 157: 
 158:     if (response.ok) {
 159:       const aiData = await response.json();
 160:       return {
 161:         plan: aiData.response,
 162:         confidence: 0.85,
 163:       };
 164:     }
 165:   } catch (error) {
 166:     logger.error('Erreur generation plan IA:', { error });
 167:   }
 168: 
 169:   return {
 170:     plan: "Plan d'action IA non disponible - suivre le plan de mitigation manuel",
 171:     confidence: 0,
 172:   };
 173: }
 174: 
 175: function generateId(): string {
 176:   return `risk_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
 177: }

   8:  */

  10: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });

  16: 
  17:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  18:     const priority = searchParams.get('priority');
  19:

  21:       status: 'active',

  26:       where.priorityLevel = { in: priorities };

  30:       where,
  31:       orderBy: { riskScore: 'desc' },
  32:       select: {

  36:         probability: true,

  39:         priorityLevel: true,
  40:         mitigationPlan: true,
  41:         status: true,
  42:         submitterEmail: true,
  43:         createdAt: true,
  44:       },
  45:     });
  46: 
  47:     return NextResponse.json(risks);
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     logger.error('Erreur liste risques:', { error });
  50:     return NextResponse.json(
  51:       { error: 'Erreur lors du chargement des risques' },
  52:       { status: 500 }
  53:     );
  54:   }
  55: }

src\app\api\forms\stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  *  API: Statistiques du systeme de formulaires
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     // Statistiques globales
  18:     const [
  19:       totalSubmissions,
  20:       pendingApprovals,
  21:       criticalRisks,
  22:       strategicDecisions,
  23:       approvedSubmissions,
  24:     ] = await Promise.all([
  25:       prisma.formSubmission.count(),
  26:       prisma.approvalTask.count({ where: { status: 'pending' } }),
  27:       prisma.riskAssessment.count({ where: { priorityLevel: 'critical' } }),
  28:       prisma.strategicDecision.count({ where: { status: 'pending-approval' } }),
  29:       prisma.formSubmission.count({ where: { status: 'approved' } }),
  30:     ]);
  31: 
  32:     // Calculer le taux d'approbation
  33:     const approvalRate = totalSubmissions > 0 
  34:       ? Math.round((approvedSubmissions / totalSubmissions) * 100)
  35:       : 0;
  36: 
  37:     // Calculer le score d'impact moyen
  38:     const avgImpactResult = await prisma.formSubmission.aggregate({
  39:       _avg: {
  40:         impactScore: true,
  41:       },
  42:       where: {
  43:         impactScore: { not: null },
  44:       },
  45:     });
  46: 
  47:     const averageImpactScore = avgImpactResult._avg.impactScore || 0;
  48: 
  49:     return NextResponse.json({
  50:       totalSubmissions,
  51:       pendingApprovals,
  52:       criticalRisks,
  53:       strategicDecisions,
  54:       approvalRate,
  55:       averageImpactScore,
  56:     });
  57:   } catch (error) {
  58:     logger.error('Erreur statistiques:', { error });
  59:     return NextResponse.json(
  60:       { error: 'Erreur lors du chargement des statistiques' },
  61:       { status: 500 }
  62:     );
  63:   }
  64: }

src\app\api\forms\strategic-decision\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * 🎯 API: Soumission de decision strategique
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const data = await request.json();
  18:     const { 
  19:       decisionTitle, 
  20:       context, 
  21:       proposedSolution, 
  22:       expectedImpact, 
  23:       risks, 
  24:       timeline, 
  25:       kpis,
  26:       metadata 
  27:     } = data;
  28: 
  29:     // Calculer le score de risque
  30:     const riskScore = await analyzeDecisionRisks({
  31:       proposedSolution,
  32:       risks,
  33:       expectedImpact,
  34:     });
  35: 
  36:     // Creer la soumission
  37:     const submission = await prisma.$executeRaw`
  38:       INSERT INTO StrategicDecision (
  39:         id, title, context, proposedSolution, expectedImpact,
  40:         risks, timeline, kpis, riskScore, status, submitterId,
  41:         createdAt, updatedAt
  42:       ) VALUES (
  43:         ${generateId()},
  44:         ${decisionTitle},
  45:         ${context},
  46:         ${proposedSolution},
  47:         ${JSON.stringify(expectedImpact)},
  48:         ${risks},
  49:         ${timeline},
  50:         ${kpis},
  51:         ${riskScore},
  52:         'pending-approval',
  53:         ${session.user.email},
  54:         ${new Date().toISOString()},
  55:         ${new Date().toISOString()}
  56:       )
  57:     `;
  58: 
  59:     // Creer workflow d'approbation multi-niveaux
  60:     if (metadata.requiresApproval) {
  61:       await createApprovalWorkflow(submission, metadata.approvers, {
  62:         title: decisionTitle,
  63:         riskScore,
  64:         impactScore: metadata.impactScore,
  65:       });
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     // Analyser avec l'IA et generer recommandations
  69:     const aiAnalysis = await getAIDecisionAnalysis(data);
  70: 
  71:     return NextResponse.json({
  72:       success: true,
  73:       submissionId: submission,
  74:       riskScore,
  75:       aiAnalysis,
  76:       message: 'Decision soumise pour approbation',
  77:     });
  78:   } catch (error) {
  79:     logger.error('Erreur soumission decision:', { error });
  80:     return NextResponse.json(
  81:       { error: 'Erreur lors de la soumission' },
  82:       { status: 500 }
  83:     );
  84:   }
  85: }
  86: 
  87: async function analyzeDecisionRisks(data: any): Promise<number> {
  88:   // Analyse basique des risques
  89:   // Dans une version avancee, utiliser l'IA pour l'analyse
  90:   const riskFactors = {
  91:     hasRiskMitigation: data.risks && data.risks.length > 100 ? 1 : 0,
  92:     impactBreadth: data.expectedImpact.length || 0,
  93:     solutionClarity: data.proposedSolution.length > 200 ? 1 : 0,
  94:   };
  95: 
  96:   const score = Object.values(riskFactors).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  97:   return Math.min(10, score * 2);
  98: }
  99: 
 100: async function createApprovalWorkflow(
 101:   submissionId: any, 
 102:   approvers: string[], 
 103:   context: any
 104: ) {
 105:   // Creer un workflow sequentiel
 106:   for (let i = 0; i < approvers.length; i++) {
 107:     await prisma.$executeRaw`
 108:       INSERT INTO ApprovalTask (
 109:         id, submissionId, approverRole, status, level, dueDate, createdAt
 110:       ) VALUES (
 111:         ${generateId()},
 112:         ${submissionId},
 113:         ${approvers[i]},
 114:         ${i === 0 ? 'pending' : 'waiting'},
 115:         ${i + 1},
 116:         ${new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()},
 117:         ${new Date().toISOString()}
 118:       )
 119:     `;
 120:   }
 121: }
 122: 
 123: async function getAIDecisionAnalysis(data: any): Promise<any> {
 124:   try {
 125:     // Appeler Ollama pour analyse
 126:     const response = await fetch('http://localhost:11434/api/generate', {
 127:       method: 'POST',
 128:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
 129:       body: JSON.stringify({
 130:         model: 'llama3.2:latest',
 131:         prompt: `Analyse cette decision strategique et fournis:
 132: 1. Points forts de la proposition (2-3 points)
 133: 2. Points de vigilance (2-3 points)
 134: 3. Recommandations d'amelioration (2-3 points)
 135: 
 136: Decision: ${data.decisionTitle}
 137: Contexte: ${data.context}
 138: Solution proposee: ${data.proposedSolution}
 139: Risques identifies: ${data.risks}
 140: 
 141: Fournis une analyse concise et actionnable.`,
 142:         stream: false,
 143:       }),
 144:     });
 145: 
 146:     if (response.ok) {
 147:       const aiData = await response.json();
 148:       return {
 149:         analysis: aiData.response,
 150:         confidence: 0.8,
 151:       };
 152:     }
 153:   } catch (error) {
 154:     logger.error('Erreur analyse IA:', { error });
 155:   }
 156: 
 157:   return {
 158:     analysis: 'Analyse IA non disponible',
 159:     confidence: 0,
 160:   };
 161: }

src\app\api\forms\submissions\route.ts

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  *  API: Liste des soumissions de formulaires
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession();
  13:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16: 
  17:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  18:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');
  19:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  20:     const formType = searchParams.get('formType');
  21: 
  22:     const where: any = {};
  23:     if (status) where.status = status;
  24:     if (formType) where.formType = formType;
  25: 
  26:     const submissions = await prisma.formSubmission.findMany({
  27:       where,
  28:       orderBy: { submittedAt: 'desc' },
  29:       take: limit,
  30:       select: {
  31:         id: true,
  32:         formType: true,
  33:         submitterEmail: true,
  34:         status: true,
  35:         impactScore: true,
  36:         submittedAt: true,
  37:         data: true,
  38:       },
  39:     });
  40: 
  41:     // Parser les donnees JSON
  42:     const parsedSubmissions = submissions.map((sub) => ({
  43:       ...sub,
  44:       data: JSON.parse(sub.data),
  45:     }));
  46: 
  47:     return NextResponse.json(parsedSubmissions);
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     logger.error('Erreur liste soumissions:', { error });
  50:     return NextResponse.json(
  51:       { error: 'Erreur lors du chargement des soumissions' },
  52:       { status: 500 }
  53:     );
  54:   }

src\app\api\github\issues\create\route.ts

  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     const { repo, title, body, labels, assignees } = await req.json();
  24: 
  25:     // Validation
  26:     if (!repo || !title) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json(
  28:         { error: 'Missing required fields: repo, title' },
  29:         { status: 400 }
  30:       );
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     // Creer l'issue pour le compte de l'utilisateur
  34:     const issue = await createIssueAsUser(repo, title, body, labels, assignees);
  35: 
  36:     logger.info('GitHub issue created via API', {
  37:       userId: (session.user as any).id,
  38:       issueNumber: issue.number,
  39:       repo,
  40:     });
  41: 
  42:     return NextResponse.json({
  43:       success: true,
  44:       issue,
  45:     });
  46:   } catch (error) {
  47:     logger.error('GitHub issue creation API error', error);
  48: 
  49:     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
  50: 
  51:     if (errorMessage.includes('not connected to GitHub')) {
  52:       return NextResponse.json(
  53:         {
  54:           error: 'GitHub not connected',
  55:           message: 'Please authorize GitHub in your account settings',
  56:           code: 'GITHUB_NOT_CONNECTED',
  57:         },
  58:         { status: 403 }
  59:       );
  60:     }
  61: 
  62:     return NextResponse.json(
  63:       {
  64:         error: 'Failed to create issue',
  65:         message: errorMessage,
  66:       },
  67:       { status: 500 }
  68:     );
  69:   }
  70: }

src\app\api\github\sync-dossier\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: Synchroniser un dossier avec GitHub
   3:  * POST /api/github/sync-dossier
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { syncDossierToGitHub } from '@/lib/github/user-actions';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  10: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  11: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16: 
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json(
  19:         { error: 'Unauthorized' },
  20:         { status: 401 }
  21:       );
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  25:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  26: 
  27:     const { dossierId, repo } = await req.json();
  28: 
  29:     if (!dossierId || !repo) {
  30:       return NextResponse.json(
  31:         { error: 'Missing required fields: dossierId, repo' },
  32:         { status: 400 }
  33:       );
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     // Recuperer le dossier
  37:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  38:       where: {
  39:         id: dossierId,
  40:         tenantId,
  41:       },
  42:       include: {
  43:         client: true,
  44:       },
  45:     });
  46: 
  47:     if (!dossier) {
  48:       return NextResponse.json(
  49:         { error: 'Dossier not found' },
  50:         { status: 404 }
  51:       );
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     // Synchroniser avec GitHub
  55:     const issue = await syncDossierToGitHub(
  56:       repo,
  57:       {
  58:         numero: dossier.numero,
  59:         client: `${dossier.client.firstName} ${dossier.client.lastName}`,
  60:         typeDossier: dossier.typeDossier,
  61:         statut: dossier.statut,
  62:         priorite: dossier.priorite,
  63:         description: dossier.description || undefined,
  64:       },
  65:       tenantId,
  66:       userId
  67:     );
  68: 
  69:     // Sauvegarder le numero d'issue dans le dossier
  70:     await prisma.dossier.update({
  71:       where: { id: dossierId },
  72:       data: {
  73:         metadata: JSON.stringify({
  74:           githubIssue: issue.number,
  75:           githubUrl: issue.url,
  76:           githubRepo: repo,
  77:         }),
  78:       },
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     logger.info('Dossier synchronized to GitHub', {
  82:       dossierId,
  83:       issueNumber: issue.number,
  84:       repo,
  85:       userId,
  86:     });
  87: 
  88:     return NextResponse.json({
  89:       success: true,
  90:       dossier: {
  91:         id: dossier.id,
  92:         numero: dossier.numero,
  93:       },
  94:       github: {
  95:         issueNumber: issue.number,
  96:         issueUrl: issue.url,
  97:         repo,
  98:       },
  99:     });
 100:   } catch (error) {
 101:     logger.error('Dossier GitHub sync API error', error);
 102: 
 103:     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error';
 104: 
 105:     return NextResponse.json(
 106:       {
 107:         error: 'Failed to sync dossier',
 108:         message: errorMessage,
 109:       },
 110:       { status: 500 }
 111:     );
 112:   }

src\app\api\import-export\csv\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import {
   5:   importClientsFromCsv,
   6:   importDossiersFromCsv,
   7:   exportClientsCsv,
   8:   exportDossiersCsv,
   9:   exportFacturesCsv,
  10: } from '@/lib/services/csv-sftp.service';
  11: 
  12: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
  13: 
  14: /**
  15:  * POST /api/import-export/csv
  16:  * 
  17:  * Import CSV : body = { action: 'import', type: 'clients'|'dossiers', csv: '...' }
  18:  * Export CSV : body = { action: 'export', type: 'clients'|'dossiers'|'factures', dateFrom?, dateTo? }
  19:  */
  20: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  21:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  22:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  23: 
  24:   const user = session.user as any;
  25:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  26:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 400 });
  27: 
  28:   let body: any;
  29:   try {
  30:     body = await request.json();
  31:   } catch {
  32:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   const { action, type, csv, delimiter, dateFrom, dateTo } = body;
  36: 
  37:   // ============ IMPORT ============
  38:   if (action === 'import') {
  39:     if (!csv || !type) {
  40:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'csv et type requis' }, { status: 400 });
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     if (type === 'clients') {
  44:       const result = await importClientsFromCsv(csv, tenantId, { delimiter });
  45:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, ...result });
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     if (type === 'dossiers') {
  49:       const result = await importDossiersFromCsv(csv, tenantId, user.id, { delimiter });
  50:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, ...result });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Type non supportÃ© (clients, dossiers)' }, { status: 400 });
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   // ============ EXPORT ============
  57:   if (action === 'export') {
  58:     if (!type) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'type requis' }, { status: 400 });
  59: 
  60:     const options = { type, tenantId, delimiter: delimiter || ';', dateFrom, dateTo };
  61:     let csvContent: string;
  62: 
  63:     if (type === 'clients') {
  64:       csvContent = await exportClientsCsv(options);
  65:     } else if (type === 'dossiers') {
  66:       csvContent = await exportDossiersCsv(options);
  67:     } else if (type === 'factures') {
  68:       csvContent = await exportFacturesCsv(options);
  69:     } else {
  70:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Type non supportÃ©' }, { status: 400 });
  71:     }
  72: 
  73:     return new NextResponse(csvContent, {
  74:       headers: {
  75:         'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
  76:         'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${type}_export_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv"`,
  77:       },
  78:     });
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Action non supportÃ©e (import, export)' }, { status: 400 });
  82: }

src\app\api\inbox\prioritized\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Inbox PriorisÃ©e (Smart Inbox)
   3:  * GET /api/inbox/prioritized - Retourne emails triÃ©s par score de prioritÃ©
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { smartInboxService } from '@/lib/services/smart-inbox.service';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15:     if (!session?.user) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  20: 
  21:     const userRole = String((session.user as any).role || '');
  22:     const sessionTenantId = String((session.user as any).tenantId || '');
  23:     const queryTenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId') || '';
  24: 
  25:     const tenantId = userRole === 'SUPER_ADMIN' ? queryTenantId || sessionTenantId : sessionTenantId;
  26:     if (!tenantId) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     if (userRole !== 'SUPER_ADMIN' && queryTenantId && queryTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  31:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© pour ce tenant' }, { status: 403 });
  32:     }
  33: 
  34:     const minScore = searchParams.get('minScore') ? parseInt(searchParams.get('minScore')!) : 0;
  35:     const category = searchParams.get('category') || undefined;
  36:     const urgency = searchParams.get('urgency') || undefined;
  37:     const limit = searchParams.get('limit') ? parseInt(searchParams.get('limit')!) : 50;
  38:     const offset = searchParams.get('offset') ? parseInt(searchParams.get('offset')!) : 0;
  39: 
  40:     const emails = await smartInboxService.getPrioritizedInbox(tenantId, {
  41:       minScore,
  42:       category,
  43:       urgency,
  44:       limit,
  45:       offset,
  46:     });
  47: 
  48:     const total = await prisma.email.count({
  49:       where: {
  50:         tenantId,
  51:         isArchived: false,
  52:         ...(category && { category }),
  53:         ...(urgency && { urgency }),
  54:         inboxScore: {
  55:           score: { gte: minScore },
  56:         },
  57:       },
  58:     });
  59: 
  60:     return NextResponse.json({
  61:       success: true,
  62:       total,
  63:       limit,
  64:       offset,
  65:       emails: emails.map((e) => ({
  66:         id: e.id,
  67:         from: e.from,
  68:         to: e.to,
  69:         subject: e.subject,
  70:         preview: e.preview,
  71:         category: e.category,
  72:         urgency: e.urgency,
  73:         sentiment: e.sentiment,
  74:         isRead: e.isRead,
  75:         isStarred: e.isStarred,
  76:         receivedAt: e.receivedAt,
  77:         score: e.inboxScore?.score || 0,
  78:         scoreFactors: e.inboxScore?.factors || {},
  79:         client: e.client
  80:           ? {
  81:               name: `${e.client.firstName} ${e.client.lastName}`,
  82:               email: e.client.email,
  83:             }
  84:           : null,
  85:         dossier: e.dossier
  86:           ? {
  87:               numero: e.dossier.numero,
  88:               objet: e.dossier.objet,
  89:             }
  90:           : null,
  91:       })),
  92:     });
  93:   } catch (error) {
  94:     console.error('[INBOX-PRIORITIZED] Erreur:', error);
  95:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur', details: String(error) }, { status: 500 });
  96:   }
  97: }

src\app\api\information-units\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import crypto from 'crypto';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: 
   8: async function resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null): Promise<
   9:   | { tenantId: string; role: string; userId: string }
  10:   | { error: NextResponse }
  11: > {
  12:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:   if (!session?.user) {
  14:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 }) };
  15:   }
  16: 
  17:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  18:   const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  19:   const userId = String((session.user as any).id || '');
  20: 
  21:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  22:     if (!requestedTenantId) {
  23:       return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'tenantId requis' }, { status: 400 }) };
  24:     }
  25:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, role, userId };
  26:   }
  27: 
  28:   if (!sessionTenantId) {
  29:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 403 }) };
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  33:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   return { tenantId: sessionTenantId, role, userId };
  37: }
  38: 
  39: // GET - Liste des InformationUnits
  40: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  41:   try {
  42:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  43:     const requestedTenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  44:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  45:     const source = searchParams.get('source');
  46:     const limit = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50', 10));
  47:     const offset = Math.max(0, parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10));
  48: 
  49:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(requestedTenantId);
  50:     if ('error' in access) {
  51:       return access.error;
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     const tenantId = access.tenantId;
  55: 
  56:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId };
  57:     if (status) where.currentStatus = status;
  58:     if (source) where.source = source;
  59: 
  60:     const [units, total] = await Promise.all([
  61:       prisma.informationUnit.findMany({
  62:         where,
  63:         include: {
  64:           statusHistory: { orderBy: { changedAt: 'desc' }, take: 5 },
  65:           proofs: { take: 3 },
  66:         },
  67:         orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' },
  68:         take: limit,
  69:         skip: offset,
  70:       }),
  71:       prisma.informationUnit.count({ where }),
  72:     ]);
  73: 
  74:     return NextResponse.json({ units, total, hasMore: offset + units.length < total });
  75:   } catch (error) {
  76:     logger.error('Erreur GET information-units:', { error });
  77:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  78:   }
  79: }
  80: 
  81: // POST - Créer une InformationUnit
  82: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  83:   try {
  84:     const body = await request.json();
  85:     const { tenantId, source, content, sourceMetadata } = body;
  86: 
  87:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess((tenantId as string | null) || null);
  88:     if ('error' in access) {
  89:       return access.error;
  90:     }
  91: 
  92:     const effectiveTenantId = access.tenantId;
  93:     const effectiveChangedBy = access.userId;
  94: 
  95:     if (!source || !content) {
  96:       return NextResponse.json(
  97:         { error: 'source et content requis' },
  98:         { status: 400 }
  99:       );
 100:     }
 101: 
 102:     const contentHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
 103: 
 104:     const existing = await prisma.informationUnit.findUnique({
 105:       where: { contentHash },
 106:     });
 107: 
 108:     if (existing) {
 109:       return NextResponse.json(
 110:         { error: 'Information déjà enregistrée', unit: existing },
 111:         { status: 409 }
 112:       );
 113:     }
 114: 
 115:     const unit = await prisma.informationUnit.create({
 116:       data: {
 117:         tenantId: effectiveTenantId,
 118:         source,
 119:         content,
 120:         contentHash,
 121:         sourceMetadata: sourceMetadata ? JSON.stringify(sourceMetadata) : null,
 122:         currentStatus: 'RECEIVED',
 123:         lastStatusChangeBy: effectiveChangedBy,
 124:         lastStatusChangeAt: new Date(),
 125:       },
 126:     });
 127: 
 128:     await prisma.informationStatusHistory.create({
 129:       data: {
 130:         unitId: unit.id,
 131:         toStatus: 'RECEIVED',
 132:         changedBy: effectiveChangedBy,
 133:         reason: 'Création initiale',
 134:       },
 135:     });
 136: 
 137:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, unit });
 138:   } catch (error) {
 139:     logger.error('Erreur POST information-unit:', { error });
 140:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 141:   }
 142: }
 143: 
 144: // PATCH - Mettre à jour le statut
 145: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 146:   try {
 147:     const body = await request.json();
 148:     const { unitId, newStatus, reason, linkedWorkspaceId } = body;
 149: 
 150:     if (!unitId || !newStatus) {
 151:       return NextResponse.json(
 152:         { error: 'unitId et newStatus requis' },
 153:         { status: 400 }
 154:       );
 155:     }
 156: 
 157:     const unit = await prisma.informationUnit.findUnique({ where: { id: unitId } });
 158:     if (!unit) {
 159:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'InformationUnit non trouvée' }, { status: 404 });
 160:     }
 161: 
 162:     const access = await resolveTenantAccess(unit.tenantId);
 163:     if ('error' in access) {
 164:       return access.error;
 165:     }
 166: 
 167:     const effectiveChangedBy = access.userId;
 168: 
 169:     const updatedUnit = await prisma.$transaction(
 170:       async (tx) => {
 171:         const u = await tx.informationUnit.update({
 172:           where: { id: unitId },
 173:           data: {
 174:             currentStatus: newStatus,
 175:             lastStatusChangeBy: effectiveChangedBy,
 176:             lastStatusChangeAt: new Date(),
 177:             ...(linkedWorkspaceId && { linkedWorkspaceId }),
 178:             ...(newStatus === 'CLASSIFIED' && { classifiedAt: new Date() }),
 179:             ...(newStatus === 'ANALYZED' && { analyzedAt: new Date() }),
 180:             ...(newStatus === 'RESOLVED' && { resolvedAt: new Date() }),
 181:             ...(newStatus === 'CLOSED' && { closedAt: new Date() }),
 182:           },
 183:         });
 184: 
 185:         await tx.informationStatusHistory.create({
 186:           data: {
 187:             unitId,
 188:             fromStatus: unit.currentStatus,
 189:             toStatus: newStatus,
 190:             reason,
 191:             changedBy: effectiveChangedBy,
 192:           },
 193:         });
 194: 
 195:         return u;
 196:       },
 197:       { timeout: 30000 }
 198:     );
 199: 
 200:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, unit: updatedUnit });
 201:   } catch (error) {
 202:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH information-unit:', { error });
 203:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 204:   }
 205: }
 206:

  97:     type,

src\app\api\integrations\sync\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { ExternalCalendarBridge } from '@/lib/oauth/calendar-bridge';
   2: import type { OAuthProvider } from '@/lib/oauth/oauth-service';
   3: import { oauthTokenService } from '@/lib/oauth/token-service';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
   8: 
   9: /**
  10:  * POST /api/integrations/sync?provider=google
  11:  * Trigger sync from external calendar to MemoLib
  12:  */
  13: export async function POST(req: Request) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession();
  16:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  21:     const provider = searchParams.get('provider') as OAuthProvider;
  22:     const type = searchParams.get('type') || 'calendar'; // 'calendar' | 'contacts'
  23: 
  24:     if (!provider) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'provider requis' }, { status: 400 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     // Get valid token
  29:     const accessToken = await oauthTokenService.ensureValidToken(session.user.id, provider);
  30: 
  31:     let result: any = {};
  32: 
  33:     if (type === 'calendar') {
  34:       if (provider === 'google') {
  35:         result = await ExternalCalendarBridge.syncGoogleCalendar(accessToken, session.user.id);
  36:       } else if (provider === 'microsoft') {
  37:         result = await ExternalCalendarBridge.syncMicrosoftCalendar(accessToken, session.user.id);
  38:       }
  39:     } else if (type === 'contacts') {
  40:       if (provider === 'google') {
  41:         result = await ExternalCalendarBridge.syncGoogleContacts(accessToken);
  42:       } else if (provider === 'microsoft') {
  43:         result = await ExternalCalendarBridge.syncMicrosoftContacts(accessToken);
  44:       }
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     return NextResponse.json(
  48:       { success: true, provider, type, synced: Array.isArray(result) ? result.length : 0 },
  49:       { status: 200 }
  50:     );
  51:   } catch (e: any) {
  52:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'sync_failed', detail: e?.message }, { status: 400 });
  53:   }
  54: }

src\app\api\jurisprudence\search\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { judilibreClient } from '@/lib/legifrance/judilibre-client';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: import { checkFeatureAccess } from '@/lib/billing/features';
   8: import { searchCache } from '@/lib/cache/cache-service';
   9: import { withRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
  10: 
  11: export const GET = withRateLimit(
  12:   async (req: NextRequest) => {
  13:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  15: 
  16:   // Feature gate : jurisprudence rÃ©servÃ©e au plan Cabinet+
  17:   const tenantId = (session.user as any)?.tenantId;
  18:   if (tenantId) {
  19:     const gate = await checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, 'jurisprudence_search');
  20:     if (!gate.allowed) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({
  22:         error: 'FEATURE_GATED',
  23:         ...gate,
  24:         upgradeUrl: '/settings/billing?upgrade=true',
  25:       }, { status: 403 });
  26:     }
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   const query = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('q');
  30:   const type = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('type') || 'all';
  31:   const source = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('source') || 'auto'; // auto | postgres | judilibre | fallback
  32:   const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('limit') || '10'), 50);
  33:   const page = Math.max(parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('page') || '1'), 1);
  34:   const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
  35: 
  36:   if (!query) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ParamÃ¨tre q requis' }, { status: 400 });
  37: 
  38:   // Cache des recherches (donnÃ©es juridiques publiques, non tenant-spÃ©cifiques) :
  39:   // Ã©vite de re-solliciter Judilibre/Postgres pour des requÃªtes identiques rÃ©pÃ©tÃ©es
  40:   // par plusieurs avocats (ex: "OQTF", "titre de sÃ©jour") â€” rÃ©ponse quasi-instantanÃ©e.
  41:   const cacheKey = `jurisprudence:${source}:${type}:${query.toLowerCase().trim()}:${limit}:${page}`;
  42:   const cached = await searchCache.get<Record<string, unknown>>(cacheKey);
  43:   if (cached) {
  44:     return NextResponse.json({ ...cached, cached: true });
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   const payload = await resolveSearch(query, type, source, limit, page, offset);
  48:   if (!('error' in payload)) {
  49:     await searchCache.set(cacheKey, payload);
  50:   }
  51:   return NextResponse.json(payload, 'status' in payload ? { status: payload.status as number } : undefined);
  52:   },
  53:   { type: 'api' }
  54: );
  55: 
  56: async function resolveSearch(
  57:   query: string,
  58:   type: string,
  59:   source: string,
  60:   limit: number,
  61:   page: number,
  62:   offset: number
  63: ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  64:   // Source priority: postgres â†’ judilibre â†’ fallback
  65:   if (source === 'auto') {
  66:     // 1. Try PostgreSQL (indexed decisions)
  67:     const count = await prisma.jurisprudence.count();
  68:     if (count > 0) {
  69:       return searchPostgres(query, type, limit, offset);
  70:     }
  71: 
  72:     // 2. Try Judilibre API
  73:     if (judilibreClient.isAvailable()) {
  74:       try {
  75:         return await searchJudilibre(query, type, limit, page);
  76:       } catch (error) {
  77:         logger.warn('[Jurisprudence] Judilibre indisponible, fallback local', { error });
  78:       }
  79:     }
  80: 
  81:     // 3. Fallback static
  82:     const results = searchFallback(query, type);
  83:     return { results, source: 'fallback', total: results.length, page };
  84:   }
  85: 
  86:   // Explicit source selection
  87:   if (source === 'postgres') {
  88:     return searchPostgres(query, type, limit, offset);
  89:   }
  90: 
  91:   if (source === 'judilibre') {
  92:     if (!judilibreClient.isAvailable()) {
  93:       return {
  94:         error: 'Judilibre non configurÃ© (JUDILIBRE_KEY_ID requis)',
  95:         status: 503,
  96:       };
  97:     }
  98:     return searchJudilibre(query, type, limit, page);
  99:   }
 100: 
 101:   // fallback
 102:   const results = searchFallback(query, type);
 103:   return { results, source: 'fallback', total: results.length, page };
 104: }
 105: 
 106: // ============================================
 107: // SOURCE: POSTGRESQL (donnÃ©es indexÃ©es localement)
 108: // ============================================
 109: 
 110: async function searchPostgres(query: string, type: string, limit: number, offset: number) {
 111:   const tsQuery = query.trim();
 112:   const themeFilter = type !== 'all' ? [type.toUpperCase()] : undefined;
 113: 
 114:   const results: any[] = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(`
 115:     SELECT id, "externalId", titre, date, juridiction, numero, chambre, solution, resume, url, themes,
 116:            ts_rank("searchVector", plainto_tsquery('french', $1)) as rank
 117:     FROM "Jurisprudence"
 118:     WHERE "searchVector" @@ plainto_tsquery('french', $1)
 119:     ${themeFilter ? `AND $2 = ANY(themes)` : ''}
 120:     ORDER BY rank DESC, date DESC
 121:     LIMIT $${themeFilter ? '3' : '2'}
 122:     OFFSET $${themeFilter ? '4' : '3'}
 123:   `, tsQuery, ...(themeFilter ? [themeFilter[0], limit, offset] : [limit, offset]));
 124: 
 125:   const total: any[] = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(`
 126:     SELECT COUNT(*)::int as count FROM "Jurisprudence"
 127:     WHERE "searchVector" @@ plainto_tsquery('french', $1)
 128:     ${themeFilter ? `AND $2 = ANY(themes)` : ''}
 129:   `, tsQuery, ...(themeFilter ? [themeFilter[0]] : []));
 130: 
 131:   return {
 132:     results: results.map(r => ({
 133:       id: r.id,
 134:       titre: r.titre,
 135:       date: r.date,
 136:       juridiction: r.juridiction,
 137:       numero: r.numero,
 138:       chambre: r.chambre,
 139:       solution: r.solution,
 140:       resume: r.resume?.slice(0, 300),
 141:       url: r.url,
 142:       themes: r.themes,
 143:       rank: r.rank,
 144:     })),
 145:     source: 'postgresql',
 146:     total: total[0]?.count || 0,
 147:     page: Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1,
 148:     pages: Math.ceil((total[0]?.count || 0) / limit),
 149:   };
 150: }
 151: 
 152: // ============================================
 153: // SOURCE: JUDILIBRE (API Cour de cassation)
 154: // ============================================
 155: 
 156: async function searchJudilibre(query: string, type: string, limit: number, page: number) {
 157:   const result = await judilibreClient.search({
 158:     query,
 159:     page_size: limit,
 160:     page: page - 1, // Judilibre pages start at 0
 161:     sort: 'score',
 162:     order: 'desc',
 163:     resolve_references: true,
 164:     ...(type !== 'all' && { theme: [type] }),
 165:   });
 166: 
 167:   return {
 168:     results: result.results.map(d => ({
 169:       id: d.id,
 170:       titre: d.summary || `${d.type} - ${d.number}`,
 171:       date: d.decision_date,
 172:       juridiction: d.jurisdiction,
 173:       numero: d.number,
 174:       chambre: d.chamber,
 175:       solution: d.solution,
 176:       resume: d.highlights?.motivations?.[0]?.replace(/<\/?em>/g, '') || d.summary || '',
 177:       url: d.ecli
 178:         ? `https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/juri/id/${d.id}`
 179:         : undefined,
 180:       themes: d.themes || [],
 181:       ecli: d.ecli,
 182:       rank: d.score,
 183:     })),
 184:     source: 'judilibre',
 185:     total: result.total,
 186:     page,
 187:     pages: Math.ceil(result.total / limit),
 188:     took: result.took,
 189:   };
 190: }

src\app\api\lawyer\workspace\[id]\execute-action\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * POST /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/execute-action
   9:  * ExÃ©cuter une action proposÃ©e
  10:  */
  11: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const user = session.user as any;
  20:     const userId = user.id;
  21:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  22:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  23: 
  24:     // Verifier isolation tenant
  25:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
  26:       where: { id: workspaceId, tenantId },
  27:     });
  28: 
  29:     if (!workspace) {
  30:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     if (workspace.locked) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace verrouille' }, { status: 400 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     const body = await request.json();
  38:     const { actionId, result } = body;
  39: 
  40:     if (!actionId) {
  41:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'actionId requis' }, { status: 400 });
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     // VÃ©rifier que l'action appartient au workspace
  45:     const action = await prisma.proposedAction.findFirst({
  46:       where: {
  47:         id: actionId,
  48:         workspaceId,
  49:       },
  50:     });
  51: 
  52:     if (!action) {
  53:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Action non trouvee' }, { status: 404 });
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     if (action.executed) {
  57:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Action deja executee' }, { status: 400 });
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     // Marquer comme executee
  61:     const updated = await prisma.proposedAction.update({
  62:       where: { id: actionId },
  63:       data: {
  64:         executed: true,
  65:         executedBy: userId,
  66:         executedAt: new Date(),
  67:         result: result || 'Executee avec succes',
  68:       },
  69:     });
  70: 
  71:     // Creer une trace
  72:     await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
  73:       data: {
  74:         workspaceId,
  75:         step: `Execution action (${action.type})`,
  76:         explanation: `Action "${action.content}" executee par ${userId}. Resultat: ${result || 'Succes'}`,
  77:         createdBy: userId,
  78:       },
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     return NextResponse.json({
  82:       success: true,
  83:       action: updated,
  84:     });
  85:   } catch (error) {

src\app\api\lawyer\workspace\[id]\execute-reasoning\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * ðŸ§  API - EXÃ‰CUTION DU RAISONNEMENT IA
   3:  *
   4:  * POST /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/execute-reasoning
   5:  *
   6:  * DÃ©clenche le raisonnement IA structurÃ© pour faire progresser
   7:  * le workspace Ã  travers les Ã©tats de la machine Ã  Ã©tats.
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  11: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  12: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  13: import {
  14:   executeFullReasoning,
  15:   executeNextStep,
  16:   executeReasoning,
  17: } from '@/lib/reasoning/reasoning-service';
  18: import { WorkspaceState } from '@/types/workspace-reasoning';
  19: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  20: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  21: 
  22: interface ExecuteReasoningBody {
  23:   mode?: 'single' | 'next' | 'full';
  24:   targetState?: WorkspaceState;
  25: }
  26: 
  27: /**
  28:  * POST - ExÃ©cuter le raisonnement IA
  29:  */
  30: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  31:   try {
  32:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  33: 
  34:     if (!session?.user) {
  35:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  39: 
  40:     // VÃ©rifier que le workspace existe et appartient au tenant
  41:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
  42:       where: {
  43:         id: workspaceId,
  44:         tenantId: (session.user as any).tenantId,
  45:       },
  46:     });
  47: 
  48:     if (!workspace) {
  49:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace not found' }, { status: 404 });
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     if (workspace.locked) {
  53:       return NextResponse.json(
  54:         { error: 'Workspace is locked. Cannot execute reasoning.' },
  55:         { status: 403 }
  56:       );
  57:     }
  58: 
  59:     // Parse request body
  60:     const body: ExecuteReasoningBody = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
  61:     const mode = body.mode || 'next';
  62: 
  63:     let result;
  64: 
  65:     switch (mode) {
  66:       case 'single':
  67:         // ExÃ©cuter vers un Ã©tat spÃ©cifique
  68:         if (!body.targetState) {
  69:           return NextResponse.json(
  70:             { error: 'targetState required for mode=single' },
  71:             { status: 400 }
  72:           );
  73:         }
  74:         result = await executeReasoning(workspaceId, body.targetState);
  75:         break;
  76: 
  77:       case 'next':
  78:         // ExÃ©cuter la prochaine Ã©tape
  79:         result = await executeNextStep(workspaceId);
  80:         break;
  81: 
  82:       case 'full':
  83:         // ExÃ©cuter tout le raisonnement d'un coup
  84:         result = await executeFullReasoning(workspaceId);
  85:         break;
  86: 
  87:       default:
  88:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid mode' }, { status: 400 });
  89:     }
  90: 
  91:     if (!result.success) {
  92:       return NextResponse.json({ error: result.error }, { status: 500 });
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     // Recharger le workspace mis Ã  jour
  96:     const updatedWorkspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findUnique({
  97:       where: { id: workspaceId },
  98:       include: {
  99:         facts: true,
 100:         contexts: true,
 101:         obligations: true,
 102:         missingElements: true,
 103:         risks: true,
 104:         proposedActions: true,
 105:         reasoningTraces: {
 106:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 107:           take: 10,
 108:         },
 109:         transitions: {
 110:           orderBy: { triggeredAt: 'desc' },
 111:           take: 5,
 112:         },
 113:       },
 114:     });
 115: 
 116:     return NextResponse.json({
 117:       success: true,
 118:       workspace: updatedWorkspace,
 119:       result: {
 120:         newState: result.newState || result.finalState,
 121:         uncertaintyLevel: result.uncertaintyLevel,
 122:         traces: result.traces,
 123:         steps: 'steps' in result ? result.steps : undefined,
 124:       },
 125:     });
 126:   } catch (error) {
 127:     logger.error('Execute reasoning error', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 128:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/execute-reasoning',
 129:     });
 130:     return NextResponse.json(
 131:       {
 132:         error: 'Internal server error',
 133:         details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
 134:       },
 135:       { status: 500 }
 136:     );
 137:   }
 138: }

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';

   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/export
   9:  * Exporter le raisonnement complet en JSON/Markdown
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14: 
  15:     if (!session?.user) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  17:     }
  18: 
  19:     const user = session.user as any;
  20:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  21:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  22: 
  23:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  24:     const format = searchParams.get('format') || 'json'; // json | markdown
  25: 
  26:     // Recuperer le workspace complet avec ses relations existantes
  27:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
  28:       where: { id: workspaceId, tenantId },
  29:       include: {
  30:         missingElements: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } },
  31:         proposedActions: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } },
  32:         reasoningTraces: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } },
  33:         transitions: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } },
  34:       },
  35:     });
  36: 
  37:     if (!workspace) {
  38:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     if (format === 'markdown') {
  42:       // Generer Markdown
  43:       const markdown = generateMarkdownExport(workspace);
  44: 
  45:       return new NextResponse(markdown, {
  46:         headers: {
  47:           'Content-Type': 'text/markdown',
  48:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="workspace-${workspaceId}.md"`,
  49:         },
  50:       });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     // Format JSON par dÃ©faut
  54:     return NextResponse.json({
  55:       success: true,
  56:       workspace,
  57:       exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  58:       exportedBy: user.id,
  59:     });
  60:   } catch (error) {
  61:     logger.error('Erreur export workspace', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  62:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/export',
  63:     });
  64:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  65:   }
  66: }
  67: 
  68: function generateMarkdownExport(workspace: any): string {
  69:   const sections: string[] = [];
  70: 
  71:   // En-tete
  72:   sections.push(`# Workspace Reasoning Export`);
  73:   sections.push(`**ID:** ${workspace.id}`);
  74:   sections.push(`**Statut:** ${workspace.status}`);
  75:   sections.push(`**Cree le:** ${new Date(workspace.createdAt).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`);
  76:   sections.push(`**Verrouille:** ${workspace.locked ? 'Oui' : 'Non'}`);
  77:   if (workspace.description) {
  78:     sections.push(`**Description:** ${workspace.description}`);
  79:   }
  80:   sections.push('');
  81: 
  82:   // Contexte
  83:   if (workspace.context) {
  84:     sections.push(`## ðŸ“¥ Contexte`);
  85:     sections.push('```json');
  86:     sections.push(workspace.context);
  87:     sections.push('```');
  88:     sections.push('');
  89:   }
  90: 
  91:   // Manques
  92:   if (workspace.missingElements?.length > 0) {
  93:     sections.push(`## â— Elements Manquants (${workspace.missingElements.length})`);
  94:     workspace.missingElements.forEach((miss: any) => {
  95:       const status = miss.resolved ? 'âœ…' : miss.priority === 'urgent' ? 'ðŸ”´' : 'ðŸŸ ';
  96:       sections.push(`${status} **${miss.type}:** ${miss.description}`);
  97:       sections.push(`   - Priorite: ${miss.priority}`);
  98:       if (miss.resolved) {
  99:         sections.push(`   - Resolu: ${miss.resolution}`);
 100:       }
 101:     });
 102:     sections.push('');
 103:   }
 104: 
 105:   // Actions
 106:   if (workspace.proposedActions?.length > 0) {
 107:     sections.push(`## ðŸ‘‰ Actions Proposees (${workspace.proposedActions.length})`);
 108:     workspace.proposedActions.forEach((action: any) => {
 109:       const status = action.executed ? 'âœ…' : action.rejected ? 'âŒ' : 'â³';
 110:       sections.push(`${status} **${action.type}** (${action.priority})`);
 111:       sections.push(`   - ${action.content}`);
 112:       if (action.executed && action.result) {
 113:         sections.push(`   - Resultat: ${action.result}`);
 114:       }
 115:       if (action.rejected && action.rejectReason) {
 116:         sections.push(`   - Raison rejet: ${action.rejectReason}`);
 117:       }
 118:     });
 119:     sections.push('');
 120:   }
 121: 
 122:   // Traces
 123:   if (workspace.reasoningTraces?.length > 0) {
 124:     sections.push(`## ðŸ§  Traces de Raisonnement`);
 125:     workspace.reasoningTraces.forEach((trace: any) => {
 126:       sections.push(`- **${trace.step}**`);
 127:       sections.push(`  ${trace.explanation}`);
 128:     });
 129:     sections.push('');
 130:   }
 131: 
 132:   // Transitions
 133:   if (workspace.transitions?.length > 0) {
 134:     sections.push(`## ðŸ”„ Transitions`);
 135:     workspace.transitions.forEach((trans: any) => {
 136:       sections.push(
 137:         `- ${trans.fromStatus} â†’ ${trans.toStatus} (${new Date(trans.createdAt).toLocaleString('fr-FR')})`
 138:       );
 139:       if (trans.reason) {
 140:         sections.push(`  Raison: ${trans.reason}`);
 141:       }
 142:     });
 143:     sections.push('');
 144:   }
 145: 
 146:   return sections.join('\n');
 147: }

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { MissingElement, canTransitionToReadyForHuman } from '@/types/workspace-reasoning';
   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: 
   8: /**
   9:  * POST /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/resolve-missing
  10:  * RÃ©soudre un Ã©lÃ©ment manquant
  11:  */
  12: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15: 
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const user = session.user as any;
  21:     const userId = user.id;
  22:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  23:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  24: 
  25:     // Verifier isolation tenant
  26:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
  27:       where: { id: workspaceId, tenantId },
  28:       include: {
  29:         missingElements: true,
  30:       },
  31:     });
  32: 
  33:     if (!workspace) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     if (workspace.locked) {
  38:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace verrouille' }, { status: 400 });
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     const body = await request.json();
  42:     const { missingElementId, resolution } = body;
  43: 
  44:     if (!missingElementId || !resolution) {
  45:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'missingElementId et resolution requis' }, { status: 400 });
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     // Verifier que l'element appartient au workspace
  49:     const missingElement = workspace.missingElements.find(m => m.id === missingElementId);
  50:     if (!missingElement) {
  51:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Element manquant non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     // Resoudre l'element
  55:     const updated = await prisma.missingElement.update({
  56:       where: { id: missingElementId },
  57:       data: {
  58:         resolved: true,
  59:         resolvedBy: userId,
  60:         resolvedAt: new Date(),
  61:         resolution,
  62:       },
  63:     });
  64: 
  65:     // Creer une trace de raisonnement
  66:     await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
  67:       data: {
  68:         workspaceId,
  69:         step: `Resolution element manquant (${missingElement.type})`,
  70:         explanation: resolution,
  71:         createdBy: userId,
  72:       },
  73:     });
  74: 
  75:     // Recuperer TOUS les missing elements mis a jour
  76:     const allMissing = await prisma.missingElement.findMany({
  77:       where: { workspaceId },
  78:     });
  79: 
  80:     // Verifier si on peut passer a READY_FOR_HUMAN
  81:     const canTransition = canTransitionToReadyForHuman(allMissing as unknown as MissingElement[]);
  82: 
  83:     if (canTransition && workspace.status === 'MISSING_IDENTIFIED') {
  84:       // Transition automatique vers READY_FOR_HUMAN
  85:       await prisma.workspaceReasoning.update({
  86:         where: { id: workspaceId },
  87:         data: {
  88:           status: 'READY_FOR_HUMAN',
  89:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  90:         },
  91:       });
  92: 
  93:       await prisma.reasoningTransition.create({
  94:         data: {
  95:           workspaceId,
  96:           fromStatus: 'MISSING_IDENTIFIED',
  97:           toStatus: 'READY_FOR_HUMAN',
  98:           triggeredBy: 'SYSTEM',
  99:           reason: 'Tous les elements bloquants resolus - transition automatique',
 100:         },
 101:       });
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     return NextResponse.json({
 105:       success: true,
 106:       missingElement: updated,
 107:       canTransitionToReady: canTransition,
 108:     });
 109:   } catch (error) {
 110:     logger.error('Erreur resolution element manquant', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 111:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspace/[id]/resolve-missing',
 112:     });
 113:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 114:   }
 115: }
