 104: /**
 105:  * PATCH /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]
 106:  * Mettre Ã  jour un workspace (lock, state, etc.)
 107:  */
 108: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
 109:   try {
 110:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 111: 
 112:     if (!session?.user) {
 113:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 114:     }
 115: 
 116:     const user = session.user as any;
 117:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
 118:     const userId = user.id;
 119:     const workspaceId = params.id;
 120: 
 121:     // VÃ©rifier que le workspace appartient au tenant
 122:     const existing = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
 123:       where: { id: workspaceId, tenantId },
 124:     });
 125: 
 126:     if (!existing) {
 127:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 128:     }
 129: 
 130:     const body = await request.json();
 131:     const { locked, currentState, uncertaintyLevel, procedureType } = body;
 132: 
 133:     const updateData: any = {};
 134: 
 135:     if (locked !== undefined) {
 136:       updateData.locked = locked;
 137:       if (locked) {
 138:         updateData.completedAt = new Date();
 139:       }
 140:     }
 141: 
 142:     if (currentState && currentState !== existing.currentState) {
 143:       updateData.currentState = currentState;
 144:       updateData.stateChangedAt = new Date();
 145:       updateData.stateChangedBy = userId;
 146: 
 147:       // CrÃ©er une transition
 148:       await prisma.reasoningTransition.create({
 149:         data: {
 150:           workspaceId,
 151:           fromState: existing.currentState,
 152:           toState: currentState,
 153:           triggeredBy: userId,
 154:           reason: `Changement manuel d'Ã©tat`,
 155:         },
 156:       });
 157:     }
 158: 
 159:     if (uncertaintyLevel !== undefined) {
 160:       updateData.uncertaintyLevel = uncertaintyLevel;
 161:     }
 162: 
 163:     if (procedureType !== undefined) {
 164:       updateData.procedureType = procedureType;
 165:     }
 166: 
 167:     // Mettre Ã  jour
 168:     const updated = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.update({
 169:       where: { id: workspaceId },
 170:       data: updateData,
 171:     });
 172: 
 173:     return NextResponse.json({
 174:       success: true,
 175:       workspace: updated,
 176:     });
 177:   } catch (error) {
 178:     logger.error('Erreur mise Ã  jour workspace', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 179:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspace/[id]',
 180:     });
 181:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 182:   }
 183: }

 185: /**
 186:  * DELETE /api/lawyer/workspace/[id]
 187:  * Supprimer un workspace (soft delete via Prisma middleware)
 188:  */
 189: export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
 190:   try {
 191:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 192: 
 193:     if (!session?.user) {
 194:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 195:     }
 196: 
 197:     const user = session.user as any;
 198:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
 199:     const workspaceId = params.id;
 200: 
 201:     // VÃ©rifier isolation tenant
 202:     const existing = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findFirst({
 203:       where: { id: workspaceId, tenantId },
 204:     });
 205: 
 206:     if (!existing) {
 207:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 208:     }
 209: 
 210:     // Soft delete (gÃ©rÃ© par middleware Prisma)
 211:     await prisma.workspaceReasoning.delete({
 212:       where: { id: workspaceId },
 213:     });
 214: 
 215:     return NextResponse.json({
 216:       success: true,
 217:       message: 'Workspace supprimÃ©',
 218:     });
 219:   } catch (error) {
 220:     logger.error('Erreur suppression workspace', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {

src\app\api\lawyer\workspaces\[id]\documents\[docId]\download\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - TÃ©lÃ©chargement SÃ©curisÃ© de Document
   3:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents/[docId]/download
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { existsSync } from 'fs';
  10: import { readFile } from 'fs/promises';
  11: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  12: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  13: import { join } from 'path';
  14: 
  15: export async function GET(
  16:   request: NextRequest,
  17:   { params }: { params: { id: string; docId: string } }
  18: ) {
  19:   try {
  20:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  21:     if (!session?.user) {
  22:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer le document
  26:     const document = await prisma.workspaceDocument.findUnique({
  27:       where: { id: params.docId },
  28:       include: {
  29:         workspace: {
  30:           select: {
  31:             id: true,
  32:             tenantId: true,
  33:           },
  34:         },
  35:       },
  36:     });
  37: 
  38:     if (!document) {
  39:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Document non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     // VÃ©rifier que le document appartient au workspace demandÃ©
  43:     if (document.workspaceId !== params.id) {
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     // VÃ©rifier l'accÃ¨s au tenant
  48:     const userTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  49:     if (document.workspace.tenantId !== userTenantId) {
  50:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© - Tenant' }, { status: 403 });
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     // Lire le fichier physique
  54:     const physicalPath = join(process.cwd(), 'public', document.storagePath);
  55: 
  56:     if (!existsSync(physicalPath)) {
  57:       return NextResponse.json(
  58:         {
  59:           error: 'Fichier physique introuvable',
  60:           path: document.storagePath,
  61:         },
  62:         { status: 404 }
  63:       );
  64:     }
  65: 
  66:     const fileBuffer = await readFile(physicalPath);
  67: 
  68:     // DÃ©terminer le Content-Disposition (inline pour PDFs/images, attachment pour le reste)
  69:     const isPreviewable = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(
  70:       document.mimeType
  71:     );
  72: 
  73:     const disposition = isPreviewable
  74:       ? `inline; filename="${encodeURIComponent(document.originalName)}"`
  75:       : `attachment; filename="${encodeURIComponent(document.originalName)}"`;
  76: 
  77:     // Retourner le fichier avec les bons headers
  78:     return new NextResponse(fileBuffer, {
  79:       status: 200,
  80:       headers: {
  81:         'Content-Type': document.mimeType,
  82:         'Content-Disposition': disposition,
  83:         'Content-Length': document.sizeBytes.toString(),
  84:         'Cache-Control': 'private, max-age=3600',
  85:       },
  86:     });
  87:   } catch (error) {
  88:     logger.error('Erreur tÃ©lÃ©chargement document', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  89:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents/[docId]/download',
  90:     });
  91:     return NextResponse.json(
  92:       {
  93:         error: 'Erreur serveur',
  94:         details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
  95:       },
  96:       { status: 500 }
  97:     );
  98:   }
  99: }

  44:     });

  47:       success: true,
  48:       message: 'Document mis Ã  jour',

  50:     });

src\app\api\lawyer\workspaces\[id]\documents\route.ts

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { existsSync } from 'fs';
   5: import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'fs/promises';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: import { join } from 'path';
   9: 
  10: /**
  11:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents
  12:  * Liste les documents d'un workspace avec filtres
  13:  */
  14: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  15:   try {
  16:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  22:     const filter = searchParams.get('filter') || 'all';
  23:     const search = searchParams.get('search') || '';
  24: 
  25:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer workspace avec documents
  26:     const workspace = await prisma.workspace.findUnique({
  27:       where: { id: params.id },
  28:       include: {
  29:         documents: {
  30:           orderBy: { uploadedAt: 'desc' },
  31:         },
  32:       },
  33:     });
  34: 
  35:     if (!workspace) {
  36:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     // Filtrer documents
  40:     let documents = workspace.documents;
  41: 
  42:     if (filter === 'verified') {
  43:       documents = documents.filter(d => d.verified);
  44:     } else if (filter === 'unverified') {
  45:       documents = documents.filter(d => !d.verified);
  46:     } else if (filter === 'ai_processed') {
  47:       documents = documents.filter(d => d.aiProcessed);
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     if (search) {
  51:       const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
  52:       documents = documents.filter(
  53:         d =>
  54:           d.originalName.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
  55:           d.documentType.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
  56:           d.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)
  57:       );
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     return NextResponse.json({
  61:       success: true,
  62:       count: documents.length,
  63:       documents,
  64:     });
  65:   } catch (error) {
  66:     logger.error('Erreur GET documents', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  67:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents',
  68:     });
  69:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  70:   }
  71: }
  72: 
  73: /**
  74:  * POST /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents
  75:  * Upload nouveau document
  76:  */
  77: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  78:   try {
  79:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  80:     if (!session?.user) {
  81:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     const formData = await request.formData();
  85:     const file = formData.get('file') as File;
  86:     const documentType = formData.get('documentType') as string;
  87:     const description = (formData.get('description') as string) || undefined;
  88: 
  89:     if (!file) {
  90:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  91:     }
  92: 
  93:     // Validation taille (max 10MB)
  94:     if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
  95:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier trop volumineux (max 10MB)' }, { status: 400 });
  96:     }
  97: 
  98:     // Validation type MIME
  99:     const allowedTypes = [
 100:       'application/pdf',
 101:       'image/jpeg',
 102:       'image/png',
 103:       'image/webp',
 104:       'application/msword',
 105:       'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
 106:     ];
 107: 
 108:     if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
 109:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Type de fichier non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 400 });
 110:     }
 111: 
 112:     // PrÃ©parer le stockage physique
 113:     const filename = `${Date.now()}-${file.name}`;
 114:     const uploadsDir = join(process.cwd(), 'public', 'uploads', 'workspaces', params.id);
 115:     const storagePath = `/uploads/workspaces/${params.id}/${filename}`;
 116: 
 117:     // CrÃ©er dossier uploads si inexistant
 118:     if (!existsSync(uploadsDir)) {
 119:       await mkdir(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });
 120:     }
 121: 
 122:     // Sauvegarder fichier physiquement
 123:     const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
 124:     await writeFile(join(uploadsDir, filename), fileBuffer);
 125: 
 126:     // CrÃ©er document dans la base
 127:     const document = await prisma.workspaceDocument.create({
 128:       data: {
 129:         tenantId: (session.user as any).tenantId,
 130:         workspaceId: params.id,
 131:         filename,
 132:         originalName: file.name,
 133:         mimeType: file.type,
 134:         sizeBytes: file.size,
 135:         storagePath,
 136:         documentType: documentType || 'other',
 137:         description,
 138:         aiProcessed: false,
 139:         verified: false,
 140:       },
 141:     });
 142: 
 143:     return NextResponse.json({
 144:       success: true,
 145:       message: 'Document uploadÃ© avec succÃ¨s',
 146:       document,
 147:     });
 148:   } catch (error) {
 149:     logger.error('Erreur POST documents', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 150:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/documents',
 151:     });
 152:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 153:   }
 154: }

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Emails Workspace
   3:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/emails - Liste emails avec filtres

   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   8: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   9: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  10: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  11: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  12: 
  13: /**
  14:  * PATCH - Actions sur emails
  15:  */
  16: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  17:   try {
  18:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     const body = await request.json();
  24:     const { emailId, action } = body;
  25: 
  26:     if (!emailId || !action) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'emailId et action requis' }, { status: 400 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     const updateData: any = {};
  31: 
  32:     switch (action) {
  33:       case 'mark_read':
  34:         updateData.isRead = true;
  35:         break;
  36:       case 'mark_unread':
  37:         updateData.isRead = false;
  38:         break;
  39:       case 'star':
  40:         updateData.isStarred = true;
  41:         break;
  42:       case 'unstar':
  43:         updateData.isStarred = false;
  44:         break;
  45:       case 'archive':
  46:         updateData.isArchived = true;
  47:         break;
  48:       case 'unarchive':
  49:         updateData.isArchived = false;
  50:         break;
  51:       default:
  52:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Action invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  53:     }
  54: 
  55:     const email = await prisma.workspaceEmail.update({
  56:       where: { id: emailId },
  57:       data: updateData,
  58:     });
  59: 
  60:     return NextResponse.json({
  61:       success: true,
  62:       message: `Action ${action} effectuÃ©e`,
  63:       email,
  64:     });
  65:   } catch (error) {
  66:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH email', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  67:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/emails',
  68:     });
  69:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  70:   }

  73: /**
  74:  * GET - Liste emails avec filtres
  75:  */
  76: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  77:   try {
  78:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  79:     if (!session?.user) {
  80:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  81:     }
  82: 
  83:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  84:     const category = searchParams.get('category');
  85:     const priority = searchParams.get('priority');
  86:     const isRead = searchParams.get('isRead');
  87:     const needsResponse = searchParams.get('needsResponse');
  88:     const search = searchParams.get('search');
  89: 
  90:     const where: any = {
  91:       workspaceId: params.id,
  92:     };
  93: 
  94:     if (category) where.category = category;
  95:     if (priority) where.priority = priority;
  96:     if (isRead !== null) where.isRead = isRead === 'true';
  97:     if (needsResponse !== null) where.needsResponse = needsResponse === 'true';
  98: 
  99:     if (search) {
 100:       where.OR = [
 101:         { from: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 102:         { subject: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 103:         { bodyText: { contains: search, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 104:       ];
 105:     }
 106: 
 107:     const emails = await prisma.workspaceEmail.findMany({
 108:       where,
 109:       orderBy: { receivedDate: 'desc' },
 110:       take: 100,
 111:     });
 112: 
 113:     return NextResponse.json({
 114:       success: true,
 115:       emails,
 116:       count: emails.length,
 117:     });
 118:   } catch (error) {
 119:     logger.error('Erreur rÃ©cupÃ©ration emails', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 120:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/emails',

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/notes
   9:  * Liste les notes d'un workspace
  10:  */
  11: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  12:   try {
  13:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  19:     const filter = searchParams.get('filter') || 'all';
  20: 
  21:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer workspace avec notes
  22:     const workspace = await prisma.workspace.findUnique({
  23:       where: { id: params.id },
  24:       include: {
  25:         notes: {
  26:           orderBy: [{ isPinned: 'desc' }, { createdAt: 'desc' }],
  27:         },
  28:       },
  29:     });
  30: 
  31:     if (!workspace) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  33:     }
  34: 
  35:     // Filtrer notes
  36:     let notes = workspace.notes;
  37: 
  38:     if (filter === 'pinned') {
  39:       notes = notes.filter(n => n.isPinned);
  40:     } else if (filter === 'private') {
  41:       notes = notes.filter(n => n.isPrivate);
  42:     } else if (filter === 'team') {
  43:       notes = notes.filter(n => !n.isPrivate);
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     return NextResponse.json({
  47:       success: true,
  48:       count: notes.length,
  49:       notes,
  50:     });
  51:   } catch (error) {
  52:     logger.error('Erreur GET notes', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  53:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/notes',
  54:     });
  55:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  56:   }
  57: }
  58:

  60:  * POST /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/notes

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Checklist Items d'une ProcÃ©dure
   3:  * PATCH /api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/procedures/[procId]/checklist - Toggle checklist item

   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: 
  12: export async function PATCH(
  13:   request: NextRequest,
  14:   { params }: { params: { id: string; procId: string } }
  15: ) {
  16:   try {
  17:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  18:     if (!session?.user) {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     const user = session.user as any;
  23:     const body = await request.json();
  24:     const { itemId, completed } = body;
  25: 
  26:     if (!itemId || completed === undefined) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'itemId et completed requis' }, { status: 400 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     // VÃ©rifier que la procÃ©dure existe et appartient au workspace
  31:     const procedure = await prisma.procedure.findUnique({
  32:       where: { id: params.procId },
  33:     });
  34: 
  35:     if (!procedure) {
  36:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ProcÃ©dure non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     if (procedure.workspaceId !== params.id) {
  40:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     // Mettre Ã  jour checklist item
  44:     const checklistItem = await prisma.procedureChecklistItem.update({
  45:       where: { id: itemId },
  46:       data: {
  47:         completed,
  48:         completedAt: completed ? new Date() : null,
  49:         completedBy: completed ? user.id : null,
  50:       },
  51:     });
  52: 
  53:     // CrÃ©er Ã©vÃ©nement timeline si complÃ©tÃ©
  54:     if (completed) {
  55:       await prisma.timelineEvent.create({
  56:         data: {
  57:           workspaceId: params.id,
  58:           eventType: 'checklist_completed',
  59:           title: 'Item checklist complÃ©tÃ©',
  60:           description: checklistItem.label,
  61:           actorType: 'user',
  62:           actorId: user.id,
  63:         },
  64:       });
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     // Mettre Ã  jour lastActivityDate workspace
  68:     await prisma.workspace.update({
  69:       where: { id: params.id },
  70:       data: { lastActivityDate: new Date() },
  71:     });
  72: 
  73:     return NextResponse.json({
  74:       success: true,
  75:       message: completed ? 'Item complÃ©tÃ©' : 'Item dÃ©cochÃ©',
  76:       checklistItem,
  77:     });
  78:   } catch (error) {
  79:     logger.error('Erreur mise Ã  jour checklist', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  80:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/procedures/[procId]/checklist',
  81:     });
  82:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });

  76: export async function PATCH(
  77:   request: NextRequest,
  78:   { params }: { params: { id: string; procId: string } }
  79: ) {
  80:   try {
  81:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  82:     if (!session?.user) {
  83:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     const user = session.user as any;
  87:     const body = await request.json();
  88: 
  89:     // VÃ©rifier que la procÃ©dure existe et appartient au workspace
  90:     const existing = await prisma.procedure.findUnique({
  91:       where: { id: params.procId },
  92:     });
  93: 
  94:     if (!existing) {
  95:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ProcÃ©dure non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  96:     }
  97: 
  98:     if (existing.workspaceId !== params.id) {
  99:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
 100:     }
 101: 
 102:     // Construire donnÃ©es de mise Ã  jour
 103:     const updateData: any = {};
 104: 
 105:     if (body.title !== undefined) updateData.title = body.title;
 106:     if (body.description !== undefined) updateData.description = body.description;
 107:     if (body.reference !== undefined) updateData.reference = body.reference;
 108:     if (body.status !== undefined) {
 109:       updateData.status = body.status;
 110:       // Si changement de statut
 111:       if (body.status !== existing.status) {
 112:         if (body.status === 'closed') {
 113:           updateData.closedAt = new Date();
 114:         }
 115:         // CrÃ©er Ã©vÃ©nement timeline
 116:         await prisma.timelineEvent.create({
 117:           data: {
 118:             workspaceId: params.id,
 119:             eventType: 'status_changed',
 120:             title: `Statut procÃ©dure modifiÃ©`,
 121:             description: `${existing.status} â†’ ${body.status}`,
 122:             actorType: 'user',
 123:             actorId: user.id,
 124:           },
 125:         });
 126:       }
 127:     }
 128: 
 129:     if (body.urgencyLevel !== undefined) updateData.urgencyLevel = body.urgencyLevel;
 130:     if (body.notificationDate !== undefined) {
 131:       updateData.notificationDate = body.notificationDate ? new Date(body.notificationDate) : null;
 132:     }
 133:     if (body.deadlineDate !== undefined) {
 134:       updateData.deadlineDate = body.deadlineDate ? new Date(body.deadlineDate) : null;
 135:     }
 136:     if (body.assignedToId !== undefined) updateData.assignedToId = body.assignedToId;
 137:     if (body.metadata !== undefined) {
 138:       updateData.metadata = body.metadata ? JSON.stringify(body.metadata) : null;
 139:     }
 140:     if (body.outcome !== undefined) updateData.outcome = body.outcome;
 141:     if (body.outcomeNotes !== undefined) updateData.outcomeNotes = body.outcomeNotes;
 142: 
 143:     // Toujours mettre Ã  jour updatedAt
 144:     updateData.updatedAt = new Date();
 145: 
 146:     // Mettre Ã  jour procÃ©dure
 147:     const procedure = await prisma.procedure.update({
 148:       where: { id: params.procId },
 149:       data: updateData,
 150:       include: {
 151:         checklist: true,
 152:         echeances: true,
 153:       },
 154:     });
 155: 
 156:     // Mettre Ã  jour lastActivityDate workspace
 157:     await prisma.workspace.update({
 158:       where: { id: params.id },
 159:       data: { lastActivityDate: new Date() },
 160:     });
 161: 
 162:     return NextResponse.json({
 163:       success: true,
 164:       message: 'ProcÃ©dure mise Ã  jour',
 165:       procedure,
 166:     });
 167:   } catch (error) {
 168:     logger.error('Erreur mise Ã  jour procÃ©dure', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 169:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/procedures/[procId]',
 170:     });
 171:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 172:   }
 173: }

 175: export async function DELETE(
 176:   request: NextRequest,
 177:   { params }: { params: { id: string; procId: string } }
 178: ) {
 179:   try {
 180:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
 181:     if (!session?.user) {
 182:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 183:     }
 184: 
 185:     const user = session.user as any;
 186: 
 187:     // VÃ©rifier que la procÃ©dure existe et appartient au workspace
 188:     const procedure = await prisma.procedure.findUnique({
 189:       where: { id: params.procId },
 190:       include: {
 191:         checklist: true,
 192:         documents: true,
 193:         echeances: true,
 194:         documentDrafts: true,
 195:       },
 196:     });
 197: 
 198:     if (!procedure) {
 199:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ProcÃ©dure non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     if (procedure.workspaceId !== params.id) {
 203:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
 204:     }
 205: 
 206:     // Supprimer en cascade (Prisma devrait gÃ©rer automatiquement avec onDelete: Cascade)
 207:     await prisma.procedure.delete({
 208:       where: { id: params.procId },
 209:     });
 210: 
 211:     // CrÃ©er Ã©vÃ©nement timeline
 212:     await prisma.timelineEvent.create({
 213:       data: {
 214:         workspaceId: params.id,
 215:         eventType: 'procedure_deleted',
 216:         title: `ProcÃ©dure ${procedure.procedureType} supprimÃ©e`,
 217:         description: procedure.title,
 218:         actorType: 'user',
 219:         actorId: user.id,
 220:       },
 221:     });
 222: 
 223:     // Mettre Ã  jour stats workspace
 224:     await prisma.workspace.update({
 225:       where: { id: params.id },
 226:       data: {
 227:         totalProcedures: { decrement: 1 },
 228:         activeProcedures: procedure.status === 'active' ? { decrement: 1 } : undefined,
 229:         lastActivityDate: new Date(),
 230:       },
 231:     });
 232: 
 233:     return NextResponse.json({
 234:       success: true,
 235:       message: 'ProcÃ©dure supprimÃ©e',
 236:     });
 237:   } catch (error) {
 238:     logger.error('Erreur suppression procÃ©dure', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 239:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces/[id]/procedures/[procId]',
 240:     });
 241:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 242:   }

 103:     }

 120:       tenantId: workspace.tenantId,
 121:     });

   7: /**
   8:  * GET /api/lawyer/workspaces - List workspaces (CESDA old + Reasoning new)
   9:  */
  10: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const user = session.user as any;
  19:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  20: 
  21:     if (!tenantId) {
  22:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 400 });
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     // Recuperer les parametres de filtrage
  26:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  27:     const type = searchParams.get('type') || 'reasoning'; // 'reasoning' | 'cesda'
  28:     const state = searchParams.get('state');
  29:     const locked = searchParams.get('locked');
  30:     const search = searchParams.get('search');
  31: 
  32:     if (type === 'reasoning') {
  33:       // Nouveau systeme WorkspaceReasoning
  34:       const where: any = { tenantId };
  35: 
  36:       if (state && state !== 'ALL') {
  37:         where.currentState = state;
  38:       }
  39: 
  40:       if (locked !== null) {
  41:         where.locked = locked === 'true';
  42:       }
  43: 
  44:       if (search) {
  45:         where.OR = [
  46:           { id: { contains: search } },
  47:           { sourceRaw: { contains: search } },
  48:           { procedureType: { contains: search } },
  49:         ];
  50:       }
  51: 
  52:       const workspaces = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findMany({
  53:         where,
  54:         include: {
  55:           facts: { take: 5 },
  56:           missingElements: {
  57:             where: { resolved: false },
  58:             take: 5,
  59:           },
  60:           _count: {
  61:             select: {
  62:               facts: true,
  63:               contexts: true,
  64:               obligations: true,
  65:               missingElements: true,
  66:               risks: true,
  67:               proposedActions: true,
  68:             },
  69:           },
  70:         },
  71:         orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  72:         take: 100,
  73:       });
  74: 
  75:       return NextResponse.json({
  76:         success: true,
  77:         workspaces,
  78:         count: workspaces.length,
  79:         type: 'reasoning',
  80:       });
  81:     }
  82: 
  83:     // Ancien systeme Workspace CESDA (fallback)
  84:     const oldWorkspaces = await prisma.workspace.findMany({
  85:       where: { tenantId },
  86:       include: {
  87:         client: {
  88:           select: {
  89:             id: true,
  90:             firstName: true,
  91:             lastName: true,
  92:           },
  93:         },
  94:         _count: {
  95:           select: {
  96:             documents: true,
  97:             alerts: true,
  98:           },
  99:         },
 100:       },
 101:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 102:       take: 100,
 103:     });
 104: 
 105:     return NextResponse.json({
 106:       success: true,
 107:       workspaces: oldWorkspaces,
 108:       count: oldWorkspaces.length,
 109:       type: 'cesda',
 110:     });
 111:   } catch (error) {
 112:     logger.error('Erreur recuperation workspaces', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 113:       route: '/api/lawyer/workspaces',
 114:     });
 115:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 116:   }
 117: }

 229:         tenantId,

 231:         procedureType,
 232:         title,
 233:         description: description || null,
 234:         urgencyLevel: urgencyLevel || 'moyen',
 235:         status: status || 'active',

 237:         notificationDate: notificationDate ? new Date(notificationDate) : null,
 238:         createdById: userId,

 245:             lastName: true,

   1: import { legalProofService } from '@/lib/services/legal-proof.service';
   2: import { ProofFormat } from '@/types/legal-proof';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/legal/proof/export
   8:  *
   9:  * Exporter une preuve lÃ©gale dans diffÃ©rents formats
  10:  *
  11:  * Body:
  12:  * {
  13:  *   "proofId": "proof_123",
  14:  *   "format": "PDF",
  15:  *   "includeAuditTrail": true,
  16:  *   "includeSignatures": true,
  17:  *   "watermark": "CONFIDENTIEL",
  18:  *   "language": "fr"
  19:  * }
  20:  */
  21: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  22:   try {
  23:     const session = await getServerSession();
  24:     if (!session?.user) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     const body = await req.json();
  29:     const {
  30:       proofId,
  31:       format = ProofFormat.PDF,
  32:       includeAuditTrail = true,
  33:       includeSignatures = true,
  34:       watermark,
  35:       language = 'fr',
  36:     } = body;
  37: 
  38:     if (!proofId) {
  39:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'proofId is required' }, { status: 400 });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     // Exporter la preuve
  43:     const buffer = await legalProofService.exportProof(proofId, {
  44:       format,
  45:       includeAuditTrail,
  46:       includeSignatures,
  47:       watermark,
  48:       language,
  49:     });
  50: 
  51:     // DÃ©terminer le Content-Type
  52:     const contentTypes: Record<ProofFormat, string> = {
  53:       JSON: 'application/json',
  54:       PDF: 'application/pdf',
  55:       XML: 'application/xml',
  56:       BLOCKCHAIN: 'text/plain',
  57:     };
  58: 
  59:     // DÃ©terminer l'extension
  60:     const extensions: Record<ProofFormat, string> = {
  61:       JSON: 'json',
  62:       PDF: 'pdf',
  63:       XML: 'xml',
  64:       BLOCKCHAIN: 'txt',
  65:     };
  66: 
  67:     const contentType = contentTypes[format] || 'application/octet-stream';
  68:     const extension = extensions[format] || 'bin';
  69:     const filename = `legal-proof-${proofId}.${extension}`;
  70:     const responseBuffer = new Uint8Array(buffer as Buffer);
  71: 
  72:     return new NextResponse(responseBuffer, {
  73:       status: 200,
  74:       headers: {
  75:         'Content-Type': contentType,
  76:         'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${filename}"`,
  77:         'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
  78:       },
  79:     });
  80:   } catch (error: any) {
  81:     console.error('Error exporting legal proof:', error);
  82:     return NextResponse.json(
  83:       { error: error.message || 'Failed to export legal proof' },
  84:       { status: 500 }
  85:     );
  86:   }
  87: }

   1: import { legalProofService } from '@/lib/services/legal-proof.service';
   2: import { ProofType } from '@/types/legal-proof';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/legal/proof/generate
   8:  *
   9:  * GÃ©nÃ©rer une preuve lÃ©gale pour une entitÃ©
  10:  *
  11:  * Body:
  12:  * {
  13:  *   "entityType": "dossier",
  14:  *   "entityId": "dossier-123",
  15:  *   "type": "DOCUMENT",
  16:  *   "reason": "Preuve de rÃ©ception du dossier",
  17:  *   "jurisdiction": "FR",
  18:  *   "includeTimestampAuthority": true,
  19:  *   "signatures": [
  20:  *     {
  21:  *       "signerId": "user-123",
  22:  *       "signerName": "Jean Dupont",
  23:  *       "signerEmail": "jean@example.com",
  24:  *       "type": "SIMPLE"
  25:  *     }
  26:  *   ]
  27:  * }
  28:  */
  29: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  30:   try {
  31:     const session = await getServerSession();
  32:     if (!session?.user) {
  33:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     const body = await req.json();
  37:     const {
  38:       entityType,
  39:       entityId,
  40:       type = ProofType.DOCUMENT,
  41:       reason,
  42:       jurisdiction,
  43:       includeTimestampAuthority = false,
  44:       signatures = [],
  45:     } = body;
  46: 
  47:     // Validation
  48:     if (!entityType || !entityId) {
  49:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'entityType and entityId are required' }, { status: 400 });
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // GÃ©nÃ©rer la preuve
  53:     const proof = await legalProofService.generateProofBundle({
  54:       type,
  55:       tenantId: (session.user as any).tenantId || 'default',
  56:       entityId,
  57:       entityType,
  58:       createdBy: session.user.email || 'unknown',
  59:       reason,
  60:       jurisdiction,
  61:       includeTimestampAuthority,
  62:       signatures,
  63:     });
  64: 
  65:     return NextResponse.json({
  66:       success: true,
  67:       proof: {
  68:         id: proof.id,
  69:         type: proof.type,
  70:         documentHash: proof.documentHash,
  71:         timestamp: proof.timestamp,
  72:         proofHash: proof.proofHash,
  73:         signaturesCount: proof.signatures.length,
  74:         hasTimestampAuthority: !!proof.timestampAuthority,
  75:         validationStatus: proof.validationStatus,
  76:       },
  77:     });
  78:   } catch (error: any) {
  79:     console.error('Error generating legal proof:', error);
  80:     return NextResponse.json(
  81:       { error: error.message || 'Failed to generate legal proof' },
  82:       { status: 500 }
  83:     );
  84:   }
  85: }

   1: import { legalProofService } from '@/lib/services/legal-proof.service';
   2: import { SignatureType } from '@/types/legal-proof';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * POST /api/legal/proof/sign
   8:  *
   9:  * Ajouter une signature Ã©lectronique Ã  une preuve existante
  10:  *
  11:  * Body:
  12:  * {
  13:  *   "proofId": "proof_123",
  14:  *   "signerName": "Marie Martin",
  15:  *   "signerEmail": "marie@example.com",
  16:  *   "type": "ADVANCED",
  17:  *   "certificate": "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."
  18:  * }
  19:  */
  20: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  21:   try {
  22:     const session = await getServerSession();
  23:     if (!session?.user) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     const body = await req.json();
  28:     const { proofId, signerName, signerEmail, type = SignatureType.SIMPLE, certificate } = body;
  29: 
  30:     // Validation
  31:     if (!proofId || !signerName || !signerEmail) {
  32:       return NextResponse.json(
  33:         { error: 'proofId, signerName, and signerEmail are required' },
  34:         { status: 400 }
  35:       );
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Ajouter la signature
  39:     const updatedProof = await legalProofService.addSignature(proofId, {
  40:       signerId: session.user.email || 'unknown',
  41:       signerName,
  42:       signerEmail,
  43:       type,
  44:       certificate,
  45:       algorithm: 'SHA-256',
  46:     });
  47: 
  48:     return NextResponse.json({
  49:       success: true,
  50:       proof: {
  51:         id: updatedProof.id,
  52:         signaturesCount: updatedProof.signatures.length,
  53:         lastSignature: updatedProof.signatures[updatedProof.signatures.length - 1],
  54:       },
  55:     });
  56:   } catch (error: any) {
  57:     console.error('Error signing legal proof:', error);
  58:     return NextResponse.json(
  59:       { error: error.message || 'Failed to sign legal proof' },
  60:       { status: 500 }
  61:     );
  62:   }
  63: }

   1: /**
   2:  * PUT /api/legal-deadlines/[id]/acknowledge
   3:  * Acquitte une deadline â€” stoppe les relances automatiques.
   4:  * PLAN_COMPLET.md Â§5.4 : "Pas de relance si acknowledgedAt est non null"
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
  11: 
  12: export async function PUT(
  13:   _request: NextRequest,
  14:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  15: ) {
  16:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  18: 
  19:   const user = session.user as { tenantId?: string; id?: string; role?: string };
  20:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  21:   const userId = user.id;
  22:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  23:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  24:   if (!userId || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'MANAGER'].includes(role)) {
  25:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  26:   }
  27: 
  28:   const { id } = await params;
  29: 
  30:   const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({
  31:     where: { id, tenantId },
  32:   });
  33:   if (!deadline) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Deadline non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  34:   if (deadline.acknowledgedAt) {
  35:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'DÃ©jÃ  acquittÃ©e', acknowledgedAt: deadline.acknowledgedAt }, { status: 409 });
  36:   }
  37: 
  38:   const updated = await prisma.legalDeadline.update({
  39:     where: { id },
  40:     data: { acknowledgedBy: userId, acknowledgedAt: new Date() },
  41:   });
  42: 
  43:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, deadline: updated });
  44: }

src\app\api\legal-deadlines\[id]\suspend\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * PUT /api/legal-deadlines/[id]/suspend
   3:  * Suspend une deadline (bloquÃ©e par un tiers).
   4:  * PLAN_COMPLET.md Â§4 CU-05 : justification obligatoire, rappel J+14.
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
  11: import { z } from 'zod';
  12: 
  13: const SuspendSchema = z.object({
  14:   reason: z.string().min(5, 'Justification requise (min 5 caractÃ¨res)'),
  15: });
  16: 
  17: export async function PUT(
  18:   request: NextRequest,
  19:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  20: ) {
  21:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  22:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  23: 
  24:   const user = session.user as { tenantId?: string; id?: string; role?: string };
  25:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  26:   const userId = user.id;
  27:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  28:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  29:   if (!userId || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'MANAGER'].includes(role)) {
  30:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  31:   }
  32: 
  33:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
  34:   const parsed = SuspendSchema.safeParse(body);
  35:   if (!parsed.success) {
  36:     return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.errors[0].message }, { status: 400 });
  37:   }
  38: 
  39:   const { id } = await params;
  40: 
  41:   const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });
  42:   if (!deadline) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Deadline non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  43:   if (deadline.status === 'SUSPENDED') {
  44:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'DÃ©jÃ  suspendue' }, { status: 409 });
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   const now = new Date();
  48:   const reminderDate = new Date(now.getTime() + 14 * 86_400_000);
  49: 
  50:   const updated = await prisma.legalDeadline.update({
  51:     where: { id },
  52:     data: {
  53:       status: 'SUSPENDED',
  54:       suspendedReason: parsed.data.reason,
  55:       suspendedAt: now,
  56:       suspendedBy: userId,
  57:     },
  58:   });
  59: 
  60:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, deadline: updated, reminderDate });
  61: }
  62: 
  63: /**
  64:  * DELETE /api/legal-deadlines/[id]/suspend â€” RÃ©active une deadline suspendue
  65:  */
  66: export async function DELETE(
  67:   _request: NextRequest,
  68:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  69: ) {
  70:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  71:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  72: 
  73:   const user = session.user as { tenantId?: string; role?: string };
  74:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  75:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  76:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  77:   if (!['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'MANAGER'].includes(role)) {
  78:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   const { id } = await params;
  82: 
  83:   const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId, status: 'SUSPENDED' } });
  84:   if (!deadline) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Deadline suspendue non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  85: 
  86:   const now = new Date();
  87:   // Recalculer le statut selon la date d'Ã©chÃ©ance
  88:   let newStatus: string = 'PENDING';
  89:   const daysLeft = (deadline.dueDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 86_400_000;
  90:   if (daysLeft < 0) newStatus = 'OVERDUE';
  91:   else if (daysLeft <= 1) newStatus = 'CRITICAL';
  92:   else if (daysLeft <= 3) newStatus = 'URGENT';
  93:   else if (daysLeft <= 7) newStatus = 'APPROACHING';
  94: 
  95:   const updated = await prisma.legalDeadline.update({
  96:     where: { id },
  97:     data: {
  98:       status: newStatus as 'PENDING' | 'APPROACHING' | 'URGENT' | 'CRITICAL' | 'OVERDUE',
  99:       suspendedReason: null,
 100:       suspendedAt: null,
 101:       suspendedBy: null,
 102:     },
 103:   });
 104: 
 105:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, deadline: updated });
 106: }

src\app\api\legal-deadlines\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { z } from 'zod';
   4: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: 
   8: const deadlineTypes = [
   9:   'RECOURS_GRACIEUX',
  10:   'RECOURS_HIERARCHIQUE',
  11:   'RECOURS_CONTENTIEUX',
  12:   'APPEL',
  13:   'CASSATION',
  14:   'REPONSE_PREFECTURE',
  15:   'CONVOCATION_AUDIENCE',
  16:   'PRODUCTION_PIECES',
  17:   'EXECUTION_DECISION',
  18:   'OQTF',
  19:   'RETENTION',
  20:   'CUSTOM',
  21: ] as const;
  22: const deadlineStatuses = ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING', 'URGENT', 'CRITICAL', 'OVERDUE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'SUSPENDED'] as const;
  23: const managedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'LAWYER', 'MANAGER']);
  24: 
  25: const CreateDeadlineSchema = z.object({
  26:   dossierId: z.string().min(1),
  27:   clientId: z.string().min(1),
  28:   type: z.enum(deadlineTypes),
  29:   label: z.string().trim().min(1).max(255),
  30:   description: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  31:   referenceDate: z.coerce.date(),
  32:   legalDays: z.number().int().min(1).max(3_650).optional(),
  33:   legalBasis: z.string().max(1_000).optional(),
  34: });
  35: 
  36: const UpdateDeadlineSchema = z.object({
  37:   deadlineId: z.string().min(1),
  38:   status: z.enum(deadlineStatuses).optional(),
  39:   completionNote: z.string().max(10_000).optional(),
  40:   proofId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  41: });
  42: 
  43: async function resolveAccess(requestedTenantId: string | null) {
  44:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  45:   if (!session?.user) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 }) };
  46: 
  47:   const user = session.user as { id?: string; tenantId?: string; role?: string };
  48:   const role = user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
  49:   if (!user.id) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Session invalide' }, { status: 401 }) };
  50: 
  51:   if (role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && requestedTenantId) {
  52:     return { tenantId: requestedTenantId, userId: user.id, role };
  53:   }
  54:   if (!user.tenantId) return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 }) };
  55:   if (requestedTenantId && requestedTenantId !== user.tenantId) {
  56:     return { error: NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 }) };
  57:   }
  58:   return { tenantId: user.tenantId, userId: user.id, role };
  59: }
  60: 
  61: function canManageDeadlines(role: string) {
  62:   return managedRoles.has(role);
  63: }
  64: 
  65: // GET - Liste des dÃ©lais lÃ©gaux du tenant de la session
  66: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  67:   try {
  68:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  69:     const access = await resolveAccess(searchParams.get('tenantId'));
  70:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
  71: 
  72:     const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  73:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  74:     const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') ?? '50', 10) || 50));
  75:     const offset = Math.max(0, Number.parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') ?? '0', 10) || 0);
  76:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId: access.tenantId };
  77:     if (dossierId) where.dossierId = dossierId;
  78:     if (status && deadlineStatuses.includes(status as (typeof deadlineStatuses)[number])) where.status = status;
  79: 
  80:     const [deadlines, total] = await Promise.all([
  81:       prisma.legalDeadline.findMany({
  82:         where,
  83:         include: {
  84:           dossier: { select: { numero: true, client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } } } },
  85:           alerts: { orderBy: { sentAt: 'desc' }, take: 3 },
  86:         },
  87:         orderBy: { dueDate: 'asc' },
  88:         take: limit,
  89:         skip: offset,
  90:       }),
  91:       prisma.legalDeadline.count({ where }),
  92:     ]);
  93:     return NextResponse.json({ deadlines, total, hasMore: offset + deadlines.length < total });
  94:   } catch (error) {
  95:     logger.error('Erreur GET legal-deadlines', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/legal-deadlines' });
  96:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  97:   }
  98: }
  99: 
 100: // POST - CrÃ©er un dÃ©lai lÃ©gal structurÃ© et rattachÃ© au tenant de la session
 101: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
 102:   try {
 103:     const access = await resolveAccess(null);
 104:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
 105:     if (!canManageDeadlines(access.role)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
 106: 
 107:     const parsed = CreateDeadlineSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
 108:     if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide', details: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });
 109: 
 110:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
 111:       where: { id: parsed.data.dossierId, tenantId: access.tenantId, clientId: parsed.data.clientId },
 112:       select: { id: true },
 113:     });
 114:     if (!dossier) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier ou client non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 115: 
 116:     const defaultDays: Partial<Record<(typeof deadlineTypes)[number], number>> = {
 117:       RECOURS_GRACIEUX: 60, RECOURS_HIERARCHIQUE: 60, RECOURS_CONTENTIEUX: 60, APPEL: 30, CASSATION: 60, OQTF: 30,
 118:     };
 119:     const legalDays = parsed.data.legalDays ?? defaultDays[parsed.data.type] ?? 30;
 120:     const dueDate = new Date(parsed.data.referenceDate);
 121:     dueDate.setDate(dueDate.getDate() + legalDays);
 122: 
 123:     const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.create({
 124:       data: {
 125:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
 126:         tenantId: access.tenantId,
 127:         dossierId: parsed.data.dossierId,
 128:         clientId: parsed.data.clientId,
 129:         type: parsed.data.type,
 130:         label: parsed.data.label,
 131:         description: parsed.data.description,
 132:         referenceDate: parsed.data.referenceDate,
 133:         dueDate,
 134:         legalDays,
 135:         legalBasis: parsed.data.legalBasis,
 136:         createdBy: access.userId,
 137:       },
 138:     });
 139:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, deadline }, { status: 201 });
 140:   } catch (error) {
 141:     logger.error('Erreur POST legal-deadline', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/legal-deadlines' });
 142:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 143:   }
 144: }
 145: 
 146: // PATCH - Mettre Ã  jour un dÃ©lai du tenant de la session
 147: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 148:   try {
 149:     const access = await resolveAccess(null);
 150:     if ('error' in access) return access.error;
 151:     if (!canManageDeadlines(access.role)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
 152: 
 153:     const parsed = UpdateDeadlineSchema.safeParse(await request.json());
 154:     if (!parsed.success) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide', details: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 });
 155: 
 156:     const existing = await prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({ where: { id: parsed.data.deadlineId, tenantId: access.tenantId } });
 157:     if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'DÃ©lai non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
 158: 
 159:     const data = {
 160:       ...(parsed.data.status ? { status: parsed.data.status } : {}),
 161:       ...(parsed.data.status === 'COMPLETED' ? { completedBy: access.userId, completedAt: new Date() } : {}),
 162:       ...(parsed.data.completionNote !== undefined ? { completionNote: parsed.data.completionNote } : {}),
 163:       ...(parsed.data.proofId !== undefined ? { proofId: parsed.data.proofId } : {}),
 164:     };
 165:     const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.update({ where: { id: existing.id }, data });
 166:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, deadline });
 167:   } catch (error) {
 168:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH legal-deadline', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, { route: '/api/legal-deadlines' });
 169:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 170:   }
 171: }

src\app\api\legifrance\search\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Routes Legifrance pour Next.js
   3:  * 
   4:  * Endpoints pour exposer les fonctionnalites Legifrance
   5:  * avec authentification et isolation tenant
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth/next';
  10: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  11: import { legifranceApi } from '@/lib/legifrance/api-client';
  12: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  13: import { searchCache } from '@/lib/cache/cache-service';
  14: import { withRateLimit } from '@/lib/middleware/rate-limit';
  15: import crypto from 'crypto';
  16: 
  17: // Actions en lecture seule (résultats stables à court terme) éligibles au cache.
  18: // 'ping' est volontairement exclu : il vérifie l'état live de l'API.
  19: const CACHEABLE_ACTIONS = new Set([
  20:   'search-ceseda',
  21:   'get-ceseda-article',
  22:   'search-ceseda-keywords',
  23:   'search-jurisprudence-admin',
  24:   'search-jurisprudence-judiciaire',
  25:   'get-ceseda-recent-caselaw',
  26:   'get-article',
  27:   'get-texte',
  28:   'get-last-jo',
  29:   'get-jorf-content',
  30: ]);
  31: 
  32: /**
  33:  * POST /api/legifrance/search
  34:  * Recherche generique dans Legifrance
  35:  */
  36: export const POST = withRateLimit(
  37:   async (req: NextRequest) => {
  38:   try {
  39:     // Authentification
  40:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
  41:     if (!session?.user) {
  42:       return NextResponse.json(
  43:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  44:         { status: 401 }
  45:       );
  46:     }
  47: 
  48:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  49:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  50: 
  51:     // Parse body
  52:     const body = await req.json();
  53:     const { action, params } = body;
  54: 
  55:     logger.info(`Requete Legifrance: ${action}`, { userId, tenantId, action });
  56: 
  57:     // Cache des recherches en lecture seule : évite de resolliciter PISTE
  58:     // pour des requêtes identiques répétées par plusieurs avocats.
  59:     const cacheable = CACHEABLE_ACTIONS.has(action);
  60:     const cacheKey = cacheable
  61:       ? `legifrance:${action}:${crypto.createHash('sha1').update(JSON.stringify(params || {})).digest('hex')}`
  62:       : null;
  63: 
  64:     if (cacheKey) {
  65:       const cached = await searchCache.get<Record<string, unknown>>(cacheKey);
  66:       if (cached) {
  67:         return NextResponse.json({ ...cached, cached: true });
  68:       }
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     let result;
  72: 
  73:     switch (action) {
  74:       // ============================================
  75:       // RECHERCHE CESEDA
  76:       // ============================================
  77: 
  78:       case 'search-ceseda':
  79:         result = await legifranceApi.searchCeseda(params);
  80:         break;
  81: 
  82:       case 'get-ceseda-article':
  83:         const { numeroArticle, date } = params;
  84:         result = await legifranceApi.getCesedaArticle(numeroArticle, date);
  85:         break;
  86: 
  87:       case 'search-ceseda-keywords':
  88:         const { keywords, options } = params;
  89:         result = await legifranceApi.searchCesedaByKeywords(keywords, options);
  90:         break;
  91: 
  92:       // ============================================
  93:       // JURISPRUDENCE
  94:       // ============================================
  95: 
  96:       case 'search-jurisprudence-admin':
  97:         result = await legifranceApi.searchJurisprudenceAdministrative(params);
  98:         break;
  99: 
 100:       case 'search-jurisprudence-judiciaire':
 101:         result = await legifranceApi.searchJurisprudenceJudiciaire(params);
 102:         break;
 103: 
 104:       case 'get-ceseda-recent-caselaw':
 105:         result = await legifranceApi.getCesedaRecentCaseLaw(params);
 106:         break;
 107: 
 108:       // ============================================
 109:       // CONSULTATION
 110:       // ============================================
 111: 
 112:       case 'get-article':
 113:         result = await legifranceApi.getArticle(params.articleId);
 114:         break;
 115: 
 116:       case 'get-texte':
 117:         result = await legifranceApi.getTextePart(params.textId, params.date);
 118:         break;
 119: 
 120:       // ============================================
 121:       // JOURNAL OFFICIEL
 122:       // ============================================
 123: 
 124:       case 'get-last-jo':
 125:         result = await legifranceApi.getLastJournalOfficiel(params.nbElements);
 126:         break;
 127: 
 128:       case 'get-jorf-content':
 129:         result = await legifranceApi.getJorfContent(params.jorfContId, params.options);
 130:         break;
 131: 
 132:       // ============================================
 133:       // UTILITAIRES
 134:       // ============================================
 135: 
 136:       case 'ping':
 137:         const isAvailable = await legifranceApi.ping();
 138:         result = { available: isAvailable, environment: legifranceApi.getEnvironment() };
 139:         break;
 140: 
 141:       default:
 142:         return NextResponse.json(
 143:           { error: `Action non supportee: ${action}` },
 144:           { status: 400 }
 145:         );
 146:     }
 147: 
 148:     // Log succes
 149:     logger.info(`Legifrance ${action} reussi`, {
 150:       userId,
 151:       tenantId,
 152:       action,
 153:       resultCount: (result as any)?.totalResultNumber || (result as any)?.results?.length || 1,
 154:     });
 155: 
 156:     const responsePayload = {
 157:       success: true,
 158:       action,
 159:       data: result,
 160:       environment: legifranceApi.getEnvironment(),
 161:     };
 162: 
 163:     if (cacheKey) {
 164:       await searchCache.set(cacheKey, responsePayload);
 165:     }
 166: 
 167:     return NextResponse.json(responsePayload);
 168: 
 169:   } catch (error) {
 170:     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erreur inconnue';
 171:     
 172:     logger.error('Erreur API Legifrance', error);
 173: 
 174:     return NextResponse.json(
 175:       {
 176:         success: false,
 177:         error: errorMessage,
 178:         environment: legifranceApi.getEnvironment(),
 179:       },
 180:       { status: 500 }
 181:     );
 182:   }
 183:   },
 184:   { type: 'api' }
 185: );
 186: 
 187: /**
 188:  * GET /api/legifrance/search
 189:  * Health check et info environnement
 190:  */
 191: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
 192:   try {
 193:     const session: any = await getServerSession(authOptions as any);
 194:     if (!session?.user) {
 195:       return NextResponse.json(
 196:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
 197:         { status: 401 }
 198:       );
 199:     }
 200: 
 201:     const isAvailable = await legifranceApi.ping();
 202: 
 203:     return NextResponse.json({
 204:       available: isAvailable,
 205:       environment: legifranceApi.getEnvironment(),
 206:       endpoints: [
 207:         'search-ceseda',
 208:         'get-ceseda-article',
 209:         'search-ceseda-keywords',
 210:         'search-jurisprudence-admin',
 211:         'search-jurisprudence-judiciaire',
 212:         'get-ceseda-recent-caselaw',
 213:         'get-article',
 214:         'get-texte',
 215:         'get-last-jo',
 216:         'get-jorf-content',
 217:         'ping',
 218:       ],
 219:     });
 220:   } catch (error) {
 221:     return NextResponse.json(
 222:       {
 223:         available: false,
 224:         error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erreur inconnue',
 225:       },
 226:       { status: 500 }
 227:     );
 228:   }
 229: }

   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { getEmailIngestionMetricsSnapshot, resetEmailIngestionMetrics } from '@/lib/email/ingestion-metrics';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: async function requireAdmin() {
   7:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   8:   if (!session?.user) {
   9:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  10:   }
  11: 
  12:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  13:   if (!['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(role)) {
  14:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  15:   }
  16: 
  17:   return null;
  18: }
  19: 
  20: export async function GET() {
  21:   const authError = await requireAdmin();
  22:   if (authError) {
  23:     return authError;
  24:   }
  25: 
  26:   const snapshot = getEmailIngestionMetricsSnapshot();
  27:   return NextResponse.json({
  28:     success: true,
  29:     status: snapshot.health.status,
  30:     data: snapshot,
  31:   });
  32: }
  33: 
  34: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  35:   const authError = await requireAdmin();
  36:   if (authError) {
  37:     return authError;
  38:   }
  39: 
  40:   const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  41:   const action = searchParams.get('action') || 'reset';
  42: 
  43:   if (action !== 'reset') {
  44:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Action invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  45:   }
  46: 
  47:   resetEmailIngestionMetrics();
  48:   const snapshot = getEmailIngestionMetricsSnapshot();
  49: 
  50:   return NextResponse.json({
  51:     success: true,
  52:     status: snapshot.health.status,
  53:     message: 'Compteurs ingestion email reinitialises',
  54:     data: snapshot,
  55:   });
  56: }

src\app\api\monitoring\metrics-dashboard\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
   2: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
   3: /**
   4:  * Sentry Metrics Dashboard Endpoint
   5:  * Phase 5: Optimisations
   6:  *
   7:  * GET /api/monitoring/metrics-dashboard
   8:  *
   9:  * Shows:
  10:  * - Real-time webhook metrics (success/error/duplicate rates)
  11:  * - Performance stats (duration percentiles)
  12:  * - Channel breakdown
  13:  * - Error trends
  14:  * - Alerts
  15:  */
  16: 
  17: import { withCompression } from '@/lib/compression';
  18: import { getCacheStats, getOrCompute } from '@/lib/response-cache';
  19: import {
  20:   getAlertsStatus,
  21:   getMetricsComparison,
  22:   getMetricsSnapshot,
  23: } from '@/lib/sentry-metrics-dashboard';
  24: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  25: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  26: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  27: 
  28: export const revalidate = 60; // ISR - revalidate every 60 seconds
  29: 
  30: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  31:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  32:   if (!session?.user) {
  33:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  37:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  38:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  39:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  40:   }
  41: 
  42:   return null;
  43: }
  44: 
  45: export async function GET() {
  46:   try {
  47:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  48:     if (authError) {
  49:       return authError;
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // Use caching for this expensive operation
  53:     const dashboardData = await getOrCompute(
  54:       '/api/monitoring/metrics-dashboard',
  55:       async () => {
  56:         const currentMetrics = getMetricsSnapshot(3600); // Last 1 hour
  57:         const comparison = getMetricsComparison();
  58:         const alerts = getAlertsStatus();
  59:         const cacheStats = getCacheStats();
  60: 
  61:         // Calculate trends
  62:         const hourlyChange =
  63:           comparison.lastHour.metrics.successRate -
  64:           (comparison.last24Hours.metrics.totalEvents > 0 ? 80 : 0); // Compare to daily baseline
  65:         const last24hTrend = {
  66:           successRate: comparison.last24Hours.metrics.successRate,
  67:           errorRate: comparison.last24Hours.metrics.errorRate,
  68:           avgDuration: comparison.last24Hours.metrics.avgDuration,
  69:         };
  70: 
  71:         return {
  72:           dashboard: {
  73:             type: 'webhook-metrics',
  74:             refreshInterval: 60,
  75:             generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  76:           },
  77:           currentStatus: {
  78:             health: alerts.alerts.length === 0 ? 'healthy' : 'degraded',
  79:             activeAlerts: alerts.alerts.length,
  80:             lastHourMetrics: currentMetrics.metrics,
  81:           },
  82:           overview: {
  83:             uptime: '99.95%',
  84:             avgResponseTime: Math.round(currentMetrics.metrics.avgDuration),
  85:             successRate: currentMetrics.metrics.successRate,
  86:             errorCount: currentMetrics.metrics.errorCount,
  87:             duplicateCount: currentMetrics.metrics.duplicateCount,
  88:             rateLimitedCount: currentMetrics.metrics.rateLimitedCount,
  89:           },
  90:           timeSeries: {
  91:             lastHour: currentMetrics.metrics,
  92:             last24Hours: comparison.last24Hours.metrics,
  93:             last7Days: comparison.last7Days.metrics,
  94:             trends: {
  95:               hourlyChange: Math.round(hourlyChange * 100) / 100,
  96:               last24h: last24hTrend,
  97:             },
  98:           },
  99:           byChannel: currentMetrics.byChannel,
 100:           errorBreakdown: currentMetrics.errorBreakdown,
 101:           performancePercentiles: {
 102:             p50: currentMetrics.metrics.p50Duration,
 103:             p95: currentMetrics.metrics.p95Duration,
 104:             p99: currentMetrics.metrics.p99Duration,
 105:             min: currentMetrics.metrics.minDuration,
 106:             max: currentMetrics.metrics.maxDuration,
 107:           },
 108:           alerts: alerts.alerts,
 109:           cacheMetrics: {
 110:             hitRate: cacheStats.hitRate,
 111:             cachedEntries: cacheStats.size,
 112:           },
 113:           recommendations: generateRecommendations(currentMetrics, alerts),
 114:         };
 115:       },
 116:       60000 // Cache for 60 seconds
 117:     );
 118: 
 119:     return await withCompression(dashboardData);
 120:   } catch (error) {
 121:     console.error('Dashboard error:', error);
 122:     return NextResponse.json(
 123:       {
 124:         error: 'Failed to generate metrics dashboard',
 125:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 126:       },
 127:       { status: 500 }
 128:     );
 129:   }
 130: }
 131: 
 132: /**
 133:  * Generate optimization recommendations based on metrics
 134:  */
 135: function generateRecommendations(
 136:   metrics: any,
 137:   alerts: any
 138: ): Array<{
 139:   category: string;
 140:   priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low';
 141:   recommendation: string;
 142:   metric: string;
 143: }> {
 144:   const recommendations: Array<any> = [];
 145: 
 146:   // High error rate recommendation
 147:   if (metrics.metrics.errorRate > 5) {
 148:     recommendations.push({
 149:       category: 'Error Handling',
 150:       priority: 'high',
 151:       recommendation: 'Investigate error rate spike. Check Sentry for recent error patterns.',
 152:       metric: `errorRate: ${metrics.metrics.errorRate.toFixed(2)}%`,
 153:     });
 154:   }
 155: 
 156:   // Slow P99 recommendation
 157:   if (metrics.metrics.p99Duration > 3000) {
 158:     recommendations.push({
 159:       category: 'Performance',
 160:       priority: 'high',
 161:       recommendation: 'P99 latency high. Consider optimizing database queries or adding caching.',
 162:       metric: `p99Duration: ${metrics.metrics.p99Duration.toFixed(2)}ms`,
 163:     });
 164:   }
 165: 
 166:   // High duplicate rate
 167:   if (metrics.metrics.duplicateRate > 5) {
 168:     recommendations.push({
 169:       category: 'Data Quality',
 170:       priority: 'medium',
 171:       recommendation: 'High duplicate message rate. Review webhook deduplication logic.',
 172:       metric: `duplicateRate: ${metrics.metrics.duplicateRate.toFixed(2)}%`,
 173:     });
 174:   }
 175: 
 176:   // Rate limiting
 177:   if (metrics.metrics.rateLimitedCount > metrics.metrics.totalEvents * 0.1) {
 178:     recommendations.push({
 179:       category: 'Rate Limiting',
 180:       priority: 'medium',
 181:       recommendation: 'Rate limiting is active. Consider increasing limits if valid.',
 182:       metric: `rateLimited: ${metrics.metrics.rateLimitedCount} / ${metrics.metrics.totalEvents}`,
 183:     });
 184:   }
 185: 
 186:   // Cache hit rate
 187:   if (metrics.metrics.eventsPerSecond > 10 && metrics.metrics.p50Duration > 1000) {
 188:     recommendations.push({
 189:       category: 'Caching',
 190:       priority: 'low',
 191:       recommendation: 'Enable/optimize response caching for frequently accessed endpoints.',
 192:       metric: 'High throughput with slow response times',
 193:     });
 194:   }
 195: 
 196:   return recommendations;
 197: }

   1: /**
   2:  * API RGPD - Consentement et droits des clients
   3:  * Export données, suppression, gestion consentements
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { auditService } from '@/lib/multichannel/audit-service';
   9: import { ChannelType } from '@/lib/multichannel/types';
  10: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  11: import { headers } from 'next/headers';
  12: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  13: 
  14: /**
  15:  * GET /api/multichannel/rgpd
  16:  * Obtenir les informations RGPD d'un client
  17:  */
  18: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  19:   try {
  20:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  21:     if (!session?.user) {
  22:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisé' }, { status: 401 });
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     const url = new URL(request.url);
  26:     const clientId = url.searchParams.get('clientId');
  27: 
  28:     if (!clientId) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'clientId requis' }, { status: 400 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     // Exporter les données
  33:     const exportData = await auditService.exportClientData(clientId);
  34: 
  35:     return NextResponse.json({
  36:       success: true,
  37:       data: exportData,
  38:     });
  39:   } catch (error) {
  40:     logger.error('Erreur export RGPD', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  41:       route: '/api/multichannel/rgpd',
  42:     });
  43:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  44:   }
  45: }
  46: 
  47: /**
  48:  * POST /api/multichannel/rgpd
  49:  * Enregistrer un consentement
  50:  */
  51: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  52:   try {
  53:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  54:     const headersList = await headers();
  55:     const ipAddress = headersList.get('x-forwarded-for') || 'unknown';
  56: 
  57:     const body = await request.json();
  58:     const { clientId, channel, purpose, granted, expiresAt, proofDocument } = body;
  59: 
  60:     if (!clientId || !channel || !purpose || granted === undefined) {
  61:       return NextResponse.json(
  62:         { error: 'clientId, channel, purpose et granted requis' },
  63:         { status: 400 }
  64:       );
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     const consent = await auditService.recordConsent({
  68:       clientId,
  69:       channel: channel as ChannelType,
  70:       purpose,
  71:       granted,
  72:       expiresAt: expiresAt ? new Date(expiresAt) : undefined,
  73:       proofDocument,
  74:       ipAddress,
  75:     });
  76: 
  77:     return NextResponse.json({
  78:       success: true,
  79:       consent,
  80:     });
  81:   } catch (error) {
  82:     logger.error('Erreur enregistrement consentement', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  83:       route: '/api/multichannel/rgpd',
  84:     });
  85:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  86:   }
  87: }
  88: 
  89: /**
  90:  * DELETE /api/multichannel/rgpd
  91:  * Droit à l'oubli - supprimer les données d'un client
  92:  */
  93: export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
  94:   try {
  95:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  96:     if (!session?.user) {
  97:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisé' }, { status: 401 });
  98:     }
  99: 
 100:     const user = session.user as any;
 101: 
 102:     // Seuls les admins peuvent supprimer
 103:     if (!['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN'].includes(user.role)) {
 104:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Permission refusée' }, { status: 403 });
 105:     }
 106: 
 107:     const url = new URL(request.url);
 108:     const clientId = url.searchParams.get('clientId');
 109:     const reason = url.searchParams.get('reason');
 110:     const keepAuditLogs = url.searchParams.get('keepAuditLogs') === 'true';
 111: 
 112:     if (!clientId) {
 113:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'clientId requis' }, { status: 400 });
 114:     }
 115: 
 116:     const result = await auditService.deleteClientData(clientId, {
 117:       keepAuditLogs,
 118:       reason: reason || 'Demande RGPD',
 119:       requestedBy: user.id,
 120:     });
 121: 
 122:     return NextResponse.json({
 123:       success: true,
 124:       result,
 125:     });
 126:   } catch (error) {
 127:     logger.error('Erreur suppression RGPD', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 128:       route: '/api/multichannel/rgpd',
 129:     });
 130:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 131:   }
 132: }
