src\app\api\multichannel\stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Stats Multi-Canal
   3:  * Statistiques et analytics pour tous les canaux
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: 
  12: /**
  13:  * GET /api/multichannel/stats
  14:  * Récupérer les statistiques multi-canal
  15:  */
  16: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  17:   try {
  18:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisé' }, { status: 401 });
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     const user = session.user as any;
  24:     const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  25: 
  26:     if (!tenantId && user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouvé' }, { status: 403 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     const url = new URL(request.url);
  31:     const period = url.searchParams.get('period') || '7d';
  32: 
  33:     // Calculer les dates
  34:     const endDate = new Date();
  35:     const startDate = new Date();
  36:     switch (period) {
  37:       case '24h':
  38:         startDate.setHours(startDate.getHours() - 24);
  39:         break;
  40:       case '7d':
  41:         startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 7);
  42:         break;
  43:       case '30d':
  44:         startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 30);
  45:         break;
  46:       case '90d':
  47:         startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - 90);
  48:         break;
  49:     }
  50: 
  51:     // Stats par canal
  52:     const channelStats = await prisma.channelMessage.groupBy({
  53:       by: ['channel'],
  54:       where: {
  55:         tenantId,
  56:         receivedAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  57:       },
  58:       _count: { id: true },
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     // Stats par statut
  62:     const statusStats = await prisma.channelMessage.groupBy({
  63:       by: ['status'],
  64:       where: {
  65:         tenantId,
  66:         receivedAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  67:       },
  68:       _count: { id: true },
  69:     });
  70: 
  71:     // Stats par urgence
  72:     const urgencyStats = await prisma.channelMessage.groupBy({
  73:       by: ['aiUrgency'],
  74:       where: {
  75:         tenantId,
  76:         receivedAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  77:         aiUrgency: { not: null },
  78:       },
  79:       _count: { id: true },
  80:     });
  81: 
  82:     // Messages par jour
  83:     const dailyStats = await prisma.$queryRaw`
  84:       SELECT
  85:         DATE(received_at) as date,
  86:         channel,
  87:         COUNT(*) as count
  88:       FROM channel_messages
  89:       WHERE tenant_id = ${tenantId}
  90:         AND received_at >= ${startDate}
  91:         AND received_at <= ${endDate}
  92:       GROUP BY DATE(received_at), channel
  93:       ORDER BY date
  94:     `;
  95: 
  96:     // Temps de traitement moyen
  97:     const processingTimeStats = await prisma.channelMessage.aggregate({
  98:       where: {
  99:         tenantId,
 100:         receivedAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
 101:         processedAt: { not: null },
 102:       },
 103:       _avg: {
 104:         // Calculer via raw query si nécessaire
 105:       },
 106:     });
 107: 
 108:     // Top clients
 109:     const topClients = await prisma.channelMessage.groupBy({
 110:       by: ['clientId'],
 111:       where: {
 112:         tenantId,
 113:         receivedAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
 114:         clientId: { not: null },
 115:       },
 116:       _count: { id: true },
 117:       orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },
 118:       take: 10,
 119:     });
 120: 
 121:     // Messages non traités
 122:     const pendingMessages = await prisma.channelMessage.count({
 123:       where: {
 124:         tenantId,
 125:         status: { in: ['RECEIVED', 'PROCESSING'] },
 126:       },
 127:     });
 128: 
 129:     // Messages urgents
 130:     const urgentMessages = await prisma.channelMessage.count({
 131:       where: {
 132:         tenantId,
 133:         aiUrgency: { in: ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL'] },
 134:         status: { not: 'ARCHIVED' },
 135:       },
 136:     });
 137: 
 138:     return NextResponse.json({
 139:       success: true,
 140:       period,
 141:       startDate,
 142:       endDate,
 143:       stats: {
 144:         byChannel: channelStats.map(s => ({
 145:           channel: s.channel,
 146:           count: s._count.id,
 147:         })),
 148:         byStatus: statusStats.map(s => ({
 149:           status: s.status,
 150:           count: s._count.id,
 151:         })),
 152:         byUrgency: urgencyStats.map(s => ({
 153:           urgency: s.aiUrgency,
 154:           count: s._count.id,
 155:         })),
 156:         daily: dailyStats,
 157:         topClients: topClients.map(c => ({
 158:           clientId: c.clientId,
 159:           messageCount: c._count.id,
 160:         })),
 161:         pendingMessages,
 162:         urgentMessages,
 163:         totalMessages: channelStats.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s._count.id, 0),
 164:       },
 165:     });
 166:   } catch (error) {
 167:     logger.error('Erreur stats multi-canal', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 168:       route: '/api/multichannel/stats',
 169:     });
 170:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 171:   }
 172: }

src\app\api\notifications\client-update\route.ts

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: 
   4: /**
   5:  * POST /api/notifications/client-update
   6:  * Envoie une notification au client sur l'avancement de son dossier.
   7:  * Appele automatiquement quand une piece est recue ou un statut change.
   8:  */
   9: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  10:   const { dossierId, type, message } = await req.json();
  11: 
  12:   if (!dossierId || !type) {
  13:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'dossierId et type requis' }, { status: 400 });
  14:   }
  15: 
  16:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findUnique({
  17:     where: { id: dossierId },
  18:     include: { Client: true },
  19:   });
  20: 
  21:   if (!dossier || !dossier.Client?.email) {
  22:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier ou client non trouve' }, { status: 404 });
  23:   }
  24: 
  25:   const templates: Record<string, (d: any) => { subject: string; body: string }> = {
  26:     piece_recue: (d) => ({
  27:       subject: `Piece recue â€” Dossier ${d.numero}`,
  28:       body: `Bonjour,\n\nNous avons bien recu votre document pour le dossier ${d.numero}.\n\nProgression : ${d.checklistReceived}/${d.checklistTotal} pieces recues.\n${d.checklistComplete ? '\nVotre dossier est maintenant COMPLET. Votre avocat va le traiter dans les meilleurs delais.' : `\nIl reste ${d.checklistTotal - d.checklistReceived} piece(s) a fournir.`}\n\nCordialement,\nCabinet ${d.tenantId}`,
  29:     }),
  30:     dossier_complet: (d) => ({
  31:       subject: `Dossier COMPLET â€” ${d.numero}`,
  32:       body: `Bonjour,\n\nToutes les pieces de votre dossier ${d.numero} ont ete recues.\n\nVotre avocat va maintenant traiter votre dossier. Vous serez informe de la suite.\n\nCordialement`,
  33:     }),
  34:     statut_change: (d) => ({
  35:       subject: `Mise a jour â€” Dossier ${d.numero}`,
  36:       body: message || `Bonjour,\n\nLe statut de votre dossier ${d.numero} a ete mis a jour.\n\nNouveau statut : ${d.statut}\n\nCordialement`,
  37:     }),
  38:     deadline_proche: (d) => ({
  39:       subject: `URGENT â€” Echeance proche dossier ${d.numero}`,
  40:       body: `Bonjour,\n\nUne echeance importante approche pour votre dossier ${d.numero}.\n\n${message || 'Merci de nous contacter rapidement.'}\n\nCordialement`,
  41:     }),
  42:   };
  43: 
  44:   const template = templates[type];
  45:   if (!template) {
  46:     return NextResponse.json({ error: `Type inconnu: ${type}` }, { status: 400 });
  47:   }
  48: 
  49:   const { subject, body } = template(dossier);
  50: 
  51:   // Log (email reel quand SMTP configure)
  52:   console.log(`[NOTIF CLIENT] To: ${dossier.Client.email} | Subject: ${subject}`);
  53: 
  54:   return NextResponse.json({
  55:     success: true,
  56:     to: dossier.Client.email,
  57:     subject,
  58:     preview: body.substring(0, 100) + '...',
  59:   });
  60: }

src\app\api\notifications\route.ts

   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import {
   3:   getUnreadCount,
   4:   markAllNotificationsAsRead,
   5:   markNotificationAsRead,
   6: } from '@/lib/notifications';
   7: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   8: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: 
  12: async function getAuthenticatedUserId(): Promise<string | null> {
  13:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14:   return session?.user?.id ?? null;
  15: }
  16: 
  17: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  18:   try {
  19:     const userId = await getAuthenticatedUserId();
  20:     if (!userId) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  25:     const unreadOnly = searchParams.get('unreadOnly') === 'true';
  26:     const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50', 10) || 50, 1), 100);
  27:     const offset = Math.max(parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10) || 0, 0);
  28: 
  29:     const [notifications, unreadCount] = await Promise.all([
  30:       prisma.notification.findMany({
  31:         where: {
  32:           userId,
  33:           ...(unreadOnly ? { isRead: false } : {}),
  34:         },
  35:         orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  36:         take: limit,
  37:         skip: offset,
  38:       }),
  39:       getUnreadCount(userId),
  40:     ]);
  41: 
  42:     return NextResponse.json({
  43:       notifications,
  44:       unreadCount,
  45:       hasMore: notifications.length === limit,
  46:     });
  47:   } catch (error) {
  48:     logger.error('Erreur GET notifications', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  49:       route: '/api/notifications',
  50:     });
  51:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  52:   }
  53: }
  54: 
  55: // PATCH - Marquer notification(s) comme lue(s)
  56: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  57:   try {
  58:     const userId = await getAuthenticatedUserId();
  59:     if (!userId) {
  60:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     const body = await request.json();
  64:     const { notificationId, markAll } = body;
  65: 
  66:     if (markAll) {
  67:       await markAllNotificationsAsRead(userId);
  68:       return NextResponse.json({
  69:         success: true,
  70:         message: 'Toutes les notifications marquees comme lues',
  71:       });
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     if (notificationId) {
  75:       await markNotificationAsRead(notificationId, userId);
  76:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Notification marquee comme lue' });
  77:     }
  78: 
  79:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'notificationId ou markAll requis' }, { status: 400 });
  80:   } catch (error) {
  81:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH notifications:', { error });
  82:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  83:   }
  84: }
  85: 
  86: // DELETE - Supprimer une notification
  87: export async function DELETE(request: NextRequest) {
  88:   try {
  89:     const userId = await getAuthenticatedUserId();
  90:     if (!userId) {
  91:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifié' }, { status: 401 });
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  95:     const notificationId = searchParams.get('id');
  96: 
  97:     if (!notificationId) {
  98:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'id requis' }, { status: 400 });
  99:     }
 100: 
 101:     const existing = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
 102:       where: { id: notificationId, userId },
 103:       select: { id: true },
 104:     });
 105: 
 106:     if (!existing) {
 107:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Notification introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
 108:     }
 109: 
 110:     await prisma.notification.delete({
 111:       where: { id: notificationId },
 112:     });
 113: 
 114:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
 115:   } catch (error) {
 116:     logger.error('Erreur DELETE notification:', { error });
 117:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 118:   }
 119: }

src\app\api\notifications\stream\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
   2: import { registerSSEClient, unregisterSSEClient } from '@/lib/notifications';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: 
   6: // GET - Stream SSE pour les notifications en temps reel
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   9:   const userId = session?.user?.id;
  10: 
  11:   if (!userId) {
  12:     return new Response('Non authentifié', { status: 401 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
  16:     start(controller) {
  17:       // Enregistrer ce client
  18:       registerSSEClient(userId, controller);
  19: 
  20:       // Envoyer un heartbeat initial
  21:       const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  22:       controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`: heartbeat\n\n`));
  23: 
  24:       // Heartbeat toutes les 30 secondes pour garder la connexion active
  25:       const heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
  26:         try {
  27:           controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`: heartbeat\n\n`));
  28:         } catch {
  29:           clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
  30:         }
  31:       }, 30000);
  32: 
  33:       // Cleanup lors de la fermeture
  34:       request.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
  35:         clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
  36:         unregisterSSEClient(userId, controller);
  37:         try {
  38:           controller.close();
  39:         } catch {
  40:           // Deja ferme
  41:         }
  42:       });
  43:     },
  44:     cancel() {
  45:       // Stream annule par le client
  46:     },
  47:   });
  48: 
  49:   return new Response(stream, {
  50:     headers: {
  51:       'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
  52:       'Cache-Control': 'no-cache, no-transform',
  53:       'Connection': 'keep-alive',
  54:       'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no',
  55:     },
  56:   });
  57: }

   8: /**
   9:  * POST /api/oauth/callback
  10:  * Ã‰change le code d'autorisation pour un token d'accÃ¨s
  11:  * Body: { provider, code }
  12:  */
  13: export async function POST(req: Request) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession();
  16:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json(
  18:         { error: 'unauthorized', detail: 'No session found' },
  19:         { status: 401 }
  20:       );
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     const body = await req.json();
  24:     const { provider, code } = body;
  25: 
  26:     if (!provider || !code) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'provider et code requis' }, { status: 400 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     const result = await oauthService.exchangeCode(provider as OAuthProvider, code);
  31: 
  32:     // Store token in database
  33:     await oauthTokenService.storeToken(session.user.id, {
  34:       provider: provider as OAuthProvider,
  35:       accessToken: result.accessToken,
  36:       refreshToken: result.refreshToken,
  37:       expiresIn: result.expiresIn,
  38:     });
  39: 
  40:     return NextResponse.json(
  41:       {
  42:         success: true,
  43:         provider,
  44:         expiresIn: result.expiresIn,
  45:       },
  46:       { status: 200 }
  47:     );
  48:   } catch (e: any) {
  49:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'callback_failed', detail: e?.message }, { status: 400 });
  50:   }
  51: }

src\app\api\ocr\extract\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * POST /api/ocr/extract
   7:  * Recoit une image (photo de courrier) et extrait les informations structurees.
   8:  * Utilise Ollama (local) ou fallback regex pour l'extraction.
   9:  */
  10: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  11:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13: 
  14:   const formData = await req.formData();
  15:   const file = formData.get('file') as File;
  16: 
  17:   if (!file) {
  18:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier requis (image ou PDF)' }, { status: 400 });
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
  22:   const text = await extractTextFromImage(buffer, file.type);
  23: 
  24:   if (!text) {
  25:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible d\'extraire le texte du document' }, { status: 422 });
  26:   }
  27: 
  28:   // Analyse du texte extrait
  29:   const extracted = analyzeDocument(text);
  30: 
  31:   return NextResponse.json({
  32:     success: true,
  33:     rawText: text.substring(0, 2000),
  34:     extracted,
  35:     confidence: extracted.type ? 'high' : 'low',
  36:   });
  37: }
  38: 
  39: /**
  40:  * Extraction de texte depuis une image via Ollama vision ou Tesseract
  41:  */
  42: async function extractTextFromImage(buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string): Promise<string | null> {
  43:   const ollamaUrl = process.env.OLLAMA_URL;
  44: 
  45:   if (ollamaUrl) {
  46:     try {
  47:       const base64 = buffer.toString('base64');
  48:       const response = await fetch(`${ollamaUrl}/api/generate`, {
  49:         method: 'POST',
  50:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  51:         body: JSON.stringify({
  52:           model: process.env.OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL || 'llava',
  53:           prompt: 'Extract all text from this document image. Return only the raw text, no commentary.',
  54:           images: [base64],
  55:           stream: false,
  56:         }),
  57:       });
  58: 
  59:       if (response.ok) {
  60:         const data = await response.json();
  61:         return data.response || null;
  62:       }
  63:     } catch (e) {
  64:       console.warn('Ollama vision unavailable, using fallback');
  65:     }
  66:   }
  67: 
  68:   // Fallback: retourner un message indiquant que l'OCR necessite Ollama
  69:   return `[OCR DEMO] Document recu (${(buffer.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB, type: ${mimeType}). Configurez OLLAMA_URL avec un modele vision (llava) pour l'extraction reelle.`;
  70: }
  71: 
  72: /**
  73:  * Analyse le texte extrait pour identifier le type de document et les donnees cles
  74:  */
  75: function analyzeDocument(text: string): Record<string, any> {
  76:   const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  77:   const result: Record<string, any> = {
  78:     type: null,
  79:     client: null,
  80:     reference: null,
  81:     date: null,
  82:     deadline: null,
  83:     urgence: 'normale',
  84:     fields: {},
  85:   };
  86: 
  87:   // Detection type de document
  88:   if (lower.includes('obligation de quitter') || lower.includes('oqtf')) {
  89:     result.type = 'OQTF';
  90:     result.urgence = lower.includes('sans delai') ? 'critique' : 'haute';
  91:     result.deadline = lower.includes('sans delai') ? '48h' : '30 jours';
  92:   } else if (lower.includes('refus de sejour') || lower.includes('titre de sejour')) {
  93:     result.type = 'TitreSejour';
  94:     result.deadline = '2 mois';
  95:   } else if (lower.includes('naturalisation')) {
  96:     result.type = 'Naturalisation';
  97:     result.deadline = '2 mois';
  98:   } else if (lower.includes('asile') || lower.includes('ofpra')) {
  99:     result.type = 'Asile';
 100:     result.deadline = '21 jours';
 101:   } else if (lower.includes('regroupement familial')) {
 102:     result.type = 'RegroupementFamilial';
 103:     result.deadline = '2 mois';
 104:   }
 105: 
 106:   // Extraction reference dossier
 107:   const refMatch = text.match(/(?:dossier|ref|nÂ°|numero)\s*[:\s]*([A-Z0-9\-\/]+)/i);
 108:   if (refMatch) result.reference = refMatch[1];
 109: 
 110:   // Extraction date
 111:   const dateMatch = text.match(/(\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{1,2})[\/\-](\d{2,4})/);
 112:   if (dateMatch) result.date = `${dateMatch[1]}/${dateMatch[2]}/${dateMatch[3]}`;
 113: 
 114:   // Extraction nom
 115:   const nomMatch = text.match(/(?:monsieur|madame|m\.|mme)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)?)/i);
 116:   if (nomMatch) result.client = nomMatch[1];
 117: 
 118:   return result;
 119: }

src\app\api\onboarding\status\route.ts

   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET() {
   7:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   8:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
   9: 
  10:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  11:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ needsOnboarding: true, steps: getEmptySteps() });
  12: 
  13:   const [dossierCount, emailCount, clientCount] = await Promise.all([
  14:     prisma.dossier.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
  15:     prisma.email.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
  16:     prisma.client.count({ where: { tenantId } }),
  17:   ]);
  18: 
  19:   const steps = {
  20:     accountCreated: true,
  21:     firstClient: clientCount > 0,
  22:     firstEmail: emailCount > 0,
  23:     firstDossier: dossierCount > 0,
  24:   };
  25: 
  26:   const completed = Object.values(steps).every(Boolean);
  27: 
  28:   return NextResponse.json({ needsOnboarding: !completed, steps, stats: { dossierCount, emailCount, clientCount } });
  29: }
  30: 
  31: function getEmptySteps() {
  32:   return { accountCreated: true, firstClient: false, firstEmail: false, firstDossier: false };
  33: }

  12: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {

  15:     if (!stripe) {
  16:       return NextResponse.json(
  17:         { error: 'Paiements dÃ©sactivÃ©s (configuration Stripe manquante).' },
  18:         { status: 503 }
  19:       );
  20:     }
  21:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  22: 
  23:     if (!session?.user?.id) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     const { factureId } = await request.json();
  28: 
  29:     if (!factureId) {
  30:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ID de facture requis' }, { status: 400 });
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer la facture depuis la base de donnÃ©es
  34:     const facture = await prisma.facture.findUnique({
  35:       where: { id: factureId },
  36:       include: {
  37:         client: true,
  38:         tenant: true,
  39:       },
  40:     });
  41: 
  42:     if (!facture) {
  43:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Facture non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     // VÃ©rifier que le client a accÃ¨s Ã  cette facture
  47:     if (facture.client?.userId !== session.user.id && session.user.role === 'CLIENT') {
  48:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s non autorisÃ© Ã  cette facture' }, { status: 403 });
  49:     }
  50: 
  51:     // VÃ©rifier que la facture n'est pas dÃ©jÃ  payÃ©e
  52:     if (facture.statut === 'payee') {
  53:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cette facture est dÃ©jÃ  payÃ©e' }, { status: 400 });
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     // CrÃ©er la session Stripe Checkout
  57:     const checkoutSession = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
  58:       payment_method_types: ['card', 'sepa_debit'],
  59:       mode: 'payment',
  60:       customer_email: facture.client?.email || session.user.email || undefined,
  61:       client_reference_id: factureId,
  62:       metadata: {
  63:         factureId,
  64:         tenantId: facture.tenantId,
  65:         factureNumero: facture.numero,
  66:       },
  67:       line_items: [
  68:         {
  69:           price_data: {
  70:             currency: 'eur',
  71:             product_data: {
  72:               name: `Facture ${facture.numero}`,
  73:               description: facture.description || `Paiement de la facture ${facture.numero}`,
  74:             },
  75:             unit_amount: Math.round(facture.montantTTC * 100), // Stripe attend des centimes
  76:           },
  77:           quantity: 1,
  78:         },
  79:       ],
  80:       success_url: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/client/paiement/succes?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
  81:       cancel_url: `${process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL}/client/paiement/annule?facture_id=${factureId}`,
  82:     });
  83: 
  84:     // Logger l'Ã©vÃ©nement de paiement initiÃ©
  85:     await prisma.auditLog.create({
  86:       data: {
  87:         action: 'PAYMENT_INITIATED',
  88:         userId: session.user.id,
  89:         tenantId: facture.tenantId,
  90:         entityType: 'Facture',
  91:         entityId: factureId,
  92:         details: {
  93:           stripeSessionId: checkoutSession.id,
  94:           montant: facture.montantTTC,
  95:         },
  96:       },
  97:     });
  98: 
  99:     return NextResponse.json({
 100:       sessionId: checkoutSession.id,
 101:       url: checkoutSession.url,
 102:     });
 103:   } catch (error) {
 104:     console.error('Erreur crÃ©ation session Stripe:', error);
 105: 
 106:     // Si Stripe n'est pas configurÃ©, retourner une erreur explicite
 107:     if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('API key')) {
 108:       return NextResponse.json(
 109:         { error: "Configuration Stripe manquante. Contactez l'administrateur." },
 110:         { status: 503 }
 111:       );
 112:     }
 113: 
 114:     return NextResponse.json(
 115:       { error: 'Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation de la session de paiement' },
 116:       { status: 500 }
 117:     );
 118:   }
 119: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';

   7:     try {
   8:         const session = await getServerSession();

  10:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  11:         }

  34:                 expYear: pm.card?.exp_year || 0
  35:             }))

  41:             { status: 500 }
  42:         );
  43:     }
  44: }

  46: export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  47:     try {
  48:         const session = await getServerSession();
  49:         if (!session?.user?.email) {
  50:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  51:         }
  52: 
  53:         const { paymentMethodId } = await req.json();
  54: 
  55:         if (!paymentMethodId) {
  56:             return NextResponse.json(
  57:                 { error: 'Missing paymentMethodId' },
  58:                 { status: 400 }
  59:             );
  60:         }
  61: 
  62:         // Detach payment method from customer
  63:         await stripe.paymentMethods.detach(paymentMethodId);
  64: 
  65:         return NextResponse.json({ message: 'Payment method removed successfully' });
  66:     } catch (error: any) {
  67:         console.error('Error removing payment method:', error);
  68:         return NextResponse.json(
  69:             { error: error.message || 'Internal server error' },

  71:         );

src\app\api\payments\webhook\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // app/api/payments/webhook/route.ts
   2: // POST /api/payments/webhook
   3: // Handle Stripe webhook events
   4: 
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: import { stripe, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET } from '@/lib/stripe/config';
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: import {
   9:     isStripeEventDuplicate,
  10:     logStripeWebhookProcessingFailure,
  11:     parseStripeWebhookRequest,
  12: } from '@/lib/stripe/webhook';
  13: import Stripe from 'stripe';
  14: 
  15: type DbClient = any;
  16: 
  17: function isStripeEventUniqueViolation(error: any): boolean {
  18:     const message = String(error?.message || '');
  19:     return (
  20:         error?.code === 'P2002' &&
  21:         (message.includes('stripeEventId') || message.includes('stripeWebhookEvent'))
  22:     );
  23: }
  24: 
  25: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  26:     const parsed = await parseStripeWebhookRequest(request, stripe, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET);
  27:     if (!parsed.ok) {
  28:         return parsed.response;
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     const { event } = parsed;
  32: 
  33:     const isDuplicate = await isStripeEventDuplicate(event.id);
  34:     if (isDuplicate) {
  35:         return NextResponse.json({ received: true, duplicate: true });
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     try {
  39:         await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
  40:             const db = tx as DbClient;
  41: 
  42:             await db.stripeWebhookEvent.create({
  43:                 data: {
  44:                     stripeEventId: event.id,
  45:                     provider: 'stripe',
  46:                     eventType: event.type,
  47:                     status: 'PROCESSING',
  48:                     payload: JSON.stringify(event),
  49:                 },
  50:             });
  51: 
  52:             switch (event.type) {
  53:                 case 'payment_intent.succeeded':
  54:                     await handlePaymentIntentSucceeded(db, event.data.object as Stripe.PaymentIntent);
  55:                     break;
  56: 
  57:                 case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
  58:                     await handlePaymentIntentFailed(db, event.data.object as Stripe.PaymentIntent);
  59:                     break;
  60: 
  61:                 case 'customer.subscription.created':
  62:                     await handleSubscriptionCreated(db, event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  63:                     break;
  64: 
  65:                 case 'customer.subscription.updated':
  66:                     await handleSubscriptionUpdated(db, event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  67:                     break;
  68: 
  69:                 case 'customer.subscription.deleted':
  70:                     await handleSubscriptionDeleted(db, event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  71:                     break;
  72: 
  73:                 case 'invoice.paid':
  74:                     await handleInvoicePaid(db, event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
  75:                     break;
  76: 
  77:                 case 'invoice.payment_failed':
  78:                     await handleInvoicePaymentFailed(db, event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
  79:                     break;
  80: 
  81:                 default:
  82:                     break;
  83:             }
  84: 
  85:             await db.stripeWebhookEvent.update({
  86:                 where: { stripeEventId: event.id },
  87:                 data: {
  88:                     status: 'PROCESSED',
  89:                     processedAt: new Date(),
  90:                 },
  91:             });
  92:         });
  93: 
  94:         return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
  95:     } catch (error: any) {
  96:         if (isStripeEventUniqueViolation(error)) {
  97:             return NextResponse.json({ received: true, duplicate: true });
  98:         }
  99: 
 100:         logStripeWebhookProcessingFailure(event.type);
 101:         return NextResponse.json(
 102:             { error: 'Webhook handler failed' },
 103:             { status: 500 }
 104:         );
 105:     }
 106: }
 107: 
 108: async function handlePaymentIntentSucceeded(db: DbClient, paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
 109:     await db.paymentIntent.update({
 110:         where: { stripeIntentId: paymentIntent.id },
 111:         data: {
 112:             status: 'succeeded',
 113:             receiptUrl: (paymentIntent as any).charges?.data?.[0]?.receipt_url,
 114:         },
 115:     });
 116: }
 117: 
 118: async function handlePaymentIntentFailed(db: DbClient, paymentIntent: Stripe.PaymentIntent) {
 119:     await db.paymentIntent.update({
 120:         where: { stripeIntentId: paymentIntent.id },
 121:         data: {
 122:             status: 'failed',
 123:             lastError: (paymentIntent as any).last_payment_error?.message,
 124:         },
 125:     });
 126: }
 127: 
 128: async function handleSubscriptionCreated(db: DbClient, subscription: Stripe.Subscription) {
 129:     const customerId = subscription.customer as string;
 130:     const customer = await db.stripeCustomer.findUnique({
 131:         where: { stripeCustomerId: customerId },
 132:     });
 133: 
 134:     if (!customer) return;
 135: 
 136:     await db.subscription.create({
 137:         data: {
 138:             userId: customer.userId,
 139:             stripeCustomerId: customerId,
 140:             stripeSubscriptionId: subscription.id,
 141:             productId: subscription.items.data[0].price.product as string,
 142:             status: subscription.status,
 143:             currentPeriodStart: new Date((subscription as any).current_period_start * 1000),
 144:             currentPeriodEnd: new Date((subscription as any).current_period_end * 1000),
 145:         },
 146:     });
 147: }
 148: 
 149: async function handleSubscriptionUpdated(db: DbClient, subscription: Stripe.Subscription) {
 150:     await db.subscription.update({
 151:         where: { stripeSubscriptionId: subscription.id },
 152:         data: {
 153:             status: subscription.status,
 154:             currentPeriodStart: new Date((subscription as any).current_period_start * 1000),
 155:             currentPeriodEnd: new Date((subscription as any).current_period_end * 1000),
 156:             cancelAtPeriodEnd: subscription.cancel_at_period_end,
 157:             canceledAt: subscription.canceled_at
 158:                 ? new Date(subscription.canceled_at * 1000)
 159:                 : null,

 161:     });

 164: async function handleSubscriptionDeleted(db: DbClient, subscription: Stripe.Subscription) {
 165:     await db.subscription.update({
 166:         where: { stripeSubscriptionId: subscription.id },
 167:         data: {
 168:             status: 'canceled',

 174: async function handleInvoicePaid(db: DbClient, invoice: Stripe.Invoice) {
 175:     const customerId = invoice.customer as string;
 176:     const customer = await db.stripeCustomer.findUnique({

 195:             hostedInvoiceUrl: invoice.hosted_invoice_url,
 196:         },
 197:         update: {
 198:             status: 'paid',
 199:             paidDate: new Date((invoice as any).status_transitions.paid_at * 1000),
 200:         },
 201:     });
 202: 
 203:     // === AUTO-Ã‰CRITURE COMPTABLE ===
 204:     // Chercher la facture MemoLib liÃ©e Ã  cette invoice Stripe
 205:     try {
 206:         const factureMemoLib = await db.facture.findFirst({

 211:         });

 214:             const { AutoEcrituresService } = await import('@/lib/services/comptabilite');
 215:             const clientNom = `${factureMemoLib.Client?.firstName || ''} ${factureMemoLib.Client?.lastName || ''}`.trim();
 216: 
 217:             await AutoEcrituresService.genererEcriturePaiement({
 218:                 tenantId: factureMemoLib.tenantId,
 219:                 factureId: factureMemoLib.id,
 220:                 factureNumero: factureMemoLib.numero,
 221:                 montant: factureMemoLib.montantTTC,
 222:                 date: new Date(),
 223:                 mode: 'stripe',
 224:                 reference: invoice.id,
 225:                 clientNom,
 226:             });
 227:         }
 228:     } catch {
 229:         // Ne pas bloquer le webhook si la compta Ã©choue
 230:     }
 231: }
 232: 
 233: async function handleInvoicePaymentFailed(db: DbClient, invoice: Stripe.Invoice) {
 234:     await db.invoice.update({
 235:         where: { stripeInvoiceId: invoice.id },
 236:         data: { status: 'uncollectible' },
 237:     });

src\app\api\pending-actions\[id]\approve\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { z } from 'zod';
   3: import { approvePendingAction } from '@/lib/pending-actions/service';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: 
   7: interface RouteContext {
   8:   params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
   9: }
  10: 
  11: const bodySchema = z.object({
  12:   tenantId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  13:   createCase: z.boolean().optional(),
  14:   caseTitle: z.string().optional(),
  15:   createClient: z.boolean().optional(),
  16:   clientName: z.string().optional(),
  17:   linkToClientId: z.string().optional(),
  18:   assignToUserId: z.string().optional(),
  19:   priority: z.number().int().min(1).max(5).optional(),
  20:   tags: z.union([z.array(z.string()), z.string()]).optional(),
  21:   notes: z.string().optional(),
  22: });
  23: 
  24: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, context: RouteContext) {
  25:   try {
  26:     const { id } = await context.params;
  27:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  28:     if (!session?.user) {
  29:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  33:     if (!sessionTenantId) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     const json = await request.json();
  38:     const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(json);
  39: 
  40:     if (!parsed.success) {
  41:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     const body = parsed.data;
  45:     if (body.tenantId && body.tenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  46:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     const tags = Array.isArray(body.tags)
  50:       ? body.tags
  51:       : body.tags
  52:         ? body.tags.split(',').map(tag => tag.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  53:         : [];

src\app\api\pending-actions\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { z } from 'zod';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: 
   7: const querySchema = z.object({
   8:   tenantId: z.string().min(1),
   9:   limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(200).default(50),
  10:   offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).default(0),
  11: });
  12: 
  13: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19:     const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  20:     if (!sessionTenantId) {
  21:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  22:     }
  23: 
  24:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  25: 
  26:     const parsed = querySchema.safeParse({
  27:       tenantId: sessionTenantId,
  28:       limit: searchParams.get('limit') ?? 50,
  29:       offset: searchParams.get('offset') ?? 0,
  30:     });
  31: 
  32:     if (!parsed.success) {
  33:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Parametres invalides' }, { status: 400 });
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     const { tenantId, limit, offset } = parsed.data;
  37: 
  38:     const [emails, total] = await Promise.all([
  39:       prisma.email.findMany({
  40:         where: {
  41:           tenantId,
  42:           isProcessed: false,
  43:         },
  44:         orderBy: {
  45:           receivedAt: 'desc',
  46:         },
  47:         skip: offset,
  48:         take: limit,
  49:         select: {
  50:           id: true,
  51:           from: true,
  52:           subject: true,
  53:           preview: true,
  54:           category: true,
  55:           urgency: true,
  56:           receivedAt: true,
  57:           clientId: true,
  58:           dossierId: true,
  59:         },
  60:       }),
  61:       prisma.email.count({
  62:         where: {
  63:           tenantId,
  64:           isProcessed: false,
  65:         },
  66:       }),
  67:     ]);
  68: 
  69:     const actions = emails.map(email => ({
  70:       id: email.id,
  71:       eventType: 'EMAIL',
  72:       status: 'PENDING',
  73:       from: email.from,
  74:       subject: email.subject,
  75:       preview: email.preview,
  76:       createdAt: email.receivedAt,
  77:       suggestCreateCase: !email.dossierId,
  78:       suggestedCaseTitle: email.subject,
  79:       suggestCreateClient: !email.clientId,
  80:       suggestLinkToExistingClient: email.clientId,
  81:       urgency: email.urgency,
  82:       category: email.category,
  83:     }));
  84: 
  85:     return NextResponse.json({
  86:       count: total,
  87:       hasMore: offset + actions.length < total,
  88:       actions,
  89:     });
  90:   } catch {
  91:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  92:   }
  93: }

src\app\api\preferences\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   8:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
   9: 
  10:   const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  11:   const prefs = await prisma.userPreference.findMany({ where: { userId } });
  12: 
  13:   const result: Record<string, any> = {};
  14:   for (const p of prefs) {
  15:     try { result[p.key] = JSON.parse(p.value); } catch { result[p.key] = p.value; }
  16:   }
  17:   return NextResponse.json(result);
  18: }
  19: 
  20: export async function PUT(request: NextRequest) {
  21:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  22:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  23: 
  24:   const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  25:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId || '';
  26:   const body = await request.json();
  27:   const { key, value } = body;
  28: 
  29:   if (!key) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'key is required' }, { status: 400 });
  30: 
  31:   const pref = await prisma.userPreference.upsert({
  32:     where: { userId_key: { userId, key } },
  33:     update: { value: JSON.stringify(value) },
  34:     create: { userId, tenantId, key, value: JSON.stringify(value) },
  35:   });
  36: 
  37:   return NextResponse.json({ key: pref.key, value: JSON.parse(pref.value) });
  38: }

src\app\api\proofs\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import crypto from 'crypto';
   6: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   7: 
   8: // GET - Liste des preuves
   9: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  10:   try {
  11:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  12:     if (!session?.user) {
  13:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  14:     }
  15:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  16:     if (!tenantId) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  21:     const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  22:     const type = searchParams.get('type');
  23:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  24:     const limit = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50', 10));
  25:     const offset = Math.max(0, parseInt(searchParams.get('offset') || '0', 10));
  26: 
  27:     const where: Record<string, unknown> = { tenantId };
  28:     if (dossierId) where.dossierId = dossierId;
  29:     if (type) where.type = type;
  30:     if (status) where.status = status;
  31: 
  32:     const [proofs, total] = await Promise.all([
  33:       prisma.proof.findMany({
  34:         where,
  35:         include: {
  36:           dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
  37:           document: { select: { filename: true } },
  38:         },
  39:         orderBy: { proofDate: 'desc' },
  40:         take: limit,
  41:         skip: offset,
  42:       }),
  43:       prisma.proof.count({ where }),
  44:     ]);
  45: 
  46:     return NextResponse.json({ proofs, total, hasMore: offset + proofs.length < total });
  47:   } catch (error) {
  48:     logger.error('Erreur GET proofs', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  49:       route: '/api/proofs',
  50:     });
  51:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  52:   }
  53: }
  54: 
  55: // POST - Créer une preuve
  56: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  57:   try {
  58:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  59:     if (!session?.user) {
  60:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  61:     }
  62:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  63:     if (!tenantId) {
  64:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     const body = await request.json();
  68:     const {
  69:       type,
  70:       title,
  71:       description,
  72:       dossierId,
  73:       clientId,
  74:       documentId,
  75:       informationUnitId,
  76:       fileStorageKey,
  77:       fileBuffer,
  78:       fileMimeType,
  79:       fileSize,
  80:       proofDate,
  81:       capturedBy,
  82:       metadata,
  83:     } = body;
  84: 
  85:     if (!type || !title || !proofDate || !capturedBy) {
  86:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs requis manquants' }, { status: 400 });
  87:     }
  88: 
  89:     const proofDateParsed = new Date(proofDate);
  90:     if (isNaN(proofDateParsed.getTime())) {
  91:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Format proofDate invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     // Calcul du hash si fichier fourni
  95:     let fileHash: string | null = null;
  96:     if (fileBuffer) {
  97:       fileHash = crypto
  98:         .createHash('sha256')
  99:         .update(Buffer.from(fileBuffer, 'base64'))
 100:         .digest('hex');
 101:     }
 102: 
 103:     // Récupérer la dernière preuve pour la chaîne
 104:     const lastProof = await prisma.proof.findFirst({
 105:       where: { tenantId },
 106:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 107:       select: { id: true },
 108:     });
 109: 
 110:     // Calcul du timestamp hash
 111:     const timestampData = `${type}|${title}|${proofDate}|${capturedBy}|${lastProof?.id || ''}`;
 112:     const timestampHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(timestampData).digest('hex');
 113: 
 114:     const proof = await prisma.proof.create({
 115:       data: {
 116:         tenantId,
 117:         type,
 118:         title,
 119:         description,
 120:         dossierId,
 121:         clientId,
 122:         documentId,
 123:         informationUnitId,
 124:         fileStorageKey,
 125:         fileHash,
 126:         fileMimeType,
 127:         fileSize,
 128:         proofDate: proofDateParsed,
 129:         capturedBy,
 130:         timestampHash,
 131:         chainPreviousId: lastProof?.id || null,
 132:         metadata: metadata ? JSON.stringify(metadata) : null,
 133:       },
 134:     });
 135: 
 136:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, proof });
 137:   } catch (error) {
 138:     logger.error('Erreur POST proof', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 139:       route: '/api/proofs',
 140:     });
 141:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 142:   }
 143: }
 144: 
 145: // PATCH - Valider/Rejeter une preuve
 146: export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
 147:   try {
 148:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 149:     if (!session?.user) {
 150:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 151:     }
 152:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
 153:     if (!tenantId) {
 154:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
 155:     }
 156: 
 157:     const body = await request.json();
 158:     const { proofId, status, validatedBy, rejectionReason } = body;
 159: 
 160:     if (!proofId || !status || !validatedBy) {
 161:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'proofId, status et validatedBy requis' }, { status: 400 });
 162:     }
 163: 
 164:     const existing = await prisma.proof.findFirst({ where: { id: proofId, tenantId } });
 165:     if (!existing) {
 166:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Preuve non trouvée' }, { status: 404 });
 167:     }
 168: 
 169:     const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = { status };
 170:     if (status === 'VALIDATED') {
 171:       updateData.validatedBy = validatedBy;
 172:       updateData.validatedAt = new Date();
 173:     } else if (status === 'REJECTED') {
 174:       updateData.validatedBy = validatedBy;
 175:       updateData.validatedAt = new Date();
 176:       updateData.rejectionReason = rejectionReason;
 177:     }
 178: 
 179:     const proof = await prisma.proof.update({
 180:       where: { id: proofId },
 181:       data: updateData,
 182:     });
 183: 
 184:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, proof });
 185:   } catch (error) {
 186:     logger.error('Erreur PATCH proof', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 187:       route: '/api/proofs',
 188:     });
 189:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 190:   }
 191: }

src\app\api\questionnaire\response\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { z } from 'zod';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getTemplateForEvent, QUESTIONNAIRE_TEMPLATES } from '@/lib/questionnaire/templates';
   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: 
   8: const bodySchema = z.object({
   9:   tenantId: z.string().min(1).optional(),
  10:   questionnaireId: z.string().min(1),
  11:   caseId: z.string().optional(),
  12:   eventId: z.string().optional(),
  13:   answers: z.record(z.string(), z.union([z.string(), z.boolean(), z.number()])),
  14: });
  15: 
  16: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  17:   try {
  18:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  21:     }
  22:     const sessionTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  23:     if (!sessionTenantId) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     const json = await request.json();
  28:     const parsed = bodySchema.safeParse(json);
  29: 
  30:     if (!parsed.success) {
  31:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  32:     }
  33: 
  34:     const payload = parsed.data;
  35:     if (payload.tenantId && payload.tenantId !== sessionTenantId) {
  36:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  37:     }
  38: 
  39:     const template = QUESTIONNAIRE_TEMPLATES.find(item => item.id === payload.questionnaireId) ||
  40:       getTemplateForEvent('email-client');
  41: 
  42:     const requiredQuestionIds = template.questions
  43:       .filter(question => question.required)
  44:       .map(question => question.id);
  45: 
  46:     const missingRequired = requiredQuestionIds.filter(questionId =>
  47:       payload.answers[questionId] === undefined || payload.answers[questionId] === ''
  48:     );
  49: 
  50:     if (missingRequired.length > 0) {
  51:       return NextResponse.json(
  52:         { error: 'Questions obligatoires non renseignÃ©es', missingRequired },
  53:         { status: 400 }
  54:       );
  55:     }
  56: 
  57:     const execution = await prisma.workflowExecution.create({
  58:       data: {
  59:         tenantId: sessionTenantId,
  60:         workflowId: `questionnaire-${template.id}`,
  61:         workflowName: `Questionnaire ${template.title}`,
  62:         emailId: payload.eventId,
  63:         triggerType: 'questionnaire-response',
  64:         status: 'completed',
  65:         progress: 100,
  66:         startedAt: new Date(),
  67:         completedAt: new Date(),
  68:         triggerData: JSON.stringify({
  69:           caseId: payload.caseId,
  70:           eventId: payload.eventId,
  71:           questionnaireId: payload.questionnaireId,
  72:           answers: payload.answers,
  73:         }),
  74:         result: JSON.stringify({
  75:           valid: true,
  76:           requiredCount: requiredQuestionIds.length,
  77:           answeredCount: Object.keys(payload.answers).length,
  78:         }),
  79:       },
  80:       select: {
  81:         id: true,
  82:         workflowId: true,
  83:         completedAt: true,
  84:       },
  85:     });
  86: 
  87:     return NextResponse.json({
  88:       success: true,
  89:       message: 'RÃ©ponses enregistrÃ©es',
  90:       responseId: execution.id,
  91:       workflow: execution,
  92:     });
  93:   } catch {
  94:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  95:   }
  96: }

src\app\api\realtime\events\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Route pour les Ã©vÃ©nements en temps rÃ©el (SSE)
   3:  * Permet aux clients de recevoir des mises Ã  jour en temps rÃ©el
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
   9: 
  10: // Store des connexions SSE actives par utilisateur
  11: const clients = new Map<string, Set<ReadableStreamDefaultController>>();
  12: const userTenantMap = new Map<string, string>();
  13: 
  14: // Types d'Ã©vÃ©nements supportÃ©s
  15: export type EventType =
  16:   | 'dossier:created'
  17:   | 'dossier:updated'
  18:   | 'dossier:deleted'
  19:   | 'notification:new'
  20:   | 'message:new'
  21:   | 'document:uploaded'
  22:   | 'deadline:reminder'
  23:   | 'system:alert'
  24:   | 'stats:update';
  25: 
  26: interface SSEEvent {
  27:   type: EventType;
  28:   data: Record<string, unknown>;
  29:   timestamp: number;
  30: }
  31: 
  32: /**
  33:  * Publier un Ã©vÃ©nement Ã  tous les clients connectÃ©s
  34:  */
  35: export function publishEvent(
  36:   event: EventType,
  37:   data: Record<string, unknown>,
  38:   targetUserIds?: string[]
  39: ): void {
  40:   const sseEvent: SSEEvent = {
  41:     type: event,
  42:     data,
  43:     timestamp: Date.now(),
  44:   };
  45: 
  46:   const eventString = `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(sseEvent)}\n\n`;
  47: 
  48:   if (targetUserIds && targetUserIds.length > 0) {
  49:     // Envoyer seulement aux utilisateurs ciblÃ©s
  50:     for (const userId of targetUserIds) {
  51:       const userClients = clients.get(userId);
  52:       if (userClients) {
  53:         for (const controller of userClients) {
  54:           try {
  55:             controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(eventString));
  56:           } catch (e) {
  57:             // Le client s'est probablement dÃ©connectÃ©
  58:             userClients.delete(controller);
  59:           }
  60:         }
  61:       }
  62:     }
  63:   } else {
  64:     // Broadcast Ã  tous
  65:     for (const [, userClients] of clients) {
  66:       for (const controller of userClients) {
  67:         try {
  68:           controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(eventString));
  69:         } catch (e) {
  70:           userClients.delete(controller);
  71:         }
  72:       }
  73:     }
  74:   }
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /**
  78:  * Publier un Ã©vÃ©nement Ã  un tenant spÃ©cifique
  79:  */
  80: export function publishToTenant(
  81:   tenantId: string,
  82:   event: EventType,
  83:   data: Record<string, unknown>
  84: ): void {
  85:   const targetUserIds = Array.from(userTenantMap.entries())
  86:     .filter(([, mappedTenantId]) => mappedTenantId === tenantId)
  87:     .map(([userId]) => userId);
  88: 
  89:   publishEvent(event, { ...data, tenantId }, targetUserIds);
  90: }
  91: 
  92: /**
  93:  * Handler GET pour les connexions SSE
  94:  */
  95: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  96:   // VÃ©rifier l'authentification
  97:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  98: 
  99:   if (!session?.user?.id) {
 100:     return new Response('Non autorisÃ©', { status: 401 });
 101:   }
 102: 
 103:   const userId = session.user.id;
 104:   const tenantId = String((session.user as any).tenantId || '');
 105: 
 106:   if (tenantId) {
 107:     userTenantMap.set(userId, tenantId);
 108:   }
 109: 
 110:   // CrÃ©er le stream SSE
 111:   const stream = new ReadableStream({
 112:     start(controller) {
 113:       // Enregistrer le client
 114:       if (!clients.has(userId)) {
 115:         clients.set(userId, new Set());
 116:       }
 117:       clients.get(userId)!.add(controller);
 118: 
 119:       // Message de connexion
 120:       const connectEvent = `event: connected\ndata: ${JSON.stringify({
 121:         userId,
 122:         timestamp: Date.now(),
 123:         message: 'Connexion Ã©tablie',
 124:       })}\n\n`;
 125:       controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(connectEvent));
 126: 
 127:       // Heartbeat toutes les 30 secondes
 128:       const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
 129:         try {
 130:           const ping = `: heartbeat ${Date.now()}\n\n`;
 131:           controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(ping));
 132:         } catch {
 133:           clearInterval(heartbeat);
 134:         }
 135:       }, 30000);
 136: 
 137:       // Cleanup Ã  la dÃ©connexion
 138:       req.signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
 139:         clearInterval(heartbeat);
 140:         const userClients = clients.get(userId);
 141:         if (userClients) {
 142:           userClients.delete(controller);
 143:           if (userClients.size === 0) {
 144:             clients.delete(userId);
 145:             userTenantMap.delete(userId);
 146:           }
 147:         }
 148:       });
 149:     },
 150: 
 151:     cancel() {
 152:       // Cleanup si le stream est annulÃ©
 153:       const userClients = clients.get(userId);
 154:       if (userClients) {
 155:         for (const controller of userClients) {
 156:           try {
 157:             controller.close();
 158:           } catch {
 159:             // Ignorer
 160:           }
 161:         }
 162:         clients.delete(userId);
 163:       }
 164:       userTenantMap.delete(userId);
 165:     },
 166:   });
 167: 
 168:   return new Response(stream, {
 169:     headers: {
 170:       'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream',
 171:       'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
 172:       Connection: 'keep-alive',
 173:       'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', // DÃ©sactiver le buffering nginx
 174:     },
 175:   });
 176: }
 177: 
 178: /**
 179:  * Handler POST pour envoyer des Ã©vÃ©nements (usage interne)
 180:  */
 181: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
 182:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 183: 
 184:   // Seulement les admins peuvent publier des Ã©vÃ©nements
 185:   if (!session?.user || !['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(session.user.role as string)) {
 186:     return new Response('Non autorisÃ©', { status: 403 });
 187:   }
 188: 
 189:   try {
 190:     const { event, data, targetUserIds } = await req.json();
 191: 
 192:     if (!event || !data) {
 193:       return Response.json({ error: 'Event et data requis' }, { status: 400 });
 194:     }
 195: 
 196:     publishEvent(event as EventType, data, targetUserIds);
 197: 
 198:     return Response.json({
 199:       success: true,
 200:       clientsCount: Array.from(clients.values()).reduce((acc, set) => acc + set.size, 0),
 201:     });
 202:   } catch (error) {
 203:     console.error('[SSE] Erreur publication:', error);
 204:     return Response.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 205:   }
 206: }
 207: 
 208: // Export pour utilisation depuis d'autres modules
 209: export { clients };

src\app\api\reports\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: 
   7: type ReportType = 'factures' | 'dossiers' | 'clients' | 'activite' | 'financier';
   8: 
   9: // POST - Generer un rapport PDF
  10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13:     if (!session?.user) {
  14:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  15:     }
  16:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId as string | undefined;
  17:     if (!tenantId) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces refuse' }, { status: 403 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const body = await request.json();
  22:     const {
  23:       type,
  24:       startDate,
  25:       endDate,
  26:       filters = {},
  27:       format = 'pdf',
  28:     } = body as {
  29:       type: ReportType;
  30:       startDate?: string;
  31:       endDate?: string;
  32:       filters?: Record<string, unknown>;
  33:       format?: 'pdf' | 'csv' | 'excel';
  34:     };
  35: 
  36:     if (!type) {
  37:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'type requis' }, { status: 400 });
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     // Recuperer les donnees selon le type de rapport
  41:     const data = await getReportData(tenantId, type, {
  42:       startDate: startDate ? new Date(startDate) : undefined,
  43:       endDate: endDate ? new Date(endDate) : undefined,
  44:       ...filters,
  45:     });
  46: 
  47:     // Generer le rapport
  48:     const report = await generateReport(type, data, format);
  49:     const responseBuffer = new Uint8Array(report.buffer as Buffer);
  50: 
  51:     // Retourner le rapport selon le format
  52:     if (format === 'pdf') {
  53:       return new Response(responseBuffer, {
  54:         headers: {
  55:           'Content-Type': 'application/pdf',
  56:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${report.filename}"`,
  57:         },
  58:       });
  59:     } else if (format === 'csv') {
  60:       return new Response(responseBuffer, {
  61:         headers: {
  62:           'Content-Type': 'text/csv; charset=utf-8',
  63:           'Content-Disposition': `attachment; filename="${report.filename}"`,
  64:         },
  65:       });
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     return NextResponse.json({
  69:       success: true,
  70:       report: {
  71:         type,
  72:         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  73:         recordCount: data.length,
  74:       },
  75:     });
  76:   } catch (error) {
  77:     logger.error('Erreur generation rapport:', { error });
  78:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  79:   }
  80: }
  81: 
  82: // Recuperer les donnees pour le rapport
  83: async function getReportData(
  84:   tenantId: string,
  85:   type: ReportType,
  86:   filters: { startDate?: Date; endDate?: Date; [key: string]: unknown }
  87: ) {
  88:   const dateFilter: Record<string, Date> = {};
  89:   if (filters.startDate) dateFilter.gte = filters.startDate;
  90:   if (filters.endDate) dateFilter.lte = filters.endDate;
  91: 
  92:   switch (type) {
  93:     case 'factures':
  94:       return prisma.facture.findMany({
  95:         where: {
  96:           tenantId,
  97:           ...(Object.keys(dateFilter).length > 0 ? { dateEmission: dateFilter } : {}),
  98:         },
  99:         include: {
 100:           client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true, email: true } },
 101:           dossier: { select: { numero: true } },
 102:           lignes: true,
 103:           paiements: true,
 104:         },
 105:         orderBy: { dateEmission: 'desc' },
 106:       });
 107: 
 108:     case 'dossiers':
 109:       return prisma.dossier.findMany({
 110:         where: {
 111:           tenantId,
 112:           ...(Object.keys(dateFilter).length > 0 ? { dateCreation: dateFilter } : {}),
 113:         },
 114:         include: {
 115:           client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 116:         },
 117:         orderBy: { dateCreation: 'desc' },
 118:       });
 119: 
 120:     case 'clients':
 121:       return prisma.client.findMany({
 122:         where: { tenantId },
 123:         include: {
 124:           dossiers: { select: { id: true, statut: true } },
 125:           _count: { select: { dossiers: true, emails: true, factures: true } },
 126:         },
 127:         orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 128:       });
 129: 
 130:     case 'activite':
 131:       const [emails, workflows] = await Promise.all([
 132:         prisma.email.findMany({
 133:           where: {
 134:             tenantId,
 135:             ...(Object.keys(dateFilter).length > 0 ? { receivedAt: dateFilter } : {}),
 136:           },
 137:           select: {
 138:             id: true,
 139:             from: true,
 140:             subject: true,
 141:             category: true,
 142:             urgency: true,
 143:             receivedAt: true,
 144:             isProcessed: true,
 145:           },
 146:           orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' },
 147:           take: 500,
 148:         }),
 149:         prisma.workflowExecution.findMany({
 150:           where: {
 151:             tenantId,
 152:             ...(Object.keys(dateFilter).length > 0 ? { createdAt: dateFilter } : {}),
 153:           },
 154:           select: {
 155:             id: true,
 156:             workflowName: true,
 157:             status: true,
 158:             createdAt: true,
 159:             completedAt: true,
 160:           },
 161:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
 162:           take: 500,
 163:         }),
 164:       ]);
 165:       return { emails, workflows };
 166: 
 167:     case 'financier':
 168:       const factures = await prisma.facture.findMany({
 169:         where: {
 170:           tenantId,
 171:           ...(Object.keys(dateFilter).length > 0 ? { dateEmission: dateFilter } : {}),
 172:         },
 173:         include: {
 174:           paiements: true,
 175:         },
 176:       });
 177: 
 178:       // Calculer les statistiques
 179:       const stats = {
 180:         totalFacture: factures.reduce((sum, f) => sum + f.montantTTC, 0),
 181:         totalPaye: factures.reduce(
 182:           (sum, f) => sum + f.paiements.reduce((s, p) => s + p.montant, 0),
 183:           0
 184:         ),
 185:         factures: {
 186:           total: factures.length,
 187:           payees: factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'payee').length,
 188:           enAttente: factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'envoyee').length,
 189:           enRetard: factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'en_retard').length,
 190:         },
 191:       };
 192: 
 193:       return { factures, stats };
 194: 
 195:     default:
 196:       return [];
 197:   }
 198: }
 199: 
 200: // Generer le rapport dans le format demande
 201: async function generateReport(
 202:   type: ReportType,
 203:   data: unknown,
 204:   format: 'pdf' | 'csv' | 'excel'
 205: ): Promise<{ buffer: Buffer; filename: string }> {
 206:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
 207:   const filename = `rapport-${type}-${timestamp}.${format}`;
 208: 
 209:   if (format === 'csv') {
 210:     const csv = convertToCSV(type, data);
 211:     return {
 212:       buffer: Buffer.from(csv, 'utf-8'),
 213:       filename,
 214:     };
 215:   }
 216: 
 217:   // Pour PDF, generer un HTML et le convertir
 218:   const html = generateHTMLReport(type, data);
 219: 
 220:   // En production, utiliser puppeteer ou playwright pour convertir en PDF
 221:   // Pour l'instant, retourner le HTML comme placeholder
 222:   const pdfPlaceholder = `

 248:     filename,

src\app\api\saas\signup\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: POST /api/saas/signup
   3:  * 
   4:  * Point d'entrÃ©e unique pour l'inscription SaaS.
   5:  * Un avocat remplit le formulaire â†’ tout est provisionnÃ© automatiquement.
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: import { saasSignup, SaasSignupInput } from '@/lib/services/saas-provisioning';
  10: import { checkRateLimit } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
  11: 
  12: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  13:   // Rate limiting: 3 inscriptions / 15 min par IP
  14:   const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0] || 'unknown';
  15:   const rateLimitResult = checkRateLimit(`signup:${ip}`, { windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000, maxRequests: 3 });
  16:   if (!rateLimitResult.allowed) {
  17:     return NextResponse.json(
  18:       { error: 'Trop de tentatives. RÃ©essayez dans quelques minutes.' },
  19:       { status: 429 }
  20:     );
  21:   }
  22: 
  23:   try {
  24:     const body = await req.json();
  25: 
  26:     // Validation des champs obligatoires
  27:     const { firstName, lastName, email, password, cabinetName, plan, billingPeriod } = body;
  28: 
  29:     if (!firstName || !lastName || !email || !password || !cabinetName) {
  30:       return NextResponse.json(
  31:         { error: 'Tous les champs obligatoires doivent Ãªtre remplis.' },
  32:         { status: 400 }
  33:       );
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     if (!email.includes('@') || email.length < 5) {
  37:       return NextResponse.json(
  38:         { error: 'Adresse email invalide.' },
  39:         { status: 400 }
  40:       );
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     if (password.length < 8) {
  44:       return NextResponse.json(
  45:         { error: 'Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractÃ¨res.' },
  46:         { status: 400 }
  47:       );
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     const validPlans = ['SOLO', 'CABINET', 'ENTERPRISE'];
  51:     const selectedPlan = validPlans.includes(plan) ? plan : 'SOLO';
  52: 
  53:     const input: SaasSignupInput = {
  54:       firstName: firstName.trim(),
  55:       lastName: lastName.trim(),
  56:       email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
  57:       password,
  58:       phone: body.phone?.trim(),
  59:       cabinetName: cabinetName.trim(),
  60:       barreauVille: body.barreauVille?.trim(),
  61:       plan: selectedPlan,
  62:       billingPeriod: billingPeriod === 'yearly' ? 'yearly' : 'monthly',
  63:     };
  64: 
  65:     const result = await saasSignup(input);
  66: 
  67:     return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 201 });
  68:   } catch (error: unknown) {
  69:     const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erreur interne';
  70: 
  71:     if (message.includes('existe dÃ©jÃ ')) {
  72:       return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 409 });
  73:     }
  74: 
  75:     console.error('SaaS signup error:', error);
  76:     return NextResponse.json(
  77:       { error: 'Une erreur est survenue lors de la crÃ©ation de votre compte. Veuillez rÃ©essayer.' },
  78:       { status: 500 }
  79:     );
  80:   }
  81: }

src\app\api\search\analytics\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import {
   4:   getEmptySearches,
   5:   getPopularSearches,
   6:   getSearchStats,
   7:   getSearchTrends,
   8:   getUserRecentSearches,
   9: } from '@/lib/services/searchAnalytics';
  10: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  11: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  12: 
  13: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16: 
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  22:     const type = searchParams.get('type') || 'stats';
  23:     const tenantId = session.user.tenantId || undefined;
  24:     const userId = session.user.id;
  25: 
  26:     if (!userId) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur invalide' }, { status: 401 });
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     switch (type) {
  31:       case 'stats': {
  32:         const stats = await getSearchStats(tenantId);
  33:         return NextResponse.json(stats);
  34:       }
  35: 
  36:       case 'popular': {
  37:         const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');
  38:         const popular = await getPopularSearches(tenantId, limit);
  39:         return NextResponse.json({ searches: popular });
  40:       }
  41: 
  42:       case 'recent': {
  43:         const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');
  44:         const recent = await getUserRecentSearches(userId, limit);
  45:         return NextResponse.json({ searches: recent });
  46:       }
  47: 
  48:       case 'empty': {
  49:         const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20');
  50:         const empty = await getEmptySearches(tenantId, limit);
  51:         return NextResponse.json({ searches: empty });
  52:       }
  53: 
  54:       case 'trends': {
  55:         const days = parseInt(searchParams.get('days') || '7');
  56:         const trends = await getSearchTrends(tenantId, days);
  57:         return NextResponse.json({ trends });
  58:       }
  59: 
  60:       default:
  61:         return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Type invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  62:     }
  63:   } catch (error) {
  64:     logger.error('Search analytics error', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  65:       route: '/api/search/analytics',
  66:     });
  67:     return NextResponse.json(
  68:       { error: 'Erreur lors de la recuperation des analytics' },
  69:       { status: 500 }
  70:     );
  71:   }
  72: }

src\app\api\search\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { logSearch } from '@/lib/services/searchAnalytics';
   4: import { SearchResultType, searchService } from '@/lib/services/searchService';
   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: 
   8: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   9:   const startTime = performance.now();
  10: 
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  19:     const query = searchParams.get('q') || '';
  20:     const types = searchParams.get('types')?.split(',') as SearchResultType[] | undefined;
  21:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
  22:     const includeArchived = searchParams.get('archived') === 'true';
  23: 
  24:     if (!query || query.length < 2) {
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ results: [], query: '' });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     // Recherche avec le service
  29:     const results = await searchService.search(query, {
  30:       tenantId: session.user.tenantId || undefined,
  31:       types,
  32:       limit,
  33:       includeArchived,
  34:     });
  35: 
  36:     const userId = session.user.id;
  37:     if (!userId) {
  38:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur invalide' }, { status: 401 });
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     const executionTime = performance.now() - startTime;
  42: 
  43:     // Logger la recherche de maniere asynchrone (ne bloque pas la reponse)
  44:     logSearch({
  45:       query,
  46:       resultCount: results.length,
  47:       executionTime,
  48:       types,
  49:       userId,
  50:       tenantId: session.user.tenantId || undefined,
  51:     }).catch(err =>
  52:       logger.error('Erreur logging recherche', err instanceof Error ? err : undefined, {
  53:         route: '/api/search',
  54:       })
  55:     );
  56: 
  57:     return NextResponse.json({
  58:       results,
  59:       query,
  60:       total: results.length,
  61:       executionTime: Math.round(executionTime),
  62:       types: types || ['client', 'dossier', 'document', 'email'],
  63:     });
  64:   } catch (error) {
  65:     logger.error('Search error', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  66:       route: '/api/search',
  67:     });
  68:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors de la recherche' }, { status: 500 });
  69:   }
  70: }
  71:
