src\app\api\signatures\request\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * POST /api/signatures/request
   7:  * Envoie une demande de signature electronique (Yousign ou fallback).
   8:  */
   9: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  12: 
  13:   const { documentId, signerEmail, signerName, documentName } = await req.json();
  14: 
  15:   if (!signerEmail || !documentName) {
  16:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'signerEmail et documentName requis' }, { status: 400 });
  17:   }
  18: 
  19:   const yousignKey = process.env.YOUSIGN_API_KEY;
  20: 
  21:   if (yousignKey) {
  22:     try {
  23:       // Yousign API v3
  24:       const response = await fetch('https://api.yousign.app/v3/signature_requests', {
  25:         method: 'POST',
  26:         headers: {
  27:           'Authorization': `Bearer ${yousignKey}`,
  28:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  29:         },
  30:         body: JSON.stringify({
  31:           name: documentName,
  32:           delivery_mode: 'email',
  33:           signers: [{ info: { first_name: signerName?.split(' ')[0] || 'Client', last_name: signerName?.split(' ')[1] || '', email: signerEmail, locale: 'fr' } }],
  34:         }),
  35:       });
  36: 
  37:       if (response.ok) {
  38:         const data = await response.json();
  39:         return NextResponse.json({ success: true, signatureId: data.id, status: 'sent', provider: 'yousign' });
  40:       }
  41:     } catch (e) {
  42:       console.error('[SIGNATURE] Yousign error:', e);
  43:     }
  44:   }
  45: 
  46:   // Fallback: simuler
  47:   return NextResponse.json({
  48:     success: true,
  49:     signatureId: `sig-${Date.now()}`,
  50:     status: 'simulated',
  51:     message: `Demande de signature envoyee a ${signerEmail} pour "${documentName}"`,
  52:     note: 'Configurez YOUSIGN_API_KEY pour les signatures reelles',
  53:   });
  54: }
  55:

src\app\api\subscriptions\cancel\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe/config';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   7:     try {
   8:         const session = await getServerSession();
   9:         if (!session?.user?.email) {
  10:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  11:         }
  12: 
  13:         const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  14:             where: { email: session.user.email },
  15:             include: {
  16:                 subscriptions: {
  17:                     where: {
  18:                         status: {
  19:                             in: ['active', 'trialing']
  20:                         }
  21:                     },
  22:                     orderBy: {
  23:                         createdAt: 'desc'
  24:                     },
  25:                     take: 1
  26:                 }
  27:             }
  28:         });
  29: 
  30:         if (!user) {
  31:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User not found' }, { status: 404 });
  32:         }
  33: 
  34:         const subscription = user.subscriptions[0];
  35: 
  36:         if (!subscription) {
  37:             return NextResponse.json(
  38:                 { error: 'No active subscription found' },
  39:                 { status: 404 }
  40:             );
  41:         }
  42: 
  43:         // Cancel subscription at period end
  44:         const cancelledSubscription = await stripe.subscriptions.update(
  45:             subscription.stripeSubscriptionId,
  46:             {
  47:                 cancel_at_period_end: true
  48:             }
  49:         );
  50: 
  51:         // Update database
  52:         await prisma.subscription.update({
  53:             where: { id: subscription.id },
  54:             data: {
  55:                 cancelAtPeriodEnd: true
  56:             }
  57:         });
  58: 
  59:         // Create subscription history entry
  60:         await prisma.subscriptionHistory.create({
  61:             data: {
  62:                 subscriptionId: subscription.id,
  63:                 action: 'CANCELLED',
  64:                 fromTier: subscription.tier,
  65:                 toTier: 'FREE',
  66:                 reason: 'User requested cancellation'
  67:             }
  68:         });
  69: 
  70:         return NextResponse.json({
  71:             message: 'Subscription will be cancelled at the end of the billing period',
  72:             cancelAt: new Date((cancelledSubscription as any).current_period_end * 1000).toISOString()
  73:         });
  74:     } catch (error: any) {
  75:         console.error('Error cancelling subscription:', error);
  76:         return NextResponse.json(
  77:             { error: error.message || 'Internal server error' },
  78:             { status: 500 }
  79:         );
  80:     }
  81: }
  82:

src\app\api\subscriptions\create\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { stripe } from '@/lib/stripe/config';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import Stripe from 'stripe';
   6: 
   7: const ALLOWED_PRICE_IDS: Record<string, string> = {
   8:     PRO_MONTHLY:        process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY        || '',
   9:     PRO_YEARLY:         process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_YEARLY         || '',
  10:     ENTERPRISE_MONTHLY: process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_ENTERPRISE_MONTHLY || '',
  11:     ENTERPRISE_YEARLY:  process.env.STRIPE_PRICE_ENTERPRISE_YEARLY  || '',
  12: };
  13: const ALLOWED_TIERS = ['PRO', 'ENTERPRISE'] as const;
  14: type AllowedTier = (typeof ALLOWED_TIERS)[number];
  15: 
  16: type ExpandedSubscription = Stripe.Subscription & {
  17:     latest_invoice?: Stripe.Invoice & {
  18:         payment_intent?: Stripe.PaymentIntent;
  19:     };
  20: };
  21: 
  22: type SubscriptionPeriods = {
  23:     current_period_start: number;
  24:     current_period_end: number;
  25: };
  26: 
  27: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  28:     try {
  29:         const session = await getServerSession();
  30:         if (!session?.user?.email) {
  31:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  32:         }
  33: 
  34:         const body = await req.json();
  35:         const priceKey: string = body?.priceKey;
  36:         const tier: string = body?.tier;
  37: 
  38:         if (!priceKey || !tier) {
  39:             return NextResponse.json(
  40:                 { error: 'Missing required fields: priceKey, tier' },
  41:                 { status: 400 }
  42:             );
  43:         }
  44: 
  45:         if (!(ALLOWED_TIERS as readonly string[]).includes(tier)) {
  46:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid tier' }, { status: 400 });
  47:         }
  48: 
  49:         const priceId = ALLOWED_PRICE_IDS[priceKey];
  50:         if (!priceId) {
  51:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid price key' }, { status: 400 });
  52:         }
  53: 
  54:         const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  55:             where: { email: session.user.email },
  56:             include: { stripeCustomer: true }
  57:         });
  58: 
  59:         if (!user) {
  60:             return NextResponse.json({ error: 'User not found' }, { status: 404 });
  61:         }
  62: 
  63:         let stripeCustomerId = user.stripeCustomer?.stripeCustomerId;
  64: 
  65:         if (!stripeCustomerId) {
  66:             const customer = await stripe.customers.create({
  67:                 email: user.email,
  68:                 name: user.name || undefined,
  69:                 metadata: { userId: user.id }
  70:             });
  71: 
  72:             await prisma.stripeCustomer.create({
  73:                 data: {
  74:                     userId: user.id,
  75:                     stripeCustomerId: customer.id,
  76:                     email: user.email
  77:                 }
  78:             });
  79: 
  80:             stripeCustomerId = customer.id;
  81:         }
  82: 
  83:         const subscription = await stripe.subscriptions.create({
  84:             customer: stripeCustomerId,
  85:             items: [{ price: priceId }],
  86:             payment_behavior: 'default_incomplete',
  87:             payment_settings: { save_default_payment_method: 'on_subscription' },
  88:             expand: ['latest_invoice.payment_intent'],
  89:             metadata: { userId: user.id, tier }
  90:         }) as ExpandedSubscription;
  91: 
  92:         const subscriptionPeriods = subscription as unknown as SubscriptionPeriods;
  93: 
  94:         await prisma.subscription.create({
  95:             data: {
  96:                 userId: user.id,
  97:                 stripeSubscriptionId: subscription.id,
  98:                 stripeCustomerId,
  99:                 tier: tier as AllowedTier,
 100:                 status: subscription.status,
 101:                 currentPeriodStart: new Date(subscriptionPeriods.current_period_start * 1000),
 102:                 currentPeriodEnd: new Date(subscriptionPeriods.current_period_end * 1000),
 103:                 cancelAtPeriodEnd: subscription.cancel_at_period_end
 104:             }
 105:         });
 106: 
 107:         return NextResponse.json({
 108:             subscriptionId: subscription.id,
 109:             clientSecret: subscription.latest_invoice?.payment_intent?.client_secret
 110:         });
 111:     } catch (error: unknown) {
 112:         console.error('Error creating subscription:', error);
 113:         return NextResponse.json(
 114:             { error: 'Une erreur est survenue lors de la crÃ©ation de l\'abonnement.' },
 115:             { status: 500 }
 116:         );
 117:     }
 118: }
 119:

src\app\api\super-admin\emails\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Super Admin Email & Workflow Monitoring
   3:  * GET /api/super-admin/emails - Liste tous les emails de la plateforme

   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';

   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15: 
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const user = session.user as any;
  21: 
  22:     if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  27:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
  28:     const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
  29:     const status = searchParams.get('status'); // processed, unprocessed, all
  30:     const urgency = searchParams.get('urgency');
  31:     const tenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  32: 
  33:     const where: any = {};
  34: 
  35:     if (status === 'processed') {
  36:       where.isProcessed = true;
  37:     } else if (status === 'unprocessed') {
  38:       where.isProcessed = false;
  39:     }
  40: 
  41:     if (urgency) {
  42:       where.urgency = urgency;
  43:     }
  44: 
  45:     if (tenantId) {
  46:       where.tenantId = tenantId;
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     const [emails, total] = await Promise.all([
  50:       prisma.email.findMany({
  51:         where,
  52:         include: {
  53:           tenant: {
  54:             select: {
  55:               id: true,
  56:               name: true,
  57:               subdomain: true,
  58:             },
  59:           },
  60:           client: {
  61:             select: {
  62:               id: true,
  63:               firstName: true,
  64:               lastName: true,
  65:               email: true,
  66:             },
  67:           },
  68:           workflows: {
  69:             select: {
  70:               id: true,
  71:               workflowName: true,
  72:               status: true,
  73:               progress: true,
  74:               startedAt: true,
  75:               completedAt: true,
  76:             },
  77:           },
  78:           _count: {
  79:             select: {
  80:               attachments: true,
  81:             },
  82:           },
  83:         },
  84:         orderBy: { receivedAt: 'desc' },
  85:         take: limit,
  86:         skip: (page - 1) * limit,
  87:       }),
  88:       prisma.email.count({ where }),
  89:     ]);
  90: 
  91:     // Statistiques globales
  92:     const stats = await prisma.email.groupBy({
  93:       by: ['category', 'urgency', 'isProcessed'],
  94:       _count: true,
  95:     });
  96: 
  97:     const categoryStats: Record<string, number> = {};
  98:     const urgencyStats: Record<string, number> = {};
  99:     let processedCount = 0;
 100:     let unprocessedCount = 0;
 101: 
 102:     stats.forEach(stat => {
 103:       categoryStats[stat.category] = (categoryStats[stat.category] || 0) + stat._count;
 104:       urgencyStats[stat.urgency] = (urgencyStats[stat.urgency] || 0) + stat._count;
 105:       if (stat.isProcessed) {
 106:         processedCount += stat._count;
 107:       } else {
 108:         unprocessedCount += stat._count;
 109:       }
 110:     });
 111: 
 112:     return NextResponse.json({
 113:       emails: emails.map(email => ({
 114:         id: email.id,
 115:         from: email.from,
 116:         to: email.to,
 117:         subject: email.subject,
 118:         preview: email.preview,
 119:         category: email.category,
 120:         urgency: email.urgency,
 121:         sentiment: email.sentiment,
 122:         isRead: email.isRead,
 123:         isProcessed: email.isProcessed,
 124:         receivedAt: email.receivedAt,
 125:         processedAt: email.processedAt,
 126:         tenant: email.tenant,
 127:         client: email.client,
 128:         attachmentCount: email._count.attachments,
 129:         workflow: email.workflows[0] || null,
 130:       })),
 131:       pagination: {
 132:         page,
 133:         limit,
 134:         total,
 135:         totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
 136:       },
 137:       stats: {
 138:         total,
 139:         processed: processedCount,
 140:         unprocessed: unprocessedCount,
 141:         byCategory: categoryStats,
 142:         byUrgency: urgencyStats,
 143:       },
 144:     });
 145:   } catch (error) {
 146:     logger.error('Erreur API super admin emails', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 147:       route: '/api/super-admin/emails',
 148:     });
 149:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 150:   }
 151: }

src\app\api\super-admin\stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   6: 
   7: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  10: 
  11:     if (!session?.user) {
  12:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  13:     }
  14: 
  15:     const user = session.user as { role?: string };
  16: 
  17:     // Seul le super admin peut acceder a ces statistiques
  18:     if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  19:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  20:     }
  21: 
  22:     // Statistiques globales de la plateforme
  23:     const [
  24:       totalTenants,
  25:       activeTenants,
  26:       totalUsers,
  27:       totalDossiers,
  28:       totalFactures,
  29:       facturesStats,
  30:       totalEmails,
  31:       totalWorkflows,
  32:     ] = await Promise.all([
  33:       prisma.tenant.count(),
  34:       prisma.tenant.count({ where: { status: 'active' } }),
  35:       prisma.user.count({ where: { role: { not: 'SUPER_ADMIN' } } }),
  36:       prisma.dossier.count(),
  37:       prisma.facture.count(),
  38:       prisma.facture.aggregate({
  39:         _sum: { montantTTC: true },
  40:         where: { statut: 'payee' },
  41:       }),
  42:       prisma.email.count(),
  43:       prisma.workflowExecution.count(),
  44:     ]);
  45: 
  46:     // Calcul de la croissance mensuelle
  47:     const lastMonth = new Date();
  48:     lastMonth.setMonth(lastMonth.getMonth() - 1);
  49: 
  50:     const newTenantsThisMonth = await prisma.tenant.count({
  51:       where: {
  52:         createdAt: { gte: lastMonth },
  53:       },
  54:     });
  55: 
  56:     const totalRevenue = facturesStats._sum.montantTTC || 0;
  57:     const averageRevenuePerTenant = totalTenants > 0 ? totalRevenue / totalTenants : 0;
  58: 
  59:     return NextResponse.json({
  60:       totalTenants,
  61:       activeTenants,
  62:       totalUsers,
  63:       totalRevenue,
  64:       monthlyGrowth: newTenantsThisMonth,
  65:       totalDossiers,
  66:       totalFactures,
  67:       totalEmails,
  68:       totalWorkflows,
  69:       averageRevenuePerTenant,
  70:     });
  71:   } catch (error) {
  72:     logger.error('Erreur API super admin stats', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  73:       route: '/api/super-admin/stats',
  74:     });
  75:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  76:   }
  77: }

src\app\api\super-admin\tenants\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: import { requireApiPermission, RBAC_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/auth/rbac';
   7: 
   8: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   9:   try {
  10:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  11:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TENANTS_READ);
  12:     if (!guard.ok) {
  13:       return guard.response;
  14:     }
  15: 
  16:     // Parse query params
  17:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  18:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
  19: 
  20:     // Recuperer tous les tenants avec leurs statistiques
  21:     const tenants = await prisma.tenant.findMany({
  22:       take: limit,
  23:       include: {
  24:         plan: {
  25:           select: {
  26:             name: true,
  27:             displayName: true
  28:           }
  29:         },
  30:         _count: {
  31:           select: {
  32:             users: true,
  33:             dossiers: true
  34:           }
  35:         }
  36:       },
  37:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }
  38:     });
  39: 
  40:     // Format response without factures (model not yet implemented)
  41:     const tenantsWithStats = tenants.map((tenant) => ({
  42:       id: tenant.id,
  43:       name: tenant.name,
  44:       plan: tenant.plan.name,
  45:       status: tenant.status,
  46:       userCount: tenant._count.users,
  47:       dossierCount: tenant._count.dossiers,
  48:       revenue: 0, // Facture model not yet implemented
  49:       createdAt: tenant.createdAt.toISOString()
  50:     }));
  51: 
  52:     return NextResponse.json(tenantsWithStats);
  53: 
  54:   } catch (error) {
  55:     logger.error('Erreur API super admin tenants', { error });
  56:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  57:   }
  58: }
  59: 
  60: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  61:   try {
  62:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  63:     const guard = requireApiPermission(session, RBAC_PERMISSIONS.TENANTS_CREATE);
  64:     if (!guard.ok) {
  65:       return guard.response;
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     const body = await request.json();
  69:     const { name, subdomain, planId, adminEmail, adminName, adminPassword } = body;
  70: 
  71:     // Validation
  72:     if (!name || !subdomain || !planId || !adminEmail || !adminName || !adminPassword) {
  73:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Donnees manquantes' }, { status: 400 });
  74:     }
  75: 
  76:     // Verifier que le subdomain est unique
  77:     const existingTenant = await prisma.tenant.findUnique({
  78:       where: { subdomain }
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     if (existingTenant) {
  82:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Subdomain deja utilise' }, { status: 400 });
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     // Creer le tenant
  86:     const tenant = await prisma.tenant.create({
  87:       data: {
  88:         name,
  89:         subdomain,
  90:         planId,
  91:         status: 'active'
  92:       }
  93:     });
  94: 
  95:     // Creer l'utilisateur admin du tenant
  96:     const bcrypt = require('bcryptjs');
  97:     const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(adminPassword, 12);
  98: 
  99:     const adminUser = await prisma.user.create({
 100:       data: {
 101:         email: adminEmail,
 102:         name: adminName,
 103:         password: hashedPassword,
 104:         role: 'ADMIN',
 105:         tenantId: tenant.id
 106:       }
 107:     });
 108: 
 109:     return NextResponse.json({
 110:       tenant: {
 111:         id: tenant.id,
 112:         name: tenant.name,
 113:         subdomain: tenant.subdomain,
 114:         status: tenant.status
 115:       },
 116:       admin: {
 117:         id: adminUser.id,
 118:         email: adminUser.email,
 119:         name: adminUser.name
 120:       }
 121:     }, { status: 201 });
 122: 
 123:   } catch (error) {
 124:     logger.error('Erreur creation tenant', { error });
 125:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 126:   }
 127: }

src\app\api\super-admin\workflows\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Route - Super Admin Workflow Monitoring
   3:  * GET /api/super-admin/workflows - Liste toutes les executions de workflows
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  15: 
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const user = session.user as any;
  21: 
  22:     if (user.role !== 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  27:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '50');
  28:     const page = parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1');
  29:     const status = searchParams.get('status');
  30:     const tenantId = searchParams.get('tenantId');
  31: 
  32:     const where: any = {};
  33: 
  34:     if (status) {
  35:       where.status = status;
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     if (tenantId) {
  39:       where.tenantId = tenantId;
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     const [workflows, total] = await Promise.all([
  43:       prisma.workflowExecution.findMany({
  44:         where,
  45:         include: {
  46:           tenant: {
  47:             select: {
  48:               id: true,
  49:               name: true,
  50:               subdomain: true,
  51:             },
  52:           },
  53:           email: {
  54:             select: {
  55:               id: true,
  56:               from: true,
  57:               subject: true,
  58:               category: true,
  59:               urgency: true,
  60:             },
  61:           },
  62:         },
  63:         orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  64:         take: limit,
  65:         skip: (page - 1) * limit,
  66:       }),
  67:       prisma.workflowExecution.count({ where }),
  68:     ]);
  69: 
  70:     // Statistiques par statut
  71:     const statusStats = await prisma.workflowExecution.groupBy({
  72:       by: ['status'],
  73:       _count: true,
  74:     });
  75: 
  76:     const stats: Record<string, number> = {};
  77:     statusStats.forEach(stat => {
  78:       stats[stat.status] = stat._count;
  79:     });
  80: 
  81:     // Temps moyen d'execution
  82:     const completedWorkflows = await prisma.workflowExecution.findMany({
  83:       where: {
  84:         status: 'completed',
  85:         completedAt: { not: null },
  86:         startedAt: { not: null },
  87:       },
  88:       select: {
  89:         startedAt: true,
  90:         completedAt: true,
  91:       },
  92:       take: 100,
  93:     });
  94: 
  95:     let avgExecutionTime = 0;
  96:     if (completedWorkflows.length > 0) {
  97:       const totalTime = completedWorkflows.reduce((sum, wf) => {
  98:         const duration = new Date(wf.completedAt!).getTime() - new Date(wf.startedAt!).getTime();
  99:         return sum + duration;
 100:       }, 0);
 101:       avgExecutionTime = totalTime / completedWorkflows.length;
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     return NextResponse.json({
 105:       workflows: workflows.map(wf => ({
 106:         id: wf.id,
 107:         workflowId: wf.workflowId,
 108:         workflowName: wf.workflowName,
 109:         status: wf.status,
 110:         currentStep: wf.currentStep,
 111:         progress: wf.progress,
 112:         triggerType: wf.triggerType,
 113:         startedAt: wf.startedAt,
 114:         completedAt: wf.completedAt,
 115:         error: wf.error,
 116:         tenant: wf.tenant,
 117:         email: wf.email,
 118:         steps: wf.steps ? JSON.parse(wf.steps) : [],
 119:         result: wf.result ? JSON.parse(wf.result) : null,
 120:       })),
 121:       pagination: {
 122:         page,
 123:         limit,
 124:         total,
 125:         totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit),
 126:       },
 127:       stats: {
 128:         total,
 129:         byStatus: stats,
 130:         avgExecutionTimeMs: Math.round(avgExecutionTime),
 131:       },
 132:     });
 133:   } catch (error) {
 134:     logger.error('Erreur API super admin workflows', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 135:       route: '/api/super-admin/workflows',
 136:     });
 137:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 138:   }
 139: }
 140:

src\app\api\tax\calculate\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   4: import { taxCalculator, type TaxCalculationRequest } from '@/lib/tax/calculator';
   5: 
   6: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   7:     try {
   8:         const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
   9:         if (!session?.user) {
  10:             return NextResponse.json(
  11:                 { error: 'Unauthorized' },
  12:                 { status: 401 }
  13:             );
  14:         }
  15: 
  16:         const body = await req.json();
  17: 
  18:         const request: TaxCalculationRequest = {
  19:             amount: body.amount,
  20:             currency: body.currency,
  21:             country: body.country,
  22:             state: body.state,
  23:             city: body.city,
  24:             zip: body.zip,
  25:             customerType: body.customerType || 'B2C',
  26:             vatNumber: body.vatNumber,
  27:             productCategory: body.productCategory || 'digital'
  28:         };
  29: 
  30:         // Validate required fields
  31:         if (!request.amount || !request.currency || !request.country) {
  32:             return NextResponse.json(
  33:                 { error: 'Missing required fields: amount, currency, country' },
  34:                 { status: 400 }
  35:             );
  36:         }
  37: 
  38:         // Calculate tax

src\app\api\tenant\[tenantId]\analytics\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Analytics - MÃ©triques IA et Apprentissage Continu
   3:  * Endpoint: /api/tenant/[tenantId]/analytics
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   9: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  10: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  11: 
  12: interface AnalyticsParams {
  13:   params: { tenantId: string };
  14: }
  15: 
  16: export async function GET(
  17:   request: NextRequest,
  18:   { params }: AnalyticsParams
  19: ) {
  20:   try {
  21:     const { tenantId } = params;
  22:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  23:     if (!session?.user) {
  24:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  25:     }
  26:     if ((session.user as any).tenantId !== tenantId) {
  27:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  28:     }
  29:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
  30:     const range = searchParams.get('range') || '30d';
  31: 
  32:     // Calculer la date de dÃ©but selon la pÃ©riode
  33:     const now = new Date();
  34:     const startDate = new Date();
  35: 
  36:     switch (range) {
  37:       case '7d':
  38:         startDate.setDate(now.getDate() - 7);
  39:         break;
  40:       case '30d':
  41:         startDate.setDate(now.getDate() - 30);
  42:         break;
  43:       case '90d':
  44:         startDate.setDate(now.getDate() - 90);
  45:         break;
  46:       default:
  47:         startDate.setDate(now.getDate() - 30);
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer toutes les actions IA de la pÃ©riode
  51:     const aiActions = await prisma.aIAction.findMany({
  52:       where: {
  53:         tenantId,
  54:         createdAt: {
  55:           gte: startDate,
  56:           lte: now
  57:         }
  58:       },
  59:       orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }
  60:     });
  61: 
  62:     // Calculer les mÃ©triques globales
  63:     const totalActions = aiActions.length;
  64:     const approvedActions = aiActions.filter(a =>
  65:       a.validationStatus === 'APPROVED' || a.validationStatus === 'AUTO_APPROVED'
  66:     ).length;
  67:     const modifiedActions = aiActions.filter(a =>
  68:       a.validationStatus === 'MODIFIED_APPROVED'
  69:     ).length;
  70:     const rejectedActions = aiActions.filter(a =>
  71:       a.validationStatus === 'REJECTED'
  72:     ).length;
  73: 
  74:     const globalSuccessRate = totalActions > 0
  75:       ? (approvedActions + modifiedActions) / totalActions
  76:       : 0;
  77: 
  78:     // Analyser les performances par type d'action
  79:     const actionTypeStats = new Map<string, {
  80:       total: number;
  81:       approved: number;
  82:       modified: number;
  83:       rejected: number;
  84:       totalConfidence: number;
  85:     }>();
  86: 
  87:     aiActions.forEach(action => {
  88:       const type = action.actionType;
  89:       const stats = actionTypeStats.get(type) || {
  90:         total: 0,
  91:         approved: 0,
  92:         modified: 0,
  93:         rejected: 0,
  94:         totalConfidence: 0
  95:       };
  96: 
  97:       stats.total++;
  98:       stats.totalConfidence += action.confidence;
  99: 
 100:       switch (action.validationStatus) {
 101:         case 'APPROVED':
 102:         case 'AUTO_APPROVED':
 103:           stats.approved++;
 104:           break;
 105:         case 'MODIFIED_APPROVED':
 106:           stats.modified++;
 107:           break;
 108:         case 'REJECTED':
 109:           stats.rejected++;
 110:           break;
 111:       }
 112: 
 113:       actionTypeStats.set(type, stats);
 114:     });
 115: 
 116:     // Calculer les amÃ©liorations (simulation basÃ©e sur les donnÃ©es actuelles)
 117:     const improvements = Array.from(actionTypeStats.entries()).map(([type, stats]) => {
 118:       const currentSuccessRate = stats.total > 0
 119:         ? (stats.approved + stats.modified) / stats.total
 120:         : 0;
 121: 
 122:       // Simulation d'amÃ©lioration basÃ©e sur le taux de succÃ¨s
 123:       let improvement = 0;
 124:       let status: 'improving' | 'stable' | 'declining' = 'stable';
 125: 
 126:       if (currentSuccessRate > 0.85) {
 127:         improvement = Math.random() * 0.05; // +0-5%
 128:         status = 'improving';
 129:       } else if (currentSuccessRate < 0.7) {
 130:         improvement = -(Math.random() * 0.1); // -0-10%
 131:         status = 'declining';
 132:       } else {
 133:         improvement = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.04; // Â±2%
 134:         status = improvement > 0 ? 'improving' : improvement < -0.01 ? 'declining' : 'stable';
 135:       }
 136: 
 137:       return {
 138:         actionType: type,
 139:         currentSuccessRate,
 140:         improvement,
 141:         status
 142:       };
 143:     });
 144: 
 145:     // RÃ©partition des actions par type
 146:     const actionsByType = Array.from(actionTypeStats.entries()).map(([type, stats]) => ({
 147:       type,
 148:       count: stats.total,
 149:       avgConfidence: stats.total > 0 ? stats.totalConfidence / stats.total : 0
 150:     }));
 151: 
 152:     // Tendances de validation (7 derniers jours)
 153:     const validationTrends: Array<{
 154:       date: string;
 155:       approved: number;
 156:       rejected: number;
 157:       modified: number;
 158:     }> = [];
 159:     for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
 160:       const date = new Date();
 161:       date.setDate(now.getDate() - i);
 162:       const dayStart = new Date(date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0));
 163:       const dayEnd = new Date(date.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999));
 164: 
 165:       const dayActions = aiActions.filter(action => {
 166:         const actionDate = new Date(action.createdAt);
 167:         return actionDate >= dayStart && actionDate <= dayEnd;
 168:       });
 169: 
 170:       validationTrends.push({
 171:         date: dayStart.toISOString(),
 172:         approved: dayActions.filter(a =>
 173:           a.validationStatus === 'APPROVED' || a.validationStatus === 'AUTO_APPROVED'
 174:         ).length,
 175:         rejected: dayActions.filter(a => a.validationStatus === 'REJECTED').length,
 176:         modified: dayActions.filter(a => a.validationStatus === 'MODIFIED_APPROVED').length
 177:       });
 178:     }
 179: 
 180:     const analyticsData = {
 181:       period: range,
 182:       globalSuccessRate,
 183:       totalActions,
 184:       improvements,
 185:       actionsByType,
 186:       validationTrends,
 187:       generatedAt: now.toISOString()
 188:     };
 189: 
 190:     return NextResponse.json(analyticsData);
 191: 
 192:   } catch (error) {
 193:     logger.error('Erreur analytics:', { error });
 194:     return NextResponse.json(
 195:       { error: 'Erreur lors du calcul des analytics' },
 196:       { status: 500 }
 197:     );
 198:   }
 199: }

src\app\api\tenant\[tenantId]\clients\[clientId]\dossiers\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   6: 
   7: export async function GET(
   8:   request: NextRequest,
   9:   { params }: { params: { tenantId: string; clientId: string } }
  10: ) {
  11:   try {
  12:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  13: 
  14:     if (!session?.user) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const user = session.user as any;
  19:     const { tenantId, clientId } = params;
  20: 
  21:     // VÃ©rification d'accÃ¨s
  22:     if (user.role !== 'ADMIN' || user.tenantId !== tenantId) {
  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer les dossiers du client avec infos du client
  27:     const dossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
  28:       where: {
  29:         tenantId,
  30:         clientId,
  31:       },
  32:       include: {
  33:         client: {
  34:           select: {
  35:             firstName: true,
  36:             lastName: true,
  37:             email: true,
  38:           },
  39:         },
  40:         documents: {
  41:           select: {
  42:             id: true,
  43:           },
  44:         },
  45:       },
  46:       orderBy: {
  47:         createdAt: 'desc',
  48:       },
  49:     });
  50: 
  51:     // Formater les donnÃ©es pour le frontend
  52:     const formattedDossiers = dossiers.map(dossier => {
  53:       // DÃ©terminer si les donnÃ©es client sont complÃ¨tes
  54:       const hasDocuments = dossier.documents.length > 0;
  55:       const hasDescription = dossier.description && dossier.description.length > 50;
  56:       const clientDataComplete = hasDocuments && hasDescription;
  57: 
  58:       // Calculer la progression
  59:       let progression = 0;
  60:       if (dossier.statut === 'en_attente') progression = 20;
  61:       else if (dossier.statut === 'documents_requis') progression = 30;
  62:       else if (dossier.statut === 'en_cours') progression = clientDataComplete ? 65 : 40;
  63:       else if (dossier.statut === 'analyse_ia') progression = 80;
  64:       else if (dossier.statut === 'termine') progression = 100;
  65: 
  66:       // DÃ©terminer la prioritÃ© (Ã  adapter selon vos critÃ¨res)
  67:       const daysSinceCreation = Math.floor(
  68:         (new Date().getTime() - new Date(dossier.createdAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
  69:       );
  70:       const priorite =
  71:         daysSinceCreation > 14 ? 'haute' : daysSinceCreation > 7 ? 'moyenne' : 'basse';
  72: 
  73:       return {
  74:         id: dossier.id,
  75:         numero: dossier.numero,
  76:         titre: dossier.objet || 'Sans objet',
  77:         type: dossier.typeDossier || 'RÃ©clamation',
  78:         statut: dossier.statut,
  79:         priorite,
  80:         progression,
  81:         clientDataComplete,
  82:         lastUpdate: getLastUpdateMessage(dossier, clientDataComplete),
  83:         clientName: 'Client',
  84:       };
  85:     });
  86: 
  87:     return NextResponse.json({
  88:       dossiers: formattedDossiers,
  89:     });
  90:   } catch (error) {
  91:     logger.error('Erreur API dossiers client', { error, params });
  92:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  93:   }
  94: }
  95: 
  96: function getLastUpdateMessage(dossier: any, clientDataComplete: boolean): string {
  97:   const timeSince = getTimeSince(dossier.updatedAt);
  98: 
  99:   if (dossier.statut === 'analyse_ia') {
 100:     return `Le systÃ¨me analyse les donnÃ©es fournies - ${timeSince}`;
 101:   }
 102:   if (!clientDataComplete) {
 103:     return `En attente des donnÃ©es client - ${timeSince}`;
 104:   }
 105:   if (dossier.statut === 'termine') {
 106:     return `Dossier terminÃ© - ${timeSince}`;
 107:   }
 108: 
 109:   return `DonnÃ©es mises Ã  jour par le client ${timeSince}`;
 110: }
 111: 
 112: function getTimeSince(date: Date): string {
 113:   const now = new Date();
 114:   const diffMs = now.getTime() - new Date(date).getTime();
 115:   const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
 116:   const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
 117:   const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);
 118: 
 119:   if (diffMins < 60) return `il y a ${diffMins}min`;
 120:   if (diffHours < 24) return `il y a ${diffHours}h`;
 121:   if (diffDays === 1) return 'il y a 1 jour';
 122:   return `il y a ${diffDays} jours`;
 123: }

  23:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s interdit' }, { status: 403 });

  73:           where: {

  75:             clientId: client.id,
  76:             statut: { in: ['en_attente', 'documents_requis'] }
  77:           }

  79:

  82:           where: {
  83:             tenantId,

  85:           },

  87:             updatedAt: 'desc'
  88:           },

  90:             updatedAt: true
  91:           }

 160: 
 161:   } catch (error) {
 162:     logger.error('Erreur API clients with stats', { error, tenantId: params.tenantId });
 163:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 164:   }
 165: }

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';

   6: 
   7: export async function GET(
   8:   req: NextRequest,
   9:   { params }: { params: { tenantId: string } }
  10: ) {

  12:   
  13:   if (!session?.user || (session.user as any).tenantId !== params.tenantId) {
  14:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
  15:   }
  16: 
  17:   try {
  18:     const months = ['Jan', 'FÃ©v', 'Mar', 'Avr', 'Mai', 'Jun'];
  19:     const data = await Promise.all(
  20:       months.map(async (month, index) => {
  21:         const startDate = new Date(2024, index, 1);
  22:         const endDate = new Date(2024, index + 1, 0);
  23: 
  24:         const [dossiers, factures, revenus] = await Promise.all([
  25:           prisma.dossier.count({
  26:             where: {
  27:               tenantId: params.tenantId,
  28:               createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate }
  29:             }
  30:           }),
  31:           prisma.facture.count({
  32:             where: {
  33:               tenantId: params.tenantId,
  34:               dateEmission: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate }
  35:             }
  36:           }),
  37:           prisma.facture.aggregate({
  38:             where: {
  39:               tenantId: params.tenantId,
  40:               dateEmission: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
  41:               statut: 'payee'
  42:             },
  43:             _sum: { montantTTC: true }
  44:           })
  45:         ]);
  46: 
  47:         return {
  48:           month,
  49:           dossiers,
  50:           factures,
  51:           revenus: revenus._sum.montantTTC || 0
  52:         };
  53:       })
  54:     );
  55: 
  56:     return NextResponse.json(data);
  57:   } catch (error) {
  58:     logger.error('Erreur monthly-data:', { error });
  59:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  60:   }

  59:       else if (dossier.statut === 'documents_requis') progression = 30;
  60:       else if (dossier.statut === 'en_cours') progression = clientDataComplete ? 65 : 40;
  61:       else if (dossier.statut === 'analyse_ia') progression = 80;
  62:       else if (dossier.statut === 'termine') progression = 100;
  63: 
  64:       const daysSinceCreation = Math.floor(
  65:         (new Date().getTime() - new Date(dossier.createdAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
  66:       );
  67:       const priorite = daysSinceCreation > 14 ? 'haute' : 
  68:                        daysSinceCreation > 7 ? 'moyenne' : 'basse';
  69: 
  70:       return {
  71:         id: dossier.id,
  72:         numero: dossier.numero,
  73:         titre: dossier.objet || 'Sans objet',
  74:         type: dossier.typeDossier || 'RÃ©clamation',
  75:         statut: dossier.statut,
  76:         priorite,
  77:         progression,
  78:         clientDataComplete,
  79:         lastUpdate: getTimeSince(dossier.updatedAt),
  80:         clientName: `${dossier.client?.firstName || ''} ${dossier.client?.lastName || ''}`.trim() || 'Client inconnu'
  81:       };
  82:     });
  83: 
  84:     return NextResponse.json({
  85:       dossiers: formattedDossiers
  86:     });
  87: 
  88:   } catch (error) {
  89:     logger.error('Erreur API tous dossiers', { error, tenantId: params.tenantId });
  90:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  91:   }
  92: }
  93: 
  94: function getTimeSince(date: Date): string {
  95:   const now = new Date();
  96:   const diffMs = now.getTime() - new Date(date).getTime();
  97:   const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  98:   const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  99:   const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);
 100: 
 101:   if (diffMins < 60) return `Il y a ${diffMins}min`;
 102:   if (diffHours < 24) return `Il y a ${diffHours}h`;
 103:   if (diffDays === 1) return 'Il y a 1 jour';
 104:   return `Il y a ${diffDays} jours`;
 105: }

src\app\api\tenant\[tenantId]\semantic-search\route.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * API Recherche SÃ©mantique - Recherche par Sens avec IA
   3:  * Endpoint: /api/tenant/[tenantId]/semantic-search
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   9: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  10: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  11: 
  12: interface SemanticSearchParams {
  13:   params: { tenantId: string };
  14: }
  15: 
  16: // Fonction pour calculer la similaritÃ© cosinus (simulation)
  17: function calculateCosineSimilarity(query: string, text: string): number {
  18:   // Simulation de similaritÃ© basÃ©e sur des mots-clÃ©s et contexte
  19:   const queryWords = query.toLowerCase().split(' ');
  20:   const textWords = text.toLowerCase().split(' ');
  21: 
  22:   let matches = 0;
  23:   let contextBonus = 0;
  24: 
  25:   // Correspondances exactes
  26:   queryWords.forEach(qWord => {
  27:     if (textWords.some(tWord => tWord.includes(qWord) || qWord.includes(tWord))) {
  28:       matches++;
  29:     }
  30:   });
  31: 
  32:   // Bonus contextuel pour termes juridiques
  33:   const legalTerms = {
  34:     'regulariser': ['titre', 'sejour', 'prefecture', 'oqtf'],
  35:     'naturalisation': ['francais', 'nationalite', 'citoyennete'],
  36:     'asile': ['protection', 'refugie', 'ofpra', 'cnda'],
  37:     'famille': ['regroupement', 'conjoint', 'enfant'],
  38:     'travail': ['salarie', 'emploi', 'autorisation']
  39:   };
  40: 
  41:   Object.entries(legalTerms).forEach(([term, related]) => {
  42:     if (query.toLowerCase().includes(term)) {
  43:       related.forEach(relatedTerm => {
  44:         if (text.toLowerCase().includes(relatedTerm)) {
  45:           contextBonus += 0.2;
  46:         }
  47:       });
  48:     }
  49:   });
  50: 
  51:   const baseScore = matches / Math.max(queryWords.length, 1);
  52:   return Math.min(baseScore + contextBonus, 1);
  53: }
  54: 
  55: // Analyser les patterns communs entre dossiers
  56: function analyzePatterns(dossiers: any[]) {
  57:   const patterns = {
  58:     documentsCommuns: new Map<string, number>(),
  59:     dureesMoyennes: new Map<string, number[]>(),
  60:     tauxReussite: new Map<string, { total: number, reussis: number }>()
  61:   };
  62: 
  63:   dossiers.forEach(dossier => {
  64:     const type = dossier.typeDossier;
  65: 
  66:     // Documents communs
  67:     dossier.documents.forEach((doc: any) => {
  68:       const key = `${type}:${doc.documentType || 'autre'}`;
  69:       patterns.documentsCommuns.set(key, (patterns.documentsCommuns.get(key) || 0) + 1);
  70:     });
  71: 
  72:     // DurÃ©es
  73:     if (dossier.dateCloture) {
  74:       const duree = Math.floor(
  75:         (new Date(dossier.dateCloture).getTime() - new Date(dossier.dateCreation).getTime())
  76:         / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
  77:       );
  78:       if (!patterns.dureesMoyennes.has(type)) {
  79:         patterns.dureesMoyennes.set(type, []);
  80:       }
  81:       patterns.dureesMoyennes.get(type)!.push(duree);
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     // Taux de rÃ©ussite
  85:     if (!patterns.tauxReussite.has(type)) {
  86:       patterns.tauxReussite.set(type, { total: 0, reussis: 0 });
  87:     }
  88:     const stats = patterns.tauxReussite.get(type)!;
  89:     stats.total++;
  90:     if (dossier.statut === 'termine') {
  91:       stats.reussis++;
  92:     }
  93:   });
  94: 
  95:   return {
  96:     documentsFrequents: Array.from(patterns.documentsCommuns.entries())
  97:       .sort(([,a], [,b]) => b - a)
  98:       .slice(0, 5)
  99:       .map(([key, count]) => {
 100:         const [type, docType] = key.split(':');
 101:         return { type, documentType: docType, frequency: count };
 102:       }),
 103: 
 104:     dureesMoyennes: Array.from(patterns.dureesMoyennes.entries())
 105:       .map(([type, durees]) => ({
 106:         type,
 107:         moyenneJours: Math.round(durees.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / durees.length),
 108:         min: Math.min(...durees),
 109:         max: Math.max(...durees)
 110:       })),
 111: 
 112:     tauxReussite: Array.from(patterns.tauxReussite.entries())
 113:       .map(([type, stats]) => ({
 114:         type,
 115:         taux: stats.total > 0 ? (stats.reussis / stats.total) * 100 : 0,
 116:         total: stats.total
 117:       }))
 118:   };
 119: }
 120: 
 121: export async function GET(
 122:   request: NextRequest,
 123:   { params }: SemanticSearchParams
 124: ) {
 125:   try {
 126:     const { tenantId } = params;
 127:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 128:     if (!session?.user) {
 129:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 130:     }
 131:     if ((session.user as any).tenantId !== tenantId) {
 132:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
 133:     }
 134:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
 135:     const query = searchParams.get('q') || '';
 136:     const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '10');
 137: 
 138:     if (!query.trim()) {
 139:       return NextResponse.json({
 140:         results: [],
 141:         patterns: null,
 142:         suggestions: [
 143:           'regulariser situation administrative',
 144:           'demande naturalisation francaise',
 145:           'recours OQTF prefecture',
 146:           'regroupement familial conjoint',
 147:           'renouvellement titre sejour'
 148:         ]
 149:       });
 150:     }
 151: 
 152:     // Rechercher dans les dossiers
 153:     const allDossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
 154:       where: { tenantId },
 155:       include: {
 156:         client: {
 157:           select: { firstName: true, lastName: true, email: true }
 158:         },
 159:         documents: {
 160:           select: { documentType: true, filename: true }
 161:         }
 162:       }
 163:     });
 164: 
 165:     // Calculer la similaritÃ© pour chaque dossier
 166:     const results = allDossiers.map(dossier => {
 167:       const searchText = [
 168:         dossier.typeDossier,
 169:         dossier.objet || '',
 170:         dossier.description || '',
 171:         dossier.notes || '',
 172:         dossier.client.firstName,
 173:         dossier.client.lastName,
 174:         dossier.articleCeseda || '',
 175:         dossier.categorieJuridique || ''
 176:       ].join(' ');
 177: 
 178:       const similarity = calculateCosineSimilarity(query, searchText);
 179: 
 180:       return {
 181:         dossier: {
 182:           id: dossier.id,
 183:           numero: dossier.numero,
 184:           typeDossier: dossier.typeDossier,
 185:           objet: dossier.objet,
 186:           statut: dossier.statut,
 187:           priorite: dossier.priorite,
 188:           dateCreation: dossier.dateCreation,
 189:           dateEcheance: dossier.dateEcheance,
 190:           client: dossier.client,
 191:           documentCount: dossier.documents.length
 192:         },
 193:         similarity: Math.round(similarity * 100),
 194:         matchedFields: [] // Simplification pour cette version
 195:       };
 196:     })
 197:     .filter(result => result.similarity > 20) // Seuil minimum de 20%
 198:     .sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity)
 199:     .slice(0, limit);
 200: 
 201:     // Analyser les patterns si on a des rÃ©sultats
 202:     let patterns: ReturnType<typeof analyzePatterns> | null = null;
 203:     if (results.length > 0) {
 204:       const similarDossiers = allDossiers.filter(d =>
 205:         results.some(r => r.dossier.id === d.id)
 206:       );
 207:       patterns = analyzePatterns(similarDossiers);

src\app\api\test-email\route.ts

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   5: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   6: import { emailMonitor } from '@/lib/email/email-monitor-service';
   7: 
   8: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   9:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  10: 
  11:   if (!session?.user) {
  12:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  13:   }
  14: 
  15:   const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  16:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  17:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  18:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  19:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  20:   }
  21: 
  22:   if (!tenantId) {
  23:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 400 });
  24:   }
  25: 
  26:   try {
  27:     const { from, subject, body } = await req.json();
  28: 
  29:     if (!from || !subject || !body) {
  30:       return NextResponse.json({
  31:         error: 'Champs requis: from, subject, body'
  32:       }, { status: 400 });
  33:     }
  34: 
  35:     const rawEmail = `From: ${from}\nSubject: ${subject}\n\n${body}`;
  36:     const result = await emailMonitor.processEmail(tenantId, rawEmail);
  37: 
  38:     return NextResponse.json({
  39:       success: true,
  40:       ...result,
  41:       message: result.action === 'created'
  42:         ? `âœ… Nouveau dossier ${result.dossierId} crÃ©Ã©`
  43:         : result.action === 'linked'
  44:         ? `âœ… Email liÃ© au dossier ${result.dossierId}`
  45:         : 'âš ï¸ Email enregistrÃ©, action manuelle requise'
  46:     });
  47: 
  48:   } catch (error) {
  49:     logger.error('Erreur test email:', { error });
  50:     return NextResponse.json({
  51:       error: 'Erreur serveur'
  52:     }, { status: 500 });
  53:   }
  54: }

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: /api/time-entries
   3:  * 
   4:  * CRUD complet pour le suivi du temps (time tracking).
   5:  * GET: liste les entrÃ©es (filtrage par dossier, date, user)
   6:  * POST: crÃ©er une entrÃ©e de temps
   7:  * PATCH: modifier une entrÃ©e
   8:  * DELETE: supprimer une entrÃ©e
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  12: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  13: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  14: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  15: import { z } from 'zod';
  16: 
  17: const createTimeEntrySchema = z.object({
  18:   dossierId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  19:   clientId: z.string().uuid().optional(),
  20:   description: z.string().min(1, 'Description requise').max(500),
  21:   date: z.string().optional(), // ISO date
  22:   startTime: z.string().optional(), // ISO datetime
  23:   endTime: z.string().optional(),
  24:   duration: z.number().min(1, 'DurÃ©e minimum 1 minute'), // en minutes
  25:   tarifHoraire: z.number().min(0).optional(),
  26:   isBillable: z.boolean().optional(),
  27:   category: z.enum(['travail', 'audience', 'rdv', 'deplacement', 'recherche', 'admin', 'telephone', 'correspondance']).optional(),
  28: });
  29: 
  30: const patchTimeEntrySchema = createTimeEntrySchema.partial().extend({
  31:   id: z.string().uuid(),
  32:   isBilled: z.boolean().optional(),
  33: });
  34: 
  35: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  36:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  37:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  38: 
  39:   const user = session.user as any;
  40:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  41:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
  42: 
  43:   const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  44:   const dossierId = searchParams.get('dossierId');
  45:   const clientId = searchParams.get('clientId');
  46:   const from = searchParams.get('from');
  47:   const to = searchParams.get('to');
  48:   const billableOnly = searchParams.get('billable') === 'true';
  49:   const unbilledOnly = searchParams.get('unbilled') === 'true';
  50: 
  51:   const where: any = { tenantId };
  52:   if (dossierId) where.dossierId = dossierId;
  53:   if (clientId) where.clientId = clientId;
  54:   if (billableOnly) where.isBillable = true;
  55:   if (unbilledOnly) { where.isBillable = true; where.isBilled = false; }
  56:   if (from || to) {
  57:     where.date = {};
  58:     if (from) where.date.gte = new Date(from);
  59:     if (to) where.date.lte = new Date(to);
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   const entries = await prisma.timeEntry.findMany({
  63:     where,
  64:     include: {
  65:       Dossier: { select: { numero: true, objet: true } },
  66:       Client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
  67:       User: { select: { name: true } },
  68:     },
  69:     orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
  70:     take: 200,
  71:   });
  72: 
  73:   // Calculs agrÃ©gÃ©s
  74:   const totalMinutes = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.duration, 0);
  75:   const totalBillable = entries.filter(e => e.isBillable).reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.duration, 0);
  76:   const totalMontant = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.montant || 0), 0);
  77:   const unbilledMontant = entries.filter(e => e.isBillable && !e.isBilled).reduce((sum, e) => sum + (e.montant || 0), 0);
  78: 
  79:   return NextResponse.json({
  80:     entries,
  81:     stats: {
  82:       totalEntries: entries.length,
  83:       totalMinutes,
  84:       totalHours: Math.round(totalMinutes / 6) / 10, // 1 decimal
  85:       totalBillableMinutes: totalBillable,
  86:       totalBillableHours: Math.round(totalBillable / 6) / 10,
  87:       totalMontant: Math.round(totalMontant * 100) / 100,
  88:       unbilledMontant: Math.round(unbilledMontant * 100) / 100,
  89:     },
  90:   });
  91: }
  92: 
  93: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  94:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  95:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  96: 
  97:   const user = session.user as any;
  98:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
  99:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
 100: 
 101:   let body: Record<string, unknown>;
 102:   try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
 103:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
 104:   }
 105: 
 106:   const parsed = createTimeEntrySchema.safeParse(body);
 107:   if (!parsed.success) {
 108:     return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message }, { status: 400 });
 109:   }
 110: 
 111:   const data = parsed.data;
 112:   const montant = data.tarifHoraire ? (data.duration / 60) * data.tarifHoraire : undefined;
 113: 
 114:   const entry = await prisma.timeEntry.create({
 115:     data: {
 116:       tenantId,
 117:       userId: user.id,
 118:       dossierId: data.dossierId || undefined,
 119:       clientId: data.clientId || undefined,
 120:       description: data.description,
 121:       date: data.date ? new Date(data.date) : new Date(),
 122:       startTime: data.startTime ? new Date(data.startTime) : undefined,
 123:       endTime: data.endTime ? new Date(data.endTime) : undefined,
 124:       duration: data.duration,
 125:       tarifHoraire: data.tarifHoraire || undefined,
 126:       montant,
 127:       isBillable: data.isBillable ?? true,
 128:       category: data.category || 'travail',
 129:     },
 130:   });
 131: 
 132:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, entry }, { status: 201 });
 133: }
 134: 
 135: export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
 136:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 137:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 138: 
 139:   const user = session.user as any;
 140:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
 141:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
 142: 
 143:   let body: Record<string, unknown>;
 144:   try { body = await req.json(); } catch {
 145:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
 146:   }
 147: 
 148:   const parsed = patchTimeEntrySchema.safeParse(body);
 149:   if (!parsed.success) {
 150:     return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.errors[0]?.message }, { status: 400 });
 151:   }
 152: 
 153:   const { id, ...updateData } = parsed.data;
 154: 
 155:   // VÃ©rifier ownership
 156:   const existing = await prisma.timeEntry.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });
 157:   if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'EntrÃ©e non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
 158: 
 159:   // Recalculer le montant si durÃ©e ou tarif changent
 160:   const duration = updateData.duration || existing.duration;
 161:   const tarif = updateData.tarifHoraire ?? existing.tarifHoraire;
 162:   const montant = tarif ? (duration / 60) * tarif : existing.montant;
 163: 
 164:   const updated = await prisma.timeEntry.update({
 165:     where: { id },
 166:     data: {
 167:       ...updateData,
 168:       ...(updateData.date ? { date: new Date(updateData.date) } : {}),
 169:       ...(updateData.startTime ? { startTime: new Date(updateData.startTime) } : {}),
 170:       ...(updateData.endTime ? { endTime: new Date(updateData.endTime) } : {}),
 171:       montant,
 172:     },
 173:   });
 174: 
 175:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, entry: updated });
 176: }
 177: 
 178: export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
 179:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 180:   if (!session?.user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 181: 
 182:   const user = session.user as any;
 183:   const tenantId = user.tenantId;
 184:   if (!tenantId) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant requis' }, { status: 403 });
 185: 
 186:   const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
 187:   const id = searchParams.get('id');
 188:   if (!id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'id requis' }, { status: 400 });
 189: 
 190:   const existing = await prisma.timeEntry.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId } });
 191:   if (!existing) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'EntrÃ©e non trouvÃ©e' }, { status: 404 });
 192:   if (existing.isBilled) {
 193:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de supprimer une entrÃ©e dÃ©jÃ  facturÃ©e' }, { status: 400 });
 194:   }
 195: 
 196:   await prisma.timeEntry.delete({ where: { id } });
 197:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
 198: }

  10: // Utilisation dynamique de l'adaptateur Prisma pour Ã©viter les erreurs de type au build
  11: 
  12: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  13:   try {
  14:     const body = await request.json();
  15:     const {
  16:       email,
  17:       firstName,
  18:       lastName,
  19:       caseTitle,
  20:       docName,
  21:       docContentBase64,
  22:       mode = 'dry-run',
  23:       threshold = 0.8,

  32:     const nameSimilarity = similarityRatio(normalized, normalized);

  34:     const docHash = buf ? sha256(buf) : null;
  35: 
  36:     if (mode === 'commit') {
  37:       if (!caseTitle || !docName || !buf) {
  38:         return NextResponse.json(
  39:           { error: 'caseTitle, docName et docContentBase64 sont requis en mode commit' },
  40:           { status: 400 }
  41:         );

  44:       const repo = new repoModule.PrismaDedupRepository();
  45:       const client = await identifyOrCreateClient(
  46:         repo,
  47:         email ?? null,
  48:         String(firstName),
  49:         String(lastName),
  50:         Number(threshold)
  51:       );
  52:       const k = await associateCase(repo, client, String(caseTitle));
  53:       const res = await ingestDocument(repo, k, String(docName), buf);
  54:       return NextResponse.json({
  55:         ok: true,
  56:         mode,
  57:         normalizedName: normalized,
  58:         nameSimilarity,
  59:         documentHash: docHash,
  60:         clientId: client.id,
  61:         caseId: k.id,
  62:         documentId: res.doc.id,
  63:         created: res.created,
  64:       });
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     // Default: dry-run result
  68:     return NextResponse.json({
  69:       ok: true,
  70:       mode: 'dry-run',
  71:       normalizedName: normalized,
  72:       nameSimilarity,
  73:       documentHash: docHash,
  74:     });
  75:   } catch (err: any) {
  76:     return NextResponse.json({ error: err?.message ?? 'Unexpected error' }, { status: 500 });
  77:   }

src\app\api\tribunal-stats\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   2: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   3: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   4: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   5: 
   6: /**
   7:  * GET /api/tribunal-stats
   8:  * Retourne les taux de succÃ¨s anonymisÃ©s par juridiction et type de dossier.
   9:  * DonnÃ©es agrÃ©gÃ©es cross-tenant â€” aucune donnÃ©e individuelle exposÃ©e.
  10:  * Minimum 5 dossiers par catÃ©gorie pour Ã©viter la rÃ©-identification.
  11:  */
  12: export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  13:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  14:   if (!session?.user) {
  15:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  16:   }
  17: 
  18:   const juridiction = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('juridiction');
  19:   const typeDossier = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('typeDossier');
  20:   const typeRecours = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('typeRecours');
  21: 
  22:   const where: any = {
  23:     outcome: { not: null },
  24:   };
  25:   if (juridiction) where.juridiction = juridiction;
  26:   if (typeDossier) where.typeDossier = typeDossier;
  27:   if (typeRecours) where.typeRecours = typeRecours;
  28: 
  29:   // AgrÃ©gation par juridiction
  30:   const byJuridiction = await prisma.dossier.groupBy({
  31:     by: ['juridiction', 'outcome'],
  32:     where: { ...where, juridiction: { not: null } },
  33:     _count: true,
  34:   });
  35: 
  36:   // AgrÃ©gation par type de dossier
  37:   const byType = await prisma.dossier.groupBy({
  38:     by: ['typeDossier', 'outcome'],
  39:     where,
  40:     _count: true,
  41:   });
  42: 
  43:   // AgrÃ©gation par type de recours
  44:   const byRecours = await prisma.dossier.groupBy({
  45:     by: ['typeRecours', 'outcome'],
  46:     where: { ...where, typeRecours: { not: null } },
  47:     _count: true,
  48:   });
  49: 
  50:   // Transformer en taux de succÃ¨s (minimum 5 dossiers pour anonymisation)
  51:   const MIN_SAMPLE = 5;
  52: 
  53:   const computeStats = (groups: any[], key: string) => {
  54:     const map: Record<string, { favorable: number; defavorable: number; total: number }> = {};
  55: 
  56:     for (const g of groups) {
  57:       const name = g[key] || 'Inconnu';
  58:       if (!map[name]) map[name] = { favorable: 0, defavorable: 0, total: 0 };
  59:       map[name].total += g._count;
  60:       if (g.outcome === 'favorable') map[name].favorable += g._count;
  61:       else if (g.outcome === 'defavorable') map[name].defavorable += g._count;
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     return Object.entries(map)
  65:       .filter(([, v]) => v.total >= MIN_SAMPLE)
  66:       .map(([name, v]) => ({
  67:         name,
  68:         tauxSucces: Math.round((v.favorable / v.total) * 100),
  69:         total: v.total,
  70:         favorable: v.favorable,
  71:         defavorable: v.defavorable,
  72:       }))
  73:       .sort((a, b) => b.tauxSucces - a.tauxSucces);
  74:   };
  75: 
  76:   const stats = {
  77:     parJuridiction: computeStats(byJuridiction, 'juridiction'),
  78:     parTypeDossier: computeStats(byType, 'typeDossier'),
  79:     parTypeRecours: computeStats(byRecours, 'typeRecours'),
  80:     metadata: {
  81:       minSample: MIN_SAMPLE,
  82:       lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
  83:       note: 'DonnÃ©es anonymisÃ©es et agrÃ©gÃ©es. Minimum 5 dossiers par catÃ©gorie.',
  84:     },
  85:   };
  86: 
  87:   return NextResponse.json(stats);
  88: }

  31: async function structureTranscript(transcript: string, context?: string): Promise<any> {
  32:   const ollamaUrl = process.env.OLLAMA_URL;
  33: 
  34:   if (ollamaUrl) {
  35:     try {
  36:       const prompt = `Tu es un assistant juridique. Structure cette dictee vocale d'un avocat en notes organisees.
  37: ${context ? `Contexte du dossier: ${context}` : ''}
  38: 
  39: Dictee: "${transcript}"
  40: 
  41: Retourne un JSON avec: { "resume": "...", "pointsCles": ["..."], "actions": ["..."], "datesMentionnees": ["..."], "personnesMentionnees": ["..."] }`;
  42: 
  43:       const response = await fetch(`${ollamaUrl}/api/generate`, {
  44:         method: 'POST',
  45:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  46:         body: JSON.stringify({
  47:           model: process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.2:latest',
  48:           prompt,
  49:           stream: false,
  50:           format: 'json',
  51:         }),
  52:       });
  53: 
  54:       if (response.ok) {
  55:         const data = await response.json();
  56:         try { return JSON.parse(data.response); } catch { /* fallback */ }
  57:       }
  58:     } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  59:   }
  60: 
  61:   // Fallback: structuration basique par regex
  62:   return fallbackStructure(transcript);
  63: }
  64: 
  65: function fallbackStructure(transcript: string): any {
  66:   const sentences = transcript.split(/[.!?]+/).filter(s => s.trim().length > 5);
  67: 
  68:   const actions = sentences.filter(s =>
  69:     /faire|envoyer|appeler|deposer|preparer|verifier|contacter|relancer/i.test(s)
  70:   ).map(s => s.trim());
  71: 
  72:   const dates = transcript.match(/\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{2,4}|lundi|mardi|mercredi|jeudi|vendredi|demain|la semaine prochaine/gi) || [];
  73: 
  74:   const personnes = transcript.match(/(?:monsieur|madame|maitre|m\.|mme)\s+[A-Z][a-z]+/gi) || [];
  75: 
  76:   return {
  77:     resume: sentences.slice(0, 2).join('. ').trim() + '.',
  78:     pointsCles: sentences.slice(0, 5).map(s => s.trim()),
  79:     actions: actions.length > 0 ? actions : ['Aucune action detectee'],
  80:     datesMentionnees: [...new Set(dates)],
  81:     personnesMentionnees: [...new Set(personnes)],
  82:   };
  83: }

  15: const CHANNEL_MAP: Record<string, ChannelType> = {
  16:   email: 'EMAIL',
  17:   whatsapp: 'WHATSAPP',
  18:   sms: 'SMS',
  19:   voice: 'VOICE',
  20:   slack: 'SLACK',
  21:   teams: 'TEAMS',
  22:   linkedin: 'LINKEDIN',
  23:   twitter: 'TWITTER',

  30: function parseWebhookPayload(rawBody: string, channel: ChannelType): Record<string, unknown> {
  31:   if (channel === 'SMS' || channel === 'VOICE') {
  32:     return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(rawBody));
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   return JSON.parse(rawBody) as Record<string, unknown>;
  36: }
  37: 
  38: function verifyTwilioSignature(rawBody: string, signature: string, authToken: string): boolean {
  39:   const webhookUrl = process.env.TWILIO_WEBHOOK_URL;
  40:   if (!webhookUrl) return false;
  41: 
  42:   const params = new URLSearchParams(rawBody);
  43:   let canonicalPayload = webhookUrl;
  44:   for (const key of Array.from(new Set(params.keys())).sort()) {
  45:     for (const value of params.getAll(key).sort()) canonicalPayload += `${key}${value}`;
  46:   }
  47: 
  48:   return safeEqual(
  49:     signature,
  50:     createHmac('sha1', authToken).update(canonicalPayload, 'utf8').digest('base64')
  51:   );
  52: }

  63:   const { channel: channelPath } = await params;

  80:     if (!authResult.valid) {
  81:       await auditService.log({
  82:         action: 'WEBHOOK_AUTH_FAILED',

  89:         userAgent,
  90:       });
  91:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Authentification webhook invalide' }, { status: 401 });
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     const payload = parseWebhookPayload(rawBody, channelType);
  95: 
  96:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer la signature selon le canal
  97:     const signature = getSignature(headersList, channelType);
  98:

 120:         processingTime: Date.now() - startTime,
 121:         hasAttachments: message.attachments.length > 0,

 123:       ipAddress,
 124:       userAgent,

 126:

 155: /**
 156:  * GET /api/webhooks/channel/[channel]
 157:  * VÃ©rification webhook (challenge)
 158:  */
 159: export async function GET(
 160:   request: NextRequest,
 161:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ channel: string }> }
 162: ) {
 163:   const { channel: channelPath } = await params;
 164:   const url = new URL(request.url);
 165: 
 166:   // WhatsApp/Meta verification
 167:   const mode = url.searchParams.get('hub.mode');
 168:   const token = url.searchParams.get('hub.verify_token');
 169:   const challenge = url.searchParams.get('hub.challenge');
 170: 
 171:   if (mode === 'subscribe' && token === process.env.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN) {
 172:     return new NextResponse(challenge, { status: 200 });
 173:   }
 174: 
 175:   // Slack challenge
 176:   const slackChallenge = url.searchParams.get('challenge');
 177:   if (slackChallenge) {
 178:     return NextResponse.json({ challenge: slackChallenge });
 179:   }
 180: 
 181:   // SantÃ© du webhook
 182:   return NextResponse.json({
 183:     status: 'active',
 184:     channel: channelPath,
 185:     timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 186:   });
 187: }
 188: 
 189: /**
 190:  * Valider l'authentification webhook selon le canal
 191:  */
 192: async function validateWebhookAuth(
 193:   rawBody: string,
 194:   channel: ChannelType,
 195:   headersList: Headers
 196: ): Promise<{ valid: boolean; reason?: string }> {
 197:   const secret = process.env[`CHANNEL_${channel}_SECRET`];
 198: 
 199:   // En mode dev uniquement, secret optionnel.
 200:   if (!secret && process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
 201:     return { valid: true };
 202:   }
 203: 
 204:   // En production, un secret par canal est requis.
 205:   if (!secret) {
 206:     return { valid: false, reason: `Missing channel secret for ${channel}` };
 207:   }
 208: 
 209:   switch (channel) {
 210:     case 'WHATSAPP':
 211:       const waSignature = headersList.get('x-hub-signature-256');
 212:       if (!waSignature) return { valid: false, reason: 'Missing signature' };
 213:       return verifyHmacSha256(rawBody, waSignature, secret, 'sha256=')
 214:         ? { valid: true }
 215:         : { valid: false, reason: 'Invalid signature' };
 216:

   1: // @ts-nocheck

   7: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
   8:   try {
   9:     const body = await req.json();
  10: 
  11:     // VÃ©rifier le secret webhook

  20:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     // Extraire les donnÃ©es selon le provider

  44:     logger.error('Erreur webhook email', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  45:       route: '/api/webhooks/email',
