   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import crypto from 'crypto';
   4: import { encryptEmailBody } from '@/lib/security/email-encryption';
   5: import { getClientIP, checkRateLimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit';
   6: import { z } from 'zod';
   7: 
   8: const inboundEmailSchema = z.object({
   9:   from: z.string().min(1).max(320),
  10:   to: z.string().max(320).optional(),
  11:   subject: z.string().max(998).optional(),
  12:   body: z.string().min(1).max(1_000_000),
  13:   html: z.string().max(2_000_000).optional(),
  14:   date: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  15:   messageId: z.string().max(998).optional(),
  16:   tenantId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
  17: });
  18: 
  19: /**
  20:  * Webhook pour recevoir des emails forwardÃ©s.
  21:  * Compatible avec:
  22:  * - Gmail forwarding (via Google Apps Script ou Zapier)
  23:  * - Outlook Power Automate
  24:  * - SendGrid Inbound Parse
  25:  * - Mailgun Routes
  26:  * - Forward direct (POST JSON)
  27:  */
  28: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  29:   // Auth par webhook secret
  30:   const secret = req.headers.get('x-webhook-secret') || req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('secret');
  31:   const expectedSecret = process.env.EMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  32:   if (!expectedSecret) {
  33:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   const validSecret =
  37:     !!secret &&
  38:     secret.length === expectedSecret.length &&
  39:     crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(secret), Buffer.from(expectedSecret));
  40:   if (!validSecret) {
  41:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  42:   }
  43: 
  44:   const rateLimit = await checkRateLimit(getClientIP(req), 'webhook');
  45:   if (!rateLimit.success) {
  46:     return NextResponse.json(
  47:       { error: 'Too many requests' },
  48:       { status: 429, headers: { 'Retry-After': String(Math.ceil((rateLimit.reset.getTime() - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
  49:     );
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   const contentType = req.headers.get('content-type') || '';
  53:   let emailData: unknown;
  54: 
  55:   if (contentType.includes('multipart/form-data')) {
  56:     // SendGrid Inbound Parse format
  57:     const formData = await req.formData();
  58:     emailData = {
  59:       from: formData.get('from') as string || '',
  60:       to: formData.get('to') as string || '',
  61:       subject: formData.get('subject') as string || '',
  62:       body: formData.get('text') as string || '',
  63:       html: formData.get('html') as string || '',
  64:       messageId: formData.get('Message-ID') as string || undefined,
  65:     };
  66:   } else {
  67:     // JSON format (Gmail Apps Script, Power Automate, direct)
  68:     try {
  69:       emailData = await req.json();
  70:     } catch {
  71:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' }, { status: 400 });
  72:     }
  73:   }
  74: 
  75:   const parsedEmail = inboundEmailSchema.safeParse(emailData);
  76:   if (!parsedEmail.success) {
  77:     return NextResponse.json(
  78:       { error: 'Payload invalide', details: parsedEmail.error.flatten().fieldErrors },
  79:       { status: 400 }
  80:     );
  81:   }
  82:   const validatedEmail = parsedEmail.data;
  83: 
  84:   // DÃ©terminer le tenant (par le "to" address ou header)
  85:   const tenantId = validatedEmail.tenantId || await resolveTenant(validatedEmail.to);
  86:   if (!tenantId) {
  87:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non rÃ©solu. Ajoutez tenantId ou configurez le routage.' }, { status: 400 });
  88:   }
  89: 
  90:   // DÃ©duplication par checksum
  91:   const checksum = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(`${validatedEmail.messageId || ''}${validatedEmail.from}${validatedEmail.subject || ''}${validatedEmail.body.slice(0, 500)}`).digest('hex');
  92: 
  93:   const existing = await prisma.email.findFirst({ where: { tenantId, checksum } });
  94:   if (existing) {
  95:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, duplicate: true, emailId: existing.id });
  96:   }
  97: 
  98:   // CrÃ©er l'email (chiffrement at-rest)
  99:   const { body: storedBody, bodyEncrypted, htmlBody: storedHtml, htmlBodyEncrypted } = encryptEmailBody(
 100:     validatedEmail.body,
 101:     validatedEmail.html || null
 102:   );
 103: 
 104:   const email = await prisma.email.create({
 105:     data: {
 106:       tenantId,
 107:       from: validatedEmail.from,
 108:       to: validatedEmail.to || '',
 109:       subject: validatedEmail.subject || '(sans objet)',
 110:       body: storedBody,
 111:       bodyEncrypted,
 112:       htmlBody: storedHtml,
 113:       htmlBodyEncrypted,
 114:       messageId: validatedEmail.messageId || null,
 115:       checksum,
 116:       direction: 'INCOMING',
 117:       status: 'PENDING',
 118:       receivedAt: validatedEmail.date ? new Date(validatedEmail.date) : new Date(),
 119:     },
 120:   });
 121: 
 122:   // Lancer l'analyse IA en arriÃ¨re-plan (fire-and-forget)
 123:   analyzeEmailAsync(email.id, validatedEmail.subject || '', validatedEmail.body, validatedEmail.from).catch(() => {});
 124: 
 125:   // Horodatage certifiÃ© RFC 3161 (preuve tierce de la date de rÃ©ception)
 126:   import('@/lib/services/certified-timestamp').then(({ certifyEmailReception }) => {
 127:     certifyEmailReception({
 128:       tenantId,
 129:       userId: 'system',
 130:       emailId: email.id,
 131:       emailHash: checksum,
 132:     }).catch(() => {});
 133:   }).catch(() => {});
 134: 
 135:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, emailId: email.id });
 136: }
 137: 
 138: async function resolveTenant(toAddress?: string): Promise<string | null> {
 139:   if (!toAddress) return null;
 140:   // Chercher un tenant dont l'email de rÃ©ception matche
 141:   const match = toAddress.match(/([^<\s]+@[^>\s]+)/);
 142:   if (!match) return null;
 143: 
 144:   const tenant = await prisma.tenant.findFirst({
 145:     where: { OR: [{ email: match[1] }, { inboundEmail: match[1] }] },
 146:     select: { id: true },
 147:   });
 148:   return tenant?.id || null;
 149: }

 151: async function analyzeEmailAsync(emailId: string, subject: string, body: string, from: string) {
 152:   try {
 153:     const baseUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
 154:     const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/ai/summarize-email`, {
 155:       method: 'POST',
 156:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-internal': 'true' },
 157:       body: JSON.stringify({ subject, body, from }),
 158:     });
 159:     if (res.ok) {
 160:       const summary = await res.json();
 161:       await prisma.email.update({
 162:         where: { id: emailId },
 163:         data: { aiSummary: JSON.stringify(summary), aiAnalyzedAt: new Date() },
 164:       });
 165:     }
 166:   } catch {}
 167: }

src\app\api\webhooks\github\route.ts

   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * Verifie la signature HMAC SHA256 du webhook GitHub
   7:  */
   8: function verifySignature(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
   9:   const expectedSignature = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', secret)
  10:     .update(payload)
  11:     .digest('hex');
  12: 
  13:   try {
  14:     return timingSafeEqual(
  15:       Buffer.from(signature),
  16:       Buffer.from(expectedSignature)
  17:     );
  18:   } catch {
  19:     return false;
  20:   }
  21: }
  22: 
  23: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  24:   try {
  25:     const signature = request.headers.get('x-hub-signature-256');
  26:     const event = request.headers.get('x-github-event');
  27:     const delivery = request.headers.get('x-github-delivery');
  28: 
  29:     if (!signature || !event) {
  30:       logger.warn('Webhook GitHub sans signature/event', { hasSignature: !!signature, event });
  31:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing headers' }, { status: 400 });
  32:     }
  33: 
  34:     const rawBody = await request.text();
  35:     const secret = process.env.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  36: 
  37:     if (!secret) {
  38:       logger.error('GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET non configure');
  39:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Webhook not configured' }, { status: 500 });
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     if (!verifySignature(rawBody, signature, secret)) {
  43:       logger.error('Signature webhook GitHub invalide', { event, delivery });
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 401 });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  48: 
  49:     logger.info('Webhook GitHub recu', {
  50:       event,
  51:       delivery,
  52:       repository: payload.repository?.full_name,
  53:       sender: payload.sender?.login
  54:     });
  55: 
  56:     // Traitement selon le type d'evenement
  57:     switch (event) {
  58:       case 'push':
  59:         logger.info('Push GitHub', {
  60:           repository: payload.repository?.full_name,
  61:           branch: payload.ref?.replace('refs/heads/', ''),
  62:           commits: payload.commits?.length
  63:         });
  64:         break;
  65: 
  66:       case 'pull_request':
  67:         logger.info('Pull Request GitHub', {
  68:           action: payload.action,
  69:           number: payload.pull_request?.number,
  70:           title: payload.pull_request?.title
  71:         });
  72:         break;
  73: 
  74:       case 'issues':
  75:         logger.info('Issue GitHub', {
  76:           action: payload.action,
  77:           number: payload.issue?.number,
  78:           title: payload.issue?.title,
  79:           labels: payload.issue?.labels?.map((l: any) => l.name)
  80:         });
  81:         break;
  82: 
  83:       case 'ping':
  84:         logger.debug('Webhook GitHub ping recu', { zen: payload.zen });
  85:         break;
  86: 
  87:       default:
  88:         logger.debug('evenement GitHub non gere', { event });
  89:     }
  90: 
  91:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true, event, delivery });
  92:   } catch (error) {
  93:     logger.error('Erreur traitement webhook GitHub', { error });
  94:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Server error' }, { status: 500 });
  95:   }
  96: }
  97: 
  98: export async function GET() {
  99:   if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
 100:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Not Found' }, { status: 404 });
 101:   }
 102: 
 103:   return NextResponse.json({
 104:     status: 'active',
 105:     supported_events: ['push', 'pull_request', 'issues', 'ping']
 106:   });
 107: }

src\app\api\webhooks\inbox\route.ts

   1: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   2: import { createHash, createHmac, randomUUID, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
   3: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   4: import { z } from 'zod';
   5: 
   6: const inboxPayloadSchema = z.object({
   7:   to: z.string().trim().min(1).max(320),
   8:   from: z.string().trim().min(1).max(320),
   9:   subject: z.string().trim().max(998).default(''),
  10:   body: z.string().max(1_000_000).optional(),
  11:   attachments: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string().trim().max(255) }).passthrough()).default([]),
  12: });
  13: 
  14: function safeEqual(actual: string, expected: string): boolean {
  15:   const actualBuffer = Buffer.from(actual);
  16:   const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected);
  17:   return actualBuffer.length === expectedBuffer.length && timingSafeEqual(actualBuffer, expectedBuffer);
  18: }
  19: 
  20: /**
  21:  * POST /api/webhooks/inbox
  22:  * Recoit les emails envoyes a [dossier]@inbox.memolib.space.
  23:  * The sender signs the raw request and supplies an immutable delivery ID.
  24:  */
  25: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  26:   const secret = process.env.INBOX_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  27:   if (!secret) {
  28:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service webhook indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  29:   }
  30: 
  31:   const eventId = req.headers.get('x-webhook-id');
  32:   if (!eventId || eventId.length > 255) {
  33:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Identifiant dâ€™Ã©vÃ©nement requis' }, { status: 400 });
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   const rawBody = await req.text();
  37:   const signature = req.headers.get('x-webhook-signature');
  38:   const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(rawBody, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  39:   if (!signature || !safeEqual(signature, `sha256=${expected}`)) {
  40:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
  41:   }
  42: 
  43:   let body: unknown;
  44:   try {
  45:     body = JSON.parse(rawBody);
  46:   } catch {
  47:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload JSON invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  48:   }
  49: 
  50:   const payload = inboxPayloadSchema.safeParse(body);
  51:   if (!payload.success) {
  52:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Payload invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  53:   }
  54: 
  55:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  56:     where: { inboxEmail: payload.data.to },
  57:     select: { id: true, tenantId: true },
  58:   });
  59:   if (!dossier) {
  60:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Dossier non trouvÃ© pour cet email' }, { status: 404 });
  61:   }
  62: 
  63:   const checksum = createHash('sha256').update(`${dossier.id}:${eventId}`, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  64:   const checklistItems = await prisma.dossierChecklistItem.findMany({
  65:     where: { dossierId: dossier.id, tenantId: dossier.tenantId },
  66:   });
  67:   const matchedItem = matchDocumentToChecklist(
  68:     payload.data.subject,
  69:     payload.data.attachments,
  70:     checklistItems
  71:   );
  72: 
  73:   try {
  74:     const result = await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
  75:       // ChannelMessage.checksum is unique and is the canonical durable
  76:       // idempotency boundary shared with the multichannel webhook pipeline.
  77:       await tx.channelMessage.create({
  78:         data: {
  79:           id: randomUUID(),
  80:           tenantId: dossier.tenantId,
  81:           externalId: eventId,
  82:           checksum,
  83:           channel: 'EMAIL',
  84:           direction: 'INBOUND',
  85:           status: 'PROCESSED',
  86:           senderData: { from: payload.data.from },
  87:           recipientData: { to: payload.data.to },
  88:           subject: payload.data.subject || null,
  89:           body: '',
  90:           channelMetadata: { source: 'inbox-webhook' },
  91:           consentStatus: 'PENDING',
  92:           auditTrail: [],
  93:           dossierId: dossier.id,
  94:         },
  95:       });
  96: 
  97:       if (!matchedItem) {
  98:         await tx.auditLog.create({
  99:           data: {
 100:             id: randomUUID(),
 101:             tenantId: dossier.tenantId,
 102:             userId: 'SYSTEM',
 103:             userEmail: 'system@memolib.local',
 104:             userRole: 'SYSTEM',
 105:             action: 'UPDATE',
 106:             entityType: 'INBOX_WEBHOOK',
 107:             entityId: eventId,
 108:             details: { matched: false, dossierId: dossier.id },
 109:           },
 110:         });
 111:         return { matched: null, received: 0, total: checklistItems.length, complete: false };
 112:       }
 113: 
 114:       await tx.dossierChecklistItem.update({
 115:         where: { id: matchedItem.id },
 116:         data: {
 117:           status: 'received',
 118:           receivedAt: new Date(),
 119:           receivedVia: 'email',
 120:         },
 121:       });
 122: 
 123:       const allItems = await tx.dossierChecklistItem.findMany({
 124:         where: { dossierId: dossier.id, tenantId: dossier.tenantId },
 125:       });
 126:       const received = allItems.filter(item => item.status === 'received' || item.status === 'validated').length;
 127:       const requiredItems = allItems.filter(item => item.required);
 128:       const complete =
 129:         requiredItems.length > 0 &&
 130:         requiredItems.every(item => item.status === 'received' || item.status === 'validated');
 131: 
 132:       await tx.dossier.update({
 133:         where: { id: dossier.id },
 134:         data: { checklistReceived: received, checklistComplete: complete },
 135:       });
 136:       await tx.auditLog.create({
 137:         data: {
 138:           id: randomUUID(),
 139:           tenantId: dossier.tenantId,
 140:           userId: 'SYSTEM',
 141:           userEmail: 'system@memolib.local',
 142:           userRole: 'SYSTEM',
 143:           action: 'UPDATE',
 144:           entityType: 'DOSSIER_CHECKLIST',
 145:           entityId: matchedItem.id,
 146:           details: { source: 'inbox-webhook', dossierId: dossier.id, eventId },
 147:         },
 148:       });
 149: 
 150:       return { matched: matchedItem.label, received, total: allItems.length, complete };
 151:     });
 152: 
 153:     return NextResponse.json({
 154:       success: true,
 155:       matched: result.matched,
 156:       progress: `${result.received}/${result.total}`,
 157:       complete: result.complete,
 158:     });
 159:   } catch (error) {
 160:     if (isUniqueConstraintError(error)) {
 161:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, duplicate: true });
 162:     }
 163:     throw error;
 164:   }
 165: }
 166: 
 167: function isUniqueConstraintError(error: unknown): boolean {
 168:   return typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'code' in error && error.code === 'P2002';
 169: }
 170: 
 171: function matchDocumentToChecklist(
 172:   subject: string,
 173:   attachments: Array<{ name: string }>,
 174:   items: Array<{ id: string; label: string; status: string }>
 175: ): { id: string; label: string } | null {
 176:   const combined = `${subject} ${attachments.map(attachment => attachment.name).join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
 177:   const keywords: Record<string, string[]> = {
 178:     passeport: ['passeport', 'passport', 'identite', 'id card'],
 179:     domicile: ['domicile', 'edf', 'electricite', 'quittance', 'loyer', 'hebergement'],
 180:     paie: ['paie', 'salaire', 'bulletin', 'fiche de paie'],
 181:     travail: ['contrat', 'travail', 'employeur', 'attestation employeur', 'cdi', 'cdd'],
 182:     imposition: ['imposition', 'impot', 'avis', 'fiscal'],
 183:     scolarite: ['scolarite', 'ecole', 'college', 'lycee', 'inscription'],
 184:     medical: ['medical', 'medecin', 'certificat medical', 'sante'],
 185:     naissance: ['naissance', 'acte de naissance', 'birth'],
 186:     mariage: ['mariage', 'acte de mariage'],
 187:     photo: ['photo', 'identite', 'portrait'],
 188:     oqtf: ['oqtf', 'obligation', 'quitter'],
 189:     recit: ['recit', 'vie', 'histoire', 'persecution'],
 190:     timbre: ['timbre', 'fiscal'],
 191:     assurance: ['assurance', 'maladie', 'securite sociale', 'cpam'],
 192:     casier: ['casier', 'judiciaire', 'criminal'],
 193:     diplome: ['diplome', 'b1', 'francais', 'delf', 'tcf'],
 194:   };
 195: 
 196:   for (const item of items.filter(candidate => candidate.status === 'missing')) {
 197:     const itemLabel = item.label.toLowerCase();
 198:     if (
 199:       Object.values(keywords).some(
 200:         terms => terms.some(term => itemLabel.includes(term)) && terms.some(term => combined.includes(term))
 201:       )
 202:     ) {
 203:       return item;
 204:     }
 205:   }
 206: 
 207:   return null;
 208: }

src\app\api\webhooks\route.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import crypto from 'crypto';
   3: import { headers } from 'next/headers';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   try {
   8:     const body = await request.text();
   9:     const headersList = await headers();
  10:     const signature = headersList.get('x-hub-signature-256');
  11: 
  12:     // Verifier la signature webhook GitHub
  13:     const secret = process.env.WEBHOOK_SECRET;
  14:     if (!secret || !signature || !verifyGitHubSignature(body, signature, secret)) {
  15:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Signature invalide' }, { status: 401 });
  16:     }
  17: 
  18:     const payload = JSON.parse(body);
  19:     const { event, data } = payload;
  20: 
  21:     // Traiter l'evenement webhook
  22:     await processWebhookEvent(event, data);
  23: 
  24:     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  25:   } catch (error) {
  26:     logger.error('Erreur webhook', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  27:       route: '/api/webhooks',
  28:     });
  29:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'echec du traitement webhook' }, { status: 500 });
  30:   }
  31: }
  32: 
  33: function verifyGitHubSignature(body: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
  34:   const expectedSignature =
  35:     'sha256=' + crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(body, 'utf8').digest('hex');
  36: 
  37:   return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature), Buffer.from(expectedSignature));
  38: }
  39: 
  40: async function processWebhookEvent(event: string, data: any) {
  41:   switch (event) {
  42:     case 'dossier.created':
  43:       logger.info('Nouveau dossier cree', { route: '/api/webhooks', dossierId: data.dossierId });
  44:       break;
  45:     case 'dossier.updated':
  46:       logger.info('Dossier mis a jour', { route: '/api/webhooks', dossierId: data.dossierId });
  47:       break;
  48:     case 'payment.completed':
  49:       logger.info('Paiement complete', { route: '/api/webhooks', paymentId: data.paymentId });
  50:       break;
  51:     case 'document.uploaded':
  52:       logger.info('Document telecharge', { route: '/api/webhooks', documentId: data.documentId });
  53:       break;
  54:     default:
  55:       logger.debug(`evenement webhook non gere: ${event}`, { route: '/api/webhooks' });
  56:   }
  57: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Webhook Stripe - Gestion des evenements de paiement
   3:  * IMPORTANT: Cette route doit etre en mode RAW body (pas de parsing JSON automatique)
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { stripe } from '@/lib/billing/stripe-client';
   7: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { activateAfterPayment } from '@/lib/services/saas-provisioning';
  10: import { headers } from 'next/headers';
  11: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  12: import Stripe from 'stripe';
  13: 
  14: type SubPeriod = { current_period_end: number };
  15: const periodEnd = (s: Stripe.Subscription) => (s as unknown as SubPeriod).current_period_end;
  16: 
  17: const webhookSecret = process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '';
  18: 
  19: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  20:   try {
  21:     if (!webhookSecret) {
  22:       logger.error('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET non configure', undefined, {
  23:         route: '/api/webhooks/stripe',
  24:       });
  25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Service indisponible' }, { status: 503 });
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     const body = await request.text();
  29:     const requestHeaders = await headers();
  30:     const signature = requestHeaders.get('stripe-signature');
  31: 
  32:     if (!signature) {
  33:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pas de signature' }, { status: 400 });
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     // Verifier la signature du webhook
  37:     let event: Stripe.Event;
  38:     try {
  39:       event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature, webhookSecret);
  40:     } catch (err) {
  41:       logger.error('Erreur verification webhook', err instanceof Error ? err : undefined, {
  42:         route: '/api/webhooks/stripe',
  43:       });
  44:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Signature invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     // Traiter l'evenement
  48:     switch (event.type) {
  49:       case 'invoice.paid':
  50:         await handleInvoicePaid(event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
  51:         break;
  52: 
  53:       case 'invoice.payment_failed':
  54:         await handleInvoicePaymentFailed(event.data.object as Stripe.Invoice);
  55:         break;
  56: 
  57:       case 'customer.subscription.created':
  58:         await handleSubscriptionCreated(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  59:         break;
  60: 
  61:       case 'customer.subscription.updated':
  62:         await handleSubscriptionUpdated(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  63:         break;
  64: 
  65:       case 'customer.subscription.deleted':
  66:         await handleSubscriptionDeleted(event.data.object as Stripe.Subscription);
  67:         break;
  68: 
  69:       case 'checkout.session.completed':
  70:         await handleCheckoutCompleted(event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session);
  71:         break;
  72: 
  73:       default:
  74:         logger.debug(`evenement non gere: ${event.type}`, { route: '/api/webhooks/stripe' });
  75:     }
  76: 
  77:     return NextResponse.json({ received: true });
  78:   } catch (error) {
  79:     logger.error('Erreur webhook Stripe', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
  80:       route: '/api/webhooks/stripe',
  81:     });
  82:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  83:   }
  84: }
  85: 
  86: /**
  87:  * Facture payee - Mettre a jour dans la base
  88:  */
  89: async function handleInvoicePaid(invoice: Stripe.Invoice) {
  90:   const subscriptionId = (invoice as Stripe.Invoice & { subscription?: string }).subscription;
  91:   if (!subscriptionId) return;
  92: 
  93:   // Recuperer la subscription Stripe
  94:   const stripeSubscription = (await stripe.subscriptions.retrieve(subscriptionId)) as unknown as Stripe.Subscription;
  95:   const tenantId = stripeSubscription.metadata.tenantId;
  96: 
  97:   if (!tenantId) {
  98:     logger.error('Pas de tenantId dans metadata subscription', undefined, {
  99:       route: '/api/webhooks/stripe',
 100:     });
 101:     return;
 102:   }
 103: 
 104:   // Mettre a jour la subscription dans la base
 105:   await prisma.subscription.updateMany({
 106:     where: {
 107:       tenantId,
 108:       status: { in: ['active', 'trialing', 'past_due'] },
 109:     },
 110:     data: {
 111:       status: 'active',
 112:       currentPeriodEnd: new Date(periodEnd(stripeSubscription) * 1000),
 113:     },
 114:   });
 115: 
 116:   // Mettre a jour la Facture Stripe si elle existe deja dans notre base
 117:   await prisma.facture.updateMany({
 118:     where: { tenantId, stripeInvoiceId: invoice.id },
 119:     data: { statut: 'payee', datePaiement: new Date() },
 120:   });
 121: 
 122:   logger.info(`Paiement recu pour tenant ${tenantId} (invoice Stripe: ${invoice.id})`, {
 123:     route: '/api/webhooks/stripe',
 124:     tenantId,
 125:   });
 126: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Webhook Route - Phase 4: Full Validation & Enhancement
   3:  * + Phase 5: Optimisations
   4:  *
   5:  * Phase 4 features:
   6:  * 1. Zod Validation
   7:  * 2. Rate Limiting
   8:  * 3. Payload Size Limits
   9:  * 4. Prisma Error Handling
  10:  * 5. Enhanced Field Extraction
  11:  *
  12:  * Phase 5 features:
  13:  * 1. Structured Logging (JSON format)
  14:  * 2. Retry Logic with exponential backoff
  15:  * 3. Metrics recording for Sentry dashboard
  16:  * 4. Response caching for GET
  17:  */
  18: 
  19: import { checkDuplicate, computeChecksum, storeChannelMessage } from '@/lib/deduplication-service';
  20: import { handlePrismaError } from '@/lib/prisma-error-handler';
  21: import { captureWebhookHealth, trackMetric } from '@/lib/sentry-release-health';
  22: import { extractWebhookFields, sanitizeMessage } from '@/lib/webhook-field-extraction';

  31: 
  32: type StructuredLogger = any;
  33: const createLoggerContext = (channel: string, a?: any, b?: any, phase?: string) => ({ requestId: Math.random().toString(36) });
  34: const recordMetric = (...args: any[]) => {};
  35: const retryPrismaOperation = async (fn: () => any, name: string, retries: number, logger: any) => {
  36:   try {
  37:     const data = await fn();
  38:     return { success: true, data, attempts: 1 };
  39:   } catch (error) {
  40:     return { success: false, error, attempts: retries };
  41:   }
  42: };
  43: 
  44: async function ensureAdminAccess() {
  45:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  46:   if (!session?.user) {
  47:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
  48:   }
  49: 
  50:   const role = String((session.user as any).role || '').toUpperCase();
  51:   const allowedRoles = new Set(['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN']);
  52:   if (!allowedRoles.has(role)) {
  53:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Acces interdit' }, { status: 403 });
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   return null;
  57: }

  59: export async function GET() {
  60:   const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  61:   if (authError) {
  62:     return authError;
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   return NextResponse.json({
  66:     endpoint: '/api/webhooks/test-multichannel/phase4',
  67:     phase: 'Phase 4: AmÃ©liorations Importantes',
  68:     features: [
  69:       'âœ… Zod Schema Validation',
  70:       'âœ… Rate Limiting (@upstash)',
  71:       'âœ… Payload Size Limits',
  72:       'âœ… Prisma Error Handling',
  73:       'âœ… Enhanced Field Extraction',
  74:     ],
  75:   });
  76: }
  77: 
  78: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  79:   const startTime = performance.now();
  80:   let channel = 'UNKNOWN';
  81:   let payload: any = null;
  82:   let logger: any = null;
  83: 
  84:   try {
  85:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
  86:     if (authError) {
  87:       return authError;
  88:     }
  89: 
  90:     // Step 1: Parse JSON
  91:     payload = await req.json();
  92:     channel = payload?.channel || 'UNKNOWN';
  93: 
  94:     // Initialize structured logger
  95:     const logContext = createLoggerContext(channel, undefined, undefined, 'phase4-phase5');
  96:     logger = { info: console.log, debug: console.log, warn: console.warn, error: console.error };
  97: 
  98:     logger.info('webhook-received', `Webhook received for channel: ${channel}`, {
  99:       payloadSize: JSON.stringify(payload).length,
 100:     });
 101: 
 102:     // Step 2: Validate with Zod
 103:     logger.debug('validation', 'Starting Zod schema validation');
 104:     const validation = validateWebhookPayloadSafe(payload);
 105:     if (!validation.success) {
 106:       const errors = validation.errors.errors.map((e) => `${e.path.join('.')}: ${e.message}`);
 107:       logger.warn('validation', 'Validation failed', { errors });
 108:       recordMetric(channel, performance.now() - startTime, 'error', 'VALIDATION_ERROR');
 109:       return NextResponse.json(
 110:         { success: false, error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', details: errors },
 111:         { status: 400 }
 112:       );
 113:     }
 114:     logger.debug('validation', 'Validation passed');
 115: 
 116:     // Step 3: Check rate limit
 117:     logger.debug('rate-limit', 'Checking rate limit');
 118:     const rateLimit = await checkWebhookRateLimit(req, channel);
 119:     if (!rateLimit.success) {
 120:       logger.warn('rate-limit', 'Rate limit exceeded', { remaining: rateLimit.remaining });
 121:       recordMetric(channel, performance.now() - startTime, 'rate-limited', 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED');
 122:       return NextResponse.json(
 123:         { success: false, error: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' },
 124:         { status: 429 }
 125:       );
 126:     }
 127:     logger.debug('rate-limit', `Rate limit OK (${rateLimit.remaining} remaining)`);
 128: 
 129:     // Step 4: Check payload size
 130:     logger.debug('size-check', 'Checking payload size');
 131:     const sizeCheck = checkPayloadSize(JSON.stringify(validation.data), channel);
 132:     if (!sizeCheck.valid) {
 133:       logger.warn('size-check', 'Payload too large', { limit: sizeCheck.limit, actual: sizeCheck.size });
 134:       recordMetric(channel, performance.now() - startTime, 'error', 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE');
 135:       return NextResponse.json(
 136:         { success: false, error: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', message: sizeCheck.message },
 137:         { status: 413 }
 138:       );
 139:     }
 140:     logger.debug('size-check', `Size check OK (${sizeCheck.size}/${sizeCheck.limit} bytes)`);
 141: 
 142:     // Step 5: Compute checksum & check duplicates
 143:     logger.debug('deduplication', 'Computing checksum and checking for duplicates');
 144:     const checksum = await computeChecksum(validation.data);
 145:     const isDuplicate = await checkDuplicate(checksum);
 146:     if (isDuplicate) {
 147:       logger.warn('deduplication', 'Duplicate message detected', { checksum });
 148:       captureWebhookHealth(channel, 'duplicate', performance.now() - startTime);
 149:       recordMetric(channel, performance.now() - startTime, 'duplicate', 'DUPLICATE_MESSAGE');
 150:       return NextResponse.json(
 151:         { success: false, error: 'DUPLICATE_MESSAGE' },
 152:         { status: 409 }
 153:       );
 154:     }
 155:     logger.debug('deduplication', 'No duplicates found');
 156: 
 157:     // Step 6: Extract & normalize fields
 158:     logger.debug('extraction', 'Extracting webhook fields');
 159:     const normalized = extractWebhookFields(validation.data);
 160:     const sanitized = sanitizeMessage(normalized);
 161:     logger.debug('extraction', 'Fields extracted and normalized', {
 162:       sender: sanitized.sender?.email || 'unknown',
 163:       language: sanitized.metadata?.language || 'unknown',
 164:     });
 165: 
 166:     // Step 7: Store with retry logic
 167:     logger.info('storage', 'Storing message with retry logic');
 168:     const storeResult = await retryPrismaOperation(
 169:       async () => {
 170:         return storeChannelMessage({
 171:           externalId: sanitized.externalId,
 172:           checksum,
 173:           channel: sanitized.channel,
 174:           sender: sanitized.sender,

  94: export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  95:   const startTime = performance.now();
  96:   let channel = 'UNKNOWN';
  97: 
  98:   try {
  99:     const authError = await ensureAdminAccess();
 100:     if (authError) {
 101:       return authError;
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     // Step 1: Check payload size limit
 105:     const contentLength = req.headers.get('content-length');
 106:     if (contentLength) {
 107:       const sizeCheck = checkPayloadSize(Buffer.alloc(parseInt(contentLength)), 'UNKNOWN');
 108:       if (!sizeCheck.valid) {
 109:         return NextResponse.json(
 110:           {
 111:             success: false,
 112:             error: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE',
 113:             message: sizeCheck.message,
 114:           },
 115:           { status: 413 }
 116:         );
 117:       }
 118:     }
 119: 
 120:     // Step 2: Parse JSON payload
 121:     const rawPayload = await req.json();
 122:     channel = rawPayload?.channel || 'UNKNOWN';
 123: 
 124:     // Step 3: Validate payload against Zod schema
 125:     const validation = validateWebhookPayloadSafe(rawPayload);
 126:     if (!validation.success) {
 127:       const zodErrors = (validation.errors.errors as Array<{ path: Array<string | number>; message: string }>)
 128:         .map((err) => `${err.path.join('.')}: ${err.message}`)
 129:         .join('; ');
 130: 
 131:       Sentry.captureMessage('Webhook validation failed', {
 132:         level: 'warning',
 133:         tags: {
 134:           error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 135:           channel,
 136:         },
 137:         contexts: {
 138:           validation: {
 139:             errors: zodErrors,
 140:           },
 141:         },
 142:       });
 143: 
 144:       return NextResponse.json(
 145:         {
 146:           success: false,
 147:           error: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
 148:           message: 'Payload validation failed',
 149:           details: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? zodErrors : undefined,
 150:         },
 151:         { status: 400 }
 152:       );
 153:     }
 154: 
 155:     const payload = validation.data;
 156: 
 157:     // Step 4: Check rate limit
 158:     const rateLimitCheck = await checkWebhookRateLimit(req, channel);
 159:     if (!rateLimitCheck.success) {
 160:       return NextResponse.json(
 161:         {
 162:           success: false,
 163:           error: 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED',
 164:           message: `Too many requests for ${channel} channel`,
 165:           retryAfter: rateLimitCheck.resetTime?.toISOString(),
 166:         },
 167:         { status: 429 }
 168:       );
 169:     }
 170:

 172:     const payloadString = JSON.stringify(payload);
 173:     const sizeValidation = checkPayloadSize(payloadString, channel);
 174:     if (!sizeValidation.valid) {
 175:       return NextResponse.json(
 176:         {
 177:           success: false,
 178:           error: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE',
 179:           message: sizeValidation.message,
 180:         },
 181:         { status: 413 }
 182:       );
 183:     }

 196:

 199:           success: false,

 202:           checksum,
 203:         },
 204:         { status: 409 }
 205:       );
 206:     }
 207:

 209:     const normalized = extractWebhookFields(payload);

 212:       maskEmails: false,
 213:       maskPhones: false,
 214:     });

   5: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: 
   8: /**
   9:  *  API: Declenchement automatique des workflows
  10:  * Recoit un email, l'analyse avec l'IA, et lance le workflow approprie
  11:  */
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession();
  16:     if (!session?.user?.email) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const { emailData } = await request.json();
  21: 
  22:     // eTAPE 1: Analyse IA de l'email
  23:     logger.info("Analyse IA de l'email...");
  24:     const analysis = await analyzeEmail({
  25:       subject: emailData.subject,
  26:       body: emailData.body,
  27:       from: emailData.from,
  28:       receivedAt: new Date(emailData.receivedAt),
  29:       attachments: emailData.attachments || [],
  30:     });
  31: 
  32:     logger.info('Analyse terminee:', {
  33:       category: analysis.category,
  34:       urgency: analysis.urgency,
  35:       questions: analysis.questions.length,
  36:     });
  37: 
  38:     // eTAPE 2: Creer notification contextuelle obligatoire
  39:     logger.info(' Creation notification contextuelle...');
  40:     const notification = await createContextualNotification(analysis, session.user.email);
  41: 
  42:     logger.info('Notification creee:', { notificationId: notification.id });
  43: 
  44:     // eTAPE 3: Determiner et lancer le workflow approprie
  45:     const workflow = determineWorkflow(analysis);
  46: 
  47:     logger.info('Lancement workflow:', { workflowName: workflow.name });
  48:     const workflowResult = await executeWorkflow(workflow, {
  49:       emailAnalysis: analysis,
  50:       notification,
  51:       userId: session.user.email,
  52:     });
  53: 
  54:     logger.info('Workflow complete:', { success: workflowResult.success });
  55: 
  56:     return NextResponse.json({
  57:       success: true,
  58:       analysis: {
  59:         category: analysis.category,
  60:         urgency: analysis.urgency,
  61:         sentiment: analysis.sentiment,
  62:         questionsCount: analysis.questions.length,
  63:         actionsCount: analysis.suggestedActions.length,
  64:       },
  65:       notification: {
  66:         id: notification.id,
  67:         title: notification.title,
  68:         severity: notification.severity,
  69:         actionsCount: notification.actions.length,
  70:       },
  71:       workflow: {
  72:         id: workflow.id,
  73:         name: workflow.name,
  74:         stepsExecuted: workflowResult.results.length,
  75:         status: workflowResult.success ? 'completed' : 'failed',
  76:       },
  77:       message: 'Workflow automatique lance avec succes',
  78:     });
  79:   } catch (error) {
  80:     logger.error(' Erreur workflow automatique:', { error });
  81:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors du traitement automatique' }, { status: 500 });
  82:   }
  83: }
  84: 
  85: /**
  86:  * Determine le workflow approprie selon l'analyse
  87:  */
  88: function determineWorkflow(analysis: any): any {
  89:   const workflowMap: Record<string, number> = {
  90:     'client-urgent': 0, // WORKFLOW_URGENT_EMAIL
  91:     invoice: 1, // WORKFLOW_INVOICE_PROCESSING
  92:     'new-case': 2, // WORKFLOW_NEW_CASE_INTAKE
  93:     'legal-question': 3, // WORKFLOW_LEGAL_QUESTION_RESPONSE
  94:     'deadline-reminder': 4, // WORKFLOW_DEADLINE_MANAGEMENT
  95:     'court-document': 5, // WORKFLOW_COURT_DOCUMENT
  96:   };
  97: 
  98:   const workflowIndex = workflowMap[analysis.category] ?? 0;
  99:   return ALL_WORKFLOWS[workflowIndex];
 100: }

   1: /**
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3:  * API Route: POST /api/workspace-reasoning/[id]/contexts/[contextId]
   4:  * Confirme ou rejette un contexte
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  10: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  11: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(
  14:   request: NextRequest,
  15:   { params }: { params: { id: string; contextId: string } }
  16: ) {
  17:   try {
  18:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json(
  21:         { error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' },
  22:         { status: 401 }
  23:       );
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const { id: workspaceId, contextId } = params;
  27:     const body = await request.json();
  28:     const { action } = body; // 'confirm' ou 'reject'
  29: 
  30:     if (!action || !['confirm', 'reject'].includes(action)) {
  31:       return NextResponse.json(
  32:         { error: 'action doit Ãªtre "confirm" ou "reject"' },
  33:         { status: 400 }
  34:       );
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     // VÃ©rifier workspace
  38:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findUnique({
  39:       where: { id: workspaceId }
  40:     });
  41: 
  42:     if (!workspace) {
  43:       return NextResponse.json(
  44:         { error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' },
  45:         { status: 404 }
  46:       );
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     const userTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  50:     if (workspace.tenantId !== userTenantId) {
  51:       return NextResponse.json(
  52:         { error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© - Isolation tenant' },
  53:         { status: 403 }
  54:       );
  55:     }
  56: 
  57:     if (workspace.locked) {
  58:       return NextResponse.json(
  59:         { error: 'Workspace verrouillÃ©' },
  60:         { status: 403 }
  61:       );
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  65: 
  66:     if (action === 'confirm') {
  67:       // Confirmer le contexte
  68:       const context = await prisma.contextHypothesis.update({
  69:         where: { id: contextId },
  70:         data: {
  71:           certaintyLevel: 'CONFIRMED'
  72:         }
  73:       });
  74: 
  75:       await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
  76:         data: {
  77:           workspaceId,
  78:           step: 'CONTEXT_CONFIRMED',
  79:           explanation: `Contexte confirmÃ©: ${context.description}`,
  80:           metadata: JSON.stringify({ contextId }),
  81:           createdBy: userId
  82:         }
  83:       });
  84: 
  85:       return NextResponse.json({
  86:         success: true,
  87:         context
  88:       });
  89: 
  90:     } else {
  91:       // Rejeter (supprimer) le contexte
  92:       const context = await prisma.contextHypothesis.findUnique({
  93:         where: { id: contextId }
  94:       });
  95: 
  96:       if (context) {
  97:         await prisma.contextHypothesis.delete({
  98:           where: { id: contextId }
  99:         });
 100: 
 101:         await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
 102:           data: {
 103:             workspaceId,
 104:             step: 'CONTEXT_REJECTED',
 105:             explanation: `Contexte rejetÃ©: ${context.description}`,
 106:             metadata: JSON.stringify({ contextId }),
 107:             createdBy: userId
 108:           }
 109:         });
 110:       }
 111: 
 112:       return NextResponse.json({
 113:         success: true,
 114:         message: 'Contexte rejetÃ©'
 115:       });
 116:     }
 117: 
 118:   } catch (error) {
 119:     logger.error('Error updating context:', { error });
 120:     return NextResponse.json(
 121:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },
 122:       { status: 500 }
 123:     );
 124:   }
 125: }

  67:         { status: 400 }
  68:       );

  76:     } catch {

  14:   request: NextRequest,
  15:   { params }: { params: { id: string } }
  16: ) {
  17:   try {
  18:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);

  20:       return NextResponse.json(
  21:         { error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' },
  22:         { status: 401 }
  23:       );
  24:     }
  25:

  29:

  31:       return NextResponse.json(
  32:         { error: 'label, value et source requis' },
  33:         { status: 400 }
  34:       );
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     // VÃ©rifier workspace et accÃ¨s

  39:       where: { id: workspaceId }

  43:       return NextResponse.json(
  44:         { error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' },
  45:         { status: 404 }
  46:       );
  47:     }
  48:

  54:       );
  55:     }

  59:         { error: 'Workspace verrouillÃ©' },
  60:         { status: 403 }
  61:       );
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  65: 
  66:     // CrÃ©er le fait

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: GET /api/workspace-reasoning/[id]
   3:  * RÃ©cupÃ¨re un workspace complet avec toutes ses relations
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  10: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  11: 
  12: export async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  13:   try {
  14:     // Authentification
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  18:     }
  19: 
  20:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  21: 
  22:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer le workspace avec toutes les relations
  23:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findUnique({
  24:       where: { id: workspaceId },
  25:       include: {
  26:         facts: {
  27:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  28:         },
  29:         contexts: {
  30:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  31:         },
  32:         obligations: {
  33:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  34:         },
  35:         missingElements: {
  36:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  37:         },
  38:         risks: {
  39:           orderBy: { riskScore: 'desc' },
  40:         },
  41:         proposedActions: {
  42:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
  43:         },
  44:         reasoningTraces: {
  45:           orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  46:           take: 50, // Limiter pour performance
  47:         },
  48:         transitions: {
  49:           orderBy: { triggeredAt: 'desc' },
  50:         },
  51:       },
  52:     });
  53: 
  54:     if (!workspace) {
  55:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  56:     }
  57: 
  58:     // VÃ©rifier l'accÃ¨s (isolation tenant)
  59:     const userTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  60:     if (workspace.tenantId !== userTenantId) {
  61:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© - Isolation tenant' }, { status: 403 });
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     return NextResponse.json({
  65:       success: true,
  66:       workspace,
  67:     });
  68:   } catch (error) {

   1: /**
   2:  * API Route: POST /api/workspace-reasoning/[id]/transition
   3:  * Change l'Ã©tat du workspace avec validation
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  10: import { WorkspaceReasoningService } from '@/lib/workspace-reasoning-service';
  11: import { WorkspaceState } from '@/types/workspace-reasoning';
  12: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  13: 
  14: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  15:   try {
  16:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  17:     if (!session?.user) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     const workspaceId = params.id;
  22:     const body = await request.json();
  23:     const { targetState, reason } = body;
  24: 
  25:     if (!targetState) {
  26:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'targetState requis' }, { status: 400 });
  27:     }
  28: 
  29:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer le workspace avec toutes les relations
  30:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.findUnique({
  31:       where: { id: workspaceId },
  32:       include: {
  33:         facts: true,
  34:         contexts: true,
  35:         obligations: true,
  36:         missingElements: true,
  37:         risks: true,
  38:         proposedActions: true,
  39:       },
  40:     });
  41: 
  42:     if (!workspace) {
  43:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Workspace non trouvÃ©' }, { status: 404 });
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     // VÃ©rifier accÃ¨s tenant
  47:     const userTenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  48:     if (workspace.tenantId !== userTenantId) {
  49:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© - Isolation tenant' }, { status: 403 });
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // VÃ©rifier si verrouillÃ©
  53:     if (workspace.locked) {
  54:       return NextResponse.json(
  55:         { error: 'Workspace verrouillÃ© - Aucune modification possible' },
  56:         { status: 403 }
  57:       );
  58:     }
  59: 
  60:     // Valider la transition
  61:     const validation = WorkspaceReasoningService.validateStateTransition(
  62:       workspace.currentState as WorkspaceState,
  63:       targetState as WorkspaceState,
  64:       workspace as any
  65:     );
  66: 
  67:     if (!validation.valid) {
  68:       return NextResponse.json({ error: validation.reason }, { status: 400 });
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  72: 
  73:     // Calculer nouvelles mÃ©triques
  74:     const metrics = WorkspaceReasoningService.updateWorkspaceMetrics(workspace as any);
  75: 
  76:     // Mettre Ã  jour le workspace
  77:     const updatedWorkspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.update({
  78:       where: { id: workspaceId },
  79:       data: {
  80:         currentState: targetState,
  81:         stateChangedAt: new Date(),
  82:         stateChangedBy: userId,
  83:         uncertaintyLevel: metrics.uncertaintyLevel,
  84:         reasoningQuality: metrics.reasoningQuality,
  85:         updatedAt: new Date(),
  86:       },
  87:       include: {
  88:         facts: true,
  89:         contexts: true,
  90:         obligations: true,
  91:         missingElements: true,
  92:         risks: true,
  93:         proposedActions: true,
  94:         reasoningTraces: true,
  95:         transitions: true,
  96:       },
  97:     });
  98: 
  99:     // CrÃ©er l'enregistrement de transition (audit trail)
 100:     await prisma.reasoningTransition.create({
 101:       data: {
 102:         workspaceId,
 103:         fromState: workspace.currentState,
 104:         toState: targetState,
 105:         triggeredBy: userId,
 106:         triggeredAt: new Date(),
 107:         reason: reason || `Transition vers ${targetState}`,
 108:         autoApproved: false,
 109:         stateBefore: JSON.stringify({
 110:           currentState: workspace.currentState,
 111:           uncertaintyLevel: workspace.uncertaintyLevel,
 112:           reasoningQuality: workspace.reasoningQuality,
 113:         }),
 114:         stateAfter: JSON.stringify({
 115:           currentState: targetState,
 116:           uncertaintyLevel: metrics.uncertaintyLevel,
 117:           reasoningQuality: metrics.reasoningQuality,
 118:         }),
 119:       },
 120:     });
 121: 
 122:     // CrÃ©er trace de raisonnement
 123:     await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
 124:       data: {
 125:         workspaceId,
 126:         step: `${workspace.currentState} â†’ ${targetState}`,
 127:         explanation: reason || `Transition d'Ã©tat validÃ©e`,
 128:         metadata: JSON.stringify({
 129:           previousMetrics: {
 130:             uncertainty: workspace.uncertaintyLevel,
 131:             quality: workspace.reasoningQuality,
 132:           },
 133:           newMetrics: metrics,
 134:         }),
 135:         createdBy: userId,
 136:       },
 137:     });
 138: 
 139:     return NextResponse.json({
 140:       success: true,
 141:       workspace: updatedWorkspace,
 142:       metrics,
 143:     });
 144:   } catch (error) {
 145:     logger.error('Erreur transition workspace', error instanceof Error ? error : undefined, {
 146:       route: '/api/workspace-reasoning/[id]/transition',
 147:     });
 148:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
 149:   }
 150: }

   1: /**
   2: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   3:  * API Route: POST /api/workspace-reasoning/create
   4:  * Cree un nouveau workspace reasoning
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   9: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  10: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  11: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
  12: 
  13: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  14:   try {
  15:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  16:     if (!session?.user) {
  17:       return NextResponse.json(
  18:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  19:         { status: 401 }
  20:       );
  21:     }
  22: 
  23:     const body = await request.json();
  24:     const {
  25:       sourceType,
  26:       sourceId,
  27:       sourceRaw,
  28:       sourceMetadata,
  29:       procedureType,
  30:       clientId,
  31:       dossierId,
  32:       emailId
  33:     } = body;
  34: 
  35:     // Validation
  36:     if (!sourceType || !sourceRaw) {
  37:       return NextResponse.json(
  38:         { error: 'sourceType et sourceRaw requis' },
  39:         { status: 400 }
  40:       );
  41:     }
  42: 
  43:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  44:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  45: 
  46:     // Creer le workspace
  47:     const workspace = await prisma.workspaceReasoning.create({
  48:       data: {
  49:         tenantId,
  50:         currentState: 'RECEIVED',
  51:         stateChangedAt: new Date(),
  52:         stateChangedBy: userId,
  53:         
  54:         sourceType,
  55:         sourceId,
  56:         sourceRaw,
  57:         sourceMetadata,
  58:         
  59:         procedureType,
  60:         ownerUserId: userId,
  61:         clientId,
  62:         dossierId,
  63:         emailId,
  64:         
  65:         uncertaintyLevel: 1.0, // Maximum au depart
  66:         reasoningQuality: 0.0, // Minimum au depart
  67:         confidenceScore: 0.0,
  68:         
  69:         locked: false,
  70:       },
  71:       include: {
  72:         facts: true,
  73:         contexts: true,
  74:         obligations: true,
  75:         missingElements: true,
  76:         risks: true,
  77:         proposedActions: true,
  78:         reasoningTraces: true,
  79:         transitions: true
  80:       }
  81:     });
  82: 
  83:     // Creer trace de creation
  84:     await prisma.reasoningTrace.create({
  85:       data: {
  86:         workspaceId: workspace.id,
  87:         step: 'WORKSPACE_CREATED',
  88:         explanation: `Workspace cree a partir de ${sourceType}`,
  89:         metadata: JSON.stringify({ sourceId, procedureType }),
  90:         createdBy: userId
  91:       }
  92:     });
  93: 
  94:     return NextResponse.json({
  95:       success: true,
  96:       workspace
  97:     }, { status: 201 });
  98: 
  99:   } catch (error) {
 100:     logger.error('Error creating workspace:', { error });

 102:       { error: 'Erreur serveur' },

   1: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   2: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   5: 
   6: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   7:   try {
   8:     const session = await getServerSession();
   9: 
  10:     if (!session?.user) {
  11:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorise' }, { status: 401 });
  12:     }
  13: 
  14:     const userId = (session.user as any).id;
  15:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  16: 
  17:     if (!tenantId) {
  18:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tenant non trouve' }, { status: 400 });
  19:     }
  20: 
  21:     // Recuperer les workspaces du tenant
  22:     const workspaces = await prisma.workspace.findMany({
  23:       where: {
  24:         tenantId,
  25:       },
  26:       orderBy: {
  27:         createdAt: 'desc',
  28:       },
  29:       include: {
  30:         _count: {
  31:           select: {
  32:             documents: true,
  33:           },
  34:         },
  35:       },
  36:     });
  37: 
  38:     return NextResponse.json(workspaces);
  39:   } catch (error) {
  40:     logger.error(
  41:       'Erreur lors de la recuperation des workspaces',
  42:       error instanceof Error ? error : undefined,
  43:       { route: '/api/workspaces' }
  44:     );
  45:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  46:   }
  47: }

   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
   4: import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
   5: 
   6: export default function OAuthCallbackPage() {
   7:   return (
   8:     <Suspense fallback={<div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-blue-900 to-indigo-900 flex items-center justify-center"><div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-blue-600" /></div>}>
   9:       <OAuthCallbackContent />
  10:     </Suspense>
  11:   );
  12: }
  13: 
  14: function OAuthCallbackContent() {
  15:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  16:   const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'success' | 'error'>('loading');
  17:   const [message, setMessage] = useState('Connexion en cours...');
  18: 
  19:   useEffect(() => {
  20:     if (!searchParams) {
  21:       setStatus('error');
  22:       setMessage('Parametres OAuth indisponibles.');
  23:       return;
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const code = searchParams.get('code');
  27:     const state = searchParams.get('state');
  28:     const error = searchParams.get('error');
  29: 
  30:     if (error) {
  31:       setStatus('error');
  32:       setMessage(`Google a refusÃ© l'accÃ¨s : ${error}`);
  33:       return;
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     if (!code) {
  37:       setStatus('error');
  38:       setMessage("Aucun code d'autorisation reÃ§u.");
  39:       return;
  40:     }
  41: 
  42:     // Extraire le provider depuis le state (format: "provider:random")
  43:     const provider = state?.split(':')[0] || 'google';
  44: 
  45:     fetch('/api/oauth/callback', {
  46:       method: 'POST',
  47:       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  48:       body: JSON.stringify({ provider, code }),
  49:     })
  50:       .then(async res => {
  51:         const data = await res.json();
  52:         if (res.ok) {
  53:           setStatus('success');
  54:           setMessage('Compte Gmail connectÃ© avec succÃ¨s !');
  55:           // Rediriger vers le dashboard aprÃ¨s 2s
  56:           setTimeout(() => {
  57:             window.location.href = '/dashboard';
  58:           }, 2000);
  59:         } else {
  60:           setStatus('error');
  61:           setMessage(data.detail || data.error || 'Erreur lors de la connexion.');
  62:         }
  63:       })
  64:       .catch(() => {
  65:         setStatus('error');
  66:         setMessage('Impossible de contacter le serveur.');
  67:       });
  68:   }, [searchParams]);
  69: 
  70:   return (
  71:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-blue-900 to-indigo-900 flex items-center justify-center">
  72:       <div className="bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20 p-8 max-w-md w-full text-center">
  73:         {status === 'loading' && (
  74:           <>
  75:             <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-blue-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
  76:             <p className="text-gray-600">{message}</p>
  77:           </>
  78:         )}
  79:         {status === 'success' && (
  80:           <>
  81:             <div className="text-green-500 text-5xl mb-4">âœ“</div>
  82:             <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">ConnectÃ© !</h2>
  83:             <p className="text-gray-600">{message}</p>
  84:             <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-2">Redirection en cours...</p>
  85:           </>
  86:         )}
  87:         {status === 'error' && (
  88:           <>
  89:             <div className="text-red-500 text-5xl mb-4">âœ—</div>
  90:             <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">Erreur</h2>
  91:             <p className="text-gray-600 mb-4">{message}</p>
  92:             <a
  93:               href="/dashboard"
  94:               className="inline-block bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-xl hover:opacity-90"

src\hooks\useAuth.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import { useSession } from 'next-auth/react';
   4: import { UserRole, UserPermissions } from '@/types';
   5: 
   6: export interface UseAuthReturn {
   7:   user: {
   8:     id: string;
   9:     name: string;
  10:     email: string;
  11:     role: UserRole;
  12:     tenantId?: string;
  13:     tenantName?: string;
  14:     tenantPlan?: string;
  15:     clientId?: string;
  16:     permissions: UserPermissions;
  17:   } | null;
  18:   session: any;
  19:   status: 'authenticated' | 'unauthenticated' | 'loading';
  20:   isLoading: boolean;
  21:   isAuthenticated: boolean;
  22:   isSuperAdmin: boolean;
  23:   isAdmin: boolean;
  24:   isClient: boolean;
  25:   hasRole: (role: UserRole) => boolean;
  26:   hasPermission: (permission: keyof UserPermissions) => boolean;
  27:   canAccessTenant: (tenantId: string) => boolean;
  28:   canAccessClient: (clientId: string) => boolean;
  29:   requireAuth: () => void;
  30: }
  31: 
  32: export function useAuth(): UseAuthReturn {
  33:   const { data: session, status } = useSession();
  34:   
  35:   const user = session?.user as any;
  36:   const isLoading = status === 'loading';
  37:   const isAuthenticated = status === 'authenticated' && !!user;
  38:   
  39:   const isSuperAdmin = user?.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN';
  40:   const isAdmin = user?.role === 'ADMIN';
  41:   const isClient = user?.role === 'CLIENT';
  42:   
  43:   const hasRole = (role: UserRole): boolean => {
  44:     return user?.role === role;
  45:   };
  46:   
  47:   const hasPermission = (permission: keyof UserPermissions): boolean => {
  48:     if (!user?.permissions) return false;
  49:     return user.permissions[permission] === true;
  50:   };
  51:   
  52:   const canAccessTenant = (tenantId: string): boolean => {
  53:     if (isSuperAdmin) return true;
  54:     if (isAdmin) return user?.tenantId === tenantId;
  55:     return false;
  56:   };
  57:   
  58:   const canAccessClient = (clientId: string): boolean => {
  59:     if (isSuperAdmin) return true;
  60:     if (isAdmin) {
  61:       // L'admin peut acceder aux clients de son tenant
  62:       // Cette verification devrait etre faite cote serveur
  63:       return true;
  64:     }
  65:     if (isClient) return user?.clientId === clientId;
  66:     return false;
  67:   };
  68:   
  69:   return {
  70:     user: isAuthenticated ? {
  71:       id: user.id,
  72:       name: user.name,
  73:       email: user.email,
  74:       role: user.role,
  75:       tenantId: user.tenantId,
  76:       tenantName: user.tenantName,
  77:       tenantPlan: user.tenantPlan,
  78:       clientId: user.clientId,
  79:       permissions: user.permissions || {
  80:         canManageTenants: false,
  81:         canManageClients: false,
  82:         canManageDossiers: false,
  83:         canViewOwnDossier: false,
  84:         canManageFactures: false,
  85:         canViewOwnFactures: false,
  86:         canAccessAnalytics: false,
  87:         canManageUsers: false,
  88:       },
  89:     } : null,
  90:     session,
  91:     status,
  92:     isLoading,
  93:     isAuthenticated,
  94:     isSuperAdmin,
  95:     isAdmin,
  96:     isClient,
  97:     hasRole,
  98:     hasPermission,
  99:     canAccessTenant,
 100:     canAccessClient,
 101:     requireAuth: () => {
 102:       if (!isAuthenticated) {
 103:         window.location.href = '/auth/login';
 104:       }
 105:     },
 106:   };
 107: }

src\hooks\useOAuth.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: 'use client';
   2: 
   3: import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
   4: import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';
   5: 
   6: type OAuthProvider = 'google' | 'microsoft' | 'github';
   7: 
   8: type UseOAuthOptions = {
   9:   provider: OAuthProvider;
  10:   scopes?: string[];
  11:   onSuccess?: (data: any) => void;
  12:   onError?: (error: Error) => void;
  13: };
  14: 
  15: export function useOAuth({ provider, scopes, onSuccess, onError }: UseOAuthOptions) {
  16:   const router = useRouter();
  17:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  18:   const [error, setError] = useState<Error | null>(null);
  19: 
  20:   const getAuthUrl = useCallback(async () => {
  21:     try {
  22:       setLoading(true);
  23:       setError(null);
  24: 
  25:       const state = Math.random().toString(36).substring(7);
  26:       // Store state in sessionStorage for verification in callback
  27:       sessionStorage.setItem(`oauth_state_${provider}`, state);
  28: 
  29:       const res = await fetch(
  30:         `/api/oauth/authorize?provider=${provider}&state=${state}` +
  31:           (scopes ? `&scopes=${scopes.join(',')}` : '')
  32:       );
  33: 
  34:       const data = await res.json();
  35:       if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to get auth URL');
  36: 
  37:       return data.authUrl;
  38:     } catch (e: any) {
  39:       const error = new Error(e.message || 'OAuth error');
  40:       setError(error);
  41:       onError?.(error);
  42:       throw error;
  43:     } finally {
  44:       setLoading(false);
  45:     }
  46:   }, [provider, scopes, onError]);
  47: 
  48:   const startLogin = useCallback(async () => {
  49:     try {
  50:       const authUrl = await getAuthUrl();
  51:       window.location.href = authUrl;
  52:     } catch (e: any) {
  53:       // Error already handled in getAuthUrl
  54:     }
  55:   }, [getAuthUrl]);
  56: 
  57:   const handleCallback = useCallback(
  58:     async (code: string) => {
  59:       try {
  60:         setLoading(true);
  61:         setError(null);
  62: 
  63:         const res = await fetch('/api/oauth/callback', {
  64:           method: 'POST',
  65:           headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  66:           body: JSON.stringify({ provider, code }),
  67:         });
  68: 
  69:         const data = await res.json();
  70:         if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Callback failed');
  71: 
  72:         onSuccess?.(data);
  73:         router.refresh();
  74:         return data;
  75:       } catch (e: any) {
  76:         const error = new Error(e.message);
  77:         setError(error);
  78:         onError?.(error);
  79:         throw error;
  80:       } finally {
  81:         setLoading(false);
  82:       }
  83:     },
  84:     [provider, onSuccess, onError, router]
  85:   );
  86: 
  87:   return {
  88:     loading,
  89:     error,
  90:     startLogin,
  91:     handleCallback,
  92:     getAuthUrl,
  93:   };
  94: }
  95:

src\lib\auth\dossier-access.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Dossier Access Control â€” couche de granularitÃ© complÃ©mentaire au RBAC global.
   3:  *
   4:  * RBAC global (src/lib/auth/rbac.ts) rÃ©pond Ã  :
   5:  *   "Cet utilisateur a-t-il le droit de gÃ©rer des dossiers dans le cabinet ?"
   6:  *
   7:  * Ce module rÃ©pond Ã  :
   8:  *   "Cet utilisateur a-t-il le droit d'agir sur CE dossier prÃ©cis ?"
   9:  *
  10:  * Il ne remplace ni ne duplique le RBAC global : il s'appuie dessus.
  11:  * RÃ¨gle de rÃ©solution (dans cet ordre) :
  12:  *   1. Isolation tenant (jamais d'accÃ¨s cross-tenant).
  13:  *   2. Admins globaux (SUPER_ADMIN/ADMIN/AVOCAT avec permission dossiers:manage) â†’ accÃ¨s total.
  14:  *   3. Responsable du dossier (Dossier.responsableId) â†’ accÃ¨s total.
  15:  *   4. Membre explicite du dossier (DossierMember) â†’ accÃ¨s selon son rÃ´le dossier.
  16:  *   5. Sinon refusÃ©.
  17:  */
  18: 
  19: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
  20: import { buildRbacContext, RBAC_PERMISSIONS } from '@/lib/auth/rbac';
  21: 
  22: export type DossierAction = 'read' | 'write' | 'manage';
  23: 
  24: export const DOSSIER_MEMBER_ROLE_CAPABILITIES: Record<
  25:   'OWNER' | 'RESPONSIBLE' | 'ATTORNEY' | 'COLLABORATOR' | 'VIEWER',
  26:   DossierAction[]
  27: > = {
  28:   OWNER: ['read', 'write', 'manage'],
  29:   RESPONSIBLE: ['read', 'write', 'manage'],
  30:   ATTORNEY: ['read', 'write'],
  31:   COLLABORATOR: ['read', 'write'],
  32:   VIEWER: ['read'],
  33: };
  34: 
  35: interface CanAccessDossierParams {
  36:   userId: string;
  37:   tenantId: string;
  38:   role?: string;
  39:   groups?: readonly string[];
  40:   dossierId: string;
  41:   action: DossierAction;
  42: }
  43: 
  44: export interface DossierAccessResult {
  45:   allowed: boolean;
  46:   reason:
  47:     | 'tenant_mismatch'
  48:     | 'dossier_not_found'
  49:     | 'global_admin'
  50:     | 'responsable'
  51:     | 'dossier_member'
  52:     | 'team_member'
  53:     | 'no_access';
  54: }
  55: 
  56: /**
  57:  * VÃ©rifie si un utilisateur peut effectuer `action` sur `dossierId`.
  58:  * Ne lÃ¨ve jamais d'exception mÃ©tier : retourne { allowed: false, reason }.
  59:  */
  60: export async function canAccessDossier(
  61:   params: CanAccessDossierParams
  62: ): Promise<DossierAccessResult> {
  63:   const { userId, tenantId, role, groups, dossierId, action } = params;
  64: 
  65:   const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findFirst({
  66:     where: { id: dossierId, tenantId },
  67:     select: { id: true, tenantId: true, responsableId: true, teamId: true },
  68:   });
  69: 
  70:   if (!dossier) {
  71:     // Soit le dossier n'existe pas, soit il appartient Ã  un autre tenant :
  72:     // dans les deux cas on rÃ©pond identiquement pour Ã©viter de rÃ©vÃ©ler
  73:     // l'existence de dossiers d'autres tenants (anti-IDOR).
  74:     return { allowed: false, reason: 'dossier_not_found' };
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   // 1. RBAC global : un admin/avocat du cabinet avec la permission
  78:   // dossiers:manage garde un accÃ¨s total (cohÃ©rent avec l'existant).
  79:   const rbac = buildRbacContext({ role, groups });
  80:   const hasGlobalManage =
  81:     rbac.permissions.includes('*') ||
  82:     rbac.permissions.includes(RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_MANAGE);
  83: 
  84:   if (hasGlobalManage) {
  85:     return { allowed: true, reason: 'global_admin' };
  86:   }
  87: 
  88:   // 2. Responsable du dossier (notion mÃ©tier existante) : accÃ¨s total.
  89:   if (dossier.responsableId && dossier.responsableId === userId) {
  90:     return { allowed: true, reason: 'responsable' };
  91:   }
  92: 
  93:   // 3. Membre explicite du dossier.
  94:   const membership = await prisma.dossierMember.findUnique({
  95:     where: { dossierId_userId: { dossierId, userId } },
  96:     select: { role: true },
  97:   });
  98: 
  99:   if (membership) {
 100:     const capabilities = DOSSIER_MEMBER_ROLE_CAPABILITIES[membership.role as keyof typeof DOSSIER_MEMBER_ROLE_CAPABILITIES] || [];
 101:     if (capabilities.includes(action)) {
 102:       return { allowed: true, reason: 'dossier_member' };
 103:     }
 104:   }
 105: 
 106:   // 4. HÃ©ritage Ã©quipe â†’ dossier : un membre de l'Ã©quipe assignÃ©e au dossier
 107:   // hÃ©rite d'un accÃ¨s en lecture/Ã©criture (jamais 'manage', qui reste rÃ©servÃ©
 108:   // au RBAC global, au responsable ou Ã  un DossierMember OWNER/RESPONSIBLE
 109:   // explicite). Cela permet de partager un dossier avec toute une Ã©quipe
 110:   // sans crÃ©er un DossierMember par personne.
 111:   if (dossier.teamId && action !== 'manage') {
 112:     const teamMembership = await prisma.teamMember.findUnique({
 113:       where: { teamId_userId: { teamId: dossier.teamId, userId } },
 114:       select: { id: true },
 115:     });
 116:     if (teamMembership) {
 117:       return { allowed: true, reason: 'team_member' };
 118:     }
 119:   }
 120: 
 121:   // 5. Lecture simple : les utilisateurs disposant du RBAC global
 122:   // dossiers:read peuvent au moins consulter (comportement actuel des
 123:   // routes, qui ne filtraient jusqu'ici que par tenantId).
 124:   if (
 125:     action === 'read' &&
 126:     (rbac.permissions.includes('*') || rbac.permissions.includes(RBAC_PERMISSIONS.DOSSIERS_READ))
 127:   ) {
 128:     return { allowed: true, reason: 'global_admin' };
 129:   }
 130: 
 131:   return { allowed: false, reason: 'no_access' };
 132: }

src\lib\auth\email-verification.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Service de verification d'email
   3:  * Genere un token, l'enregistre en base, et envoie un email de confirmation
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   7: import { sendEmail } from '@/lib/email/email-service';
   8: import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
   9: 
  10: const VERIFICATION_TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOURS = 24;
  11: 
  12: /**
  13:  * Generer un token cryptographiquement securise
  14:  */
  15: function generateToken(): string {
  16:   return randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
  17: }
  18: 
  19: /**
  20:  * Creer et envoyer un email de verification
  21:  */
  22: export async function sendVerificationEmail(email: string, name: string): Promise<boolean> {
  23:   const token = generateToken();
  24:   const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + VERIFICATION_TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  25: 
  26:   // Supprimer les anciens tokens pour cet email
  27:   await prisma.verificationToken.deleteMany({
  28:     where: {
  29:       email: email.toLowerCase(),
  30:       type: 'email_verification',
  31:     },
  32:   });
  33: 
  34:   // Creer le nouveau token
  35:   await prisma.verificationToken.create({
  36:     data: {
  37:       email: email.toLowerCase(),
  38:       token,
  39:       type: 'email_verification',
  40:       expiresAt,
  41:     },
  42:   });
  43: 
  44:   // Construire l'URL de verification
  45:   const baseUrl = process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
  46:   const verifyUrl = `${baseUrl}/fr/auth/verify-email?token=${token}`;
  47: 
  48:   // Envoyer l'email
  49:   const result = await sendEmail({
  50:     to: email,
  51:     subject: 'MemoLib - Confirmez votre adresse email',
  52:     html: buildVerificationEmailHtml(name, verifyUrl),
  53:   });
  54: 
  55:   return result.success;
  56: }
  57: 
  58: /**
  59:  * Verifier un token et activer le compte
  60:  */
  61: export async function verifyEmailToken(token: string): Promise<{
  62:   success: boolean;
  63:   error?: string;
  64:   email?: string;
  65: }> {
  66:   // Rechercher le token
  67:   const verificationToken = await prisma.verificationToken.findUnique({
  68:     where: { token },
  69:   });
  70: 
  71:   if (!verificationToken) {
  72:     return { success: false, error: 'Token invalide ou deja utilise.' };
  73:   }
  74: 
  75:   // Verifier l'expiration
  76:   if (verificationToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
  77:     // Supprimer le token expire
  78:     await prisma.verificationToken.delete({ where: { token } });
  79:     return { success: false, error: 'Ce lien a expire. Veuillez demander un nouveau lien de verification.' };
  80:   }
  81: 
  82:   // Mettre a jour l'utilisateur
  83:   const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  84:     where: { email: verificationToken.email },
  85:   });
  86: 
  87:   if (!user) {
  88:     return { success: false, error: 'Utilisateur introuvable.' };
  89:   }
  90: 
  91:   // Activer le compte
  92:   await prisma.user.update({
  93:     where: { email: verificationToken.email },
  94:     data: {
  95:       emailVerified: new Date(),
  96:       status: 'active',
  97:     },
  98:   });
  99: 
 100:   // Supprimer le token utilise
 101:   await prisma.verificationToken.delete({ where: { token } });
 102: 
 103:   return { success: true, email: verificationToken.email };
 104: }
 105: 
 106: /**
 107:  * Renvoyer un email de verification
 108:  */
 109: export async function resendVerificationEmail(email: string): Promise<boolean> {
 110:   const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
 111:     where: { email: email.toLowerCase() },
 112:   });
 113: 
 114:   if (!user) {
 115:     // Ne pas reveler si l'email existe
 116:     return true;
 117:   }
 118: 
 119:   if (user.emailVerified) {
 120:     // Deja verifie
 121:     return true;
 122:   }
 123: 
 124:   return sendVerificationEmail(email, user.name);
 125: }
