 151: const ROLE_GROUPS: Record<string, RbacGroup[]> = {
 152:   SUPER_ADMIN: ['platform-admin'],
 153:   ADMIN: ['cabinet-admin', 'billing-manager'],
 154:   AVOCAT: ['cabinet-admin', 'billing-manager'],
 155:   ASSOCIE: ['associate', 'billing-manager'],
 156:   COLLABORATEUR: ['lawyer'],
 157:   LAWYER: ['lawyer'],
 158:   STAGIAIRE: ['intern'],
 159:   SECRETAIRE: ['secretary'],
 160:   COMPTABLE: ['accountant'],
 161:   CLIENT: ['client'],
 162: };
 163: 
 164: function unique<T>(items: T[]): T[] {
 165:   return Array.from(new Set(items));
 166: }
 167: 
 168: function normalizeRole(role?: string): string {
 169:   return (role || '').trim().toUpperCase();
 170: }
 171: 
 172: export function resolveGroupsFromRole(role?: string): RbacGroup[] {
 173:   const normalized = normalizeRole(role);
 174:   return ROLE_GROUPS[normalized] || ['client'];
 175: }
 176: 
 177: export function resolvePermissionsFromGroups(groups: readonly string[]): RbacPermission[] {
 178:   const allPermissions: RbacPermission[] = [];
 179:   for (const group of groups) {
 180:     const groupKey = group as RbacGroup;
 181:     const groupPermissions = GROUP_PERMISSIONS[groupKey] || [];
 182:     allPermissions.push(...groupPermissions);
 183:   }
 184:   return unique(allPermissions);
 185: }
 186: 
 187: export function buildRbacContext(params: { role?: string; groups?: readonly string[] }) {
 188:   const roleGroups = resolveGroupsFromRole(params.role);
 189:   const explicitGroups = (params.groups || []).filter((group): group is string => Boolean(group));
 190:   const groups = unique([...roleGroups, ...explicitGroups]);
 191:   const permissions = resolvePermissionsFromGroups(groups);
 192: 
 193:   return {
 194:     role: normalizeRole(params.role),
 195:     groups,
 196:     permissions,
 197:   };
 198: }
 199: 
 200: export function hasPermission(params: { role?: string; groups?: readonly string[]; required: RbacPermission }): boolean {
 201:   const context = buildRbacContext({ role: params.role, groups: params.groups });
 202:   return context.permissions.includes('*') || context.permissions.includes(params.required);
 203: }
 204: 
 205: export function requireApiPermission(
 206:   session: SessionLike | null,
 207:   required: RbacPermission
 208: ): { ok: true; role: string; groups: string[]; permissions: RbacPermission[] } | { ok: false; response: NextResponse } {
 209:   if (!session?.user) {
 210:     return {
 211:       ok: false,
 212:       response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 }),
 213:     };
 214:   }
 215: 
 216:   const context = buildRbacContext({
 217:     role: session.user.role,
 218:     groups: session.user.groups,
 219:   });
 220: 
 221:   const allowed = context.permissions.includes('*') || context.permissions.includes(required);
 222:   if (!allowed) {
 223:     return {
 224:       ok: false,
 225:       response: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 }),
 226:     };
 227:   }
 228: 
 229:   return {
 230:     ok: true,
 231:     role: context.role,
 232:     groups: context.groups,
 233:     permissions: context.permissions,
 234:   };
 235: }

src\lib\billing\feature-gate-middleware.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware Feature Gate â€” MemoLib
   3:  *
   4:  * HOF (Higher-Order Function) pour protÃ©ger les API routes
   5:  * avec vÃ©rification automatique du plan.
   6:  *
   7:  * Usage dans une route API :
   8:  *
   9:  *   import { withFeatureGate } from '@/lib/billing/feature-gate-middleware';
  10:  *
  11:  *   export const POST = withFeatureGate('ai_draft_reply', async (request, context) => {
  12:  *     // Code exÃ©cutÃ© seulement si le tenant a accÃ¨s
  13:  *     return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  14:  *   });
  15:  *
  16:  * Usage avec plusieurs features (toutes requises) :
  17:  *
  18:  *   export const POST = withFeatureGate(
  19:  *     ['ai_draft_reply', 'emails_inbound'],
  20:  *     handler
  21:  *   );
  22:  */
  23: 
  24: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  25: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
  26: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
  27: import { Feature, checkFeatureAccess, FeatureCheckResult } from './features';
  28: 
  29: interface RouteContext {
  30:   params?: Record<string, string>;
  31: }
  32: 
  33: type RouteHandler = (
  34:   request: NextRequest,
  35:   context: RouteContext & { featureGate: FeatureCheckResult }
  36: ) => Promise<NextResponse> | NextResponse;
  37: 
  38: /**
  39:  * ProtÃ¨ge une route API par feature gate.
  40:  * Extrait automatiquement le tenantId de la session.
  41:  */
  42: export function withFeatureGate(
  43:   feature: Feature | Feature[],
  44:   handler: RouteHandler,
  45: ): (request: NextRequest, context?: RouteContext) => Promise<NextResponse> {
  46:   return async (request: NextRequest, context: RouteContext = {}) => {
  47:     // 1. VÃ©rifier la session
  48:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  49:     if (!session?.user) {
  50:       return NextResponse.json(
  51:         { error: 'Non autorisÃ©', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' },
  52:         { status: 401 }
  53:       );
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     const tenantId = (session.user as any).tenantId;
  57:     if (!tenantId) {
  58:       return NextResponse.json(
  59:         { error: 'Tenant non identifiÃ©', code: 'NO_TENANT' },
  60:         { status: 403 }
  61:       );
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     // 2. VÃ©rifier les features
  65:     const features = Array.isArray(feature) ? feature : [feature];
  66:     
  67:     for (const f of features) {
  68:       const result = await checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, f);
  69:       
  70:       if (!result.allowed) {
  71:         return NextResponse.json(
  72:           {
  73:             error: 'FEATURE_GATED',
  74:             feature: result.feature,
  75:             currentTier: result.currentTier,
  76:             requiredTier: result.requiredTier,
  77:             message: result.message,
  78:             upgradeUrl: '/settings/billing?upgrade=true',
  79:           },
  80:           { status: 403 }
  81:         );
  82:       }
  83:     }
  84: 
  85:     // 3. ExÃ©cuter le handler
  86:     const firstFeature = features[0];
  87:     const gateResult = await checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, firstFeature);
  88:     
  89:     return handler(request, { ...context, featureGate: gateResult });
  90:   };
  91: }
  92: 
  93: /**
  94:  * Version lÃ©gÃ¨re : vÃ©rifie juste le feature gate et retourne le rÃ©sultat.
  95:  * Utile quand on veut gÃ©rer le comportement manuellement (soft gate).
  96:  *
  97:  * Usage :
  98:  *   const access = await softFeatureCheck(request, 'ai_draft_reply');
  99:  *   if (!access.allowed) {
 100:  *     // Montrer un message d'upgrade au lieu de bloquer
 101:  *   }
 102:  */
 103: export async function softFeatureCheck(
 104:   request: NextRequest,
 105:   feature: Feature,
 106: ): Promise<FeatureCheckResult & { tenantId: string | null }> {
 107:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 108:   const tenantId = (session?.user as any)?.tenantId || null;
 109: 
 110:   if (!tenantId) {
 111:     return {
 112:       allowed: false,
 113:       feature,
 114:       currentTier: 'PILOT',
 115:       requiredTier: 'PILOT',
 116:       upgradeRequired: false,
 117:       message: 'Utilisateur non authentifiÃ©',
 118:       tenantId: null,
 119:     };
 120:   }
 121: 
 122:   const result = await checkFeatureAccess(tenantId, feature);
 123:   return { ...result, tenantId };
 124: }

  41:    */

  43:     try {
  44:       const token = await legifranceOAuth.getValidToken();
  45: 
  46:       const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${endpoint}`, {
  47:         method: 'POST',
  48:         headers: {
  49:           'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
  50:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  51:           'Accept': 'application/json',
  52:         },
  53:         body: JSON.stringify(body),
  54:       });
  55: 
  56:       if (!response.ok) {
  57:         const errorText = await response.text();
  58:         
  59:         // Si 401, invalider le token et reessayer une fois
  60:         if (response.status === 401) {
  61:           legifranceOAuth.invalidateToken();
  62:           return this.request<T>(endpoint, body);
  63:         }
  64: 
  65:         throw new Error(
  66:           `Erreur API Legifrance (${response.status}): ${errorText}`
  67:         );
  68:       }
  69: 
  70:       return await response.json();
  71:     } catch (error) {
  72:       console.error(` Erreur requete Legifrance ${endpoint}:`, error);
  73:       throw error;
  74:     }

src\lib\legifrance\oauth-client.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * Client OAuth2.0 pour API Legifrance (PISTE)
   3:  *
   4:  * Gestion des tokens OAuth avec flux Client Credentials
   5:  * Documentation: https://developer.aife.economie.gouv.fr/
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: interface OAuthToken {
   9:   access_token: string;
  10:   token_type: 'Bearer';
  11:   expires_in: number;
  12:   scope: string;
  13:   expires_at: number; // Timestamp d'expiration calcule
  14: }
  15: 
  16: interface PisteConfig {
  17:   clientId: string;
  18:   clientSecret: string;
  19:   oauthUrl: string;
  20:   apiUrl: string;
  21:   environment: 'sandbox' | 'production';
  22: }
  23: 
  24: export class LegifranceOAuthClient {
  25:   private config: PisteConfig;
  26:   private token: OAuthToken | null = null;
  27:   private configured: boolean = false;
  28: 
  29:   constructor(environment: 'sandbox' | 'production' = 'sandbox') {
  30:     const isSandbox = environment === 'sandbox';
  31: 
  32:     this.config = {
  33:       clientId: isSandbox
  34:         ? process.env.PISTE_SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID || ''
  35:         : process.env.PISTE_PROD_CLIENT_ID || '',
  36:       clientSecret: isSandbox
  37:         ? process.env.PISTE_SANDBOX_CLIENT_SECRET || ''
  38:         : process.env.PISTE_PROD_CLIENT_SECRET || '',
  39:       oauthUrl: isSandbox
  40:         ? process.env.PISTE_SANDBOX_OAUTH_URL || 'https://sandbox-oauth.piste.gouv.fr/api/oauth/token'
  41:         : process.env.PISTE_PROD_OAUTH_URL || '',
  42:       apiUrl: isSandbox
  43:         ? process.env.PISTE_SANDBOX_API_URL || 'https://sandbox-api.piste.gouv.fr/dila/legifrance/lf-engine-app'
  44:         : process.env.PISTE_PROD_API_URL || '',
  45:       environment,
  46:     };
  47: 
  48:     // Validation configuration - juste un warning, pas d'erreur
  49:     this.configured = !!(this.config.clientId && this.config.clientSecret);
  50:     if (!this.configured) {
  51:       console.warn(
  52:         `? Configuration PISTE manquante pour l'environnement ${environment}. ` +
  53:         `L'API Legifrance sera desactivee.`
  54:       );
  55:     }
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   /**
  59:    * Verifie si le client est configure
  60:    */
  61:   isAvailable(): boolean {
  62:     return this.configured;
  63:   }
  64: 
  65:   /**
  66:    * Obtenir un token OAuth valide (recupere ou renouvelle)
  67:    */
  68:   async getValidToken(): Promise<string> {
  69:     if (!this.configured) {
  70:       throw new Error('API Legifrance non configuree');
  71:     }
  72: 
  73:     // Si token existant et encore valide (avec marge de 5 minutes)
  74:     if (this.token && this.token.expires_at > Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000) {
  75:       return this.token.access_token;
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     // Sinon, obtenir un nouveau token
  79:     await this.fetchNewToken();
  80:     return this.token!.access_token;
  81:   }
  82: 
  83:   /**
  84:    * Recuperer un nouveau token OAuth
  85:    */
  86:   private async fetchNewToken(): Promise<void> {
  87:     try {
  88:       const params = new URLSearchParams({
  89:         grant_type: 'client_credentials',
  90:         client_id: this.config.clientId,
  91:         client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
  92:         scope: 'openid',
  93:       });
  94: 
  95:       const response = await fetch(this.config.oauthUrl, {
  96:         method: 'POST',
  97:         headers: {
  98:           'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
  99:           'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip,deflate',
 100:           'User-Agent': 'IA-Poste-Manager/1.0',
 101:         },
 102:         body: params.toString(),
 103:       });
 104: 
 105:       if (!response.ok) {
 106:         const errorText = await response.text();
 107:         throw new Error(
 108:           `Erreur OAuth PISTE (${response.status}): ${errorText}`
 109:         );
 110:       }
 111: 
 112:       const data = await response.json();
 113: 
 114:       this.token = {
 115:         access_token: data.access_token,
 116:         token_type: data.token_type,
 117:         expires_in: data.expires_in,
 118:         scope: data.scope,
 119:         expires_at: Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000,
 120:       };
 121: 
 122:       console.log(
 123:         ` Token OAuth PISTE obtenu (${this.config.environment}). ` +
 124:         `Expire dans ${data.expires_in}s`
 125:       );
 126:     } catch (error) {
 127:       console.error(' Erreur obtention token PISTE:', error);
 128:       throw error;
 129:     }
 130:   }
 131: 
 132:   /**
 133:    * Obtenir l'URL de base de l'API
 134:    */
 135:   getApiUrl(): string {
 136:     return this.config.apiUrl;
 137:   }
 138: 
 139:   /**
 140:    * Obtenir l'environnement actuel
 141:    */
 142:   getEnvironment(): 'sandbox' | 'production' {
 143:     return this.config.environment;
 144:   }
 145: 
 146:   /**
 147:    * Verifier si le client est configure
 148:    */
 149:   isConfigured(): boolean {
 150:     return !!(this.config.clientId && this.config.clientSecret);
 151:   }
 152: 
 153:   /**
 154:    * Invalider le token actuel (force un renouvellement)
 155:    */
 156:   invalidateToken(): void {
 157:     this.token = null;
 158:   }
 159: }
 160: 
 161: // Instance singleton selon environnement (.env)
 162: const environment = (process.env.PISTE_ENVIRONMENT || 'sandbox') as 'sandbox' | 'production';
 163: export const legifranceOAuth = new LegifranceOAuthClient(environment);
 164: 
 165: // Export pour tests ou usage multi-environnements
 166: export const createLegifranceOAuth = (env: 'sandbox' | 'production') => {
 167:   return new LegifranceOAuthClient(env);
 168: };

src\lib\middleware\compression.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * API Response Compression Middleware
   3:  * 
   4:  * Implements Brotli/Gzip compression for API responses
   5:  * Reduces payload size and improves transfer speed
   6:  * 
   7:  * GDPR compliant - no data modification, only compression
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  11: import { gzip, brotliCompress } from 'zlib';
  12: import { promisify } from 'util';
  13: 
  14: const gzipAsync = promisify(gzip);
  15: const brotliAsync = promisify(brotliCompress);
  16: 
  17: // Minimum size to compress (bytes)
  18: const MIN_COMPRESS_SIZE = 1024; // 1KB
  19: 
  20: // Compressible MIME types
  21: const COMPRESSIBLE_TYPES = [
  22:     'application/json',
  23:     'application/javascript',
  24:     'text/html',
  25:     'text/css',
  26:     'text/plain',
  27:     'text/xml',
  28:     'application/xml',
  29:     'image/svg+xml',
  30: ];
  31: 
  32: /**
  33:  * Compression middleware
  34:  */
  35: export async function compressResponse(
  36:     request: NextRequest,
  37:     response: NextResponse
  38: ): Promise<NextResponse> {
  39:     // Skip if already compressed
  40:     if (response.headers.get('Content-Encoding')) {
  41:         return response;
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     // Check Accept-Encoding header
  45:     const acceptEncoding = request.headers.get('Accept-Encoding') || '';
  46:     const supportsBrotli = acceptEncoding.includes('br');
  47:     const supportsGzip = acceptEncoding.includes('gzip');
  48: 
  49:     if (!supportsBrotli && !supportsGzip) {
  50:         return response; // Client doesn't support compression
  51:     }
  52: 
  53:     // Check content type
  54:     const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
  55:     const isCompressible = COMPRESSIBLE_TYPES.some(type =>
  56:         contentType.includes(type)
  57:     );
  58: 
  59:     if (!isCompressible) {
  60:         return response; // Not a compressible type
  61:     }
  62: 
  63:     // Get response body
  64:     const body = await response.text();
  65: 
  66:     // Check size threshold
  67:     if (body.length < MIN_COMPRESS_SIZE) {
  68:         return response; // Too small to benefit from compression
  69:     }
  70: 
  71:     try {
  72:         let compressed: Buffer;
  73:         let encoding: string;
  74: 
  75:         // Prefer Brotli (better compression)
  76:         if (supportsBrotli) {
  77:             compressed = await brotliAsync(Buffer.from(body));
  78:             encoding = 'br';
  79:         } else {
  80:             compressed = await gzipAsync(Buffer.from(body));
  81:             encoding = 'gzip';
  82:         }
  83: 
  84:         // Only use compression if it reduces size
  85:         if (compressed.length < body.length) {
  86:             // Create new response with compressed body
  87:             const headers = new Headers(response.headers);
  88:             headers.set('Content-Encoding', encoding);
  89:             headers.set('Content-Length', compressed.length.toString());
  90:             headers.set('Vary', 'Accept-Encoding');
  91:             headers.delete('Content-Length'); // Let Next.js set this
  92: 
  93:             const arrayBuf = compressed.buffer.slice(
  94:                 compressed.byteOffset,
  95:                 compressed.byteOffset + compressed.byteLength
  96:             ) as ArrayBuffer;
  97:             return new NextResponse(arrayBuf, {
  98:                 status: response.status,
  99:                 statusText: response.statusText,
 100:                 headers,
 101:             });
 102:         }
 103:     } catch (error) {
 104:         console.error('Compression error:', error);
 105:     }
 106: 
 107:     // Return original response if compression fails or doesn't help
 108:     return response;
 109: }
 110: 
 111: /**
 112:  * Compression utility functions
 113:  */
 114: export class CompressionUtils {
 115:     /**
 116:      * Compress string with Brotli
 117:      */
 118:     static async brotli(data: string): Promise<Buffer> {
 119:         return brotliAsync(Buffer.from(data));
 120:     }
 121: 
 122:     /**
 123:      * Compress string with Gzip
 124:      */
 125:     static async gzip(data: string): Promise<Buffer> {
 126:         return gzipAsync(Buffer.from(data));
 127:     }
 128: 
 129:     /**
 130:      * Get compression ratio
 131:      */
 132:     static getCompressionRatio(original: number, compressed: number): number {
 133:         return Math.round((1 - compressed / original) * 100);
 134:     }
 135: 
 136:     /**
 137:      * Format bytes
 138:      */
 139:     static formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
 140:         if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';
 141:         const k = 1024;
 142:         const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
 143:         const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
 144:         return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];
 145:     }
 146: }
 147: 
 148: /**
 149:  * API endpoint wrapper with compression
 150:  */
 151: export function withCompression(
 152:     handler: (req: NextRequest) => Promise<NextResponse>
 153: ) {
 154:     return async (req: NextRequest) => {
 155:         const response = await handler(req);
 156:         return compressResponse(req, response);
 157:     };
 158: }
 159: 
 160: /**
 161:  * Compression stats for monitoring
 162:  */
 163: export class CompressionMonitor {
 164:     private static stats = {
 165:         requests: 0,
 166:         compressed: 0,
 167:         originalSize: 0,
 168:         compressedSize: 0,
 169:     };
 170: 
 171:     static record(originalSize: number, compressedSize: number) {
 172:         this.stats.requests++;
 173:         this.stats.compressed++;
 174:         this.stats.originalSize += originalSize;
 175:         this.stats.compressedSize += compressedSize;
 176:     }
 177: 
 178:     static getStats() {
 179:         const {
 180:             requests,
 181:             compressed,
 182:             originalSize,
 183:             compressedSize,
 184:         } = this.stats;
 185: 
 186:         const compressionRate = requests > 0 ? (compressed / requests) * 100 : 0;
 187:         const avgRatio = originalSize > 0
 188:             ? CompressionUtils.getCompressionRatio(originalSize, compressedSize)
 189:             : 0;
 190: 
 191:         return {
 192:             totalRequests: requests,
 193:             compressedRequests: compressed,
 194:             compressionRate: Math.round(compressionRate * 100) / 100,
 195:             originalSize: CompressionUtils.formatBytes(originalSize),
 196:             compressedSize: CompressionUtils.formatBytes(compressedSize),
 197:             savedBytes: CompressionUtils.formatBytes(originalSize - compressedSize),
 198:             avgCompressionRatio: avgRatio,
 199:         };
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     static reset() {
 203:         this.stats = {
 204:             requests: 0,
 205:             compressed: 0,
 206:             originalSize: 0,
 207:             compressedSize: 0,
 208:         };
 209:     }
 210: }
 211:

src\lib\middleware\feature-gate.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: import { getBlockedFeature } from '@/lib/feature-flags';
   3: 
   4: /**
   5:  * API Feature Gate Middleware
   6:  * 
   7:  * Blocks API routes for disabled feature modules.
   8:  * Returns a clean 404 with a message indicating the feature is not available.
   9:  * 
  10:  * Usage in API routes:
  11:  *   import { featureGateResponse } from '@/lib/middleware/feature-gate';
  12:  *   
  13:  *   export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  14:  *     const blocked = featureGateResponse(request);
  15:  *     if (blocked) return blocked;
  16:  *     // ... normal handler
  17:  *   }
  18:  * 
  19:  * Or use the wrapper:
  20:  *   import { withFeatureGate } from '@/lib/middleware/feature-gate';
  21:  *   
  22:  *   export const GET = withFeatureGate(async (request) => {
  23:  *     // ... normal handler
  24:  *   });
  25:  */
  26: 
  27: /**
  28:  * Check if the request should be blocked. Returns a 404 response if blocked, null otherwise.
  29:  */
  30: export function featureGateResponse(request: NextRequest): NextResponse | null {
  31:   const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;
  32:   const blockedModule = getBlockedFeature(pathname);
  33: 
  34:   if (blockedModule) {
  35:     return NextResponse.json(
  36:       {
  37:         error: 'Feature not available',
  38:         message: `Le module "${blockedModule}" n'est pas disponible dans votre plan actuel.`,
  39:         code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED',
  40:         module: blockedModule,
  41:       },
  42:       { status: 404 }
  43:     );
  44:   }
  45: 
  46:   return null;
  47: }
  48: 
  49: /**
  50:  * HOF wrapper that adds feature gate check before the handler
  51:  */
  52: export function withFeatureGate(
  53:   handler: (request: NextRequest, context?: unknown) => Promise<NextResponse> | NextResponse
  54: ) {
  55:   return async (request: NextRequest, context?: unknown) => {
  56:     const blocked = featureGateResponse(request);
  57:     if (blocked) return blocked;
  58:     return handler(request, context);
  59:   };
  60: }

src\lib\middleware\parse-json.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   2: 
   3: export type ParseResult<T> =
   4:   | { success: true; data: T }
   5:   | { success: false; response: NextResponse };
   6: 
   7: /**
   8:  * Parse et valide le body JSON d'une requÃªte.
   9:  * VÃ©rifie le Content-Type et gÃ¨re les erreurs de parsing.
  10:  *
  11:  * @example
  12:  * const parsed = await parseJsonBody<CreateDossierRequest>(request);
  13:  * if (!parsed.success) return parsed.response;
  14:  * const data = parsed.data;
  15:  */
  16: export async function parseJsonBody<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
  17:   request: NextRequest
  18: ): Promise<ParseResult<T>> {
  19:   const contentType = request.headers.get('content-type');
  20:   if (!contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
  21:     return {
  22:       success: false,
  23:       response: NextResponse.json(
  24:         { error: 'Content-Type application/json requis.' },
  25:         { status: 415 }
  26:       ),
  27:     };
  28:   }
  29: 
  30:   try {
  31:     const data = await request.json() as T;
  32:     return { success: true, data };
  33:   } catch {
  34:     return {
  35:       success: false,
  36:       response: NextResponse.json(
  37:         { error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' },
  38:         { status: 400 }
  39:       ),
  40:     };
  41:   }
  42: }

src\lib\middleware\rate-limit.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware Rate Limiting pour les API Next.js
   3:  * Wrapper centralisÃ© pour appliquer le rate limiting Ã  toutes les routes
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth/authOptions';
   7: import { checkRateLimit, RATE_LIMITS } from '@/lib/security/rate-limiter';
   8: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   9: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  10: 
  11: type RateLimitType = keyof typeof RATE_LIMITS;
  12: 
  13: interface RateLimitMiddlewareOptions {
  14:   type?: RateLimitType;
  15:   customConfig?: {
  16:     windowMs: number;
  17:     maxRequests: number;
  18:     blockDuration?: number;
  19:   };
  20:   keyGenerator?: (req: NextRequest) => string;
  21: }
  22: 
  23: /**
  24:  * Extraire l'IP du client
  25:  */
  26: function getClientIP(req: NextRequest): string {
  27:   const forwarded = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  28:   const realIP = req.headers.get('x-real-ip');
  29: 
  30:   if (forwarded) {
  31:     return forwarded.split(',')[0].trim();
  32:   }
  33: 
  34:   if (realIP) {
  35:     return realIP;
  36:   }
  37: 
  38:   return '127.0.0.1';
  39: }
  40: 
  41: /**
  42:  * CrÃ©er une rÃ©ponse rate limit
  43:  */
  44: function createRateLimitResponse(resetIn: number): NextResponse {
  45:   return NextResponse.json(
  46:     {
  47:       success: false,
  48:       error: 'Too Many Requests',
  49:       message: 'Vous avez dÃ©passÃ© la limite de requÃªtes. Veuillez rÃ©essayer plus tard.',
  50:       retryAfter: Math.ceil(resetIn / 1000),
  51:     },
  52:     {
  53:       status: 429,
  54:       headers: {
  55:         'Retry-After': String(Math.ceil(resetIn / 1000)),
  56:         'X-RateLimit-Limit': '0',
  57:         'X-RateLimit-Remaining': '0',
  58:         'X-RateLimit-Reset': String(Date.now() + resetIn),
  59:       },
  60:     }
  61:   );
  62: }
  63: 
  64: /**
  65:  * Higher-order function pour wrapper un handler avec rate limiting
  66:  */
  67: export function withRateLimit<T>(
  68:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>,
  69:   options: RateLimitMiddlewareOptions = {}
  70: ) {
  71:   return async (req: NextRequest, context?: T): Promise<NextResponse> => {
  72:     const { type = 'api', customConfig, keyGenerator } = options;
  73: 
  74:     // DÃ©terminer la configuration
  75:     const config = customConfig || RATE_LIMITS[type];
  76: 
  77:     // GÃ©nÃ©rer l'identifiant (IP par dÃ©faut, ou userId si authentifiÃ©)
  78:     let identifier: string;
  79: 
  80:     if (keyGenerator) {
  81:       identifier = keyGenerator(req);
  82:     } else {
  83:       const ip = getClientIP(req);
  84: 
  85:       // Essayer d'obtenir l'utilisateur authentifiÃ©
  86:       try {
  87:         const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  88:         if (session?.user?.id) {
  89:           identifier = `user:${session.user.id}`;
  90:         } else {
  91:           identifier = `ip:${ip}`;
  92:         }
  93:       } catch {
  94:         identifier = `ip:${ip}`;
  95:       }
  96:     }
  97: 
  98:     // Ajouter le path pour diffÃ©rencier les endpoints
  99:     const path = req.nextUrl.pathname;
 100:     const fullIdentifier = `${identifier}:${path}`;
 101: 
 102:     // VÃ©rifier le rate limit
 103:     const { allowed, remaining, resetIn } = checkRateLimit(fullIdentifier, config);
 104: 
 105:     if (!allowed) {
 106:       return createRateLimitResponse(resetIn);
 107:     }
 108: 
 109:     // ExÃ©cuter le handler original
 110:     let response: NextResponse;
 111:     try {
 112:       response = await handler(req, context);
 113:     } catch (error) {
 114:       // Catch unhandled errors from the handler (e.g., malformed request body)
 115:       const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
 116:       const isJsonParseError = message.includes('JSON') && message.includes('position');
 117:       
 118:       if (isJsonParseError) {
 119:         return NextResponse.json(
 120:           { error: 'Corps de requÃªte invalide. JSON attendu.' },
 121:           { status: 400 }
 122:         );
 123:       }
 124: 
 125:       return NextResponse.json(
 126:         { error: 'Erreur interne du serveur' },
 127:         { status: 500 }
 128:       );
 129:     }
 130: 
 131:     // Ajouter les headers de rate limit
 132:     response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Limit', String(config.maxRequests));
 133:     response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Remaining', String(remaining));
 134:     response.headers.set('X-RateLimit-Reset', String(Date.now() + resetIn));
 135: 
 136:     return response;
 137:   };
 138: }
 139: 
 140: /**
 141:  * DÃ©corateurs spÃ©cialisÃ©s par type d'endpoint
 142:  */
 143: export const withLoginRateLimit = <T>(
 144:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>
 145: ) => withRateLimit(handler, { type: 'login' });
 146: 
 147: export const withUploadRateLimit = <T>(
 148:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>
 149: ) => withRateLimit(handler, { type: 'upload' });
 150: 
 151: export const withAIRateLimit = <T>(
 152:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>
 153: ) => withRateLimit(handler, { type: 'ai' });
 154: 
 155: export const withExportRateLimit = <T>(
 156:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>
 157: ) => withRateLimit(handler, { type: 'export' });
 158: 
 159: export const withEmailRateLimit = <T>(
 160:   handler: (req: NextRequest, context?: T) => Promise<NextResponse>
 161: ) => withRateLimit(handler, { type: 'email' });
 162: 
 163: /**
 164:  * Rate limiting global via middleware Next.js
 165:  * Ã€ ajouter dans middleware.ts
 166:  */
 167: export async function rateLimitMiddleware(req: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse | null> {
 168:   const path = req.nextUrl.pathname;
 169: 
 170:   // Ignorer les assets statiques
 171:   if (
 172:     path.startsWith('/_next') ||
 173:     path.startsWith('/static') ||
 174:     path.includes('.') // fichiers statiques
 175:   ) {
 176:     return null;
 177:   }
 178: 
 179:   // DÃ©terminer le type de rate limit
 180:   let type: RateLimitType = 'api';
 181: 
 182:   if (path.includes('/auth/') || path.includes('/login')) {
 183:     type = 'login';
 184:   } else if (path.includes('/upload')) {
 185:     type = 'upload';
 186:   } else if (path.includes('/ai') || path.includes('/analyze')) {
 187:     type = 'ai';
 188:   } else if (path.includes('/export')) {
 189:     type = 'export';
 190:   } else if (path.includes('/email')) {
 191:     type = 'email';
 192:   }
 193: 
 194:   const ip = getClientIP(req);
 195:   const identifier = `ip:${ip}:${path}`;
 196: 
 197:   const config = RATE_LIMITS[type];
 198:   const { allowed, resetIn } = checkRateLimit(identifier, config);
 199: 
 200:   if (!allowed) {
 201:     return createRateLimitResponse(resetIn);
 202:   }
 203: 
 204:   return null;
 205: }
 206: 
 207: export default withRateLimit;

   3: /**
   4:  * Google Calendar API connector
   5:  * Requires scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar
   6:  */
   7: export class GoogleCalendarConnector {
   8:   async listEvents(accessToken: string, options?: { timeMin?: string; timeMax?: string }) {
   9:     try {
  10:       const params = new URLSearchParams();
  11:       if (options?.timeMin) params.append('timeMin', options.timeMin);
  12:       if (options?.timeMax) params.append('timeMax', options.timeMax);
  13:       params.append('singleEvents', 'true');
  14:       params.append('orderBy', 'startTime');
  15: 
  16:       const res = await fetch(
  17:         `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?${params.toString()}`,
  18:         {
  19:           headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
  20:         }
  21:       );
  22: 
  23:       if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  24: 
  25:       const data = await res.json();
  26:       return data.items || [];
  27:     } catch (e: any) {
  28:       throw new OAuthServiceError('google', `Calendar listEvents failed: ${e.message}`);
  29:     }
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   async createEvent(
  33:     accessToken: string,
  34:     event: {
  35:       summary: string;
  36:       description?: string;
  37:       start: { dateTime: string; timeZone: string };
  38:       end: { dateTime: string; timeZone: string };
  39:       attendees?: { email: string; displayName?: string }[];
  40:     }
  41:   ) {
  42:     try {
  43:       const res = await fetch('https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events', {
  44:         method: 'POST',
  45:         headers: {
  46:           Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
  47:           'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  48:         },
  49:         body: JSON.stringify(event),
  50:       });
  51: 
  52:       if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  53:       return await res.json();
  54:     } catch (e: any) {
  55:       throw new OAuthServiceError('google', `Calendar createEvent failed: ${e.message}`);
  56:     }
  57:   }
  58: }

   1: import type { OAuthProvider } from '@/lib/oauth/oauth-service';
   2: import { oauthTokenService } from '@/lib/oauth/token-service';
   3: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * Middleware to ensure OAuth token is valid
   7:  * Automatically refreshes if needed
   8:  */
   9: export async function withOAuthToken(provider: OAuthProvider) {
  10:   const session = await getServerSession();
  11: 
  12:   if (!session?.user?.id) {
  13:     throw new Error('Unauthorized');
  14:   }
  15: 
  16:   try {
  17:     const token = await oauthTokenService.ensureValidToken(session.user.id, provider);
  18:     return token;
  19:   } catch (e: any) {
  20:     throw new Error(`OAuth token access denied: ${e.message}`);
  21:   }
  22: }
  23: 
  24: /**
  25:  * Utility to get OAuth token with optional refresh
  26:  */
  27: export async function getOAuthToken(provider: OAuthProvider, userId: string) {
  28:   return oauthTokenService.ensureValidToken(userId, provider);
  29: }

src\lib\oauth\oauth-service.ts

   1: import { z } from 'zod';
   2: 
   3: export type OAuthProvider = 'google' | 'microsoft' | 'github';
   4: 
   5: export const OAuthConfigSchema = z.object({
   6:   clientId: z.string().min(1),
   7:   clientSecret: z.string().min(1),
   8:   redirectUri: z.string().url(),
   9: });
  10: 
  11: export type OAuthConfig = z.infer<typeof OAuthConfigSchema>;
  12: 
  13: export class OAuthServiceError extends Error {
  14:   constructor(
  15:     public provider: OAuthProvider,
  16:     message: string,
  17:     public cause?: any
  18:   ) {
  19:     super(`OAuth error [${provider}]: ${message}`);
  20:   }
  21: }
  22: 
  23: /**
  24:  * Base OAuth service connector
  25:  * Handles token exchange, refresh, and user info retrieval
  26:  */
  27: export abstract class BaseOAuthConnector {
  28:   protected config: OAuthConfig;
  29:   protected provider: OAuthProvider;
  30: 
  31:   constructor(provider: OAuthProvider, config: OAuthConfig) {
  32:     this.provider = provider;
  33:     this.config = OAuthConfigSchema.parse(config);
  34:   }
  35: 
  36:   abstract getAuthorizationUrl(state: string, scopes?: string[]): string;
  37:   abstract exchangeCode(
  38:     code: string
  39:   ): Promise<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken?: string; expiresIn: number }>;
  40:   abstract refreshToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<{ accessToken: string; expiresIn: number }>;
  41:   abstract getUserInfo(accessToken: string): Promise<any>;
  42: 
  43:   protected async fetchOAuth(url: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<any> {
  44:     try {
  45:       const res = await fetch(url, {
  46:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  47:         ...options,
  48:       });
  49: 
  50:       if (!res.ok) {
  51:         throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);
  52:       }
  53: 
  54:       return await res.json();
  55:     } catch (e: any) {
  56:       throw new OAuthServiceError(this.provider, e.message, e);
  57:     }
  58:   }
  59: }
  60: 
  61: /**
  62:  * Google OAuth connector
  63:  * Supports Calendar, Contacts, and basic profile scopes
  64:  */
  65: export class GoogleOAuthConnector extends BaseOAuthConnector {
  66:   constructor(config: OAuthConfig) {
  67:     super('google', config);
  68:   }
  69: 
  70:   getAuthorizationUrl(state: string, scopes: string[] = ['openid', 'profile', 'email']): string {
  71:     const params = new URLSearchParams({
  72:       client_id: this.config.clientId,
  73:       redirect_uri: this.config.redirectUri,
  74:       response_type: 'code',
  75:       scope: scopes.join(' '),
  76:       state,
  77:       access_type: 'offline',
  78:       prompt: 'consent',
  79:     });
  80:     return `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?${params.toString()}`;
  81:   }
  82: 
  83:   async exchangeCode(code: string) {
  84:     const data = await this.fetchOAuth('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
  85:       method: 'POST',
  86:       body: JSON.stringify({
  87:         code,
  88:         client_id: this.config.clientId,
  89:         client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
  90:         redirect_uri: this.config.redirectUri,
  91:         grant_type: 'authorization_code',
  92:       }),
  93:     });
  94: 
  95:     return {
  96:       accessToken: data.access_token,
  97:       refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
  98:       expiresIn: data.expires_in,
  99:     };
 100:   }
 101: 
 102:   async refreshToken(refreshToken: string) {
 103:     const data = await this.fetchOAuth('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
 104:       method: 'POST',
 105:       body: JSON.stringify({
 106:         client_id: this.config.clientId,
 107:         client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
 108:         refresh_token: refreshToken,
 109:         grant_type: 'refresh_token',
 110:       }),
 111:     });
 112:

 114:       accessToken: data.access_token,
 115:       expiresIn: data.expires_in,

src\lib\oauth\token-service.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { oauthService, type OAuthProvider } from './oauth-service';
   2: 
   3: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   4: 
   5: export type OAuthTokenData = {
   6:   provider: OAuthProvider;
   7:   accessToken: string;
   8:   refreshToken?: string;
   9:   expiresIn: number;
  10:   scope?: string;
  11: };
  12: 
  13: /**
  14:  * Service for managing stored OAuth tokens
  15:  * Handles persistence, refresh, and revocation
  16:  */
  17: export class OAuthTokenService {
  18:   /**
  19:    * Store or update OAuth token for a user
  20:    */
  21:   async storeToken(userId: string, tokenData: OAuthTokenData) {
  22:     const expiresAt = tokenData.expiresIn
  23:       ? new Date(Date.now() + tokenData.expiresIn * 1000)
  24:       : null;
  25: 
  26:     return prisma.oAuthToken.upsert({
  27:       where: {
  28:         userId_provider: {
  29:           userId,
  30:           provider: tokenData.provider,
  31:         },
  32:       },
  33:       update: {
  34:         accessToken: tokenData.accessToken,
  35:         refreshToken: tokenData.refreshToken,
  36:         expiresAt,
  37:         scope: tokenData.scope,
  38:         lastUsedAt: new Date(),
  39:       },
  40:       create: {
  41:         userId,
  42:         provider: tokenData.provider,
  43:         accessToken: tokenData.accessToken,
  44:         refreshToken: tokenData.refreshToken,
  45:         expiresAt,
  46:         scope: tokenData.scope,
  47:       },
  48:     });
  49:   }
  50: 
  51:   /**
  52:    * Get stored token for a user and provider
  53:    */
  54:   async getToken(userId: string, provider: OAuthProvider) {
  55:     const token = await prisma.oAuthToken.findUnique({
  56:       where: {
  57:         userId_provider: {
  58:           userId,
  59:           provider,
  60:         },
  61:       },
  62:     });
  63: 
  64:     if (token?.revokedAt) {
  65:       throw new Error(`OAuth token for ${provider} has been revoked`);
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     return token;
  69:   }
  70: 
  71:   /**
  72:    * Check if token is expired and refresh if needed
  73:    */
  74:   async ensureValidToken(userId: string, provider: OAuthProvider): Promise<string> {
  75:     const token = await this.getToken(userId, provider);
  76: 
  77:     if (!token) {
  78:       throw new Error(`No OAuth token found for ${provider}`);
  79:     }
  80: 
  81:     // If token is expiring within 5 minutes, refresh it
  82:     if (token.expiresAt && new Date() > new Date(token.expiresAt.getTime() - 5 * 60 * 1000)) {
  83:       if (!token.refreshToken) {
  84:         throw new Error(`Cannot refresh ${provider} token without refresh token`);
  85:       }
  86: 
  87:       try {
  88:         const refreshed = await oauthService.refreshToken(provider, token.refreshToken);
  89:         await this.storeToken(userId, {
  90:           provider,
  91:           accessToken: refreshed.accessToken,
  92:           refreshToken: token.refreshToken, // Keep old refresh token if new one not provided
  93:           expiresIn: refreshed.expiresIn,
  94:         });
  95: 
  96:         return refreshed.accessToken;
  97:       } catch (e: any) {
  98:         // If refresh fails, require re-authentication
  99:         await this.revokeToken(userId, provider, 'Refresh failed');
 100:         throw new Error(`Failed to refresh ${provider} token: ${e.message}`);
 101:       }
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     // Update last used
 105:     await prisma.oAuthToken.update({
 106:       where: {
 107:         userId_provider: {
 108:           userId,
 109:           provider,
 110:         },
 111:       },
 112:       data: { lastUsedAt: new Date() },
 113:     });
 114: 
 115:     return token.accessToken;
 116:   }
 117: 
 118:   /**
 119:    * Revoke token
 120:    */
 121:   async revokeToken(userId: string, provider: OAuthProvider, reason?: string) {
 122:     const token = await prisma.oAuthToken.findUnique({
 123:       where: {
 124:         userId_provider: {
 125:           userId,
 126:           provider,
 127:         },
 128:       },
 129:     });
 130: 
 131:     if (!token) return null;
 132: 
 133:     return prisma.oAuthToken.update({
 134:       where: { id: token.id },
 135:       data: {
 136:         revokedAt: new Date(),
 137:         accessToken: '', // Clear token data for security
 138:         refreshToken: null,
 139:       },
 140:     });
 141:   }
 142: 
 143:   /**
 144:    * List all connected OAuth providers for a user
 145:    */
 146:   async getConnectedProviders(userId: string) {
 147:     const tokens = await prisma.oAuthToken.findMany({
 148:       where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
 149:       select: {
 150:         provider: true,
 151:         scope: true,
 152:         connectedAt: true,
 153:         lastUsedAt: true,
 154:       },
 155:     });
 156: 
 157:     return tokens;
 158:   }
 159: 
 160:   /**
 161:    * Get all OAuth tokens for a user (without sensitive data)
 162:    */
 163:   async listTokens(userId: string) {
 164:     return prisma.oAuthToken.findMany({
 165:       where: { userId },
 166:       select: {
 167:         id: true,
 168:         provider: true,
 169:         scope: true,
 170:         connectedAt: true,
 171:         lastUsedAt: true,
 172:         revokedAt: true,
 173:       },
 174:       orderBy: { connectedAt: 'desc' },
 175:     });
 176:   }
 177: }
 178: 
 179: export const oauthTokenService = new OAuthTokenService();

src\lib\security\two-factor-auth.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) System
   4:  * - TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password)
   5:  * - QR code generation for authenticator apps
   6:  * - Backup codes for account recovery
   7:  * - Enforce 2FA for admins
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import crypto from 'crypto';
  11: import { authenticator } from 'otplib';
  12: import QRCode from 'qrcode';
  13: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
  14: 
  15: /**
  16:  * Generate 2FA secret for user
  17:  */
  18: export function generate2FASecret(userEmail: string): {
  19:   secret: string;
  20:   qrCodeUrl: string;
  21: } {
  22:   const secret = authenticator.generateSecret();
  23:   const otpauthUrl = authenticator.keyuri(userEmail, 'memoLib', secret);
  24: 
  25:   return {
  26:     secret,
  27:     qrCodeUrl: otpauthUrl,
  28:   };
  29: }
  30: 
  31: /**
  32:  * Generate QR code image for 2FA setup
  33:  */
  34: export async function generateQRCode(otpauthUrl: string): Promise<string> {
  35:   try {
  36:     const qrCodeDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(otpauthUrl);
  37:     return qrCodeDataUrl;
  38:   } catch (error) {
  39:     console.error('[2FA] QR code generation failed:', error);
  40:     throw new Error('Failed to generate QR code');
  41:   }
  42: }
  43: 
  44: /**
  45:  * Verify 2FA token
  46:  */
  47: export function verify2FAToken(token: string, secret: string): boolean {
  48:   try {
  49:     return authenticator.check(token, secret);
  50:   } catch (error) {
  51:     console.error('[2FA] Token verification failed:', error);
  52:     return false;
  53:   }
  54: }
  55: 
  56: /**
  57:  * Generate backup codes for account recovery
  58:  */
  59: export function generateBackupCodes(count: number = 10): string[] {
  60:   const codes: string[] = [];
  61: 
  62:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
  63:     const code = crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex').toUpperCase();
  64:     codes.push(code);
  65:   }
  66: 
  67:   return codes;
  68: }
  69: 
  70: /**
  71:  * Hash backup code for storage
  72:  */
  73: export function hashBackupCode(code: string): string {
  74:   return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(code).digest('hex');
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /**
  78:  * Verify backup code
  79:  */
  80: export function verifyBackupCode(providedCode: string, hashedCodes: string[]): boolean {
  81:   const hashedProvided = hashBackupCode(providedCode);
  82:   return hashedCodes.includes(hashedProvided);
  83: }
  84: 
  85: /**
  86:  * Check if 2FA is required for user role
  87:  */
  88: export function is2FARequired(userRole: string): boolean {
  89:   return ['SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN'].includes(userRole);
  90: }
  91: 
  92: /**
  93:  * 2FA setup flow for user
  94:  */
  95: export interface TwoFactorSetup {
  96:   secret: string;
  97:   qrCode: string;
  98:   backupCodes: string[];
  99: }
 100: 
 101: export async function setup2FA(userEmail: string): Promise<TwoFactorSetup> {
 102:   const { secret, qrCodeUrl } = generate2FASecret(userEmail);
 103:   const qrCode = await generateQRCode(qrCodeUrl);
 104:   const backupCodes = generateBackupCodes();
 105: 
 106:   return {
 107:     secret,
 108:     qrCode,
 109:     backupCodes,
 110:   };
 111: }
 112: 
 113: /**
 114:  * Validate 2FA during login
 115:  */
 116: export async function validate2FALogin(
 117:   userId: string,
 118:   token: string,
 119:   secret: string,
 120:   backupCodes: string[]
 121: ): Promise<{ success: boolean; usedBackupCode?: boolean }> {
 122:   // First try TOTP token
 123:   if (verify2FAToken(token, secret)) {
 124:     return { success: true };
 125:   }
 126: 
 127:   // If TOTP fails, try backup code
 128:   if (verifyBackupCode(token, backupCodes)) {
 129:     // Mark backup code as used (remove from list)
 130:     const hashedToken = hashBackupCode(token);
 131:     const updatedCodes = backupCodes.filter(code => code !== hashedToken);
 132: 
 133:     // Update user's backup codes in database
 134:     try {
 135:       await prisma.user.update({
 136:         where: { id: userId },
 137:         data: { backupCodes: updatedCodes },
 138:       });
 139:     } catch (error) {
 140:       console.error('[2FA] Failed to update backup codes:', error);
 141:     }
 142: 
 143:     return { success: true, usedBackupCode: true };
 144:   }
 145: 
 146:   return { success: false };
 147: }
 148: 
 149: /**
 150:  * Enforce 2FA for sensitive operations
 151:  */
 152: export function require2FA(userRole: string) {
 153:   return (target: any, propertyKey: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) => {
 154:     const originalMethod = descriptor.value;
 155: 
 156:     descriptor.value = async function (...args: any[]) {
 157:       const session = args[0]?.session; // Assume first arg contains session
 158: 
 159:       if (is2FARequired(userRole) && !session?.user?.twoFactorVerified) {
 160:         throw new Error('2FA verification required for this operation');
 161:       }
 162: 
 163:       return originalMethod.apply(this, args);
 164:     };
 165: 
 166:     return descriptor;
 167:   };
 168: }

  72:   .strict();

  77:   role: string;
  78: };

  92:   | { kind: 'not_found' }
  93:   | { kind: 'forbidden' }
  94:   | { kind: 'conflict'; proposal: unknown };

  96: export const ACTION_PROPOSAL_EXECUTION_POLICY = 'RECORD_DECISION_ONLY' as const;

  98: export async function getActionProposalAccess(): Promise<ActionProposalAccessResult> {
  99:   const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
 100:   if (!session?.user?.id) {
 101:     return { kind: 'unauthenticated' };
 102:   }
 103: 
 104:   const tenantId = session.user.tenantId;
 105:   const role = session.user.role?.toUpperCase() ?? '';
 106:   if (!tenantId || !allowedRoles.has(role)) {
 107:     return { kind: 'forbidden' };
 108:   }
 109: 
 110:   return {
 111:     kind: 'ok',
 112:     actor: {
 113:       tenantId,
 114:       userId: session.user.id,
 115:       role,
 116:     },
 117:   };
 118: }

 122:   query: z.infer<typeof ActionProposalListQuerySchema>

 124:   const where = {
 125:     tenantId: actor.tenantId,
 126:     ...(query.status ? { status: query.status } : {}),
 127:     ...(query.dossierId ? { dossierId: query.dossierId } : {}),
 128:   };
 129: 
 130:   const [proposals, total] = await Promise.all([
 131:     prisma.actionProposal.findMany({
 132:       where,
 133:       orderBy: [{ priority: 'desc' }, { proposedAt: 'desc' }],
 134:       take: query.limit,
 135:       skip: query.offset,
 136:     }),
 137:     prisma.actionProposal.count({ where }),
 138:   ]);
 139: 
 140:   return { proposals, total, hasMore: query.offset + proposals.length < total };

 182: export async function decideActionProposal(
 183:   actor: ActionProposalActor,
 184:   id: string,
 185:   decision: ActionProposalDecision,
 186:   reason?: string
 187: ): Promise<ActionProposalDecisionResult> {
 188:   const existing = await prisma.actionProposal.findUnique({
 189:     where: { id },
 190:     select: { id: true, tenantId: true },
 191:   });
 192:   if (!existing) {
 193:     return { kind: 'not_found' };
 194:   }
 195:   if (existing.tenantId !== actor.tenantId) {
 196:     return { kind: 'forbidden' };
 197:   }
 198: 
 199:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx: ActionProposalTransaction) => {
 200:     const decisionAt = new Date();
 201:     const update = await tx.actionProposal.updateMany({
 202:       where: {
 203:         id,
 204:         tenantId: actor.tenantId,
 205:         status: ActionProposalStatus.PENDING,
 206:       },
 207:       data: {
 208:         status: decision,
 209:         decidedAt: decisionAt,
 210:         decidedBy: actor.userId,
 211:         decisionReason: reason ?? null,
 212:         ...(decision === ActionProposalStatus.APPROVED
 213:           ? {
 214:               executedAt: null,
 215:               executedBy: null,
 216:               executionResult: JSON.stringify({
 217:                 policy: ACTION_PROPOSAL_EXECUTION_POLICY,
 218:                 externalEffect: 'NOT_EXECUTED',
 219:               }),
 220:             }
 221:           : {}),
 222:       },
 223:     });
 224: 
 225:     const proposal = await tx.actionProposal.findUnique({ where: { id } });
 226:     if (!proposal || proposal.tenantId !== actor.tenantId) {
 227:       return { kind: 'not_found' };
 228:     }
 229: 
 230:     if (update.count === 0) {
 231:       if (proposal.status === decision) {
 232:         return { kind: 'idempotent', proposal };
 233:       }
 234:       return { kind: 'conflict', proposal };
 235:     }
 236: 
 237:     await writeDecisionAudit(tx, actor, proposal.id, decision, proposal.type, decisionAt);
 238:     return { kind: 'updated', proposal };
 239:   });
 240: }

 247:     case 'deadline-reminder':
 248:       return ActionProposalType.CREATE_LEGAL_DEADLINE;
 249:     case 'document-request':

  58:   async submitQuery(params: {
  59:     query: string;
  60:     userId: string;
  61:     tenantId: string;
  62:     sessionId?: string;
  63:     dossierId?: string;
  64:   }): Promise<{ sessionId: string; response: AIResponse }> {
  65:     const { query, userId, tenantId, sessionId, dossierId } = params;
  66: 
  67:     // 1. CrÃ©er ou rÃ©cupÃ©rer session
  68:     let session = sessionId
  69:       ? await prisma.chatSession.findUnique({
  70:           where: { id: sessionId },
  71:           include: { messages: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } } },
  72:         })
  73:       : null;

  75:     if (!session) {

 128:       },

 130:

 137:     });
 138:

 145:       })),

 160:         sessionId: session.id,
 161:         role: 'assistant',

 163:         metadata: {
 164:           model: aiResponse.model,
 165:           tokensUsed: aiResponse.tokensUsed,
 166:           confidence: aiResponse.confidence,
 167:           ragDocuments: ragDocuments.map(d => ({
 168:             id: d.id,
 169:             title: d.title,
 170:             relevanceScore: d.relevanceScore,
 171:           })),
 172:           citations: aiResponse.citations,
 173:         },
 174:       },
 175:     });
 176:

 178:     await eventLogService.createEventLog({
 179:       tenantId,
 180:       actorId: userId,
 181:       actorType: 'AI',
 182:       eventType: 'AI_RESPONSE_GENERATED',
 183:       entityType: 'chat_session',
 184:       entityId: session.id,

 156: export async function analyzeRisk(dossier: any): Promise<RiskAnalysis> {
 157:   await simulateDelay()
 158:   
 159:   // Calcul simplifie du score de risque
 160:   let score = 50
 161:   const factors: RiskAnalysis['factors'] = []
 162:   
 163:   if (dossier.montant && dossier.montant > 10000) {
 164:     score += 15
 165:     factors.push({
 166:       factor: 'Montant eleve',
 167:       impact: 'negative',
 168:       description: `Le montant de ${dossier.montant}€ augmente le risque financier`
 169:     })
 170:   }
 171:   
 172:   if (dossier.urgence === 'critique') {
 173:     score += 20
 174:     factors.push({
 175:       factor: 'Urgence critique',
 176:       impact: 'negative',
 177:       description: 'Delai tres court necessitant une action immediate'
 178:     })
 179:   }
 180:   
 181:   if (dossier.documents && dossier.documents.length > 5) {
 182:     score -= 10
 183:     factors.push({
 184:       factor: 'Bonne documentation',
 185:       impact: 'positive',
 186:       description: 'Nombreuses pieces justificatives au dossier'
 187:     })
 188:   }
 189:   
 190:   const level = score >= 75 ? 'critique' : score >= 60 ? 'eleve' : score >= 40 ? 'moyen' : 'faible'
 191:   
 192:   const recommendations = [
 193:     'Prioriser ce dossier dans le planning',
 194:     'Prevoir une audience de mise en etat',
 195:     'Constituer un dossier de preuves solide',
 196:     'Envisager une mediation prealable'
 197:   ]
 198:   
 199:   return { score, level, factors, recommendations }
 200: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Service d'analytics predictifs

   8: export interface PredictionData {
   9:   date: Date;
  10:   value: number;
  11: }

  13: export interface PredictionResult {
  14:   predicted: number;
  15:   confidence: number; // 0-100%

  17:   trendPercentage: number;

  43: /**
  44:  * Prevision des revenus basee sur l'historique
  45:  */
  46: export function predictRevenue(historicalData: PredictionData[]): RevenueForecast {
  47:   if (historicalData.length < 3) {
  48:     return {
  49:       currentMonth: historicalData[historicalData.length - 1]?.value || 0,
  50:       nextMonth: { predicted: 0, confidence: 0, trend: 'stable', trendPercentage: 0 },
  51:       next3Months: { predicted: 0, confidence: 0, trend: 'stable', trendPercentage: 0 },
  52:       next6Months: { predicted: 0, confidence: 0, trend: 'stable', trendPercentage: 0 },
  53:     };
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   // Preparer les donnees pour la regression (x = mois, y = revenu)
  57:   const data: [number, number][] = historicalData.map((point, index) => [index, point.value]);
  58:   
  59:   // Regression lineaire
  60:   const result = regression.linear(data);
  61:   
  62:   const currentMonth = historicalData[historicalData.length - 1].value;
  63:   const nextIndex = historicalData.length;
  64:   
  65:   // Predictions
  66:   const nextMonth = result.predict(nextIndex)[1];
  67:   const next3Months = result.predict(nextIndex + 2)[1];
  68:   const next6Months = result.predict(nextIndex + 5)[1];
  69:   
  70:   // Calculer la confiance basee sur le R²
  71:   const confidence = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, result.r2 * 100));
  72:   
  73:   // Detecter la tendance
  74:   const getTrend = (current: number, predicted: number): { trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'stable', percentage: number } => {
  75:     const diff = ((predicted - current) / current) * 100;
  76:     if (Math.abs(diff) < 5) return { trend: 'stable', percentage: diff };
  77:     return { trend: diff > 0 ? 'up' : 'down', percentage: diff };
  78:   };
  79:   
  80:   const trendNextMonth = getTrend(currentMonth, nextMonth);
  81:   const trend3Months = getTrend(currentMonth, next3Months);
  82:   const trend6Months = getTrend(currentMonth, next6Months);
  83:   
  84:   return {
  85:     currentMonth,
  86:     nextMonth: {
  87:       predicted: Math.max(0, nextMonth),
  88:       confidence,
  89:       trend: trendNextMonth.trend,
  90:       trendPercentage: trendNextMonth.percentage
  91:     },
  92:     next3Months: {
  93:       predicted: Math.max(0, next3Months),
  94:       confidence: confidence * 0.8, // Moins confiant pour +3 mois
  95:       trend: trend3Months.trend,
  96:       trendPercentage: trend3Months.percentage
  97:     },
  98:     next6Months: {
  99:       predicted: Math.max(0, next6Months),
 100:       confidence: confidence * 0.6, // Encore moins confiant pour +6 mois
 101:       trend: trend6Months.trend,
 102:       trendPercentage: trend6Months.percentage
 103:     }
 104:   };
 105: }

 107: /**
 108:  * Analyse du taux de recouvrement
 109:  */
 110: export function analyzeRecoveryRate(
 111:   factures: Array<{
 112:     montant: number;
 113:     statut: string;
 114:     dateEmission: Date;
 115:     datePaiement?: Date;
 116:   }>
 117: ): RecoveryRateAnalysis {
 118:   const paidFactures = factures.filter(f => f.statut === 'PAYEE' && f.datePaiement);
 119:   const totalFactures = factures.filter(f => f.statut !== 'BROUILLON');
 120:   
 121:   const currentRate = calculateCurrentRate(paidFactures, totalFactures);
 122:   const averageDelayDays = calculateAverageDelay(paidFactures);
 123:   const predictedRate = calculatePredictedRate(factures, currentRate);
 124:   const riskFactors = identifyRiskFactors(currentRate, averageDelayDays, predictedRate, factures);
 125:   
 126:   return {
 127:     currentRate,
 128:     predictedRate,
 129:     averageDelayDays,
 130:     riskFactors
 131:   };
 132: }
 133: 
 134: function calculateCurrentRate(paidFactures: any[], totalFactures: any[]): number {
 135:   return totalFactures.length > 0 
 136:     ? (paidFactures.length / totalFactures.length) * 100 
 137:     : 0;
 138: }
 139: 
 140: function calculateAverageDelay(paidFactures: any[]): number {
 141:   const delays = paidFactures
 142:     .filter(f => f.datePaiement)
 143:     .map(f => {
 144:       const emission = new Date(f.dateEmission);
 145:       const paiement = new Date(f.datePaiement!);
 146:       return (paiement.getTime() - emission.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
 147:     });
 148:   
 149:   return delays.length > 0
 150:     ? delays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / delays.length
 151:     : 0;
 152: }
 153: 
 154: function calculatePredictedRate(factures: any[], currentRate: number): PredictionResult {
 155:   const monthlyRates = getMonthlyRates(factures);
 156:   
 157:   if (monthlyRates.length >= 3) {
 158:     const result = regression.linear(monthlyRates);
 159:     const nextRate = result.predict(6)[1];
 160:     const trend = getTrendDirection(nextRate, currentRate);
 161:     
 162:     return {
 163:       predicted: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, nextRate)),
 164:       confidence: result.r2 * 100,
 165:       trend,
 166:       trendPercentage: ((nextRate - currentRate) / currentRate) * 100
 167:     };
 168:   }
 169:   
 170:   return {
 171:     predicted: currentRate,
 172:     confidence: 50,
 173:     trend: 'stable',
 174:     trendPercentage: 0
 175:   };
 176: }
 177: 
 178: function getMonthlyRates(factures: any[]): [number, number][] {
 179:   const monthlyRates: [number, number][] = [];
 180:   const now = new Date();
 181:   const totalFactures = factures.filter(f => f.statut !== 'BROUILLON');
 182:   
 183:   for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
 184:     const monthAgo = new Date(now);
 185:     monthAgo.setMonth(now.getMonth() - i);
 186:     
 187:     const monthFactures = totalFactures.filter(f => {
 188:       const date = new Date(f.dateEmission);
 189:       return date.getMonth() === monthAgo.getMonth() && 
 190:              date.getFullYear() === monthAgo.getFullYear();
 191:     });
 192:     
 193:     const monthPaid = monthFactures.filter(f => f.statut === 'PAYEE');
 194:     const rate = monthFactures.length > 0 ? (monthPaid.length / monthFactures.length) * 100 : 0;
 195:     
 196:     monthlyRates.unshift([5 - i, rate]);
 197:   }
 198:   
 199:   return monthlyRates;
 200: }
 201: 
 202: function getTrendDirection(nextRate: number, currentRate: number): 'up' | 'down' | 'stable' {
 203:   return nextRate > currentRate ? 'up' : nextRate < currentRate ? 'down' : 'stable';
 204: }
 205: 
 206: function identifyRiskFactors(
 207:   currentRate: number, 
 208:   averageDelayDays: number, 
 209:   predictedRate: PredictionResult, 
 210:   factures: any[]
 211: ): string[] {
 212:   const riskFactors: string[] = [];
 213:   
 214:   if (currentRate < 70) riskFactors.push('Taux de recouvrement faible');
 215:   if (averageDelayDays > 45) riskFactors.push('Delais de paiement trop longs');
 216:   if (predictedRate.trend === 'down') riskFactors.push('Tendance a la baisse');
 217:   
 218:   const overdueCount = getOverdueFacturesCount(factures);
 219:   if (overdueCount > 0) {
 220:     riskFactors.push(`${overdueCount} facture(s) en retard`);
 221:   }
 222:   
 223:   return riskFactors;
 224: }
 225: 
 226: function getOverdueFacturesCount(factures: any[]): number {
 227:   return factures.filter(f => {
 228:     if (f.statut === 'PAYEE' || f.statut === 'BROUILLON') return false;
 229:     const daysSince = (Date.now() - new Date(f.dateEmission).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
 230:     return daysSince > 30;
 231:   }).length;
 232: 
 233: }

 236:  * Analyse de rentabilite par type de dossier
 237:  */
 238: export function analyzeDossierProfitability(
 239:   dossiers: Array<{
 240:     type: string;

 249:     .map(([type, typeDossiers]) => calculateProfitability(type, typeDossiers))

  41: export function calculateAlertLevel(
  42:   deadlineDate: Date,
  43:   now: Date = new Date()
  44: ): AntiOubliAlert['type'] | null {
  45:   const msRemaining = deadlineDate.getTime() - now.getTime();
  46:   const heuresRestantes = msRemaining / (1000 * 60 * 60);
  47:   const joursRestants = heuresRestantes / 24;
  48: 
  49:   if (joursRestants < -1) return 'DEPASSE';    // J+1 et plus
  50:   if (joursRestants <= 0) return 'CRITIQUE';    // Jour J
  51:   if (joursRestants <= 1) return 'URGENCE';     // J-1 (24h)
  52:   if (joursRestants <= 3) return 'ALERTE';      // J-3
  53:   if (joursRestants <= 7) return 'RAPPEL';      // J-7
  54:   return null; // Pas encore d'alerte
  55: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware d'horodatage certifiÃ© pour les actions critiques.
   3:  * 
   4:  * S'utilise dans les services mÃ©tier pour ajouter un timestamp RFC 3161
   5:  * aux Ã©vÃ©nements qui ont besoin d'une preuve de date opposable.
   6:  * 
   7:  * Actions horodatÃ©es :
   8:  * - DÃ©pÃ´t de document (preuve d'antÃ©rioritÃ©)
   9:  * - Partage au client (preuve de notification)
  10:  * - Signature client (preuve de consentement)
  11:  * - CrÃ©ation de preuve lÃ©gale (ProofBundle)
  12:  * - RÃ©ception email (preuve de rÃ©ception)
  13:  */
  14: 
  15: import { timestampService, type TimestampResult } from './timestamp.service';
  16: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  17: import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
  18: 
  19: export type CriticalAction =
  20:   | 'DOCUMENT_UPLOADED'
  21:   | 'DOCUMENT_SHARED'
  22:   | 'CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGED'
  23:   | 'CLIENT_SIGNED'
  24:   | 'PROOF_GENERATED'
  25:   | 'EMAIL_RECEIVED'
  26:   | 'DEADLINE_CREATED'
  27:   | 'DOSSIER_CLOSED';
  28: 
  29: interface CertifiedTimestampInput {
  30:   tenantId: string;
  31:   userId: string;
  32:   action: CriticalAction;
  33:   entityType: string;
  34:   entityId: string;
  35:   contentHash: string; // SHA-256 du contenu horodatÃ©
  36:   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  37: }
  38: 
  39: interface CertifiedTimestampRecord {
  40:   id: string;
  41:   action: CriticalAction;
  42:   entityId: string;
  43:   contentHash: string;
  44:   tsaProvider: string;
  45:   tsaTimestamp: string;
  46:   tsaToken: string;
  47:   createdAt: Date;
  48: }
  49: 
  50: /**
  51:  * Horodater une action critique avec preuve tierce.
  52:  * Le rÃ©sultat est stockÃ© dans l'AuditLog avec le token TSA.
  53:  */
  54: export async function certifyAction(input: CertifiedTimestampInput): Promise<CertifiedTimestampRecord> {
  55:   // 1. Demander l'horodatage au TSA
  56:   const tsResult = await timestampService.timestampEvent({
  57:     action: input.action,
  58:     entityId: input.entityId,
  59:     entityType: input.entityType,
  60:     userId: input.userId,
  61:     data: {
  62:       contentHash: input.contentHash,
  63:       ...input.metadata,
  64:     },
  65:   });
  66: 
  67:   const record: CertifiedTimestampRecord = {
  68:     id: randomUUID(),
  69:     action: input.action,
  70:     entityId: input.entityId,
  71:     contentHash: input.contentHash,
  72:     tsaProvider: tsResult.provider,
  73:     tsaTimestamp: tsResult.timestamp,
  74:     tsaToken: tsResult.tokenHex || tsResult.token || '',
  75:     createdAt: new Date(),
  76:   };
  77: 
  78:   // 2. Stocker dans l'AuditLog avec le token TSA
  79:   try {
  80:     await prisma.auditLog.create({
  81:       data: {
  82:         id: record.id,
  83:         tenantId: input.tenantId,
  84:         userId: input.userId,
  85:         userEmail: '',
  86:         userRole: '',
  87:         action: input.action as any,
  88:         entityType: input.entityType,
  89:         entityId: input.entityId,
  90:         details: JSON.stringify({
  91:           contentHash: input.contentHash,
  92:           tsa: {
  93:             provider: tsResult.provider,
  94:             timestamp: tsResult.timestamp,
  95:             tokenHex: tsResult.tokenHex,
  96:             success: tsResult.success,
  97:           },
  98:           ...input.metadata,
  99:         }),
 100:         ipAddress: '',
 101:         createdAt: new Date(),
 102:       },
 103:     });
 104:   } catch (err) {
 105:     // Si l'enum AuditAction ne contient pas notre action, on log quand mÃªme
 106:     console.warn(`[certifyAction] AuditLog creation failed for ${input.action}, storing in-memory only`);
 107:   }

  99:   async shareDocument(input: ShareDocumentInput): Promise<ClientShare> {
 100:     const shareId = randomUUID();

  10: interface CreateCommentParams {
  11:   content: string;
  12:   entityType: 'email' | 'dossier' | 'client' | 'document';
  13:   entityId: string;
  14:   authorId: string;
  15:   tenantId: string;
  16: }
  17: 
  18: interface MentionInfo {
  19:   userId: string;
  20:   username: string;
  21: }
  22: 
  23: export class CollaborationService {
  24:   private prisma: PrismaClient;
  25:   private eventLogService: EventLogService;
  26: 
  27:   constructor(prisma?: PrismaClient, eventLogService?: EventLogService) {
  28:     this.prisma = prisma || new PrismaClient();
  29:     this.eventLogService = eventLogService || new EventLogService(this.prisma);
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   /**
  33:    * DÃ©tecte les mentions @username dans le contenu
  34:    * Format: @john.doe ou @marie
  35:    */
  36:   private async parseMentions(content: string, tenantId: string): Promise<MentionInfo[]> {
  37:     const mentionRegex = /@([\w.]+)/g;
  38:     const matches = [...content.matchAll(mentionRegex)];
  39: 
  40:     if (matches.length === 0) {
  41:       return [];
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     const usernames = [...new Set(matches.map(m => m[1]))];
  45: 
  46:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer les users du tenant par email/username
  47:     const users = await this.prisma.user.findMany({
  48:       where: {
  49:         tenantId,
  50:         OR: usernames.map(username => ({
  51:           email: { contains: username, mode: 'insensitive' as const },
  52:         })),
  53:       },
  54:       select: {
  55:         id: true,
  56:         email: true,
  57:         name: true,
  58:       },
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     return users.map(u => ({
  62:       userId: u.id,
  63:       username: u.email.split('@')[0],
  64:     }));
  65:   }
  66: 
  67:   /**
  68:    * CrÃ©er un commentaire avec mentions automatiques
  69:    */
  70:   async createComment(params: CreateCommentParams) {
  71:     const { content, entityType, entityId, authorId, tenantId } = params;
  72: 
  73:     // DÃ©tecter mentions
  74:     const mentions = await this.parseMentions(content, tenantId);
  75: 
  76:     // CrÃ©er commentaire + mentions en transaction
  77:     const runTransaction = this.prisma.$transaction as <T>(
  78:       fn: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>
  79:     ) => Promise<T>;
  80: 
  81:     const comment = await runTransaction(async tx => {
  82:       // 1. CrÃ©er le commentaire
  83:       const newComment = await tx.comment.create({
  84:         data: {
  85:           content,
  86:           entityType,
  87:           entityId,
  88:           authorId,
  89:           tenantId,
  90:         },
  91:         include: {
  92:           author: {
  93:             select: {
  94:               id: true,
  95:               name: true,
  96:               email: true,
  97:               avatar: true,
  98:             },
  99:           },
 100:         },
 101:       });
 102: 
 103:       // 2. CrÃ©er les mentions
 104:       if (mentions.length > 0) {
 105:         await tx.mention.createMany({
 106:           data: mentions.map(m => ({
 107:             commentId: newComment.id,
 108:             userId: m.userId,
 109:           })),
 110:         });
 111:       }
 112: 
 113:       // 3. EventLog USER_COMMENTED
 114:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 115:         tenantId,
 116:         eventType: 'USER_ADDED_COMMENT',
 117:         actorType: 'USER',
 118:         actorId: authorId,
 119:         entityType,
 120:         entityId,
 121:         metadata: {
 122:           commentId: newComment.id,
 123:           content: content.substring(0, 100),
 124:           mentionsCount: mentions.length,
 125:         },
 126:       });
 127: 
 128:       // 4. EventLog USER_MENTIONED pour chaque mention
 129:       for (const mention of mentions) {
 130:         await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 131:           tenantId,
 132:           eventType: 'USER_MENTIONED',
 133:           actorType: 'USER',
 134:           actorId: authorId,
 135:           entityType: 'mention',
 136:           entityId: newComment.id,
 137:           metadata: {
 138:             commentId: newComment.id,
 139:             mentionedUserId: mention.userId,
 140:             mentionedUsername: mention.username,
 141:             entityType,
 142:             entityId,
 143:           },
 144:         });
 145:       }
 146: 
 147:       return newComment;
 148:     });
 149: 
 150:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer avec mentions
 151:     const commentWithMentions = await this.prisma.comment.findUnique({
 152:       where: { id: comment.id },
 153:       include: {
 154:         author: {
 155:           select: {
 156:             id: true,
 157:             name: true,
 158:             email: true,
 159:             avatar: true,
 160:           },
 161:         },
 162:         mentions: {
 163:           include: {
 164:             user: {
 165:               select: {
 166:                 id: true,
 167:                 name: true,
 168:                 email: true,
 169:               },
 170:             },
 171:           },
 172:         },
 173:       },
 174:     });
 175:

   1: /**
   2:  * CARPA Service
   3:  * Gestion des fonds clients (maniement de fonds - obligation dÃ©ontologique avocats)
   4:  * 
   5:  * La CARPA (Caisse des RÃ¨glements PÃ©cuniaires des Avocats) est un organisme
   6:  * qui garantit la sÃ©paration des fonds personnels de l'avocat et des fonds
   7:  * qu'il dÃ©tient pour le compte de ses clients.
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
  11: 
  12: // Type local â€” miroir de l'enum Prisma TypeMouvementCARPA
  13: type TypeMouvementCARPA = 'PROVISION' | 'RESTITUTION' | 'REGLEMENT_TIERS' | 'HONORAIRES';
  14: 
  15: interface MouvementCARPAInput {
  16:   tenantId: string;
  17:   dossierId: string;
  18:   clientId: string;
  19:   type: TypeMouvementCARPA;
  20:   montant: number;
  21:   libelle: string;
  22:   reference?: string;
  23: }
  24: 
  25: export class CARPAService {
  26:   /**
  27:    * Enregistre un mouvement CARPA et met Ã  jour le solde
  28:    */
  29:   static async enregistrerMouvement(input: MouvementCARPAInput) {
  30:     // Calculer le solde actuel du dossier
  31:     const soldeActuel = await this.getSoldeDossier(input.tenantId, input.dossierId);
  32: 
  33:     // Calcul nouveau solde
  34:     let nouveauSolde: number;
  35:     switch (input.type) {
  36:       case 'PROVISION':
  37:         nouveauSolde = soldeActuel + input.montant;
  38:         break;
  39:       case 'RESTITUTION':
  40:       case 'REGLEMENT_TIERS':
  41:       case 'HONORAIRES':
  42:         // VÃ©rifier qu'il y a assez de fonds
  43:         if (soldeActuel < input.montant) {
  44:           throw new Error(
  45:             `Fonds insuffisants : solde CARPA=${soldeActuel.toFixed(2)}â‚¬, demandÃ©=${input.montant.toFixed(2)}â‚¬`
  46:           );
  47:         }
  48:         nouveauSolde = soldeActuel - input.montant;
  49:         break;
  50:       default:
  51:         throw new Error(`Type de mouvement CARPA inconnu : ${input.type}`);
  52:     }
  53: 
  54:     return prisma.mouvementCARPA.create({
  55:       data: {
  56:         tenantId: input.tenantId,
  57:         dossierId: input.dossierId,
  58:         clientId: input.clientId,
  59:         type: input.type,
  60:         montant: input.montant,
  61:         libelle: input.libelle,
  62:         reference: input.reference || null,
  63:         soldeApres: nouveauSolde,
  64:         date: new Date(),
  65:       },
  66:     });
  67:   }
  68: 
  69:   /**
  70:    * Solde CARPA pour un dossier
  71:    */
  72:   static async getSoldeDossier(tenantId: string, dossierId: string): Promise<number> {
  73:     const dernierMouvement = await prisma.mouvementCARPA.findFirst({
  74:       where: { tenantId, dossierId },
  75:       orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
  76:       select: { soldeApres: true },
  77:     });
  78: 
  79:     return dernierMouvement?.soldeApres || 0;
  80:   }
  81: 
  82:   /**
  83:    * Solde CARPA global du cabinet (tous dossiers)
  84:    */
  85:   static async getSoldeGlobal(tenantId: string): Promise<number> {
  86:     // Somme des derniers soldes de chaque dossier
  87:     const dossiers = await prisma.mouvementCARPA.groupBy({
  88:       by: ['dossierId'],
  89:       where: { tenantId },
  90:       _max: { date: true },
  91:     });
  92: 
  93:     let total = 0;
  94:     for (const d of dossiers) {
  95:       const solde = await this.getSoldeDossier(tenantId, d.dossierId);
  96:       total += solde;
  97:     }
  98: 
  99:     return total;
 100:   }

 176:             solde,
 177:             dernierMouvement: d._max.date,
 178:             joursInactif,
 179:           });
 180:         }
 181:       }

   9: type SourceEcriture = 'MANUELLE' | 'FACTURE' | 'PAIEMENT' | 'BANQUE' | 'IA';
