  30: 
  31: export class EcrituresService {
  32:   /**
  33:    * CrÃ©e une Ã©criture comptable avec ses lignes
  34:    * VÃ©rifie l'Ã©quilibre dÃ©bit/crÃ©dit avant insertion
  35:    */
  36:   static async creerEcriture(input: CreateEcritureInput) {
  37:     // VÃ©rification Ã©quilibre
  38:     const totalDebit = input.lignes.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.debit, 0);
  39:     const totalCredit = input.lignes.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.credit, 0);
  40: 
  41:     if (Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) > 0.01) {
  42:       throw new Error(
  43:         `Ã‰criture dÃ©sÃ©quilibrÃ©e : dÃ©bit=${totalDebit.toFixed(2)}, crÃ©dit=${totalCredit.toFixed(2)}`
  44:       );
  45:     }
  46: 
  47:     // RÃ©cupÃ©rer le journal
  48:     const journal = await prisma.journal.findUnique({
  49:       where: { tenantId_code: { tenantId: input.tenantId, code: input.journalCode } },
  50:     });
  51: 
  52:     if (!journal) {
  53:       throw new Error(`Journal "${input.journalCode}" introuvable pour ce cabinet`);
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     // GÃ©nÃ©rer le numÃ©ro d'Ã©criture (sÃ©quentiel par tenant)
  57:     const numero = await this.genererNumeroEcriture(input.tenantId, input.journalCode);
  58: 
  59:     // RÃ©soudre les comptes par numÃ©ro
  60:     const comptesMap = new Map<string, string>();
  61:     for (const ligne of input.lignes) {
  62:       if (!comptesMap.has(ligne.compteNumero)) {
  63:         const compte = await prisma.compteComptable.findUnique({
  64:           where: { tenantId_numero: { tenantId: input.tenantId, numero: ligne.compteNumero } },
  65:         });
  66:         if (!compte) {
  67:           throw new Error(`Compte "${ligne.compteNumero}" introuvable`);
  68:         }
  69:         comptesMap.set(ligne.compteNumero, compte.id);
  70:       }
  71:     }
  72: 
  73:     // CrÃ©er l'Ã©criture + lignes en transaction
  74:     const ecriture = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  75:       const ecr = await tx.ecriture.create({
  76:         data: {
  77:           tenantId: input.tenantId,
  78:           journalId: journal.id,
  79:           numero,
  80:           date: input.date,
  81:           libelle: input.libelle,
  82:           reference: input.reference || null,
  83:           factureId: input.factureId || null,
  84:           dossierId: input.dossierId || null,
  85:           source: input.source || 'MANUELLE',
  86:           statut: 'BROUILLON',
  87:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  88:           Lignes: {
  89:             create: input.lignes.map(l => ({
  90:               compteId: comptesMap.get(l.compteNumero)!,
  91:               libelle: l.libelle || null,
  92:               debit: l.debit,
  93:               credit: l.credit,
  94:             })),
  95:           },
  96:         },
  97:         include: { Lignes: { include: { Compte: true } }, Journal: true },
  98:       });
  99: 
 100:       return ecr;
 101:     });
 102: 
 103:     return ecriture;
 104:   }

 133:     dateDebut?: Date;

 149:       if (options?.dateFin) where.date.lte = options.dateFin;
 150:     }

 152:     if (options?.dossierId) where.dossierId = options.dossierId;
 153:     if (options?.compteNumero) {

 164:         orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
 165:         take: options?.limit || 50,
 166:         skip: options?.offset || 0,
 167:       }),
 168:       prisma.ecriture.count({ where }),
 169:     ]);
 170:

 174:   /**
 175:    * Lettrage : rapproche deux Ã©critures (ex: facture + paiement)
 176:    */
 177:   static async lettrer(tenantId: string, ligneIds: string[]) {
 178:     // VÃ©rifier que les lignes sont sur le mÃªme compte et s'Ã©quilibrent
 179:     const lignes = await prisma.ligneEcriture.findMany({
 180:       where: { id: { in: ligneIds } },
 181:       include: { Ecriture: true, Compte: true },
 182:     });
 183: 
 184:     if (lignes.length < 2) {
 185:       throw new Error('Au moins 2 lignes nÃ©cessaires pour le lettrage');
 186:     }
 187: 
 188:     const compteIds = Array.from(new Set(lignes.map(l => l.compteId)));
 189:     if (compteIds.length > 1) {
 190:       throw new Error('Toutes les lignes doivent Ãªtre sur le mÃªme compte');
 191:     }
 192: 
 193:     const totalDebit = lignes.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.debit, 0);
 194:     const totalCredit = lignes.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.credit, 0);
 195: 
 196:     if (Math.abs(totalDebit - totalCredit) > 0.01) {
 197:       throw new Error(
 198:         `Lettrage dÃ©sÃ©quilibrÃ© : dÃ©bit=${totalDebit.toFixed(2)}, crÃ©dit=${totalCredit.toFixed(2)}`
 199:       );
 200:     }
 201: 
 202:     // GÃ©nÃ©rer un code de lettrage
 203:     const codeLettrage = await this.genererCodeLettrage(tenantId);
 204: 
 205:     // Appliquer le lettrage
 206:     await prisma.ligneEcriture.updateMany({
 207:       where: { id: { in: ligneIds } },
 208:       data: { lettrage: codeLettrage },
 209:     });
 210: 
 211:     // Marquer les Ã©critures comme lettrÃ©es si toutes leurs lignes le sont
 212:     const ecritureIds = Array.from(new Set(lignes.map(l => l.ecritureId)));
 213:     for (const ecritureId of ecritureIds) {
 214:       const lignesNonLettrees = await prisma.ligneEcriture.count({
 215:         where: { ecritureId, lettrage: null },
 216:       });
 217:       if (lignesNonLettrees === 0) {
 218:         await prisma.ecriture.update({
 219:           where: { id: ecritureId },
 220:           data: { statut: 'LETTREE', updatedAt: new Date() },
 221:         });
 222:       }
 223:     }
 224: 
 225:     return { codeLettrage, lignesLettrees: ligneIds.length };
 226:   }

   1: /**
   2:  * Rapprochement Bancaire Service
   3:  * Import de relevÃ©s + matching IA (inspirÃ© Sage Copilot)
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';
   7: 
   8: interface MouvementImport {
   9:   date: string; // YYYY-MM-DD
  10:   libelle: string;
  11:   montant: number; // positif = crÃ©dit, nÃ©gatif = dÃ©bit
  12:   reference?: string;
  13: }
  14: 
  15: interface SuggestionRapprochement {
  16:   mouvementId: string;
  17:   mouvementLibelle: string;
  18:   mouvementMontant: number;
  19:   suggestion: {
  20:     type: 'FACTURE' | 'ECRITURE' | 'INCONNU';
  21:     factureId?: string;
  22:     factureNumero?: string;
  23:     ecritureId?: string;
  24:     clientNom?: string;
  25:   } | null;
  26:   confidence: number;
  27: }
  28: 
  29: export class RapprochementService {
  30:   /**
  31:    * Importe des mouvements bancaires depuis un CSV ou OFX
  32:    */
  33:   static async importerMouvements(
  34:     tenantId: string,
  35:     compteBancaire: string,
  36:     mouvements: MouvementImport[]
  37:   ) {
  38:     const data = mouvements.map(m => ({
  39:       tenantId,
  40:       compteBancaire,
  41:       date: new Date(m.date),
  42:       libelle: m.libelle,
  43:       montant: m.montant,
  44:       reference: m.reference || null,
  45:       isRapproche: false,
  46:     }));
  47: 
  48:     const result = await prisma.mouvementBancaire.createMany({
  49:       data,
  50:       skipDuplicates: true,
  51:     });
  52: 
  53:     return { imported: result.count };
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   /**
  57:    * Parse un fichier CSV bancaire (format standard franÃ§ais)
  58:    * Colonnes attendues : Date;LibellÃ©;DÃ©bit;CrÃ©dit ou Date;LibellÃ©;Montant
  59:    */
  60:   static parseCSV(content: string): MouvementImport[] {
  61:     const lines = content.trim().split('\n');
  62:     if (lines.length < 2) return [];
  63: 
  64:     const header = lines[0].toLowerCase();
  65:     const separator = header.includes(';') ? ';' : ',';
  66:     const columns = header.split(separator).map(c => c.trim());
  67: 
  68:     const dateIdx = columns.findIndex(c => c.includes('date'));
  69:     const libelleIdx = columns.findIndex(c => c.includes('libell') || c.includes('description'));
  70:     const montantIdx = columns.findIndex(c => c.includes('montant') || c.includes('amount'));
  71:     const debitIdx = columns.findIndex(c => c.includes('debit') || c.includes('dÃ©bit'));
  72:     const creditIdx = columns.findIndex(c => c.includes('credit') || c.includes('crÃ©dit'));
  73: 
  74:     if (dateIdx === -1 || libelleIdx === -1) {
  75:       throw new Error('Format CSV non reconnu : colonnes Date et LibellÃ© requises');
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     return lines.slice(1).filter(l => l.trim()).map(line => {
  79:       const cols = line.split(separator).map(c => c.trim().replace(/"/g, ''));
  80: 
  81:       let montant: number;
  82:       if (montantIdx !== -1) {
  83:         montant = parseFloat(cols[montantIdx].replace(',', '.').replace(/\s/g, '')) || 0;
  84:       } else {
  85:         const debit = parseFloat((cols[debitIdx] || '0').replace(',', '.').replace(/\s/g, '')) || 0;
  86:         const credit = parseFloat((cols[creditIdx] || '0').replace(',', '.').replace(/\s/g, '')) || 0;
  87:         montant = credit - debit;
  88:       }
  89: 
  90:       // Parse date (DD/MM/YYYY â†’ YYYY-MM-DD)
  91:       const dateStr = cols[dateIdx];
  92:       let date: string;
  93:       if (dateStr.includes('/')) {
  94:         const [d, m, y] = dateStr.split('/');
  95:         date = `${y}-${m.padStart(2, '0')}-${d.padStart(2, '0')}`;
  96:       } else {
  97:         date = dateStr;
  98:       }
  99: 
 100:       return {
 101:         date,
 102:         libelle: cols[libelleIdx],
 103:         montant,
 104:       };
 105:     });
 106:   }
 107: 
 108:   /**
 109:    * SuggÃ¨re des rapprochements entre mouvements bancaires et factures
 110:    * Utilise un matching par montant + similaritÃ© du libellÃ©
 111:    */
 112:   static async suggererRapprochements(tenantId: string): Promise<SuggestionRapprochement[]> {
 113:     // Mouvements non rapprochÃ©s
 114:     const mouvements = await prisma.mouvementBancaire.findMany({
 115:       where: { tenantId, isRapproche: false },
 116:       orderBy: { date: 'desc' },
 117:       take: 100,
 118:     });
 119: 
 120:     // Factures en attente de paiement
 121:     const facturesEnAttente = await prisma.facture.findMany({
 122:       where: {
 123:         tenantId,
 124:         statut: { in: ['envoyee', 'en_retard'] },
 125:       },
 126:       include: {
 127:         Client: { select: { firstName: true, lastName: true } },
 128:       },
 129:     });
 130: 
 131:     const suggestions: SuggestionRapprochement[] = [];
 132: 
 133:     for (const mouvement of mouvements) {
 134:       // On cherche parmi les encaissements (montant positif)
 135:       if (mouvement.montant <= 0) {
 136:         suggestions.push({
 137:           mouvementId: mouvement.id,
 138:           mouvementLibelle: mouvement.libelle,
 139:           mouvementMontant: mouvement.montant,
 140:           suggestion: null,
 141:           confidence: 0,
 142:         });
 143:         continue;
 144:       }
 145: 
 146:       // Match par montant exact
 147:       const matchExact = facturesEnAttente.find(f =>
 148:         Math.abs(f.montantTTC - mouvement.montant) < 0.01
 149:       );
 150: 
 151:       if (matchExact) {
 152:         const clientNom = `${matchExact.Client.firstName} ${matchExact.Client.lastName}`;
 153:         const libelleMatch = this.similarite(
 154:           mouvement.libelle.toLowerCase(),
 155:           clientNom.toLowerCase()
 156:         );
 157: 
 158:         suggestions.push({
 159:           mouvementId: mouvement.id,
 160:           mouvementLibelle: mouvement.libelle,
 161:           mouvementMontant: mouvement.montant,
 162:           suggestion: {
 163:             type: 'FACTURE',
 164:             factureId: matchExact.id,
 165:             factureNumero: matchExact.numero,
 166:             clientNom,
 167:           },
 168:           confidence: libelleMatch > 0.3 ? 0.95 : 0.7,
 169:         });
 170:         continue;
 171:       }
 172: 
 173:       // Match par montant approchant (Â± 5%)
 174:       const matchApprox = facturesEnAttente.find(f =>
 175:         Math.abs(f.montantTTC - mouvement.montant) / f.montantTTC < 0.05
 176:       );
 177: 
 178:       if (matchApprox) {
 179:         const clientNom = `${matchApprox.Client.firstName} ${matchApprox.Client.lastName}`;
 180:         suggestions.push({
 181:           mouvementId: mouvement.id,
 182:           mouvementLibelle: mouvement.libelle,
 183:           mouvementMontant: mouvement.montant,
 184:           suggestion: {
 185:             type: 'FACTURE',
 186:             factureId: matchApprox.id,
 187:             factureNumero: matchApprox.numero,
 188:             clientNom,
 189:           },
 190:           confidence: 0.5,
 191:         });
 192:         continue;
 193:       }
 194: 
 195:       suggestions.push({
 196:         mouvementId: mouvement.id,
 197:         mouvementLibelle: mouvement.libelle,
 198:         mouvementMontant: mouvement.montant,
 199:         suggestion: null,
 200:         confidence: 0,
 201:       });
 202:     }
 203:

  93:   static async balance(tenantId: string, options: {

  95:     dateFin: Date;
  96:     classeMin?: number;
  97:     classeMax?: number;
  98:   }): Promise<{ lignes: BalanceLine[]; totaux: { debit: number; credit: number } }> {
  99:     const comptes = await prisma.compteComptable.findMany({
 100:       where: {
 101:         tenantId,
 102:         isActive: true,
 103:         ...(options.classeMin || options.classeMax ? {
 104:           classe: {
 105:             ...(options.classeMin ? { gte: options.classeMin } : {}),
 106:             ...(options.classeMax ? { lte: options.classeMax } : {}),

 128:       });
 129: 
 130:       const debit = agg._sum.debit || 0;
 131:       const credit = agg._sum.credit || 0;
 132: 
 133:       // Ne montrer que les comptes mouvementÃ©s
 134:       if (debit === 0 && credit === 0) continue;
 135: 
 136:       const solde = debit - credit;
 137:       lignes.push({
 138:         numero: compte.numero,
 139:         libelle: compte.libelle,
 140:         classe: compte.classe,
 141:         totalDebit: Math.round(debit * 100) / 100,
 142:         totalCredit: Math.round(credit * 100) / 100,
 143:         soldeDebiteur: solde > 0 ? Math.round(solde * 100) / 100 : 0,
 144:         soldeCrediteur: solde < 0 ? Math.round(Math.abs(solde) * 100) / 100 : 0,
 145:       });
 146: 
 147:       totalDebit += debit;
 148:       totalCredit += credit;
 149:     }
 150: 
 151:     return {
 152:       lignes,
 153:       totaux: {
 154:         debit: Math.round(totalDebit * 100) / 100,
 155:         credit: Math.round(totalCredit * 100) / 100,
 156:       },
 157:     };

   1: /**
   2:  * TVA Service

  22:   /**
  23:    * Calcule la TVA pour une pÃ©riode donnÃ©e
  24:    */
  25:   static async calculerTVA(tenantId: string, periode: { debut: Date; fin: Date }): Promise<CalculTVA> {
  26:     // TVA collectÃ©e : crÃ©dit sur compte 445710
  27:     const lignesCollectee = await prisma.ligneEcriture.findMany({
  28:       where: {
  29:         Ecriture: {
  30:           tenantId,

  35:         credit: { gt: 0 },
  36:       },
  37:       include: { Compte: { select: { numero: true } } },
  38:     });
  39: 
  40:     // TVA dÃ©ductible : dÃ©bit sur comptes 44566x

  53:

  63:         deductible: lignesDeductible.map(l => ({ compte: l.Compte.numero, montant: l.debit })),

 117:   /**
 118:    * Parse une pÃ©riode ("2026-Q2" â†’ dates, "2026-06" â†’ dates)
 119:    */
 120:   private static parsePeriode(periode: string): { debut: Date; fin: Date } {
 121:     if (periode.includes('Q')) {
 122:       // Trimestriel : "2026-Q2"
 123:       const [annee, q] = periode.split('-Q');
 124:       const trimestre = parseInt(q);
 125:       const moisDebut = (trimestre - 1) * 3; // 0-indexed
 126:       const debut = new Date(parseInt(annee), moisDebut, 1);
 127:       const fin = new Date(parseInt(annee), moisDebut + 3, 0); // Dernier jour du trimestre
 128:       return { debut, fin };
 129:     }
 130: 
 131:     // Mensuel : "2026-06"
 132:     const [annee, mois] = periode.split('-').map(Number);
 133:     const debut = new Date(annee, mois - 1, 1);
 134:     const fin = new Date(annee, mois, 0); // Dernier jour du mois
 135:     return { debut, fin };
 136:   }
 137: 
 138:   /**
 139:    * Calcule la date limite de dÃ©claration
 140:    */
 141:   private static calculerDateLimite(finPeriode: Date, regime: RegimeTVA): Date {
 142:     const dateLimite = new Date(finPeriode);
 143: 
 144:     switch (regime) {
 145:       case 'MENSUEL':
 146:         // DÃ©claration avant le 19 du mois suivant
 147:         dateLimite.setMonth(dateLimite.getMonth() + 1);
 148:         dateLimite.setDate(19);
 149:         break;
 150:       case 'TRIMESTRIEL':
 151:         // DÃ©claration avant le 19 du mois suivant la fin du trimestre
 152:         dateLimite.setMonth(dateLimite.getMonth() + 1);
 153:         dateLimite.setDate(19);
 154:         break;
 155:       case 'ANNUEL_SIMPLIFIE':
 156:         // CA12 : avant le 2Ã¨me jour ouvrÃ© suivant le 1er mai
 157:         dateLimite.setMonth(4); // Mai
 158:         dateLimite.setDate(3);
 159:         break;
 160:     }
 161: 
 162:     return dateLimite;
 163:   }

  45: export async function importClientsFromCsv(
  46:   csvContent: string,
  47:   tenantId: string,
  48:   options: { delimiter?: string; skipHeader?: boolean } = {}
  49: ): Promise<CsvImportResult> {
  50:   const { delimiter = ';', skipHeader = true } = options;
  51:   const lines = csvContent.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
  52:   const result: CsvImportResult = { total: lines.length, imported: 0, errors: 0, skipped: 0, details: [] };
  53: 
  54:   const startIndex = skipHeader ? 1 : 0;
  55: 
  56:   for (let i = startIndex; i < lines.length; i++) {
  57:     const cols = lines[i].split(delimiter).map(c => c.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ''));
  58: 
  59:     if (cols.length < 3) {
  60:       result.errors++;
  61:       result.details.push({ line: i + 1, error: 'Colonnes insuffisantes (min: nom, prenom, email)', status: 'error' });
  62:       continue;
  63:     }
  64: 
  65:     const [nom, prenom, email, telephone, adresse, codePostal, ville, nationalite] = cols;
  66: 
  67:     if (!nom || !prenom || !email) {
  68:       result.errors++;
  69:       result.details.push({ line: i + 1, error: 'Nom, prÃ©nom ou email manquant', status: 'error' });
  70:       continue;
  71:     }
  72: 
  73:     // VÃ©rifier doublon
  74:     const existing = await prisma.client.findFirst({
  75:       where: { tenantId, email: email.toLowerCase() },
  76:     });
  77: 
  78:     if (existing) {
  79:       result.skipped++;
  80:       result.details.push({ line: i + 1, status: 'skipped' });
  81:       continue;
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     try {
  85:       await prisma.client.create({
  86:         data: {
  87:           id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  88:           tenantId,
  89:           lastName: nom,
  90:           firstName: prenom,
  91:           email: email.toLowerCase(),
  92:           phone: telephone || null,
  93:           address: adresse || null,
  94:           codePostal: codePostal || null,
  95:           ville: ville || null,
  96:           nationality: nationalite || null,
  97:           status: 'active',
  98:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  99:         },
 100:       });
 101:       result.imported++;
 102:       result.details.push({ line: i + 1, status: 'ok' });
 103:     } catch (error) {
 104:       result.errors++;
 105:       result.details.push({ line: i + 1, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Erreur', status: 'error' });
 106:     }
 107:   }
 108: 
 109:   logger.info(`[CSV Import] Clients: ${result.imported} importÃ©s, ${result.errors} erreurs, ${result.skipped} doublons`, { tenantId });
 110:   return result;

  42: /**
  43:  * CrÃ©e automatiquement une LegalDeadline pour un dossier nouvellement crÃ©Ã©
  44:  */
  45: export async function createAutoDeadline(params: CreateDeadlineParams) {
  46:   const { dossierId, tenantId, clientId, typeDossier, caseSubType, createdBy } = params;
  47: 
  48:   const procedureType = TYPE_TO_PROCEDURE[typeDossier];
  49:   if (!procedureType) return null; // Type non reconnu, pas de deadline auto
  50: 
  51:   const notificationDate = params.notificationDate || new Date();
  52: 
  53:   const metadata: Record<string, string> = {};
  54:   if (typeDossier === 'OQTF' && caseSubType === 'sans_delai') {
  55:     metadata.oqtfType = 'sans_delai';
  56:   }
  57: 
  58:   const calc = calculateDeadline(procedureType, notificationDate, metadata);
  59: 
  60:   const deadlineType = TYPE_TO_DEADLINE_TYPE[typeDossier] || 'CUSTOM';
  61: 
  62:   const deadline = await prisma.legalDeadline.create({
  63:     data: {
  64:       tenantId,
  65:       dossierId,
  66:       clientId,
  67:       type: deadlineType as any,
  68:       label: `Ã‰chÃ©ance ${typeDossier} â€” ${calc.daysRemaining}j restants`,
  69:       description: `CalculÃ©e automatiquement. Notification: ${notificationDate.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`,
  70:       referenceDate: notificationDate,
  71:       dueDate: calc.deadlineDate,
  72:       status: calc.isExpired ? 'OVERDUE' : calc.hoursRemaining <= 48 ? 'CRITICAL' : 'PENDING',
  73:       legalBasis: `CESEDA â€” ${procedureType}`,
  74:       legalDays: calc.daysRemaining,
  75:       createdBy,
  76:     },
  77:   });
  78: 
  79:   // Mettre Ã  jour la dateEcheance du dossier
  80:   await prisma.dossier.update({
  81:     where: { id: dossierId },
  82:     data: { dateEcheance: calc.deadlineDate },
  83:   });
  84: 
  85:   return deadline;
  86: }

   1: /**
   2:  * Service d'extraction automatique des delais (echeances) depuis les documents CESEDA

  92: /**
  93:  * Detecte le template OQTF applicable au document
  94:  */
  95: function detectOQTFTemplate(documentText: string): keyof typeof OQTF_TEMPLATES | null {
  96:   const lowerText = documentText.toLowerCase();
  97: 
  98:   // Recherche OQTF sans delai (priorite haute)
  99:   if (
 100:     (lowerText.includes('oqtf') || lowerText.includes('obligation de quitter')) &&
 101:     (lowerText.includes('sans delai') ||
 102:       lowerText.includes('immediatement') ||
 103:       lowerText.includes('sans delai de depart volontaire'))
 104:   ) {
 105:     return 'OQTF_48H_SANS_DELAI';
 106:   }
 107: 
 108:   // OQTF avec delai
 109:   if (
 110:     (lowerText.includes('oqtf') || lowerText.includes('obligation de quitter')) &&
 111:     (lowerText.includes('delai de depart volontaire') ||
 112:       lowerText.includes('30 jours') ||
 113:       lowerText.includes('trente jours'))
 114:   ) {
 115:     return 'OQTF_30J_AVEC_DELAI';
 116:   }
 117: 
 118:   // Refus de titre
 119:   if (
 120:     lowerText.includes('refus') &&
 121:     (lowerText.includes('titre de sejour') || lowerText.includes('sejour'))
 122:   ) {
 123:     return 'REFUS_TITRE_2MOIS';
 124:   }
 125: 
 126:   return null;
 127: }

 129: /**
 130:  * Genere la checklist automatique selon le template
 131:  */
 132: function generateAutoChecklist(
 133:   template: keyof typeof OQTF_TEMPLATES | null,
 134:   deadline: Partial<ExtractedDeadline>
 135: ): string[] {
 136:   if (!template) {
 137:     // Checklist generique
 138:     return [
 139:       'Verifier date de notification',
 140:       'Calculer delai de recours',
 141:       'Consulter avocat specialise',
 142:       'Rassembler documents justificatifs',
 143:     ];
 144:   }
 145: 
 146:   const templateData = OQTF_TEMPLATES[template];
 147:   return [...templateData.checklist];
 148: }

 150: /**
 151:  * Calcule le niveau de confiance (high/medium/low)
 152:  */
 153: function calculateConfidenceLevel(aiConfidence: number): 'high' | 'medium' | 'low' {
 154:   if (aiConfidence >= 0.9) return 'high';
 155:   if (aiConfidence >= 0.7) return 'medium';
 156:   return 'low';
 157: }
 158: 
 159: /**
 160:  * Enrichit le delai avec template OQTF et checklist
 161:  */
 162: function enrichDeadlineWithTemplate(
 163:   deadline: ExtractedDeadline,
 164:   templateKey: keyof typeof OQTF_TEMPLATES | null,
 165:   documentText: string
 166: ): ExtractedDeadline {
 167:   const enriched = { ...deadline };
 168: 
 169:   if (templateKey) {
 170:     const template = OQTF_TEMPLATES[templateKey];
 171: 
 172:     // Ajouter template match
 173:     enriched.templateMatch = templateKey;
 174: 
 175:     // Generer checklist automatique
 176:     enriched.autoChecklist = generateAutoChecklist(templateKey, deadline);
 177: 
 178:     // Enrichir metadata
 179:     enriched.metadata = {
 180:       ...enriched.metadata,
 181:       delaiStandard: `${template.delaiRecours}${templateKey.includes('48H') ? 'h' : 'j'} pour ${template.name}`,
 182:       articlesApplicables: template.articles,
 183:       templateName: template.name,
 184:     };
 185: 
 186:     // Ajuster la confiance si le template match est fort
 187:     const hasStrongKeywords = template.keywords.some(kw =>
 188:       documentText.toLowerCase().includes(kw.toLowerCase())
 189:     );
 190: 
 191:     if (hasStrongKeywords && enriched.aiConfidence < 0.9) {
 192:       enriched.aiConfidence = Math.min(0.95, enriched.aiConfidence + 0.15);
 193:     }
 194:   }
 195: 
 196:   // Calculer confidence level
 197:   enriched.confidenceLevel = calculateConfidenceLevel(enriched.aiConfidence);
 198: 
 199:   return enriched;
 200: }

   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { PrismaClient, DeadlineStatus } from '@prisma/client';
   8: import { EventLogService } from './event-log.service';
   9: 
  10: interface DeadlineCheckResult {
  11:   deadlineId: string;
  12:   label: string;
  13:   dueDate: Date;
  14:   previousStatus: DeadlineStatus;
  15:   newStatus: DeadlineStatus;
  16:   daysRemaining: number;
  17:   eventCreated: boolean;
  18: }
  19: 
  20: export class DeadlineMonitorService {
  21:   private prisma: PrismaClient;
  22:   private eventLogService: EventLogService;
  23: 
  24:   constructor(prisma?: PrismaClient, eventLogService?: EventLogService) {
  25:     this.prisma = prisma || new PrismaClient();
  26:     this.eventLogService = eventLogService || new EventLogService(this.prisma);
  27:   }
  28: 
  29:   /**
  30:    * Calculer jours restants jusqu'Ã  deadline
  31:    */
  32:   private calculateDaysRemaining(dueDate: Date): number {
  33:     const now = new Date();
  34:     now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  35:     const due = new Date(dueDate);
  36:     due.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  37:     const diffTime = due.getTime() - now.getTime();
  38:     return Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  39:   }
  40: 
  41:   /**
  42:    * DÃ©terminer status selon jours restants
  43:    */
  44:   private determineStatus(daysRemaining: number, currentStatus: DeadlineStatus): DeadlineStatus {
  45:     // Ne pas changer si dÃ©jÃ  COMPLETED ou CANCELLED
  46:     if (currentStatus === 'COMPLETED' || currentStatus === 'CANCELLED') {
  47:       return currentStatus;
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     if (daysRemaining < 0) {
  51:       return 'OVERDUE';
  52:     } else if (daysRemaining === 0 || daysRemaining === 1) {
  53:       return 'CRITICAL'; // J-1 ou J-0
  54:     } else if (daysRemaining <= 3) {
  55:       return 'URGENT'; // J-3 Ã  J-2
  56:     } else if (daysRemaining <= 7) {
  57:       return 'APPROACHING'; // J-7 Ã  J-4
  58:     }
  59:     return 'PENDING';
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   /**
  63:    * VÃ©rifier et mettre Ã  jour une deadline
  64:    */
  65:   private async checkSingleDeadline(deadline: any): Promise<DeadlineCheckResult | null> {
  66:     const daysRemaining = this.calculateDaysRemaining(deadline.dueDate);
  67:     const newStatus = this.determineStatus(daysRemaining, deadline.status);
  68: 
  69:     // Pas de changement nÃ©cessaire
  70:     if (newStatus === deadline.status) {
  71:       return null;
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     // Mettre Ã  jour status + flags alert
  75:     const updates: any = { status: newStatus };
  76: 
  77:     if (daysRemaining <= 7 && !deadline.alertJ7Sent) {
  78:       updates.alertJ7Sent = true;
  79:     }
  80:     if (daysRemaining <= 3 && !deadline.alertJ3Sent) {
  81:       updates.alertJ3Sent = true;
  82:     }
  83:     if (daysRemaining <= 1 && !deadline.alertJ1Sent) {
  84:       updates.alertJ1Sent = true;
  85:     }
  86: 
  87:     await this.prisma.legalDeadline.update({
  88:       where: { id: deadline.id },
  89:       data: updates,
  90:     });
  91: 
  92:     // CrÃ©er EventLog selon nouveau status
  93:     let eventType: any = null;
  94:     if (newStatus === 'APPROACHING') eventType = 'DEADLINE_APPROACHING';
  95:     else if (newStatus === 'URGENT') eventType = 'DEADLINE_URGENT';
  96:     else if (newStatus === 'CRITICAL') eventType = 'DEADLINE_CRITICAL';
  97:     else if (newStatus === 'OVERDUE') eventType = 'DEADLINE_MISSED';
  98: 
  99:     let eventCreated = false;
 100:     if (eventType) {
 101:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 102:         tenantId: deadline.tenantId,
 103:         eventType,
 104:         actorType: 'SYSTEM',
 105:         entityType: 'deadline',
 106:         entityId: deadline.id,
 107:         metadata: {
 108:           deadlineId: deadline.id,
 109:           label: deadline.label,
 110:           type: deadline.type,
 111:           dueDate: deadline.dueDate.toISOString(),
 112:           daysRemaining,
 113:           previousStatus: deadline.status,
 114:           newStatus,
 115:           dossierId: deadline.dossierId,
 116:           clientId: deadline.clientId,
 117:         },
 118:       });
 119:       eventCreated = true;
 120:     }
 121: 
 122:     return {
 123:       deadlineId: deadline.id,
 124:       label: deadline.label,
 125:       dueDate: deadline.dueDate,
 126:       previousStatus: deadline.status,
 127:       newStatus,
 128:       daysRemaining,
 129:       eventCreated,
 130:     };
 131:   }

 134:    * VÃ©rifier toutes les deadlines actives

 136:   async checkAllDeadlines(tenantId?: string) {
 137:     const where: any = {
 138:       status: {
 139:         notIn: ['COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'],
 140:       },
 141:     };

 172:       results,

  90: /**
  91:  * Extrait les dates et delais d'un texte
  92:  */
  93: function extractDeadlinesFromText(text: string): ExtractedDeadline[] {
  94:   const deadlines: ExtractedDeadline[] = [];
  95:   const today = new Date();
  96: 
  97:   // Patterns de recherche pour les dates
  98:   const datePatterns = [
  99:     /audience.*?(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})/gi,
 100:     /delai.*?(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})/gi,
 101:     /avant le.*?(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})/gi,
 102:     /echeance.*?(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})/gi,
 103:     /date limite.*?(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})/gi,
 104:   ];
 105: 
 106:   datePatterns.forEach((pattern, index) => {
 107:     const matches = text.matchAll(pattern);
 108:     for (const match of matches) {
 109:       const dateStr = match[1];
 110:       const date = parseDate(dateStr);
 111: 
 112:       if (date) {
 113:         const daysRemaining = Math.ceil((date.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
 114: 
 115:         deadlines.push({
 116:           type: index === 0 ? 'AUDIENCE' : index === 1 ? 'DEPOT' : 'REPONSE',
 117:           date: date.toISOString().split('T')[0],
 118:           description: match[0],
 119:           priority: daysRemaining <= 7 ? 'HAUTE' : daysRemaining <= 30 ? 'MOYENNE' : 'BASSE',
 120:           daysRemaining,
 121:         });
 122:       }
 123:     }
 124:   });
 125: 
 126:   return deadlines;
 127: }

 129: /**
 130:  * Extrait les noms des parties d'un document

 132: function extractPartiesFromText(text: string): string[] {
 133:   const parties: Set<string> = new Set();
 134: 
 135:   // Patterns pour identifier les parties
 136:   const patterns = [
 137:     /(?:demandeur|requerant|plaignant)\s*:\s*([A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+(?:\s+[A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+)*)/gi,
 138:     /(?:defendeur|intime)\s*:\s*([A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+(?:\s+[A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+)*)/gi,
 139:     /M\.\s+([A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+)/g,
 140:     /Mme\s+([A-Ze-e][a-ze-e]+)/g,
 141:   ];
 142: 
 143:   patterns.forEach(pattern => {
 144:     const matches = text.matchAll(pattern);
 145:     for (const match of matches) {
 146:       if (match[1]) {
 147:         parties.add(match[1].trim());
 148:       }
 149:     }
 150:   });
 151: 
 152:   return Array.from(parties);
 153: }

 155: /**
 156:  * Detecte le type d'affaire
 157:  */
 158: function detectCaseType(text: string): string {
 159:   const lowerText = text.toLowerCase();
 160: 
 161:   if (
 162:     lowerText.includes('divorce') ||
 163:     lowerText.includes('succession') ||
 164:     lowerText.includes('propriete')
 165:   ) {
 166:     return 'CIVIL';
 167:   }
 168:   if (lowerText.includes('vol') || lowerText.includes('agression') || lowerText.includes('penal')) {
 169:     return 'PENAL';
 170:   }
 171:   if (
 172:     lowerText.includes('commercial') ||
 173:     lowerText.includes('societe') ||
 174:     lowerText.includes('contrat')
 175:   ) {
 176:     return 'COMMERCIAL';
 177:   }
 178:   if (
 179:     lowerText.includes('administratif') ||
 180:     lowerText.includes('permis') ||
 181:     lowerText.includes('urbanisme')
 182:   ) {
 183:     return 'ADMINISTRATIF';
 184:   }
 185: 
 186:   return 'CIVIL';
 187: }

 222: /**

 224:  */
 225: function parseDate(dateStr: string): Date | null {
 226:   const parts = dateStr.split(/[\/\-]/);
 227:   if (parts.length === 3) {
 228:     const day = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
 229:     const month = parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1;
 230:     const year = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
 231: 
 232:     const date = new Date(year, month, day);
 233:     if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
 234:       return date;
 235:     }
 236:   }
 237:   return null;

   1: /**
   2:  * Document text extraction service
   3:  * Extracts text from PDF (pdf-parse) and DOCX (mammoth).
   4:  * Both packages are already in package.json dependencies.
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   9: 
  10: interface ExtractionResult {
  11:   text: string;
  12:   confidence: number;
  13:   pages?: number;
  14: }
  15: 
  16: /**
  17:  * Extract text from a document buffer based on MIME type
  18:  */
  19: export async function extractText(
  20:   buffer: Buffer,
  21:   mimeType: string
  22: ): Promise<ExtractionResult> {
  23:   switch (mimeType) {
  24:     case 'application/pdf':
  25:       return extractFromPDF(buffer);
  26:     case 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document':
  27:       return extractFromDOCX(buffer);
  28:     case 'text/plain':
  29:       return { text: buffer.toString('utf-8'), confidence: 1.0 };
  30:     default:
  31:       return { text: '', confidence: 0 };
  32:   }
  33: }
  34: 
  35: async function extractFromPDF(buffer: Buffer): Promise<ExtractionResult> {
  36:   try {
  37:     const pdfParseModule = await import('pdf-parse');
  38:     const pdfParse = (pdfParseModule as any).default || pdfParseModule;
  39:     const data = await pdfParse(buffer);
  40:     return {
  41:       text: data.text || '',
  42:       confidence: data.text?.length > 10 ? 0.95 : 0.3,
  43:       pages: data.numpages,
  44:     };
  45:   } catch (error) {
  46:     logger.error('[OCR] PDF extraction failed', { error });
  47:     return { text: '', confidence: 0 };
  48:   }
  49: }
  50: 
  51: async function extractFromDOCX(buffer: Buffer): Promise<ExtractionResult> {
  52:   try {
  53:     const mammoth = await import('mammoth');
  54:     const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer });
  55:     return {
  56:       text: result.value || '',
  57:       confidence: result.value?.length > 10 ? 0.95 : 0.3,
  58:     };
  59:   } catch (error) {
  60:     logger.error('[OCR] DOCX extraction failed', { error });
  61:     return { text: '', confidence: 0 };
  62:   }
  63: }
  64: 
  65: /**
  66:  * Process OCR for a document and update the DB record
  67:  */
  68: export async function processDocumentOCR(documentId: string, buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string) {
  69:   try {
  70:     const result = await extractText(buffer, mimeType);
  71: 
  72:     if (result.text.length === 0) {
  73:       await prisma.document.update({
  74:         where: { id: documentId },
  75:         data: { ocrProcessed: true, ocrConfidence: 0 },
  76:       });
  77:       return;
  78:     }
  79: 
  80:     await prisma.document.update({
  81:       where: { id: documentId },
  82:       data: {
  83:         ocrProcessed: true,
  84:         ocrText: result.text.substring(0, 50000),
  85:         ocrConfidence: result.confidence,
  86:       },
  87:     });
  88: 
  89:     logger.info('[OCR] Extraction complete', {
  90:       documentId,
  91:       chars: result.text.length,
  92:       confidence: result.confidence,
  93:       pages: result.pages,
  94:     });
  95:   } catch (error) {
  96:     logger.error('[OCR] Processing failed', { documentId, error });
  97:     await prisma.document.update({
  98:       where: { id: documentId },
  99:       data: { ocrProcessed: true, ocrConfidence: 0 },
 100:     }).catch(() => {});
 101:   }
 102: }

 119:   private extractNames(text: string): string[] {
 120:     const nameRegex = /\b[A-ZÃ€-Ã][a-zÃ -Ã½]+(?:\s+[A-ZÃ€-Ã][a-zÃ -Ã½]+)*\b/g;
 121:     const matches = text.match(nameRegex);

 124:           name =>
 125:             name.length > 2 &&
 126:             ![
 127:               'Monsieur',
 128:               'Madame',
 129:               'Mademoiselle',
 130:               'Le',
 131:               'La',
 132:               'Les',
 133:               'Vu',
 134:               'Article',
 135:               'RÃ‰PUBLIQUE',
 136:               'FRANÃ‡AISE',
 137:               'AU',
 138:               'NOM',
 139:               'DU',
 140:               'PEUPLE',
 141:               'FRANÃ‡AIS',
 142:             ].includes(name)
 143:         )
 144:       : [];
 145:     return [...new Set(filtered)];
 146:   }

 148:   /**
 149:    * Extraire numÃ©ros (tÃ©lÃ©phone, dossier, etc.)
 150:    */
 151:   private extractNumbers(text: string): string[] {
 152:     const numberRegex = /\b(?:\d{10}|\d{2}\s\d{2}\s\d{2}\s\d{2}\s\d{2}|NÂ°\s*\d+)\b/g;

 160:   private extractEmails(text: string): string[] {

 163:     return matches ? [...new Set(matches)] : [];

 166:   /**
 167:    * Traiter un document (OCR + extraction entitÃ©s)
 168:    */
 169:   async processDocument(params: ProcessDocumentParams): Promise<OCRResult> {
 170:     const { documentId, tenantId, fileBuffer, mimeType } = params;
 171: 
 172:     try {
 173:       // VÃ©rifier que document existe
 174:       const document = await this.prisma.document.findUnique({
 175:         where: { id: documentId },
 176:       });
 177: 
 178:       if (!document || document.tenantId !== tenantId) {
 179:         throw new Error('Document not found');
 180:       }
 181: 
 182:       // Extraction OCR
 183:       const ocrResult = await this.extractTextFromBuffer(fileBuffer || Buffer.from(''), mimeType);
 184: 
 185:       // Sauvegarder rÃ©sultats en DB
 186:       await this.prisma.document.update({
 187:         where: { id: documentId },
 188:         data: {
 189:           ocrProcessed: true,
 190:           ocrText: ocrResult.text,

 192:           extractedData: JSON.stringify({
 193:             entities: ocrResult.entities,
 194:             wordCount: ocrResult.wordCount,
 195:             language: ocrResult.language,
 196:           }),
 197:         },
 198:       });
 199: 
 200:       // EventLog DOCUMENT_OCR_PROCESSED
 201:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 202:         tenantId,
 203:         eventType: 'DOCUMENT_OCR_PROCESSED',
 204:         actorType: 'SYSTEM',
 205:         entityType: 'document',
 206:         entityId: documentId,
 207:         metadata: {
 208:           documentId,
 209:           filename: document.filename,
 210:           mimeType,
 211:           confidence: ocrResult.confidence,
 212:           textLength: ocrResult.text.length,
 213:           wordCount: ocrResult.wordCount,
 214:           entitiesFound: {
 215:             dates: ocrResult.entities.dates?.length || 0,
 216:             names: ocrResult.entities.names?.length || 0,
 217:             numbers: ocrResult.entities.numbers?.length || 0,
 218:             emails: ocrResult.entities.emails?.length || 0,
 219:           },
 220:         },
 221:       });
 222: 
 223:       return ocrResult;
 224:     } catch (error: any) {
 225:       // EventLog DOCUMENT_OCR_FAILED
 226:       await this.eventLogService.createEventLog({
 227:         tenantId,
 228:         eventType: 'DOCUMENT_OCR_FAILED',
 229:         actorType: 'SYSTEM',
 230:         entityType: 'document',
 231:         entityId: documentId,
 232:         metadata: {
 233:           documentId,
 234:           error: error.message,
 235:           mimeType,
 236:         },
 237:       });
 238: 
 239:       throw error;
 240:     }
 241:   }

   1: /**

   5: import prisma from '@/lib/prisma';

   9: 
  10: export class DossierService {
  11:   /**
  12:    * Genere un numero de dossier unique pour un tenant
  13:    */
  14:   static async generateNumeroDossier(tenantId: string): Promise<string> {
  15:     const count = await prisma.dossier.count({
  16:       where: { tenantId },
  17:     });
  18:     return generateNumeroDossier(count);
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   /**
  22:    * Cree un nouveau dossier (utilise par l'avocat)
  23:    */
  24:   static async createDossier(data: CreateDossierDTO, tenantId: string): Promise<DossierDB> {
  25:     // Verifier que le client appartient au tenant
  26:     const client = await prisma.client.findFirst({
  27:       where: {
  28:         id: data.clientId,
  29:         tenantId,
  30:       },
  31:     });
  32: 
  33:     if (!client) {
  34:       throw new Error('Client non trouve ou acces refuse');
  35:     }
  36: 
  37:     // Generer le numero
  38:     const numero = await this.generateNumeroDossier(tenantId);
  39: 
  40:     // Creer le dossier
  41:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.create({
  42:       data: {
  43:         numero,
  44:         typeDossier: data.typeDossier,
  45:         objet: data.objetDemande,
  46:         priorite: mapPrioriteToDB(data.priorite || 'NORMALE'),
  47:         statut: mapStatutToDB(data.statut || 'EN_COURS'),
  48:         dateEcheance: data.dateEcheance ? new Date(data.dateEcheance) : null,
  49:         notes: data.notes || '',
  50:         tenantId,
  51:         clientId: data.clientId,
  52:         dateCreation: new Date(),
  53:       },
  54:       include: {
  55:         client: {
  56:           select: {
  57:             id: true,
  58:             firstName: true,
  59:             lastName: true,
  60:             email: true,
  61:           },
  62:         },
  63:         _count: {
  64:           select: {
  65:             documents: true,
  66:             echeances: true,
  67:           },
  68:         },
  69:       },
  70:     });
  71: 
  72:     return dossier as any;
  73:   }
  74:

   1: /**

src\lib\services\encryption.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: import crypto from 'crypto';
   3: 
   4: const ENCRYPTION_KEY = process.env.ENCRYPTION_KEY || crypto.randomBytes(32);
   5: const ALGORITHM = 'aes-256-gcm';
   6: 
   7: function getKey(): Buffer {
   8:   if (Buffer.isBuffer(ENCRYPTION_KEY)) {
   9:     return ENCRYPTION_KEY;
  10:   }
  11: 
  12:   return crypto.scryptSync(String(ENCRYPTION_KEY), 'memolib-encryption-salt', 32);
  13: }
  14: 
  15: export class EncryptionService {
  16:   static encrypt(text: string): string {
  17:     if (!text) return text;
  18: 
  19:     const iv = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  20:     const key = getKey();
  21:     const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv) as crypto.CipherGCM;
  22:     cipher.setAAD(Buffer.from('memolib-sensitive-data'));
  23: 
  24:     let encrypted = cipher.update(text, 'utf8', 'hex');
  25:     encrypted += cipher.final('hex');
  26: 
  27:     const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  28: 
  29:     return `${iv.toString('hex')}:${authTag.toString('hex')}:${encrypted}`;
  30:   }
  31: 
  32:   static decrypt(encryptedText: string): string {
  33:     if (!encryptedText || !encryptedText.includes(':')) return encryptedText;
  34: 
  35:     try {
  36:       const [ivHex, authTagHex, encrypted] = encryptedText.split(':');
  37: 
  38:       const iv = Buffer.from(ivHex, 'hex');
  39:       const authTag = Buffer.from(authTagHex, 'hex');
  40: 
  41:       const key = getKey();
  42:       const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv(ALGORITHM, key, iv) as crypto.DecipherGCM;
  43:       decipher.setAAD(Buffer.from('memolib-sensitive-data'));
  44:       decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);
  45: 
  46:       let decrypted = decipher.update(encrypted, 'hex', 'utf8');
  47:       decrypted += decipher.final('utf8');
  48: 
  49:       return decrypted;
  50:     } catch {
  51:       return encryptedText;
  52:     }
  53:   }
  54: 
  55:   static hashPassword(password: string): string {
  56:     const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16);
  57:     const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100000, 64, 'sha512');
  58:     return `${salt.toString('hex')}:${hash.toString('hex')}`;
  59:   }
  60: 
  61:   static verifyPassword(password: string, hashedPassword: string): boolean {
  62:     if (!hashedPassword.includes(':')) return false;
  63: 
  64:     const [saltHex, hashHex] = hashedPassword.split(':');
  65:     const salt = Buffer.from(saltHex, 'hex');
  66:     const hash = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, 100000, 64, 'sha512');
  67: 
  68:     return hash.toString('hex') === hashHex;
  69:   }
  70: }

  57:   /**
  58:    * CrÃ©er un EventLog immuable
  59:    *
  60:    * RULE-005 : GÃ©nÃ¨re un checksum SHA-256 pour garantir l'intÃ©gritÃ©
  61:    * RULE-006 : L'Ã©vÃ©nement est horodatÃ© cÃ´tÃ© serveur
  62:    */
  63:   async createEventLog(params: CreateEventLogParams): Promise<EventLogData> {
  64:     const { eventType, entityType, entityId, actorType, actorId, metadata = {}, tenantId } = params;
  65: 
  66:     // Horodatage serveur (source de vÃ©ritÃ© - RULE-003)
  67:     const timestamp = new Date();
  68: 
  69:     // Calcul checksum AVANT insertion (RULE-006)
  70:     const checksum = this.calculateChecksum({
  71:       timestamp,
  72:       eventType,
  73:       entityType,
  74:       entityId,
  75:       actorType,

  77:       metadata,
  78:       tenantId,
  79:     });
  80:

  83:       data: {
  84:         timestamp,
  85:         eventType,
  86:         entityType,
  87:         entityId,
  88:         actorType,
  89:         actorId: actorId || null,
  90:         metadata: metadata as any,
  91:         tenantId,
  92:         immutable: true, // Toujours true (sÃ©curitÃ© DB)
  93:         checksum,
  94:       },
  95:     });
  96: 
  97:     return eventLog;
  98:   }
  99: 
 100:   /**
 101:    * Calculer le checksum SHA-256 d'un Ã©vÃ©nement
 102:    *
 103:    * RULE-006 : Hash canonique pour vÃ©rification d'intÃ©gritÃ©
 104:    */
 105:   private calculateChecksum(event: {
 106:     timestamp: Date;
 107:     eventType: EventType;
 108:     entityType: string;
 109:     entityId: string;
 110:     actorType: ActorType;
 111:     actorId: string | null;
 112:     metadata: any;
 113:     tenantId: string;
 114:   }): string {
 115:     // Canonicalisation : ordre dÃ©terministe des champs
 116:     const canonical = JSON.stringify({
 117:       timestamp: event.timestamp.toISOString(),
 118:       eventType: event.eventType,
 119:       entityType: event.entityType,
 120:       entityId: event.entityId,
 121:       actorType: event.actorType,
 122:       actorId: event.actorId,
 123:       metadata: event.metadata,
 124:       tenantId: event.tenantId,
 125:     });
 126: 
 127:     return createHash('sha256').update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex');
 128:   }
 129: 
 130:   /**
 131:    * VÃ©rifier l'intÃ©gritÃ© d'un EventLog
 132:    *
 133:    * Retourne true si le checksum stockÃ© = checksum recalculÃ©
 134:    */
 135:   async verifyIntegrity(eventLogId: string): Promise<boolean> {
 136:     const eventLog = await this.prisma.eventLog.findUnique({
 137:       where: { id: eventLogId },
 138:     });
 139: 
 140:     if (!eventLog) {
 141:       throw new Error(`EventLog ${eventLogId} not found`);
 142:     }
 143: 
 144:     const recalculatedChecksum = this.calculateChecksum({
 145:       timestamp: eventLog.timestamp,
 146:       eventType: eventLog.eventType,
 147:       entityType: eventLog.entityType,
 148:       entityId: eventLog.entityId,
 149:       actorType: eventLog.actorType,
 150:       actorId: eventLog.actorId,
 151:       metadata: eventLog.metadata,
 152:       tenantId: eventLog.tenantId,
 153:     });
 154: 
 155:     return recalculatedChecksum === eventLog.checksum;
 156:   }

src\lib\services\exportService.ts

   1: "use client"
   2: 
   3: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   4: 
   5: /**
   6:  * Service d'export multi-formats
   7:  * Supporte Excel, Word, CSV avec ExcelJS (securise)
   8:  */
   9: 
  10: import ExcelJS from 'exceljs'
  11: import { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableCell, TableRow } from 'docx'
  12: import Papa from 'papaparse'
  13: 
  14: /**
  15:  * Export vers Excel (.xlsx) avec ExcelJS
  16:  */
  17: export async function exportToExcel(
  18:   data: any[],
  19:   filename: string = 'export.xlsx',
  20:   sheetName: string = 'Data'
  21: ): Promise<void> {
  22:   try {
  23:     const workbook = new ExcelJS.Workbook()
  24:     const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet(sheetName)
  25: 
  26:     if (data.length > 0) {
  27:       // Ajouter les en-tetes (cles du premier objet)
  28:       const headers = Object.keys(data[0])
  29:       worksheet.addRow(headers)
  30:       
  31:       // Ajouter les donnees
  32:       data.forEach(row => {
  33:         const values = headers.map(h => row[h])
  34:         worksheet.addRow(values)
  35:       })
  36:     }
  37: 
  38:     // Generer et telecharger
  39:     const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer()
  40:     const blob = new Blob([buffer], { 
  41:       type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' 
  42:     })
  43:     
  44:     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  45:     const a = document.createElement('a')
  46:     a.href = url
  47:     a.download = filename
  48:     a.click()
  49:     window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  50: 
  51:     logger.info('Export Excel reussi', { filename, rowCount: data.length });
  52:   } catch (error) {
  53:     logger.error('Erreur lors de l\'export Excel', error, { filename })
  54:     throw error
  55:   }
  56: }
  57: 
  58: /**
  59:  * Export de plusieurs feuilles vers Excel avec ExcelJS
  60:  */
  61: export async function exportToExcelMultiSheet(
  62:   sheets: Array<{ name: string; data: any[] }>,
  63:   filename: string = 'export.xlsx'
  64: ): Promise<void> {
  65:   try {

  67: 
  68:     sheets.forEach(sheet => {
  69:       const worksheet = workbook.addWorksheet(sheet.name)
  70:       
  71:       if (sheet.data.length > 0) {
  72:         const headers = Object.keys(sheet.data[0])
  73:         worksheet.addRow(headers)
  74:         
  75:         sheet.data.forEach(row => {
  76:           const values = headers.map(h => row[h])
  77:           worksheet.addRow(values)
  78:         })
  79:       }
  80:     })
  81: 
  82:     const buffer = await workbook.xlsx.writeBuffer()
  83:     const blob = new Blob([buffer], { 
  84:       type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' 
  85:     })
  86:     
  87:     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
  88:     const a = document.createElement('a')
  89:     a.href = url
  90:     a.download = filename
  91:     a.click()
  92:     window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  93: 
  94:     logger.info('Export Excel multi-feuilles reussi', { filename, sheetsCount: Object.keys(sheets).length });
  95:   } catch (error) {
  96:     logger.error('Erreur lors de l\'export Excel multi-feuilles', error, { filename })
  97:     throw error
  98:   }
  99: }

 101: /**
 102:  * Export vers Word (.docx)
 103:  */
 104: export async function exportToWord(
 105:   content: {
 106:     title?: string
 107:     sections: Array<{
 108:       title?: string
 109:       paragraphs: string[]
 110:       table?: {
 111:         headers: string[]
 112:         rows: string[][]
 113:       }
 114:     }>
 115:   },
 116:   filename: string = 'export.docx'
 117: ): Promise<void> {
 118:   try {
 119:     const children: any[] = []
 120: 
 121:     // Titre principal
 122:     if (content.title) {
 123:       children.push(
 124:         new Paragraph({
 125:           text: content.title,
 126:           heading: 'Heading1',
 127:           spacing: { after: 300 },
 128:         })
 129:       )
 130:     }
 131: 
 132:     // Sections
 133:     content.sections.forEach(section => {
 134:       // Titre de section
 135:       if (section.title) {
 136:         children.push(
 137:           new Paragraph({
 138:             text: section.title,
 139:             heading: 'Heading2',
 140:             spacing: { before: 200, after: 200 },
 141:           })
 142:         )
 143:       }
 144: 
 145:       // Paragraphes
 146:       section.paragraphs.forEach(para => {
 147:         children.push(
 148:           new Paragraph({
 149:             children: [new TextRun(para)],
 150:             spacing: { after: 100 },
 151:           })
 152:         )
 153:       })
 154: 
 155:       // Table
 156:       if (section.table) {
 157:         const tableRows: TableRow[] = [
 158:           // Headers
 159:           new TableRow({
 160:             children: section.table.headers.map(
 161:               h =>
 162:                 new TableCell({
 163:                   children: [new Paragraph({ text: h })],
 164:                 })
 165:             ),
 166:           }),
 167:           // Rows
 168:           ...section.table.rows.map(
 169:             row =>
 170:               new TableRow({
 171:                 children: row.map(
 172:                   cell =>
 173:                     new TableCell({
 174:                       children: [new Paragraph({ text: cell })],
 175:                     })
 176:                 ),
 177:               })
 178:           ),
 179:         ]
 180: 
 181:         children.push(
 182:           new Table({
 183:             rows: tableRows,
 184:           })
 185:         )
 186:       }
 187:     })
 188: 
 189:     // Creer le document
 190:     const doc = new Document({
 191:       sections: [
 192:         {
 193:           properties: {},
 194:           children,
 195:         },
 196:       ],
 197:     })
 198: 
 199:     // Generer et telecharger
 200:     const blob = await Packer.toBlob(doc)
 201:     const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob)
 202:     const link = document.createElement('a')
 203:     link.href = url
 204:     link.download = filename
 205:     document.body.appendChild(link)
 206:     link.click()

src\lib\services\filter-rule.service.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * FilterRuleService - Service de filtrage email automatique (Phase 3)
   4:  *
   5:  * Ãƒâ€°value des rÃ¨gles de filtrage pour router automatiquement les emails
   6:  * vers dossiers, clients, catÃ©gories selon conditions (from, subject, etc.)
   7:  *
   8:  * @example
   9:  * ```ts
  10:  * const service = new FilterRuleService();
  11:  * const matches = await service.evaluateAllRules(email, tenantId);
  12:  * for (const match of matches) {
  13:  *   await service.applyActions(email.id, match.rule);
  14:  * }
  15:  * ```
  16:  */
  17: 
  18: import { PrismaClient, FilterRule, Email } from '@prisma/client';
  19: import { eventLogService } from './event-log.service';
  20: 
  21: export type FilterCondition = {
  22:   field: 'from' | 'to' | 'subject' | 'body' | 'category' | 'urgency' | 'sentiment';
  23:   operator: 'EQUALS' | 'CONTAINS' | 'STARTS_WITH' | 'ENDS_WITH' | 'REGEX' | 'IN' | 'NOT_IN';
  24:   value: string | string[];
  25: };
  26: 
  27: export type FilterAction = {
  28:   type:
  29:     | 'ASSIGN_DOSSIER'
  30:     | 'ASSIGN_CLIENT'
  31:     | 'SET_CATEGORY'
  32:     | 'SET_URGENCY'
  33:     | 'SET_TAGS'
  34:     | 'MARK_STARRED'
  35:     | 'ARCHIVE'
  36:     | 'NOTIFY_USER'
  37:     | 'TRIGGER_WORKFLOW';
  38:   dossierId?: string;
  39:   clientId?: string;
  40:   value?: string;
  41:   userId?: string;
  42:   workflowId?: string;
  43: };
  44: 
  45: export type RuleMatch = {
  46:   rule: FilterRule;
  47:   matchedConditions: string[]; // Liste des champs qui ont matchÃ©
  48:   confidence: number; // 0-1 (% conditions matchÃ©es)
  49: };
  50: 
  51: export class FilterRuleService {
  52:   constructor(private prisma: PrismaClient = new PrismaClient()) {}
  53: 
  54:   /**
  55:    * Ãƒâ€°value toutes les rÃ¨gles actives pour un email donnÃ©
  56:    * Retourne les rÃ¨gles qui matchent, triÃ©es par prioritÃ©
  57:    */
  58:   async evaluateAllRules(email: Email, tenantId: string): Promise<RuleMatch[]> {
  59:     const rules = await this.prisma.filterRule.findMany({
  60:       where: {
  61:         tenantId,
  62:         enabled: true,
  63:       },
  64:       orderBy: {
  65:         priority: 'asc', // Plus bas = plus prioritaire
  66:       },
  67:     });
  68: 
  69:     const matches: RuleMatch[] = [];
  70: 
  71:     for (const rule of rules) {
  72:       const match = this.evaluateRule(email, rule);
  73:       if (match) {
  74:         matches.push(match);
  75:       }
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     return matches;
  79:   }
  80: 
  81:   /**
  82:    * Ãƒâ€°value une rÃ¨gle contre un email
  83:    * Retourne RuleMatch si toutes les conditions sont remplies, null sinon
  84:    */
  85:   private evaluateRule(email: Email, rule: FilterRule): RuleMatch | null {
  86:     const conditions = rule.conditions as FilterCondition[];
  87:     const matchedConditions: string[] = [];
  88: 
  89:     for (const condition of conditions) {
  90:       if (this.evaluateCondition(email, condition)) {
  91:         matchedConditions.push(condition.field);
  92:       }
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     // Si toutes conditions matchent, c'est un succÃ¨s
  96:     if (matchedConditions.length === conditions.length) {
  97:       return {
  98:         rule,
  99:         matchedConditions,
 100:         confidence: 1.0,
 101:       };
 102:     }
 103: 
 104:     return null;
 105:   }
 106: 
 107:   /**
 108:    * Ãƒâ€°value une condition individuelle
 109:    */
 110:   private evaluateCondition(email: Email, condition: FilterCondition): boolean {
 111:     const fieldValue = this.getFieldValue(email, condition.field);
 112:     if (!fieldValue) return false;
 113: 
 114:     switch (condition.operator) {
 115:       case 'EQUALS':
 116:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase() === (condition.value as string).toLowerCase();
 117: 
 118:       case 'CONTAINS':
 119:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().includes((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 120: 
 121:       case 'STARTS_WITH':
 122:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().startsWith((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 123: 
 124:       case 'ENDS_WITH':
 125:         return fieldValue.toLowerCase().endsWith((condition.value as string).toLowerCase());
 126: 
 127:       case 'REGEX':
 128:         try {
 129:           const regex = new RegExp(condition.value as string, 'i');
 130:           return regex.test(fieldValue);
 131:         } catch {
 132:           return false;
 133:         }
 134: 
 135:       case 'IN':
 136:         return (condition.value as string[]).some(
 137:           v => v.toLowerCase() === fieldValue.toLowerCase()
 138:         );
 139: 
 140:       case 'NOT_IN':
 141:         return !(condition.value as string[]).some(
 142:           v => v.toLowerCase() === fieldValue.toLowerCase()
 143:         );
 144: 
 145:       default:
 146:         return false;
 147:     }
 148:   }
 149: 
 150:   /**
 151:    * RÃ©cupÃ¨re la valeur d'un champ email
 152:    */
 153:   private getFieldValue(email: Email, field: FilterCondition['field']): string | null {
 154:     switch (field) {
 155:       case 'from':
 156:         return email.from;
 157:       case 'to':
 158:         return email.to;
 159:       case 'subject':
 160:         return email.subject;
 161:       case 'body':
 162:         return email.body;
 163:       case 'category':
 164:         return email.category;
 165:       case 'urgency':
 166:         return email.urgency;
 167:       case 'sentiment':
 168:         return email.sentiment;
 169:       default:
 170:         return null;
 171:     }
 172:   }
 173: 
 174:   /**

 201:           break;
 202: 
 203:         case 'SET_URGENCY':
 204:           if (action.value) {
 205:             updateData.urgency = action.value;
 206:           }
 207:           break;
 208: 
 209:         case 'SET_TAGS':
 210:           if (action.value) {
 211:             updateData.tags = action.value;
 212:           }
 213:           break;
 214: 
 215:         case 'MARK_STARRED':
 216:           updateData.isStarred = true;
 217:           break;

 219:         case 'ARCHIVE':

 228:           // TODO: implÃ©menter trigger workflow
 229:           break;
 230:       }
 231:     }
 232: 
 233:     // Mettre Ã  jour email
 234:     await this.prisma.email.update({

 236:       data: updateData,
 237:     });
 238: 
 239:     // Mettre Ã  jour stats de la rÃ¨gle
 240:     await this.prisma.filterRule.update({
 241:       where: { id: rule.id },
 242:       data: {
 243:         matchCount: { increment: 1 },
 244:         lastMatchedAt: new Date(),
 245:         lastMatchedBy: emailId,

 247:     });
 248: 
 249:     // Tracer avec EventLog
 250:     await eventLogService.createEventLog({

src\lib\services\information-unit.service.ts

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * InformationUnitService
   4:  *
   5:  * Core service for the "Zero Ignored Information" guarantee
   6:  * Implements closed pipeline state machine with automatic escalations
   7:  *
   8:  * Pipeline: RECEIVED -> CLASSIFIED -> ANALYZED -> [INCOMPLETE|AMBIGUOUS|RESOLVED] -> CLOSED
   9:  *
  10:  * @file src/lib/services/information-unit.service.ts
  11:  * @date 2026-01-22
  12:  */
  13: 
  14: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  15: import crypto from 'crypto';
  16: 
  17: type InformationUnitSource = string;
  18: 
  19: export const InformationUnitStatus = {
  20:   RECEIVED: 'RECEIVED',
  21:   CLASSIFIED: 'CLASSIFIED',
  22:   ANALYZED: 'ANALYZED',
  23:   INCOMPLETE: 'INCOMPLETE',
  24:   AMBIGUOUS: 'AMBIGUOUS',
  25:   HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED: 'HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED',
  26:   RESOLVED: 'RESOLVED',
  27:   CLOSED: 'CLOSED',
  28: } as const;
  29: 
  30: type InformationUnitStatusValue =
  31:   (typeof InformationUnitStatus)[keyof typeof InformationUnitStatus];
  32: 
  33: // ============================================
  34: // TYPES
  35: // ============================================
  36: 
  37: interface CreateInformationUnitInput {
  38:   tenantId: string;
  39:   source: InformationUnitSource;
  40:   content: string;
  41:   sourceMetadata?: Record<string, any>;
  42:   linkedWorkspaceId?: string;
  43:   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  44: }
  45: 
  46: interface TransitionInput {
  47:   unitId: string;
  48:   toStatus: InformationUnitStatusValue;
  49:   reason: string;
  50:   changedBy: string;
  51:   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  52: }
  53: 
  54: interface EscalationResult {
  55:   unitId: string;
  56:   previousStatus: InformationUnitStatusValue;
  57:   newStatus: InformationUnitStatusValue;
  58:   escalationAction: string;
  59:   escalatedAt: Date;
  60: }
  61: 
  62: // ============================================
  63: // STATE MACHINE RULES
  64: // ============================================
  65: 
  66: // Define allowed transitions (CLOSED PIPELINE)
  67: const ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: Record<InformationUnitStatusValue, InformationUnitStatusValue[]> = {
  68:   RECEIVED: ['CLASSIFIED'],
  69:   CLASSIFIED: ['ANALYZED'],
  70:   ANALYZED: ['INCOMPLETE', 'AMBIGUOUS', 'RESOLVED'],
  71:   INCOMPLETE: ['INCOMPLETE', 'HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED', 'RESOLVED'], // Can stay or escalate
  72:   AMBIGUOUS: ['HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED', 'RESOLVED'], // Ambiguous items go to human action
  73:   HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED: ['RESOLVED'], // Only one way out
  74:   RESOLVED: ['CLOSED'], // Can only go to closed
  75:   CLOSED: [], // Terminal state
  76: };
  77: 
  78: // Status timeouts (maximum time in each status)
  79: const STATUS_TIMEOUTS: Record<InformationUnitStatusValue, number> = {
  80:   RECEIVED: 5 * 60, // 5 minutes
  81:   CLASSIFIED: 15 * 60, // 15 minutes
  82:   ANALYZED: 30 * 60, // 30 minutes
  83:   INCOMPLETE: 72 * 60 * 60, // 72 hours (escalates at 72h)
  84:   AMBIGUOUS: 1 * 60 * 60, // 1 hour (should escalate immediately)
  85:   HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED: 96 * 60 * 60, // 96 hours (escalates at 96h)
  86:   RESOLVED: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60, // 7 days
  87:   CLOSED: Infinity, // No timeout
  88: };
  89: 
  90: // ============================================
  91: // ESCALATION RULES
  92: // ============================================
  93: 
  94: const ESCALATION_RULES = {
  95:   INCOMPLETE: {
  96:     reminder_at: 48 * 60 * 60, // 48 hours: send reminder to client
  97:     escalate_at: 72 * 60 * 60, // 72 hours: escalate to HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED
  98:   },
  99:   AMBIGUOUS: {
 100:     immediate: true, // Immediate escalation
 101:   },
 102:   HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED: {
 103:     escalate_at: 96 * 60 * 60, // 96 hours: escalate to admin alert
 104:   },
 105: };
 106: 
 107: // ============================================
 108: // SERVICE CLASS
 109: // ============================================
 110: 
 111: export class InformationUnitService {
 112:   /**
 113:    * Create a new information unit
 114:    * Auto-transitions: RECEIVED -> (auto-classify) -> CLASSIFIED
 115:    */
 116:   async create(input: CreateInformationUnitInput) {
 117:     // Calculate content hash for deduplication
 118:     const contentHash = this.calculateHash(input.content);
 119: 
 120:     // Check for duplicate
 121:     const existing = await prisma.informationUnit.findUnique({
 122:       where: { contentHash },
 123:     });
 124: 
 125:     if (existing) {
 126:       console.warn(`[InformationUnit] Duplicate detected for tenant ${input.tenantId}`);
 127:       return existing;
 128:     }
 129: 
 130:     // Create unit in RECEIVED status
 131:     const unit = await prisma.informationUnit.create({
 132:       data: {
 133:         tenantId: input.tenantId,
 134:         source: input.source,
 135:         content: input.content,
 136:         contentHash,
 137:         sourceMetadata: input.sourceMetadata,
 138:         linkedWorkspaceId: input.linkedWorkspaceId,
 139:         metadata: input.metadata,
 140:         currentStatus: InformationUnitStatus.RECEIVED,
 141:         statusReason: `Recu via ${input.source}`,
 142:         lastStatusChangeBy: 'system',
 143:         statusHistory: [
 144:           {
 145:             timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 146:             fromStatus: null,
 147:             toStatus: InformationUnitStatus.RECEIVED,
 148:             reason: `Auto-cree via ${input.source}`,
 149:             changedBy: 'system',
 150:             metadata: input.sourceMetadata,
 151:           },
 152:         ],
 153:       },
 154:     });
 155: 
 156:     // Auto-classify to CLASSIFIED (simulated AI classification)
 157:     // In production, this would call AI classification service
 158:     await this.transition({
 159:       unitId: unit.id,
 160:       toStatus: InformationUnitStatus.CLASSIFIED,
 161:       reason: 'Classification automatique (IA)',
 162:       changedBy: 'system',
 163:       metadata: {
 164:         confidence: 0.89,
 165:         classifier: 'llama3.2:3b',
 166:       },
 167:     });
 168: 
 169:     return unit;
 170:   }
 171: 
 172:   /**
 173:    * Transition unit to new status (enforces state machine rules)
 174:    */
 175:   async transition(input: TransitionInput) {
 176:     const unit = await prisma.informationUnit.findUnique({
 177:       where: { id: input.unitId },
 178:     });
 179: 
 180:     if (!unit) {
 181:       throw new Error(`InformationUnit not found: ${input.unitId}`);
 182:     }
 183: 
 184:     // Validate transition is allowed
 185:     this.validateTransition(unit.currentStatus, input.toStatus);
 186: 
 187:     // Validate required fields for state transitions
 188:     this.validateStatusRequirements(input.toStatus, input.reason);
 189: 
 190:     // Append to audit trail
 191:     const newHistory = [
 192:       ...((unit.statusHistory as any[]) || []),
 193:       {
 194:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 195:         fromStatus: unit.currentStatus,
 196:         toStatus: input.toStatus,
 197:         reason: input.reason,
 198:         changedBy: input.changedBy,
 199:         metadata: input.metadata,
 200:       },
 201:     ];
 202: 
 203:     // Determine if this status requires human action
 204:     const requiresAction = this.checkHumanActionRequired(input.toStatus);
 205: 
 206:     // Update unit
 207:     const updated = await prisma.informationUnit.update({
 208:       where: { id: input.unitId },
 209:       data: {
 210:         currentStatus: input.toStatus,
 211:         statusReason: input.reason,
 212:         statusHistory: newHistory,
 213:         lastStatusChangeAt: new Date(),
 214:         lastStatusChangeBy: input.changedBy,
 215:         requiresHumanAction: requiresAction,
 216:         metadata: input.metadata,
 217:       },
 218:     });
 219: 
 220:     return updated;
 221:   }
 222: 
 223:   /**
 224:    * Validate state machine transition is allowed
 225:    * @throws Error if transition is forbidden
 226:    */
 227:   private validateTransition(
 228:     fromStatus: InformationUnitStatusValue,
 229:     toStatus: InformationUnitStatusValue
 230:   ): void {
 231:     // CRITICAL RULE: No direct jump to CLOSED except from RESOLVED (check first for specific error message)
 232:     if (
 233:       toStatus === InformationUnitStatus.CLOSED &&
 234:       fromStatus !== InformationUnitStatus.RESOLVED
 235:     ) {
 236:       throw new Error(
 237:         `PIPELINE ERROR: Cannot transition from ${fromStatus} to CLOSED. Must pass through RESOLVED first.`
 238:       );
 239:     }
 240: 
 241:     const allowed = ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[fromStatus] || [];
 242: 
 243:     if (!allowed.includes(toStatus)) {
 244:       throw new Error(
 245:         `Forbidden transition: ${fromStatus} -> ${toStatus}. ` + `Allowed: ${allowed.join(', ')}`
 246:       );
 247:     }
 248:   }

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * Service d'Apprentissage Continu IA
   4:  * Analyse les validations humaines pour ameliorer les predictions
   5:  */
   6: 
   7: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   8: 
   9: export class LearningService {
  10:   /**
  11:    * Analyser les patterns de validation pour un tenant
  12:    */
  13:   static async analyzeValidationPatterns(tenantId: string, periodDays: number = 30) {
  14:     const startDate = new Date();
  15:     startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - periodDays);
  16: 
  17:     // Recuperer toutes les actions validees de la periode
  18:     const validatedActions = await prisma.aIAction.findMany({
  19:       where: {
  20:         tenantId,
  21:         validatedAt: {
  22:           gte: startDate
  23:         },
  24:         validationStatus: {
  25:           in: ['APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'MODIFIED_APPROVED', 'AUTO_APPROVED']
  26:         }
  27:       },
  28:       orderBy: { validatedAt: 'desc' }
  29:     });
  30: 
  31:     // Analyser par type d'action
  32:     const actionTypeAnalysis = new Map<string, {
  33:       total: number;
  34:       approved: number;
  35:       rejected: number;
  36:       modified: number;
  37:       avgConfidence: number;
  38:       totalConfidence: number;
  39:       shouldAdjust: boolean;
  40:       adjustment: number;
  41:     }>();
  42: 
  43:     validatedActions.forEach(action => {
  44:       const type = action.actionType;
  45:       const analysis = actionTypeAnalysis.get(type) || {
  46:         total: 0,
  47:         approved: 0,
  48:         rejected: 0,
  49:         modified: 0,
  50:         avgConfidence: 0,
  51:         totalConfidence: 0,
  52:         shouldAdjust: false,
  53:         adjustment: 0
  54:       };
  55: 
  56:       analysis.total++;
  57:       analysis.totalConfidence += action.confidence;
  58: 
  59:       switch (action.validationStatus) {
  60:         case 'APPROVED':
  61:         case 'AUTO_APPROVED':
  62:           analysis.approved++;
  63:           break;
  64:         case 'REJECTED':
  65:           analysis.rejected++;
  66:           break;
  67:         case 'MODIFIED_APPROVED':
  68:           analysis.modified++;
  69:           break;
  70:       }
  71: 
  72:       actionTypeAnalysis.set(type, analysis);
  73:     });
  74: 
  75:     // Calculer les ajustements de confiance
  76:     const results = Array.from(actionTypeAnalysis.entries()).map(([type, analysis]) => {
  77:       analysis.avgConfidence = analysis.total > 0 ? analysis.totalConfidence / analysis.total : 0;
  78:       
  79:       const successRate = analysis.total > 0 
  80:         ? (analysis.approved + analysis.modified) / analysis.total 
  81:         : 0;
  82: 
  83:       // Regles d'ajustement automatique
  84:       let adjustment = 0;
  85:       let shouldAdjust = false;
  86: 
  87:       if (analysis.total >= 10) { // Minimum 10 actions pour ajuster
  88:         if (successRate > 0.9) {
  89:           // Excellent taux de succes : augmenter la confiance
  90:           adjustment = 0.05; // +5%
  91:           shouldAdjust = true;
  92:         } else if (successRate < 0.7) {
  93:           // Taux de succes faible : diminuer la confiance
  94:           adjustment = -0.1; // -10%
  95:           shouldAdjust = true;
  96:         }
  97:       }
  98: 
  99:       analysis.shouldAdjust = shouldAdjust;
 100:       analysis.adjustment = adjustment;
 101: 
 102:       return {
 103:         actionType: type,
 104:         ...analysis,
 105:         successRate,
 106:         recommendation: this.getRecommendation(successRate, analysis.total)
 107:       };
 108:     });
 109: 
 110:     return {
 111:       periodDays,
 112:       totalActions: validatedActions.length,
 113:       actionTypes: results,
 114:       globalSuccessRate: validatedActions.length > 0 
 115:         ? validatedActions.filter(a => 
 116:             a.validationStatus === 'APPROVED' || 
 117:             a.validationStatus === 'AUTO_APPROVED' || 
 118:             a.validationStatus === 'MODIFIED_APPROVED'
 119:           ).length / validatedActions.length 
 120:         : 0,
 121:       generatedAt: new Date()
 122:     };
 123:   }
 124: 
 125:   /**
 126:    * Predire la probabilite d'approbation d'une action
 127:    */
 128:   static async predictApprovalProbability(
 129:     tenantId: string, 
 130:     actionType: string, 
 131:     confidence: number
 132:   ): Promise<{
 133:     probability: number;
 134:     recommendation: 'AUTO_APPROVE' | 'VALIDATION' | 'HIGH_RISK';
 135:     reasoning: string;
 136:   }> {
 137:     // Recuperer l'historique pour ce type d'action
 138:     const historicalActions = await prisma.aIAction.findMany({
 139:       where: {
 140:         tenantId,
 141:         actionType,
 142:         validationStatus: {
 143:           in: ['APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'MODIFIED_APPROVED', 'AUTO_APPROVED']
 144:         }
 145:       },
 146:       orderBy: { validatedAt: 'desc' },
 147:       take: 100 // Dernieres 100 actions
 148:     });
 149: 
 150:     if (historicalActions.length < 5) {
 151:       return {
 152:         probability: 0.5,
 153:         recommendation: 'VALIDATION',
 154:         reasoning: 'Pas assez de donnees historiques pour predire'
 155:       };
 156:     }
 157: 
 158:     // Analyser les actions avec une confiance similaire (+/-0.1)
 159:     const similarConfidenceActions = historicalActions.filter(action => 
 160:       Math.abs(action.confidence - confidence) <= 0.1
 161:     );
 162: 
 163:     let probability = 0.5;
 164:     let reasoning = '';
 165: 
 166:     if (similarConfidenceActions.length >= 3) {
 167:       const approved = similarConfidenceActions.filter(a => 
 168:         a.validationStatus === 'APPROVED' || 
 169:         a.validationStatus === 'AUTO_APPROVED' ||
 170:         a.validationStatus === 'MODIFIED_APPROVED'
 171:       ).length;
 172:       
 173:       probability = approved / similarConfidenceActions.length;
 174:       reasoning = `Base sur ${similarConfidenceActions.length} actions similaires`;
 175:     } else {
 176:       // Utiliser toutes les actions du type
 177:       const approved = historicalActions.filter(a => 
 178:         a.validationStatus === 'APPROVED' || 
 179:         a.validationStatus === 'AUTO_APPROVED' ||
 180:         a.validationStatus === 'MODIFIED_APPROVED'
 181:       ).length;
 182:       
 183:       probability = approved / historicalActions.length;
 184:       reasoning = `Base sur ${historicalActions.length} actions de ce type`;
 185:     }
 186: 
 187:     // Determiner la recommandation
 188:     let recommendation: 'AUTO_APPROVE' | 'VALIDATION' | 'HIGH_RISK';
 189:     
 190:     if (probability >= 0.9 && confidence >= 0.8) {
 191:       recommendation = 'AUTO_APPROVE';
 192:     } else if (probability >= 0.7) {
 193:       recommendation = 'VALIDATION';
 194:     } else {
 195:       recommendation = 'HIGH_RISK';
 196:     }
 197: 
 198:     return {
 199:       probability,
 200:       recommendation,
 201:       reasoning
 202:     };
 203:   }

 205:   /**
 206:    * Appliquer les ajustements de confiance automatiques
 207:    */
 208:   static async applyConfidenceAdjustments(tenantId: string) {
 209:     const analysis = await this.analyzeValidationPatterns(tenantId);
 210:     const adjustments = [];
 211: 
 212:     for (const actionType of analysis.actionTypes) {
 213:       if (actionType.shouldAdjust) {
 214:         // Dans une vraie implementation, on mettrait a jour les parametres du modele IA
 215:         // Ici on simule en enregistrant l'ajustement
 216:         adjustments.push({
 217:           actionType: actionType.actionType,
 218:           oldConfidence: actionType.avgConfidence,
 219:           adjustment: actionType.adjustment,
 220:           newConfidence: Math.max(0, Math.min(1, actionType.avgConfidence + actionType.adjustment)),
 221:           reason: actionType.successRate > 0.9 ? 'Excellent taux de succes' : 'Taux de succes faible'
 222:         });
 223:       }
 224:     }
 225: 
 226:     return {
 227:       adjustmentsApplied: adjustments.length,
 228:       adjustments,
 229:       appliedAt: new Date()
 230:     };
 231:   }

 244:         return {
 245:           actionType: current.actionType,
 246:           status: 'new' as const,
 247:           currentSuccessRate: current.successRate,
 248:           improvement: 0
