 107:     patterns: [
 108:       'demande d\'asile',
 109:       'protection internationale',
 110:       'statut de refugie',
 111:       'protection subsidiaire',

 115:     articles: [

 140: interface DelaiExtrait {
 141:   type: 'OQTF' | 'REFUS_TITRE' | 'ASILE' | 'AUTRE';
 142:   date: Date;
 143:   description: string;
 144:   priorite: 'CRITIQUE' | 'HAUTE' | 'NORMALE';
 145:   joursRestants: number;
 146:   confidence: number; // 0-100%
 147:   articlesCeseda: string[];
 148:   suggestionsRecours: string[];
 149:   checklistRecommandee: string[];
 150: }
 151: 
 152: /**
 153:  * Calcule le score de confiance base sur les patterns detectes
 154:  */
 155: function calculateConfidence(
 156:   text: string,
 157:   template: TemplateJuridique
 158: ): number {
 159:   let score = 0;
 160:   const textLower = text.toLowerCase();
 161: 
 162:   // Patterns principaux (40 points max)
 163:   const patternMatches = template.patterns.filter(p => 
 164:     textLower.includes(p.toLowerCase())
 165:   );
 166:   score += Math.min(patternMatches.length * 20, 40);
 167: 
 168:   // Articles CESEDA (30 points max)
 169:   const articleMatches = template.articles.filter(a => 
 170:     textLower.includes(a.toLowerCase())
 171:   );
 172:   score += Math.min(articleMatches.length * 15, 30);
 173: 
 174:   // Keywords juridiques (30 points max)
 175:   const keywordMatches = template.keywords.filter(k => 
 176:     textLower.includes(k.toLowerCase())
 177:   );
 178:   score += Math.min(keywordMatches.length * 3, 30);
 179: 
 180:   return Math.min(score, 100);
 181: }
 182: 
 183: /**
 184:  * Identifie automatiquement le type de dossier CESEDA
 185:  */
 186: export function identifierTypeDossier(
 187:   texte: string
 188: ): { type: TypeDossierCESEDA; confidence: number; articles: string[] } | null {
 189:   let bestMatch = {
 190:     template: null as TemplateJuridique | null,
 191:     confidence: 0
 192:   };
 193: 
 194:   for (const template of TEMPLATES_OQTF) {
 195:     const confidence = calculateConfidence(texte, template);
 196:     if (confidence > bestMatch.confidence) {
 197:       bestMatch = { template, confidence };
 198:     }
 199:   }
 200: 
 201:   // Seuil minimum de confiance: 40%
 202:   if (bestMatch.confidence < 40 || !bestMatch.template) {
 203:     return null;
 204:   }
 205: 
 206:   const articlesDetectes = bestMatch.template.articles.filter(article =>
 207:     texte.toLowerCase().includes(article.toLowerCase())
 208:   );
 209: 
 210:   logger.logAIAction('ANALYSIS', 'system', 'auto', {
 211:     type: bestMatch.template.type,
 212:     confidence: bestMatch.confidence,
 213:     articles: articlesDetectes
 214:   });
 215: 
 216:   return {
 217:     type: bestMatch.template.type,
 218:     confidence: bestMatch.confidence,
 219:     articles: articlesDetectes
 220:   };
 221: }

 243:       return [];
 244:     }
 245: 
 246:     const template = TEMPLATES_OQTF.find(t => t.type === identification.type);
 247:     if (!template) return [];
 248: 
 249:     // 2. Patterns de dates juridiques
 250:     const datePatterns = [

  28:   /** Si true, l'utilisateur est crÃ©Ã© en status 'pending_verification' */

  36: const PLAN_ALIASES: Record<string, string[]> = {

  39:   ENTERPRISE: ['ENTERPRISE'],

  41: 
  42: function generateSubdomain(cabinetNom: string | undefined, nom: string): string {
  43:   const baseSubdomain = (cabinetNom || nom || 'cabinet')
  44:     .toLowerCase()
  45:     .normalize('NFD')
  46:     .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
  47:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
  48:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
  49:     .slice(0, 30) || 'cabinet';
  50: 
  51:   const uniqueSuffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
  52:   return `${baseSubdomain}-${uniqueSuffix}`;
  53: }
  54: 
  55: // --- Main Service ---
  56: 
  57: /**
  58:  * Logique mÃ©tier d'inscription partagÃ©e entre les deux routes register.
  59:  * Valide les donnÃ©es, crÃ©e le tenant + utilisateur en transaction.
  60:  */
  61: export async function registerUser(
  62:   input: RegistrationInput,
  63:   options: RegistrationOptions = {}
  64: ): Promise<RegistrationResult> {
  65:   const { requireEmailVerification = false, createSubscription = true } = options;
  66:   const { prenom, nom, email, password, cabinetNom, plan: planName } = input;
  67: 
  68:   // 1. Validation champs obligatoires
  69:   if (!prenom || !nom || !email || !password) {
  70:     return { success: false, error: 'Champs obligatoires manquants', status: 400 };
  71:   }
  72: 
  73:   // 2. Validation format email
  74:   const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
  75:   if (!emailRegex.test(email)) {
  76:     return { success: false, error: "Format d'email invalide", status: 400 };
  77:   }
  78: 
  79:   // 3. Validation force mot de passe
  80:   const pwStrength = checkPasswordStrength(password);
  81:   if (!pwStrength.valid) {
  82:     return {
  83:       success: false,
  84:       error: pwStrength.errors[0] || 'Mot de passe trop faible',
  85:       status: 400,
  86:       details: pwStrength.errors,
  87:     };
  88:   }
  89: 
  90:   // 4. VÃ©rification doublon email
  91:   const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
  92:     where: { email: email.toLowerCase() },
  93:   });
  94: 
  95:   if (existingUser) {
  96:     return {
  97:       success: false,
  98:       error: 'Impossible de crÃ©er le compte. VÃ©rifiez vos informations ou essayez de vous connecter.',
  99:       status: 409,
 100:     };
 101:   }
 102: 
 103:   // 5. RÃ©solution du plan
 104:   const requestedPlan = String(planName || 'SOLO').toUpperCase();
 105:   const candidatePlanNames = PLAN_ALIASES[requestedPlan] || [requestedPlan];
 106: 
 107:   const plan = await prisma.plan.findFirst({
 108:     where: { name: { in: candidatePlanNames, mode: 'insensitive' } },
 109:   });
 110: 
 111:   if (!plan) {
 112:     return { success: false, error: 'Plan tarifaire invalide', status: 400 };
 113:   }
 114: 
 115:   // 6. Hash mot de passe
 116:   const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);
 117: 
 118:   // 7. CrÃ©ation en transaction
 119:   const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
 120:     const subdomain = generateSubdomain(cabinetNom, nom);
 121: 
 122:     const tenant = await tx.tenant.create({
 123:       data: {
 124:         id: randomUUID(),
 125:         name: cabinetNom || `Cabinet ${nom}`,
 126:         subdomain,
 127:         planId: plan.id,
 128:         currentWorkspaces: 0,
 129:         currentDossiers: 0,
 130:         currentClients: 0,
 131:         currentUsers: 1,
 132:         currentStorageGb: 0,
 133:         updatedAt: new Date(),
 134:       },
 135:     });
 136: 
 137:     const user = await tx.user.create({
 138:       data: {
 139:         id: randomUUID(),
 140:         email: email.toLowerCase(),
 141:         name: `${prenom} ${nom}`,
 142:         password: hashedPassword,
 143:         role: 'AVOCAT',
 144:         status: requireEmailVerification ? 'pending_verification' : 'active',
 145:         emailVerified: requireEmailVerification ? null : undefined,
 146:         tenantId: tenant.id,
 147:         updatedAt: new Date(),
 148:       },
 149:     });
 150: 
 151:     if (createSubscription) {
 152:       await tx.subscription.create({
 153:         data: {
 154:           id: randomUUID(),
 155:           tenantId: tenant.id,
 156:           planId: plan.id,
 157:           status: 'trialing',
 158:           billingCycle: 'monthly',
 159:           currentPeriodStart: new Date(),
 160:           currentPeriodEnd: new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 161:           trialEnd: new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
 162:           pricePerMonth: plan.priceMonthly,
 163:           currency: plan.currency,
 164:           updatedAt: new Date(),
 165:         },
 166:       });
 167: 
 168:       await tx.tenantSettings.create({
 169:         data: {
 170:           id: randomUUID(),
 171:           tenantId: tenant.id,
 172:           maxDossiers: plan.maxDossiers,
 173:           maxUsers: plan.maxUsers,
 174:           storageLimit: plan.maxStorageGb * 1000,
 175:           ollamaEnabled: true,
 176:           updatedAt: new Date(),
 177:         },
 178:       });
 179:     }
 180: 
 181:     return { tenant, user };
 182:   });
 183: 
 184:   logger.info(
 185:     `[REGISTER] Nouvel avocat inscrit${requireEmailVerification ? ' (pending)' : ''}: ${result.user.email} - Cabinet: ${result.tenant.name}`
 186:   );
 187: 
 188:   return {
 189:     success: true,
 190:     user: { id: result.user.id, email: result.user.email, name: result.user.name! },
 191:     tenant: { id: result.tenant.id, name: result.tenant.name },
 192:   };
 193: }

   1: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';

   3: export interface SearchAnalytics {
   4:   query: string;
   5:   resultCount: number;
   6:   executionTime: number;

   8:   userId: string;
   9:   tenantId?: string;

  12: /**
  13:  * Logger une recherche pour analytics
  14:  */
  15: export async function logSearch(analytics: SearchAnalytics): Promise<void> {
  16:   try {
  17:     await prisma.searchLog.create({
  18:       data: {
  19:         query: analytics.query,
  20:         resultCount: analytics.resultCount,
  21:         executionTime: analytics.executionTime,
  22:         types: analytics.types ? JSON.stringify(analytics.types) : null,
  23:         userId: analytics.userId,
  24:         tenantId: analytics.tenantId || null,
  25:       },
  26:     });
  27:   } catch (error) {
  28:     console.error('Erreur logging recherche:', error);
  29:     // Ne pas bloquer la recherche si le logging echoue
  30:   }
  31: }
  32: 
  33: /**
  34:  * Obtenir les recherches les plus populaires
  35:  */
  36: export async function getPopularSearches(
  37:   tenantId?: string,
  38:   limit = 10
  39: ): Promise<Array<{ query: string; count: number }>> {
  40:   const where = tenantId ? { tenantId } : {};
  41: 
  42:   const searches = await prisma.searchLog.groupBy({
  43:     by: ['query'],
  44:     where,
  45:     _count: {
  46:       query: true,
  47:     },
  48:     orderBy: {
  49:       _count: {
  50:         query: 'desc',
  51:       },
  52:     },
  53:     take: limit,
  54:   });
  55: 
  56:   return searches.map((s) => ({
  57:     query: s.query,
  58:     count: s._count.query,
  59:   }));
  60: }
  61: 
  62: /**
  63:  * Obtenir les recherches recentes d'un utilisateur
  64:  */
  65: export async function getUserRecentSearches(
  66:   userId: string,
  67:   limit = 10
  68: ): Promise<string[]> {
  69:   const searches = await prisma.searchLog.findMany({
  70:     where: { userId },
  71:     orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  72:     take: limit,
  73:     distinct: ['query'],
  74:     select: { query: true },
  75:   });
  76: 
  77:   return searches.map((s) => s.query);
  78: }
  79: 
  80: /**
  81:  * Obtenir les statistiques de recherche
  82:  */
  83: export async function getSearchStats(tenantId?: string) {
  84:   const where = tenantId ? { tenantId } : {};
  85: 
  86:   const [totalSearches, avgExecutionTime, topSearches] = await Promise.all([
  87:     prisma.searchLog.count({ where }),
  88:     prisma.searchLog.aggregate({
  89:       where,
  90:       _avg: { executionTime: true },
  91:     }),
  92:     getPopularSearches(tenantId, 5),
  93:   ]);
  94: 
  95:   return {
  96:     totalSearches,
  97:     avgExecutionTime: avgExecutionTime._avg.executionTime || 0,
  98:     topSearches,
  99:   };
 100: }

 103:  * Obtenir les recherches sans resultats (pour ameliorer le systeme)
 104:  */
 105: export async function getEmptySearches(
 106:   tenantId?: string,
 107:   limit = 20
 108: ): Promise<Array<{ query: string; count: number }>> {
 109:   const where = tenantId ? { tenantId, resultCount: 0 } : { resultCount: 0 };
 110: 
 111:   const searches = await prisma.searchLog.groupBy({
 112:     by: ['query'],
 113:     where,
 114:     _count: {
 115:       query: true,
 116:     },
 117:     orderBy: {
 118:       _count: {
 119:         query: 'desc',
 120:       },
 121:     },
 122:     take: limit,
 123:   });
 124:

 126:     query: s.query,
 127:     count: s._count.query,
 128:   }));

 131: /**
 132:  * Obtenir les tendances de recherche (par jour/semaine)
 133:  */
 134: export async function getSearchTrends(
 135:   tenantId?: string,
 136:   days = 7
 137: ): Promise<Array<{ date: string; count: number }>> {
 138:   const startDate = new Date();
 139:   startDate.setDate(startDate.getDate() - days);
 140: 
 141:   const where = tenantId
 142:     ? { tenantId, createdAt: { gte: startDate } }
 143:     : { createdAt: { gte: startDate } };
 144: 
 145:   const searches = await prisma.searchLog.findMany({
 146:     where,
 147:     select: { createdAt: true },
 148:   });
 149: 
 150:   // Grouper par jour
 151:   const byDay = new Map<string, number>();
 152: 
 153:   searches.forEach((search) => {
 154:     const day = search.createdAt.toISOString().split('T')[0];
 155:     byDay.set(day, (byDay.get(day) || 0) + 1);
 156:   });
 157: 
 158:   return Array.from(byDay.entries())
 159:     .map(([date, count]) => ({ date, count }))
 160:     .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
 161: }

src\lib\services\searchService.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   2: 
   3: export type SearchResultType = 'client' | 'dossier' | 'document' | 'email' | 'user';
   4: 
   5: export interface SearchResult {
   6:   id: string;
   7:   type: SearchResultType;
   8:   title: string;
   9:   subtitle?: string;
  10:   description?: string;
  11:   score: number;
  12:   metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  13:   url?: string;
  14:   date?: Date;
  15:   tags?: string[];
  16: }
  17: 
  18: export interface SearchOptions {
  19:   tenantId?: string;
  20:   types?: SearchResultType[];
  21:   limit?: number;
  22:   includeArchived?: boolean;
  23:   dateFrom?: Date;
  24:   dateTo?: Date;
  25: }
  26: 
  27: /**
  28:  * Moteur de recherche intelligent multi-entites
  29:  */
  30: export class SearchService {
  31:   /**
  32:    * Recherche globale avec scoring intelligent
  33:    */
  34:   async search(query: string, options: SearchOptions = {}): Promise<SearchResult[]> {
  35:     const {
  36:       tenantId,
  37:       types = ['client', 'dossier', 'document', 'email'],
  38:       limit = 50,
  39:       includeArchived = false,
  40:     } = options;
  41: 
  42:     if (!query || query.trim().length < 2) {
  43:       return [];
  44:     }
  45: 
  46:     const searchTerm = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  47:     const results: SearchResult[] = [];
  48: 
  49:     // Recherche parallele dans toutes les entites
  50:     const [clients, dossiers, documents, emails] = await Promise.all([
  51:       types.includes('client') ? this.searchClients(searchTerm, tenantId, includeArchived) : [],
  52:       types.includes('dossier') ? this.searchDossiers(searchTerm, tenantId, includeArchived) : [],
  53:       types.includes('document') ? this.searchDocuments(searchTerm, tenantId) : [],
  54:       types.includes('email') ? this.searchEmails(searchTerm, tenantId) : [],
  55:     ]);
  56: 
  57:     // Combiner et scorer les resultats
  58:     results.push(...clients, ...dossiers, ...documents, ...emails);
  59: 
  60:     // Trier par score (pertinence) decroissant
  61:     results.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  62: 
  63:     return results.slice(0, limit);
  64:   }
  65: 
  66:   /**
  67:    * Recherche clients
  68:    */
  69:   private async searchClients(
  70:     searchTerm: string,
  71:     tenantId?: string,
  72:     includeArchived = false
  73:   ): Promise<SearchResult[]> {
  74:     const where: any = {
  75:       OR: [
  76:         { firstName: { contains: searchTerm } },
  77:         { lastName: { contains: searchTerm } },
  78:         { email: { contains: searchTerm } },
  79:         { phone: { contains: searchTerm } },
  80:         { nationality: { contains: searchTerm } },
  81:       ],
  82:     };
  83: 
  84:     if (tenantId) {
  85:       where.tenantId = tenantId;
  86:     }
  87: 
  88:     if (!includeArchived) {
  89:       where.status = { not: 'archived' };
  90:     }
  91: 
  92:     const clients = await prisma.client.findMany({
  93:       where,
  94:       take: 20,
  95:       select: {
  96:         id: true,
  97:         firstName: true,
  98:         lastName: true,
  99:         email: true,
 100:         phone: true,
 101:         nationality: true,
 102:         status: true,
 103:         createdAt: true,
 104:       },
 105:     });
 106: 
 107:     return clients.map(client => {
 108:       const fullName = `${client.firstName} ${client.lastName}`;
 109:       const score = this.calculateScore(searchTerm, [
 110:         fullName,
 111:         client.email,
 112:         client.phone || '',
 113:         client.nationality || '',
 114:       ]);
 115: 
 116:       return {
 117:         id: client.id,
 118:         type: 'client' as SearchResultType,
 119:         title: fullName,
 120:         subtitle: client.email,
 121:         description: `${client.nationality || 'Nationalite inconnue'} - ${client.phone || 'Pas de telephone'}`,
 122:         score,
 123:         metadata: {
 124:           status: client.status,
 125:           nationality: client.nationality,
 126:         },
 127:         url: `/clients/${client.id}`,
 128:         date: client.createdAt,
 129:         tags: [client.status, 'client'],
 130:       };
 131:     });
 132:   }
 133: 
 134:   /**
 135:    * Recherche dossiers
 136:    */
 137:   private async searchDossiers(
 138:     searchTerm: string,
 139:     tenantId?: string,
 140:     includeArchived = false
 141:   ): Promise<SearchResult[]> {
 142:     const where: any = {
 143:       OR: [
 144:         { numero: { contains: searchTerm } },
 145:         { objet: { contains: searchTerm } },
 146:         { typeDossier: { contains: searchTerm } },
 147:         { description: { contains: searchTerm } },
 148:         { articleCeseda: { contains: searchTerm } },
 149:       ],
 150:     };
 151:

 153:       where.tenantId = tenantId;
 154:     }
 155:

 159:

 161:       where,
 162:       take: 20,

 164:         id: true,

 168:         statut: true,
 169:         priorite: true,

 174:             firstName: true,
 175:             lastName: true,
 176:           },
 177:         },
 178:       },

 180:

 200:         metadata: {
 201:           statut: dossier.statut,
 202:           priorite: dossier.priorite,
 203:           typeDossier: dossier.typeDossier,
 204:         },
 205:         url: `/dossiers/${dossier.id}`,
 206:         date: dossier.dateCreation,
 207:         tags: [dossier.statut, dossier.typeDossier, dossier.priorite],
 208:       };
 209:     });
 210:   }

 242:         dossier: {

src\lib\services\semanticSearchService.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Service de Recherche Semantique
   3:  * Utilise Ollama embeddings pour trouver des dossiers similaires
   4:  * 
   5:  * Innovation: Recherche intelligente basee sur le sens, pas juste les mots-cles
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   9: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
  10: 
  11: interface SemanticSearchResult {
  12:   id: string;
  13:   numero: string;
  14:   type: string;
  15:   description: string;
  16:   similarity: number;
  17:   client: {
  18:     id: string;
  19:     nom: string;
  20:     prenom: string;
  21:   };
  22:   createdAt: Date;
  23:   statut: string;
  24: }
  25: 
  26: export class SemanticSearchService {
  27:   private ollamaUrl: string;
  28:   private embeddingModel: string;
  29: 
  30:   constructor() {
  31:     this.ollamaUrl = process.env.OLLAMA_URL || 'http://localhost:11434';
  32:     this.embeddingModel = 'nomic-embed-text:latest';
  33:   }
  34: 
  35:   /**
  36:    * Genere un embedding pour un texte
  37:    */
  38:   private async generateEmbedding(text: string): Promise<number[]> {
  39:     try {
  40:       const response = await fetch(`${this.ollamaUrl}/api/embeddings`, {
  41:         method: 'POST',
  42:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  43:         body: JSON.stringify({
  44:           model: this.embeddingModel,
  45:           prompt: text
  46:         })
  47:       });
  48: 
  49:       if (!response.ok) {
  50:         throw new Error(`Ollama embeddings error: ${response.status}`);
  51:       }
  52: 
  53:       const data = await response.json();
  54:       return data.embedding;
  55:     } catch (error) {
  56:       logger.error('Erreur generation embedding Ollama', error, {
  57:         textLength: text.length,
  58:         ollamaUrl: this.ollamaUrl,
  59:         model: this.embeddingModel
  60:       });
  61:       // Fallback: retourner un vecteur simple base sur le hash du texte
  62:       return this.simpleFallbackEmbedding(text);
  63:     }
  64:   }
  65: 
  66:   /**
  67:    * Fallback simple si Ollama n'est pas disponible
  68:    */
  69:   private simpleFallbackEmbedding(text: string): number[] {
  70:     const normalized = text.toLowerCase();
  71:     const vector = new Array(128).fill(0);
  72:     
  73:     for (let i = 0; i < normalized.length; i++) {
  74:       const charCode = normalized.charCodeAt(i);
  75:       vector[charCode % 128] += 1;
  76:     }
  77:     
  78:     // Normaliser
  79:     const magnitude = Math.sqrt(vector.reduce((sum, val) => sum + val * val, 0));
  80:     return vector.map(val => val / (magnitude || 1));
  81:   }
  82: 
  83:   /**
  84:    * Calcule la similarite cosinus entre deux vecteurs
  85:    */
  86:   private cosineSimilarity(vecA: number[], vecB: number[]): number {
  87:     if (vecA.length !== vecB.length) return 0;
  88:     
  89:     let dotProduct = 0;
  90:     let magnitudeA = 0;
  91:     let magnitudeB = 0;
  92:     
  93:     for (let i = 0; i < vecA.length; i++) {
  94:       dotProduct += vecA[i] * vecB[i];
  95:       magnitudeA += vecA[i] * vecA[i];
  96:       magnitudeB += vecB[i] * vecB[i];
  97:     }
  98:     
  99:     const magnitude = Math.sqrt(magnitudeA) * Math.sqrt(magnitudeB);
 100:     return magnitude === 0 ? 0 : dotProduct / magnitude;
 101:   }
 102: 
 103:   /**
 104:    * Recherche semantique de dossiers similaires
 105:    */
 106:   async searchSimilarCases(
 107:     tenantId: string,
 108:     query: string,
 109:     limit: number = 5,
 110:     minSimilarity: number = 0.5
 111:   ): Promise<SemanticSearchResult[]> {
 112:     // Generer l'embedding de la requete
 113:     const queryEmbedding = await this.generateEmbedding(query);
 114: 
 115:     // Recuperer tous les dossiers (dans une vraie app, on stockerait les embeddings)
 116:     const dossiers = await prisma.dossier.findMany({
 117:       where: { tenantId },
 118:       include: {
 119:         client: true
 120:       },
 121:       take: 100 // Limiter pour la demo
 122:     });
 123: 
 124:     // Calculer la similarite pour chaque dossier
 125:     const results: (SemanticSearchResult & { embedding: number[] })[] = [];
 126: 
 127:     for (const dossier of dossiers) {
 128:       // Creer une representation textuelle du dossier
 129:       const dossierText = [
 130:         dossier.typeDossier,
 131:         dossier.description || '',
 132:         dossier.notes || '',
 133:         dossier.client.firstName,
 134:         dossier.client.lastName
 135:       ].join(' ');
 136: 
 137:       const dossierEmbedding = await this.generateEmbedding(dossierText);
 138:       const similarity = this.cosineSimilarity(queryEmbedding, dossierEmbedding);
 139: 
 140:       if (similarity >= minSimilarity) {
 141:         results.push({
 142:           id: dossier.id,
 143:           numero: dossier.numero,
 144:           type: dossier.typeDossier,
 145:           description: dossier.description || '',
 146:           similarity,
 147:           client: {
 148:             id: dossier.client.id,
 149:             nom: dossier.client.lastName,
 150:             prenom: dossier.client.firstName
 151:           },
 152:           createdAt: dossier.createdAt,
 153:           statut: dossier.statut,
 154:           embedding: dossierEmbedding
 155:         });
 156:       }
 157:     }
 158: 
 159:     // Trier par similarite decroissante
 160:     results.sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity);
 161: 
 162:     // Retourner les top resultats sans l'embedding
 163:     return results.slice(0, limit).map(({ embedding, ...rest }) => rest);
 164:   }
 165: 
 166:   /**
 167:    * Trouve des dossiers similaires e un dossier existant
 168:    */
 169:   async findSimilarCases(
 170:     dossierId: string,
 171:     limit: number = 5
 172:   ): Promise<SemanticSearchResult[]> {
 173:     const dossier = await prisma.dossier.findUnique({
 174:       where: { id: dossierId },
 175:       include: { Client: true }
 176:     });
 177: 
 178:     if (!dossier) {
 179:       throw new Error('Dossier non trouve');
 180:     }
 181: 
 182:     const query = [
 183:       dossier.typeDossier,
 184:       dossier.description || '',
 185:       dossier.notes || ''
 186:     ].join(' ');
 187: 
 188:     const results = await this.searchSimilarCases(
 189:       dossier.tenantId,
 190:       query,
 191:       limit + 1, // +1 car le dossier lui-meme sera dans les resultats
 192:       0.3 // Seuil plus bas pour trouver des cas similaires
 193:     );
 194: 
 195:     // Filtrer le dossier source
 196:     return results.filter(r => r.id !== dossierId);
 197:   }

 216:         case 'TITRE_SEJOUR':

 218:         case 'REGROUPEMENT_FAMILIAL':
 219:           return 'Demandes de regroupement familial';
 220:         case 'NATURALISATION':
 221:           return 'Procedures de naturalisation';
 222:         default:
 223:           return `Dossiers de type ${dt.typeDossier}`;
 224:       }
 225:     });
 226:   }

   1: // @ts-nocheck
   2: /**
   3:  * SmartInboxService - Service de scoring intelligent des emails (Phase 4)
   4:  *
   5:  * Calcule un score de prioritÃ© 0-100 pour chaque email basÃ© sur:
   6:  * - Urgence (30%)
   7:  * - Client VIP (25%)
   8:  * - Deadline proche (20%)
   9:  * - Sentiment (15%)
  10:  * - Attachments (10%)
  11:  *
  12:  * @example
  13:  * ```ts
  14:  * const service = new SmartInboxService();
  15:  * const score = await service.calculateScore(email, tenant);
  16:  * console.log(score.score); // 85
  17:  * console.log(score.factors); // { urgency: 30, vipClient: 25, ... }
  18:  * ```
  19:  */
  20: 
  21: import { PrismaClient, Email, Client } from '@prisma/client';
  22: import { eventLogService } from './event-log.service';
  23: 
  24: export type ScoringFactors = {
  25:   urgency: number; // 0-30
  26:   vipClient: number; // 0-25
  27:   hasDeadline: number; // 0-20
  28:   sentiment: number; // 0-15
  29:   hasAttachments: number; // 0-10
  30:   total: number; // 0-100
  31: };
  32: 
  33: export type InboxScoreResult = {
  34:   score: number;
  35:   factors: ScoringFactors;
  36:   model: string;
  37:   confidence: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  38: };
  39: 
  40: export class SmartInboxService {
  41:   constructor(private prisma: PrismaClient = new PrismaClient()) {}
  42: 
  43:   /**
  44:    * Calcule le score de prioritÃ© pour un email
  45:    */
  46:   async calculateScore(email: Email, tenantId: string): Promise<InboxScoreResult> {
  47:     const factors: ScoringFactors = {
  48:       urgency: 0,
  49:       vipClient: 0,
  50:       hasDeadline: 0,
  51:       sentiment: 0,
  52:       hasAttachments: 0,
  53:       total: 0,
  54:     };
  55: 
  56:     // 1. Urgence (30 points max)
  57:     factors.urgency = this.scoreUrgency(email.urgency);
  58: 
  59:     // 2. Client VIP (25 points max)
  60:     if (email.clientId) {
  61:       const client = await this.prisma.client.findUnique({
  62:         where: { id: email.clientId },
  63:       });
  64:       factors.vipClient = await this.scoreVIPClient(client);
  65:     }
  66: 
  67:     // 3. Deadline proche (20 points max)
  68:     factors.hasDeadline = await this.scoreDeadline(email);
  69: 
  70:     // 4. Sentiment (15 points max)
  71:     factors.sentiment = this.scoreSentiment(email.sentiment);
  72: 
  73:     // 5. Attachments (10 points max)
  74:     const attachments = await this.prisma.emailAttachment.count({
  75:       where: { emailId: email.id },
  76:     });
  77:     factors.hasAttachments = this.scoreAttachments(attachments);
  78: 
  79:     // Total
  80:     factors.total = Math.min(
  81:       100,
  82:       factors.urgency +
  83:         factors.vipClient +
  84:         factors.hasDeadline +
  85:         factors.sentiment +
  86:         factors.hasAttachments
  87:     );
  88: 
  89:     // Confidence basÃ©e sur nombre de facteurs non-nuls
  90:     const nonZeroFactors = Object.values(factors).filter(v => v > 0).length - 1; // -1 pour exclure total
  91:     const confidence: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' =
  92:       nonZeroFactors >= 4 ? 'high' : nonZeroFactors >= 2 ? 'medium' : 'low';
  93: 
  94:     return {
  95:       score: factors.total,
  96:       factors,
  97:       model: 'smart-inbox-v1',
  98:       confidence,
  99:     };
 100:   }
 101: 
 102:   /**
 103:    * Score urgence: critical=30, high=20, medium=10, low=5
 104:    */
 105:   private scoreUrgency(urgency: string): number {
 106:     switch (urgency.toLowerCase()) {
 107:       case 'critical':
 108:         return 30;
 109:       case 'high':
 110:         return 20;
 111:       case 'medium':
 112:         return 10;
 113:       case 'low':
 114:         return 5;
 115:       default:
 116:         return 0;
 117:     }
 118:   }
 119: 
 120:   /**
 121:    * Score client VIP: 25 points si VIP, 0 sinon
 122:    * CritÃ¨res VIP: >5 dossiers actifs OU factures >10kÃ¢â€šÂ¬
 123:    */
 124:   private async scoreVIPClient(client: Client | null): Promise<number> {
 125:     if (!client) return 0;
 126: 
 127:     const dossiers = await this.prisma.dossier.count({
 128:       where: {
 129:         clientId: client.id,
 130:         statut: 'en_cours',
 131:       },
 132:     });
 133: 
 134:     if (dossiers >= 5) return 25;
 135: 
 136:     // TODO: VÃ©rifier montant factures si >10kÃ¢â€šÂ¬
 137:     // const factures = await prisma.facture.aggregate({ ... })
 138: 
 139:     return 0;
 140:   }
 141: 
 142:   /**
 143:    * Score deadline proche: 20 points si deadline <7j, 10 si <30j
 144:    */
 145:   private async scoreDeadline(email: Email): Promise<number> {
 146:     if (!email.dossierId) return 0;
 147: 
 148:     const now = new Date();
 149:     const in7days = new Date(now.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 150:     const in30days = new Date(now.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
 151: 
 152:     const urgentDeadline = await this.prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({
 153:       where: {
 154:         dossierId: email.dossierId,
 155:         dueDate: {
 156:           gte: now,
 157:           lte: in7days,
 158:         },
 159:         status: { in: ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING', 'URGENT'] },
 160:       },
 161:     });
 162: 
 163:     if (urgentDeadline) return 20;
 164: 
 165:     const approachingDeadline = await this.prisma.legalDeadline.findFirst({
 166:       where: {
 167:         dossierId: email.dossierId,
 168:         dueDate: {
 169:           gte: now,
 170:           lte: in30days,
 171:         },
 172:         status: { in: ['PENDING', 'APPROACHING'] },
 173:       },
 174:     });
 175: 
 176:     if (approachingDeadline) return 10;
 177: 
 178:     return 0;
 179:   }
 180: 
 181:   /**
 182:    * Score sentiment: negative=15 (besoin aide), neutral=8, positive=5
 183:    */
 184:   private scoreSentiment(sentiment: string): number {
 185:     switch (sentiment.toLowerCase()) {
 186:       case 'negative':
 187:         return 15; // Client mÃ©content = prioritaire
 188:       case 'neutral':
 189:         return 8;
 190:       case 'positive':
 191:         return 5;
 192:       default:
 193:         return 0;
 194:     }
 195:   }
 196: 
 197:   /**
 198:    * Score attachments: 10 points si >=1 piÃ¨ce jointe
 199:    */
 200:   private scoreAttachments(count: number): number {
 201:     return count > 0 ? 10 : 0;
 202:   }

 205:    * Sauvegarde le score en DB et trace avec EventLog
 206:    */

 208:     // CrÃ©er/mettre Ã  jour InboxScore
 209:     await this.prisma.inboxScore.upsert({
 210:       where: { emailId },
 211:       create: {
 212:         emailId,
 213:         score: scoreResult.score,
 214:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 215:         model: scoreResult.model,
 216:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 217:       },
 218:       update: {
 219:         score: scoreResult.score,
 220:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 221:         model: scoreResult.model,
 222:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 223:         calculatedAt: new Date(),
 224:       },
 225:     });
 226: 
 227:     // Tracer avec EventLog
 228:     await eventLogService.createEventLog({
 229:       eventType: 'FLOW_SCORED',
 230:       entityType: 'email',
 231:       entityId: emailId,
 232:       actorType: 'AI',
 233:       tenantId,
 234:       metadata: {
 235:         score: scoreResult.score,
 236:         factors: scoreResult.factors,
 237:         model: scoreResult.model,
 238:         confidence: scoreResult.confidence,
 239:       },
 240:     });
 241:   }

  42: export async function uploadFile(
  43:   file: File,
  44:   options: UploadOptions
  45: ): Promise<StoredFile> {
  46:   const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
  47: 
  48:   if (file.size === 0) {
  49:     throw new Error('Le fichier est vide');
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   if (file.size > maxSize) {
  53:     throw new Error('Le fichier est trop volumineux (max 10 MB)');
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   if (!options.dossierId) {
  57:     throw new Error('Dossier requis pour envoyer le fichier');
  58:   }
  59: 
  60:   const allowedTypes = [
  61:     'application/pdf',
  62:     'image/jpeg',
  63:     'image/png',
  64:     'image/webp',
  65:     'image/gif',
  66:     'application/msword',
  67:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  68:     'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  69:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
  70:     'text/plain',
  71:   ];
  72: 
  73:   if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
  74:     throw new Error('Type de fichier non autorise');
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   const formData = new FormData();
  78: 
  79:   formData.append('file', file);
  80:   formData.append('dossierId', options.dossierId);
  81:   formData.append('type', options.category || 'piece_jointe');
  82:   formData.append('description', options.description || '');
  83: 
  84:   const response = await fetch('/api/documents/upload', {
  85:     method: 'POST',
  86:     body: formData,
  87:     credentials: 'include',
  88:   });
  89: 
  90:   const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  91: 
  92:   if (!response.ok) {
  93:     throw new Error(
  94:       data.error || `Erreur lors de l'upload (${response.status})`
  95:     );
  96:   }
  97: 
  98:   if (!data.document?.id) {
  99:     throw new Error('Reponse serveur invalide');
 100:   }
 101: 
 102:   const document = data.document;
 103: 
 104:   const storedFile: StoredFile = {
 105:     id: document.id,
 106:     name: document.fileName || document.filename || file.name,
 107:     originalName: document.originalName || file.name,
 108:     size: document.fileSize ?? document.size ?? file.size,
 109:     mimeType: document.fileType || document.mimeType || file.type,
 110:     url: `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(document.id)}`,
 111:     uploadedAt: new Date(),
 112:     uploadedBy: 'current_user',
 113:     version: 1,
 114:     parentId: options.parentId,
 115:     tags: options.tags || [],
 116:     metadata: {
 117:       dossierId: options.dossierId,
 118:       clientId: options.clientId,
 119:       category: options.category || 'piece_jointe',
 120:       description: options.description,
 121:     },
 122:   };
 123: 
 124:   logger.info('Fichier uploade avec succes', {
 125:     fileId: storedFile.id,
 126:     filename: storedFile.name,
 127:     size: storedFile.size,
 128:   });
 129: 
 130:   return storedFile;
 131: }

 136:   link.href = `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(file.id)}`;
 137:   link.download = file.originalName;
 138:   link.rel = 'noopener';

 140:   document.body.appendChild(link);
 141:   link.click();
 142:   link.remove();
 143: }

 145: export function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
 146:   if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
 147: 
 148:   const k = 1024;
 149:   const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
 150:   const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
 151: 
 152:   return `${Math.round((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)) * 100) / 100} ${sizes[i]}`;
 153: }

 155: export function getFileIcon(mimeType: string): string {
 156:   if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return 'Image';
 157:   if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') return 'PDF';

 159: 
 160:   if (
 161:     mimeType.includes('excel') ||
 162:     mimeType.includes('spreadsheet')
 163:   ) {
 164:     return 'Excel';
 165:   }
 166: 
 167:   if (mimeType.includes('text')) return 'Texte';
 168: 
 169:   return 'Fichier';

   1: /**

  13:   title: string;
  14:   description: string;
  15:   actionType: AIActionType;
  16:   priority: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL';

  19:     type: string;

   1: /**
   2:  * Service d'horodatage certifiÃ© RFC 3161 (Timestamp Authority)
   3:  * 
   4:  * Fournit une preuve tierce de la date d'un Ã©vÃ©nement.
   5:  * Utilise FreeTSA.org (gratuit) ou Universign (payant, qualifiÃ© eIDAS).
   6:  * 
   7:  * Fonctionnement :
   8:  * 1. On hash le contenu Ã  horodater (SHA-256)
   9:  * 2. On envoie le hash Ã  un serveur TSA (RFC 3161)
  10:  * 3. Le serveur signe le hash + date avec son certificat
  11:  * 4. On stocke le token TSA comme preuve
  12:  * 
  13:  * Valeur lÃ©gale :

  57: export class TimestampService {
  58:   /**
  59:    * Horodater un contenu (texte, JSON, ou hash dÃ©jÃ  calculÃ©).
  60:    * Retourne un token prouvant que ce contenu existait Ã  cette date.
  61:    */
  62:   async timestamp(content: string | Buffer): Promise<TimestampResult> {
  63:     const hash = this.computeHash(content);
  64:     
  65:     // Essayer FreeTSA d'abord
  66:     if (TSA_CONFIG.freetsa.enabled) {
  67:       try {
  68:         const result = await this.requestFreeTSA(hash);
  69:         if (result.success) return result;
  70:       } catch (err: any) {
  71:         console.warn('[TSA] FreeTSA failed, falling back to local:', err.message);
  72:       }
  73:     }
  74: 
  75:     // Fallback : horodatage local signÃ© (moins de valeur mais tracÃ©)
  76:     return this.localTimestamp(hash);
  77:   }
  78: 
  79:   /**
  80:    * Horodater un Ã©vÃ©nement critique (audit log, preuve, signature).
  81:    * Shortcut pour les cas d'usage frÃ©quents.
  82:    */
  83:   async timestampEvent(eventData: {
  84:     action: string;
  85:     entityId: string;
  86:     entityType: string;
  87:     userId: string;
  88:     data?: Record<string, any>;
  89:   }): Promise<TimestampResult> {
  90:     const payload = JSON.stringify({
  91:       ...eventData,
  92:       serverTime: new Date().toISOString(),
  93:       nonce: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
  94:     });
  95:     return this.timestamp(payload);
  96:   }
  97: 
  98:   /**
  99:    * Horodater un document (par son hash SHA-256).
 100:    */
 101:   async timestampDocument(documentHash: string): Promise<TimestampResult> {
 102:     // Le hash est dÃ©jÃ  calculÃ©, on l'envoie directement au TSA
 103:     if (TSA_CONFIG.freetsa.enabled) {
 104:       try {
 105:         return await this.requestFreeTSA(documentHash);
 106:       } catch {
 107:         return this.localTimestamp(documentHash);
 108:       }
 109:     }
 110:     return this.localTimestamp(documentHash);
 111:   }
 112: 
 113:   // â”€â”€â”€ FreeTSA (RFC 3161) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 114: 
 115:   private async requestFreeTSA(hash: string): Promise<TimestampResult> {
 116:     // Construire la requÃªte TSA (RFC 3161 TimeStampReq)
 117:     // Format simplifiÃ© : on envoie le hash en POST
 118:     const tsaUrl = TSA_CONFIG.freetsa.url;
 119:     
 120:     // CrÃ©er le corps de la requÃªte RFC 3161 (ASN.1 DER)
 121:     const tsRequest = this.buildTSRequest(hash);
 122: 
 123:     const response = await fetch(tsaUrl, {
 124:       method: 'POST',
 125:       headers: {
 126:         'Content-Type': 'application/timestamp-query',
 127:       },
 128:       body: new Uint8Array(tsRequest),
 129:       signal: AbortSignal.timeout(10000), // 10s timeout
 130:     });
 131: 
 132:     if (!response.ok) {
 133:       throw new Error(`TSA responded with ${response.status}`);
 134:     }
 135: 
 136:     const responseBuffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
 137:     const tokenBase64 = Buffer.from(responseBuffer).toString('base64');
 138:     const tokenHex = Buffer.from(responseBuffer).toString('hex').slice(0, 64);
 139: 
 140:     return {
 141:       success: true,
 142:       provider: 'freetsa',
 143:       hash,
 144:       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 145:       token: tokenBase64,
 146:       tokenHex,
 147:     };
 148:   }
 149: 
 150:   /**
 151:    * Construit une requÃªte TimeStampReq RFC 3161 minimale.
 152:    * Structure ASN.1 DER :
 153:    *   SEQUENCE {
 154:    *     INTEGER 1 (version)
 155:    *     SEQUENCE {
 156:    *       SEQUENCE {
 157:    *         OID 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1 (SHA-256)
 158:    *         NULL
 159:    *       }
 160:    *       OCTET STRING (hash 32 bytes)
 161:    *     }
 162:    *     BOOLEAN TRUE (certReq)
 163:    *   }
 164:    */
 165:   private buildTSRequest(hexHash: string): Buffer {
 166:     const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hexHash, 'hex');
 167:     
 168:     // Si le hash n'est pas exactement 32 bytes (SHA-256), recalculer
 169:     const hash32 = hashBytes.length === 32 
 170:       ? hashBytes 
 171:       : createHash('sha256').update(hexHash).digest();
 172: 
 173:     // OID SHA-256: 2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1
 174:     const sha256OID = Buffer.from([
 175:       0x30, 0x0d, // SEQUENCE (AlgorithmIdentifier)
 176:       0x06, 0x09, // OID
 177:       0x60, 0x86, 0x48, 0x01, 0x65, 0x03, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01, // SHA-256 OID
 178:       0x05, 0x00, // NULL
 179:     ]);
 180: 
 181:     // MessageImprint: SEQUENCE { AlgorithmIdentifier, OCTET STRING hash }
 182:     const messageImprint = Buffer.concat([
 183:       Buffer.from([0x30, sha256OID.length + 2 + hash32.length]), // SEQUENCE
 184:       sha256OID,
 185:       Buffer.from([0x04, hash32.length]), // OCTET STRING
 186:       hash32,
 187:     ]);
 188: 
 189:     // Version: INTEGER 1
 190:     const version = Buffer.from([0x02, 0x01, 0x01]);
 191: 
 192:     // CertReq: BOOLEAN TRUE
 193:     const certReq = Buffer.from([0x01, 0x01, 0xff]);
 194: 
 195:     // TimeStampReq: SEQUENCE { version, messageImprint, certReq }
 196:     const innerLength = version.length + messageImprint.length + certReq.length;
 197:     const tsReq = Buffer.concat([
 198:       Buffer.from([0x30, innerLength]),
 199:       version,
 200:       messageImprint,
 201:       certReq,
 202:     ]);
 203: 
 204:     return tsReq;
 205:   }
 206: 
 207:   // â”€â”€â”€ Fallback local â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

 209:   private localTimestamp(hash: string): TimestampResult {
 210:     const now = new Date().toISOString();
 211:     // CrÃ©er un "token" local signÃ© = hash(contenu + date + secret)
 212:     const localSecret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || 'memolib-tsa-local';
 213:     const localToken = createHash('sha256')
 214:       .update(`${hash}|${now}|${localSecret}`)
 215:       .digest('hex');
 216: 
 217:     return {
 218:       success: true,
 219:       provider: 'local',
 220:       hash,
 221:       timestamp: now,
 222:       token: localToken,
 223:       tokenHex: localToken.slice(0, 64),
 224:     };
 225:   }
 226: 
 227:   // â”€â”€â”€ Utilitaires â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 228: 
 229:   private computeHash(content: string | Buffer): string {
 230:     return createHash('sha256').update(content).digest('hex');
 231:   }
 232: 
 233:   /**
 234:    * VÃ©rifier si un token TSA est valide (basique).
 235:    * Pour une vÃ©rification complÃ¨te, il faudrait parser l'ASN.1.
 236:    */
 237:   verifyLocal(hash: string, timestamp: string, token: string): boolean {
 238:     const localSecret = process.env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET || 'memolib-tsa-local';
 239:     const expected = createHash('sha256')
 240:       .update(`${hash}|${timestamp}|${localSecret}`)
 241:       .digest('hex');
 242:     return expected === token;
 243:   }
 244: }

  30:

  34:   value: any
  35: }

  58:

   4:   const protect = process.env.PREVIEW_PROTECT === 'true';
   5:   if (!protect) {
   6:     return NextResponse.next();
   7:   }
   8: 
   9:   // Allow assets and Next internals

  15:     pathname.startsWith('/robots.txt') ||
  16:     pathname.startsWith('/sitemap.xml')
  17:   ) {
  18:     return NextResponse.next();
  19:   }
  20: 
  21:   // Token via header or cookie
  22:   const headerToken = req.headers.get('x-preview-token') || '';
  23:   const cookieToken = req.cookies.get('preview_token')?.value || '';
  24:   const expected = process.env.PREVIEW_TOKEN || '';
  25: 
  26:   if (expected && (headerToken === expected || cookieToken === expected)) {
  27:     return NextResponse.next();
  28:   }
  29: 
  30:   return new NextResponse('Preview Protected: set x-preview-token header or cookie', {
  31:     status: 401,
  32:     headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },

src\middleware\auth.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware d'authentification
   3:  * GÃ¨re la vÃ©rification des sessions et des tokens
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: 
  10: export interface AuthenticatedRequest extends NextRequest {
  11:   user?: {
  12:     id: string;
  13:     email: string;
  14:     role: string;
  15:     tenantId?: string;
  16:   };
  17: }
  18: 
  19: export interface AuthResult {
  20:   authenticated: boolean;
  21:   user?: {
  22:     id: string;
  23:     email: string;
  24:     role: string;
  25:     tenantId?: string;
  26:   };
  27:   error?: string;
  28: }
  29: 
  30: /**
  31:  * VÃ©rifie si la requÃªte est authentifiÃ©e
  32:  */
  33: export async function verifyAuth(req: NextRequest): Promise<AuthResult> {
  34:   try {
  35:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  36: 
  37:     if (!session?.user) {
  38:       return {
  39:         authenticated: false,
  40:         error: 'Non authentifiÃ©',
  41:       };
  42:     }
  43: 
  44:     return {
  45:       authenticated: true,
  46:       user: {
  47:         id: session.user.id || '',
  48:         email: session.user.email || '',
  49:         role: (session.user as { role?: string }).role || 'user',
  50:         tenantId: (session.user as { tenantId?: string }).tenantId,
  51:       },
  52:     };
  53:   } catch (error) {
  54:     console.error('Erreur de vÃ©rification auth:', error);
  55:     return {
  56:       authenticated: false,
  57:       error: 'Erreur de session',
  58:     };
  59:   }
  60: }
  61: 
  62: /**
  63:  * Middleware pour protÃ©ger les routes API
  64:  */
  65: export async function authMiddleware(
  66:   req: NextRequest,
  67:   handler: (req: AuthenticatedRequest) => Promise<NextResponse>
  68: ): Promise<NextResponse> {
  69:   const authResult = await verifyAuth(req);
  70: 
  71:   if (!authResult.authenticated) {
  72:     return NextResponse.json({ error: authResult.error || 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
  73:   }
  74: 
  75:   const authenticatedReq = req as AuthenticatedRequest;
  76:   authenticatedReq.user = authResult.user;
  77: 
  78:   return handler(authenticatedReq);
  79: }
  80: 
  81: /**
  82:  * VÃ©rifie si l'utilisateur a un rÃ´le spÃ©cifique
  83:  */
  84: export function hasRole(user: AuthResult['user'], roles: string[]): boolean {
  85:   if (!user?.role) return false;
  86:   return roles.includes(user.role);
  87: }
  88: 
  89: /**
  90:  * Middleware pour vÃ©rifier les rÃ´les
  91:  */
  92: export async function roleMiddleware(
  93:   req: NextRequest,
  94:   allowedRoles: string[],
  95:   handler: (req: AuthenticatedRequest) => Promise<NextResponse>
  96: ): Promise<NextResponse> {
  97:   const authResult = await verifyAuth(req);
  98: 
  99:   if (!authResult.authenticated) {
 100:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifiÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
 101:   }
 102: 
 103:   if (!hasRole(authResult.user, allowedRoles)) {
 104:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ© - RÃ´le insuffisant' }, { status: 403 });
 105:   }
 106: 
 107:   const authenticatedReq = req as AuthenticatedRequest;
 108:   authenticatedReq.user = authResult.user;
 109: 
 110:   return handler(authenticatedReq);
 111: }

src\middleware\quota-check.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware de verification des quotas
   3:  * Bloque les creations si quotas depasses
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   7: import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
   8: import { getAuthToken } from '@/lib/auth/nextauth-token';
   9: import { checkQuota, ResourceType } from '@/lib/billing/quota-service';
  10: 
  11: /**
  12:  * Routes protegees par quota
  13:  */
  14: const QUOTA_ROUTES: Record<string, ResourceType> = {
  15:   '/api/workspaces': 'workspaces',
  16:   '/api/dossiers': 'dossiers',
  17:   '/api/clients': 'clients',
  18:   '/api/users': 'users',
  19: };
  20: 
  21: const QUOTA_ROUTE_ENTRIES = Object.entries(QUOTA_ROUTES) as [string, ResourceType][];
  22: 
  23: /**
  24:  * Middleware de verification quota
  25:  */
  26: export async function quotaCheckMiddleware(request: NextRequest) {
  27:   const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
  28: 
  29:   // Verifier si c'est une requete POST (creation)
  30:   if (request.method !== 'POST') {
  31:     return NextResponse.next();
  32:   }
  33: 
  34:   // Verifier si la route necessite un controle quota
  35:   const quotaRoute = QUOTA_ROUTE_ENTRIES.find(([route]) => pathname.startsWith(route));
  36: 
  37:   if (!quotaRoute) {
  38:     return NextResponse.next();
  39:   }
  40: 
  41:   const [, resourceType] = quotaRoute;
  42: 
  43:   // Recuperer le token
  44:   const token = await getAuthToken(request);
  45: 
  46:   if (!token || !token.tenantId) {
  47:     return NextResponse.json(
  48:       { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  49:       { status: 401 }
  50:     );
  51:   }
  52: 
  53:   try {
  54:     // Verifier le quota
  55:     const quota = await checkQuota(
  56:       token.tenantId as string,
  57:       resourceType
  58:     );
  59: 
  60:     if (!quota.allowed) {
  61:       return NextResponse.json(
  62:         {
  63:           error: 'Quota depasse',
  64:           message: `Vous avez atteint la limite de votre plan (${quota.current}/${quota.limit} ${resourceType}).`,
  65:           quotaInfo: {
  66:             current: quota.current,
  67:             limit: quota.limit,
  68:             percentage: quota.percentage,
  69:           },
  70:           upgradeRequired: true,
  71:         },
  72:         {
  73:           status: 402, // Payment Required
  74:           headers: {
  75:             'X-Quota-Exceeded': 'true',
  76:             'X-Quota-Type': resourceType,
  77:             'X-Quota-Limit': quota.limit.toString(),
  78:             'X-Quota-Current': quota.current.toString(),
  79:           }
  80:         }
  81:       );
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     // Alerte si proche de la limite
  85:     if (quota.warningLevel === 'warning' || quota.warningLevel === 'critical') {
  86:       const response = NextResponse.next();
  87:       response.headers.set('X-Quota-Warning', quota.warningLevel);
  88:       response.headers.set('X-Quota-Percentage', quota.percentage.toFixed(2));
  89:       return response;
  90:     }
  91: 
  92:     return NextResponse.next();
  93:   } catch (error) {
  94:     console.error('Erreur verification quota:', error);
  95:     return NextResponse.next(); // En cas d'erreur, on laisse passer (fail-open)
  96:   }
  97: }
  98: 
  99: /**
 100:  * Configuration du matcher
 101:  */
 102: export const config = {
 103:   matcher: [
 104:     '/api/workspaces/:path*',
 105:     '/api/dossiers/:path*',
 106:     '/api/clients/:path*',
 107:     '/api/users/:path*',
 108:   ],
 109: };

src\middleware\security.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Security Middleware - OWASP ZAP Compliant
   3:  * memoLib - Securite niveau Enterprise
   4:  *
   5:  * Conforme aux exigences :
   6:  * - RGPD / CNIL
   7:  * - OWASP Top 10
   8:  * - Audit cabinet d'avocats
   9:  */
  10: 
  11: import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
  12: import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server';
  13: 
  14: /**
  15:  * Headers de securite OWASP compliant
  16:  */
  17: export function addSecurityHeaders(response: NextResponse): NextResponse {
  18:   const version = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION || 'unknown';
  19:   const commit = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_COMMIT || '';
  20: 
  21:   // CSP nonce pour scripts (élimine unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval)
  22:   const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64');
  23:   response.headers.set('x-nonce', nonce);
  24: 
  25:   const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development';
  26: 
  27:   const csp = [
  28:     "default-src 'self'",
  29:     isDev
  30:       ? "script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-inline'"
  31:       : `script-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'`,
  32:     "style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com",
  33:     "font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com",
  34:     "img-src 'self' data: https: blob:",
  35:     `connect-src 'self' ${isDev ? 'http://localhost:* ws://localhost:* wss://localhost:*' : 'https://api.* wss://*'}`,
  36:     "media-src 'self'",
  37:     "object-src 'none'",
  38:     "base-uri 'self'",
  39:     "form-action 'self'",
  40:     "frame-ancestors 'none'",
  41:     ...(isDev ? [] : ['upgrade-insecure-requests']),
  42:   ].join('; ');
  43: 
  44:   // Headers de securite obligatoires
  45:   response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', csp);
  46:   response.headers.set('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
  47:   response.headers.set('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
  48:   response.headers.set('Referrer-Policy', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin');
  49:   response.headers.set('X-XSS-Protection', '1; mode=block');
  50: 
  51:   // HSTS - Seulement en HTTPS
  52:   if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
  53:     response.headers.set(
  54:       'Strict-Transport-Security',
  55:       'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload'
  56:     );
  57:   }
  58: 
  59:   // Permissions Policy (anciennement Feature Policy)
  60:   const permissions = [
  61:     'camera=()',
  62:     'microphone=()',
  63:     'geolocation=()',
  64:     'payment=()',
  65:     'usb=()',
  66:     'magnetometer=()',
  67:     'gyroscope=()',
  68:     'accelerometer=()',
  69:   ].join(', ');
  70:   response.headers.set('Permissions-Policy', permissions);
  71: 
  72:   // Headers additionnels pour la confidentialite
  73:   response.headers.set('X-Powered-By', ''); // Masquer la technologie
  74:   response.headers.set('Server', ''); // Masquer le serveur
  75: 
  76:   // Headers de version applicative
  77:   response.headers.set('x-app-version', version);
  78:   if (commit) {
  79:     response.headers.set('x-build-commit', commit);
  80:   }
  81: 
  82:   return response;
  83: }
  84: 
  85: /**
  86:  * Configuration cookies securises
  87:  */
  88: export const SECURE_COOKIE_CONFIG = {
  89:   httpOnly: true,
  90:   secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  91:   sameSite: 'strict' as const,
  92:   maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, // 7 jours
  93:   path: '/',
  94: };
  95: 
  96: /**
  97:  * Rate limiting simple (en memoire)
  98:  */
  99: const rateLimitMap = new Map<string, { count: number; resetTime: number }>();
 100: 
 101: export function checkRateLimit(request: NextRequest, maxRequests = 100, windowMs = 60000): boolean {
 102:   const ip = (request as any).ip || request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || 'unknown';
 103:   const now = Date.now();
 104:   const windowStart = now - windowMs;
 105: 
 106:   const current = rateLimitMap.get(ip);
 107: 
 108:   if (!current || current.resetTime < windowStart) {
 109:     rateLimitMap.set(ip, { count: 1, resetTime: now + windowMs });
 110:     return true;
 111:   }
 112: 
 113:   if (current.count >= maxRequests) {
 114:     return false;
 115:   }
 116: 
 117:   current.count++;
 118:   return true;
 119: }
 120: 
 121: /**
 122:  * Validation des routes sensibles
 123:  */
 124: export function isSecureRoute(pathname: string): boolean {
 125:   const secureRoutes = [
 126:     '/api/admin',
 127:     '/api/tenant',
 128:     '/dashboard',
 129:     '/dossiers',
 130:     '/clients',
 131:     '/factures',
 132:     '/super-admin',
 133:   ];
 134: 
 135:   return secureRoutes.some(route => pathname.startsWith(route));
 136: }
 137: 
 138: /**
 139:  * Headers specifiques API
 140:  */
 141: export function addApiSecurityHeaders(response: NextResponse): NextResponse {
 142:   response.headers.set('X-API-Version', '1.0');
 143:   response.headers.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate');
 144:   response.headers.set('Pragma', 'no-cache');
 145:   response.headers.set('Expires', '0');
 146: 
 147:   return response;
 148: }
 149: 
 150: /**
 151:  * Validation CSRF simple
 152:  */
 153: export function validateCSRF(request: NextRequest): boolean {
 154:   if (request.method === 'GET') return true;
 155: 
 156:   const origin = request.headers.get('origin');
 157:   const referer = request.headers.get('referer');
 158:   const host = request.headers.get('host');
 159: 
 160:   if (!origin && !referer) return false;
 161: 
 162:   const allowedOrigins = [
 163:     `http://localhost:3000`,
 164:     `https://${host}`,
 165:     process.env.NEXTAUTH_URL,
 166:   ].filter(Boolean);
 167: 
 168:   return allowedOrigins.some(allowed => origin === allowed || referer?.startsWith(allowed + '/'));
 169: }

src\middleware\tenant-isolation.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Tenant Isolation Middleware
   3:  *
   4:  * Enforces multi-tenant data isolation at the middleware level.
   5:  * CRITICAL: Every API request must be scoped to the authenticated user's tenant.
   6:  */
   7: 
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: import { getAuthToken } from '@/lib/auth/nextauth-token';
  10: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
  11: 
  12: interface TenantContext {
  13:   tenantId: string;
  14:   userId: string;
  15:   role: 'SUPER_ADMIN' | 'ADMIN' | 'CLIENT';
  16: }
  17: 
  18: /**
  19:  * Extract tenant context from authenticated session
  20:  */
  21: export async function getTenantContext(req: NextRequest): Promise<TenantContext | null> {
  22:   try {
  23:     const token = await getAuthToken(req);
  24: 
  25:     if (!token) {
  26:       return null;
  27:     }
  28: 
  29:     return {
  30:       tenantId: (token as any).tenantId,
  31:       userId: (token as any).id || (token as any).sub,
  32:       role: (token as any).role,
  33:     };
  34:   } catch (error) {
  35:     logger.error('Failed to extract tenant context', error);
  36:     return null;
  37:   }
  38: }
  39: 
  40: /**
  41:  * Validate tenant access for a resource
  42:  */
  43: export function validateTenantAccess(
  44:   context: TenantContext,
  45:   resourceTenantId: string
  46: ): boolean {
  47:   // Super Admin can access all tenants
  48:   if (context.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  49:     return true;
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   // Other users can only access their own tenant
  53:   if (context.tenantId !== resourceTenantId) {
  54:     logger.warn('Tenant isolation violation attempt', {
  55:       userId: context.userId,
  56:       userTenantId: context.tenantId,
  57:       requestedTenantId: resourceTenantId,
  58:     });
  59:     return false;
  60:   }
  61: 
  62:   return true;
  63: }
  64: 
  65: /**
  66:  * Middleware wrapper for tenant-scoped API routes
  67:  */
  68: export function withTenantIsolation(
  69:   handler: (
  70:     req: NextRequest,
  71:     context: TenantContext
  72:   ) => Promise<NextResponse>
  73: ) {
  74:   return async (req: NextRequest): Promise<NextResponse> => {
  75:     // Extract tenant context
  76:     const context = await getTenantContext(req);
  77: 
  78:     if (!context) {
  79:       logger.warn('Unauthenticated request blocked', {
  80:         path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
  81:       });
  82: 
  83:       return NextResponse.json(
  84:         { error: 'Authentication required' },
  85:         { status: 401 }
  86:       );
  87:     }
  88: 
  89:     // Clients can only access their own data - enforce strict isolation
  90:     if (context.role === 'CLIENT') {
  91:       const pathParts = req.nextUrl.pathname.split('/');
  92:       const clientIdInPath = pathParts.find(part => part.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i));
  93: 
  94:       // For client routes, validate they're accessing their own data
  95:       if (clientIdInPath && clientIdInPath !== (context as any).clientId) {
  96:         logger.warn('Client attempted cross-client access', {
  97:           userId: context.userId,
  98:           attemptedClientId: clientIdInPath,
  99:         });
 100: 
 101:         return NextResponse.json(
 102:           { error: 'Access denied' },
 103:           { status: 403 }
 104:         );
 105:       }
 106:     }
 107: 
 108:     // Log tenant-scoped request
 109:     logger.info('Tenant-scoped request', {
 110:       tenantId: context.tenantId,
 111:       userId: context.userId,
 112:       role: context.role,
 113:       path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
 114:       method: req.method,
 115:     });
 116: 
 117:     try {
 118:       return await handler(req, context);
 119:     } catch (error) {
 120:       logger.error('Request handler error', error, {
 121:         tenantId: context.tenantId,
 122:         userId: context.userId,
 123:         path: req.nextUrl.pathname,
 124:       });
 125: 
 126:       return NextResponse.json(
 127:         { error: 'Internal server error' },
 128:         { status: 500 }
 129:       );
 130:     }
 131:   };
 132: }
 133: 
 134: /**
 135:  * Check if user has required role
 136:  */
 137: export function requireRole(
 138:   context: TenantContext,
 139:   allowedRoles: ('SUPER_ADMIN' | 'ADMIN' | 'CLIENT')[]
 140: ): boolean {
 141:   return allowedRoles.includes(context.role);
 142: }
 143: 
 144: /**
 145:  * Helper to build tenant-scoped Prisma where clause
 146:  */
 147: export function tenantWhere<T extends { tenantId?: string }>(
 148:   context: TenantContext,
 149:   additionalWhere?: Partial<T>
 150: ): T {
 151:   // Super Admin can query all tenants if no tenantId specified
 152:   if (context.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN' && !additionalWhere?.tenantId) {
 153:     return { ...additionalWhere } as T;
 154:   }
 155: 
 156:   // All other users are scoped to their tenant
 157:   return {
 158:     tenantId: context.tenantId,
 159:     ...additionalWhere,
 160:   } as T;
 161: }

src\middleware\withAuth.ts

   1: /**
   2:  * HOC (Higher Order Component) pour les routes API protÃ©gÃ©es
   3:  * Wrapper simplifiÃ© pour l'authentification
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { authOptions } from '@/lib/auth';
   7: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: 
  10: export interface AuthenticatedUser {
  11:   id: string;
  12:   email: string;
  13:   name?: string;
  14:   role: string;
  15:   tenantId?: string;
  16: }
  17: 
  18: export interface AuthenticatedContext {
  19:   user: AuthenticatedUser;
  20:   params?: Record<string, string>;
  21: }
  22: 
  23: type AuthenticatedHandler = (
  24:   req: NextRequest,
  25:   context: AuthenticatedContext
  26: ) => Promise<NextResponse>;
  27: 
  28: /**
  29:  * Wrapper pour protÃ©ger les routes API avec authentification
  30:  *
  31:  * @example
  32:  * export const GET = withAuth(async (req, { user }) => {
  33:  *   return NextResponse.json({ user });
  34:  * });
  35:  */
  36: export function withAuth(handler: AuthenticatedHandler) {
  37:   return async (
  38:     req: NextRequest,
  39:     context?: { params?: Record<string, string> }
  40:   ): Promise<NextResponse> => {
  41:     try {
  42:       const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  43: 
  44:       if (!session?.user) {
  45:         return NextResponse.json(
  46:           { error: 'Non authentifiÃ©', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' },
  47:           { status: 401 }
  48:         );
  49:       }
  50: 
  51:       const user: AuthenticatedUser = {
  52:         id: session.user.id || '',
  53:         email: session.user.email || '',
  54:         name: session.user.name || undefined,
  55:         role: (session.user as { role?: string }).role || 'user',
  56:         tenantId: (session.user as { tenantId?: string }).tenantId,
  57:       };
  58: 
  59:       return handler(req, {
  60:         user,
  61:         params: context?.params,
  62:       });
  63:     } catch (error) {
  64:       console.error('Erreur withAuth:', error);
  65:       return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur', code: 'SERVER_ERROR' }, { status: 500 });
  66:     }
  67:   };
  68: }
  69: 
  70: /**
  71:  * Wrapper avec vÃ©rification de rÃ´le
  72:  *
  73:  * @example
  74:  * export const GET = withRole(['admin', 'manager'])(async (req, { user }) => {
  75:  *   return NextResponse.json({ user });
  76:  * });
  77:  */
  78: export function withRole(allowedRoles: string[]) {
  79:   return (handler: AuthenticatedHandler) => {
  80:     return async (
  81:       req: NextRequest,
  82:       context?: { params?: Record<string, string> }
  83:     ): Promise<NextResponse> => {
  84:       try {
  85:         const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  86: 
  87:         if (!session?.user) {
  88:           return NextResponse.json(
  89:             { error: 'Non authentifiÃ©', code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' },
  90:             { status: 401 }
  91:           );
  92:         }
  93: 
  94:         const userRole = (session.user as { role?: string }).role || 'user';
  95: 
  96:         if (!allowedRoles.includes(userRole)) {
  97:           return NextResponse.json({ error: 'AccÃ¨s refusÃ©', code: 'FORBIDDEN' }, { status: 403 });
  98:         }
  99: 
 100:         const user: AuthenticatedUser = {
 101:           id: session.user.id || '',
 102:           email: session.user.email || '',
 103:           name: session.user.name || undefined,
 104:           role: userRole,
 105:           tenantId: (session.user as { tenantId?: string }).tenantId,
 106:         };
 107: 
 108:         return handler(req, {
 109:           user,
 110:           params: context?.params,
 111:         });
 112:       } catch (error) {
 113:         console.error('Erreur withRole:', error);
 114:         return NextResponse.json(
 115:           { error: 'Erreur serveur', code: 'SERVER_ERROR' },
 116:           { status: 500 }
 117:         );
 118:       }
 119:     };
 120:   };
 121: }

 123: /**

 131: export const withLawyer = withRole(['lawyer', 'admin', 'super_admin']);

src\middleware\zero-trust.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
   1: /**
   2:  * Middleware Zero-Trust pour Next.js
   3:  * Authentification + Autorisation + Journalisation
   4:  */
   5: 
   6: import { AuditHelpers, logAudit } from '@/lib/audit';
   7: import { getAuthToken } from '@/lib/auth/nextauth-token';
   8: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   9: 
  10: /**
  11:  * Extraction du contexte de la requete
  12:  */
  13: function extractContext(req: NextRequest): {
  14:   pathname: string;
  15:   tenantId: string | null;
  16:   resourceType: string | null;
  17:   method: string;
  18:   ip: string;
  19:   userAgent: string;
  20: } {
  21:   const pathname = req.nextUrl.pathname;
  22: 
  23:   // Extraction tenantId depuis l'URL (ex: /api/tenant/[id]/...)
  24:   const tenantMatch = pathname.match(/\/api\/tenant\/([^\/]+)/);
  25:   const tenantId: string | null = tenantMatch ? tenantMatch[1] : null;
  26: 
  27:   // Determination du type de ressource
  28:   let resourceType: string | null = null;
  29:   if (pathname.includes('/dossiers')) resourceType = 'Dossier';
  30:   else if (pathname.includes('/clients')) resourceType = 'Client';
  31:   else if (pathname.includes('/documents')) resourceType = 'Document';
  32:   else if (pathname.includes('/factures')) resourceType = 'Facture';
  33:   else if (pathname.includes('/tenants')) resourceType = 'Tenant';
  34: 
  35:   return {
  36:     pathname,
  37:     tenantId,
  38:     resourceType,
  39:     method: req.method,
  40:     ip: req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || req.headers.get('x-real-ip') || 'unknown',
  41:     userAgent: req.headers.get('user-agent') || 'unknown',
  42:   };
  43: }
  44: 
  45: /**
  46:  * Verification des autorisations
  47:  */
  48: async function checkAuthorization(
  49:   user: any,
  50:   tenantId: string | null,
  51:   resourceType: string | null,
  52:   method: string
  53: ): Promise<{ authorized: boolean; reason?: string }> {
  54:   // SUPER_ADMIN : acces structure uniquement, pas au contenu
  55:   if (user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN') {
  56:     // Peut acceder aux routes /api/super-admin
  57:     if (resourceType === 'Tenant') {
  58:       return { authorized: true };
  59:     }
  60:     // Ne peut PAS acceder au contenu des tenants
  61:     if (tenantId && resourceType !== 'Tenant') {
  62:       return {
  63:         authorized: false,
  64:         reason: 'SUPER_ADMIN ne peut acceder au contenu des tenants',
  65:       };
  66:     }
  67:   }
  68: 
  69:   // ADMIN : doit appartenir au meme tenant
  70:   if (user.role === 'ADMIN') {
  71:     if (!tenantId) {
  72:       return { authorized: true }; // Routes non tenant-specific
  73:     }
  74:     if (user.tenantId !== tenantId) {
  75:       return {
  76:         authorized: false,
  77:         reason: 'Acces cross-tenant interdit',
  78:       };
  79:     }
  80:     return { authorized: true };
  81:   }
  82: 
  83:   // CLIENT : acces restreint a ses propres donnees
  84:   if (user.role === 'CLIENT') {
  85:     // Les clients ne peuvent acceder qu'a leurs propres dossiers
  86:     if (method === 'GET' && (resourceType === 'Dossier' || resourceType === 'Facture')) {
  87:       // Verification additionnelle necessaire au niveau de la route
  88:       return { authorized: true };
  89:     }
  90:     // Pas de creation/modification pour les clients
  91:     if (method !== 'GET') {
  92:       return {
  93:         authorized: false,
  94:         reason: 'Les clients ne peuvent que consulter',
  95:       };
  96:     }
  97:   }
  98: 
  99:   return { authorized: true };
 100: }
 101: 
 102: /**
 103:  * Routes publiques (pas de verification)
 104:  */
 105: 
 106: const PUBLIC_ROUTES = ['/api/auth/', '/_next/', '/favicon.ico', '/manifest.webmanifest', '/sw.js'];
 107: 
 108: function isPublicRoute(pathname: string): boolean {
 109:   return PUBLIC_ROUTES.some(route => pathname.startsWith(route));
 110: }
 111: 
 112: /**
 113:  * Middleware principal Zero-Trust
 114:  */
 115: export async function zeroTrustMiddleware(req: NextRequest) {
 116:   const context = extractContext(req);
 117: 
 118:   // Routes publiques : bypass
 119:   if (isPublicRoute(context.pathname)) {
 120:     return NextResponse.next();
 121:   }
 122: 
 123:   // 1. AUTHENTIFICATION
 124:   const token = await getAuthToken(req);
 125: 
 126:   if (!token) {
 127:     // Log tentative d'acces non authentifie
 128:     await logAudit({
 129:       action: 'UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS',
 130:       objectType: (context.resourceType as any) || 'Unknown',
 131:       metadata: {
 132:         pathname: context.pathname,
 133:         method: context.method,
 134:       },
 135:       ipAddress: context.ip || null,
 136:       userAgent: context.userAgent,
 137:       success: false,
 138:       errorMessage: 'Non authentifie',
 139:     });
 140: 
 141:     return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non authentifie' }, { status: 401 });
 142:   }
 143: 
 144:   // 2. AUTORISATION
 145:   const authCheck = await checkAuthorization(
 146:     token as any,
 147:     context.tenantId,
 148:     context.resourceType,
 149:     context.method
 150:   );
 151: 
 152:   if (!authCheck.authorized) {
 153:     // Log acces non autorise
 154:     await AuditHelpers.logUnauthorizedAccess(
 155:       (token.id as string) || 'anonymous',
 156:       context.tenantId as string | null,
 157:       (context.resourceType as any) || 'Unknown',
 158:       'route',
 159:       authCheck.reason || 'Non autorise',
 160:       context.ip || undefined
 161:     );
 162: 
 163:     return NextResponse.json({ error: authCheck.reason || 'Non autorise' }, { status: 403 });
 164:   }
 165: 
 166:   // 3. JOURNALISATION (actions sensibles uniquement)
 167:   if (context.method !== 'GET' || context.resourceType === 'Document') {
 168:     await logAudit({
 169:       tenantId: context.tenantId as string | undefined,
 170:       userId: token.id as string,
 171:       userRole: token.role as string,
 172:       action: context.method as any,
 173:       objectType: (context.resourceType as any) || 'Unknown',
 174:       metadata: {
 175:         pathname: context.pathname,
 176:       },
 177:       ipAddress: context.ip || null,
 178:       userAgent: context.userAgent,
 179:       success: true,
 180:     });
 181:   }
 182: 
 183:   // 4. PASSAGE a LA RESSOURCE
 184:   return NextResponse.next();
 185: }
 186: 
 187: /**
 188:  * Configuration du middleware
 189:  */
 190: export const config = {
 191:   matcher: ['/api/:path*', '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)'],
 192: };

 171:     const delay = (ms: number) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
 172:     
 173:     for (let i = 0; i < requests; i++) {
 174:       await delay(100); // 100ms between requests = 10 req/s max
 175:     }
 176:     
 177:     const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
 178:     expect(elapsed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(requests * 100 - 50); // Allow some tolerance
 179:   });

   4: import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';

   6: describe('SaaS Provisioning', () => {
   7:   describe('Subdomain generation', () => {
   8:     function generateSubdomain(cabinetName: string): string {
   9:       const base = cabinetName
  10:         .toLowerCase()
  11:         .normalize('NFD')
  12:         .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
  13:         .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')
  14:         .replace(/-+/g, '-')
  15:         .replace(/^-|-$/g, '')
  16:         .slice(0, 30);
  17:       const suffix = Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
  18:       return `${base}-${suffix}`;
  19:     }
  20:

src\app\api\documents\[id]\route.ts
