   1: import { authOptions } from '@/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route';
   2: import { canAccessDossier } from '@/lib/auth/dossier-access';
   3: import { getBlobServiceClient } from '@/lib/azure/clients';
   4: import { logger } from '@/lib/logger';
   5: import { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';
   6: import { getServerSession } from 'next-auth';
   7: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
   8: 
   9: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
  10: export const runtime = 'nodejs';
  11: 
  12: export async function DELETE(
  13:   _request: NextRequest,
  14:   { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
  15: ) {
  16:   try {
  17:     const session = await getServerSession(authOptions);
  18: 
  19:     if (!session?.user) {
  20:       return NextResponse.json(
  21:         { error: 'Non authentifie' },
  22:         { status: 401 }
  23:       );
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     const user = session.user as {
  27:       id?: string;
  28:       tenantId?: string;
  29:       role?: string;
  30:       groups?: string[];
  31:     };
  32: 
  33:     if (!user.id || !user.tenantId) {
  34:       return NextResponse.json(
  35:         { error: 'Acces interdit' },
  36:         { status: 403 }
  37:       );
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     const { id } = await params;
  41: 
  42:     if (!id) {
  43:       return NextResponse.json(
  44:         { error: 'ID document requis' },
  45:         { status: 400 }
  46:       );
  47:     }
  48: 
  49:     const document = await prisma.document.findFirst({
  50:       where: {
  51:         id,
  52:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  53:       },
  54:       select: {
  55:         id: true,
  56:         dossierId: true,
  57:         storageKey: true,
  58:       },
  59:     });
  60: 
  61:     if (!document) {
  62:       return NextResponse.json(
  63:         { error: 'Document non trouve' },
  64:         { status: 404 }
  65:       );
  66:     }
  67: 
  68:     if (document.dossierId) {
  69:       const access = await canAccessDossier({
  70:         userId: user.id,
  71:         tenantId: user.tenantId,
  72:         role: user.role,
  73:         groups: user.groups,
  74:         dossierId: document.dossierId,
  75:         action: 'read',
  76:       });
  77: 
  78:       if (!access.allowed) {
  79:         return NextResponse.json(
  80:           { error: 'Document non trouve' },
  81:           { status: 404 }
  82:         );
  83:       }
  84:     } else if (user.role === 'CLIENT') {
  85:       return NextResponse.json(
  86:         { error: 'Acces interdit' },
  87:         { status: 403 }
  88:       );
  89:     }
  90: 
  91:     try {
  92:       if (document.storageKey.startsWith('azure://')) {
  93:         const storagePath = document.storageKey.slice('azure://'.length);
  94:         const [container, ...blobParts] = storagePath.split('/');
  95:         const blobName = blobParts.join('/');
  96: 
  97:         if (container && blobName) {
  98:           await getBlobServiceClient()
  99:             .getContainerClient(container)
 100:             .getBlockBlobClient(blobName)
 101:             .deleteIfExists();
 102:         }
 103:       } else if (document.storageKey.startsWith('/uploads/')) {
 104:         const fs = await import('fs/promises');
 105:         const path = await import('path');
 106: 
 107:         const uploadsDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
 108:         const relativePath = document.storageKey.replace(/^\/uploads\//, '');
 109: 
 110:         if (
 111:           relativePath.includes('..') ||
 112:           relativePath.includes('%2e')
 113:         ) {
 114:           return NextResponse.json(
 115:             { error: 'Chemin invalide' },
 116:             { status: 400 }
 117:           );
 118:         }
 119: 
 120:         const filePath = path.resolve(uploadsDir, relativePath);
 121: 
 122:         if (!filePath.startsWith(uploadsDir + path.sep)) {
 123:           return NextResponse.json(
 124:             { error: 'Chemin invalide' },
 125:             { status: 400 }
 126:           );
 127:         }
 128: 
 129:         await fs.unlink(filePath).catch(() => {});
 130:       }
 131:     } catch (storageError) {
 132:       logger.warn('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Erreur suppression stockage', {
 133:         documentId: id,
 134:         error: storageError,
 135:       });
 136:     }
 137: 
 138:     await prisma.document.delete({
 139:       where: {
 140:         id: document.id,
 141:       },
 142:     });
 143: 
 144:     logger.info('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Document supprime', {
 145:       documentId: document.id,
 146:       userId: user.id,
 147:     });
 148: 
 149:     return NextResponse.json({
 150:       success: true,
 151:       id: document.id,
 152:     });
 153:   } catch (error) {
 154:     logger.error('[DOCUMENT DELETE] Erreur:', { error });
 155: 
 156:     return NextResponse.json(
 157:       { error: 'Erreur lors de la suppression du document' },
 158:       { status: 500 }
 159:     );
 160:   }
 161: }

  42: export async function uploadFile(
  43:   file: File,
  44:   options: UploadOptions
  45: ): Promise<StoredFile> {
  46:   const maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
  47: 
  48:   if (file.size === 0) {
  49:     throw new Error('Le fichier est vide');
  50:   }
  51: 
  52:   if (file.size > maxSize) {
  53:     throw new Error('Le fichier est trop volumineux (max 10 MB)');
  54:   }
  55: 
  56:   if (!options.dossierId) {
  57:     throw new Error('Dossier requis pour envoyer le fichier');
  58:   }
  59: 
  60:   const allowedTypes = [
  61:     'application/pdf',
  62:     'image/jpeg',
  63:     'image/png',
  64:     'image/webp',
  65:     'image/gif',
  66:     'application/msword',
  67:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  68:     'application/vnd.ms-excel',
  69:     'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
  70:     'text/plain',
  71:   ];
  72: 
  73:   if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
  74:     throw new Error('Type de fichier non autorise');
  75:   }
  76: 
  77:   const formData = new FormData();
  78: 
  79:   formData.append('file', file);
  80:   formData.append('dossierId', options.dossierId);
  81:   formData.append('type', options.category || 'piece_jointe');
  82:   formData.append('description', options.description || '');
  83: 
  84:   const response = await fetch('/api/documents/upload', {
  85:     method: 'POST',
  86:     body: formData,
  87:     credentials: 'include',
  88:   });
  89: 
  90:   const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  91: 
  92:   if (!response.ok) {
  93:     throw new Error(
  94:       data.error || `Erreur lors de l'upload (${response.status})`
  95:     );
  96:   }
  97: 
  98:   if (!data.document?.id) {
  99:     throw new Error('Reponse serveur invalide');
 100:   }
 101: 
 102:   const document = data.document;
 103: 
 104:   const storedFile: StoredFile = {
 105:     id: document.id,
 106:     name: document.fileName || document.filename || file.name,
 107:     originalName: document.originalName || file.name,
 108:     size: document.fileSize ?? document.size ?? file.size,
 109:     mimeType: document.fileType || document.mimeType || file.type,
 110:     url: `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(document.id)}`,
 111:     uploadedAt: new Date(),
 112:     uploadedBy: 'current_user',
 113:     version: 1,
 114:     parentId: options.parentId,
 115:     tags: options.tags || [],
 116:     metadata: {
 117:       dossierId: options.dossierId,
 118:       clientId: options.clientId,
 119:       category: options.category || 'piece_jointe',
 120:       description: options.description,
 121:     },
 122:   };
 123: 
 124:   logger.info('Fichier uploade avec succes', {
 125:     fileId: storedFile.id,
 126:     filename: storedFile.name,
 127:     size: storedFile.size,
 128:   });
 129: 
 130:   return storedFile;
 131: }

 133: export function downloadFile(file: StoredFile): void {
 134:   const link = document.createElement('a');
 135: 
 136:   link.href = `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(file.id)}`;
 137:   link.download = file.originalName;
 138:   link.rel = 'noopener';
 139: 
 140:   document.body.appendChild(link);
 141:   link.click();
 142:   link.remove();
 143: }

 145: export function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
 146:   if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
 147: 
 148:   const k = 1024;
 149:   const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
 150:   const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
 151: 
 152:   return `${Math.round((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)) * 100) / 100} ${sizes[i]}`;
 153: }
 154: 
 155: export function getFileIcon(mimeType: string): string {
 156:   if (mimeType.startsWith('image/')) return 'Image';
 157:   if (mimeType === 'application/pdf') return 'PDF';
 158:   if (mimeType.includes('word')) return 'Word';
 159: 
 160:   if (
 161:     mimeType.includes('excel') ||
 162:     mimeType.includes('spreadsheet')
 163:   ) {
 164:     return 'Excel';
 165:   }
 166: 
 167:   if (mimeType.includes('text')) return 'Texte';
 168: 
 169:   return 'Fichier';
 170: }

 186: export async function getStoredFiles(filters?: {
 187:   dossierId?: string;
 188:   clientId?: string;
 189:   category?: string;
 190:   tags?: string[];
 191: }): Promise<StoredFile[]> {
 192:   if (!filters?.dossierId) {
 193:     return [];
 194:   }
 195: 
 196:   const params = new URLSearchParams();
 197:   params.set('dossierId', filters.dossierId);
 198:   params.set('limit', '100');
 199: 
 200:   const response = await fetch(
 201:     `/api/documents/upload?${params.toString()}`,
 202:     {
 203:       method: 'GET',
 204:       credentials: 'include',
 205:       cache: 'no-store',
 206:     }
 207:   );
 208: 
 209:   const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
 210: 
 211:   if (!response.ok) {
 212:     throw new Error(
 213:       data.error || 'Impossible de recuperer les documents'
 214:     );
 215:   }
 216: 
 217:   return (data.documents || []).map(
 218:     (document: any): StoredFile => ({
 219:       id: document.id,
 220:       name: document.filename,
 221:       originalName: document.originalName || document.filename,
 222:       size: document.size,
 223:       mimeType: document.mimeType,
 224:       url: `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(document.id)}`,
 225:       uploadedAt: new Date(document.createdAt),
 226:       uploadedBy: document.uploadedBy || '',
 227:       version: 1,
 228:       tags: [],
 229:       metadata: {
 230:         dossierId: document.dossierId || undefined,
 231:         clientId: document.clientId || undefined,
 232:         category:
 233:           document.category === 'piece_jointe' ||
 234:           document.category === 'document_genere' ||
 235:           document.category === 'template' ||
 236:           document.category === 'autre'
 237:             ? document.category
 238:             : 'autre',
 239:         description: document.description || undefined,
 240:       },
 241:     })
 242:   );
 243: }
 244: 
 245: export async function getFileVersions(
 246:   fileId: string
 247: ): Promise<StoredFile[]> {
 248:   const response = await fetch(
 249:     `/api/documents/download/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}`,
 250:     {
 251:       method: 'HEAD',
 252:       credentials: 'include',
 253:     }
 254:   );
 255: 
 256:   if (!response.ok) {
 257:     return [];
 258:   }
 259: 
 260:   return [];
 261: }
 262: 
 263: export async function deleteFile(fileId: string): Promise<void> {
 264:   const response = await fetch(
 265:     `/api/documents/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}`,
 266:     {
 267:       method: 'DELETE',
 268:       credentials: 'include',
 269:     }
 270:   );
 271: 
 272:   const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
 273: 
 274:   if (!response.ok) {
 275:     throw new Error(
 276:       data.error || 'Impossible de supprimer le document'
 277:     );
 278:   }
 279: 
 280:   logger.info('Fichier supprime', { fileId });
 281: }
